comments: Bruno was a very friendly and helpfull host. The location is good with a bakery 1min away and also the beach and the supermarcet can be reached by foot. We really enjoyed our time in the House.

This is a gorgeous appartment. Paula & Sergio are super friendly and welcoming and all their little pamphlets and maps of the area were very helpful. We would definitely look in to staying here again if we were to return to Porto. It was a home away from home. Thanks for a great stay!
Paula was great, very helpful and always available if we needed anything. The house is in a very central location and is lovely with great art and woodwork.

Paula's flat is really beautiful; it has loads of space and is full of great artwork. It's in a great location, close to transport and shops and within easy walking distance of the old town. Paula and her husband are extremely welcoming hosts and make you feel at home straight away. Highly recommended.
Paula was very nice, she explained us how to get around and even gave us a personalized map. The apartment is super clean and very beautiful and elegant. We had an amazing time there!

Absolutely loved this apartment! We had an amazing stay and Paula was extremely helpful throughout the whole trip. She waited for us to get there from the train station and had a personal map her husband made for us to use. The apartment is exactly what you expect, so homey and clean. If it hadn't been raining we would have been outside on the beautiful balcony all the time. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone! If we ever make it back, we are for sure staying here again! (Great location too)

We have had a wonderfull week in this apartment. It was very clean. We had a warm welcome by Paula, who explained us everything we needed to know.. Sergio showed us eveything we wanted to know at a ,by himself made, map of the apartment and surroundings in Porto. The three level-apartment is beautiful decorated with colourful paintings. We felt very at home there. The view from the large sunterrace over Porto was marvellous. We would return to this apartment again with a next visit to Porto. Thank you, Sergio, for bringing our luggage with your car to Trindade, when we left for the airport.

Thank you so much Paula for a fabulous stay!!!! The location of the apartment was perfect for us to walk from to explore Porto and we loved popping back for a little relax each day before heading back out to explore more. The apartment was very tidy and there was everything we needed for a fantastic stay. We had an amazing time at the apartment and loved Porto! Thanks again Paula!
Best house ever stayed with AirBnB ! Totally recommended! 1. Excellent location  2.lovely host 3. Safe environment and surroundings

This multistory flat is located just far enough out of the center of town that it feels like a place where real people live, but close enough in so you can easily walk to all the attractions. Paula was helpful in orienting my mom and I to Porto, and offered a whole slew of ideas on how we might spend our time. Bed comfy, pictures accurate, terrace lovely.

This is a lovely flat, and the pictures capture it accurately.  We had a fantastic time. The map with the personal recommendations was amazing. There is lots of room in the flat, and when the weather is great, it would be amazing to take advantage of the lovely terrace.  The disadvantage for me was the distance from the centre.  Although you start to reach the shopping area within a 12 minute walk, the bars and restaurants are about 25 minutes  away, and the flat is at the top of a hill.  (Which is quite a distance when it's pouring down with rain...) Although Uber taxis are very cheap in Porto, so it made no difference to our stay.

Paula was the perfect host! The apartment was charming, cozy, and very comfortable. (And beautifully decorated, also!) Paula had a lovely basket of treats waiting for us when we arrived, which we thoroughly enjoyed. She not only gave us full instructions on all the amenities of the apartment (washing machine, heating, cooking, etc.) but also on how to best get around the city and even offered to make restaurant reservations for us if we needed help with the language barrier. She was always quick to reply to questions before we arrived and we knew that if we needed help while we were there, she would have been ready and willing. We would come back to this location again and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Porto.
The apartment could not be more well placed. Directly on the principal street where there’s all the shopping to do. Only thing is its noisy at night!
Very comfortable and spacious with great sitting areas. Close to the main shopping strip and also to public transport. Paula was a great host
Such a nice place. Quite confortable. Close to a metro station but relatively near to the city centre.

A pleasant few days in Porto. Paula was very helpful and communicated in a timely manner both before and during the trip. The map and advice upon arrival was extremely helpful.  We particularly enjoyed the terrace for a relax after a day seeing the sights or a evening drink.  The apartment is located about 15 minutes from the centre and 30 minutes from the river. However we still walked to all the main sites and there are some metro stops close by.

Great apartment! Location is ideal. Paula and her husband are perfect hosts. They have literally thought of everything. Maps , to a great bottle of Port (and the basket of cookies). Apartment is spotless and very roomy. We loved the terrace to sip a glass of red after a day of touring. We liked heading up the street to avoid heavy tourist area. The cafes and restaurants are excellent. Lots of bakeries and cafes close.  Stay here. You will not regret it! Thank you Paula x
Locality of apartment is very good, only 10 minutes away from shops and restaurant, road noise is noticeable but not an issue for us

The apartment was simply great and well located.  There’s a lot of space and everything was clean.  We particularly enjoyed the terrace which offers an amazing view on the city center.  The host, Paula, is very nice and friendly. She helped us a lot giving us useful information during our stay ☺️ So thank you Paula!  I totally recommend this accommodation! 😄

We loved our stay at Paula’s apartment. The location was perfect for sightseeing the downtown area and visiting the Bolhão Market. It had all of the basic necessities that we needed.  There are lots of windows which were great for letting in the natural light, but since our visit was in mid-November they did make the apartment a little chilly. The heaters in the bedrooms were great.  We were specifically looking for an apartment with laundry so we could wash our clothes while travelling, but the clothes didn’t dry overnight on the drying rack. We ended up using the dryer at the laundromat not too far (in the summer it would probably dry quickly).  It was so nice that Paula came to meet us to give us a tour of the apartment, give us the key and answer any questions we had. She provided a map of the local area and responded quickly to messages. The apartment is beautiful and very unique!
Paula’s place is well located. It is walkable to the downtown area which has lots of shopping.

Obrigada! Paula was a super host! Great stay! Straight walk down hill to Main Street with shops and eateries! Apartment had gorgeous view. All amenities in apartment! Washer, WiFi, blow dryer. You make it! Obrigada!

This a true home away from home, and made our vacation just that much better!  At day’s end, we looked forward to retreating to this spotless apartment that clearly has received love and care by its owner. From its art to its book collection, its spacious bedrooms and beautiful sunroom and terrace, the apartment wants for nothing. Paula is super responsive and exceptionally considerate — even providing personalized walking maps for us! I have stayed in Airbnbs all over the world, and this — by far — was my favorite. Was even better than the description — I didn’t know that was possible. Thank you, Paula, for a wonderful and memorable stay! Can’t wait to come back!

Nice house, great amenities. The pool area is a plus. The Host doesn't speak English, so plan accordingly. The gate getting in and out of the property is on a curve and a little scary at times with oncoming traffic. Losts of room to spread out.

We’ve just come back from a family holiday at this amazing villa. It’s spacious and catered for all our needs, the kids loved the pool and the garden with all its fruit and veg. The best thing about the pool is the kids section for a peace-of-mind swimming experience. The neighbour who hands over the key is very helpful, but only speaks Portuguese, so we’ve used a translation programme on our phones to understand. The location is good, 30 mins by car from Porto, 15 mins from the nearest beach. You can hear the nearest motorway, though and at nighttime dogs are sometimes disturbing with their barking. We’ve had a great time at the villa!

A lovely old house that perfectly suited our family holiday. The pool was brilliant for the kids to thrash around in and the outdoor cooking area was great too. It's in a nice area - quiet and not very touristy, but also slightly out-of-the-way. So having the hire car was very useful.

Hugo's flat is in a superb location in Porto. It has the great combination of being in a lovely old building but renovated in a modern and well thought out way. There are some lovely design touches - him and his wife have great taste. Hugo was there waiting for us when we arrived with a smile, and a welcoming glass of port was much appreciated as well! This place comes highly recommended. Our only regret is that we didn't book it for longer.

Hugo was an excellent host and the apartment was perfect for our stay. Hugo picked us up at the metro station (even though we were an hour late!) and also provided maps and other travel information. The apartment is furnished with modern furniture and appliances and was very comfortable.   A great host.

Perfect apartment!! Quite, clean, well-located and well-equipped! Ideally for a couple! Hugo is a great host: very kind and welcoming! To sum-up, as Hugo say "Each detail is important!". I definitely recommend that apartment! :)
Apartment is just great and perfectly located. Very nicely decorated and clean. We enjoyed our stay and can only recommend toc toc studio !!!

My husband and I had a really enjoyable stay at Hugo's lovely and cozy apartment.  The location was very ideal and within walking access to all the major sites in Porto.  The waterfront was only a 10 minute stroll as was the commercial center of Porto.  The apartment is tastefully decorated and exceptionally clean and fully stocked with coffee, tea, extra towels, pillows and blankets.  There's everything we needed for a comfortable weekend stay and the nice, firm bed was a bonus. Location was quiet and peaceful at night as well.  Although we didn't meet Hugo personally but his friend met with us to hand over the keys and she was very friendly and prompt.  All in all, we had a very good experience at a reasonable cost.  We were very happy all around and would definitely stay again if we're ever in Porto again.

We loved staying at the toc toc studio! Not very far from a metro stop and the location was perfect for getting around the city.  The studio was very clean, beautifully decorated and had all we needed.  Our flight arrived early in the morning and we were able to leave our luggage at the cafe below while we walked around the city.  Hugo was a terrific host and met us to let us in the apartment.  He gave us great recommendations on places to go and eat.  A terrific host! Highly recommended!

Hugo is the perfect host and TocToc Studio is wonderfully and quietly located in the old city. It offers all the comfort you need. My friend Carine and I were and are still very enthusiastic about our stay in Porto. We will definitely recommend TocToc Studio to our friends if they are looking for a nice and cosy place in Porto !

Very nice place to stay in Porto. Hugo was waiting for us in the studio and gave use some tips to do in Porto. As we were only staying for a few days we could not try them all ;-) Very well equipped room and really great bed. If we ever come back to Porto it will be in toc toc studio.

Hugo was a gem! Great, thorough recommendations for the area, and beyond. Super nice, helpful, communicative guy. The location of this charming little apartment couldn't be better. It was gorgeous, clean, comfortable and well-equipped. You can tell a lot of love went into putting the place together. We had a wonderful time.

The apartment, in the city center, is very comfortable with a nice decoration. It includes all needed equipment. Hugo is very welcoming and thoughtfull.  However, the apartment is a bit noisy and make sure that you can let your luggage to the restaurant downstair otherwise you will have to take them with you the whole day when leaving (as it arrived to us)…

We had such an amazing time at Toc Toc studio. Hugo promptly met us outside the building and gave us a very thorough and friendly tour. Everything about the studio was perfect. Everything we needed was there, big amazing windows, and central location. Hugo had complimentary port waiting for us which was wonderful. Hugo had fantastic suggestions for enjoying Porto. We definitely recommend Toc Toc Studio. Thanks Hugo!

We could not have asked for a lovelier place to stay while we were in Porto. Hugo Figueiredo, our host met us outside the apartment, then escorted us up to the apartment, showing us around and how to work the television and stereo. Hugo recommended several eating establishments that were superb and very enjoyable. The apartment is close to shopping, dining and many area churches and other areas of interest. Everything is within walking distance, however, the local transportation is very easy to use and convenient. We would definitely stay at one of Hugo's properties again as they are very well kept up, and he is a pleasure to work with.  We truly enjoyed our visit to Porto and Hugo and his apartment made our stay that much more enjoyable.
Very nice days  in Porto. The appartment was in a perfect situation to visit and have fiesta. Thanks Hugo for the advices.

It was my 3rd business trip to Porto so I've seen a few apartments in town. The toctoc studio was by far the best "home" I've booked in Portugal. Hugo is a great host and the description says it all. Actually it's even better!

Hugo gave us a very useful tour of the apartment when we arrived and was very welcoming. The apartment is very nicely decorated and well equipped. The location was perfect for us, just next to the city centre and an easy walk to everything. Thanks for a lovely stay. Would definitely recommend.

Hugo made us feel welcome and gave us many tips on what to see and do. We had lost our luggage and Hugo helped us with the delivery of the suitcases and taking care of the communication with the delivery staff, allowing us to enjoy our stay in Porto. The studio is very nice, close to the attractions you want to see. Highly recommended!

Toc too studio was the ideal location for our visit to Porto. Everything you wish to see was within walking distance- such a fantastic city to 'get lost' in the streets. Hugo ensured we felt welcome and provided us with some local knowledge. A fantastic host- Hugo made himself available 24/7 if we had any concerns- of which we had none. Sorry we ran out of time to write in the book this morning- we just had to take in some more sights before leaving. Thank you so very much Hugo.

Hei Hugo,  Your appartement is fantastic, the localisation is perfect and thank for your precious informations. Thank for your intention... ! We will recommand you to our friends. See you soon. Audrey and her familly

We had a wonderful stay at Hugo's apartment. From the moment we arrived Hugo made us feel welcome and took time to provide recommendations for the length of our stay. He was incredibly efficient responding to any queries we had before arriving and during our visit to Porto.    On the apartment itself, it is situated in an excellent location enabling convenient walks to many of Porto's attractions. There are a few nice restaurants on the street and two cafes directly outside the apartment where you can grab traditional Portuguese breakfast. It was clean, tidy and well serviced with everything you would need for a short stay in the city. Highly recommended for anyone seeking to visit Porto.

Whoa, what a beautiful apartment! We really enjoyed our stay in Porto. Hugo was really good to us, it's easy to see that he enjoys what he does, he took the time to go through a map of Porto with us and he was very thorough showing us around the apartment. The apartment is as pictured and is in a great location. We would definitely recommend it.

We loved this wonderful studio apartment.... Well situated, very clean and inviting.  Hugo met us at the apt and made us feel welcomed - showing us local attractions on the map . We would highly recommend this wonderful apartment...

My friends really enjoyed staying at Hugo's place. He was really helpful and welcoming, the appartment is beautiful, comfy and clean just like the pictures, and with everything you may need. We trully recommend this place.
Great location and Hugo was a perfect host. Was waiting at the apartment even though our flight was delayed and gave lots of useful advice.
The apartment is great,wonderful location in center.Hugo is a great host.We have had a lovely few days in Porto.

Thanks Hugo for the amazing stay ! Flat is stunning, very clean and comfortable with all amenities. It is very well located in the city centre of Porto. Hugo has given us very nice tips to enjoy the city. We are definitely recommending the place and will go back here if we come back to Porto

We had a fantastic stay in hugo's apartment! He was a wonderful host and greeted us warmly with a map of the best sights and restaurants in Porto.  The flat is just as beautiful as it looks in the photos, with everything you need and in a superb location. Thanks Hugo!

We had a great stay at Hugo's apartment in Porto. It is fully equipped with everything one might need during the stay and it welcomes one with its cosy and stylish charm. Hugo is a great host and provided us with several tips and a map showing us his recommended places to go. We would definitely recommend to stay at Hugo's place!

We had an amazing stay at toc toc studio! Hugo is a great host, we forgot the keys in the house one day and he managed quickly to send someone open it for us. The house is fully equipped, cozy, well decorated, clean, very comfortable bed and perfect location to enjoy porto. I would definitely come back here next time I visit.

This was a perfect place to stay. The house is fully equipped with whatever you may need, is spotlessly clean, super close to everything Porto has to offer, and Hugo was extremely communicative and a real professional host. Highly recommended if staying in Porto!
Can't imagine a better place to stay in Porto! The location is unbeatable, the space itself is well-equipped and quiet, and Hugo was easy to communicate with and very helpful.

Hugo is the most professional host I've ever met. The apartment is situated in the very central location in the UNESCO heritage. Beautifully decorated and well equipped. Hugo shares his own recommendations of what is best to see and where to eat! Very handy!

Hugo is a great host. He will give you tips and show you around. Very helpfull.  We have enjoyed our stay at toc toc studio. The location is top, the appartment modern andnice to stay. We have got a nice Port from Hugo.  The kitchen and bathroom have all you will need.  Great restaurants are nearby and you can walk everywhete.

Yes, the place is great, accurate, clean and in a phenomenal location. Would stay here again.  What I need to emphasize though is how wonderful of a host Hugo is. I’ve been to many Airbnb’s through the years and Hugo went above and beyond any host I’ve previously encountered. From communication to his personalized recommendation map (what a touch!), my trip was completely enhanced because of Hugo.
Hugo and Paula were amazing hosts - helped us get in and out, gave us local tips, and were super accommodating. The apartment is super nice and in an amazing location.

We had an amazing time at Hugo's. Definitely one of the nicest Airbnb's I've stayed in. His personalised map of the city was crucial to our stay and he was extremely easy to communicate with throughout the duration of our trip. The location is incredible - nice, safe area - and has two great restaurants at the end of the street as well as a good cafe just downstairs. We had an amazing time, Hugo is an incredible host.

Hugo is a great host, he gave us so many recommendations and helped us with everything we needed! The apartment is very clean, in a great location, the area is very silence (so you can sleep well), great facilities- we had everything we needed.
Great studio in a good location. Hugo was friendly and gave us lots of helpful advice. It was a quiet place to stay and the bed was super comfy. Thanks Hugo!

Located in the city centre just steps away from the Clock Tower, this apartment provides easy walking access to all the key tourist sites as well as many, local restaurants.  Hugo was super welcoming and helped map out our itinerary for our Porto visit - invaluable on a tight schedule!
Hugo is a very accommodating host.  His place is in a great location with all the amenities you could want/need.  As well, his restaurant recommendations are pretty great.

Much better than expected, perfect stay at Hugo's. Communication is quick and efficient, place is stylish, cosy and totally clean, it's in the historical old Porto building. Very strategic location, in the centre of (night and day) life yet calm place.  Will recommend the place and come again!

Amazing hospitality! Hugo was patient, helpful and charming. The apartment was quiet yet well positioned to explore the city. His tips on what to do we’re very helpful.  We were even allowed to store our bags with his friend at the coffee shop below the apartment. Absolutely awesome!

Hugo was a delightful host, with great tips to share about Porto. Toctoc studio is perfect for a short stay in Porto, very well situated (near the photographic museum, the miradouro and  a great tapas joint all worth a visit). Bright place, very comfortable bed and a welcome complimentary carafe of port. Highly recommended.

Hugo was easy to communicate with prior and at arrival.  He met us at the apartment and explained the amenities plus shared a map with great recommendations.  His welcome gift was a carafe of great Port wine that we really enjoyed!  The apartment was clean and comfortable, it is on a quiet back street and next to everything.  Midpoint to walk upper and lower Porto.  I would give it a rating higher then 5* if available.  Certainly recommend!
Beautiful studio full of great details (coffee, bottle of Porto wine...) Hugo is a great host and made everything very easy. We stayed with two kids and it was perfect for some days

Porto is a beautiful, walkable city, and Hugo’s place sits on a lovely quiet street just 2 minutes from shops and restaurants. There is a park, a gelato shop, a wine bar, and a cozy restaurant just at the doorstep. Hugo was amazingly gracious and took the time to tell me all his recommendations for the city—I went to all and was not disappointed once! highly recommend

Amazing place in a great location. Well decorated and every detail has been thought about—from bottled water in the fridge to a carafe of port! On a quieter street, very clean and Hugo was a great host!

Hugo is a spectacular host! The space is perfectly located in the city, close to markets, restaurants, shops, etc...  Our flight arrived late and Hugo was so kind to wait until 1:00am to meet us at the airbnb. Gave us wonderful recommendations and even port wine as a welcome drink. He arranged a taxi driver to pick us up from the airport- Tiago, which also provided us with a great service. Will stay here my next time in Porto!

The City Double View apartment is highly recommended. The place itself is clean, bright, nice details and has indeed wonderful views. The welcome gift was great and delicious. Location is good, everything in walking distance. Communication was almost instant, lots of tips on where to go and what to eat (Sandes de Pernil at Casa Guedes!). Next time we'll try to book it again!

We had a wonderful staying at Hug Oporto, Porto, the place is perfect! The apartment was stylish, clean, spacious and of course with beautiful views from the balcony.  Francisco made us feel very welcome, gave some great recommendations and was flexible with our timings. The apartment was in a really central location, walking distance from all the main sights. I would definitely stay again next time I'm in Porto - thanks again Francisco!

Toc toc studio is everything you need for a porto getaway. The location is great. The interior is tastefully decorated and had everything you might need. Last but not least, the host Hugo is super nice and makes you feel at home. Also he shares a lot of good tips to see, do and eat. We will definitely return!
Unfortunately, had to cancel the trip to Portugal last minute, but host was responsive in the lead up. Wish we could have stayed at Hugo's place!

We had a very nice stay at Hugo flat. Perfectly located and very well decorated, it really made us enjoy our stay in Porto. Easy to find, easy to park the car.  Hugo has been lovely from day one helping us with the check in but also with some advices and very good addresses.  The perfect stay for a weekend in Porto
Hugo went above and beyond to make sure we could have had the best possible time in Porto. The place was immaculate and comfortable. I wish every host was as great as Hugo.

This is a lovely flat in a beautiful city. Perfect for a couple and in the perfect location! The balcony is a great extra - lovely views over Sé Cathedral and even a bit of the Douro itself! :) It was clean and very comfortable. Francisco was a great host and gave us so many tips about Porto - all his restaurant recommendations were fantastic and he also pointed us to some great sights. All in all we had a great break away and will definitely stay there again when visiting Porto!
Very good journey, the apartment is really nice and very well situated. Hug and his friend are very friendly.
We had the perfect weekend trip in the apartment. Great location, clean and an awesome city view! Will come back soon!

We really appreciated this first taste of Portugal thank to Francisco and to his great flat and tips! The restaurants he advised we went to were yummy! As for the appartment it is very well located, it was clean and decorated with a lot of taste, the terrasse is a real must to enjoy a breakfast or a drink! We have to insist on this little old fashionned grocery shop at the bottom of the building that is owned by a memorable old lady who served us amazing cheese and ham ! The only thing we were disappointed about was not to have the chance to be welcomed with a selection of little things to eat or drink like the other guests.... We have here in Lisboa and it changes everything! This would have made the stay perfect :)

Nice touch bottle of wine and cheese and ham on arrival. Very comfortable well furnished apartment in excellent central location. Nice sunsets on the balcony. Be careful construction across the street but quiet at the weekend while we were there.
It's a really nice flat in a really nice location, wit a really nice view and a really nice host!
Great apartment in a superb location. The views are even better than the photographs! A friendly welcome to our friends that checked in first. Plus great eating tips. Thank you!

Thank you for your warm welcome and your nice adresses and recommendation in Porto. Your flat is nice and perfectly located in the center of Porto. We spend a very nice moment in Porto thanks to you! I highly recommend your apartment!!
The flat is really nice and comfortable and perfectly located. Francisco's welcome was great and made us feel at home. His tips and indications were great.
Nice location near the river and only a short distance from the edge of town. Can get a little chilly in the wintertime, but a great place for exploring the town of Porto.

We loved our stay at Francisco's place! His warm welcome, hospitality and local food tips really made our stay. The apartment was in the perfect location for us, in the middle of the busier neighborhoods but a quieter area itself. The apartment was clean and we had everything we needed. The balcony is perfect for a wine at sunset!

The Toc Toc studio was the perfect spot for our getaway to Porto. The location was perfect and made hitting all that Porto has to see easy in just 3 days. Hugo was a great host and his suggestions were spot on!

My partner and I had a great stay at Hugo's place during our time in Porto! The apartment is really well located, within walking distance to most main attractions and has many great restaurants close by. The check-in process was smooth and the apartment was clean and comfortable. We would definitely recommend it!

This was an awesome place to stay for a few days in Porto! Great location a little tucked away from the main areas in Porto. Lots of thought went into decorating and setting up the Air B and B. Would recommend!

Really enjoyed our stay at Hugo’s place! Check-in was easy and the place was clean. The door got a little stuck when we were first checking in, but Hugo was very helpful when we messaged him and we had no further issues throughout our trip. The location is also great - close to all sites and good eats. Would definitely recommend this stay!

A beautiful apartment right in the heart of Porto! Lots of places to eat within a 10 minute walk and all of it is outside the touristy area. Also an easy Uber to and from the train station. Easy to walk or take an Uber to the Port Cellar district across the river.
Awesome location lovely view. Francisco gave so many tour tips. Highly recommend.

My partner and I spent 4 nights at Francisco's apartment and it was perfect. Francisco was responsive and very helpful giving us great tips for places to eat and see around Porto. The location is very central (very central and close to tourist bus stops, Sao Bento station and the funicular to the river), the view from the balcony overlooks the Gothic cathedral and is a great place to have breakfast or sip port cocktails! The lift was quick, responsive and elegant and much needed after sight seeing all day. The apartment itself has everything you may need from extra blankets when chilly on the balcony to kitchen utensils for cooking in. The bedroom was airy and the bed semi firm and comfortable. The only slight (and it is slight!) issue was the drilling from the building works behind the apartment which we could hear if we came back in the afternoon for a siesta but it wasn't every day. I have recommended this apartment to friends and we would definitely return!!
Francisco was a great host, very easy to communicate with and offering handy tips about the local area. The apartment was clean and charming and the area is perfect. Can happily recommend.

Really lovely flat. Amazing balcony and location. Great advise on local restaurants etc on arrival. Early check in really helped too. Only very small improvement could be to provide a little coffee or tea as no supplies are provided. Easily rectified as there was a shop right next door. Thank you

Wonderful location, central and near all. Great spacious apartment with a lovely overlook terrace outside! The friendly couple in the small downstairs grocery were darling! The bakery around the corner was delicious. We had everything we needed just a step away.  Thank you so much for a great stay in Porto.

Great location, excellent host, extremely helpful suggestions and advice from Francisco. The apartment had everything we needed. On the fifth floor with a lift. Pleasant view from the balcony. We would thoroughly recommend to a couple.
We loved staying in Hugo’s place! Perfect location and very comfortable apartment. Hugo was very communicative and we had no issues at all. Highly recommend!

I absolutely loved my stay at Hugo’s apartment. He was an amazing host, really quick to respond to messages ahead of arrival and so welcoming. The apartment itself is beautiful and the location is stunning, everywhere you would want to find yourself in Porto is walking distance from the place. Could not recommend more highly, looking forward to my next stay here on my next visit to Porto :)

Hugo’s place was really great. Started with a smooth self check in with our welcome drink, map of the city, snd Hugo’s restaurant recommendations. Quiet street but close enough to the action. Just 2 mins downhill is one of the city’s nicest views of the river/hills.

This studio is a great choice to stay in Porto! It is really nice and quite spacious for a studio. Between the decor, windows, and building it is truly a unique stay. The location is really the highlight though, you are walking distance to many of the main sites of Porto but on a side street that was quite and local. Hugo provided some excellent recommendations of places to eat nearby. Definitely would stay again at this location!
Hugo was an excellent host and we loved our stay at his place in Porto! Super convenient location and the studio had everything we needed.

Hugo’s place was exactly as described and even better in person! Truly in an impeccable location too. Checking in was seamless with very clear and easy instructions to follow. We were welcomed to some fresh port wine and a stunning space. I can’t wait to stay in Porto again, def would want to stay in the same home!

Perfect location within walking distance of everything you need. Unique historic building. The bed is very comfortable. Building is not accessible for all as there’s several flights of stairs and entry door is very large and heavy.

Great location, great host, walkable city, comfortable beds, great shower. One small, simple detail that most hosts overlook that we very much appreciated: Hugo's place is that rare exception that offers an actual set of  hooks in the entry way, a place to hang your hat, jackets, or umbrellas. Highly recommended!

It was the perfect apartment for our stay in Porto. Fantastic location with great places to eat around the corner. Studio facing quiet back alley. Hugo provided us with a helpful personalized map that included sights and restaurants.

Hugo provided clear instructions on how to check-in and how to use the AC/heating system. He also provided some port wine for us to try! The space had everything we needed and everything was within walking distance. The only thing to note is that he warned us of a recent water leak in the ceiling, right about the shower. Luckily, it seemed like the leaking had stopped by the time of our stay but there was some visible water damage and a bit of a smell. It wasn't really ideal but I understand that it was out of Hugo's control. Over all, we were pretty happy with our stay and Hugo's communication!

The apartment is just wonderful! I totally recommend it and it will be definitely my choice for the next trip to Porto. It’s everything you need and more. Very nice and cozy, with lots of cool details. The location is perfect - very close to all the main attractions and to Ribeira. Near the beautiful park. Hugo is the great host, very responsive and attentive. The communication was smooth and friendly (additional thanks for the welcome gift - a bottle of port wine :)  I enjoyed my stay so much! It was my first time in Porto and the apartment was a part of unforgettable experience. I really recommend to stay here!

Hands-down, probably one of the best Airbnb‘s I’ve ever stayed in. It was clean spacious super Central. The bed was very comfortable extra pillows linens comforters, very clean. The AC was really cold and heater worked perfect too on those cold nights. Hugo was very responsive and I was very happy with the location since it’s walkable and in the heart of the city really. If you’re considering a trip to Porto, don’t miss out on this amazing apartment.

Hugo’s place was very easy to find and he provided helpful instructions on how to get to it. It was located in a great neighbourhood and located within close proximity to various restaurants and monuments. The apartment was fairly well maintained and not too loud at night which was great! We would recommend!
Super cute, great street with a lot of character but just enough off the main tourist area. Hugo was super responsive and helpful.
André and Anne were very nice hosts. They were very helpfull. We had a very nice stay here and recommend this place. :)
Andre was very accomodating despite us being quite late. I would recommend him and his flat. We loved the area, which seemed to be very safe. By car, it is very close to Porto.

Large and beautiful apartment, perfect position to reach Porto city center in 10 minutes by car: you can enjoy the town and sleep in a quiet place. The host has been so kind to arrange check-in and chech-out when it was more convenient for us. We've been shown around the house by André's sister (Ana) and mother (Silvia) and they have given us precious advice about Porto and the surroundings. Mrs. Silvia is so kind and sweet. I highly recommend this host and  is beautiful house.

Wonderful place with soul, restored furniture is amazing, roof terrace is superb and location is quiet and green. We enjoyed morning walks in the forest nearby. Kitchen is big and we’ll equipped. Many bathrooms, comfortable beds.
The place is amazing. Wonderfull night in Porto, warm welcoming. Go there with no doubts!

João has an incredible eye for detail. The apartment has been restored with love and a lot of thought. João made us extremely welcome and every morning he left food and drink for us to prepare a wonderful breakfast so we were able to make the most of the long table in the breathtaking living room. The apartment is also within walking distance from the main attractions.

We had a really nice stay at the apartment. The place is perfectly located in the city, was clean, tidy and most important, looks exactly like the pictures promised. Although we arrived late at 11.30 pm, Sharron the owner gave us a really warm welcome. To be recommend without any hesitations.  Friedrich Braumann

Nice welcome, Cristela gave us some good advice about the city and some adresses to go. The appartment was clean and exactly like the pictures discribed. A surplus was the hammock on the balcony, which was ideal to drink some wine before dinner :) breakfast was included and the bacon and eggs we asked for tased really good.  We really liked our stay there and were not ready to leave so soon, thanks!

My family group of five enjoyed staying at this property. There was plenty of room for everyone. The detailing of the apartment was amazing. High ceilings and understated decor with loads of unique character. The location is 1 block from the metro and very central with loads of great restaurants and shopping right around the corner. This was a fantastic place to stay in a incredible city. I would recommend staying here to anyone without hesitation.

Andre and his sister Ana are great hosts - they provided very clear instructions during the check-in as well as quite useful recommendations for our one week in Porto. There is a lot of space in this apartment and all necessary appliances. The location is great - in particular, for those driving a car as it is quite close to the city and provides short routes to highways connecting to other attractions in the region.

The apartment is large and spacious for 4 people, it’s a little far from Porto which suited us fine, there is a promenade to walk into Porto once you get to the river. The owners Sister picked us up from the Bus station which was most welcome and also allowed us to check out late as we had a late flight.

We were two families with kids. We loved the apartment, it was walkable to almost all the attractions. She gave us a really check in and was very sweet to us. Everything went well. Bathrooms were clean, we used the laundry as well. Overall great experience.

We thought the apartment was really lovely. Really spacious, amazing ceiling, beautiful windows throughout and a great garden with the bonus of the huge variety of craft beer on sale! So enjoyed our stay in Porto!
We had a great stay !! The appartement is so beautiful, comfortable and really well situated. We basically walked everywhere. Maja was very welcoming. We were 7 and definitely recommend this place !!
Really nice flat, comfortable and stylish, walking distance from the city center. The host was very patient and compehensive as our plane to Porto was delayed. I definitely recommend this place!
Amazing flat! Just as it is in the pictures:  big, spacious, cool and cozy. Plus is comfortable and central . Joao is nice and he gave us good advices  Super !

Absolutely loved our stay - very responsive, Maja met us early so we could drop our bags off and explore the city, and the place itself is great. The craft beer bar next door is awesome too, great place to hang out and added a lot to the experience. Would love to stay again!

We had a great stay with a big group at this beautiful house. The kitchen/livingroom looks absolutely stunning and is very spacious, our host was super helpful and communication was easy and smooth. Location is very central and very close to a metrostation. Definitely recommended!
Nicely renovated apartment in the heart of Porto. You can reach nearly anything by foot and the host offered some nice tipps to eat and do
Amazing apartment. House is beautifully renovated. The beer garden below has cool events with live jazz music on Sundays. Everything you need is available.

Isabella is a great host. She was always available for us and answer all our questions and needs. The appartment is well located and very clean. It correspond to the pictures. Thanks Again Isabella, hope to see you again very soon:)
The apartment is comfortable and well situated and our host was kind and very helpful. We had the possibility to leave our luggage before check-in and after check-out, which was very helpful

Mord’s place is great - not just because of its location and design, but also because it is simply well hosted. Isabelle was a quick and responsive communicator from the beginning, met us at the flat to make sure we got in and settled, and was quick to respond anytime we needed anything.  It’s true that there is a bar out back - but if you’re a night owl, you won’t have too much to worry about.  Highly recommend!
Even better than the pictures! This place is beautiful and a unique find, close to many of Porto’s main attractions. We were lucky to find this place.

This is a very clean house, and Diogo was very nice, he was available and answered to all our questions. Our room was clean and organized. We met a lot of other nice people as there are 9 or 10 rooms available in total. The house is located 5mn from the main shopping street, which is not good for your credit card ;) . We'll definitively come back if we go to Porto again!!

The place's excellent location was incredibly convenient, within easy walking distance of the city center. There were plenty of restaurants in the area, and the property's cleanliness and orderliness made my stay enjoyable.

The perfect accommodation for our four day stay in Porto. It is super central. Everything was in walking distance. The room and shared areas were as described. We made the most of the kitchen, which has everything you could possibly need. You get a lot for the price. Communication with Kiki was excellent. Would definitely recommend!

Chris picked me up from the bus station which was great.  There was also a variety of fruit snacks and beverages waiting for me at the flat which was very nice and tasty.  Flat is as described and was comfortable.  I walked to the old center and the contemporary art museum (long walks) but a metro station is within 10 mins walk.  There was a grocery store quite close and a great little cafe as well.  I enjoyed my stay.

Chris's flat is clean, well placed between the beach and the city center, close to the metro station "Casa da musica" and very cozy. We had a great experience and this was thanks to Chris who took the time to show us the neighborhood and advice what to visit in Porto.

Chris is a great host. Very welcoming and someone who knows a lot about Porto city - we still go to places like Casinha and Labirintho, which he showed us. About the apartament, it is in a great location and very equiped. We loved our stay! Thanks a lot, Chris! :)

Nice place for a long stay, it's located in a good area that is removed from the most crowded streets of the city, but is close to many other overlooked sights, and the ocean is almost within walking distance. The communication was quick, I had no problems whatsoever.
Had a great stay in Porto at Chris's place. Was easy to get around on foot from the flat with plenty of amenities close by.  The WiFi was fast and reliable and check in and check out painless.

This is a great place to stay with a fabulous host. You can walk to many cool places in the areas, like the food hall, the botanical gardens and planetarium. The metro is nearby so you can get around easily and Chris is a cool guy who is more than helpful with sharing knowledge about what to do.

I absolutely loved staying at Chris's house. It was a fantastic experience. I felt right at home and found the space to be incredibly inspiring for work. The house has everything you need, making it perfect for long stays (I stayed for a month). Chris was always available to offer help and advice about the city. The views are stunning — you can see the entire sky, and the sunlight is perfect for getting some vitamin D while you work. The house is very bright. The location is also fantastic; it's in a very business area with great public transport connections. You have buses, metro, and you can even walk to Bolhao in about 35-40 minutes. If you take the metro, it's just a 10-minute ride from Casa da Música to Bolhao. Highly recommend!

Very convenient location for all there is to see in Porto. Diana and colleague were prompt in responding to our questions and helpful in getting us situated. Clean, airy apartment. Just right for 2 people.

We really loved this location, unfortunately the weather in Porto did not cooperate so we spent more time indoors then expected. The restaurants along the water were nice and we were able to walk to several sight seeing locations before the rain fell.

What a gem!! We had a spectacular experience in this beautiful location in Oporto on the Rio Douro. We were steps away from everything we needed and wanted - restaurants, shopping, the port cellars, city parks, all the historical landmarks and other hidden treasures. Mostly, Diana and her team were incredibly helpful and gracious hosts (thank you Catia for hand-delivering a cork-screw so we could open our wine!!!). We would be happy to come back to this perfect spot in Oporto!

I really enjoyed my stay at Diana's place. It was cozy and modern, great views, spotlessly cleaned and had everything one might need for a comfortable stay. Very well located and in walking distance from almost all the tourist attractions. Also Diana was very friendly. She was quick to respond and communications where always warm and clear. Highly recommended! I'll definitely be back.

We spent a great long weekend in Helena's apartment. The apartment was clean and looked exactly the same as it was in the photos, the mattress is really comfortable and you have everything you need to cook. When we got to the apartment location, Helena's husband met us there and explained us everything we might need related to the apartment and to the neighborhood, he gave us some pieces of advice about what to visit, where to eat and so on. If I came back to Oporto I’d definitely stay in Helena’s place.

Helena's place is in a great area away from the touristy places with a nice neighborhood feeling.   It is close to the bus station within easy walking distance of most of the sites.  The view of the park is very nice and peaceful.  Oh, Casa Guedes is just a few doors away!
We loved the apartment.  It's in a great location and has wonderful natural light.  There are lots of good food options close by.  It was also great to be across the street from a park.

Host was very accommodating. I missed my flight and let the host know and they happily arranged to meet my friend who had already arrived to give the keys. The apartment is clean and in a great location and easy access to the subway and only a 6 Euro taxi from the train station. We had a lovely stay.
We enjoyed our stay, a lovely apartment in a convenient location. Helena was very welcoming and helpful.

Helena was lovely as well as her apartment.  It is exactly how it's shown on Airbnb.  After a long day of trekking up and down porto, it was nice to come back to a comforting and cozy apt. It is also in a prime location as its close proximity to the city center and the main train station which allowed easy access to transportation.

Helena's and Artur's apartment is very comfortable. Although it's little bit smaller than we had expected but we could comfortably accommodate ourselves. We were 5, including two kids. The apartment would be ideal for a couple or family with one child.  We received warm welcome from Artur as soon as we arrived. He provided us with a good guidance including the recommended taxi service with an English speaking driver.  The apartment is ideally located in the city center with big supermarket and lots of local restaurants nearby. Cafe Majestic and Rua Santa Catarina (the main shopping area) is within 5 minutes walking distance. In fact, all major tourist destinations are in walking distance.  The apartment is cozy and clean with a well-equipped kitchen.  We highly recommend this apartment to those who want to have a comfortable stay in Porto.
Best location with many local food restaurants, cafes. Flat clean, comfortable with big windows and a nice view. I recommend it fully. We will come there back for sure when possible.

Artur met us outside the apartment and gave us great tips on what to see and where to go in Portugal, including the great bakery downstairs and the supermarket around the corner.  The apartment is exactly as described in the pictures, with beautiful windows, a great kitchen and living area. It was a great apartment in a great location - we had a fantastic time and would stay there again! The only (small) downs are that the bed is quite hard and not much toilet paper provided.
Artur made us feel very welcome and gave us a lot of helpful information. Thank you. The apartment was ideally situated and had a pleasant outlook.

The apt was really nice. it had everything you need for a visit to Porto. There are restaurants everywhere, its close to grocery stores, transport.  The apt is well furnished.  It is opposite, and has a nice view of a park.  Its perfect. We never actually met Helena, but we did communicate via email and she very prompt and accurate when she got back to me.

We had a perfect stay in this apartment! The apartment is beautifully decorated and very comfortable, confortable bed and pillows, great lounge. The kitchen is modern and clean. There are restaurants and supermarkets all around it, and a great bakery just downstairs from the apartment. You can easily walk to everywhere in Porto and will get to the tower in max 20 minutes. The check in and the hosts are very professional and efficient. Highly recommended!

The flat is beautiful and has everything you need (towels, hair dryer, plates, ....) it's just a short walk to the city center and a supermarket is close near by. Porto is a lovely city with so much to explore. Unfortunately we couldn't meet Helena in person but the lovely lady who welcomed us was very helpful and friendly. Communication before our stay was easy. Definitely good value for money!

Absolutely loved our stay at this Airbnb! The hosts have a great eye for design; the place is beautifully decorated, and perfectly clean. It is very centrally located, with all of the major attractions and a big grocery store within walking distance. It also overlooks a park, and because it is not on a major street it isn't loud at night. We were greeted by Helena and her boyfriend who were so friendly. They gave us a map and a very helpful overview of Porto and major attractions we should check out. I highly recommend checking out their restaurant recommendations; they were incredible! Would happily stay here again.
The apartment is in a great central location for exploring Porto and easy to get to from the train station and airport. Loved the bakery next door for morning coffee and treats!
Very spacious and comfortable space. Great base to explore all of Porto. Air con was a very welcome addition in the heatwave! Would highly recommend
Lovely apartment with character Fabulous location  Comfy bed with loads of storage

Great location. Close to everything, we were able to walk everywhere. Check in was easy and we were given a map & some tips from the property manager. Apartment was clean and spacious for 2 people. & there’s air conditioning, which is a major plus. I’d recommend this apartment to anyone.

Fantastic place! If we are ever in Porto again, we will hopefully stay here. The location is great and very easy to get to from the airport train. The space was extremely clean and tidy and had all the amenities needed for a stay.
The apartment is well located to explore the city. Everything you need is there. Thank you for the stay.
Apartment was very well located and check in was very easy. There are bit squeeky floors but thats to be expected from old buildings. Overall good stay.

This was the perfect place to rest and explore Porto!! I really loved this little apartment and would definitely stay again. Very thoughtful with the extra blankets. I also liked being able to do laundry here! Walkable to many close restaurants and shops as well as the main attractions in Porto.
Great place, we enjoyed our short stay. Apartment had everything that we needed. Host was very friendly and communicated great. Very central location, everything is close by. Definitely recommend.
We stayed a week in this lovely apartment. It's very well located. Tomàs is a wonderful host, he took time to suggest place to visit, eat and go out. We really suggest this apartment.

We had a very good time in Porto! The apartment was so nice and clean and at a great location close to many nice restaurants and bars and other good spots in Porto. Tomas was very helpful at any time of the day.

We were 5 girls on a city trip in Porto ! The appartment was great, even better than on the pictures : very spacious, bright, clean and so well furnished, nothing was missing. The bedrooms were very confortable and 2 bathrooms were very useful. The location was just perfect, in the center of the old city, close from the main places to visit, the shopping street, the restaurants and night spot !  We've received very nice tips to visit the city and Tomas was very flexible with the organisation. We highly recommand this place ! Thanks a lot & enjoy !
We had a great time in Porto and the appartment was great. Spacious, clean and very nice. Next to that Tomas helped a lot arranging a car and some good food. warmly recommended this place
The apartment is very very cool, clean and full of stuff! Tomàs is a kindly host!
We were here only for three days. Host is very kind. Apartment is well equipped and very clean. We got all promised and the space is exactly what is in the photos.

What a great time we had in Porto. The appartment of Tomas is absolute a great choiche for a stay in Porto. It is as nice as on the pictures, it is very well decorated, clean, a lot of space en right in the middle of the historic centre. Tomas is a very friendly host who helped us with maps and other information for a great sty in Porto. And yes, you have to climbe quite a few stairs to reach the appartment, but isn't that a great help to stay slim after eating al the delicious pastery that you can eat every where?

The apartment was in a great location, walking distance to many attractions/restaurants/bars/shops. While very clearly written out in the description, note that the apartment is the top two levels of a building and one of the full bathrooms is on the lower level, so you could be going up and down stairs to shower. Also the upstairs bathroom's layout is long, narrow, with stairs and has doors to both rooms, which could be awkward. Also, the main wifi signal comes from the floor below the aparment, so connection was strong on the lower level, but didn't quite reach to the second level.  Tomás was a great host. He was very communicative leading up to our stay, and was very flexible with both our arrival and departure times, which was very much appreciated.

We had a very warm welcome! Tomás friend who greeted us was wonderful and very helpful. She showed us the entire apartment and how to work everything as well. She then continued to tell us the best places to eat and the best sites to see. The listing was very accurate. It was in close in proximity to everything and we could easily catch the bus to go to the beach. It was a warm and welcoming space.  I would definitely  stay in one of Tomás apartments again!

Tomas welcomed us with maps and tons of suggestions for things to do. The apartment is in an EXCELLENT location. Couldn't find a better one. Beautiful apartment. Restored building, so appliances were a bit shifty (bad water pressure) but that is to be expected with old buildings.  Lovely apartment, we loved it

Tomas was great - exceedingly responsive, polite and a pleasure to deal with in every respect. The flat is a great location at the edge of the old town, wonderful cafes right outside and everything within a short walk. It's a little quirky - up several flights of stairs would be challenging with a lot of luggage and it's not the quietest but very clean, comfortable and welcoming and with two full bedrooms and bathrooms is great value. Highly recommended as a base for visits in Porto.

Amazing apartment, centrally located. Tomás was not able to meet with us but arranged for a friend to meet with us at our most convenient time. A map and booklet with descriptions of all you need to know for your stay in Porto was prepared.

This apartment was fantastic! The best thing about it is the location - right within the heart of downtown Porto. Everything is within walking distance! The apartment was very clean, and the kitchen comes with all the essentials. Tomas and Sophia were wonderful with communication. We tried several of Sophia's recommendations (including the Francesinha at Cafe Santiago and port tasting at Ferreira), and everything was great. We would definitely stay here again!

There was thorough communication prior to my arrival and throughout my stay. Unfortunately wasn't able to meet Tomas until the end of my stay (which I was informed of in advance, but he was easily contactable and quick to respond. The place was immaculate, photos don't do it justice! Very clean and spacious, will definitely recommend!
The flat was really beautiful and right in the centre of town so super easy to get around. Tomas was also really responsive when we had questions for him. A great trip!

The appartment is pretty big and is made on 2 levels (rooms on second floor) The whole place is clean, comfortable and we'll equipped . The view from the main bedroom is great. The neiborhood is very central and is surrounded with restaurants, bars and stores. Thomas is very welcoming and knows well his town. I highly recommend!

The apartment was lovely, spacious, clean & so close to everything. It had all we needed plus amazing views over the rooftops of fabulous Porto. Tomas met us and was really helpful and friendly giving advice on lots of places to see & things to do plus some good restaurant recommendations. I would highly recommend the apartment.
Tomás' place was perfectly located in walking distance from everything. The apartment had exceptional views, was nicely decorated and clean. Tomás was very responsive and flexible. Highly recommend!
Comfortable, clean stylish and spacious in a perfect location to explore the city.  also a very good price too! thanks

My family and I loved our stay! The apartment is well furnished and right where it needs to be to see all the sights of Porto. In the one day we were there we walked out our front door and everything was a few minutes away. The only thing we were left wanting for was a slightly better view and an elevator.

Tomas' place is in a great location, within walking distance of the Ribiera and all the shopping, eating and drinking locations in Porto.  A supermarket is  just around the corner and a pharmacy is across the street. His communication was great and there were refreshments and a bottle of wine waiting for us on arrival. The apartment is really nicely decorated and furnished and we felt at home right away. Tomas' office is also located in the building so he is always on hand if you need anything. Trasca, the tapas/wine bar next to the front door has great food and wine, highly recommended.

The apartment is located in the heart of the city and is beautifully furnished with attention to detail. We were warmly welcomed and received many helpful tips at the beginning. The communication was extremely fast and the team was very friendly!
A wonderful spacious flat with great rooftop views over Porto. Well located and only a short walk to the riverfront. We were very well hosted with a bottle of wine waiting for us when we arrived.

It was a great stay in Tomas’ apartment. We were very well welcomed by Tomas who gave us many good recommendations for our stay in Porto.  I’d definitely recommend Tomas’ place for people who want to stay in Porto ! Thanks again !

This apartment was spacious and cute! Perfect amount of room for 5 ladies. Located in a central area of Porto, we were able to walk to all of the places we wanted to explore. The hosts were accommodating and friendly, and we were able to store our luggage with them before check-in which was very helpful. Thank you!

We had an amazing stay! The apartment has the best location to get almost everywhere by foot.  It also was super clean with lovely interior decorations just like in the pictures!  I can only recommend this place for anyone visiting Porto!

We had a fantastic stay in Tomas' apartment.  It's huge, beautifully furnished and was spotless.  It's also in a really great location, very central and a short walk to everywhere we wanted to go in this beautiful city.  Tomas was always quick to reply to messages, self check in was very straightforward and he was flexible enough to allow early check in (although we didn't need it in the end) and allow us to leave our bags on our last day. We loved this place - would definitely stay again if we ever visit Porto again! Thank you
Tomas was super helpful especially with allowing up to leave our bags in the office outside of check in/out hours. Great place and very central!

This apartment was centrally located and easy to find. Check in was easy and we were even able to check-in early upon arrival in town. The host was very responsive and even gave some great restaurant recommendations. We had a fabulous trip!
Tomas was great!  Loved Porto and the apartment There is construction of the new metro right down the street - which takes the magic out of the location

This Airbnb was nice, spacious, and centrally located to downtown Porto. During the periods of construction it is very loud and difficult to sleep. The construction also makes it difficult to get around town at times, but once the construction is finished this will be a wonderful place to stay when visiting Porto
This is such a beautiful place. Location couldn't be better. There is a bar downstairs and can be a bit loud at night, but we didn't care. Atmosphere was great and hosts were very accommodating.

Very  nice and charming apartment right in the centre. Everything was as expected, clean and well equipped. Communication with the host and check in and check out instructions were clear and easy. We are just sorry that we didn’t have enough time to enjoy the apartment at its fullest because we were on a weekend escapade and Porto has so many interesting things to offer, so we had to choose. I would not doubt to book this apartment again or recommend it to friends visiting Porto.
A wonderful place with an aura of antiquity, excellent location to get anywhere. I could definitely come back here🤗

Nicely updated space and very centrally  located. The host’s office is in the same building as the unit which proved to be convenient as questions arose: they went above and beyond to respond, take action and ensure our stay was great. Impressed by the level of service offered.
Come with a light bag when you are staying at the top floor. Very helpful host. Great nightlife and restaurants at a stone drop distance.

Very nice and clean apartment, just around the corner to the beach. It was in a good location. Only 20 minutes away by taxi (cost roughly 8-10 euros) to Casa da musical and 5 minutes walk to the beach. The description of the apartment is accurate. I'll definitely go back to the apartment one day, we will come back here, no doubt...

We enjoyed our stay at Miguels Flattered apartment very well. He is very friendly and willing to help. The room was clean and everything was available. We stayes there with our daughter during a week and were surprised of the good housekeeping! Everyday the room was cleaned and checked, really good service which we didn't expect. Porto is a very nice city and from this apartment you are at the beach in 5 minutes walking, great for joggers!! But also you can take the old tram (nr. 1) and get to the city centre for only 2,50 euro p.p., not only afordable but also a nice experience in this ancient vehicle

This is a lovely apartment in a very cozy and nice part of town. The host is great and offer an amazing breakfast the first morning and cleaning.  I had some problems with my phone while staying there, but everybody were very patient, positive and helpfull.. This will be my first priority to book whenever I am in Porto. 5 stars!
We enjoyed our stay here. Miquel and friends were great. The place is clean, well stocked and close to a lot of things. Would stay again. Thanks guys!
great location in the middle of the "porto side", near to lots of restaurants and the main attractions. 10min walk to river. good for a group of friends.

This airbnb was very charming! It was extremely comfortable for 3 people, had all accommodations and was very clean. The only tough part was walking up 5 or so flights of stairs with heavy luggage, but in my opinion, it was well worth it! Definitely would note that the airbnb itself is two floors, with one bathroom being downstairs. Nice living area and television on the first floor too. Tomas was easy to communicate with and was able to allow us to check in early when we arrived in the city before check in time. The location is in the main hub of Porto which was good for us (being tourists), but the airbnb itself remains very quiet and you cannot hear any pedestrians on the street below. Would recommend staying here!

Wow! It’s even prettier than the pictures. We had a lovely time, the location is perfect, the host is super responsive and the value for money is outstanding. Can highly recommend. There are a few stairs, so take in account when you have large pieces of luggage. Will be perfect for a family with children.
It was a fantastic location and exactly as depicted. It was up a bunch of stairs, but definitely worth it. Also, fantastic places to eat nearby!!

A very lovely appartment right in the heart of Porto. Everything you need to see is in walking distance. The appartment is beautiful and looks exactly as shown on the pictures. Great restaurants and bars nearby. We really enjoyed it! :)

A lovely apartment right in the centre of Porto with great facilities on its doorstep. The apartment is spacious and comfortable. Tomás was a great, responsive host, both before we arrived and during our stay. There was quite a bit of noise at night, but that was to be expected given its central location. Overall we all had a great stay.
Tomas was great to communicate with. Kind and helpful! The location was awesome…totally worth the stair walk!
A lovely semi-studio close to the waterside. The hosts were very communicative and helpful with local recommendations. About a half an hour walk into the centre of Porto.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the apartment. It was clean, spacious and right around the corner from the beach. The bed was comfortable and the apartment had all the amenties you could think of. A slightly more comforrable couch is the only thing i would suggest, but this is being picky. The host was always responsibe and very helpful. Would love to come back!
Very attractive apartment with high quality equipments and neatly decorated. All in place and in good condition. We had extremely good time here. Hope all the best for Juliana.

We have had an excellent experience staying at Juliana's place. Apart from the area where the apartment is located which we already knew, we were very positively impressed by the welcoming attitude from Juliana. We have been received warmly with typical Portuguese cookies and Juliana promptly showed us the apartment. We were not expecting such a nice functional apartment which immediately felt like home and is much bigger than what the photos show. Amenities we carefully placed everywhere and the heating during this colder season  works very well. Juliana took the time upon our arrival to provide us with information about the city but we mentioned we were familiar and had a very nice chat. Unfortunately it was raining and we couldn't enjoy the nice terrace on the ground floor which we hope to have the opportunity to do during one of our next stays in Porto. We thank Juliana for this awesome experience and hope to meet her sometime soon.

If you are looking for a central place, this is the right spot. Close to everything , transportation, restaurant, shopping and more. Juliana is a lovely person, very helpful and dedicated to her guests.

Comfortable, stylish, clean, great location. All the main touristy things are within walking distance and a stone’s throw from Trindade metro station. Very convenient. Wonderful host, very friendly and hospitable and went out of her way to get my purse if left behind to me before our flight!! Would highly recommend.

We had a great stay here with our family of 5. It's quite near to the metro, and there's a little market next door. Juliana was a great host, with quick communication. She even helped us track down our daughter's lost camera!

Very nice bi-level apartment, as expected from advertisement. Host is friendly and easy to communicate with and the place is smartly renovated and quite clean. Great location just north of the city center and the river - it was great to have a little distance from the tourist center while still being convenient. I would gladly stay here again.

We had a great time at Juliana’s place. The communication was super easy and quick and the place looks exactly like it does on the pictures. The neighborhood is very conveniently located and the apartment is very quiet! Would absolutely recommend to stay there!
Great location, close to all the main attractions. Amenities were superb. Size was very large for European standards. We had a great stay and would come again!
Very beatiful appartment... very well situated and very well  equipped. 5/5. We recommand you it.
Very nice location. Close from city center, station, and the market. We would definitely visit again.
We really loved our stay in Porto, greatly because of the experience we had at our stay. Joao was really helpful in the check in process. Thanks for having us!
We had a great stay, the terrace is nice and private and very comfortable with two bedrooms and two bathrooms

Very nice apartment, everything was like in the description, nice location for exploring the beautiful city of Porto. We can definitely recommend staying here for some days and would always come back again.

Maria is very nice. The apartment looks as described. The apartment is very clean. The problem is a very strong smell of mold / moist. It is overwhelming. And there are no windows, but only two doors on the same side that do not circulate the air. For us it was very hard to stay there and we shortened our visit.  Also, from the little we saw, the immediate area is not interesting, but a rather boring suburb of porto.

Pedro is a great host. Once you reserve a room in his cool apartment, he send you a lot of tips for you enjoy Porto. He is friendly and open minded. His place is very well located and very clean. I spent a great time!

We stayed at Pedro's place for a long weekend and it was a pleasant stay. The room was quite nice and spacious, as the whole apartment is. It is well located near the metro and in walking distance to the city centre with the main sights. Pedro is a cool host and doesn't hesitate to give advices if you need. Only thing I would criticize is the cleaning frequency of the kitchen. But all in all a very recommendable place to stay.
Nice flat lovely vintage flair. 10 minutes walking from the centre. Pedro was a great help with lots of hints. Some parts could have been a bit cleaner
Definitely the right person to give the best tips in and around Porto. Really enjoyed my stay at Pedro's flat. Close to the centre, just the perfect location. Loved the balcony! :)

Pedro is friendly, very helpful. Seems like he knows everything about Porto :) He even prepared me a list of events, which were happening in the city during my stay. Room is really artsy. I especially liked a common balcony, where you can sit and enjoy the sun in the late afternoon. All the main attractions are a short walk down the mountain, very convenient. If I'll ever come to Porto again, I'll definitely choose this place again.

Pedro was a great host. I was a pretty mediocre guest and he really made the most fo things! My bus was late getting into porto and I only had the night there. He gave me a bunch of great recommendations and even helped me with my bicycle and bags. When I go back to Porto for more time, I hope he is still doing airbnb because I would absolutely stay at his place again.

Pedro was very welcoming and gave us great advice about events and locations that he recommended. He made us feel comfortable and at home. Porto is beautiful and within a five minute walking distance from the apartment. We were very pleased with our stay and greatly appreciated the privacy of the room. We did not see the pool and spa, but otherwise everything is true to the description.

Pedro was the perfect host! He gave me detailed explanations on how to get to the apartment, and once I arrived equipped me with a map and gave me tons of recommendations of places to go and things to do. Really great guy! The flat was also excellent, clean, spacious, and with an excellent location. Highly recommended!

Pedro is an amazing guy who made me feel at home immediately. He was available to help from the start and gave me suggestions about where to go to and what to visit in Porto. The room is spacious and clean and I slept really well in it. I totally recommend it!

Pedro is a very kind host. He was attentive and made my stay very comfortable. The neighbourhood is up and coming and has lots of charme. His guesthouse is clean and I met many friendly guests. The atmosphere is great. I will return for sure! Thank you for this wonderful stay.
Pedro is a great host, the house has everything you need, close to the city centre and just a few steps away from the metro. I really reccommend it, we had a great time there! Thanks:)

Pedro was really great about communicating with the guests and always checking-in with us to see if anything was needed. He provides you with a map the first day you stay as a guest with all the key locations to see in Porto, he even goes a bit further to recommend locations where to eat and shop.  The location of the home is a quick metro ride to the historic center of Porto. Overall, awesome experience with a great host. I would book this place without a doubt if I were to visit Porto again. Thanks Pedro!
I had a restful and restorative stay at Pedros. Great location and nice private room for a great price. Pedro was a great communicator as well!
Really enjoyed my stay. Super close to trindade station. Location is great! Pedro is a very friendly and easy going guy. Hope to be back again

Great location, nice room, very friendly and helpful host. Everything worked fine, I had a short but very relaxing stay of only two nights. The centre is just around the corner, bus in froint of the house, metro five minutes walk. I hope to be back one time. Thanks

Pedro is an awesome, responsible and a very friendly host, who will give you only the best recommendations while visiting Porto. The accommodation is located just near the center. Thus, one can explore Porto very easily from there. Moreover, the accommodation is very authentic creating a unique atmosphere right from the beginning of a trip to Porto.

The apartment is nice and very well located. Pedro was an excellent host eager to give you any information you may need to go around the city andhe was very flexible on the time of departure. One con though, the floor is a bit creaky so i woke up sometimes in the middle of the night because the other guests were walking in the corridor...

My friend and me stayed in Porto for 4 days. We felt at home there because Julieta is a great hostess! She is kind,caring and sweet! Her daughter met us at the train station, Julieta gave us a huge pile of guide-books, prepared a traditional portuguese supper and always helped us with advice. In addition- the house is absolutely lovely, very cosy and beautiful.The only thing that you should keep in mind is that it is 30 min by bus from the historic center.If you don't mind that then Julieta's house is the best place to stay in Porto. We felt warm there even when is was raining)

A wonderful woman and a wonderful home. I was picked up and dropped off at the train station which was so helpful. Julieta was helpful, kind and very accommodating. She has books, maps and written instructions on where to go and how to get there. A great experience and I would recommend to anyone.

Maria is a very nice and friendly host. Though we only stayed one night, arrived late and left quite early in the morning - everything was perfect: the bed is quite comfy, the whole flat is clean & cozy!

Julieta is the best!!! I am so lucky to be able to stay in her house when I visited Porto, it totally makes the whole experience different and wonderful!
