Her house is very cute, clean and comfortable, and she is just lovely and caring, we had 2 great dinner together chatting and sharing stories, I will definitely go back just to visit her, and the city of course ha, if you ever visit Porto, this is the place you should stay!

We were so happy to stay in Julieta house. Everything was as discribed. Her house is clean and comfortable and well furnitured. The breakfast sie served each morning was wonderful.  Julieta is a lovely and very helpful person. She had answers on all our questions and a lot of information about Porto and Duoro. We also say thank you for her assistance to find a nice restaurant serving sardinas (not so easy end of September 2014) Hopefully we will meet her again...perhaps In HH.

Great place to stay in Porto and the best Host! Julieta picked us up at the Metro Station while checking in and also gave us a ride to the Bus station at the departure. She's an awesome and lovely host, provided maps and home-made "day planner" tour guides. The house is very nice and comfortable, kitchen fully equipped. Close to the Park and the beach on walkable distance. Buses work very good to get to the city center. Extremely recommended!!!

Without a doubt the best airbnb I stayed in, in Portugal. Julieta provided a lovely light airy bedroom with private bathroom, a great breakfast. On top of all that Julieta was a great source of information re. Porto, parking, walking, places to go etc. Also, when Julieta knew that I was heading south to Evora she gave me lots of information on that area. All in all a brilliant hostess. I cannot recommend highly enough.

We had friends staying in another house nearby and didn't know the direction to the apartment. Julieta kindly picked us up from the house and brought us to the apartment. She gave us a tour of the entire apartment and even provided ingredients for our breakfast during the week. The patio garden was lovely to sit in with our evening meals where it was cool. She was warm and welcoming and very friendly. Very hospitable host, when we go to Porto again we are definitely considering her apartment as a 1st choice on our list!!
It was a really nice neighborhood and Maria is such a sweet lady. She's very hospitable and showed us where to go.

Wenn we arrived Julieta made us a cup of coffee and told us the places we should visit. Futher she explaned wich routes we could take. During the week she stayed in contact with us ans send us whatsap messeges with touristic tips. Julieta gives you the feeling to feel at home.

If you plan on having a great trip in Porto, this is where you should stay! Located next to the beach and the historical center, there are plenty of things to see for days and days. The house is also clean, charming and functional. However the main point is Maria Julieta herself: kind and helpful, she made our travel way easier by giving us a commented map and providing precious information about the city, culture and transports. Hurry up and contact her! The price is exceptional, it's totally worth it.

Julieta has an amazing house and she is a very detailic and kind type of person! She's prepared amazing and very detailic maps, journey plans and basically everything you need and even thing you didn't realize you needed! She has an amazing daughter and the flat is in really beautiful area by a beautiful Parque da Cidade that is huge and leads directly to the beach :) I definitely 101%-ly recommend this host!! Muito obrigado!!
Wonderful place with the best location in Porto! Maria Julietta is wonderful host! She is really in love with Porto! Thanx!

Maria is an amazing host. Everything is clean, well prepared and she gave us a lot of information regarding Porto City. Honestly the best Airbnb which I stayed so far. Highly recommend it. Muito obrigado Maria!
Maria is a very nice and hospitable person. Her house is pretty and comfortable. She shared with us her kitchen and terrace. Room was small but clean and nice. Thank You Maria!

We loved our stay here! A bit outside the downtown, which was perfect given how busy Porto was when we visited, and it’s beside the beautiful city park. Also lots of buses going downtown, so it’s easy to explore. Maria was very friendly and helpful, she provided lots of recommendations for local sights and places to eat, and the space itself is lovely. Definitely recommend!

Superhost is right! Really enjoyed my stay with Julieta all around a positive experience. Location was in a nice quiet suburb within walking distance to the city park and amazing beach. Place was spotless well furnished and fully kitted out if you’re looking to cook at home. Julieta was incredibly welcoming. Would highly recommend a stay here!

Excellent location,  walk to downtown along the river. Beautiful, very clean and spacious condo with all amenities. Watch the sun rise over the river. Parking, Cristina is a very charming and personable host with great tips into the Porto area. Highly recommended.

Cristina’s apartment was great, whilst not close to the centre, the walk was no issue. It’s proximity to the railway station and metro enabled us to walk up the hill and travel to other towns directly without having to change at the central station. The views, comfort and amenities were as indicated and should delight, we were very comfortable and all six of us greatly enjoyed are stay in Porto, thank you Cristina!
Perfect for two couples though it was a three bedroom apartment. Cristina met us at the front door as per our communication. She was very helpful with parking and suggestions.

The apartment was spotless clean, which is very important to us, has great view over the river. Fully equipped and very spacious. Cristina was really nice  at meeting us and made us feel welcomed and at home. We arrived by a car and it has private parking in the building. Very handy.I will recommend her place anytime. Thanks again

Christina's place is very spacious, clean and well-equipped.  We arrived earlier than expected as one of our party didn't feel well.  Christina was very accommodating to that and very sympathetic.    Unfortunately, we ended up in the emergency room and only stayed one night before flying back to the States.  The short time we had at Christina's was satisfying with comfortable beds.  Having 2-1/2 baths for 3 people is very convenient, as well. We would recommend staying there.

Cristina is an amazing host. We drove up from Faro and she was there within a few minutes of our arrival to let us in. Her apartment was perfect for 5 and the balcony private. Definitely recommend if you’re looking for a relaxing time in Porto!
One of the greatest view on Porto and the Douro river direct from the bed ! Such a great welcome, from Filipa and her husband. Don't miss the Quay Wine bar on the ground floor !!
Courteous and smiley host, amazing view, awesome big bed, perfect location.  What more could you want?

This place is amazing! Perfect location, beautiful view and a lovely cozy room. We had a lovely warm welcome from our host Filipa, including port and cookies on arrival. We looked at a bunch of places and this was by far the best option. We would definitely stay there again!!

The place was amazing and Filipa and Moises were wonderful hosts  -generous with their time, advice and assistance. Nice wine bar downstairs as well! I'd highly recommend the room - spectacular view and great position to check out Porto.
The location was fantastic. Great view from window and the owner's wine bar downstairs was a real bonus. Very helpful and accommodating.

Looking at the photo of the room with its balcony views of the River Douro, we were expecting a lot. And the thing is, it lived up to all our expectations, and then some! The view is every bit as good as the photo implies, and what you don't see until you walk onto the balcony is all the bustling life below and the incredible view of Eiffel's beautiful bridge. We fell in love with Porto, and when we come back, this will be the first place we choose. Thanks so much to Filipa and Moses

Filipa's place was great. It has great view as just like in photo. Location was also great that right in front of the river. If you looking for the place with nice river view, this place would be the one for your trip.

Location, location, location!! This apartment is centrally located in the heart of Porto. The pictures truly don't do this airbnb justice. We just loved waking up in the morning and opening our doors to the Douro River and the Riviera neighborhood. We enjoyed two amazing dinners on the street behind the apartment and some amazing wines and apps at the Quay Bar underneath the apartment. Would absolutely return anytime we come back to Porto!
You will probably find lots of places to stay in porto, but this place is the best, take it from someone who stayed here x
Filipa’s apartment has definitely the best view in Porto! Location is very good and the room is clean and cozy. Host is also kind and nice :)  Highly recommended!

Very nice, welcoming and helpful host.  The apartment is beautiful with a fantastic view over the river, just like on the photos. It is located (obviously) right next to the river in the old town with all the major sights close by. Also there are a lot of restaurants, bars and wine tasting locations right next door or within a few minutes walk. All in all a great experience and we will certainly stay there again the next time we are in Porto!
The room was in a perfect location close to everything. Filipa were great hosts that helped tremendously with my stay.

Loved everything about this place! It was exactly as described, such a beautiful place with a stunning view. Directly in the middle of everything. Would highly recommend staying there!! Hopefully I’ll be back one day.  Thank you so so much for having us!! We had the best time and would’ve stayed so much longer if we could!

Filipa's apartment is located on the second floor of a building right on the Ribeira. The balcony gives an amazing view of Gaia and Douro River. We would pull the chairs up to the french windows and enjoy our coffee/tea/wine. Filipa also owns the wine bar on the first floor, although they only serve simple bar food, but they are very high quality and yummy. Filipa was very friendly and helpful. This place is a true gem, so much larger and better priced than the hotels in the area.

What an absolutely spectacular apartment!  Your view will be looking out with an unobstructed view over the river and across to the port wine houses in Gaia.  We could have stared out the window all day.  Everything was very beautiful and comfortable.  It was also remarkably quiet considering the location immediately by the river.  We really didn't hear any noise at night at all.  Filipa's restaurant is also a must to enjoy!
Beautiful space, right on the river. The views were amazing. The location was perfect for our stay. Would definitely recommend this place to visitors.
The most amazing Airbnb in the most central location! I wish our stay here was longer, exceeded all expectations!

This apartment is in the most beautiful location. The view is amazing. I honestly felt like sitting at the window and watching the river all day.  It’s located directly above a wine bar which is also owned by Filipa. We ventured down on our first night and were treated to a welcome drink. We stayed for a while and enjoyed some delicious tapas before venturing out around the city. Everyone was friendly and welcoming. The location is right on the river so you have immediate access to restaurants and shopping. It’s also close to the Dom Luis Bridge so we could easily cross the river when we wanted.  The apartment itself isn’t large and doesn’t have a full kitchen (as listed), and the bed is a full size bed so I wouldn’t recommend for more than 2 people. It’s a beautiful space but small. The main appeal is the location and the view which I wouldn’t trade as we were only there a couple of days.

Had a great stay at Filipa’s apartment. Great location with a great view right on the river. Cannot beat the location or the view. Only disadvantage of being at the river level is that everything is uphill from there but also it is downhill on the way back 😀. Filipa and Moises communicated well, had a little misunderstanding about the key on checkout but everything worked out. Also on our last evening we went down for our welcome drink at the wine bar they own below. Moises was super nice and I wish we had had an opportunity to enjoy a tapas dinner and wine there but unfortunately I had booked a different wine and tapas tasting in advance, which I would not do next time, as we had it right there!

We loved Filipa's rental!  Super responsive if we had questions, or needed help, always friendly and made us feel we never asked too much.  The apartment was beautiful with granite stone walls, window doors that opened out to the river with an incredible view.  Plenty of restaurants and attractions within walking distance, and the vibe on the river front was fun, with musicians here and there, lots of restaurants.  An added bonus, a tapas and wine bar right downstairs that was Filipa and Moses place!  If i ever return to Porto, this is where i would stay!  Thank you!

Filipa’s apartment was perfect for our stay in Porto. The view from the balcony was amazing - the best view of the city and the location was perfect for walking, exploring and eating. The apartment was spotlessly clean, the bed was comfortable and the windows filtered out any noise from the river outside. The welcome drink from the bar below the apartment was a lovely touch. We love Porto and will book here again next time we visit.
Amazing apartment with a beautiful view. The hosts were very responsive and extremely helpful and kind. I would recommend it 100%.

Amazing place to stay! Literally, couldn’t be a better location, with a great view of the river. The space is in the middle of SO many great things - walk out the door and you’re surrounded by some of the best spots inporto. The space itself was spacious and cute. Filipa & Moises were the best :)  Super friendly, & very helpful!
Unbeatable views and perfect location. Hosts were so accommodating and we felt like at home. Would stay here again if visiting Porto. Highly recommend!!

A fabulous space, well furnished, with incredible views.  The tasteful apartment, is in a fabulous building, full of history and has everything you need for a stay in Porto! The location could not be better, although in a busy area, you are not affected by noise once the doors and windows are closed.  I have already recommended this Airbnb to many people and we cannot wait to return.

Filipa’s Airbnb was wonderful! It was a beautiful space with a great view. The location was central to lots of restaurants and activities in Porto, and an easy walk to Gaia as well. Would strongly recommend staying here!
We would recommend Filipa's place as it overlooks the river and is surrounded by great places to visit and dine.

This place was a once in a lifetime stay! It was an absolutely stunning location that you can’t beat. It was amazing waking up to the water every day. The host gave great instructions and were very friendly when we interacted with them. We would recommend this stay to anyone interested in visiting porto
This location is unmatched!! The views, access to water, and access to attractions is spot on. Perfect location in the coolest building.
Such a beautiful place to stay in Porto! Waking up to a stunning view of the river was amazing. The hosts were helpful and the location was great. Absolutely recommend!!
Fantastic place! Excellent location and wonderful communication from Mario. We loved the flat and found it very comfortable and clean. We would stay again for sure! Loved Porto, too!!

Mario was very thorough with his information on how to find and access the apartment. We had everything we needed and more! Very well located and nice surroundings. Apartment is even nicer than pictures and the terrace is amazing! We were 3 couples with 3 children under 2. Very comfortable and spacious. Will definitely return. Highly recommend this place. Thank you Mario!

We stayed at Mario's place for a family easter trip to Porto, and I truly hope it hasn't been the last time there! His place is perfect: in the city center, very nice and clean rooms, welcome drink and all sort of helpful tips (maps, app etc), spacious (we were 6 people, but even with 2 or 3 more it'd still be ok!). We felt perfectly comfortable! I can warmly recommand this place! Thank you very much Mario!!!
Mario was great, checked to see that we are all ok and we have all we need.

Great apartment, very central, nice little balcony, lots of bedrooms. Really comfy beds! We didn't meet Mario, but instructions were excellent and it was very easy to find and check in.  Mario's ap is really good and we followed his recommendations for places to eat - all good! Planning to come back!
Mario is very reactive and thoughtful Perfect place, you can do everything by feet. Spacious rooms, very pleasant terrace. But a living room without windows
Great location within easy walking distance of everything! Parking close by. Seagulls are very noisy at night!!! Comfortable apartment.
Beautiful, modern, clean apartment.  Walking distance to shops & River.  Traffic noise a bit loud but otherwise had a fantastic stay.
Thank you Mario!  We had a great time in your place and only wished that we could have stayed longer! We loved the space and your app!  We will definitely come back to Porto! Amy
We enjoy our stay at Mario’s! It was located in a great area with easy access to the Metro. It was walking distance to a lot of places that we wanted to see and do.

We travelled with a couple of friends and we rented the 2 flats Pink and Green. Those flats have a connecting door and are perfect for 2 couples. We were with our 5 month old baby, Eugenia and Luis provided us with a baby bed, baby bath tube, disposable baby-changing cloth... Luis was really helpful via email for the booking and we had a warm welcoming from Eugenia when arriving in Porto. For our next trip to Porto, we already know where we will stay!!!

Never met the son. Moma has her own agenda. Don't waste your time with her. All she did was send us to a construction site once we refused to buy the tours she sells. Apartment was very nice, well located but on a very noisy street. Ok if you can keep the windows closed.
We had a great WE in Porto. The flat is very nice and well located in the medieval center.  Eugenia and Luis will give you good advices and tips to discover the city.

We had a great time at Luis' wonderful apartment. Everything from first contact via mail to our arrival was handled very professionally. All his tips are superb. Highly recommend staying at his place.
Everything from first contact via mail to our arrival was handled very good. The room was nice & clean, nothing to note.  definitely recommended! We had a great time.

We had a very nice stay at your apartment. It's very well situated in the middle of the most beautiful part of the (old) city of Porto. It's well equipped and very clean. Thanks for your tips, we enjoyed Porto! Marc and Kitty

We stayed here for three nights and had a fantastic time! Eugénia welcomed us very cordially and gave us lots of useful information about the history of Porto, the area around the house, as well as nearby restaurants, cafés, beaches. The flat, at five minutes' walk from the riverbank, was very clean and tastefully decorated, and there was a complimentary bottle of port on the table, much appreciated! We will definitely stay here again next time we are in Porto. Muito obrigada!

We stayed in this lovely flat for two nights. The flat was well equipped in the centre of the city. We would recommend it to couples that wish to stay close to all the atractions with all the confort.

Perfect! A most hospitable welcome from Luis, who immediately provided extensive information for enjoying the pleasures of the neighborhood, the city, and the surrounding area (and a complimentary port); a spacious, beautifully and comfortably furnished apartment, with modern kitchen, that provided a quiet haven to return to after days of exploring; an excellent location in walking distance of most of Porto's interesting sights, good restaurants, river front. Extra nice touches in fresh French rolls delivered each morning and the provision of butter, jams, coffee and several other snacks, excellent wifi, and for those who need it, TV reception. And friendly, helpful staff! Yes, perfect!

Excellent stay. From the check-in until the check-out everything was perfect at Eugenias + Luis place. They provided very helpful information to discover Porto and the apartment itself felt like-home, very comfortable and spacious.

Eugenia and Luis' place was absolutely perfect!! I cannot express how charming the place is and how comfortable and convenient the location is to nearly everything you want to see and do in Porto. The directions from the train station were fantastic and a great help! We were greeted by Eugenia who made sure to be there by our arrival time (even though we booked last minute and arrived in the evening). We were given great tips for what to do and see around the city and this helped us plan our time in Porto. We arrived on a Sunday and by the time we got ready for dinner many places had closed, but, Eugenia called some restaurants and got us reservations at a great little place down the street. I can't explain how much we felt at home from the minute we entered the place. Highly recommended and we'll definitely stay here again when we return to Porto!!
Wonderful renovated apartments in the middle of historic Porto. Walking distance to the best spots in town. The hosts are amazing and very helpful.
We had a great stay for an extended weekend at this extraordinary place. Eugenia was a great host, welcoming us with many tips and providing a small breakfast every morning!
The location is great! And, the fresh bread each morning is a nice touch.  The hosts are quick to respond, which is great.  It's a bit noisy but great walkable location.

The apartment is in a great location - it’s easy to walk to all the main sights and there are plenty of restaurants and bars nearby. However it is also very quiet and peaceful, and so comfortable. We had a warm welcome on Sunday evening from Eugenia who shared lots of ideas for restaurants and places to visit. Breakfast rolls and pastries were provided every morning which is a welcome touch. We loved Porto and hope to return one day, and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended.

The welcome we received when we arrived at Eugenia & Luis’s was the best we have ever received. What an outstanding apartment too, beautifully renovated and in a fantastic location. The breakfast supplied was very much appreciated too. We wish we could have stayed longer.

Lovely apartment! Clean and within walking distance to shops and restaurants and public transit. Very central location. Easy checkin and the host was helpful and responded immediately to any questions. Thank you for making our stay so enjoyable!

We could not imagine a better location for a visit to Porto — walking distance to everything, great restaurants in the immediate area, and just far enough from the riverfront activities. The apartment was exactly as shown and super clean. The fresh morning bread delivered to the door was an unexpected treat. Highly recommended!

Eugenia and Luis were kind and helpful from booking to check out, and the apartment was excellent. Communication was easy and prompt leading up to our stay. Eugenia met us at check in and walked us through some informative do’s and don’ts of Porto, all of which turned out to be very helpful.  The apartment itself was truly sparkling clean, with coffee maker and pastries provided. The location made it easy to access all the sights we wanted to see in Porto. We had two days in the city and could easily have stayed for several more.  Thank you both for a wonderful stay, we hope to be back soon.
Great location, safe building with some great suggestions for sightseeing, eats and drinks. Try Portugues de Gema just up the road but make a booking if you can as limited space.
Good location. Cool "vintage" look to things. Some of the furniture could be renewed-fans, matress, tv

Lovely apartment, with everything you may need. Right in the city centre, very close to the river. The host was really nice and they bring you warm bread and croissants early in the morning. Definitely will repeat.

We loved this apartment! The location is just perfect, the apartment is spacious and the apartment is very clean. It had evening we needed for our stay in Porto. Check in was very easy and the hosts are very sweet and easy to get in touch with. Would definitely book again!
Great place in the heart of Porto, within minutes of all the major tourist destinations and transit hubs. The apartment itself is bright and airy, and has everything you need for 1-2 travelers.

This apartment was lovely! I stayed for 18 days, had Porto home base and did some day trips as well as one overnight from there. Great location, super nice and stylish apartment, clean, pleasant, had everything needed. Hosts were very helpful and communicative but also gave much privacy. Porto is a hilly city, and the apartment is also a walk up, so you'll get some climbing exercise in Porto! The windows are double paned and really do an excellent job keeping the lively street noise down - I slept well every night on the comfy bad. Would absolutely stay here again. 5 stars.

Extremely convenient location near Sao Bento station, where you can travel to many other places, including day trips. Close to the water and other areas (e.g. restaurants). Check in and out were very easy and communication was extremely fast. Sound proof windows were very effective. Great facilities. Tons of space. Would highly recommend.

This apartment is great! We loved the location. You will be within short walking distance of many great restaurants and cafes, along with shops and sights to see. Check in is easy, and communication leading up to our stay was great, too. The apartment is clean, with a bunch of natural light. The kitchen is set up nicely and has an electric kettle along with a coffee maker. We appreciated how easy it was to be comfortable here.
We really enjoyed our stay! We were surprised by how this lovely stay is in the middle of the Porto historical center. We are definitely coming back!
Amazing apartment in an amazing area, easy to get to many points of interest.  Hosts were very accommodating! Great internet access/speeds as well!
The hospitality provided was exceptional. The space itself and location are perfect for couples and families visiting Porto. We had a wonderful experience and would highly recommend to others.
Eugenia and Luis were responsive, friendly and had a beautiful apartment for our stay in Porto!

Definitely recommend it to anyone who wants to have a nice clean and accessible place. If you have too many problems with stairs maybe you should reconsider you have about 12 stairs to go but totally manageable

We enjoyed Eugenia and Luis’ hospitality very much. Minor details were settled quickly and communication was excellent. We loved our stay in Porto. Lucky for us the museum of Contemporary Art featured an exhibition of Kusama. Very worthwhile. We certainly recommend this place.
Location location location!! This apartment is phenomenal. Everything we could possibly need on a European vacation. Would love to stay there again and will definitely be recommending others.
Beautiful spot in a perfect location! The apartment was impeccably maintained and offered a comfortable oasis within the heart of Porto. Couldn’t recommend Eugenia and Luis’ place highly enough.

The apartment was clean, comfortable and quiet despite being on a busy road very close to major attractions. There was excellent instruction for access and good communication. A warm welcome awaits!  A tranquil, comfortable stay close to sights and restaurants. We will definitely recommend!

Excellent location in walking distance to the main sites in town. Perfect hosts who were communicative. Happened to be in town for the festival of Sao Joao and they made sure we were ready to participate and prepared for what to expect. Extremely clean. Helpful guide for the city. Would stay again if back in Porto!

Excellent central location, walking distance from several of the major sites. Apartment was clean with adequate space and the necessary amenities for a couple with a small child. Space was quiet and allowed for comfortable rest after long days of sightseeing. Hosts were proactive and responsive with communication, accommodating an early check-in after our overnight flight and helping us with our luggage. We would recommend to anyone and stay here again.

Eugenia and Luis's place was absolutely a great find! perfect location near train station, restaurants, river and all things to do in walking distance. We were welcomed to their home personally and when we entered into our apt. it was beautiful. What a great place to celebrate our 20th anniversary together.  would highly recommend to anyone, don't even hesitate! Thank you for your kindness and all your recommendations. Michelle
Eugenia and Luis’ place was wonderful. It was right in the heart of the city, you can walk to anything in less than 15 minutes. The bed was comfortable and it was quiet.

This Apartment is great! Defenetly go there. It is perfectly located, clean and lovely furnished. Luis organized the transfer from the airport for us which was realy easy and convenient. Highly recommended!!!

Definitely the nicest apartment I have had via airbnb so far! Absolutely beautiful rooms and a nice view and the location is great. Eugenia is a very nice and friendly host and took time to explain a lot to us and to give us really good recommendations for food and sightseeing. To sum up: great host and great apartment, I recommend it very much.

Mouzinho 134 is a really nice, big and well equipped apartment. It's location is great, at walking distance from everything! Eugenia was very nice, she really made everything for us to feel at home, gave us a lot of useful indications about the city and was lovely to our son! Definitely a place to stay in Porto.

This place was simply perfect ... a wonderful flat, centrally located, it had everything we needed and honestly, we just loved it.  I hope to make it to Porto again as it is a special place.  Thank you Eugenia and Luis for making my trip so wonderful!

We had fantastic stay at Mouziho 134, the apartment is spacious and comfortable for 6 people, the location is very central, the view is great. It's in an old building tastefully restored with all the modern comfort and it is spotless clean when we checked in. I had the pleasure to meet Eugenia, she's professional, friendly and very helpful, gave us lots tips about the area. On the whole this is perfect stay and I highly recommend Mouzinho 134!

it was a pleasure to stay in this beautiful apartment. it's located directly in the center of porto. you can reach every spot within minutes. and luis is just great. he helped us with the luggage (2 kids, 3 weeks, a stroller...) and went with me to the car parking which is really near by and gave me tickets which reduced the price by 70 €! i would recommend this apartment!

We are so lucky to have booked this apartment! The staff were so helpful when we arrived, orienting us to the city and providing excellent recommendations for visits and restaurants. The apartment itself is absolutely gorgeous, full of character and very comfortable as well as spotlessly clean. Thanks for the port wine on our arrival and the useful bits and pieces in the kitchen cupboard. This apartment is perfectly located in the old town, just a short walk from the riverside and also very near the Sao Bento station and Metro - a perfect base to explore Porto. We'd love to come again some time!

We were greeted with much enthusiasm by Eugenia, who provided us with a brief history of the area, as well as maps and recommendations for restaurants, bakeries, shopping, etc.  The apartment was recently renovated and very clean.  It is in a great location, within walking distance to many historical sites and the waterfront.  Eugenia was easy reachable by email for any questions we had.  Thanks for a great stay!

We had a very nice stay in Porto. The appartment is perfect for a small group of friends or family: it's well located, well equiped and clean. At our arrival we got a warm welcome with a small bottle of Port and Eugenia was enthousiastic on explaining the highlights and history of Porto.
We had a great time in Porto and this was a lovely apartment.  I would highly recommend to anyone visiting Porto.

We had a really great stay. Hosts were very welcoming and provided really good restaurant and entertainment options in the city. The location is amazing and close to everything. The decorations and furnishing of the apartment is top notch. The building smells amazing throughout. Bathrooms and kitchen area are all newly renovated.  We will definitely book again when visiting Porto and would recommend these apartments highly.  Thank you for your hospitality.  Regards,  Alex

Eugenia and Luis’s property is beautiful and perfectly located in Porto within walking distance to everything. We arrived later than anticipated due to some issues with our rental car, but Eugenia and Luis were very accommodating. When we arrived Eugenia checked us in and was able to provide us with discounted parking passes for a nearby garage. She also gave us a map and list of recommendations that we used for the entirety of our stay. There was a plumbing issue in the apartment during our stay, but our hosts made sure to get in touch with us and give us plenty of notice when the plumber needed to get into our room. The apartment is gorgeous and is exactly as pictured, we liked it so much that we arranged to stay an extra night in our of their other rooms. Don’t hesitate to stay here.  It is beautiful, perfectly located and the hosts are amazing!

This is a lovely apartment with comfortable and quiet bedrooms, a light and open living room with plenty of seating, and a well-stocked kitchen. We were met at the door by Luis, who helped carry our luggage upstairs. He provided a map and a listing of restaurants and shops in the area. Our group enjoyed the bustling neighborhood and found it convenient to sights and services. Nice touches: towel warmers in the bathrooms and a bottle of port on the dining table!

Fantastic apartment in an ideal location with friendly and helpful hosts.  Couldn't have asked for a better place to stay and great value too.  Loved Oporto too, wish we'd had longer than the 3 nights we were there.  Go!
We had a real great time. Luis and Eugenia welcomed us very warmly and the apartment was beautiful, clean and comfortable.

The flat was great - spacious, comfortable and in a great location in the centre of Porto.  It is close to the river and fantastic bars and restaurants.  Highly recommended.  Luis was also very helpful and provided a list of local bars, restaurants and attractions to visit.

The perfect place for a short stay in Porto, near everything! Eugenia is a great host - with detailed information about what to do,  where to go, and the history of the place - and the flat is beautiful. Worth coming back!

If you want to time in Porto make more comfortable and nicer then this apartment is the right choice. The four of us stayed for 3 days and we had a phenomenal time.Apartmant is in the center of the city, 5 to 10 minutes from everything you wanted to visite. Excellent atmosphere, comfortable and quiet and the host is always there for any assistance for you. we enjoyed so much,and we hope that we will be back very soon.Thanks and enjoy Porto Goran

We loved our stay in Porto, it felt like we were neighbors, rather than visitors. Luis and Eugenia left us fresh bread and pastries every morning, and Luis took the time to point out local sights, landmarks, and favorite restaurants to help us get started. That makes a huge difference in how you feel about a place.

We loved staying at Eugenia and Luis' place apartment. They are well located and walking distance from all the historical sites and amazing restaurants. Our vacation timing was a little off as it rained the first two days of our three days stay but we were lucky to have been at this apartment and, despite the rain, left very satisfied with Porto.

This beautifully remodeled, spacious and light-filled apartment is in the heart of Porto's very old and charming historical distract just one block from the river. We were greeted warmly and graciously and Eugenia took the time to introduce us to the neighborhood and recommend many restaurants, cafes, shops and interesting sights to visit. Each morning during our five night stay, we found a bag of fresh rolls hanging on our doorknob! I cannot imagine a more perfect place for our family of 5 to spend our time in lovely Porto.

Loved this place! The unit is essentially one long hallway on the fourth floor (no elevator), with rooms jutting off the hallway. Lots of light in two of the room, no windows/natural light in two rooms. Very fresh bread each morning. Lovely!

The stay at Luis and Eugenia's apartment was excellent all around. The highlights are the amount of space in the apartment, perfect location, and beautiful touches to top it off (fresh bread every morning, amazing restaurant recommendations, etc). No need to look further!
We had a memorable stay, highly recommended! Great location, clean, & very responsive and welcoming hosts (fresh bread, port wine treat and flexibility for checkout)!

Lovely and big appartment in the heart of Porto. Very close to the river but also close to the northern part of the center, actually perfecly situated.  I loved the laundry service for a very reasonnable price

A really great place to stay. It's central, spacious, clean, lovely decor and very comfortable. Lots of nice extras like bread and pastries delivered to your door every morning, coffee, jam ,butter etc all in the fridge. Great views from our top floor flat and plenty of exercise getting up to it! Our lovely hosts were very helpful with local tips and nothing was too much trouble. Highly recommended.

The apartment is in a great location! The space is beautiful and the morning bread and pastries is a wonderful added touch! Check in was a breeze and we were provided great recommendations on where to eat and what to see! Would most definitely stay here again should we be back to Porto!
Very nice apartment. Only problem for senior adults are the four floors to climb. The rest is perfect.

Place was absolutely perfect - great location.  Wonderful hospitality- Port on arrival, and great fresh bread and pastries for breakfast. They provided maps and tips on the city which were really helpful. Faultless all round.

Personable and hospitable hosts. Eugenia and Luis are proud of their place, and of the town of Porto, and it shows in their communication, the information they provide throughout the course of the visit, the upkeep of the place and the quality of the experience they create.

This is an appartement hôtel with multiple appartements in the same building. Easy to manage. The check in was smooth although the cleaning lady does not speak English there was clear instruction and detailed trip advice left for us.  The appartement was on the last floor so a lot of stairs to climb. Super clean and all facilities run well. The beds are bit too soft to our taste and two rooms have no outside window so can be bit hot depending on the season. The whole floor is leaning badly as the building must be very old. Sometimes you feel dizzy walking or standing in the room. Excellent location! Enjoyed it very much. Thank you.

Apartment was AMAZING! Perfect location and everything they say but better.  Check-in was very informative, friendly and welcoming. They even provided fresh croissants and bread daily!  They offer a laundry service as well and it is well worth the spend! We would absolutely stay here again next time in Porto!! Best place we stayed in our whole trip through Spain and Portugal. Thank you, again!!
For the price the location is great but the road to the front of the building is very noisy. Lack of AC made the apartment very stuffy.

Great place for a long weekend in Porto! Really near all the sights in the center and very convenient if arriving by plane. The Porto wine bottle, crackers and sardine paté are nice welcoming touches and the beds are very confortable. If carrying heavy bags or having any mobility issues take into account that the steps from the front entrance are quite high. Otherwise a really great place for a nice stay in Porto!
The apartment is great, very easy to get around to all the touristic places, just a short walk away. Communication was great, we never had any issues! Would def come back!

Wonderful well furnished apartment located very conveniently. We travelled as a family of four and thae apartment offered a great space for all to read and relax. The kitchen was well stocked and the view from them living room was amazing. Close the windows and all hustle and bustle of the street disappeared.  Wonderful stay.

Great apartment in the heart of Porto!  3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms as described with a nice large living area with windows to the street.  This apartment is within walking distance (within 10 minutes) to nearly every attraction in Porto.  Even walking to Guia on the other side of the river is a quick 15 minutes! The apartment was clean, updated, and modern.  Communication with the hosts was fantastic, and they were able to accommodate our schedule for check-in.  Our family would recommend staying here for a nice trip to Porto.   One comment for future guests.  Check into parking garage rates nearby, the closest and most convenient one does not offer discounts for full-day parking, which can get quite expensive.
Great family-friendly appartment in the heart of downtown.  Easy walks to the Ribeira, Sé, Dom Luis I bridge, and Clerigos Church.  Would stay here again!

This location is fantastic, the apartment spotlessly clean and the responsiveness of the owner’s excellent. The amenities are as listed although I missed that there was no washing machine. Laundromats are close by. There is no aircon but every room had fans. The living space and main bedroom remained cool by keeping the windows open. This was harder to do for the second and third bedrooms  but fans kept the temperature down in those rooms. We loved the living space it was large,  roomy and airy.  The location was amazing there was nothing we couldn’t walk to. There are a few flights of stairs to climb but they were wide and easy to navigate.

We enjoyed staying in this villa. The villa was very clean. The location was perfect and close to restaurants and shops. The owners are so easy to work with. They had all the local information for us..  There are some stairs that you need to climb, but it is worth the climb! We really had a great time! Hope to stay in this charming villa again!   - Sarah

Really had a great stay. It’s a beautiful and completely walkable location in the old Porto. The apartment itself is a renovated apartment in an old building, very comfortable and well stocked. The hosts were very responsive and helpful, including coming in late to provide us with a pack’n play and toddler mattress. Our favorite Airbnb in Portugal.

We had a wonderful stay! Two parents and two teens had room to stretch out but with space to get together. Bathrooms were updated and very clean. The hosts responded promptly to all questions. We’d definitely stay again! Thanks for the wonderful visit!

We had a fantastic stay! We were greeted by the host's representative, who was absolutely amazing, such a lovely person and very thorough in walking us through everything. The location is right in the heart of the city, super close to everything you could need or want to explore. The place itself was immaculate, spotless and clearly well cared for, with extra touches that made it feel special. The port and jam left for us on arrival were such a thoughtful and delicious surprise! We highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a comfortable and upscale stay in the city. They truly went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect.

We absolutely loved this apartment! So close to the River, and so many restaurants and things to do. Lively area, but the windows were great for soundproofing at night. We felt right at home…. Thank you Eugenia and Luis!
The accommodation and hosts were great.  There are a lot of stairs. Probably not for the elderly or unfit.

We never got to meet Helena. We were welcome by Eduardo instead, who kindly showed us the apartment and gave us the usual directions. He was very nice and helpful. We loved the apartment, a refurbished old flat, with high ceilings and big rooms. It is much bigger than it looks from the pictures.   The apartment was cold the first night, probably because it was empty the week before. Heating was set on and off automatically but It took that night and the following day to get to a comfortable temperature inside the house. At times it was colder inside than outside.  Location was good. Pretty close to Porto's city centre, but "far" enough to be quiet at night, which is especially interesting when you travel with kids.  muito obrigado!
We had a very good time at eduardo's place! The appartement was very clean and cosy. All touristic places are accessible by walk. Thank you for the warm welcome! We highly recommend this place :)

What a beautiful and perfect place to discover Porto! Right in the middle of the art districts all you need to see is around. Eduardo was an amazing host! Very understanding and flexible. I will come back to his apartment! Namaste

Host is amazing! Very helpful.  We got towed and couldn't have gotten the car back without him.  He even drove us to pick up the apartment.  Apartment is very nice, clean, good location and there are so many treats left for you to make you feel welcome!  Such a good stop, wish we could have stayed longer!

We enjoyed very much our stay in Porto and in Helena's flat. Eduardo expected us at arrival, the flat is very well situated and clean. Although in the center, with the windows closed the sleeping room was calm and we slept well. Everything is like described. We can recommend the flat to everyone, especially if u look for a place from where u can explore the beautiful city by foot. Thank you!

We had a great time in Helena's apartment. Eduardo welcomed us and was very supportive. We are very glad that we took his advice to visit Aveiro. The apartment is very spacious and as described. You can easily reach the city by foot. We would definitvely recommend this place.

The flat was spotless and clutter-free. We enjoyed every bit of our stay. The neighborhood is lively - cafes, shops, restaurants, galleries at a stone's throw. Helena and her husband were very nice and I can say it was one of hour best airbnb experiences so far. Thank you for your hospitality!!

Rosário is a great place to stay when you are in Porto. It is soo beautiful and super clean. The apartment is pretty big and very nicely furnished. It is located very close to the old town (a few minutes walking). When we arrived we got a very warm welcome from Eduardo explaining us everything and giving us tips for our stay in Porto. We totally recommend this apartment!

The communication with Helena and Eduardo was super easy. Eduardo waited for us at the appartment and made the check-in. He also gave us good tips for our City trip. The Apartment is spacious, super clean, cozy and super-equipped. We really felt like home! By 10 minutes of walking you are in the City Center.  Eduardo and Helena were brilliant Hosts. Highly recommended!!! We hope to come back to the beautiful City of Porto!

This apartment was incredibly comfortable, spacious and nicely laid out, we enjoyed the location and the abundant amount of parking available streetside.  Our hosts were generous and flexible and we couldn’t have been happier to spend our time in Porto there.
This is a great place to stay. Comfortable, very clean and in great location. Eduardo was very helpful and accommodating.  We had great time. We would love to visit again. Thank you!

Such a great apartment! It is pretty close to the centre of Porto and Eduardo was very helpful to locate everything on our map. The apartment is superclean and very nicely decorated! Towels, toiletpaper, sheets, ... everything is provided.

Very clean and nicely decorated with several thoughtful touches like wine and chocolate. It’s about 15 min walk from heart of city which is done well specially going down. The old building is well kept and has a lot of character with hardwood floors and high ceilings. The sofa bed was firm and comfortable.  I will definitely return.

My husband and I had a great time staying at Eduardo and Helena’s apartment, very clean and functional and very accessible to the town centre and tourist attractions. Much appreciated the welcoming treats and friendly advice, they were both very quick to reply to all queries and prompt to come over to the apartment when/if needed. I would recommend their accommodation without hesitation.
We had a lovely stay in Porto at Helena’s apartment, the location was ideal and check in was very easy!
So much space , so well appointed! And the fabulous garden space! Great neighborhood! Hospitality genuine and so helpful! A MUST stop over in Porto !
Incredible location and spot. The apartment is huge and very nicely situated. I was beyond impressed with the accommodations and value.

IT was a Nice and big appartement, clean and every kitchen aplliances were good quality.  The place was well located also.  The husband of Helena welcomed us and explained to us where was the best spots to visite in Porto on a card.  I would recommend this place to everyone.

I enjoyed my stay here while in Porto. Everything was great (aside from some noisy neighbors that were upstairs---but that was out of their control). The space looked exactly like the pictures, and I would not hesitate to stay there on a future trip to Porto. There are some hidden gems in the neighborhood that I really enjoyed. And, once I got an understanding of the lay of the land, I was able to create my own little shortcuts into the city center.

Our stay was incredibly comfortable and the Airbnb was super cute and a good size place. It was around a bunch of cafes and restaurants and so close to all attractions. Our only complaint is as not really being well informed about the parking in the area.  I would definitely recommend Helena’s place to anyone travelling to Porto.

I loved my stay at Helena and Eduardo’s apartment, very clean and spacious and has everything you need! Good location, only a short walk from the main centre.  Only downside was the people upstairs were quite noisy late at night but there’s nothing that can really be done about that.

I had a great stay in Porto. Eduardo waited for me to arrive at the apartment and showed me the apartment. It is a very spacious , sunny and lovely place. The location is great, walking distance to all the attractions and nice restaurants. Would definately recommend to stay here !
Perfect location and lovely host.  I have stayed here before several years ago and would certainly do so again if coming to Porto.

We enjoyed our stay in Helena and Eudouro 's house and 100% recommend. It's closed to everywhere(15mins to 20mins walking distance to the main tourist attractions), there's nearby metro station to the airport. Quiet and safe neighbourhood,  great supermarkets nearby. The flat is comfortable and roomy, the bed is so comfortable, kitchen is well equipped. The hosts are very friendly and flexible about check in and out,  worth every penny to stay with them.

Carla's apartment was excellent!!! It was very clean and comfortable, in such a beautiful and characteristic street in the middle of the historical centre of Oporto. Carla welcomed us very kindly and she adviced us lots of places to visit and experience to do in the city, and she also adviced us a little typical restaurant that was very cheap and had such great food! Thank you Carla we really enjoyned it, and we hope to come back soon :)  Willy & Cristina
Thank you Carla for your welcoming. Our journey to Porto was awesome thank to you. Your apartment is very well located and near Rio Douro and Ponte Luis. I really recommend this place

Carla and Marco are very friendly and have very good advices (ask them about the best pasteis de nata in the neighbourhood you will not be disappointed). The appartment is clean, well furnished and very well situated. The 2 single beds are not recommanded for people taller than 1,70m. A very good stay, we do recommand the appartment.

A pleasant accomodation, very close to all the major sights of Porto. Well-equipped and comfortable apartament. The whole "procedures" part was smooth. On the whole, it's definitely a place to recommend if you plan to stay in Porto!
Everything was perfect ! The studio is extremly well situated ! Our weekend was amazing !  Thanks Carla !
Lovely refurbished apartment in the old town of Porto.  Right in the middle of everywhere, but still quiet and relaxing.  Very helpful and friendly host - thanks Carla :-)

Carla and her husband were very nice and helpful.  They gave us great recommendations on things to do in Porto.    The apartment is in a great location and is clean and nice and exactly as it looks in the pictures.

The apartment is lovely: very well located in the city center, nicely renovated, clean and equipped with all needed domestic appliances. Carla was super friendly and helpful, she gave us some good tips for things to do in the surroundings and local restaurants.  The only thing you maybe should take into account, is that the ceiling is quite thin. A couple with their 2 young kids was staying in the studio above us, running from one side to the other till late evening, and it sometimes seemed as if they were standing in our room.

Carla is very nice and she helped us we everything that we needed to know about the city. The place is lovely even if it's quite dark as there is only one window. The apartment is very close to the center and you can do a lot of things just by walking. I recomend it!

Our stay at the apartment of Marco and Carla was perfect. Carla welcomed us with great tips of the surroundings and the location was ideal! Right in the heart of the old centre but is a small quiet street. The apartment is beautiful, clean and good equipped. It felt like our home for 5 days! Recommended!!

We were made welcome, the apartment is tiny but adequate and met all the needs domestically.  However, the apartment is situated in an extremely noisy street, a mens club opposite, screaming neighbours, and a special needs girl who just screams and screams.  Very unfortunate.  The apartment has only a small window facing the street, very claustraphobic, and with the noise issue made sleeping very difficult, as the noise goes on every night!
A very pleasant studio with complete facilities. Marco is very handsome and warmhearted. He provided much help. Also, Check-in is easy. We really had a nice experience in Porto. Thank you Marco.
The place was great and located on a quiet street. The host gave us some precious infos about where to dine and have breakfast. Would recommend.

Although Marco did not meet me in person, I was always able to contact him when I needed help. His colleague Nani was there to greet me on arrival and was very helpful with my inquiries. Excellent service and a brilliant studio apartment.

Simply perfect. Very welcoming host and easy check-in. Super helpful and willing to explain everything we want to know about the city, really making this trip into one which cannot be forgotten. The apartment is all one could ask for: clean, tidy, pretty, spacious and comfortable. Also it is situated in a great neighborhood, close to everything and very lively. If you are coming to Porto do not hesitate, stay here!!
A lovely stay, great comfortable apartment, close to many interesting locations in the area. Hosts were very helpful throughout. Thoroughly recommend! :)

Marco was there waiting for us on arrival. The flat was just as described (very spacious for 2, clean and in a fab location).   Marco gave us some excellent advice for exploring Porto and we had a great few days. Would highly recommend.
Apartment was lovely & very close to everything. Kept very clean & tidy which we loved. Enjoyed the streets atmosphere when we arrived as they had assumption day festivities on.

This apartment was in the historic city center of Porto, a great location with shops and restaurants within easy walking distance.  It was very clean and tidy, and had all the amenities we needed.  We stayed out late every night, and felt safe walking home.  We look forward to visiting again soon...

Amazing hosts! Communication with Marco was easy. Carla was very welcoming and helpful at check-in. The apartment is clean, comfortable, and central. They also have a detailed guidebook with important information and more suggestions. Overall, great place to stay in Porto!

We had a wonderful time at Marco's unit! The apartment was perfect to settle into for a couple days, and the perfect location - accessible to great food and exploration spots while still having a neighborhood vibe and calmness. We also received excellent suggestions for dinner and sites to visit; we felt very welcomed and would absolutely stay here again.
A lovely appartment, perfectly situated right in the heart of Porto. Marco was kind and welcoming from the start. Highly rated!

Very conveniently located and easy to get to from the airport. Carla greeted us upon our arrival to the flat and gave us some wonderful tips of where to eat - especially the Francesinha! - wouldn't hesitate to book with Carla and Marco again.

We are very satisfied about Marco's appartment . In spite of not meeting him and his wife, we enjoyed very much our last week-end in Porto . This home is very well located. Everything is close concerning visits, restaurants. Otherwise, we particularly liked the charm , the quietness and the cleanliness of this well-equipped location. We do recommand this Airbnb home which has a good value for money. Thank you to Marco and Carla about everything  .... and maybe see you soon for an other time Valérie et Philippe

The apartment is very well located, right in the heart of the city. It is very nice, clean, well priced, and an excellent place to stay when in Porto. Would definitely reccomend if you're visiting Porto.

Looking for a place in the middle of all the action? Then This studio is for you. The design is a combination of old and new. Stone walls and stone seating area by the window. Modern kitchen and bathroom. With in walking distance to many of the sites on your list , cafes and bars. Area can be a little noisy if you want to go to sleep early or want piece and quiet. Not handicap accessible.
We spent 3 days in this beautiful apartment. The location is great and we walked everything by foot. The apartment was larger than I thought, very comfortable and clean. Any time again.
An utterly fantastic location, right in the heart of the old town. A very charming apartment, spacious, clean and fully fitted for a very comfortable stay. Highly, highly recommend!
Great place in the middle of Porto. Our check-in was particularly easy with our host greeting us with keys and advice for our stay.

Highly recommend this place! The hosts are very kind and responsive and accommodating (they made check in easy for us even if we were arriving late). They also provided a small guidebook of recommendations that were AMAZING!  The place itself was amazingly clean and very cute!! It was in a fantastic central location and easily walkable to a bunch of sites. Bathroom was cute and clean and stylish and the stone wall in the apartment was very nice.  Checkout was also easy! Loved this place!

Marco’s place was perfect for us - a 10 minute walk to the station and a 5 minute walk down to the riverfront and the centre of the Old Town.  Carla was kind enough to let us drop off our luggage a little earlier than their 3pm check-in time, which was very helpful as it allowed us time to explore the city.  Carla’s communication was excellent and she always responded quickly to my enquiries.  Recommended.

Great place to stay in the center of Porto. Fancy a wine at the bar, a walk in the gardens or a coffee by the river - you have everything close by! The check in and check out is super easy and I would always come back!
The apartment is spacious, clean, well equipped and in a very handy location. Carla was a great host and a pleasure to deal with.
the apartment very clean and nice and it is located in the city Center, all tourist attractions can be reached by foot

Absolutely lovely apartment in the heart Porto! The check in is very smooth due to codes provided for the front and apartment door. We really liked the helpful and detailed recommendations and descriptions of Porto, especially for the food! The apartment was very clean with a well equipped kitchen. Definitely recommended, would have loved to stay longer!! Thanks! Porto is definitely worth the visit.
The place was perfectly clean, and the location is very convenient. Only negative point is that it was quite noisy. But overall we really enjoyed our stay!
Very nice apartment with all the equipments needed. Great location and the guest was very easy to talk to and helpful.
The place was in a great location. It was super close to the river, main attractions, and lots of restaurants. Marco was very friendly and responsive.
Marcos was very friendly and we had a lovely time in their place. Short distance to great spots in Porto! Thanks for everything!
We enjoyed our stay at Marco’s place. It was very central and made getting places very easy.

100% recommend this AirBnB! It was a lovely, comfortable place to stay in for several nights with a fully functional kitchen and clean bathroom. The neighborhood was lovely and lively in the evening with the locals meeting up and having a small celebration. Everything in Porto was easily walkable from here or close to bus and train stations. We would definitely stay here again!
The accommodation is  in a really good area surrounded by restaurants and nice viewing spots. Marco is really helpful and communicates quickly.

A lovely apartment, very well equipped and comfortable with some charming decor, very hot shower, comfortable bed (with spare bed as well),  in a friendly residential location but just a step away from Porto's attractions.  Marco let me check in early which was a tremendous help after a very early flight.  The pop up restaurant next door had a late  lively night on Saturday, but this is I believe only on Saturdays and looked like a lot of fun. The neighbourhood is very calm, with some lovely (very cheap!!!)  cafes and restaurants with great views just round the corner, and only about  ten minute walk to to the centre of town and ten minutes to the river.  I really enjoyed staying here. Thank you Marco.

Amazing host,  very responsive. The place was clean when we arrived. Location was great too, walkable to the main area of the city centre but far enough that it is quiet so easy to sleep.  Well worth it and would recommend every time.
The accompdstion was in a great location to exlplore Lisbon. Marco was responsive and was very helpful in making our stay extremely comfortable.
Great central location.  Very comfortable bed and it is quiet for sleeping.  Had everything we needed.  Marco was very helpful with instructions on catching metro.
The apartment was very clean and exactly as in photos. The host  responded quickly to our messages.

Marco was a great host, very nice and provided us with a document full of recommendations and advice for our stay in Porto. We were also granted an early check in as the apartment was available early. I would highly recommend staying here in the future!
A lovely apartment, great for two people. A really comfortable double bed! Kitchen fully equipped. Lurdes was good about our late arrival and changed details.

This is a truly amazing apartment right on the seaside, with fantastic views of the sunset. We had an absolutely amazing time. The apartment is modern, clean and with all the amenities you need. Parking is easy just in front of the building.
Lurdes and Edgar are brilliant, caring hosts and they not only made feel at home they were promptly responsive to my inquiries and always helpful. Thank you 🙏 Lurdes and Edgar
A nice apartment! Extra cozy with a good fire place which made it nice even in rainy season.

Beautiful place with good atmosphere, nice to have breakfast outside, close to the beach, nice bike rides to Porto and most of all: great hosts! Thank you Bernardo, it was wonderful. We hope to come back one day.

Bernardo was very accommodating and the blue and white house was comfortable and clean. We arrived at night and he was there to greet us and show us all of the great places to visit and foods to eat. The beach is a short walk and the outdoor sitting area is sweet. It is located on his grandfather's former olive facility and it was interesting to see the big concrete vats they were stored in and the story of the process.

Me and my little daughter stayed at Bernardos house for five nights. It was like in the description and the beautiful beach is very close. Bernardo and his family were very kind and helpful. I think it is a ideal place for surfers especially but also for everyone else who just wants to enjoy a nice time in a cosy and good equipped appartement!
Very welcoming, the host meet us in the night in the pouring rain and made sure we were at home - the fridge had cold beer and everything was clean and comfy.

My BF an I had a long weekend in Portos beautiful Suburb. The Beach is maybe a minute walk from the cosy apartment. They have a sweet bars and cafes around the corner and also a nice seaside walk. Surfspots like Espinho is a 15 min drive. All in all it was a Great experience for is. Unfortunately Bernando wasn't home but his mom is adorable. We went out together on Friday night and had a great dinner in a local fish restaurant. Very good talks about life and also Future plans. We had an anwesend experience that we wont forget, we definitely will return someday. The apartment was very clean and had everything u need. Good kitchen, wifi, porch and new bathroom. Definitely worth it. We felt very very welcomed and comfortable,thank u

We had a great stay in Bernardo's apartment!! It is located just a few steps away from the wonderful beach, really comfortable and nicely furnished and clean. Last but not least there is Bernardo's mum, who made our trip to Porto an unforgettable journey. She cared for us all the time - thank you again!! We love you - see you soon! :)

We searched for a long time before we founded the house, we did not know where we had to get off the bus and wich way we had to follow. When we arrived everything was very good, Bernardo's mother, Suzanna, let us into the surf house and it looked exactly like the pictures.  The house is very cosy! If you like to surf or kitesurf this is the ideal place. You get to the beach by walinking 5min. If you want to lay down at the beach, it can get very cold because there is a lot of wind.  Next to the house there is a busstop where you can take the bus to the centre of Porto, +-40 min. Lovely house, nice stay, thanks a lot Suzanna!

We really loved the little villa. It is close to the beach and the center of Porto is easily accessible.  We haven't seen Bernardo but he responded great to all our questions before our stay. Again thank you Suzanne, for being a wonderful host!!

Bernardo and Suzana were great hosts. They were very friendly and helpful, and made me feel like at home. The beach house is big enough for two persons. It's well-equipped, well-furnished, clean, and quite close to the beach and a supermarket. The only thing is, if you go there by bus, you should be careful since google doesn't know the bus routes in the area. It was one of my greatest experiences on airbnb. I will definitely come back one day!

Thank you Suzana and Bernardo for making our stay in Vila Nova de Gaia WONDERFUL!!!!!!!! Everything that I read on the reviews was exactly as described and more!! Suzana helped us with tips about  Porto , supermarkets and restaurants .She also provided us with things that we forgot to bring... The house was spotless,  a walking distance to the beach and easy access to public transportation. I HIGHLY recommend this place!!!!!

I stayed at the Airbnb with my little brother, we had a great time. Suzana was super welcoming, she was present all the time and you could always ask for anything. Bernardo took us to his surf school. They offer a lift to the airport which is super helpful.  The place is very close to the beautiful beach (watch the sunset!). We loved that we were nearly alone at the beach, it’s never crowded. The house has everything you need and the supermarket is close by.  It takes awhile to get to Porto by bus but by car it’s super fast.  We met lovely people and became friends with Suzana, Bernardo and also the other guests.  Would definitely come back and highly recommend the place espacially if yo want to surf and have a relaxed time! Thank you for everything, Suzana!

We had an amazing time at this Airbnb! A lot of nice people and other guests. We would really recommend this place for everyone that loves to be around people and that loves to surfs or do other stuff.

Had a really enjoyable stay. Great people, who we’re carring so well that we felt welcomed. Such a calming eviroment which is not as far form Porto as it may seem. We went there by bike , which she provided to us. Thank U a lot for those day
Great host,  They made our trip special.. a great welcome and a lot of advices to enjoy our trip.  The place is nice and close to the city or the ocean! Will definitly recomand!
Well located; few minutes walk from the beach and a short drive from Porto. Beautiful little house with everything you need, and the host was very helpful.

It was like being in a small cozy village! This old Olives Factory turned into an Air b&b for this amazing family was a really nice experience Bernardo was a super nice and friendly host and his mum was super nice and helpful when I had and accident and I need help, she was like a mum and she try to help me in all she could The apartment was really clean and had all things and accesories u could need, and the access to the amazing beach was just 5 min walking Super recommended!!!!
The accomodation is great for the beach. It is about a 40 min cycle into Porto centre along the coast - a very pleasant cycle.

Very nice little apartment, cozy and super lovely hosts. We could choose to have twin or double beds. Everything was clean. Location is good, few min walk from the beach with a good path for running or walking. Porto easy to reach by car, uber or A longer walk and boat. It‘s been a pleasure staying with Suzana and Bernardo. Also the surf lesson with Bernardo was very very nice.
Fantastic place - super clean and comfortable. Has everything you need. Close to the beach, shops and beach bars.
Very nice place. Clean and got all essentials. Host is very sweet and very helpful with good recommendations.

Susan and her son Bernardo are native to Vila Nova di Gaia. The guest cottage I stayed in was comfortable, beachy, and peaceful. I walked to the beach each morning for coffee and breakfast at Ar d’Mar— thank you, Rui. Susan recommended terrific sights (Janet Echelman’s Anemone and the Eiffel Bridge) and restaurants: Brasao and San Valentim. We had terrific conversations about interests in common. Finally, Bernardo has established a well-organized instructional program for surfing (!) Yes, I need to take lessons next time. Thank you!

A great place to stay with wonderful hosts. added bonuses were that we got to have a brilliant paddle-boarding induction on the river and to enjoy the company of  the 2 friendly dogs. We thoroughly recommend this place.

This is my second visit to 'Surf n olives' after several years of absence. I came here this time both to surf and also to recuperate from a health issue. Bernardo and Suzana were the very definition of kindness itself.  Bernardo is a first rate surf instructor. He has a keen eye for detail and also was incredibly patient with working around some of my physical limitations. Hehas a superb positive energy about him, and I always feel inspired to do better and keep improving under his tutelage.  Suzana is one of the kindest, most generous and gentle people I have ever met. She made every effort to take good care of me during my stay. I feel like I have a second family now and can't wait to visit again for more surf, fun, friendship and delicious Portuguese food!

We had a lovely stay at Surf & Olives. Dan was able to hire a wet suit & surfboard. Beach at the end of the street. He was very happy. Easy 15min drive to get into Porto. Beach at the end of the street.

I was well recieved from Jeronimo's friend which explained everything to me. Location is very central close to rua de cedofeitas. I came here for a business trip and appartment had everything you need. I can easily recommend it.

Jerónimo's place is great. It's clean, cozy, nice and well-located. You even have a TV and Jerónimo's help is unique and quite friendly, he gave us plenty of information and advice on how to know Porto. If you want to party don't miss Rua Tapas & Music and Breyner 85, which are very close to the apartment
Jerónimo was a friendly and welcoming host and his studio apartment was ideally located and perfect for 2 for a long weekend. Thank you!

The positives: Very quiet cute flat in a nice area of Porto. Good check in. Lovely building. Wonderful to have such a good shower and great black-out blind! TV. Amazing restaurant only two doors away (try the sardines!). Good transport links. Clean. The negatives: Very stuffy as only one window in the whole flat and that doesn't open fully for ventilation. Probably some of the blankets could be refreshed or washable as I don't like using anything that has been used by previous guests. Mattress not very comfortable. Hob difficult to use to the point we couldn't actually cook at home.
I highly recommend this place. It is in a perfect location, and the flat is really clean and well kept.
Nicely located apartment, with all amenities and a supermarket not far (convenient!). Within walking distance from most touristy spots.  Hosts are very responsive! Overall a good experience in Porto
I enjoyed my stay at the studio, great location a little outside the busiest areas but still within walking distance. Good value!
Great location, great house. I didn't find it tiny. Only problem: it can easily get hot in the house especially when you cook

This is an amazing location for peace, quiet, beautiful views and great hiking trails. There is everything you need created with great hospitality in mind. We loved the delicious complimentary jam and port as well. We’ll surely be back to this beautiful area.

Beautiful location. Perfect if you are looking for a quite and peaceful place to stay. Positioned half way between Porto and Aveiro is a perfect choice if you aim to visit the main cities around escaping the cahos of the citylife. Ana was very nice and helpful. Check in and check out went very smooth.

Jerónimo was such a great host, very friendly and obliging. The apartment was clean with the perfect location in Porto's historic centre. We will definitely recommend it and hope to be able to come back soon!

The studio is lovely and very well located. We were pleasantly surprised to find fresh bottles of water and biscuits waiting for us on arrival. The location is perfect, right in the center, yet calm and peaceful. The only downside for us was the lack of air conditioning, as the apartment became quite hot during our stay. Since the window cannot be opened when the blind is down, ventilation was a bit tricky, though a fan was kindly provided. Overall, we had a great stay and really appreciated the thoughtful touches from our host.

This apartment worked well for us.  It is in walking distance of all the central attractions, but we also liked that it was a little outside the most touristy areas, so quite peaceful to come back to after being out and about all day. It has a  nice outlook to the law school and church across the road, and the bed was very comfortable. It was easy to get to from the airport, and there is a supermarket, bakeries and fruit shops near by.

We with my mom and sister had a great time in Abel`s apartment. Its modern, bright and very comfortable, equipped with all necessities. Location is just perfect - in a walking distance of everything, including train station. One more important thing - apt equipped with general heating, which is really important cuz its cold in the night)  Hosts were very helpful suggesting some restaurants and other places.  If I come to Porto again Id defenetly want to stay in this beautiful central apartment. And of course i reccomend my friends this place!

Perfect stay in the heart of Porto. Just a few walking minutes to the night life centre and the river. Abel was a kind host who had nice recommendations that helped a lot. The apartment is as fancy as in the pictures and has everything you need to recover from long days and nights in Porto.  Arne
Very nice and clean place in the city center! No problems with the host or the apartment. I definitely recommend staying here.
Really enjoyed this spacious light and modern apartment and it's great location for our week in Porto. Definitely recommend it.

I had a wonderful introduction to Porto (and Airbnb) thanks to Rose and Abel.  Rose was a wonderful hostess.  Her warm welcome and thoughtful guidance helped me to make the most of my stay in Porto.  Abel's apartment was even nicer than the pictures and the location could not have been better.    This stylish, centrally located base was perfect.  It was so clean and well-appointed that I felt completely at home.  I am already planning my next trip to Porto which of course will be scheduled around the availability of Abel's flat!

Abel's flat is huge, clean and in very convenient location. We stayed here only for a night but thanks to this, we could go many places. His flat locates just 10 min walk from Trindade station. Unfortunately, a little bit noisy at night but absolutely recommendable flat!

Rose was very kind to us and we felt very welcome. The only complaint we had was some noise on friday and saturday, as there is a bar below the windows of the bedrooms. The location is perfect, everything is nearby and the kitchen and bathroom were huge.
Fantastic apartment, very helpful host and a great central location. Thank You very much Abel & Rose
This is a great flat for exploring Porto. It's very modern and roomy. Close to the old town nightlife. Highly recommended
