This was a great place to stay in the beautiful city of Porto. The location was close to everything... great restaurants and cafes nearby. The space is very large.

The flat was exactly as in the pictures, very clean and comfortable. Great location near the main attractions was a plus. However, it can get quite noisy at night as people tend to gather at the park outside.
Abel's place was beautiful, spacious, clean and looked even better in real life than in photos. Check-in was smooth and the location is outstanding. Calm but still in the city center.
Spacy, well furnitured and perfect located apartment in the heart of Porto. Good communication with the host, everything perfect! Don't come by car, parking is incredible expensive!

Location was fantastic.  We had 5 different great meals within a block of the apartment.  Most of the major tourist sites were nearby (and downhill!)  Apartment was accurately described, clean, and well equipped.  Had an unforgettable visit.  Highly recommended.

Fantastic apartment in a great location. Was perfect for our group of 3 guys but could have had room for one or two more people overall. Rose and Abel really lovely hosts and very helpful during our stay
Great apartment!  The location was excellent with a lot of restaurants around the block!
Spacious place to stay at a great location. The overall experience was amazing! Rose is a lovely host, and communication was efficient.
The apartment is really beatutiful and is located in a very beautiful square, close to all interesting places in Porto. It was clean and had everything you need (shets, towels...)

Lovely spacious apartment. Three of us stayed here for 5 days and had a wonderful time. The flat was spotlessly clean and had everything we needed. It is very centrally located, we walked everywhere from this location! Lovely bars and restaurants close by. Abel and co were easy to get hold of if we needed anything too. Thank you for a great stay!
The apartment is in a great location and very spacious.  Marta was also very prompt in responding to our questions and issues after check in.
The apartment is even bigger than it looks in the photos with a great location. Unfortunately the bedding was not clean.
The property is in a prime location to get anywhere you want around the city. If you drive into the city, parking is extremely simple, by it being right outside the front door.

Perfect location to Stay in Porto, Apartment is everything as described,  even though we didn't get to meet the hosts communication was excellent and check in/out process was flawless. Would definitely recommend to everybody and stay here without hesitation! Muito obrigado!
The location was excellent and it was easy to walk to most of the major attractions of the city.  There were many nearby bars and restaurants.  The apartment is stylish and well equipped.

This was in a great location - very near all the major sites, next to the nightlife, and several restaurants were located on the same block.  The apartment itself is huge and had thoughtful touches like mini shower gels, and coffee pods for the coffee maker.  Apartment was clean and check in was simple. Would definitely stay here again!

The apartment is nice and in a great location.  However the service that we received was not welcoming or responsive.This is a shame because there were many good things about the apartment – comfortable beds, clean linen and a nice bathroom.
Nice place in the center of Porto, quick and helpful communication with the hosts. Only drawback was the noisy place in front of the building where people gathered every night and played loud music
nice Airbnb in the middle of the centre. Many bars & restaurants around the area, however the balcony is not a proper balcony, but rather a communal entrance. Otherwise very nice :)
Nice modern apartment on a great location in the city. Good and fast contact with Mariana. Thanks!
fantastic location, nice large apartment and easy to find. would stay here again and recommend to anyone travelling to Porto

The appartement is just like in the photo’s. Awesome! The location is super great! Everything in 15 minutes by feet. Al though I wouldn’t recommend is to people who want to go to bed between 22pm and 2am. Because it vested at a  square where young people get together at night. But me and my to friends loved it there. And I like the background noise to fall a sleep. Also if you like the go out you have a lot of possibilities in the neighborhood (5 min. max). I would go there again without a doubt!

I waited a 5 days to write this review as I like to give a chance to people to explain why things are the way it is. But I didn't receive any response so far!  Anyhow, I was disappointed with the place because the heat was not working and it was a cold night. After sleeping with my coat on, I was looking for a nice shower in the morning but the water was soooo hot with no way of regulate it!!!  My friend tried as well with no luck. I can't explain any better than this. I got sick actually from being cold that night. Otherwise, the location is perfect and the apartment pleasant. The bathroom can definitely use some TLC. I hope they fix those couple issues and communicate better with people in the future as it is a great place overall. :-((
The appartment is very beautiful, comfortable and well located. The only thing is that it is difficult to contact the host.
Big, clean and comfortable space. instructions for checking in were clear. Centric, with a nice brunch place right downstairs
Great location for walking and exploring Porto, very spacious, lots of bars and restaurants nearby. Great communication with Rose who was very obliging and always got back to me within a few minutes.

Thanks again Rose for allowing us an early checkin. The flat was same as the photos, location is just perfect. There is a lift, not sure if it was mentioned. The only thing missing was some glasses for the wine :-) We will be back for sure. Thanks again.
great communication and helpful when we found the heater didn't work, they solved the problem asap.
We had a beautiful experience in Abel's home. I would highly reccomend this place. Position was perfect for moving around the city, a little bit noisy in the night because of the nightlife.
Everything was great, Hosts were very responsive, and place was really nice. Close to everything in the city, very centric location
Nice place! Happy to stay here again some time. Right in the city centre so no problem getting anywhere.
We had a lovely stay at this flat. Location was perfect and the space was very clean. It can be a bit loud at night (I think on the weekends), but we weren't bothered. Highly recommend.

Carlos meet us at the apartment and all was as described in the listing comfortable modern apartment in an old building very close to all the attractions of Porto parking difficult in narrow streets but the same for all of this area, great affordable place to stay Thanks again Carlos
Carlos & Christina's place was perfect! Great location and newly renovated. They were very helpful with recommendations of restaurants/things to do. Would definitely stay again.

Carlos and his wife Cristina provided his with a warm welcome in their city Porto. They had tips for around Porto, for instance sight-seeing. The appartement is conveniently located near the water and the Pont Luis I bridge in a quiet street. Also, it is within walking distance from the Sao Bento train/metro station.  We enjoyed are stay here very much!
This is the first time that I used the airbnb, and it was a wonderful experience! They are really good host!!! My friend and me had a wonderful weekend in Porto!!!
Perfect apartment located near the river in beautiful Porto! Check in and check out were easy and our group enjoyed our stay. Walking distance to historic Porto and the river.

Amazing friendly reception - super efficient and helpful. The appartment is wonderful and so clean, very well equipped and very comfortable beds.  The location of the appartment is great - just a stone's throw from all the best parts of Ribiera. We had a good meal at the Vime restaurant opposite the appartment - the Pumpkin cheescake is amazing. Just next door to the restaurant is a bike hire shop - we had a brilliant time with our two sons cycling to the sea and up the coast to a small town where restaurants cooked fish on BBQ's in the street. Overall a wonderful stay.

A nice, modern apartment in a traditional building, situated in an excellent location (although it's still quiet). The river is quite literally over the road and everything else you'd want is walkable in no more than 5-10 minutes or so. I've been to Porto three times now and I think Carlos's place is the best I've stayed in.

Cristina was waiting for us on arrival at the apartment and gave us lots of information on the locality and the main sites of interest.  My daughter and her boyfriend had very early flights home on different days and Cristina arranged taxis for them with a punctual and reliable driver, so if you want to take a taxi to or from the airport I recommend asking Carlos & Cristina to arrange it.  Everything we needed was there in the apartment which is just as it looks in the photos.  The locality was perfect for us as we were attending a wedding at the Sao Francisco church, and it is also in the centre of everything with the tram to the beach at Foz and the 500 bus just at the end of the road, restaurants on the doorstep and 2 minutes walk to the heart of Ribeira.  A really comfortable and spacious apartment with great hosts - thank you Carlos & Cristina.
Perfect host and accommodation.  Great location. We were only there for one night but would have liked to stay longer.
The apartment was clean and was in a great location. This is a really good base to explore Porto from.
We had a very pleasant stay in this accommodation. It has a superb location close to the river and many of the city's features are within easy walking.

My parents and I stayed at this place for one night. It was perfect for us. The apartment is really close to the water and really easy to walk to from the main train station or wherever in Porto you arrive. The hosts were very responsive and kind. There is a nice kitchen if you would like to make food while you are there. If you need a grocery store, my mom and i walked about 2 km down the river. Otherwise, there is a tiny shop around the corner. Perfect for a short stay in Porto.
Great spot. Really clean and convenient. It was my first Airbnb experience and Carlos has set the bar really high!!
Fantastic apartment...very central...very clean...Cristina was a lovely host...would definately come back to stay here!!!!

Amazing apartment in the best location ever! In the Ribeira, but not in the noise. The apartment has 2 bedrooms, big dining room and kitchen. Well equipped. Cristina and Carlos were sooooo kind with us! 100% recommended!!

Location was very convenient, within walking distance of the river, Sao Bento train station, and numerous restaurants and bars. Cristina received us warmly and shared helpful tips on how to best enjoy the city.
We had a really nice time in Porto, Also because of the very nice appartement! Very central and Cristina was very helpfull. Would definetely recommend this place!!

The apartment is in a great location, close to attractions, transport, restaurants, the river. Easy to walk to many locations. Hosts Christina & Carlos met us on arrival and Christina gave us lots of helpful information. Would happily stay here next time we visit Porto
I was really impressed with this apartment. It’s roomy, clean, modern and so close to everything yet quite quiet as it’s on a side street, but just a minute from the esplanade.

Perfect for a central location to Porto City. Apartment is clean and exactly as it is in the pictures, a little smaller than expected but perfectly comfortable. Tea is included, but if arriving late its best to order a welcome pack. As we arrived late with hangry children and too late for takeaway delivery this was at 11:30...not good after a long day traveling.

Carlos and Cristina have the most fabulous apartment. We had such a great experience here. Check in was easy and Cristina showed us where to park and gave some great tips and advice. The location is absolutely amazing, we couldn't ask for better! we recommend trying the restaurants of Puro 4050 for some amazing food and music on the patio, and Portu's with great service and food. You can't go wrong with either and you will love this apartment!
Great apartment in a good location to tourist attractions. Apartment was clean and comfortable. Close to restaurants and shops. Was given a warm welcome and some useful information about the city.

We personally met Christina and she was amazing. She met us right at our check in time and welcomed us into the first floor apartment. She made us comfortable with the place and gave us dozens of local tips on what to see and do. The place is in a FANTASTIC location, right by the river and bridge. You are steps away from incredible restaurants, and a hop skip and a jump away from the amazing places to try port wine. We would go back to Porto and stay at Christina’s in a heartbeat. The bed was so comfortable and the rooms were nice and big. The bathroom and shower were a nice size too! The windows on the side of the apartment open up and let a great amount of sunlight in which is perfect in the morning when you are getting ready. We didn’t spend much time in the apartment because there is so much to do! But, it served its purpose and exceeded expectations. Stay here!
Fantastic, stylish and comfortable flat in a great central location. Has all mod cons. We would definitely return. Christina was really friendly and helpful. A real gem in Porto!

What an incredible spot Carlos and Cristina have and a lovely flat to boot. My family loved staying here and were greeted with such a warm welcome when they arrived. Thank you for making their stay in Porto so memorable

This apartment is in an ideal location in the center of the old part or Porto. Most places that you may want to visit are within walking distance. Be prepared for hills. The apartment is one block from the river Douro, very close to the famous bridge, Louis I. Every thing is up hill from here.  The apartment is one flight up from the street, access is easy. There are 2 bedrooms, the second one with 2 single beds. The kitchen is modern and reasonably well equipped. The WiFi works well as does the tv. It’s a comfortable apartment. If you are coming in winter as we did, you might find the 2 portable electric space heaters less than adequate.  Cristina came to meet us and was generous with her time, suggesting places to visit and explaining the bus and metro. We took a couple of walking tours thru AirBnb which were excellent. One with Carlotta and one with Antonio.

We had an amazing trip in Porto and were extremely satisfied with the appartment of Olga and her husband! The appartment is really spacious and clean, has all the comfort we needed and is the best equiped accomodation we have ever had in this price range! To be honest, the appartment is better than the photos that are provided on AirBnB. Next June we are returning to Porto, and depending on the amount of friends we are coming with, we will certainly return to this appartment! The location couldn't be better, the terrasse is wonderful to enjoy a great vinho verde (sorry Olga for the glass deposit we have left... :-)). Olga and her husband were extremely kind and always available for questions or information and were very flexible in terms of checkin and checkout. Thanks for the nice pastel de nata at our arrival! All the best.

The apartment is wonderful, even better than the pictures. It is so warmly decorated with so much care that we immediately felt at home. Paulo welcomed us very kindly and provided us with all the necessary information. He and Olga are great hosts, flexible and easy in communication. We really hope to come back some time!
Lovely hosts, welcoming and helpful. The listing is well located and has all comforts. Very confortable beds!  Recommended!
Cristina is a very good hostess. She gave tips for the environment. The apartment is git equipped and i would book again anytime. The Apartment is near very good Restaurants.

The appartment was very clean, nice decorated and well situated on the 1st floor with small balconys towards the pedestrian street Sao Francisco. Even there are some restaurants in the street, it was very quiet at night. We enjoined going to the closely situated Cais da Ribeiro or to the other river side for dining or Port tasting.

Porto was in general a very pleasant and colorful city. The appartment is located in the heart of the old city in proximity of everything.  2 min walk to the river bank with astonishing views. It was clean and had everything necessary for a short 2 day stay. Cristina was nice and helpful. Enjoyable stay!

Olga and Paulo are very welcoming and helpful persons, have gave us a lot of useful recommendations about spending the time at Porto. Their  stylish decorated, very neat and good equipped appartement  is located in the very heart of Porto only 20 min away from the main square on foot and 30 min from the other side of the river. There may be some problem for eldery people with the spiral stairs in the appartement, as it is realy steep. But it worked for us. We can highly recommended the romantic apartement.

We adored our stay in this beautiful and charming apartment, which is very well located in Porto. Olga and Paulo were very kind and available for all of our inquiries. We would most definitely recommend this apartment for anyone traveling to Porto.  Thanks again!

Beautiful 2 floor apartment.  The upper floor has a terrace and the bottom one is with a French balcony. All attractions within a few min. walk. Paulo welcomed us with a bottle of wine and left his and Olga's numbers in case we needed any help. We got a message from them with a list of places where to eat at a reasonable cost and with a top quality of food. They booked a taxi for us at 3:30 in the morning when we were leaving for airport, which was very helpful if you do not speak Portuguese. It was very clean, sunny, quiet but still in the centre. We strongly recommend this apartment. Suitable for 2 couples.

Olga and Paulo have been very responsive. They were there when we arrived and always answered to our messages when we needed tips or help to do something. The flat is very nice and super well located. Few minutes walking from the main shopping street and walking distance from the vibrant area full of nice bars and restaurant. We had great time in the city and in the flat, and we'll totally recommend it. On a sunny day, the balcony and the terrace upstairs are gold.

We had an amazing stay in Porto thanks to Olga and Paulo. We arrived pretty early, but Olga and Paulo were already waiting for us so that we could store our luggage while they were cleaning the apartment from the other guests. The apartment is really charming. There are two floors and the highlight was definitely the little balcony. The location is very good because nearby there are a big shopping street, a lot of restaurants and cafes. We could walk everywhere (the only time we were using the metro, which is around the corner was from the airport and back). Olga and Paulo are very nice and friendly people. The welcome was very warm and they helped us out with a lot of useful tips what to see and where to go. It was our first time in Porto and thanks to Olga and Paulo it was an unforgettable trip. Hopefully we will come back at some point and when we do we will definitely stay at Olga and Paulo's again! Recommenable!!
The appartement was beautifull and exactly like in the description. We had a nice welkom and got lots of information about the city. We loved our stay!
Christina was very nice and pointed out all the best places to viset . Apartment was very nice and clean and the location was spot on .
Cute nice apartment close to the city center. You’ll find pretty much everything you need. It was a lovely stay. Thank you

This apartment is ideal in every way! Perfect location and comfortable space with everything you need. I stayed a month and didn’t want to leave! Cristina responds quickly with questions and is a warm hostess that works hard to keep her guests happy. 5 stars!!!
Very nice apartment, not far from the water. You can do anything by walk or by bike. We very much enjoyed our stay!

We had an amazing stay thanks to Paulo and Olga, lovely couple friendly and warm! Everything about the apartment is perfect, good location (walkable distance from everything), clean and well equipped. They made our stay at Porto just like home helping us with everything needed. Absolutely recommended!

Olga and Paulo were welcoming and helpful giving us little present, sending e-mails with hints and tips for public transport, lists of restaurants, bars and advising what to see. They are really friendly and nice people.  Tha apartement is amazing with great location. It was clean, tidy, equipped with everything we needed for our stay. The flat is for short walk from metro station, surrounded by little restaurants and tourist attractions are in the neighbourhood.

Olga was a wonderful host and the apartment is beautiful. It is conveniently located right in the heart of the city within walking distance of restaurants, shops, super markets etc. And there is paid parking available close by. All in all a wonderful place to stay.
Very good place to stay.  And very smart and welcoming personnes.  we loved the terrasse i recommand.
Olga's place is really beautiful and in very good location!!! Along with her husband they are amazing hosts and have been very helpful. I would definitely recommended this place!!
We loved staying in Olga's apartment. It was beautiful and in a great location. We would definitely return!

Beautiful home, welcoming hosts, location great. Perfect for our family of four. The upstairs bedroom is lovely, but I would say not suitable for very young children or anyone not happy with steep spiral stairs. We loved it though!

Lovely helpful hosts. Quick to respond. The apartment is clean and well prepared, nice bed linen upstairs. It is a 3rd floor walk up and the internal staircase was a problem to us as it is a very steep, narrow and open spiral staircase. The kitchen is well stocked with china, glass etc and a good size dining table. There is no separate sitting area. This part of Rua Formosa is a little unloved but a few minutes from main shopping street and nice restaurants. Main sites of interest no more than 20 minutes so easy to get around.
A very comfortable flat in the center of porto. The hosts are very friendly and always helped with great tips. High recommendation.

It's just as good as in the pictures. Close to center, clean and cozy apartment. Communications went very smooth and quick although we've actually did not see each other in person. Highly recommended.
The place was very clean and just like I expected from the pictures. What I valued most was friendliness and quick answers to any questions.
Wonderful house in Porto city centre. Host is excellent and other thing in that house is excellent too.

The apartment of Olga & Paulo is perfectly located near the metro and the shopping area! It is perfect for a couple with kids or group of friend. I can only recommend this place with its well-oriented terrace. Thanks again! :)
very charmed and central apartment. the host is symphathic and helped me / us with sightseeing points of the city. everything was totally fine ;)
The flat is well located and have all that is needed for a great vacation, the host is convenient and reactive! I recommend without any problem!
Great area to be in for Porto and Gaia. Comfortable flat that was clean and adequately stocked. Good value for money
Great location! Not super quiet but so close to the river and the places you want to explore. The location really is quite the best.

Good place to stay close to main attraction and lots of cafes / restaurants.  It is an old apartment on the street  level, so one has to be aware of the same.  The 3 small balconies are of little use as there are hardly  any views apart from a couple of cafes.  Overall a fine place to explore Porto

Perfect location. 2 blocks to Duoro River where you can take cruises or eat at the many restaurants. We ate at Pimm's Cafe/diner which is across street from the apartment though, and  it has really good pizza and burgers. Yum. Also walkable to Cathedral, the bridge you cross to the Port Cellars and restaurants. Etc. Plus the apartment itself is very clean, stylish, with a very nice kitchen.

It was the 2nd time we rented from Christina (another apparment) and she was again super friendly and suggested nice places to go. The location is perfect to visit the city and the apartment is spacious. highly recommended!

We, three young girls who just graduated, have loved our stay in this beautiful apartment right in/close to the centre of Porto! The balcony, where the sun shines throughout the whole day, is lovely. It was also nice to have two bathrooms in this apartment. There is everything you need in this lovely apartment and in the centre of Porto. The supermarket and the biggest clothing stores are for example just two streets away. We did mostly everything by foot, but you can also easily take the bus or metro to go some other place, like the beach. Olga, the owner of the apartment, was very kindly and she answered our questions immediately if we had them. She told us for example how to go from the airport to this apartment, which restaurants she recommended and where to put our garbage. We would definitely recommend this apartment to everyone else who wants to visit Porto!

Great appartement with a nice price. As they were not available we had a check-in through a keybox which worked great. Some minor issues were resolved quickly though chat and we received some great restaurant recommendations.  The windows cannot be completely shut from light, which could be an issue to some people. Normally to me as well, but the days were exhausting enough :) The shower and beds were good. Also liked that there is a bread toaster.  Definitely recommended!

We had a great stay at Cristina's: she was a fabulous host and offered us lots of advice for where to go in the area. The apartment was very convenient and comfortable. Would recommend for a trip to Porto!
Great host  Apartment is in a very old building which I’m sure is very difficult to secure. Good area for walking and exploring Porto.

There is a bad smell from the bathroom and it really hits you when entering the apartment the first time maybe a few air fresheners around the apartment also maybe a mirror in each of the bedrooms but overall location is great

Our group of 4 had a great stay here in Porto. The location is very central and close to all the happenings in town. The layout is perfect for two couples. There are two balconies and this place was even cuter than the pictures. Host was extremely accommodating and kind. One thing of note, the spiral staircase to get up to the second bedroom is teeny tiny, which makes it difficult to get up and down into the second bedroom especially with luggage. For us, this wasn’t a huge issue since we were out of the house most of the day. Would definitely stay here again!!

We really liked the apartment, spacious and with unique decoration. Staircase to the second floor rather tight, but marvelous terrasse. Very convenient location in the center, a few minutes walk from all main spots; we did not even need public transport.

The apartment is beautiful,  very stylish. Olga Maria was very helpful and her instructions were clear. It is very central for everything.  We loved exploring the immediate area then branching out. The beautiful river is a great place within reasonable walking distance. We would love to go again next year

Lovely, well eqipped, clean and comfortable apartment v close to Porto centre. Balcony area great for enjoying sunshine.  Olga a very welcoming and friendly host Would definitely recommend staying here

We had a fantastic stay in Porto in this Air BnB. It was clean and near all major sights in Porto. The appartment had everything we needed. The second bedroom and terrace were only accesible by a narrow spiral staircase. Which was fine for us, but maybe good to know beforehand if you're not easy with stairs. Thank you for Hastings us.
The location was absolutely ideal and we found it to be in a very walkable area. Looked exactly like the pictures and was very clean.

This apartment is in a prime location of Porto. Everything is within walking distance. The hosts are very kind and responsive. We are a family with a young toddler and we were so happy that Cristina was able to supply a crib. The towels and linens were very clean and comfortable. My only comment was there was some wear on the furniture, however it did not effect our stay since we were out and about.
Really nice place. The bedrooms are large and spacious, and there is a terrace along with a small balcony. We enjoyed having two bathrooms across four people!
Higly recommanded! Big hospitality, great house with each a privat bathroom, very clean. Very handy outdoor kitchen and bathroom.  Very correct person, don't hesitate to book.

This rent was my best experience on Airbnb so far. The apartment is perfect : 2 floors. The living room can be a bedroom there is a TV and the kitchen is fully furnished, you can cook everything ! The bedroom upstairs is massive with a lot of storage and another TV. The bathroom is also upstairs but there is a WC downstairs. All the equipments are very new. As we were staying for 9 nights Céleste came twice to do the cleaning and give us fresh towels. The apartment was perfecty clean. Céleste showed us the neighbourhood that is very nice and quiet. The main street is 5 minutes away by foot otherwise the metro stop is just down the street so not even 2 min. I HIGHLY recommend !

Great experience! The host was very helpful and the house was amazing. The neighbourhood is really nice, and close to the center. I'll be saving this one for future visits to Porto. Would recommend to friends and family!

We had a lovely time in Porto, and Afonso was really helpful and kind with us, really good recommendations ! The house is in a nice neighborhood with all facilities and great location ! We cant wait to come back and enjoy this experience again.
Great location with easy walk to the beachside restaurants, also well-connected with the city of Porto. We enjoyed the space. Lovely garden and pool
This is a very peaceful spot. Beautiful garden, short walk to the beach and a great pool. Perfect for a weekend with our toddler. Thanks so much.

If I could give more stars I would, it was the gem of our time spent in Portugal, only regret was that we didn’t book for the whole time instead of hopping around. The home owner Grace was very kind and helpful, the street parking was a worry as we had many stressful issues with parking at other stays, but home is situated on a dead end street that is wide enough to accommodate 2 wat traffic, we felt extremely safe both inside the property as well as leaving the car on the street. Was very walkable to the ocean front where we spent every day at, would come back to cook meals then head back out on foot to see more sites. Such a memorable stat, can’t recommend enough, thank you!
The house was perfect for us, a family with 2 kids and a baby. Nicely renovated and in the best spot near Porto! Thanks Joao!

João and Susanna are very nice people, easy to be with and arrange things. Everything was working in the house. The beds are good quality for a relaxing night of deep sleep. Toilettes and the shower are spacious and top notch condition. It's a great neighbourhood. If you don't want to cook in the well equipped kitchen of the house, there are plenty of nice restaurants with fresh fish around. A lot of parking places for free makes it easy if you arrive by car. The walk to the city centre is beautiful and not too long. And if you want to go towards north-east coast there is a boat every 30 minutes right around the corner.
We had a lovely stay at Porto White. The location is good and the hosts are great!

We stayed at the PortoWhite apartment for New Years and it was the best location. Very close to everything in the city, in a nice pedestrian street.  The apartment was clean, spacious and very well furnished. Thoughtful touches all around the apartment.   If I may, it was just a little cold at night but that’s just me being picky.  We totally recommend !
The place was central and not noisy even if the flat is on the main street.  Joao was very kind with us and he share many infos very helpful for us.  Ask him about his famous restaurant !

Great location!  Apartment was exactly like photos & check in with Dulce was an added bonus as she made us feel right at home with tips & recommendations while in Porto.  I would definitely stay here again!

Fantastic apartment in a great location. Everything we wanted was in walking distance, and the apartment was very quiet overnight. It’s well equipped and very comfortable. It more than met all our expectations, as did Porto overall. Will stay again if/when we come back.   Thanks for a great city break!

A fantastic apartment in terms of comfort & location (less than 1 min from nearest metro station).  The apartment was as described and had everything we needed for our stay. Pedro was friendly, gave clear instructions for check in /out and responded promptly to all messages. Would highly recommend.

PortoWhite was super easy to find! It’s in a great location near Mercardo do Bolhao and Capela das Almas on the doorstep. Also, Gruta seafood restaurant on the opposite street.  Communication was proactive even while Portugal had a power outage!  The apartment looks just like the photos and was super clean. Definitely recommend it to anyone visiting beautiful Porto!

Joana was a very friendly and knowledgable host. She allowed early check-in which was kind. Nice flat with spacious living room and a cosy kitchen. Nice terrace. 8-10 min walk from metro and even quicker from bus. Would recommend!

Definitely the best place I've ever been to!  Amazing flat, exactly as advertised. Beautiful furniture, great outdoors space, small pool but enough for 4 people to cool down from hot weather.  Joana is an amazing host, even all the instructions were on the flat, she was really proactive and gave us great recommendations. One evening we  accidentally got locked outside (we were clumsy 😅) and literally 5 min after text her, another person came and let us get in.  Great value for money, we will definitely be back and recommend Joana's place to our friends and relatives. Thank you very much Joana!!!
The house was just perfect, beautiful and in a perfect position. I really had great time in it.  Marco was really nice and available for everything we needed.  Just go there!  Andrea

We've been greeted by Carla, who provided us all necessary information about Porto and even offered what to visit in western Portugal during our trip here.  The appartment itself is even better than it looks in pictures - very clean, cozy and has everything for short or longer stay. We've actually felt like at home and wanted to return back home every evening after exploring this fantastic city - Porto. Location is just perfect - all tourist POIs are in a walk distance - ~10 min to most important historical points and ~3 min to the location of bars. Highly recommended to choose this listing - one of the best experiences we had while backpack travelling.

Great location, great apartment, great hosts! The room is bright and airy and well appointed. Bed was comfortable, kitchen had everything we needed and the shower was large based on my experiences in Europe. The location is ideal as you are very close to great restaurants and bars, but the street itself is quiet.

We stayed at Marco's place in Porto and it was really nice. The appartment is exactly like the pictures and really well situated. Marco and Carla were really helpful and gave us all the good tips on the city. If you're coming to Porto don't hesitate to stay at this appartment it's worth it!
This appartment has a perfect location. Close to a main metro Station (Trinidade) but everything can be done by walking. Everything was clean and confortable. I recommand this appartment.
We really loved the apartment. It's beautifully decorated and the location is perfect. Marco replies really fast if you have a question. We felt very comfortable and safe.

Booking process nice and simple. Apartment is in a lovely block, full of the character of Porto. The apartment is a bright, stylish and clean and perfect location for exploring. They recommended a great restaurant too. If you're a very light sleeper I'd suggest earplugs but it's not excessive and no different from any other city centre apartment on a Saturday night. I would thoroughly recommend staying here!

We had a great time with our stay here. Everything was exactly like the pictures en was all nice and clean. Marco and Carla were easy to contact en they informed us about nice places to eat nearby the apartment. I would recomment friends and family to stay at this apartement during there stay in Porto.
This house is big and clean. It's quite cozy, and the host are thoughtful. It's easy to catch the metro and the host provide me much useful info.
We've had a great time in Porto and enjoyed the City. The apartment was nice and good located. Thank's Marco and Carla for everything.
The apartment was very comfortable and clean!  Great location and very warm welcome.  Totally recomended!

We loved our stay in your apartment. The description of the apartment is perfectly accurate. It was clean and well equipped for our stay. The neighbourhood and apartment felt safe with a super central location. Restaurants in the neighbourhood were great... we particularly loved Cristo Rei for breakfast and Lagostim and Tasco for dinner. All these restaurants are very close to this apartment which is a bonus! Thank you kindly Carla(and your lovely mom) and Marco.
We had a great time at the Almada 329 apartment in Porto. The apartment is well located. It is very well equipped and absolutely clean. Mario was very friendly and organised us a cab to the airport.

An amazing apartment in the heart of the city. Very adorable, neatly decorated. The only slight minus is that because it's in the center of it all, the street can get a bit loud at night, but that's the price of staying in the heart of it. We put a fan on for white noise to drown out the street sounds. Marco and Carla great hosts, great with communication and with anything we needed.

Super apartment: beautiful, clean, spacious, good shower, very central located, nice place for breakfast and coffee next door. Also Carla and Marco were very kind and responded quickly via email and whatsapp.
Had a lovely stay. The room was central, comfortable and perfect for a five-day stay to explore Porto.
Beautiful flat in a great location. My visit was really enjoyable and Marco and his wife were very accommodating and helpful.

Lovely and simple apartment in Porto. In close vicinity to all the major touristic sites (max 15min walking). The apartment was very clean. Only downside was the loud noise coming from partying people on Saturday night.
The apartment is exactly as presented in the pictures. We loved the big windows. I would recommend staying there for a few days in Porto: perfect location to explore the city!

Marco's place was great. Perfect location for everything one might want to do in Porto. His recommendations were spot on! And the check in and check out process was very easy. We arrived a little early and had a very early flight to catch. Our uber was super cheap to the airport. The apt was very clean. And the towels were awesome. Everything worked and our travels were easy because of how well the apt was located. It's on the 2nd floor. And faces the street. Lovely balcony to people watch from
Could not fault this apartment. Our stay was wonderful. Super spacious and clean. Thank you for a great stay- highly recommend!
Great location and apartment.  Just what we were looking for.   Marco and Carla were wonderful hosts.  Would definitely recommend this place for the value.

Marco and Carla's apartment was beautiful, spacious, centrally located and has everything needed for a great stay. Lots of room for luggage and a nice table and chairs to spread out and view maps. Carla gave the best suggestions for things to do in Porto. We were greeted with a smile and warm personality. There is a lovely modern Italian restaurant just across the street, plus great places to eat and drink on both the street and nearby. We are airbnb hosts ourselves in Nashville TN and appreciated all the nice touches provided. If we are lucky enough to return to this amazing city of Porto we will stay here, for sure!
Great central location and nice private apartment. Very clean! Marco and Carla were very helpful. Highly recommend!
This place is great. It's roomy and nicely decorated. The neighborhood is very hip and has an abundance of nice bars and restaurants. Marco and his wife Carla were very accommodating.
Great location. Central, close to metro and supermarkets. Modern and stylish, well kept appartment. Would definitely recommend

This is a truly great place and we loved it very much.  Just as advertised.  This was our first visit to Porto and this flat was in the perfect location for everything.  It was in a little cold inside even with the space heater on, but I imagine this is only a problem in the colder winter months,
Absolutely loved Marco’s place! The location is great and Maria is so sweet! We did not want to leave!

Really pretty studio apartment; nicely decorated and it's an ideal location. Relatively quiet block but super close to lots of landmarks and public transportation. Would 100% stay here again if I find myself back in Porto.
Marco’s place was in what felt like a quieter place in Porto,  but everything is walkable! Easy to get around to stores, the churches, and train stations. Was a good stay!
This place is a great find! Perfect location and the space is lovely. But, it’s VERY loud outside, making it difficult to sleep.

The apartment is very central, close to sights, restaurants and cafés. It is very beautifully furnished and we enjoyed our stay there. The WiFi works well and the communication with the host was quite easy.

We had a great stay at Marco and Carla’s place. The apartment is easy to navigate to from the train station and located within walking distance to all of the major sites. Carla welcomed us when we arrived and provided us with a map and guide. Highly recommend this place for a couple or solo traveler!
Fantastic location! Surrounded by hardware stores and restaurants it is perfect!  Checkin/out was also a breeze! It's a bit noisy due to construction but that's progress!

We had a great time in Porto staying at Marco’s apartment. The communication in advance and during our stay was easy and fast, the apartment is located directly in center town and the provided amenities were good. We can highly recommend the place and Marco as local hosts! :)

Nice place in Porto, lots of restaurants and sites to visit around the apartment. The train station is close by. Spacious, clean and sunny. A little noisy on the street but it's a lively neighborhood. I recommend it.

Stunning apartment with a location that doesn’t get better than this! Very clean, central to the city center and hotspots! Carla was extremely responsive and accommodating to our check in requests which started off the vacation on a good note already! Highly recommend!
We had the best time in this apartment. It's cozy, comfortable, stylish and well located. The hosts are really kind and available. Highly recommended!!

The Airbnb was perfect for our stay in Porto and we enjoyed staying there. It was clean and very well furnished. The apartment is located in the center of Porto (therefore it was a little bit noisy) and you can reach basically everything within walking distance. Supermarkets, bars, cafés and restaurants are  also nearby the accommodation. Carla welcomed us warmly and the communication with her was excellent. We can recommend this Airbnb and would always come back. Thank you very much for letting us stay at your apartment!
This place is so gorgeous! Perfect location near bars, restaurants and Porto sights, really accomodating hosts. Thank you!
I recommend this airbnb to everyone who wants to see the beautiful city Porto. Its a really nice apartment for two persons. Its clean and has everything you need for a citytrip!

The location of this flat is perfect, very central and easy to get to from the train station (which was a very easy train ride to/from the airport).  The flat is clean and adorable, and the bed comfortable. Do be aware that the street noise can be a bit loud late on the weekend but was less noisy during the week. All in all we would absolutely stay here again in the future. Marco was very communicative and friendly which is always nice!

We enjoyed our stay here. Apartment is nice and clean with a nice bathroom. It is located in the city center close to the main sights, but also in a street with a lot of bars (can be quite loud at night). Check in was as easy as the communication. We can definitely recommend staying here.
We had a great time in Porto. The apartment is great and is located nicely. Marco and his wife are great hosts. We would come back in the future.

Ideal location and accommodating hosts. Great nearby restaurants and shops. The studio was fully equipped and tastefully decorated. And as previous guests have mentioned the bed was extremely comfortable. We hope to return here soon.

It's a lovely apartment just as the pictures in a great location near lots of bars and restaurants. My stay was smooth and the hosts were very helpful and replied quickly.  I would highly recommend this place. Oporto is worth visiting.

Marcos place was in the perfect location for us. It was close enough to walk everywhere & the apartment was much bigger than we expected. The balcony windows were our favourite part. Tons of bars & restaurants nearby, & the busier waterfront area is only a 15 minute walk. Beautiful stay would 100% recommend!
The location is amazing! The place is cozy and has everything you need to have a great stay. Communication with the host was friendly and helpful. We would definitely come back.

When I come back to Porto, I won’t consider any other options for accommodations. This was the most perfect location and space for me and my husband. There were lots of eating options, it’s easy to get to and there are a few great bars nearby. I was so grateful they had the option to allow us to check in a bit early as well. I can’t say enough positive things about this space. I also loved the Alice in Brewland and Bao Beers right downstairs
Saturday night was a bit noisy with the people coming back from going out. Other than that, perfect stay.

Nice vibey spacious apartment with a great central location. We truly enjoyed our stay at Marco’s! The only thing is that it might be loud outside on the weekends, but the location is truly worth it:)

This is a very lovely place. Very close to everything. Simple and modern interior! Huge recommendation to everyone who wants to stay in Porto. Rafael was also very accommodating with my check in and check out

We have enjoyed our stay in the nice and clean appartement of Rafaël. Thanks to his friendly advise we found al we needed in the area. The appartement is suited close to the river Douro, walking distance to the centre of town. We loved everything about is, Jan & Eva

Rafael's place is perfect for a couple, the location is walking distance to the centre and the ribeira.  Even though the flat overlooks a noisy road the double glazing ensures that there is no noise. Couldn't have asked for a better place. Thoroughly recommend it.

This apartment was in a great location just outside of the busiest areas and yet within walking distance of everything we wanted.  The instructions were great upon arrival including a nice suggestion of Francesinha, a traditional Porto sandwich that is covered with a crazy amount of meats, cheese and sauce.  The A/C worked when needed and when windows were closed, it was very quiet inside.  Wi/Fi reliable.  Street traffic was pretty quiet at night, anyway. Expect a very minimalist decor which is clean and very simple.    Loved the city, loved walking and everything at this Airbnb location went so smoothly -- just as one would want.

The place was beautiful and clean. It was very convenient to move around the city. Rafael wasn’t there when we went but Pau was so helpful and nice with us. Porto its an amazing city and this is the perfect place to stay.  Highly recommended.

Basic clean apartment in a great location -- lots of good eats on the same block and a short walk away!. Rafael was great with communication and check in was super smooth. We stayed for a short time 1 night before our flight out. Not noisy at all. I liked the black out shutters as well!
Very well located, clean and charming. Very quiet, well isolated, even with this noisy street.

Great place to stay and a really well designed space. We stayed with our 5 year old. The bed is comfy and the sofa bed was great for him too. It’s a short walk into central Porto. The communication was easy, clear and fast. I’d recommend it to all :-)
Comfortable flat conveniently located to city centre. Very clean. Lots of restaurants, shops, etc. in the area.

A great studio near the city center. The place is clean  and tidy. sometimes you can hear people on the building as the walls are not very sound proofing, but not enough to wake you. The hosts were great and very quick to set up the place as we booked with short notice. It was overall a great stay for a city break.

This was a gem of an apartment. Large windows with sunlight streaming through them, beautiful stone lintels, and gorgeous original old wooden interior shutters (good if you want to sleep in!). The space is thoughtfully furnished, with everything you might need in a spacious studio apartment. I should also add that the bed, with cotton sheets, was extremely comfortable. All communications and the checkin were easy and pleasant, as the hosts are so friendly and accommodating. I would recommend the apartment to anyone seeking a spacious pied-à-terre in Porto.

I took 1 week, and another week and then I extended to 1 month. Just an awesome place (Matosinhos) to stay in and around Porto, morely if you like outdoor life and surfing. Beach in on 5min biking. The tramline is on 5min walking. A bike to the city center of Porto, 30 min, along the sea and the river. And above all, you're staying in an very nice place, renovated farm and lots of space in the garden and around. Loving dogs is a pro :-) But they're so cute!
Had a wonderful stay at Vania's flat. It was very spacious and clean and in a good location. Recommended!

Angelo and Antonia are very friendly, kind and helpful. We could have count on them at any time. They were constantly in touch with us. The house is comfortable and full equiped. The distance to the sea was aproximently 15 min walk. Also, there is a garden included with a lot of fruit trees. The area is quiet and the neighbourhood is also peaceful. We can absolutly recommend this house for anyone, who wish to spend nice time in a beautiful surrounding.

Really nice house with all stuff you need to stay with your whole family. You got a private parking lot in front of the building on the property. The Beach is 700 m from the house and reachable by feet. Angelo & Antónia welcomed us heartily and showed us every detail of the house, it was a pleasure.

We had an absolutely delightful time at the house! With our three young children in tow, the house with the huge closed garden proved to be a perfect choice. Antonia and Angelo, our gracious hosts, welcomed us warmly and were incredibly friendly and helpful throughout our stay. The house itself was well-equipped, immaculately clean, and situated in an ideal location. Not only were we close to the beach, but also conveniently near Porto. It’s rare to find such a combination of comfort, cleanliness, and convenience all in one place. We wholeheartedly recommend this holiday house and we extend our heartfelt thanks to Antonia and Angelo!

We were made very welcome and given helpful suggestions and advice when we arrived. The apartment is spacious and full of character with a great and convenient location behind the cathedral - and the panoramic view is fabulous. The kitchen is well equipped. Unfortunately, the weather (at the beginning of Feb) was too cold to enjoy sitting in the garden. If we visited Porto again we would come a bit later in the year!

The location is very good, a small walk to the centre, bridge and Metro station. The house is located in a quiet street, in site the house is very big. Also for a family. The garden is nice. The few is magnificent. We enjoyed Porto and the house made it perfect.

Amazing amazing amazing place! I am quite loathed to give a good review because selfishly we all wanted to keep this place a secret it was simply stunning, The garden was magical just under the fabulous Luis 1 bridge it was like a film set! The whole place is spacious with views from every window so lovely to live there for a few days! All the amenities are there big kitchen and everything was clean and fresh WE ALL LOVED IT! We will return hopefully again and again and again! Thank you Claudia & Alexander PERFECT!
We recieved a very warm welcome, our host showed us around and we where happy to be able to leave our things in the flat while cleaning.
This was a great stay and within walking distance to all the sights the city has to offer. Very spacious.

Great stay at Manor House Porto, recommended and unique experience, right on the famous bridge on the Douro!  The apartment has such a great feel, which already starts at the surroundings of the cathedral, it almost feel if you stay inside it. The entrance is gorgeous, high ceilings, the rooms are tidy and everything was spotless!  Great welcome by Alexandre, we arrived late at the evening without any issues!  Only point is that the bathroom is a bit small, shower could use a glass door and do add a new TV! But that's maybe just me!   What a place, the terrace is amazing! Highly Recommended!

It was the nicest experience on this year's holidays. Alex is the best host. His house is the most beautiful place, situated in historical part of Porto. The view from our private garden was breathtaking. He even arranged for us to be picked up from the airport. Claudia drove us to the house and was very helpful with all the information we needed for our short stay. I would love to stay there again.

Just amazing. Perfect place, or better said: palace. Great view, perfect situated. Easy communication in advance with many helpful advices. We recommend the place very much and would love to come back. Thank you for hosting us.
Warm welcome to great house with amazing views over the river, excellent location. We would definitely recommend it for a stay in Porto.  Could park right outside.

The view alone makes this location well worth a stay. Alexandre was a fantastic host and provides us with very useful tips and suggestions for things to do and where to eat while in Porto. Overall a charming, beautiful, spacious place to stay while in Porto. I can't recommend this enough!

A beautiful 16 century abode with amazing views of the duro and bridge. Your own private garden with a 15 min walk to the main center. Beds very comfortable and great shower. We loved this special place

If you want an authentic Porto experience, this is the house for you.  This home has character and history.  It's a beautiful house with a lovely garden and a spectacular view.  The beds are very comfortable, kitchen is spacious, living area is the perfect size.  It's also very clean.  We stayed in February and the house was nice and comfortable because there's a heater in the bedrooms, living area and bathroom.  It's in a great location because it's walking distance to the many attractions in Porto.  We'll definitely stay here again if we are in town.
It was easy too acces. The car can be parked closely. Visting Oporto from here is great. Everything was easy too find and on walking distance.
This is a beautiful apartment with stunning views and a gorgeous peaceful garden patio. We didn't want to leave! Thank you so much Alex for everything!

We had a wonderful stay at the Manor House. It is an absolutely beautiful apartment, very centrally located, and watching the sunset over the river from the terrace truly made our trip! Thanks for an amazing stay.

An amazing host with an authentic, historic and warm apartment that gave us the perfect place to explore this terrific city...an absolute highlight of our twenty day adventure to Portugal! The location is unbeatable, the garden as lovely as it appears in the pictures (and yes, that is the view!) and so much room. Our only regret was not planning our trip so we spent more time here. Next time...thank you, Alex!
This apartment is in a brilliant location with a fantastic view from its garden. We were a family of five who thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Porto. Alexandre was an excellent host.

Stay there with my 3 kids from 2 y old to 17 was great safety  even for baby. Raining for 3 days we don’t mind to stay inside because it’s very large place . Weill take it again if come back to Porto !

Fantastic place that’s perfectly located to explore this city, or simply just sit in the garden and gaze at its beauty. The apartment is old, yes, but has lots of charm and all the functionality one needs - for the few hours one isn’t strolling around Porto and it’s surroundings.

The place is great! Just like in photos, bigger than expected and the terrace... oh the terrace! One of the best views in town but less windy than others. I usually prefer to dine out but in this trip I had all the breakfasts and dinners there. Great check-in and check-out experience. We arrived way later than expected and Alex was v fexible! Google maps does take you to the right place, fear not. Would def go back
Amazing location with some of the best views of Porto. I would definitely recommend staying here. The hosts are lovely, and the place is amazing

There were four of us (two couples) that stayed at Manor House Porto.  The location is great and on a quiet street. We walked mostly everywhere, and were so close to São Bento train station.  The space is big! And was sufficiently clean. Plus the view of Porto from the garden is amazing! We enjoyed having coffee in the morning and wine in the evenings on it.  Lastly, the pillows and bed were one of the more comfortable ones I’ve slept in while traveling through Europe. Can’t beat that!!  Stay here, you won’t be sorry!

This place is gorgeous! I highly recommend. The location is perfect. It is right in the middle of everything and is very easy to walk anywhere in the city center that you will want. The view is breathtaking. The space itself is even nicer in person.  The space is a bit hard to find, but the host offers detailed pictures and directions that helped a lot.  We rented a car, and were worried about how we would park, but since it is a bit removed from the main street you can park up on the street near the cathedral. It is actually in a space that seems like it wouldn't be allowed, but was totally fine.  The host was very responsive and flexible. We were given a map and some great recommendations.  Thanks for a wonderful stay!

Old world charm and amazing location and views made our stay in Porto unique, relaxing, convenient and comfortable. We could have stayed for a month and still found ways to enjoy! Felt like a local and soaked up the Porto vibes. Our host graciously allowed for early arrival and baggage storage for our late departure; provided excellent and detailed instructions which made for a smooth checkin and check out. Highly recommend for those wanting a classic Porto experience!

This stay was a top for us! The patio was an amazing place to relax and unwind in the morning and evenings. The place was quite spacious, beds were very comfortable, and overall just a wonderful location!!

Great location and views.  Old historic house with charm as described.  Owner was helpful for checkin snd suggestions.  Biggest issue was lots if ants in kitchen.  We kept it spotless and still had them and could only use the kitchen to make coffee

Brilliant location with amazing views.  This is the real Porto experience.  Very attentive host and comfortable place.  A true old original building in the old streets and behind a church. Truly magical!
A great location to explore Porto! You can't beat the view and patio area. Check-in was very smooth, and our host had great recommendations. Thank you!

Majestic and beautiful! We had an amazing stay at the Manor house. Our host was so accommodating  and gracious. We couldn'thave asked for a better arrival and adventure in Porto. The 3 bedroom apartment was extremely spacious with the best view of the entire riverfront. The terrace was the best terrace in Porto, perched high above the city, we never needed to leave. We can't wait to go back!

Loved our stay here! Perfect location and view! Easy walking distance to everything. We felt very fortunate to have this Airbnb. Traveled with husband and 3 kids ages 25, 12 and 15. Everyone was happy.

First of all, many thanks to Alex who was met us on arrival and was available by phone or text at all times.  We were able to drop off luggage early and get a quick tour of the property.  Alex was especially helpful in terms of securing parking for our vehicle on a very busy national holiday.  The apartment is huge and I was pleasantly surprised with comfort of sheets and bed. It is not a luxurious apartment, but was clean, private, comfortable, safe. We enjoyed the shared terrace overlooking the river, and the location was fantastic.

The shared garden and view are what really make this rental special. Watching the sunset and the bridge lit up at night was really enjoyable for my family. The space was clean and comfortable. We had a small hiccup with checkin, but Alex was very responsive and got us in as soon as possible. Be aware that the location of the house behind the cathedral is in a very busy area. Convenient to walk a lot of places, but very crowded with tourists. If you follow the directions and photos, you will easily locate the house. The only thing that wasn't great was the cobblestone walk from where an Uber can drop you off to the house with all the luggage. The wheels don't tend to work on the cobblestones well and you have to carry all of your bags. Other than that, we really enjoyed this space and Porto.

Amazing place to stay.  Location was perfect as it is a 5-15min walk to nearly everything; including crossing over the bridge to Gaia The views from the balcony were always stunning and we found ourselves out there quite a bit. Alex was very helpful and responsive provided us a local map where he pinpointed good food places and places to see. Would 100% stay again and recommend

Amazing place right in the center of Porto with the most spectacular views and old city charm. Almost makes you not want to leave and explore the city. Beautiful patio with trees growing and a great look at the river, bridge, and port houses across the way.

Beautiful location - the views from the yard are exactly as pictured with every bedroom having a stunning view of the bridge and river. The area is close to many main attractions and makes it easy to navigate Porto. Note that the walls are a bit thin so at times, you can hear people in other apartments - this didn't bother us, but can be good to know!

Unbeatable location overlooking Luis I bridge and across to Gaia. Extremely easy to walk to most attractions and shopping and restaurants. Seating in the garden with Porto and the Douro in front of us was our favorite time of the day. Thanks for hosting us!

Location, location, location! I would highly recommend this place due to the location next to the cathedral and the beautiful view on the river and bridge. From there you can walk to and from all major city highlights, cafes, restaurants. Beautiful apartment. The house next door is currently being renovated (large building site) and it can get noisy due to construction.
What an absolute Gem, thanks Alex for hosting us and helping with all this ur questions, the absolute best views from the garden and a very spacious house.

Gorgeous view in a charming old home. Convenient to most areas of town and easy to navigate once you figure out the back streets. Depending on where you're coming from, it can be a climb to get to the house, but that means it's downhill going most anywhere. Had a great few days staying here
Beautiful place with lots of character and amazing views! It was a bit hard to locate with Uber.

Fernando was a welcoming and gracious host. Our first impression was very good as he had an irish flag flying next to the portuguese flag at the front of the house when we arrived. This was a nice touch. He was very helpful to us throughout our stay. The property exceeded our expectations (first time Airbnb users) and was as listed. We are a family of 6 and managed without a car pretty well, Fernando's house is a 5-10 min walk to shops and beach, about 25 min walk to Mindelo metro station. The metro is direct into Porto (about 30 min) and you can get to the airport with one line change. We found Mindelo town quite spread out but local shops and takeaway were good and Restaurante Rubens Dunas was very good with big portions.

Carla's apartment is perfectly located in the center of Porto.  It's within walking distance to all the major sites and half a block from tbd metro. The apartment is brand new and stunning.  Very clean and the perfect size.  The photos do not do it justice.  I really enjoyed my stay.  Definitively the best air b n b apartment I have ever rented.  If you are visiting Porto then stay here!
Great appartment, we could stay there every day in our life.  Location is perfect.

We had such a great time, the flat is very central and a great starting point for tours to country side. We love cooking and have to say the kitchen was the best equipt and clean one we have ever had and cocking was so much fun. Thank you so much and we would recommend it any time!

Carla's apartment is the best-ever apartment I've stayed from airbnb in the past years. It's truly in the very center of the old town of Porto, with the view of São Bento train station from the bedroom's balcony 200 meters away. Almost every sightseeing place is walkable - taking a stroll in Porto is very pleasant, no matter what the weather is. Carla is very responsive and helpful - she provides very detailed travel info for guests with maps, restaurants and bars recommendation and sights nearby. The apartment itself is quite modern and in simplicity style which is just where my taste falls. It has three sides of windows, which means you can have an almost panoramic view.  Put all in a nutshell, the four-day stay at Carla's apt is simply perfect.

My sister and I gave our parents a 5 days vacation in Carla's apartment in Porto. They had a great time! The apartment was nice and cosy and very clean. They loved that it was situated in the very center of Porto, close to the train station and to the river. I can't wait to stay here myself one day.

Our stay at Carla's apartment was wonderful. The apartment is exactly as shown on the pictures. We didn't know Porto, so it was only once there that we realized how incredibly well located the appartment is, close to the metro, and the rua da flores, the galleria de paris neighborhood...   And dealing with Carla was a pleasure!

Carla's friend Sonia met us. She showed us around the flat, answered all our questions and explained everything.  Carla's flat is lovely, spacious, very trendy with everything you might want.  Great views and balconies (on all three sides!).  Right next to the metro and on an interesting street with lots of old shops and cafes less than 10 minutes walk to the harbour.  The weather was lovely too - despite it being the last weekend in December!

The Flat was amazing, lovely and in a very central location. Carlas friend Sonia welcomed us and gave us some useful information. She was also available in case of issues or questions, which was very helpful. It was a great experience.

We did not meet Carla, her friend Sonia waited for us at the apartment. Sonia was very nice and helpful. The apartment is very modern, clean and very well located, many places are at a walking distance and the metro is at the corner. We would highly recommand the apartment to all travelers

Carla's friend Sonia met us on arrival and provided us with lots of useful information. The flat is right in the heart of the city with most attractions, restaurants and shops within a short walk. Being so central, there's some daytime noise.  It is a bright and airy flat and it was a pleasure spending a week there.

The Best Ever We have stayed at many Air Bnb properties this is the best so far. Apartment is better than pictured Spotless Location is Ideal for walking to all sites Has everything you need including things like Cooking Oil and spices like coming home Host and her friend who let us in are great Value amazing

We had a great time in Porto and the apartment  was just the perfect way to enjoy it in a relaxing and luxurious way. We did not meet Carla herself but Sónia helped us with the key so that was perfect too. I would highly recommend this apartment for a visit in beautiful Porto!

This is one of the nicest apartments I’ve ever stayed in, and I’ve stayed in several rental apartments in Europe, Canada and the US. Carla (and her friend Sonia) were excellent hosts. They were accessible/responsive, very informative, and check-in was easy and efficient. The apartment location is outstanding - conveniently located near tourist sights, as well as a supermarket. The apartment is just as nice as it appears in the pictures. It was extremely clean, newly renovated, nicely decorated, and fully equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay (we were there for 4 nights). Wifi was fast and reliable. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay in this apartment again and highly recommend you book this apartment if visiting Porto.

Carla's place is unique! The location is so central and in a very beautiful neighborhood. The apartment itself is unique and tastefully decorated. It is very cleaned and spacious. On our arrival Carla warmly greeted us at the apartment and gave us many useful tips about the city, and recommended some restaurants, museum and bars to explore. Thank you Carla for this great getaway!

The appartment is AWESOME: modern, clean, full equiped, wifi included. There is a parking just below the flat. Great location in the heart of Oporto, closed to main atractions and a few minutes walk to the river. Carla and her friend Sonia are great hosts, very communicative and helpful during all the stay. Great place, recommendable 100%

We loved the apartment as we were only a few steps away from Metro, railway and restaurants. If you like it calmer and more quiet then I would search in another quarter. The equipment of the apartment is perfect! It is very spacious and luminous! Great!

This apartment is modern, clean and very well equipped.   The kitchen is exceptional, and the apartment is bright and airy.   The location is great, with the downside that is located on a very busy pedestrian street with lots of people, street musicians, cafes, etc.   It is very noisy well into the night, and you cannot escape the noise in the bedroom.   It is quieter in the living room, so we slept on the fold out sofa.   Otherwise the apartment would have been perfect!

This was the perfect location! We could easily walk to the station  and also to all the main spots. Our host was super easy to communicate with and check in and check out were simple. Everything was clean. Would recommend!

Very tidy and lovely AirBnb apartment equipped with everything you need. Carla is a great host and there when you need her, Very nice and wants to share all she knows about the area. We had a great stay!

Beautiful flat in an incredibly convenient location. Right in the middle of Porto and you can easily get to everywhere you could want to on foot. The flat was very comfortable and spotlessly clean, with lots of great touches like coffee machine, Netflix etc. Loved having a meal on the balcony and watching the street below.

Best hostess’ we’ve had - provided such personalized experience by understanding our needs.  Best of Porto - location, hospitality, communication, and accommodating service. Don’t look further and book here! Carla is amazing!

Very cool apartment, absolutely loved it! Carla was very responsive too. The only thing that was difficult was the keys getting into the building and gate, but luckily there was a very nice security guard to help ☺️

We had a fabulous stay in Carla's apartment. locations was ideal to explore all parts of the city easily by foot. The apartment was spotless and spacious, we couldn't have asked for me. we would highly recommend Carla's apartment for your stay in Porto

We were 6 Croatian students who spend 3 nights at Joao apartment. Apartment is very clean, comfortable and good equipment.  Its located very close to the city center. Unfortunately we have not met Joao but people who welcome us were nice but they didnt speak english, so we coudnt get more informations about thing we wanted to know.
It is a great and comfortable apartman with very good location, where the owner is really helpful and flexible.
Plenty of room in this nice apartment.  Very well located.  We had a great time there

Simple and basic accomodation. The flat is not so cosy but it still fulfils the purpose. João was answering really fast. Luckily we were in Porto at weekend so the parking was for free. Parking could be a little problematic during the week.

Staff were really welcoming and friendly. Uporto House is definitely a great experience and I’d recommend.  It’s not the closest location from the center but there’s bus stops and subway stations. Besides that, it is a little noisy but nothing disturbing. I really enjoyed my stay. Place is big, very clean (there’s staff to clean weekly) - some people do not respect cleaning rules but that’s on their own, I don’t blame Uporto House for that - overall great experience. I would come back. Thank you.

Isabel was a great host and her home is lovely, clean and comfortable! I had a great stay and I warmly want to thank Isabel for her hospitality :-)  The apartment is very well located in the heart of Vila do Conde, 10-15 min walk to metro and beach!
my  mum  and i we   really  enjoyed  our   10 days  stay- Isabel made  as  feel  very  welcome  ! the  room is new and  clean and the house  is  closed  to the  shops  and restaurant !

This is a lovely space in a great location. I loved hearing the seagulls in the morning.  Taxis from the metro are a bit scarce but if you are travelling light it is a fairly easy (mainly)  downhill run.

Best experience in Portugal! Isabel is so friendly and helped us a lot. The room is also incredibly comfortable and clean. It’s awesome to stay there for 4 nights, chill, and experience a local life in such a small fishing village!!

we only stayed for one night. Isabel is a very friendly person, the room and the beds were very comfortable and the bathroom was super clean :) the location also is very nice, with the beach around the corner and cool restaurants and a chilled vibe!

Isabel's place was amazing..very modern, clean and in an amazing place just outside of Porto. The train into Porto was just under one hour and the train station is a 12 min walk. It is a seaside town with beautiful views. It was nice to come back to peace, quiet..a wonderful bed and a great shower after being in Porto all day!
Isabel is a great host. Nice house, clean room with individual bathroom. I can fully recommend staying at Isabel's.

Beautiful and simple home comforts. Isabel is a wonderful host and has a lovely young family, which are a joy to be around. Excellent location - easy walk to Santa Clara metro. Close to beach, River, swimming pool, shops, cinema, cafes- everything you need. Would definitely like to stay here again

I stayed a weekend at Isabel's lovely home. The location is perfect, right in the middle of the old part of Vila do Conde, close to the restaurants and bars. The room and bathroom are clean and bright.  The wifi was strong and the bed was very comfortable. Isabel also gave me a lot of privacy. I would highly recommend staying in Isabel's home!
Very spacious and clean  house in the old part of town. At walking distance from supermarket and the beach and also from the metro station.

Everything was so great! Isabel was so kind and nice woman. We felt there really like at home. We had private room and bathroom and we could use her kitchen for cooking. I really recoment this acommodation for everybody. The place is close to market, beach and many caffees. Thank you for all Isabel 💙

I stayed for 2 nights at Isabel‘s and had a very lovely time! The room and bathroom were super clean, the room is really spacious and bright, the bed is so comfortable and i loved the wooden floors. Also the location is great, it‘s in the beautiful old part of the town, a short walk to the sea, all kinds of cafes and restaurants or the metro (ca 15min).  Isabel is a very kind person and I just felt really comfortable staying at her place.

The room and the bathroom were clean and in a good condition. We had to wait about 15 minutes due to unexpected complications, which is OK. Isabela is very friendly and explained a lot of things. What we didn’t like was that the kitchen was a bit messy and it was hard to find some space to store our food.
The flat was nice and as it is described. Ana was very nice and helpful. We enjoyed our stay.
It is a great Appatment. Ana is very friendly, helpfull and always responsive. It was a very nice stay!

Great location. There's a steep ladder to the upstairs bedroom so no good if you have mobility issues.  No TV either but lots of bars nearby all of whom have televisions. Good for exploring a really nice city.  Easy check in.
Thank you for welcoming us and letting us visit this amazing town ! We had a wonderful stay in Porto ! The apartment was comfy and pretty easy to find. We're already looking forward to come back !
Nice stay at Ana's place situated in the heart of the Porto, everything was easily accessible from the apartment and Ana's son was very helpful. Thanks for everything.

Don't hesitate visiting Ana's place! It is very beautiful and big to stay there with your friends:) Also it has good views being on the high floor. Very nice way to organize an evening dinner on the terrace and listen to the sound of night Porto!  Have a great time there!
