Nice apartment, great for many people. Unfortunately there is a stair that is very difficult to climb, mostly in the night for going to the bathroom, it is very dangerous! The flat was dusty on the floor and on the furniture. In the night the street was very crowded and noisy. Neither the windows closed stopped the noise.
Beautiful flat, very clean, almost in city center, bit noisy, not enough stuff for six people

This is a truly unique place. Beautifully designed and comfortable. The hosts, Alexandre and Sonia, were very welcoming and caring. They welcomed us upon arrival, made sure that we and our baby have all what we need and gave us tips on what to do in Porto. Highly recommended place both for the comfortable and stylish stay as well as the amazing hosts.
A big plus for us was that the flat has a terrace. The appartment was clean and had everything we needed. It is located in the centre with everything on walking distance.
Spacious apartment with a central location. Noisy street throughout the night so bring ear plugs :)  Ana is a hospitable host.
A great place to stay! A few stations with the subway to the center of Porto, and also a very quiet area to sleep.  Thank you Alexandre!

Alexandre was a fabulous host and great at all the communication with us. We found the accommodation to be in a very convenient location and a quiet street. The main issue was the bedroom was quite hot when the weather warms up and this made sleeping uncomfortable. We have fed this back to the hosts so hopefully they will work to improve this. It was so thoughtful  of the hosts to provide some breakfasts foods for us as the following day was a public holiday. Highly recommended

We had a great stay at Alexandre and Sonia’s. Alexandre was an attentive host and very approachable for anything you need. The loft has a brilliant atmosphere- calm and welcoming, which is what we wanted for a few days exploring Porto. We had ample space for working remotely in the room with a desk, and in the communal open plan living areas.  There was light breakfast each morning (bread, pastries, cereal) and access to tea/coffee making & kitchen facilities to prepare light meals/snacks throughout the day. We would recommend staying here for a quiet relaxing base away from the centre of Porto. We were able to walk into the main areas of Porto by foot but mainly chose Bolt/Uber which was very convenient and affordable to get around promptly. Prime location for the Campanhã train/metro station. Overall a lovely stay and friendly approachable hosts. We will stay here again when visiting Porto in the future!

It was really nice stay with amazing apartment. Alex have recommended to me local good restaurants which was all great to me. And also he was so kind and always helpful for me. Also apartment was so clean and well organized. I wish I could stay a few more days in Porto.
Very nice and comfortable place, his family so sweet.we've a wonderful trip, thank you for everything.

I spent one night in Alexandre and Sonias apartment with my boyfriend on the way from Portugal to Spain. I will recommend the place highly to every one. Very good value for the money! The apartment looks even more amazing real life than on the pictures. Also very clean and tidy,.Alexandre was also very helpful with our check in and all other questions we had during our stay. Very convenient if you are passing by porto like we did, since the train station is just a couple of minutes away.

It was a wonderful stay, Alexandre put so much effort in making the guests feel welcome. Everything was neat, clean and in gorgeous design. Even though there where other guests we felt completely private and it was a great atmosphere! I can highly recommend the loft!
We can totally recommend Alexandre&Sonia’s place! If we ever come back to Porto we won't hesitate to book again. Great design and super friendly hosts!
Clean, modern and right by the train station. Highly recommend for those looking to meet new people in a new city.

One of our best Airbnb experiences! Lovely people. Alexandre gave us great tips of places in Porto & he made our breakfast everyday. The place has an unique design! We highly recommend it. Marta & Yasin

Alexandre&Sonia’s place is really lovely! There’s a wonderful shared space with a garden. Alexandre checked me in and took the time to provide recommendations for exploring Porto and he also offered to connect me with the other solo travelers staying in the space. The bedrooms are nice. There is breakfast in the morning and juice/milk/tea available all day. The location is also great next to the station.

We enjoyed our stay - there was street parking right out the front , room to move around in the apartment and even a nice view from the bedroom. It was exactly what we were looking for and would recommend.
Alexandre and Sonia were very friendly and we enjoyed our stay! It was very clean and beautiful. Any problems that arose were quickly resolved by them, recommend anyone to stay there 🫰
Beautiful flat, very clean and well located  at a 10 minutes walking distance from the city center. Fernando is very nice and the communication was easy.  We had a perfect stay!

The apartment is perfect. The host is more perfect. Welcomed us when we arrived and also woke up early to see us off at 6am!!  Also appreciated the welcome goodies of wine and bake goods. As well as the white clean fluffy towels  One of the best Airbnb experiences ever!

Fernando’s place was incredible! It is spacious and beautifully decorated. We had everything we needed and he even stocked the fridge with beer, juices, jams and gave us a bottle of wine. It is right in the heart of the city center, the waterfront is less than a 30 min walk, and there is a grocery, restaurant and pharmacy on every block. We enjoyed the place immensely! Thank you Fernando!

If you want to stay in the most perfect place in Porto, I highly recommend Fernando's place. It is in a fantastic location.   The apartment is spacious, extremely clean, has air conditioning in every room and is just the perfect place to relax after hours of walking. Our family of 6 had plenty of room in the 3 bedroom apartment. Fernando also added a special touch by providing us with crossiants, fruit, milk,  coffee, beer and wine. I recommend this place if you want to enjoy the city and have a beautiful place to rest at the end of the day.

Fernando is a gracious host. He met us at the apartment to walk us around. He bought breakfast food and beer/wine.  He left detailed recommendations. And the apartment itself was perfect for my family.

Everything was wonderful!   The apartment is stunning, and in a fantastic location.  It’s easily accessible to the train station and center of town.  The air conditioning worked perfectly throughout.  The bedrooms are comfortable and quiet. The kitchen also has everything you want.

Location, location, location! This place is not only stylish, comfortable, spacious, and modern, this is centrally located and on the first floor with an elevator for your luggage! My two gal friends and I had plenty of space to do our hair, makeup, and lounge without incident lol. Oh, and the nespresso machine is such an added bonus. Thank you Fernando for hosting us!

Casa da Alegria felt like we were truly at home in Porto. In fact, we decided to extend our stay by a day because we loved it so much. Beautiful apartment, perfect location and the very best host. Fernando was warm and gracious. We will be back and will definitely refer friends!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Fernando's place.  Stunning place in an excellent location, a very friendly host and the actual look and feel even better than the pictures.  With some extras such as a washing machine that add to the benefits of his place. And the welcoming with some beers, wine, snacks and fruit was such a nice touch. I can highly recommend this for a great stay in Porto.  Many thanks Fernando!

Fernando's place was so lovely and comfortable. Everything you would need in a kitchen too! He sent restaurant recommendations in advance  and they were great! Highly recommend staying here if you want to be right in the middle of the action and walkable to all the sites.

We had a wonderful time at this apartment! The place matched the photos exactly and was very spacious for our group of 4. Fernando was very responsive and even let us check in after the window as we had a delayed flight. He met us upon arrival and provided some lovely welcome snacks. The location is great! So close to the city center and anywhere you would want to walk.

We stayed for 3 nights in Fernando's centrally located apartment.  Extremely close to everything you could possibly want to do and see in Porto and the plus was that it comes with a parking space right in the centre of Porto which wasn't easy to find.  The apartment was immaculately clean (couldn't even find dust inside) and kitchen was well stocked, with both wine AND beer.  Although we didn't manage to use it, it set us up for our stay.  Fernando was kind and thoughtful and waited for us to show us the parking.  His restaurant recommendation for us which he also booked for us given our limited Portuguese was easily the best meal we had in Porto!   Many thanks Fernando for a great time in Porto
We really enjoyed our stay. Fernando was very easy to communicate with. He was happy to accommodate an early check in for my son. The snacks and beverages he left for us were greatly appreciated!
We felt right at home from home. Great access to public transit, markets, and stores.  It is a charming apartmen!

The communication with the host was really easy even though they were away. The flat although not in the centre, it was very close to metro stop and local shops. The place had a character to it,quirky, in very cool vintage style, clean and cosy, really loved it. There was nice balcony where we had tea in the mornings. The wifi was good. In general we had a lovely stay and would definitely recommend it.

The apartment is really lovely. The vintage decor makes the apartment really cozy and welcoming. There's a variety of stores in the neigborhood and getting around Berlin was easy with the metro station so close. Communication with Bartolo was really easy and he was arranging with the arrival and departure time. Me and my friends we recommend this place! :)
Lovely and relaxing spot.  Bartolo is a great host, his house is lovely.  Spacious rooms, well decorated, everything matches the description.  Nice spot to unwind.

Fernando was a great host. He met us upon arrival and graciously bought breakfast items for next morning as well as a bottle of wine and beer!! We truly appreciated that.  We highly recommend staying at Fernando’s place!

Well appointed apartment, high quality linens and furniture, lots of kitchen tools.  very comfortable beds.  Everything in good shape.  Just 5 steps up to elevator level.  Lots of shopping nearby.  Fernando met us to hand over the keys.  Fresh croissants and buns and jams were a real treat.

FLAWLESS!!! Fernando as a host and his apartment are FLAWLESS! Location is great, Apartment is perfect and feels like home. Fernando provided sooooo many little details. All kinds of supplies in the small fridge, Nespresso Cafe, slippers, soaps, shampoo, conditioner, just everything. The only things lacking were a clothes dryer, and a full size refrigerator. Neither of which mattered to us for our 4 day stay.  I cannot recommend Fernando and his beautiful apartment which I wish I could buy from him! (Seriously Fernando reach out to me). Not to mention that we fell in love either Porto. Forget the South, stick to the North!!!! Porto is a gem, Duoro Valley is fantastic, Aveiro is charming as can be.  If you go to Portugal do not miss Porto and stay at Fernando’s apartment you won’t be dissapointed!

A gem of a place accompanied by a gem of a host. Thoughtful touches throughout including welcome snacks and fully stocked with everything you could need on a vacation and more. There’s also an elevator which is great for carrying luggage up, even though it’s only one floor.

Fernando was a wonderful host.  He provided treats to welcome us, and even stocked the fridge with milk for our grandson.  Very thoughtful!  His apartment was spacious, well maintained and very clean and located perfectly for us - we could walk to a lot of the sights, shopping, restaurants.  We highly recommend Fernando and his apartment in Porto.

We stayed three nights in Porto and the apartment was terrific. It was in a perfect location, was clean and bright, stylish, and very well stocked with all we could need. I would recommend this apartment (and probably all the apartments in the building) wholeheartedly. It was lovely to come back to after a day of seeing Porto. Anne was very helpful, especially in her recommendation of the amazing restaurant FLOW.

Celia's flat was really lovely, bigger than expected and had a surprise roof terrace with a view over the square. It's in a really central location and right next door to the famous bookshop. Thanks for having us!

Perfect apartment: clean, spacious with a wonderful terrace and very well situated in the center (close to everything). The host was very helpful, providing us with all kinds of tips about sightseeing and places where to eat. We had a pleasant stay there and we would definitely come back!
Era was really helpful and the place was really great. It was really central and we had a great time and would recommend the place to anyone.

Very friendly welcome. They left us a bottle of wine and provided us with loads of information about the city. Amazing location in the centre of town next to night life as well historic sites and railway station. Flat has a balcony too. Stay here!

We had a lovely stay at this apartment and in Porto - it's a great location. The apartment itself is really comfortable and spacious, good for friends. The hosts were really helpful and reliable, offering to take us for coffee when we arrived. I'd highly recommend staying here for sure.

we had a lovely stay the apartment was very nice big and clean every thing we needed in it, the host were very helpful and easy to contact. it was a little hard to find, location fab right in the centre of town and only a few minutes from the station. if we come back to porto again we will defiantly book this one
Really thoroughly enjoyed spending time in the apartment. Really good location. Era gave us great tips on what to do in the area, would definitely recommend staying here!
The apartment was spacious, clean, and very centrally located. Joana checked us in and had great recommendations on restaurants and bars in Porto. Would recommend staying here to anyone.
The apartment is very spacious and in a perfect locations for a quick visit to an amazing city. Strongly recommend it to anyone going to Porto.

The flat is fantastic and absolutely exceeds your expectations. The location could not be betterif you asked, right next to livraria Lello with a fantastic gelateria next door also. Fantastic flat in an absolutely wonderful city, could not reccomend more.
Great apartment at a perfect location. There is a bar on the first floor with music till 4 am in the weekend, which you can hear in the apartment.
Good location, comfortable space.  The bar and street noise is as per previous reviews so you must be prepared for that. It was a good choice for us.

Lovely spacious apartment with two bathrooms. Good location. Host was very prompt with his response to issues that arose. We were able to drop our luggage whilst waiting for check in. Unfortunately noise from bar downstairs is loud at the weekend so families may find this a problem
Amazing location, terrific host  and very clean apartment with a great view from the terrace. Would definitely recommend the apartment to others.
Cool apartment located right in the heart of Porto. It doesn't get any better than that. Totally recommended

Very nice stay! The flat is really well located in the city, clean, and the team who manage the booking is really reactive. Good tips to visit the city and a delicious bottle of wine for welcoming visitors

Spacious apartment in the hustling and bustling neighborhood of Porto. If you are ok with staying above a bar (that can get a bit noisy), the location cannot be more perfect. We had no problem exploring Porto on foot and had an amazing stay at this apartment.
Great place to stay in the city centre of Porto! Very spacious, modern and cosy room design, clean; everything you need is provided by Era. I highly recommend this loft!

The place is really roomy and beautiful! We enjoyed every minute of it.  The courtesy of the host to let us check in earlier was very appreciated.  Probably this place is the best you can find in Porto. We will certainly be back soon! Thank you so so much!

We had a lovely stay at Once Upon A Time. The apartment was a spacious penthouse suite, larger than expected. The outside patio with a view of the square was enjoyable and we loved the location. Will definitely stay here next time we’re in Porto!
Great place to stay.  Convenient to all the tourist spots in town.  Close to several restaurants and gelato shops.  Beds were comfortable.  I would stay there again.
Our stay was just perfect: situation in the city, quality of the apartment, interaction with the host … definitely one of the best spot we had in the city in many years
Perfectly situated in the city centre but still quiet inside.  Nicely laid out apartment with tons of space. We loved the place and would highly recommend to anyone. Thanks for a great stay!

The owners/property managers were very responsive and friendly.  Very large two bedroom and large outdoor deck for warm evenings.  Kind of a Retro Loft vibe next to the famous Harry Potter bookshop and above an amazing gelato shop.  Busy Plaza due to the location but great for walking to restaurants and tourist sights.  It is a three floor walk up, which is very common in Portugal.

The place was wonderfully located, and the apartment had everything we needed for a short stay. Being central to the town comes with the downside of a bit of noise due to construction next door and night time activities in the square below.
We had a great stay at Jimmie's and Alina's flat! It is located very central, very clean and lovely. The two were always helpful with flat and city issues.

The apartment is located in a quiet neighborhood abt 15 mins walk from Trindade Metro. The living area and bedroom are spacious and you can hear the birds whilst in courtyard. The clothes drying rack was very useful. We appreciated the sight seeing and traditional restuarant tips. We especially liked lunch at Restaurante Braganza and the seafood experience at Tito ll. We appreciated your prompt responses when needed.

Perfectly located in the center of Porto, an easy walk from sao bento train station. Beautiful private terrace to sit outside and enjoy coffee/breakfast.  We stocked up on fruit, yogurt, bread, and coffee and made our own breakfast every morning.  Porto is a lovely city, and this was the perfect place to use as a homebase!

Great flat. Alaina & Jimmie were lovely hosts and very helpful. There are some good value restaurants nearby and a more pricey little hipster area just round the corner as well, if you like that sort of thing. The town centre is really close and it's very easy to get there from the airport. The upper terrace has great views and the lower one is a pleasant quiet spot for morning coffee, etc. The guys downstairs have some great wine as well.
Alaina&Jimmie's place is in an amazing location, close to all the sites and a short walk from the major metro station. We had a lovely stay, and would recommend their place any time.

Alana & Jimmies apartment is in a fantastic location,  within waking distance to pretty much everything.  Alex and Paulo are amazing 'hosts' who gave us the most useful information and welcome.  The apartment has all you need and is very comfortable,  bed and great shower.  Whilst the view from the top terrace is fantastic, it is a bit overgrown. We had a wonderful break in a fabulous city,  so much to see, lovely food and very welcoming people.

The flat is great ! The location of the flat is perfect. The hosts were amazing and made us feel at home. We had a great time and we ll definitely come back to this place next time we come to Porto. Thank you guys !

Very nice, big and cosy appartment, in the centre of town, with a patio and a very nice terrace! Very warm welcome from Alaina and Alex! Am ideal place to discover Porto and an excellent value for money.

This place was very spacious, comfortable, and easy to make our home for 11 days. The host Alaina and the nearby wine shop owner Alex were extremely helpful with our travel questions and our lost luggage issue. Alaina suggested several great ideas to visit, and Alex arranged a day-long tour that was a highlight of our time in Porto.

Absolutely can't fault this spot, right in the center of Porto in the heart of the entertainment area, including fantastic bars right on your street! The apartment itself is incredibly spacious, and the views from the balconies are genuinely incredible. The place was clean, with all the possible amenities you might need. No faults.

Pictures are accurate reflection of apartment.  great location, and nice and quite, good bed, basic kitchen.  Week long stay let down by lack of basics like dishwashing liquid, rubbish bags and tea coffee. little things which you expect hosts to provide for a short stay.
This is a really spacious, well equipped and well decorated apartment. The location is absolutely ideal for Porto. Both hosts were lovely and easy to communicate with.

I might not be impartial because I love Porto so much, but I'd say this is the best Airbnb apartment I've ever been. Big and comfortable, well decorated, quiet and home-like, even if it's so near the main streets of the city. Alaina and Jimmie were so caring and kind! The neighborhood is very secure, the main subway station is within a 5 minutes walk, and you have small shops and supermarkets along the streets surrounding the apartment. We couldn't enjoy the terraces because it rained during our stay, but I'm sure they're lovely places for the mornings and evenings. As I plan to go to Porto more often, I'm pretty sure I'll stay again at Alaina and Jimmie's. I felt like home. Thankyou!

We had a lovely time staying in Porto. Paulo met us at his shop under the apartment and welcomed us warmly with a nice glass of wine. We sat and chatted for 15 minutes and he showed us into our space. He was responsive throughout our stay and offered recommendations for sights and restaurants. The apartment was in a perfect location within a few minutes walk of several great restaurants, bars, and attractions. We would come back here in a heartbeat. The outdoor space was a very nice spot to have breakfast. We highly recommend.
Great place to stay. Large airy rooms  and a variety of private and shared outdoor spaces. The views from the top are magnificent. Alaina and Jimmy are fantastic hosts

Great Location, Apartment and Hosts!  First- you can see the ocean from your balcony and rooftop, it is a couple minute walk to the funnest beach around Porto.  Our family of 5 stayed at this apartment for months while we looked for long term housing.  The house is big enough for a family of 5.  It has great art, it is a slightly older building, but has everything you need to be comfortable including all of the appliances that you are used to.  Finally, Nuno and Ana were wonderful hosts, they are very quick to respond and very helful.

Fabulous stay in Matosinhos. The flat was ideal for us and three teenagers - spacious, very close to the beach and some fantastic fish restaurants, and for the bus or tram into Porto. Ana was a great host with good recommendations for places to eat.

Spacious flat with all the equipment we needed. Flat is located near shops and restaurant. Easy access to beach.  Communication and check in and out was easy. Flat could have been cleaner when we arrived but this was quickly sorted.

The location was absolutely perfect! The apartment was excellent. Host was in contact from the beginning of reservation and was always available when we had a question or a need. It was nice to show up and find some coffee and sugar and toiletries available to get us started. She was available Beyond expectations. As far as the apartment, the separation between the bedroom and the living space was great. Truly felt like a small efficient and very clean apartment. We would definitely stay here again on our next visit

Rita is a great host! The place is great..great location . You can walk everywhere. Near all the main attractions, restaurants  and all transportations: taxi, train and bus. Small grocery store near by and even a gym! Thé place was super clean , very modern perfect for a couple . The apartment is on the third floor with no elevator…. But who cares…lol  I would go back for sure!! Thank you Rita for letting us stay in your lovely apartment.
Great location, exactly as published, very clean and well maintained.  Be sure you are fit…third floor with no lift, but that was fine for us.  We really enjoyed our stay.
Beautifully equiped, very well located but a bit noisy accommodation. A bit more and proactive communication by the hosts would have been appreciated.
Very cosy and perfect located apartment. I had to do a late night check in but that was no problem. This Airbnb is definitely recommendable.

José and his family made us feel very welcome in their house, being really friendly. The place is great and the facilities exceeded our expectations (really clean, tidy and quite spacious). This is a perfect place to spend some days relaxing while visiting the surrounding areas (e.g. Passadiços do Paiva).
Wonderful experience. The house is absolutely amazing and the host family is super nice. We recommend!

A lovely place with great facilities. Very comfortable and great hosts. We especially enjoyed the swimming pool. Sadly we didn't have room in our car for Cookie the dog so he will be there to greet you.

We had a very nice stay in Jose house. The house was perfect for us, with the very nice garden, swimming pool and all playing facilities. Every morning we were surprised by fresh sandwiches. Also the presence of your dog Cookie was a nice surprise for us and the children The location of the house is also beautiful, in nature, but close to Arouca, perfect for hiking in the Arouca geopark mountains or a short trip to visit the beautiful city of Porto. Jose, his wife and sons were alway very helpfull to us, they even send us clothes that we forgot when leaving. See you a next time! Andy, Heidi, Kobe, Bo and Anaïs Belgium

This place is fabulous! The house has lots of space and the garden is really brilliant. Our kids spent hours in the pools and playing...there's big gates on the property so it's very safe. Jose and his family are so friendly and helpful. The area is lovely. We had a great time here

We had a fun night at Arouca Town and Dulce's place. Though it was raining, we were received by warm welcome and home-felt villa of Dulce's family. Apart from its full facility and stylish decor, as the place is located in village high up the mountain, you could enjoy a wonderful view through window. It's the prefect choice for accommodation if you wish to have a "escape" trip to indulge in countryside life style.
The place is outstanding. We will definitely be recommending it to friends and family. 5 star hospitality. P.S. they have a pinball machine, how cool is that!

This is the most amazing place you can ever stay at! It's really close to Arouca (lovely little town) and 15 minutes drive from the Paiva Walkways and a great stop for a quick trip to the country side of Portugal. The hosts were amazing and the place was fantastic!

What an incredible place! Nice house, nice people, nice dog, nice swimmingpools, nice terraces, nice soccerarea, nice gamingroom, etc etc. We really enjoyed our stay. The surroundings are also very beautiful and Arouca itself is also worth a visit. We recommend this place to everyone!
Superb quality accommodation, spotlessly clean and extremely well equipped. The location is quiet and relaxing. Highly recommended.

Very nice place inside the owner’s house but well separated with everything. The kitchen is very good with a big oven and gas kitchen. The bedrooms are vey big and comfortable as well as the bathroom. You can use the swimming pool, gym, ping pong table, football field that are the common places. Overall a very positive experience and with good reason has so many good reviews.

Marcia is as lovely as the other guest already described.. Waited for us as we were delayed .. She even provided a crib for our little baby which was lovely! The terrace is great and huge ;) our son had a lot of fun with the cats from the neighborhood.  Even the place is central (just 2min by foot to the city hall and main square) it is absolutely quiet! Everything is new, lovely decorations, and it's a bright place where you get up with sunlight on your face.

A perfect place in Porto with perfect hosts !  We really enjoyed our trip in Marcia's apartment. Her and her boyfriend were there at our arrival to show us everything. They were very friendly and welcoming, and gave us great tips. The apartment is very beautiful and quiet, and we spent most of our time (when not visiting the city) on the terrace, it was very relaxing. We stayed there 3 nights but we would have stayed more ! Thanks again !

I could not recommend this airbnb more! When you dream of moving to a city and having a studio apartment - this is what you dream of! The terrace is incredible, the views at sunset are to die for and it is the perfect place to relax with a glass of wine or have your morning coffee.  The inside is decorated so beautifully and I genuinely did not want to leave! Marcia was so kind to not only leave us breakfast but also some little cakes to get us through the long walks of the day!  Location is perfect! It is close enough to the tourist hub (15 minutes walk maybe?) but also in an amazing spot of its own with cool bars and restaurants!  I would recommend this airbnb to any of my friends and family! We can't thank you enough!

Marcia is very very communicative and nice. She replied to our questions instantly and she gave all the useful information. The house is situated in a very strategic place and easily accesible to the city center. The house is very clean and well equipped. The balcony is absolutely a luxury. Highly recommend without any hesitation :)
This place is the best. The rooftop is wonderful and the kitchen is stocked with plenty of food and beverages.

We loved our staying in Marcia's apartment. Position was perfect, she welcomed us in a kindly and friendly way, space in the apartment was perfect for 3 people and the sunny and calm terrace was the perfect place to relax after walking all day around the city

This was a perfectly suitable small apartment for my adult daughter and myself. It was clean and comfortable and carefully decorated. The bed was quite comfortable. The outdoor space was a nice bonus. The location was good for us, quiet but close to restaurants, shops and the train station. We would choose it again.
We really enjoy Marcia's appartment. It is small, but really perfect for a few days in Porto. The location is great, near the action. I definitely recommend this place.
Marcia's place is absolutely lovely! Top location in a stunning city. Too bad we only had two days in Porto.

Such a nice place in a lovely city. Pedro and his wife are a really sweet couple. The apartment was in a right position next to the city center, clean and with everything that you need. If you want to enjoy Porto choose them :)

Pedro and Ines have such a beautiful space, the apartment is light and peaceful and we immediately felt relaxed during our time in Porto. The design is gorgeous and the location is great. We will definitely be back.

I’m hesitant to leave a public review because I want this place all for myself. The apartment is clean, serene, tastefully and austerely designed. The kitchen and bathroom are perhaps the most beautiful I’ve ever used. Easily walkable to the central part of the city but I hardly made it there because the neighborhood has all you could want. A quiet reprieve from the bustling city. Pedro was a great host, and I’ll be lucky to return again.
Hands down the most beautiful apartment I have ever stayed in! An additional plus: it is located in a great area in Porto with lot's of art and good food all around you.
Beautiful apartment and very tasteful decor. Loved the patio for sitting out after lots of walking around Porto. Would highly recommend this apartment and would love to return.

We had a truly amazing stay at Pedro and Inês’ beautiful apartment! They are the loveliest family and made us feel at home straight away, thank you so much for your amazing recommendations (everyone needs to try the coffee and brunch at Hakko across the street!). On the final day when the weather wasn’t too great we were able to stay at the apartment and check out much later in the day which was extremely kind!  The location was absolutely perfect, peaceful and quiet but still central and definitely closest to the best places to eat and drink!  The apartment itself is absolutely beautiful and the interiors are amazing, especially the kitchen area and terrace views. We would love to come and stay here again!  Ella 😊

This Airbnb is so perfect - the touches from every aspect added to the cozy and relaxing experience. We fell in love with it. The location is great for being within walking distance to attractions/restaurants without being in the exact thick of it. Highly recommend.

Pedro and Ines home is nothing short of beautiful. The architecture and interior design was a dream. My husband and I never wanted to leave! The location was fantastic with easy access to everything we wanted to do. Some amazing restaurants we found nearby were Alto and Gruta (seriously one of the best meals I’ve ever had - get the bisque and raviolo. Right across the street from the apartment are two great brunch spots recommended by Pedro—Hakko and Rosi. Pedro was very communicative and check in was very easy. Can’t wait to come back to Porto and stay in this apartment!
Pedro is a wonderful Host. His flat is amazing. Nearby are many restaurants and places to enjoy Porto. We loved our stay at Pedro's place!!!

An architectural gem tastefully furnished with an artist's eye. A beautiful and peaceful oasis within a bustling city. Magical light and a beautiful terrace with garden & city views. Pedro & Ines are attentive, warm, low-key hosts. The apartment is a work of art! Location was within walking distance to everything we wanted to see & do. I highly recommend.

This apartment is very well located, peaceful, and cosy. With its terrace, you'll be surprised to be in the heart of Porto. Marcia is a nice host, that take care of her visitors and with whom the communication is fast and easy. I definitely recommend her! :)

Marcia's apartment is in a great location! It was the perfect spot for exploring Porto. It's a very comfortable apartment with outdoor space to soak up the sun. And Marcia was very friendly and helpful, would highly recommend!

We had a fantastic time in porto and Marcias appartment was perfectly situated and very cosy with an amazing balcony view. Marcia was kind and welcoming on arrival and gave us tonnes of tips for food and drinks nearby. Definitely recommended!

Beautiful and well located flat, exactly like in the pictures. Check in was very easy and Marcia was always contactable in case we needed anything. She also provided us with excellent tips about where to eat in the area.

The apartment is close to the train station Sao Bento. There supermarkets and great restaurants around. The terrace makes the apartment so worth the rental. Marcia is really nice and gave me a lot of local tips. I am so happy that I chose this apartment.

My boyfriend and I stayed in Marcias sweet Appartement. It is perfectly located for a citytrip in Porto. We arrived by car and get a parkingspace in front of the Appartement. Marcia was very kind and gave us good advices for our stay. Thank you very much.   Bests Julia & Timm
this flat is great for a couple on a city break. the terrace is amazing. the location is excellently placed near nice dinner restaurant and few mins walk from city heart

The apartment is beautiful with old world charm. The bar in the kitchen is lovely, especially on sunny mornings as it was nice and warm. The location is perfect for exploring Porto (5-15 minute walk to lost sites) and not crowded like the Ribeira district. Very nice restaurants nearby and Pedro made some great recommendations. I highly recommend this apartment for travelers who are looking for a nice home base with some space.

The apartment is beautiful, such lovely spaces and architecture. The location is perfect, with lots of shops and restaurants around as well as being walkable to the city centre. We loved our stay here and the host was very friendly and helpful with recommendations
A very clean, compact apartment in a good location. The outside area on the balcony was very pleasant and relaxing.

The flat is very cosy and on a great street close to nice bars and restaurants. What was special about the flat was the large terrace with a beautiful view. We woke up to cats and seagulls hanging out every morning. Marcia was very helpful and the place is charming. I would highly recommend staying here !

Marcia's apartment was above our expectations! It was stunningly clean, nicely decorated, bright, cool, and comfortable. We particularly enjoyed making use of the beautiful terrace. It's perfect for spending a relaxing moment in the midst of a busy day sight-seeing! The location is also perfect--we were able to walk almost everywhere, with most of the central attractions being no more than 10-15 minutes away by foot. There are plenty of delicious restaurants nearby (5 minutes) for lunch or dinner. Although Covid restrictions limited nightlife, some bars and lively terraces were open nearby in the evening as well. Despite its central location, the flat itself is quiet and relaxing. Marcia is also very nice and always responded quickly to my messages. Thank you so much Marcia for welcoming us into your home!
Really nice place, good communication with super friendly Marcia who fix any problem or question super quickly, a small coffee machine could be nice :)

The host is nice and communicated well. The apartment is not entirely the same as the pictures. The apartment had strange smell and not properly cleaned up. The sheets and towels aren’t fresh. Apart from that, the apartment is okay.
Wonderful place. Cosy appartment, fantastic terrace in the very centre of Porto. Marcia is very nice and very reactive to any question

Great place, great location. The apartment is never more than ~20 minutes walk from all the major hotspots, including the restaurants, river,  university and library. The apartment is immaculate and has a balcony- we didn't get much use out of it in January, however in the summer it would be gorgeous.
We had a lovely stay in your apartment - thank you !! The contact with Marcia was easy and quick, everything was clean and the apartment is really cute. I can really recommend it 👍🏻

The apartment was really nice and the best part is the stunning terrace. It is perfect to explore Porto since it is located super central so that it is possible to explore the city by walking. We can recommend this apartment.

Marcia was an amazing host!  Replying to any questions we had or any enquiries we had!  The apartment itself was amazing, very clean and in the perfect location!  Would highly recommend if travelling to Porto!  Thanks again for everything!
We loved our stay in Marcus’s apartment and would definitely recommend! Great location near bars and restaurants. Very clean and the terrace is a really bonus.
Lovely apartment, great central location, enjoyed the tarrace a lot. No problem with check in or out, swift communication with the owner. Would recommend to any traveler.

This apartment is in a great location, just a short walk to great restaurants and bars in the local area as well as all the key tourist attractions. It was easy to get around via taxi or metro too. The apartment had everything we needed for a few days stay. We loved our trip to Porto!
Very cozy appartment. Everything was neat and clean. The neighborhood was also very cool! Thank you!
Lovely apartment with an amazing roof terrace, in a great location very easy to walk everywhere. Kitchen was in the bedroom which was fine but meant you could smell the food the whole time.

The flat is indeed at a perfect location. It's striking that you can find some local shops and restaurants on the same street, making the area very trendy. There's a large terrace, which unfortunately we didn't get to enjoy because of the weather, so maybe consider spring onwards to visit Porto. Otherwise, Marcia communicates everything efficiently and even allowed us to have a late check out. Highly recommended without a single doubt
Nice place, very well located, clean, beautiful terrace, comfortable… perfect for some days in Porto!
I had a very nice stay in Marcias apartment. The terrace is a perfect place to relax. Marcias responds quickly and everything function in the apartment. I will recommend this place for everyone.
Had a really lovely few days, the terrace is amazing for a spot of sunbathing before exploring the city.

The place is in a very good location within walking distance to all interesting places. There are restaurants nearby with good food and a supermarket if you need it. Easy to get to and from the airport, less than 10 min from Trindad metro station. The apartment is clean and quiet, good for resting after a long walk.

Great place. Perfect for long or short stay.  The place was very clean and cosy, and if you are lucky with the weather as we were, you can take the coffee in the morning in the beautiful terrace with the nice company of some local cats.  I recommend this place 100 %

The host was nice and accessible. The place is nice, just as described, enough for 3 or 4 people, and the terrace is ideal to have dinner in the nights of summer. The neighbourhood is located in the most traditional downtown, surrounded with lots of points of interest and close to the metro. Also, two pokestops are easily catchable!
Great place very well situated downtown with a very nice terrace.  Host very kind and helpfull.

Great and cosy apartment in Porto. Nothing was missing at all. And the terrace was great for a chill out in the evening. Although our flight had a delay and my mobile was not working Patricia waited for us till we came. Thanks for that again and again.

I had a great time at the apartment during my stay in Porto. The apartment is located in a very nice area with a lot of shops, bars, galleries, restaurants , etc around the corner and you can basically walk everywhere from there. I met with Rui who let me in and provided me with a lot of tips regarding the area, sightseeing and going out. For sunny days ( unfortunately not during my stay) the apartment also has a great terrace you can enjoy. The bathroom is a bit small, but it's manageable for a few days. If in Porto I definitely would stay there again.

If you are looking for somewhere to stay, look no further! This is the place to be in Porto. Walking distance to everything, public transport nearby, and with great hosts who make every second of your stay comfortable. The apartment is clean and beautiful- if I was moving to Porto I would move into this Airbnb! Thank you Patricia and Rui!
Fantastic stay - central location, gorgeous flats and great hosts! Patricia was extremely helpful in showing me where to go in Porto. Would recommend 100%!

The check in was smooth and prompt communication throughout. The location of the place is amazing! So close to everything and great for exploring Porto. Rui was such a friendly host and glad to have stayed here!
The host was very friendly and warm. Welcomed us at the time we set, and gave us tips for activities in and around   Porto. The bnb itself was very clean.

We really enjoyed our stay at this flat! It was very well equipped with everything we could have needed, the bed was comfortable, and the location couldn’t get any better! It’s right next to loads of cafes and restaurants, and walking distance to anything else you might want to check out :) Rui gave us a warm and friendly welcome, along with some excellent tips of places to go. I highly recommend staying here :)

The neighborhood is nice and as it's not in the heart of the city it's super calm. The house is in a tiny street where it's not easy to drive, it was like a show to see the drivers trying not to touch the walls of the houses. Diogo was THE perfect host thanks to his recommendations and his reactivity and availability! Thank you very much Diogo! ❤️💕

Clean and modern space with all the amenities you need - towels, soap, fully stocked kitchen with dishes, glasses, utensils, coffee maker, hot water kettle, coffee, tea, cookies, juice, yogurt, milk, beer, even apples... It’s close to public transportation and the Vincci Hotel.

Everything positive I had read in previous reviews proved correct: the location, interior design and its comforts, communication with Diogo and his attention to all details made our experience staying here ideal.  The stairs,  just beyond apartment that wind it’s way up to the Jardins do Palacio de Cristal are great cardio and   a nice way to experience the old Porto. The Jardins itself are worth meandering through and catching all the peacocks that reside there.  Highly recommend this Airbnb and all the wonderful sites of Porto.

This place was great. Diogo met us upon our arrival at the house. Took the time to go over a local map, give us recommendations for restaurants and activities. Even made a reservation for us at a place we couldn’t get into. Very responsive and communicative host. Beds were very comfortable. Great location. Felt safe. Nice touches with some snacks, wine, tea and coffee.  Highly recommend their place for any stay in Porto.

Such a charming Airbnb away from the tourist center. The house was spacious enough for 5 adults and had everything needed for a comfortable stay. The true standout is Diogo’s hospitality. He helped in every way possible and made us feel right at home. Would definitely recommend.

Lovely 5 night stay. Diogo was a great host, helpful with local recommendations and kindly offering for us to leave our luggage in the house until our evening flight home. Great space for our family of 2 adults + 2 teenagers.  15 min walk to the city centre, 30 min walk to the beach. We loved the layout and decor of the house, very well thought out and comfortable. We had a wonderful time evploring Oporto!

We absolutely loved our stay! Diogo was fantastic, he had so many recommendations. He was happy for us to message him at any time asking for help or suggestions. And he was always quick to reply. Honestly could not recommend them enough! Loved this stay!

This was a great property in a great location with easy access to Porto’s public transport network. The property in spectacular inside and really is something special. Our host was very personable and provide some great recommendations for our short stay in Porto. Would certainly use again and would recommend to any friends looking to visit Porto. Many thanks Diogo
What a great place!  A very creative remodel of an old town space. We walked everywhere and enjoyed Porto.
Diogo is a perfect host, responsive and popped by to give us area recommendations which were really good.  The house is spacious and quirky and a good base close to the centre of Porto

A lovely house on the outskirts of downtown Porto - beautifully decorated and designed . We enjoyed the peace after taking the 10 min tram back home, out of the busy tourist areas (easy 25 min walk). Restaurants and bars still around in this area, on the river front, which was great and the area felt a lot more local rather than touristy. Diogo was really helpful with his recommendations and tips. We have had a fantastic week.
Lovely home very well equipped. We enjoyed the location being in a quiet spot but walkable to everywhere with a few bars and restaurants nearby. Very helpful hosts.

Good location - away from centre so quiet but easy to walk into city or get tram. Hosts were very responsive and helpful. Diogo gave us great restaurant recommendations as well as places to go and booked us an early morning taxi for the airport to catch our flight home. Would definitely stay again.

our stay at Joana y Diogas wood & blue house was wonderful.  the location, the home, the hospitality were all above and beyond.  thank you to host Diogo for the recommendations.  we loved our stay here.

We had a great stay in Porto. The house was quirky and fun and very clean. Diogo provided everything we needed for a comfortable stay. He also provided lots of great recommendations for places to eat and things to do.

We had a lovely time staying at Joana and Diogo’s place. It was exactly as listed and within walking distance of the historic centre.  Joana and Diogo were extremely helpful. I would recommend. Thank you for a lovely stay!

Joana & Diogo’s place was stunning! Exactly like the pictures. Diogo was extremely helpful and quick to respond for everything we needed. The apartment itself is in the best location possible! Just a few minutes walk from soooo many restaurants and a picturesque scene infront of the River. My family and I had the most amazing stay and cannot wait to visit Porto again thanks to Joana & Diogo’s place!
Just as described. Cleanliness on the spot! Priscilla is a great host and the communication with her flows naturally. Will use again if needed. Thank you.

The room was really nice, clean, organised, and the apartment is in a great location, near the metro, restaurants, supermarket, few stories, and I could also walk to the main tourist attraction on the Douro River. The communication was good, and kind. I recommend!!

Clean, organized. The room is in a two-bedroom apartment with the livingroom also converted to a bedroom, so 3 guest rooms plus kitchen and bathroom. I was there during part of her cleaning because the other two guests left the day before, and I got to see how thorough the cleaning process was. A good stay.

My stay at Priscilla's place was a real success. The price-quality ratio is excellent for Porto. The apartment is well located near the train/metro and the city center, yet peacefully apart. The neighborhood felt cozy.  The room was comfortable, with a big bed, quality sheets, four pillows (!), and a good cabinet. It's worth noting the city noise, the cars you can hear. If you're very sensitive, earplugs might be a good idea. I myself loved the bed and slept very well, except one night some neighbor woke me up with his voice for a moment. Portugal is just in general more noisy than my country.  The kitchen is well-equipped, and the bathroom is spacious and clean.  I also enjoyed meaningful conversations with other guests. I’d happily stay here again the next time I come to Porto.

Priscilla is a wonderful host that goes above and beyond to ensure a comfortable stay. She is responsive and communication was easy. Location is great - super close to metro, supermarkets and only 20 min walk to the bridge. Lovely place for those who want to stay away from the crowds. Price+host+location is unbeatable. Definitely recommend

I really enjoyed my stay in Porto! The property is very comfortable and well located. The apartment looks exactly like photos. Priscilla was wonderful, super helpful and always ready to assist, which made a big difference. I highly recommend this place to anyone!
Nice Reception, everything was there and I never felt alone. The apartment was clean and with complete equipment. Everything in Sto. Tirso was close to reach.

Clean, tidy and in a very quiet location. Our hosts could not have been more helpful, and were always available when we needed them. I would consider using them again, and would recommend the property as a good choice if you stay in the north of Portugal. We felt at home. Thank you so much Ana and Luis, we had a great time.
Rute is a wonderful and attentive host. She made a booklet of local attractions and restaurants which all turned out to be great.  Hard to believe, but the apartment is cuter than pictured!
Great spot near train station and nightlife. Amazing little food spots nearby and a cool bar with cheap yum wine 30 seconds away! Great find in Porto.

This charming apartment is very well situated in the heart of Porto, but very calm as it is situated in closed road, with almost no trafic. It is also very well equipped with everything! We will come back again!

We LOVED our stay at Rute's airbnb. Everything was perfect: the location (near the city centre, metro, restaurants, the supermarket, a bakery), the appartment was beautiful and very, very clean! Rute was a great host, she recommended us where we should go, what we should see and do in Porto, which restaurants were nice, where we could hire a bike, etc. We had a great time and we would definitely go there again!

A neat little apartment in a great central location.  Noise from above could be a problem but there are building rules and while we were there had no problems.  Rute was welcoming and helpful, very pleasant host.

Amazing location, super bright and welcoming apartment. Rute was a very accommodating and helpful host. We had an amazing time in Porto, the whole city felt walkable from our location. We miss it already!

What a lovely place! The location is great, it offers everything you need and was sparkling clean. The loads of tourist information provided was also nice!  The best part about the apartment for us was coming home after a long, hot day and feeling the coolness of the apartment. We stayed here during a few extra hot days and this was great!  We did not meet Rute in person but kept in contact through WhatsApp and chats, she was very helpful and quick to respond. Would absolutely go back here again!
The apartment was very clean and located perfectly for exploring Porto. Communication with Rute was swift and she provided us with nice tips for interesting places around.

Really nice (and recently renovated) place with an incredible location. Just steps away from great restaurants and bars at night, but off to the side on a quiet street. Would highly recommend staying here in you are in Porto.
Such a beautiful flat in such a beautiful city. The host was so patient and easy to contact for any and all questions and the location couldn’t be beat!
We loved our stay at Rute’s place! On a cute street by some great bars and restaurants, about a 20-min walk to the waterfront. Solid apartment that didn’t feel at all like a studio.

Dilia’s place is located in a vibrant part of old Porto.  She left a great summary of local dining/ drinking spots within minutes of apartment.  Her recommendations were excellent!  The apartment is as advertised, super clean, modern apartment.  Check in was easy.

Communication with the hosts was very good, nice location and pleasant apartment. However, the house is made of wood so you could literally hear every step from the people upstairs. But overall is was a decent place and we enjoyed our time there.
This place is the best Airbnb apartment we have ever been to. The location is just perfect. The host is very nice and responsive. The place is stylish and sparkling clean.

The apartment was just what we needed for our long weekend in Porto. It was basic, pretty, and clean, but the best thing for me was the location. It was quiet but not too quiet - still lively enough with cafes and a square just a stone’s throw away, but we weren’t kept up all night with street chatter! Plus it was a very easy and pleasant walk into the busier city centre. So convenient! Ricardo and Cristina were helpful and easy to reach by text or phone call. I highly recommend using their apartment if you’re visiting Porto (and please, if it’s your first visit, go and find a bar or restaurant that plays traditional Fado music - you won’t regret it!!)

The place ticks every box! It’s very near to all the important places that you want to visit; all within walking distance. Apart from that, the flat is equipped for the entire duration of your stay. Highly recommended 🤩

Great place close to Trinidade metro station with direct connection to the airport. We explored Porto on foot for two days. Many attractions, restaurants and grocery stores are within walking distance. The street is quiet at night even though there are bars and restaurants close by.
Lovely place to stay  Perfect location, everything is a short walk away  Hosts were amazing, let us check in slightly early and were very responsive
Great location on a quieter street but still nearby all. Everything was easy and very clean! Rute was friendly, accessible and flexible. Would stay again :)

Great small apartment in the heart of the city. Ideal for couples. We found that this was the best neighborhood in terms of bars and cafes. You can walk to all main attractions easily. 100% recommended!

Came to Porto for the first time as a solo traveller. Rute’s apartment is perfectly located, I walked everywhere I wanted to easily from the apartment. Apartment itself is cozy, I loved that Rute popped her head in to check I got in okay - this was very kind and I felt comfortable. Bed is very comfy too, bathroom was clean and tidy - even has a hairdryer far better than the one I brought with me. Kitchen was equipped with essentials and bonus of a coffee maker.  Also felt very secure and safe despite being alone.  I had a wonderful time, highly recommend the apartment and Rute was a fantastic host 😁

Lovely place! Close to the train station and downtown. The apartment was really nice and clean, but the walls are thin so you can hear your neighbours pretty well;) other than that it’s a pretty good deal!
The apartment is perfect for 2 people! Everything you need is there. The best part was that you could easily walk everywhere from there!

Absolutely loved the stay! Incredible attention to detail which made it feel very special. Very kind to provide a bottle of wine. The place had everything we needed. The hosts were great,  very responsive and friendly and the folder had loads of recommendations.

Celia was a great host and. Sry friendly. We only spent about 12 hours on Porto between flights, so her place was a perfect location. We planned on walking to and from the airport because it seems to be about a five minute walk, but Celia was gracious enough to pick us up at night, and also drop us off the next morning. The room was very comfortable with a nice view of her garden. She also gave us a nice breakfast basket with fresh fruit from her garden. Great place. Would stay here again!
I think this space is very good. It is convenient from the airport. And this owner is very kind and friendly. I had a good stay. Thank you.

Best host ever. She peaked me up at the airport in her car for free and without me requesting it. The place is just as described. Big, with all you may need, privacy etc. It's 5 min by car to the airport or 20 by feet. She gave me breakfast, suggestion and so on. I totally recommend it.

To stay at Celia's Place was the perfect start for my vacation in Portugal! Staying at here place was one of the best experiences I have ever had while using Airbnb. She also picked me up at the airport and arranged a small breakfast! I can strongly recommend staying at Celia's place!

My first airbnb experience and Celia raised the bar very high for my next airbnb experience. Very close to airport and public transport. Clean room and bathroom.  Celia is a caring host who helps you out and makes sure you are fine.

Celia was an awesome host who really gives a lot of thought into the needs of the guests, including picking me up from the airport while it was raining, giving me directions to the airport as I was planning to walk there next day morning, even providing me a light breakfast and helping me to print my boarding pass. Highly recommended!

The place is simply great. It's super close to the airport and it has a wonderful garden to relax and watch the sunrise. Célia was very warm and welcoming. She helped us with everything. Staying at Célias place was like visiting an old friend. We even had a nice breakfast prepared and provided by her.  Don't hesitate to book. I definitely recommend it. If I'm back in Porto I'll come back.
10/10, Excellent stay! Nice, clean and spacious room in a calm neighborhood. Célia is very caring, and was quick to answer everything.

Strong recomendation! Célia is very pleasent person. She helped me with everything. Good clean comfortable place to stay near airport. Delicious bajery is nearby. Colled Confeitaria São Marcos, Rua Guardeiras 313, Maia
We had great stay at Celias place. She picked us up from airport so the check in was super easy. Thank you Celia for warm welcome!

Celia is a very kind and generous lady, a Superwoman! I got lost, and she managed to find me, and helped me with my car hire issues. She will definitely go above and beyond. Her apartment is very nice, and has everything you will need for a nice stay in Porto. It was just a shame my visit was so short.
celia is a really nice and friendly host. and also her flat is nice and cosy.  it was a wonderful stay!

awesome! the Lady is really nice and helps with all the questions one can have. she pickend us up from the airport for free. it‘s also possible to Walk to the Airport (20min) and the Metro  Is very close to Drive to the Beach.

I arrived in Porto in the night and my host picked me up at the airport(for free). She was very accessible and easy to communicate with. Flat was very clean and there was a orange tree in the garden. I could smell the orange and it helped me to sleep well :) she also provided small breakfast. I definitely want to be back for another vacation!
This was a fabulous place to stay, very clean, convenient quiet and relaxed. A great base to explore the city of Porto.
Great one night stay to get off the plane into a quick rest. Célia is soooo super friendly would stay again for sure! Thank you
The host has an amazing hospitality. She prepared us breakfast and the place was nice enough especially it was pretty close to the airport.
Large clean apartments near the airport (25 minutes walk) and Metro (10 minutes walk). Breakfast  included. Célia is a wonderful host, so friendly. Highly recommend this place!
It is a nice house and the room is located at the ground floor with a good view of the garten.  Célia also provides us a nice breakfast, was a nice stay.

Celia's place has everything you need, and more!  It's conveniently located next to the airport, and close to a couple of metro stops.  Above all else, Celia is a fantastic host who was very helpful and welcoming. I won't hesitate in returning for my next trip to Porto.

I had a good stay at Célias place. It's a 20 minutes walk from the airport. The check in was super easy. The garden and the outside area is nice to chill. The toilet and shower is outside and the bed is a little short, but besides that it's a nice place. Thanks for the breakfast! :-)
Celia was more than generous by picking me up from the airport, and of very kind nature.

Célia is a wonderful hostess - kind and welcoming, and she cares for the comfort of her guests.  The room is as advertised, very cozy and warm.  It's also clean and comfortable, and contains a coffee maker and microwave, so if you're tired or just want to go out, you don't have to. There are chairs on the patio to enjoy the peaceful backyard. Although it's close to the airport, the room is quiet and peaceful.
so kind and thoughtful. had breakfast already set out for me and showed me the route to the airport late at night so i could there the next morning. overall perfect host!

If you need somewhere to stay need the airport but still close enough to the metro to get to Porto, this place is PERFECT. I had a very early flight and instead of worrying about finding a taxi, I was able to walk 20 minutes right to the terminal. The space is comfortable and private, everything you may need. Thank you Célia!

Property is walking distance from the airport, room was comfortable. I had to get up at 4 am and they kindly prepared breakfast the night before!  They even told me to let them know if the Uber driver didn't turn up and they would kindly take me to the airport at 4:30 am (Not many people would do this). The bathroom is outside in a separate building but this can be seen in the pictures but was no issue for me. Great value for money and would definitely come back! 5 stars *****

It was so amazing to spend one day there!!!!!  I will never forget Celine and her big heart 🥺  She pick me up from the airport for free and allow to stay much more than I expected  Love and recommendation!

This was the perfect stay near the airport. There was a lot of private space to relax after our long flight.  Every request was responded to immediately. We loved it so much we have rebooked for our August trip back to Porto.
Perfect stay near the airport. Sérgio picked us up from the airport and was very welcoming. Good facilities and spacious would stay again :)
very close to the airport and the metro if yoh want yo head downtown.  second time of staying and look forward to visiting again, thankyou Sergio

This was a fantastic Airbnb and I wish that I was staying longer. I will definitely be rebooking the next time I visit Porto. Everything was clean and spacious, communication was excellent, and the airport pickup and breakfast was above and beyond expectations. I highly recommend!!!

Once again Célia was a wonderful host! She remembered some details about us from our visit two weeks prior, which made the stay even more special. We would recommend Célia's place to anyone who wants to gently ease into Portugal. She goes above and beyond to make sure you feel comfortable and know your surroundings. A+

Célia is a kind person and pro active to know what guests wants in advance. Added she has great tips to roam around Porto and things to try. The place is awesome for a small family and vey near to Metro station. The property is extremely clean and we felt like home. Would definitely recommend the place and I have decided this would be place to stay , whenever we visit Porto.

We only stayed on night at Celia's place before taking an early flight. Everything is as described and Celia was always easy to reach. The airport is very close which was super handy. I can definitely recommend this place.
Very comfortable bad + Orange tree in garden + Terase + Cold ground and not strong heating (the end of November) -
It was my third time staying here, so needless to say - I like it :) I usually stay here when I am flying out of or returning to Porto! The pickup service is outstanding.

It was great!:) easy to reach the train that brings you to the center. Enough space to unbuild the bike and put it to the box. Very convenient from the distance to the airport. Thanks for hosting me!:)
It was absolutely perfect. Very nice people, caring and attentive care and the location was wonderful for me this morning.

The place is like a private extension of the house, you get your private bathroom, access to the garden, a mini kitchen and the room is pretty big with quite a few amenities. The host was kind enough to pick me up from the airport which was very close only a 10 minute short trip, and they provided a small breakfast which was handy. I would recommend to anyone
I had a fantastic stay. The place is very close to the airport and the host is super kind, she came to pick me up very late and also offered a nice, unexpected, breakfast!

Nice flat,near airport ,I was travelling to Germany back my work and it's very close airport,why I'm taking this flat, also not so far 800 mtr intermarche where can buy food,also Aldi near, perfect place rest before travel
Exceptionally friendly host and communication. Perfect for short stays (we are a family of 5 and came late in the evening and left again the next day).

"I had a lovely stay—everything was clean, comfortable, and well-organised. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the atmosphere was peaceful. I’d definitely recommend it and would love to return!"

For my short stay it was absolutely lovely. The scenery and also the proximity to the airport made it an absolute point to choose. The communication was always there with the host. Lovely place definitely recommend it.
Great place near the airport! Great host, she picked us up from the airport and showed us the place ensuring we had everything we needed.
Ana's apartment is really in one of the nicest streets of Porto, close to the oldest parts of the city. She was a very nice host, even helped us to find parking for our car. Lovely stay altogether.
We loved staying in Porto! The apartment is beautiful and extremely well located. Everything was super clean, and there was a metro 5 minutes away. We recommend! Thank you so much, Ana.
Ana is a great host, of a great and clean apartment near the city center of porto. you can walk to the most POI's in a few minutes. we would highly recommend a stay in this apartment!

We enjoyed our stay in Porto. The apartment was clean, located within a short walk from the Porto’s main tourist attractions. The communication with Ana was very good, we were welcomed by Ana’s relative who gave us the keys. In the apartment we found a list of all the recommendations including shops and restaurants close-by. We met Ana for a short while upon our departure and she was very kind. One remark: the pedestrian street where the apartment is located may get loud on Friday and Saturday nights as there are some bars in the area.
Ana's flat was just perfect! Very clean, nicely decorated and perfectly located for our stay in Porto. We absolutely loved it! Highly recommended!

Really nice apartment in a beautiful position, near to Clerigos tower, night life quarter, shops and restaurants but in a quiet and nice pedestrian street, Ana has been really nice and helpful, everything was perfect!

The apartment was clean, open, big and very light. There were big windows and you have a tiny space/balcony to look outside. The bedroom/living room is very spaceous and the bathroom is very nice. The kitchen as well. However the street noice is annoying. So you have to close the windows and use the airfan as air conditioning. Also the cleaning lady comes in to the apartment un announced which is a bit weird if you are home at that time. The wifi didn't work properly but Ana tried to fix it. The communication with Ana was great. We were greeted by her brother in law and he was a very nice person. Ana leaves behind a little note with recommendations. I would recommend this apartment!

We had such a great time in this wonderful appartement. The flat is exactly as it looks in the pictures. Very comfortable and has everything you need. The district is very good and you can reach the city centre by walking. Ana is great hosts - Top recommendation!
The appartement was perfect ! Very central, cute, clean ! I didnt see Ana but i was in communication with her all my stay she has good advices :)  Thanks for all Ana !

Amazing place to stay for our short 4 day visit in Porto! Definitely recommended to others but be sure to bring earplugs as it can be loud in the evening outdoors and the soundproofing doesn't cut out the noise enough. Ana and her husband were very quick at responding to our questions and amazing hosts who provided us with some greta places to check out.

Amazing location, me & my girlfriend like going out late night, the area is safe full of life during the day and night (enough noise for people who like nightlife), downstairs cafe for quick and fast breakfast. We enjoy hot temperatures during August, the fan provided was enough for me & my girlfriend.
It was a great stay! I would definitely came back! Charming apartment, charming host, charming city!

I spent a lovely weekend at Ana’s place and it was great. Location is Central, the apartment is clean and you have everything you need close to supermarket, cafes, restaurants, the touristic spots. The communication was fast. I was allowed to check in earlier than planned as my flight was early in the morning. The apartment is highly recommended

Mateus made us feel very welcome and was kind enough to wait for us at the apartment when we got delayed. The apartment is very nice. It is located on the second floor. There was coffee, tea and water available. The apartment was clean and spacious. The bathroom a little small but this did not bother us.  The apartment is wel located with plenty off shops and restaurants nearby. Although on a shopping street inside the apartment it is quiet. Communication with Mateus was easy! We would recommend it!

This apartment was a gem, good value for money, great location - very central, clean and lovely flat! Mateus was an amazing host, very communicative and was always ready to help if we needed anything. We would 100% stay again and we really enjoyed our time in Porto :)

Highly recommend this cute 1 bedroom in Porto! The location was fantastic and within walking distance to most tourist places, shopping, groceries, and laundry. The apartment was clean, airy, and relaxing. Thank you for the great accommodations during our stay in Porto!

Perfect place for two! Great location, just outside the louder main city center and 10 min walk from a beautiful park and the cool local art gallery area - everything is very walkable (max 15 mins to the bridge). We enjoyed the little grocery on the street. The host was very responsive and helpful

This appartement is really nice and charming ! Located in the best area of Porto, you'll find everything you need from restaurants to shops. Joao gave us great tips to enjoy the city and is always available if you need anything.

João was a friendly and flexible host. Just when we arrived he had a map of Porto ready and showed us the main spots but also his favorite restaurants which are no tourist traps (we tried some if them and all served really delicious food). The flat is located perfectly just to get to know Porto by bike. And just next to the entrance of the flat was a bicycle shop where you could rent bikes.

Ana’s place is just like the pictures, high ceilings which is a must when the temperature rises. It was very clean and has everything you need (++ for the coffee machine). You have everything nearby including good pastelaria to get your pasteis de nata in the morning. Mateus was a really responsive host and it was a very easy checkin and checkout. Would highly recommend this place for your stay in Porto!

This place was fantastic and super functional for our Porto experience. Mateus and the hosts were very attentive and proactive with their suggestions and assistance. The apartment is in a great location which is close to restaurants, bars, major sights, parks and public transport. It was clean and had all the ammenities you need + there’s a inexpensive laundromat nearby if you need.  Definitely recommend this place to anyone staying in Porto.

Great place to stay in Porto in a central location and walkable to tourist sights, shops, restaurants, cafes, bars etc. We were met at the unit by the host who was very communicative and friendly who helped us with our luggage when checking in. He was quick to respond to any other issues we had and also checked up on us periodically which was nice.  The flat was actually more spacious than we thought and has lot of place for storage as well as a full kitchen which came in handy. The small balconies were nice and the windows shut out all sound despite being on a busier street. I could forsee the flat being a little hot in summer but there was a great box fan provided which helped. The flat could maybe use an ironing board and once or twice the hot water in the shower ran out quite quickly but otherwise a comfortable place to stay in Porto. Thanks!

it was such a perfect appartement in porto. superclean, it really smelled quiet fantastic and the furnishing was supercute and comfortable. i've found everything what i needed - even more than that. i felt like a queen : ) mateus was also really nice and friendly. thank you so, so much for this wonderful place!

beautiful,  wide open, wooden staircase to access apartment on the 2nd floor. would not be good for someone with mobility issues. the only thing missing was a washing machine but we had clear instructions for local laundry services and could easily hand wash and there was a drying rack. Would highly recommend this apartment, local groceries and restaurants and easy access to  Portos sites. Our hosts son, Mateus was very responsive to our communication.

Had an excellent stay.  Apartment was a perfect base and well located we did everything by foot.  There are loads of restaurants close by.  Mateus was a great host, great communication and even allowed us to drop our cases early. A great place to stay and recommend. Thanks again  Tim

Fantastic location. Charming, rustic and very clean apartment with an incredibly welcoming, helpful host. Joao has great recommendations on activities and restaurants, so be sure to get them in advance so you can secure reservations at Porto's best eateries and plan your time accordingly. Located in an old quaint building, the apartment is equipped with space heaters. If you are visiting in the middle of winter, you might be a little cold. Otherwise, a great apartment!

I stayed in this apartment together with three of my friends to enjoy a long weekend in Porto. The apartment has a very central location from which you can walk everywhere and it is a very lively neighborhood. The apartment was nice and spacious and had everything we needed for our stay. Joao was very friendly, gave a lot of good tips about the area and was easy to reach for questions.
João's apartment was fantastic! Perfect location, extremely clean and João was very helpful throughout. Thank you so much.
Nice place in the middle of old town. Great host who share tips and trick with us.Would definitely return.
The host was very helpful and went out of his way to provide us with recommendations. Great location and spacious flat, right in the heart of it all.
Joao was a fantastic host who gave us plenty of great tips which really made our stay in Porto a great experience. The apartment was very clean and well maintained in a great area.
We have a great time. Mateus was very attentive and kind.  appartement as description, good for a few days. Well located.

The hosts were very helpful and communicative. The flat suited my needs perfectly and I had a comfortable and enjoyable two weeks in Porto! The location was ideal for getting about the city, and the flat was clean, cozy and felt secure. Thanks to Ana and Mateus!

Comfortable, nicely renovated apartment, perfectly located to discover the UNESCO protected old quarter of Porto. The host was extremely pleasant and helpful, and offered great suggestions to discover Porto (obrigado Joao!).
