After making ourselves comfortable we got a call from joão that we are in the wrong appartement and that we have to move to another appartement at a different floor. We were not very amused since we all were supertired and the new app didn't have a balcony like it was said in the description. Besides that everything was really great. It was very clean and very well equipped (everything's there for cooking) the location can't be better and the host is supernice and provided us with helpful information. All in all a definite recommendation!
Joao's apartment is right in the centre of old town Porto and as such is a fantastic base for exploring beautiful Porto. Lovely, clean and spacious we enjoyed our night there and would book again.

That’s a lovely apartment, beware that it looks a bit bigger and more impressive on photos though! The shower is quite old and the entry to bedrooms is from the living room - so not ideal if you travel with kids. The kitchen is well equipped. The location is ideal. I think this apartment is perfect for a group of friends or a couple but would not recommend to a family with young children.

Accommodation to avoid when traveling with children. Poorly equipped  in the bathroom and in the kitchen. Completely without any  furnitures to hold things, there isn’t a coat rack  or a shelf in which to place a  little beauty-case. It's nice to look at, but very impractical with children.

This stylish apartment is really central but quiet, and it is very clean. Heating is not part of the price but João offered heating for extra cost which was necessary in January and kept the apartment nice and warm. João made sure everything was okay throughout our stay. I would come back again if I come back to Porto! Thank you João :)

So much is within walking distance. I only stayed one night; would have been a great base to explore for a few days. I was able to pop down the block and find a nice casual spot for dinner, and walk to São Bento in the morning.

Nice flat in the center of Porto, just 8 minutes from the metro. João gave us a bunch of tips of nice places to visit. A lot of them are just in 10 minutes walking distance, the other can be reached by bike that can be rent near the apartment.

Great apartment in central location. Our host was very quick to respond and happy to help with any questions. Nicely decorated interior. Only comment to note is it is up a few flights of stairs which is worth noting with a lot of luggage. We would recommend this apartment!
Joao's is a nice apartment in the very heart of Porto, an ideal base to discover the city. Joao gave us all the informations we needed to make it to the apartment.
The apartment is on the perfect location. The only drawback is that there is not free heating. We had a mouse on the house, but Joao solves the problem quickly.
The flat was as advertised in the photos, very good location, a bit cold now in winter-heating cost extra.

We really enjoyed our stay at João’s apartment! He was always so quick to respond and very helpful. We asked for an iron and he brought it over almost straight away, which we were grateful for. The location is amazing: can recommend the wine bar across the road and the chocolate shop up the street :)  We didn’t cook in the flat at all so can’t comment on that, but the living room is beautiful and the beds are super comfy.  Thanks João

I recommend this apartment, well located, in a quite peacefull street. Located in the old Porto, close to the Sé by feet (5min). The place was clean and tidy, beds were good quality.  João answered quickly to all my questions. He is a really polite guest who gave us advices about Porto.

This flat is in the perfect location to see Porto! We only had 3 nights but were able to get easily to anywhere from the area. There is a small grocery store a 1 min walk away which had everything we needed. Despite the hot weather the flat cooled off at night and the area was quiet enough to sleep with the windows open.

We had a great time at João's place. He can be described as a very hostile person who gave us a great introduction to the city of Porto after arrival, and kept in close contact during our stay if everything was ok.  The apartment itself was perfect. It's location in the middle of the old town is perfect, with everything in walking distance. Furthermore it is quite spacious, and nicely furnished. It is a great place to discover the city of Porto, and feel at home right away.

Lovely apartment located just a few minutes walk into the heart of the city. The apartment itself was extremely clean and is perfect for a few days stay, despite the central location it’s situated off a small side street, so it’s extremely quiet at night. João was on hand to ensure we had everything we needed and provided some recommendations for us during our stay. There is loads of amenities nearby and a great wine bar across the street, serving local produce. We really enjoyed our stay here and would most definitely recommend as a base to explore Porto.
The house is very comfortable, the location is excellent and João was Super helpful and available to help us on whatever we needed. I would definitely come back and recommend this apartment.

We had an amazing stay at the apartment. The communication and checking in was great and clear. The apartment was very clean and looked very good. The location is superb and within a few minutes of walking you are in the city center. Overal an amazing stay!

Recommend to opt for heating during winter times as it can get quite cold at night. Otherwise, very central location, walking distance to most part of the city. 5 minute walk to a good breakfast place on flower street, 15 to the harbour side for some fantastic seafood.

This dude is dodgey AF. Adds like loads of charges afterwards for things like heat. What next, did I breathe too much and need an oxygen bill? Save yourself the hassle and deal with someone with dignity.

Everything was great! Super comfy beds, perfect area, easy check-in. Joao was really friendly and responsive :) definitely a great value for a 2 bedroom.  Only thing was the internet was very slow, so if you are expecting to work from your computer it may be difficult.

we had a fab stay in this appartment! just the right size for me and my mum mum. Absolulety superb location. Just round the corner from fab restaurants and from the river front. And about 10 mins walk to the train station. Highly recommended!
The apartment has a great location but it is very limited with amenities. The apartment can be very noisy at night.
everything in the apartment was great! the check in process was smooth and the location was amazing.  João was super responsive and provided really great recommendations in the area.
Brilliant place in the city centre of Porto. Lots of restaurants and shops in walking distance. The apartment was bigger then we expected. Check in was super easy and João was a great host!
Perfect location and host for visiting Porto.   The appartement is great and include everything you need. I would comeback anytime ! Thanks João for everything.
Great location with lots of good restaurants nearby and close to the river. Joao was very communicative and sent lots of recommendations prior to our arrival. Wonderful host!

We had a fantastic stay at João’s place in Porto! The apartment is very spacious, stylish and comfortable, so it was perfect for a weekend in the city. The area was central to everything we wanted to do and there are some great bars and restaurants nearby. Would highly recommend!

We found João to be one of the best - very quick to respond and help, he's in Porto, so you are dealing with him, not an agent. The location is perfectly placed on the steep hill of Porto, being a short wander down to the river, and not to far into the town - you'd get a better view from the window on the river front, but we've been there before, and were happier having a shorter walk up the hill, whilst still being in a great location. Can't speak highly enough of Porto, we'll be back.

Fantastic spot in the heart of Porto! Perfect walking distance to everywhere we wanted to go to in Porto. João was super helpful and attentive - sending great recommendations and advice. Would definitely come back to stay here again - perfect for 3/4 people - especially for two couples! Very spacious.

Awesome location, super responsive host, overall great value for money! The place was perfect for a family of 4 (2+2), the kitchen was well equipped.  Highly recommended and would stay there again ourselves next time we visit Porto!
Great, well located apartment for exploring Porto. The immediate area could be noisy at night but generally close to everything and a good base
Perfect location and apartment for our stay in Porto. Joao sent tons of information and recommendations and we had zero issues. Would stay again!
We stayed at João's accommodation for two nights and we had a great stay! It's really in the heart of everything.
João was very responsive and his place was a perfect accommodation for my group of 5. Let us check in early which was very appreciated. Place was clean and comfortable.
It was an amazing experience to stay in his apartment! He's a really nice guy, he gave us a lot of advices for the city! I really recommend him! Thank you for everythin

A nice apartment in a great location, clean, functional and accommodated our family of 3 really well. Pedro is a lovely host, he spent so much time sharing where we should go, he should work for the tour agencies! Thank you Pedro
Lovely flat with a stunning view over the river. Only a short walk from the old town and conveniently close to the port cellars! Pedro gave us lots of useful information and tips on where to go.

The property is in a great location with a fantastic view of Porto and the river.  A short walk takes you to the Vila da Gaia riverfront or into Porto.  Pedro is a wonderful host who was incredibly welcoming and helpful. The only down-side was the multiple flights of stairs to access the apartment.

Pedro's place was great! Big, clean and with amazing tarrace. We found everything we needed. It's just 10 minutes by walk to the river side and a few minutes to metro station.  Pedro is very helpful and kind person. He visited us to check if everything is alright and if we need anything. We spent a fantastic time in his apartment and for sure back there next time.

Porto is so shockingly beautiful, but you need a guy like Pedro to understand it is not just the natural beauty, it's also the people and the atmosphere that make it so amazing. Pedro is everything you would need from a host -  friendly, positive, and has deep knowledge about everything in Porto. Thanks to him we saw the best of the city (on foot) in just 24h, and we even had time for a great seafood diner in a local restaurant. All the rooms including the bathroom and the kitchen are very spacious so you don't feel squeezed. It is nicely furnished and very clean too ... and then you get the view - right at your doorstep you have a view of the river, the old town, the bridges. It's not just a place to stay, it is a miradouro! If you don't know that word - just go to Porto, and see Pedro, we will surely return some day!

If you decide to choose this apartment it will be the best choice. So I recommend it for everybody. Pedro was very kind, helpful. He gave many advice what to visit in Porto. Pedro's apartment is very cosy, as well as in great location with amazing view.

Pedro's appartment is exquisitely well located on the south bank of the city. The walk from there to the river offers a spectacular view on the old city, the river, the boats, the impressive Dom Luis bridge, and you find yourself in a few minutes in one of the prime touristic areas of the city, filled with merchant's souvenirs stands, cafés and restaurants.  The appartment is welcoming, roomy, comfortable and well equipped. Communication with Pedro was pleasant, indications were clear, access to the appartment utterly easy.  Only downside, the touristic area isn't quite so car-friendly (traffic can be busy during day-time and parking lots full, with backed-up lines), and the expected parking lot nearby was under construction and unavailable. Just be aware and organize consequently. Other than that, I highly recommend staying there, the location is fantastic.
Wondeful location and easy check in procedure. The flat is large but a bit damp and smelly.

Pedro and his apartment were both awesome. Great location and space, and Pedro was the best host I could ask for. I had tickets shipped to the apartment while I was there and Pedro went out of his way to make sure I got the tickets on time and was very welcoming.

Pedro is a delightful host, he collected us from the airport, waited patiently while we dealt with lost luggage. He spent the time to give us useful information on places to eat, metro and train stops, and mapped out a walking tour through the city. The apartment is spacious, and has all the necessary amenities, including a washing machine and dishwasher. Pedro arranged an extra bed and brought our luggage to the apartment, once the airline tracked it down and delivered it. Last, but not least: the view across the river to Porto is magnificent and let's one enjoy all the moods of the river, sunrise, sunset, mist rolling in and out. Porto is a beautiful city to visit.

This was such a great trip from start to finish. Pedro was quick to respond and offer suggestions as soon as I contacted him. He picked us up at the airport despite our plane being delayed and the apartments at My Riverplace are the perfect base to explore Porto. Pedro took us on a guided tour the next day and included a fantastic lunch in a lovely restaurant that had people queuing to get in. He showed us the best Port shop in Porto and gave some excellent recommendations for dinner. I can’t recommend Pedro and his apartments enough for a short city break.

Comfortable, clean accommodation with everything we needed for our 5-night stay.  We enjoyed sampling the port and appreciated Pedro's helpful tips and recommendations.  A lovely location, so convenient for the Metro and Dom Luis bridge for quick trips across the river into Porto.  Sorry we couldn't stay longer.

Exactly what we needed. I loved that there was an iron and a hairdryer to make life easier. This location was also very easy to get to, quiet, and close to all of the things we wanted to do. The only time we needed an Uber was to get to and from the train station. Otherwise, we were able to walk everywhere we went. I loved Pedro’s list of things to do. We did them! We loved the view and absolutely LOVED Porto!

We stayed at Pedro’s place for two days and we didn’t want to leave. It’s an amazing location with a terrific view to the city. The apartment is very clean and comfortable and it has everything needed for a pleasant stay.
Pedro's place is perfect for your stay in Porto. Very well located near the bridge and with a beautifull terrace. He gave us some good recommendations and it was very easy to communicatie with him!
The location of this apartment is superb. Very clean, tidy and with a welcoming bottle of Port. 10/10 would recommend!

As it is mentioned by Pedro, the location is truly strategic! If you stay in this place, I feel you don't have to go anywhere! The most amazing and famous view is right in front of the door. We enjoyed our evening tea in the common balcony. My little kid was so happy climbing the stairs and playing in the balcony. And Pedro is a super host and I don't have to praise other categories. Highly recommended.
Very beautiful and clean accomodaiton, however, very bad air in the whole flat and not really good air condition.  Anyway, the view is amazing and Porto as well.

Great place and location (crazy view!). Look as good as the pictures! Communication with Pedro was easy and he was quick to reply, and offered good recommendations. The check in process was smooth as well Recommend the place!

Pedro’s apartment was a perfect place to stay for our trip to Porto. The rooms were spacious, and the location is very convenient and in a quiet yet central spot. Pedro is a very friendly host who provided us a lots of recommendations.

Pedro's place is at an awesome location with beautiful views! The place is very clean and spacious, the bed is comfortable and there is even a washing machine in the kitchen. The only thing is that there are only two small windows (on in the living room and one in the kitchen) and there is no cross ventilation, no windows in the bedroom or bathroom at all. Besides that, it is a fantastic place and we can highly recommend it! It is an quick (but steep) walk down to the river and very close to the bridge.

The place is as you can see it in the pictures and the host is really kind and available throughout the entire process. Great hospitality with many nice details. I would definitely recommend to stay there!
Great host, great place, great stay, but what is beautiful ends soon.  I recommend this place in every respect - location, hospitality and of course the PEDRO host (he will always help and advise)

This is the perfect place to explore Porto and Gaia from. Amazing location within walking distance to all. Great view across the River to see all of Porto. Spacious, clean, well equipped. We will definitely stay again next time we are in Porto!

Pedro was a great host and always responsive and helpful. The stay is in a convenient location  The actual house felt slightly different than the pictures. lack of windows in the rooms felt a little stuffy.
Fantastic spot in a perfect location, very responsive host and we followed his itenery and toured Porto and it was perfect. Would come again.

The place was perfect for our trip. Always clear and detailed instructions from the host. Lots of information provided and shuttle service available for early flights. The place itself was spacious, well equipped and a great location. Very easily walkable for us. Would definitely recommend it overall!
Pedro was super helpful, responsive, and the place was great - cool view of the river.

What a spot!  The location somehow manages to be steps from the restaurant and vendor scene by the river and at the same time feel like a peaceful oasis where the city can't get to you. Everything was perfect with our stay from the optional transfer from the airport, to a great talk on local history and recommendations, to the actual physical space itself.  And the views - wow.  You'll be gazing from the heights of the Gaia neighborhood across the river to old town Porto.  We loved Pedro's place and would stay there again without question.
Very central, many things are reachable by foot and clean apartment. Pedro is one of the friendliest hosts we had!

Pedro was a great host.  Very helpful and responds quickly to messages. Had lots of tips and advice about transportation to and from the air bnb. Location was great and within walking distance to downtown Porto. Place was very clean.
One of the most beautiful place in Portugal  and Pedro is exceptional as a host. Great to know you Pedro and thank you for all the support provided during our stay in Porto 😊

Good base to explore Porto. Spacious interiors.  Very well equipped.  We struggled a bit with light , heat and ventilation- there is 1 small window for the living area and bedroom and this is on a walkway. So for privacy you keep the blind down but then you have no natural light.  You also can’t keep the window open so we found the apartment got very hot and stuffy.  All other aspects of the apartment, and stay were good.  Thanks Pedro for the port and assistance during our stay !

Pedro's place was a great place to stay for our 4 day visit.  Quiet area for sleeping, but easily walkable and close to all Porto has to see. There is a carpark down the hill near the bridge where you can leave your car and come and go as often as you want for reasonable cost (we drove to the North for a day excursion one day, also very beautiful).  The home was clean and plenty of space for us.  Pedro was very responsive and made some great suggestions. One thing to keep in mind is that there are three flights of stairs down to the apartment from the road.  Thanks again Pedro, I will definitely stay again if I come back to Porto.
Pedro was quick and easy to deal with.. place was clean and easy to find. Close to everything.. bars, resultant t’s clubs.. it’s a walk.. but the city is on a hill so I lu can expect any different
Thoroughly enjoyed stay and apartment. Wonderful location easily accessible to restaurants and attractions. Pedro was great and kind host.

This apartment had a superb view over to Porto old town and was close to all the attractions on the Gaia side of the river. Pedro was an excellent host providing us with lots of helpful tips and a wonderful transfer service. Thanks again Pedro, you're the best

Highly recommend! Wow! Where to start!  The room itself is absolutely stunning, comfortable and very spacious. Waking up to the sunrise outside the window was something to look forward to everyday as well as the view over the river just amazing!  The kitchen is well equipped and the bathroom just beautiful  Everything about our stay was perfect! As for our host the BEAUTIFUL TINA, she took us under her wing as though we were her family from the very beginning. She really made us feel at home. Her kind and caring nature as well as extreme generosity made us really feel like we were in a "home away from home." Dont think twice just book and Tina will welcome you with open arms.
This was my first experience with airBnB and i am really happy. Porto is a beautiful place and Tina is an amazing person. Her house il beautiful.i hope the best for her :)
Highly recommend this host! Tina is the warmest person in the world. We felt like home, and she was helpful and friendly. I wish more hosts were like her.

My experience with Tina was absolutely amazing. I loved spending time with her and the location of her apartment has the  best view! She was so helpful and gracious, I will never forget my time in Porto thanks to her!! Definitely one of the most genuine and caring people I have met!

Tina is more than helpful at ensuring you have a hassle-free stay.  The place is great, with the only (slight) down side being that that part of the city has less public transportation than one might want. But your host will be more than eager to help over come this :)
Tina is great lady and the place is perfect for trips both on the beach and to the centre. Porto is beautifull even in bad weather and I warmly recommend you to see it.
Great location in between city and beach, both easily reachable with public transport. Tina gave lots of helpful local tips regarding food and places to see as well as walking routes within Porto.

Had a great stay at Tina’s Airbnb. Tina was very friendly and sent us great recommendations about what to do in Porto. It’s a 50 minute walk to the Porto city center, but it’s by the river and scenic.  I can recommend!

I am very glad I could stay at Tina’s place. She makes sure that your stay is comfortable and provides many good local recommendations.   Her place is also easy to reach. I would definitely recommend her place!

Tina is a great person. The suggestions she gave me about the places to visit were okay. The place was clean, tidy and quiet. She was very kind. I'd recommend Tina's place if you're planning to stay in Porto.
Tina was very welcoming and  communication was very responsive and helpful. The accommodation had a mini market and bus stops right outside and was an easy walk to the sea and river.

Tina was such a great host. She welcomed me right from my arrival and gave me a list of recommendations for Porto. The room was clean, the view was incredible, and the overall stay was very comfortable. I highly recommend staying with Tina.

Tina is really nice and friendly. She even allowed me to check out a bit later so I could finish working. The room was spacious and clean, and I loved the view of the river. The bathroom was shared, but it was always available and clean, so it was comfortable. The location isn’t very central, but it’s well connected via public transport, and the neighborhood is quiet and safe.

We had a wonderful stay at Tina’s place — it truly felt like a home away from home. Tina was incredibly warm and welcoming, and she shared plenty of great recommendations to help us make the most of our time in Porto. Her hospitality made our trip even more enjoyable and she  has a very lovely dog that likes to cuddle :) Would definitely recommend!

Tina was a very friendly host and sent us a lot of recommendations. Her dogs are also very cute! Unfortunately, during our stay, there was both a heat wave and low tide so opening the window would let in a sewage-like smell. Tina graciously provided a fan outside of the listed accommodations, which made things a little better, but we found ourselves in a catch-22 situation of having either a hot or smelly room. Combined with the slight smoke and dog smells, it was a bit hard to sleep at night. Overall, however, it was a very peaceful and convenient location. There’s a grocery store nearby, and it’s easy to walk to both the Porto city center and to the seaside.
Overall is OK Location is well, although a bit noisy Baby equipment was excellent Bathrooms  are a bit mouldy Parking situation is well
This apartment is spotless, spacious and very well appointed.  Matched photos and Maria Jose was super helpful. I would stay there again!

Catarina's apartment was the perfect choice for us as it has great location and was spacious enough for four adults. The apartment was comfortable, clean and well-equipped and not least had a great view. Catarina's father, Antonio was super helpful and he could speak just enough English so he could explain us everything and shown us around a bit. I could only recommend to stay at Catarina's place :)

This place is perfect. We felt like in our home. It is in a good location and we really experinced a wonderful vacation. The appartment was very clean and had all we need. We recomend this place. Thank you catarina and antonio. Obrigado
Excellent appt.all the space to be confortable . extremely well located and a great welcome talk with antonio.  we highly recommend it
The apartment is very spacious in every aspect. Catarina and Antonio were extremely helpful with recommendations and accommodation inquiries. We loved Porto and staying in this apartment!

Catarina’s home was a great place for our month long trip to Portugal.  The apartment has all that you need for a short or long stay. The transport to and from the airport was particularly thoughtful.  The quick access to the metro stop is a must to get around the city.  We bought a monthly metro pass which I think would be worth it for even a two week stay instead of having to deal with purchasing tickets for individual daily trips. The pass includes metro and bus.  We still walked a lot!  Catarina and Antonio were very responsive if we needed anything.  We absolutely enjoyed our stay!

Super apartment great location Metro close by. Super market short walk away. Fabulous view. Very quiet at night. Everything as advertised or better .  Take advantage of the transfer service from airport or train station. We would definitely stay here again.

The check-in experience was one of the best we ever had: Antonio was waiting for us at the airport and drove us straight to the apartment while giving all kinds of tips for our stay (being a local to Porto). The apartment itself was very spacious and could easily fit our family of four (we have one toddler and one baby), including two modern bathrooms. There are two elevators which came in handy to bring everything up. There were also some thoughtful amenities, like a trolley to go to the supermarket. The apartment is also well connected to the city: it is within 1 minute of a metro stop, there is a taxi rank right behind the little chapel uphill, and also some main bus lines within easy walking distance. Overall we would recommend anyone to stay here!
I loved the place, amazing view over porto, quiet street and beautiful apartment. The communication and check-in process was perfect. I highly recommend the place and will come again.

The place is very large and well-fitted. Two lovely balconies, a washing machine, a full kitchen, two bathrooms, all very clean. Antonio was a lovely host, he even picked me up from the airport and told me all about Porto before dropping me at the Airbnb. The location is perfect, about a 15 minute walk from the start of the historic center, literally 1 minute from a metro station that will take you to the airport or the train station, but still in a very quiet area. Highly recommend.

Highly recommend! The apartment was clean, very spacious and had an amazing balcony. Antonio picked us up from the airport and dropped us off as well. He gave us plenty of local restaurants to try and overall he gave our stay a nice personal touch.

Great apartment with a great view in a great location - just 2 mins walk from metro  Host was so helpful - even picked us up from the airport and showed us where things were in the area. Much appreciated !

Catarina and Antonio's apartment was absolutely lovely with every amenity you could think of. The place was spotless and just as described. Antonio was the perfect host and had also arranged to pick us up and drop us off at Porto airport.  Our hosts also gave us lovely recommendations about local shops, cafes, restaurants and local tourist spots.  I have no hesitation in recommending Catarina and Antonio's gorgeous apartment.
Our host told us everything wa had to know about Porto and helped us plan our weekend. Very nice introduction to porto.
We had an extraordinary time in Porto.  The flat is central with everything next to it.  We recommended this place and Manuela is very kind.  Thanks again !!! Emily and romain
Manuela's apartment was conveniently located.  It was very clean.  Manuela was responsive to my communication and needs when we arrived. We recommend her place if you are in Porto.

That apartment was clean, centrally located and the availability to store our luggage at the store below was very helpful. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend the apartment. The host went above and beyond in getting us reservations for dinner. Thank you kindly!
It's the best location, thank you for the host's consideration. If I travel to Portugal, I will stay here again.

Manuela is the top! A warm welcome with lots of relevant infos. She did an excellent reference booklet with lots of interesting information for people who want to explore Porto. The apartment is very well equipped and very well located too...in the heart of the city. Could not recommend more...
Location is great. Very central. We stayed for 3 nights. Family of 5. With  the public park near the apartment,  we didnt used the car. Great restaurants near by . Apartment was well kept and modern.

Great spot to stay in Porto. Nice and central to all there is to see. Great hosts that make sure you are well catered for. Great communication offering suggestions to restaurants and things to do and see. Make sure you visit Loja Das Conservas, next door for a bite to eat.  Good value, I would recommend.
Fantastic place right in the heart of Porto. Wonderful, helpful, and accommodating host did everything to make my stay enjoyable. Thank you.

This super cute apartment is located steps outside of the Sao Bento train/metro station. Very lovely neighborhood with many choices for dining and entertainment. Marta was so helpful, she even made us reservations at one of her favorite restaurants. We had an amazing stay! Highly recommend!

The place and how it’s is located is simply wonderful. We had an amazing time enjoying the city and after long walk around the city we had a place to rest and recharge batteries. Highly recommend this place and I am sure me and my family will come back :)
Beautiful apartment and the location was right in the centre. Manuela was also very accommodating with our check in. Highly recommend this place!
Excellent location! It’s on a busy street but the windows were really good at keeping out the noise. Very comfortable apartment

We have arrived early in the morning and Manuela did her best to accomodate us earlier. The apartment is clean, has equiped kitchen, laundry. the location is excellent - walking distance to Ribeira. Many restaurants and a small grocery are around, and an underground parking is around the corner. Manuela provides very helpful info about local attractions, "out of bitten path" restaurants , and Marta, her associate, is around during the daytime to provide help and assistance. We enjoyed our stay, thank you.

The place is extremely convenient to get around the downtown area. The hosts are very friendly and informative. The guide books has provided great tips where to go and what to do.  We enjoyed the stay!
Great location, walkable to historical sights and many restaurant/shops. Bed was comfortable and street noise was drowned out by closing the window door panels. Would stay there again.
Our stay at the apartment was fantastic! The location is unrivalled, and the hosts were very welcoming and communicative. Would definitely recommend.

We had a great stay, very central but surprisingly very quiet for the city center.  The possibility to leave the luggage before/after checkin/checkout is a great plus. We'd definitely come back again in our next trip to Porto.

Great location within walkable distance to most Porto attractions , very interesting restaurants recommendations  . Last not least very nice appt well decorated and very clean. Will completely recommend . Thanks Manuela

Manuela’s place is located at the perfect location! The river is just a few minutes away, along with cultural sites, restaurants and stores.  The apartment is beautiful, very clean and spacious. I loved the view. I can’t wait to go back to Porto and stay at Manuela’s flat again!

The apartment’s location couldn’t be better in visiting Porto. The place was well remodeled, with soundproof windows and kept its original charm (high-ceilings). It was spotlessly clean and had all the amenities for a short stay. The host (Manuela) sent us easy to follow checkin instructions and was always proactive and available.  The apartment is on the 2nd floor and has no elevator - the listing makes it clear, but make sure you know it’s quite an effort if you have any heavy luggage with you.  Finally, and unrelated to the quality of the apartment, don’t bring a car with you (we did…). You won’t need it in Porto, and if you park at the nearby Cardosas parking, it will cost you 36 Euro per night without in/out privileges. Some of the previous guest comments are not right.  Anyway, great place, great host. Highly recommended!!!
Just be aware the washer/dryer is not in the unit or free to use, but rather in the building for a fee. Not a huge problem, but just need to be aware. Everything else was fantastic.

Nice spacious and comfortable apartment. There is a lift for those that cannot manage stairs. We did not prepare any meals, but the kitchen is well equipped for doing so. Located in a residential neighborhood and a short walk to the tourist areas, restaurants, and groceries. Walk to Porto Campanha train station in under 20 minutes. Metro stop (Heroismo) is close by if you do not want to walk from the train station. Host, Isabel, was extremely helpful and communicated frequently with us. Isabel's informative introduction to Porto allowed us to make the most of our short time in Porto.

Hands down the best hospitality we have ever received. Isabel is so wonderful. She met us for late check in, she spent some time with us showing us around Porto and giving us recommendations on what to do and eat which all were great. The apartment was sparkling clean, very spacious for our week stay and fast WiFi which is very important for us since we work virtually and need a reliable internet. Porto is a beautiful city but Isabel and her apartment made it even more memorable for us.  Oh and it’s in a great location. We walked everywhere.

Isabel's place is a great located and well equipped place to stay in porto. Isabel was very welcoming, kind and very helpful giving suggestions for places to eat and to sightsee. I can not recommend enough.

We had such a good time at Isabel's cozy appartment in Porto. Clean and comfy all allround and fully stocked with Isabels travelling recommendations. The location is splendid in a nice and quiet neighbourhood close to the city center. A great place to stay,  a welcoming and entusiastic host as well as all the advice we could ever have wished for. 10/10 - we would come again!

Isabel was a super friendly host! :) She was really kind and always there when we needed something. We spent a wonderful trip at her apartment! It’s away from the touristic center (very quiet), but close enough to do everything by walking. The appartment had everything we needed and was super clean! The bathroom is freshly renovated with a nice shower too. We also loved all the cats from the neighbourhood! The grocery store is also very close (pingo doce). Would reserved there again for sure! This is the kind of experience that make you appreciate Airbnb! :)

We absolutely loved our time in Porto, and this apartment was a big reason why! The location is perfect — close to lovely cafes and restaurants, the centre of the city and everything you might need, including 2 supermarkets. The apartment was spotless, cozy, and had all the comforts for a longer stay, from a well-equipped kitchen to 2 comfy beds. But the real highlight was our amazing host — such a warm, kind, and caring person. She helped us with so many things, shared great tips about the city, and truly made us feel like we were visiting a friend’s home rather than a rental. We left with full hearts and wonderful memories, and we’d happily stay here again in a heartbeat! Thank you very much for your hospitality, Isabel!

We were a group of 8 friends staying at Catarina's & Alexandra's place. The apartment was exactly what we needed, very well located and super comfortable. The communication with them was very easy and they were very helpful all the time, from our arrival to our departure.  We had a great weekend in Porto and we will definitely come back to Aida's Haven.
Alexandra provides a google map of Porto and all of her recommendations for food, shopping, culture. It was so useful and such a great idea for Airbnb hosts to utilize.
Big light apartment in great place near old town. Very hospitable owner, gave us a lot of excellent advice on the city. We enjoyed meeting her and stay in the apartment!!!

The flat was exactly as expected and the welcome from Catarina was the absolute best. We would recommend this place to anyone coming to Porto!  The terrace was beautiful and the flat was super clean with everything you would need. Catarina was there to greet us and spent time to go through the best attractions and restaurants in the area, even helping to book a table at a great restaurant on our first night since we were a big group.
We loved the place. Great for working remotly !  Is really close by to restaurants and to city centrum.

beautiful apartment with terrace and views. walkable to all areas. excellent space for 5 people, 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms.  standing fans in each room were great since it was warm at night even in October. alexandra was amazing, helpful with map and lists of everythingto do. wonderful time, will be back!

Host met us at the location to help with parking and entrance instructions. Balcony was pleasant and the breeze made the place comfortable. Would definitely recommend. Host gave great recommendations which reinforced our research.

Nice place to stay.  Good to have 3 bathrooms, however the bathroom from the suite room has a bit of smell.  Convenient to pedestrian street and downtown, since Porto is mostly ramps is advisable to take Uber back to the place after a good night out.

Alexandra was the best! She met us for check in and even allowed us to check out later than expected. We appreciated that very much. She had excellent restaurant recommendations. Wonderful host! Would work with her again.

We had a great stay at this place for a group of 8 friends. It was spacious, clean, and quiet at night. Alexandra was very helpful at check in and throughout our entire stay. We would definitely stay there again and recommend to our friends. It was a short and easy walking distance from the center of the city and felt very safe.
A lovely room with complete privacy and in an amazing location . The hosts were always there when needed and were very kind . Would definitely recommend this place . Thank you for the lovely stay
This is a charming large room in a characterful old terrace house. The host was helpful and responsive.
Great location to walk around and see the sites - must be able to walk uphill - more lighting needed in front hall and lower stairs for after dark
Clean and spacious apartment in a great location - 2 minutes walk from the beach and plenty of restaurants/bars. Would recommend to anyone staying in Foz.

We had a great time staying in Sofia's spacious beautiful apartment for five nights. It provides everything we need and more. Plus the sea views from inside and two bolcnies are fantastic. Communication with Sofia was great too. A wonderful vacation for us... Highly recommend!
Sofia was a very responsive host. Answered questions quickly. However there is no air conditioning so would be quite warm on a hit day.
This apartment is very nicely furnished and has great bathrooms. The location allows easy access to the beach and walking path. Good place for beach time.

The apartment is really great , it is located in a central location , it is spacious and clean. The kitchen is comfortable and well equipped. The apartment is in a high position of the city and Therefore the terrace offers a panoramic view of the city (you can see the Douro River and Vila Nova de Gaia) . The welcome from the host was really satisfying . He described us in detail all the major points of interest of the city. I highly recommend this apartment for a special stay in Porto.
Great apartment, great service, great location .. we had a wonderful time in porto and enjoyd as well the apartment and the city!!!  5 stars for sure!

Great place located in the centre of Porto. David and his friend were very helpful when we arrived, the place was very clean and quiet, and I believe it is even bigger than on the pictures. Walking distance from the train station, touristic highlights and bars and restaurants. I highly recommend it !
Great location. Clean, everything you need to have s great holiday in Porto. David was very helpful with maps, restaurant and things to see.  Worth a stay.

The flat is beautiful, very well located, super clean and very confortable. I'll definitely come back and I would recommend it to anyone. Also the host give us a map pointing out all the attractions, restaurants, and areas to visit.
This is a beautiful apartment in a great area of Porto. Easy to access, the hosts are very friendly and helpful and the facilities are first class. Highly recommended!
Great apartment centrally located.  Nice sized space, clean and well kept.  Would certainly stay here again.

The apartment is in a very central location with a lovely view out over Porto. It has a nice balcony on which to relax with a glass or two. There are also a couple of small grocery shops just up the hill from which you can get the basics of what you need. There is also a nice little bar about 10 mins away, again up the hill to the left with a nice view down the river. Everything that you would probably wish to see, sights, etc, is within in walking distance, although, for those unfamiliar with Porto, you'll need a strong pair of legs !!!. I would recommend a tour of at least one of the Port Lodges, otherwise just wander and take in things as you go.  David and his staff are just a couple of minutes from the apartment in scooter rental shop, so, if you need advice, etc, it's on tap so to speak. Would I use this apartment again ?. Yes, without question.

We loved our stay here. The apartment was impeccably clean and stylishly decorated. The location was fabulous and our host was easy to communicate with and met our every need. We highly recommend this place.

The place is exactly as advertised! Clean, convenient location, great view and superb communication on the hosts front! Bed was comfy, it had a wine opener which I believe to be one of the utmost important devices available to you! The balcony area was lovely - and hopefully you can appreciate a good cat because the lower courtyard provided a symphony of meows ;)
The place looks like the pictures. It's really nice and central, the balcony is great for breakfast in the Sun (even in January..!). It was very quiet and the bed is super comfortable.
The flat is in a perfect location, close to everything!    Very clean, spacious and the terrace is a lovely place to start the day. We would love to come back!

Perfect for us for our long weekend in Porto. Location was great for exploring everywhere on foot and the apartment was very clean and well equipped. The balcony was great for having a drink with a view in the mornings/evenings. Maggie was an excellent host, very knowledgeable about the local area and gave great recommendations on where to visit/eat. Would love to stay again.
Very nice apartment with plenty of room. The view is really nice and Maggie is always available. Many cute porto‘ restaurant close by and everything can be reached by foot.

Our host Maggie was excellent. She was very accommodating and gave us a number of recommendations for our first visit to Porto. We had a great time in the apartment as it had everything we needed as well as an excellent view of Gaia. An excellent stay and would definitely return.

The apartment is large, comfortable and has a balcony with a really nice view despite the construction just below. It is especially perfectly located, in the middle of Porto. It was perfect to visit the city during the weekend !

Great location, spacious apartment, very clean, awesome sunny balcony. Maggie gave us a warm welcome and offered a lot of great tips on where to go, eat and visit, which I really appreciated as a guest. Definitely recommend!

Maggie is a great Host, very talkative and helpful. The apartment is exactly like in the photos and very well located in the city center. The view from the apartment is beautiful and makes it worth the price. The only issue for us was the hot water that would end very quickly making it impossible for two people to shower one after the other.
Such a lovely stay- location, host, and accommodation couldn’t have been better. Definitely recommend!!
Perfect apartment in many ways. Views amazing, the location perfect and the best host who gave us the perfect tips for what to do and see in Porto. I can’t recommend it enough.

Amazing location. Less than 5 minute walk to the River and local attractions. Historic area that is super friendly and safe, even late at night. Apartment has a balcony with an amazing view of the river! I definitely recommend.
The house was very clean and big enough for the three of us. The host was very friendly and the communication went smooth.

Really nice modern apartment set within an old town facade . Good to have a south facing balcony with view over towards the river . The location is perfect for all the shops , waterfront & restaurants . Check in and check out very easy with Maggie .
The place has a great location and the host was very nice as well. It’s spacious and quiet.

Lovely apartment. Well located for old town. Everything you needed for a stay. Great communication and instant help from representative. View rather  over described as was through other buildings but could definitely see  the river.  Porto is  very hilly so  somewhat unsuitable for anyone with with breathing or mobility issues in my opinion.  Door stop in front of shower a bit of a hazard. Otherwise great stay.

The apartment was beautiful, exactly as described.  There are several restaurants nearby and small grocery stores.  The apartment is on the ground floor so no need to carry luggage up the stairs.  We took an Uber from the airport and it cost around 15 Euros.  Porto is very hilly so wear comfortable walking shoes for going up and down the hills.  We had a great time and would recommend this apartment to anyone coming to Porto.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay.  Maggie was quick to respond anytime we had a question (even how to use the washing machine) and was flexible about meeting us for check in. This flat's location is perfect - close to all the major sites and easily walkable to numerous restaurants and a grocery store. We especially loved the sunny terrace with the view of the Douro River from both the bedroom and living room. Thanks for a lovely visit!
Very nice place, and also very nice hosts. The location and the site was amazing. Totally recommended

We had five amazing days at Paula's place. She was so attentive and although the place is in the mountains and a little difficult to reach (it's worth going anyways), she gave us all the informations that we needed about the zone. Moreover, the place had everything that you need to live and more (toys for kids, books, etc) so it was like being at home. Thanks for everything again.

A really lovely house with stunning views, full of amenities, in a quiet village setting. Paula is always contactable and always helpful. She provides a lot of information about the local area. If she’s not around her friend Maria is also super helpful. The house was amazingly clean. Had a really nice stay here.

It's a great place with a beautiful view. When we arrived Maria welcomed us and showed us around. The house has plenty of privacy and parking space. It consists of two floors + an extra place where there is a BBQ and pizza oven. On the top floor it has the bedroom and bathroom with a nice balcony. On the ground floor it has the kitchen/living room and a terrace. We used the wood burner for heating, but there is also air conditioning on both floors.  We had a very nice time there and can certainly recommend.
It‘s a quite and lovely place. Amazing location. If you need to calm down, this is perfect. Totally recommended.

This was a great place to stay!   I was a bit concerned about my ability to find the place but Paula’s directions couldn’t have been better.  The dining pavilion off the  courtyard is a great feature and having a washing machine came in handy.   The kitchen has everything you need for preparing at home meals.  I’d recommend this place and would be a repeat visitor for sure!

The house is beautiful and I felt so at home. You can really unwind there. It has everything you need to spend a relaxing vacation. I can recommend it especially to singles, couples and small families. Thank you Paula for your kindness!

Such a nice and cozy traditional house to stay in. Paula was a great host and quick to respond. Even though we got some rainy days, the chance to use the pizza oven made us all feel so warm and welcomed. Thank you so much Paula!
It was a beautiful getaway for us, waking up with the roosters, walks up the hills, lots of space, immaculate. 15 mins into town.
we loved our stay here! it looks even better than the photos, Paula was super helpful and responsive, the place is perfect for a getaway from the city
A very nice flat 3 minutes away from the beach. Good location to get public transport to go to Porto.
Great view of the ocean, parking was convenient, quiet and close to our location, very pleasant host and no problems whatsoever.

Mari is amazing host. We arrived much late then the check-in time. However, Maria met us with very warm welcome. She showed us her house, gave a small guide about places to eat and shop around. She also helped us with  underground tickets. Plus, she gave us a complimentary bottle of nice wine.  The place itself is a very nice and clean flat with 2 bedrooms. The balcony window oversee the ocean. Stunning view.  Plenty of channels on TV, good speedy internet.  There are many places around to eat, one of them is just around the corner, where you can stuff yourself with enormous amounts of seafood. Will definitely stay again at this place my next visit.

Maria’s apartment is in a fantastic location with a beautiful view of the sea.  It has all features that we could have asked for. Parking is also quite easy outside.  Maria and her husband are very friendly and made us feel very welcome!
Clean, spacious apartment. Less than five minutes to Flores street. Located in a quiet square. Hosts were easy to communicate with.

We loved staying in our Invicta apartment.  We stayed 10 nights.  It was clean, comfortable and cosy.  The oil heaters kept us toasty warm even though it was chilly January.  The neighbourhood is authentic and you can walk to all points of interest in Porto.  Marco and Carla are great communicators and were responsive to our needs.  The price to cost ratio was very good and we would definitely stay here again.

Marco's apartment is very well located in Porto, close to all amenities, very clean and well equipped. We were greeted by Marco's wife, were very attentive hosts and available either before or during our stay. I recommend this apartment.
Nice  cosy spacious place to explore Porto! Very light with 5 big windows giving you the feeling of the old city even when you are inside. Would gladly stay here again!

The location and restaurant suggestions were fantastic. The check-in and out procedures were very easy. The walls seemed thin, and we heard noises from the next apartment and outside the apartment often. There were some ants in the kitchen and bathroom. Overall, our experience here was good.

We were very pleased with the stay. Beautiful apartment and welcoming hosts. We had to change the dates during our trip, due to the sickness of our son, there were no problems with the hosts. Definitely would come back.

We really enjoyed our seven night stay in the apartment.  It is located close to all of  the historic sights in Porto and you can travel most places by foot if you are able to walk  hills (and they are never ending).  The Sao Bento train station is a 10 min walk and from there you can catch the regional trains to the historic towns nearby.  Carla and Marco were very accommodating with our check in and check out times and provided great advice to help us with our stay.  This apartment is urban so you should expect the “sounds of a city”, but we did not find them bad. If we return to Porto in the future we will try to book here again.
Marco’s apartment was an important part of our trip in Porto. A well located apartment with lots of amenities and impeccable cleanliness. I would stay there again for sure!

We loved this place and only wish we were staying longer. The location is very walkable to where we needed to be downtown. Clean, comfortable and well-appointed. Nice neighborhood, quiet and peaceful space, stylish and very nice accommodations. Zero complaints. Stay here, you won’t be sorry.

We had a great stay at the apartment. We work from home and so it had enough space for both of us to work comfortably. Marco and Carla upgraded the internet for us too! It is now super fast fibre internet (100mbps up and down).  The kitchen is fully stocked with everything you need to cook as well.  The neighbourhood is great, the apartment is close to everything. Just a few minute walk away from the river.
very well located, very clean ! Marco is very easy to communicate  highly recommend !
I was very happy at Marco's place. I would stay there again and hope to do that sometime in the future.  Wonderful bakery/cafe just opened right across the street!

The apartment was very big, very nice and with everything you need and more.  I enojyed my stay there very much, Marco and Carla are very friendly and extremly helpful in all thinks! There is everythink around, its in mittle of the Center of Porto. Very good Restaurants in the near. Thank you Marco and Carla, i will come again! BR Andreas
Excellent service and communication with the owners. The location can be a bit noisy at night especially given the thin windows. Overall a pleasant experience.
The host had clear and good communication. He also checks in with you if you need anything. That is very kind!

This place is a gem in Porto! Its near great fado places and lovely restaurants! Down a steep staircase escada de novo is the Ribeira district !! Turn left and you can walk to the famous rue da flores ! Liveraria lello, Cletigos tower almost everywhere is walkable as long as you can handle the steep hills of porto 😋 Lovely home ! Book it if you’re coming to Porto!! 🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩🥳
Irene was super friendly and gave us many informations and recommendations. Especially her restaurant-tips were amazing! She was very helpful and we had a great time discovering Porto!

Pedro was such a nice host, nice and helpful. he showed the house and gave tons of informations about the city. he also reserved a taxi for us, cause we had to be at the airport very early.  the house was very clean, the bed very comfortable. recommended! :)

Pedro welcomed us when we arrived at the apartment. During the stay we had the entire apartment to ourselves (the apartment has two Airbnb bedrooms). The apartment has a nice bathroom with a rain shower. The bed was super comfy as was mentioned by other reviewers here. The location is in the western part of the city centre. The part of Bolhao with its shops is about 15 minuted by foot. We particularly liked the art galleries closely, check out O! Galleria.

Pedro was very responsive and gave us a full and detailed talk through of the local area. It was great to know all of the local information and tips, really made our trip amazing! The location is great as you are only a ten minute walk from most places. Really recommend.
Everything was great. The apartments have 2 separate rooms and a common large living room. Pedro is friendly guy. he gave us a lot of advices what to see in Porto.
We fell in love with Porto! Pedro gave us a lot of great tipps and we could always text him to get more informations:)
We had a great time in Antonio´s flat which is very well located, brand new, clean. Futhermore, Antonio welcomed us very well and was available for us when we had questions ! Everything was perfect.
Really nice apartment! Although we had some problems with our flight and came 3 hours late, we had no problems with our host and thankfully he waited for us! Obrigada!

The appartment was amazing, super super bright and everything was super clean.  I would love to have a place like that in Paris ! the only bad point would be the comfort of the sofa and the bed that makes A LOT of noise . Except from that it was perfect !

We loved staying at Antonios apartment, it was close to everything worth seeing/doing in Porto. The host was very kind and sent us plenty of local tips on what to keep ourselves occupied with while in Porto. Loved the electric scooters as well - they were very usefull if you wanted to go a bit further away in the city but didn’t want to take public transport or walk.
Great location in the city, part of a company of apartments which meant that communication was quick. Check in was great and flexible.
Antonio is a great host, the appartement is located in a perfect place, well-equiped and very clean. Very easy check in and out.

Antonio's place was truly great. It had everything we needed, and was in a good location. Antonio was there to meet us when we arrived, and showed us everything in the apartment. We'd highly, highly recommend his place!
Very good experience! We would like one more mirror and a little more soap. But thats details! Everything was nice. We enjoyed our stay!

Antonio was very friendly and responsive to messages. Antonio’s place was great and exactly as described on the listing. He provided helpful instructions in advance of our arrival for check in and was flexible with the check in time due to our flight arriving earlier in the day. The apartment was in a good location, walkable to most things including the old town down at the bridge. Would definitely recommend staying here :)
Fantastic apartment with a great balcony, neighbours were a bit noisy some nights but other than that it was perfect.

As soon as we entered the apartment, we immediately noticed how clean and well-maintained everything was. The atmosphere was really pleasant, and it was easy for us to feel at home right away. The balcony was absolutely perfect for us, especially during the warm days in Porto. Communication was also super easy, with quick responses and a proactive approach that we really appreciated. Thank you again for the helpful tips about Porto – they were really useful! I can highly recommend this accommodation.

CL Ildefonso was a nice apartment, clean and uncluttered. We were a couple, but it would be a bit crowded for four adults. The location was good, near restaurants and a quiet street when the windows were closed.  A few more chairs in the living area would be helpful, as well as improved lighting in the bathroom.
Nice and spacious apartment, it was 15 min walk to most central areas and the neighbourhood had lots of restaurants around but still very calm. Would stay here again.

We had a great time staying at this Airbnb. The apartment is great value for money, clean, and the location is excellent. Pedro was quick to reply and check in was straightforward. We would definitely recommend staying here.
Apartment on 7th floor was clean, secure and basically a great space to stay in Porto
A little expensive---the view is obstructed by a massive car garage and with the windows open the car noise is overwhelming, like being on a highway. You won't end up using the patio at all.

We had a great stay at Sven’s apartment. The apartment is spacious and has a good location near the centre and public transport. The beds were comfortable and the kitchen was well equipped. The apartment was good value of money.
Great apartment to experience Porto! Easy on foot to anywhere, and great hospitality from Sven and Sandra! Will return
Loved the place. It was very clean, with a good location, big, with a nice balcony and well equipped kitchen. Sandra was super friendly too.
Excelent place and an even better location,close to everything. Sven was really helpful with everything. Deffinetely would recomend this place!!

I stayed at Sven’s place for 2 weeks. I always felt safe and comfortable. The photos are accurate and exactly as shown. The apartment was also larger than I expected. Sitting on the balcony with a glass of wine is the perfect place to catch the sunset!

Very nice appartment very good situated very close to the center of Porto. The appartment was exactly as described by Sven. Appartment was well equipped and clean. The communication with Sven was easy and everything was well arranged before arrival Was not the last time we will use this flat
Our stay was good. The location was really great, close to nice supermarkets and restaurants. Sven and Sandra communicated well and quickly, which was really important. Thank you

We stayed 3 nights in the Amalia room. Tiago and Catia are wonderful hosts. Communication was excellent, and they even arranged a airport transfer for us at a very reasonable rate.  They were very warm and welcoming. The room was more than we expected, newly renovated and beautifully laid out and perfect for two people. It is extremely comfortable and has everything we needed for our stay. There is a separate bedroom with double bed, an excellent bathroom, and well equipped kitchen. The apartment is in an excellent location in Old O'Porto, directly opposite the splendid Sao Bento train station. You can walk everywhere, and are surrounded by cafe's and many attractions. Old O'Porto is a beautiful town, and if you want to visit, you could not stay in a better location or a better apartment than the Sendme2Portugal apartments. Muito Obrigado Tiago and Catia
Place was great and the location was amazing! Catia also provided some wonderful suggestions which made the experience even better!

We had a great stay with Sendme2Portugak! The apartment was clean and nice with a cute welcome gift and plenty of recommendations in a secure building right near the central train station, the ribiera, and plenty of bars/restaurants. They even had AC for when it got hotter and was pretty quiet considering that it is so centrally located. Would definitely stay there again, was great for me and my partner

A great apartment on a great location and with fantastic hosts. The hosts provided us with a lot of good local insights on what to do and eat, and where to go. We had a great stay and would come back any time.

We enjoyed this Cátia and Tiago’s place very much. It is super convenient to train, metro, and tour buses. You can walk to tourist attractions, the river and more. The place was quiet, clean and well equipped. The pastel de nata and port was an extra treat. Communication was great. Definitely recommend.
We had a great stay - the location was perfect for visiting Porto - walking distance to everything.  The apartment was clean, well appointed and quiet at night.  Would highly recommend.
Good location, just a few minutes walk from Sao Bento train station. Nice and clean place.

Clean and modern apartment, not far from city center. We found the kitchen to be on the smaller size. Even though we did not have a chance to meet Mario, he was very accommodating and responded very quickly to all of our concerns.

The apartment is very clean and very well located, just next to the metro station, and only 12 minutes walk from Santa Catarina Street. We had a nice stay in the room.   You can feel it that it's new plus the architecture is beautiful. Simple and fresh!

BEAUTIFUL place, just like the pictures. Check-in was very easy and Mario, our host, was very friendly and helpful. The appartment is right next to a metro and bus station, and also walking distance from the city center. Would highly recommend.
We have had a great time at marios apartment. Very well equipped, new and comfortable. You won't regret staying there for a nice time in Porto.
Marion was perfect to deal with and the private room was great. Nice room and very central. We loved it. Highly recommend  :)
Super easy communication, very well located (15 min walk from the centre and around the corner from the main bus station) and a very comfortable room! We really enjoyed our stay here :)

Great appartement, the room was nice and bright. The rest of the appartement (including the shared spaces) were nicely designed as well. The only negative point I would have is that you can hear street noices and cars. However, I would still recommend this place.

Mario’s place was everything the ad said and more. The space was so clean and very stylish. The location was walking distance to anything needed and best of all Mario was amazing. Check in went smooth and he responded to any messages ASAP. My favourite thing he added was a customized map of Porto and its best tourist attractions including the best route to take. Mario really went above and beyond. I would recommend to anyone.
We had a nice stay in Porto. Place is close to city. Mario responded quickly and helped us when we asked something. Although 1 shower wasn’t working and it was pretty noisy.
Lovely appartment, functional, perfect emplacement. If you love  indepedency this is a good place for you. A little bit noisy from the street, but didn't bother us at all.
Easy check-in; also late at night, fast communication and cozy room in a super awesome area (walking distance to the center but also great area with locals all around). Perfect spot.

Great place, very clean and a lot of space. I haven’t met Mario but he helped me with everything I needed via text messages and replied super fast. A bit noisy at nights from the street outside the window and other people but nonetheless I had a great time!

The place is very close to the inner city. Check-In and Check-Out was easy, the place itself was clean, lots of natural light and a good atmosphere. The only thing that bothered us was the constant showering of other people- but that is to be expected with a shared bathroom.  Mario is very friendly and gave great recommendations for the city. We stayed as a couple, which worked fine but we recommend the place more as a stay for friends.
Alex was the perfect host! Everything was organized from my arrival untill i had to leave. Definitely coming back!
Great and cozy place. Nice communication with host. 10-15 min by walk to the main attractions. Highly recommend 👍🏻

This place is very neat and has any facility you need! It has nice beds, a very clean kitchen and bathroom (with a nice bathtub/shower and even a very nice TV in the livingroom were you can watch your favorite netflix series or movies. Moreover, the location is very good. It was very close to the MRT and other spots in the city and a Lidl supermarket. It's maybe not 100% soundproof but for us that was not a big deal. We would really recommend the place. Thank you for staying!
Mario and Alex are great guests! Very helpful and protective. The apartment is so celan and beautiful! We had a great time there ❤️

A walk away from the points of interest in Porto and just next to a metro station. The rooms are nice and have a lot of light. The shared spaces looked good too, but we never spent a lot of time there. The communication with the host was very fast and friendly. That’s pretty much it. :)
Clean rooms, close to the center and easy communication with the host!  Thank you for the stay!

Very good location near the metro and supermarkt (15min walk from the center). Airport-metro connection is very good. Cool appartement and always Nice to meet new People as it is very Nice to cohouse. Instant connectivity with the host via Whatsapp. Me and my girlfriend truely enjoyed our stay!

everything was really goods from first contact till checkout. bright rooms, comfortable, metro across the street. the only thing which would have been a problem for me (if we would have stayed longer than 3 days) : it's very noisy due to the street and traffic. I am travelling with a child, so maybe that's maybe only me personal issue :-) I would definitely recommend!
We loved this AirBnB, we were well looked after and the accommodation, the location and host were all fantastic, genuinely couldn’t of asked for a better stay!

We enjoyed our stay in Susana E Ricardo's beautiful and recently redecorated appartement.  The ocean and harbour view, the very nice kitchen with a nespresso coffeemaker, oven and microwave, a great shower, 3 TV's and a reserved place in a parking garage. Susana and Ricardo were also very helpfull.
It’s an amazing airbnb! Very clean, good location near to the beach and a very friendly host!

We had such a relaxing stay at Susana and Ricardo's rental. It was spotless, and they were so accommodating and responsive.  The location was close to the beach and restaurants. Obrigada Susana and Ricardo!

The house is very nice, it is not in the heart of Porto, but in a good location, with a mall two blocks away and easy transportation. The house is very clean, the only turn down was the private bathroom that was not inside the room. But besides that, I loved the place.

I absolutely recommend Carmo's house to anyone. She is just amazing, took the time to mark the map with places I could visit as I was traveling on my own. During my stay, I felt very comfortable, had my private room with all commodities and my own bathroom. The place is very well kept, super clean and tidy and the neighborhood is secure and quite. Has a shopping center two minutes away that opens till midnight (just in case) by metro you can access to the city center in about 20 minutes. I don't think I will be able to tell in words how delighted I am that I found Carmo's place and how grateful I am to her. She even gave me goodbye present!  Thank you so much, Carmo!
Our stay was great. Carmo did everything to make us feel comfy and gave us great tips.

We had great time here! The place is located near a metro station so you can get anywhere you want very fast. Room was clean and cozy but a bit cold. Carmo was very nice and helpfull. She quickly answered all my questions.
It was great experience. Good location. Spotlessly clean. Nice place to stay. Thank you for your kindness.
We had a great time at Carmo's house. Carmo is very friendly and hospitable. We had a nice rooms and everything was very clean. We can definitely recommend the accommodation.
I really recomandate Carmos`s place. The room was very clean. it is very easy to find the place and also is near the airport.
Lovely hosts, house and very handy location for where I needed to be. Allowed me to keep my bag there after I checked out and very helpful overall.
Lovely clean space with attention to all the little details that makes for a great stay. Good location easy to move around the city. Highly recommended!
Our host was very helpfull in town visiting information and flexible as we arrived earlier than the communicated time 🙂
Without any doubt its the best place for staying  Carmo care for the guest with the love There are a lot of extra things, even a bathroom dressing down Highly recommended to stayin 🥰

This is the perfect place for Primavera Sound lovers!  It's only 15 minutes away and very close to a metro station towards Porto and the airport.  The house is clean and right next to a huge shopping mall where you can find all kinds of food. Carmo is lovely and very prone to help!
A very neat and organized apartment. Very close to the mall, which all that was needed throughout the stay.

Carmo was an absolutely amazing host. After showing me a quick tour of the facilities, Carmo sat me down and opened up several local maps. She showed me points of interests, places to eat, places to go, and made my trip so much better! I ended up taking her advice and had a great time. Accomodation was perfect, everything as described and very homely.  Can't rate this highly enough, great host and accomodation.

I highly recommend Carmo’s place! It’s located next to the metro station and some big shopping malls. It takes only 15 minutes to get to either the old town or the airport. On my arrival Carmo provided me with abundant information about what to see and do in Porto. Thank you Carmo for hosting me! I really appreciate it.
Convenient location close to the metro. Carmo was very kind with her tips of the area and accommodating for check in/check out. Would recommend!
Was great for the night! Had everything I needed and was close to a nearby mall with many restaurants. Felt at home!
Anytime you visit Porto, you always have to stay at Carmo's place! It's the best. As usual, I had a great stay at Carmo's place.
Carmo’s place is full of cute little decorations, making it feel just like home. It’s easy to access public transportation and is close to a shopping mall and a supermarket

We stayed a night at Cristina's flat and it was really nice, confortable and clean. Cristina was a really awesome host, easy to comunicate with and helpful. We recommend it and we are willing to come back soon :)
Very clean bedroom and bathroom. Shower was nice, bed was nice, balcony was nice. Host was very responsive. No AC but fan was provided. Ideal location as well.
can not  recommend every aspect enough. Try the apartment and Oporto and you won't be disappointed

Everything about this trip was perfect but what really made it was the accommodation and the service provided by Cristina. Her place is in the most perfect location. Walking distance of... well everything really, in a very popular (but quiet at night when needed) and had everything you need for a your stay. Cristina was fantastic with suggestions of things to do and her friendly show around check-in process added that extra touch. Already looking to go back for NYE!
The apartment was nice and  very clean and we had a nice time there. Can truly recommend trying it out if you go to Porto.
The apartment was clean and spacious. Cristina was very kind en waited for us, the communication went smooth and quick. The apartment is well located near the city center, lots of restaurants nearby.

The space was efficient and super clean. Location was perfect, quiet but still close to everything and in a nice active neighborhood. Christina was very communicative and quick in responding. I very much enjoyed my stay.

Bright and spacious apartment in the best location. We loved our stay! The bed is really comfortable, shower pressure is amazing, kitchen is fully equipped, and the view from the balconies is incredible. We were able to walk everywhere. You can park right in front which is so convenient. Great place to explore Porto!

Todo muito bem :)) We had a perfect stay. The apartment is really well located. We slept well. The neighborhood is really cool and close to many bars and restaurants. It would have been a pleasure to stay longer in Porto, a beautiful city !

This is an ideal location for exploring and is also quiet.  There’s lots of parking opportunities around the area at the weekend.  We are used to bedding being available in the apartment for the 2nd bed. Be sure to mention it in advance, if you plan to use it.

A fantastic apartment! Such a great location. This apartment is within walking distance to all the best and central spots in Porto. The apartment is so clean, the space is lovely! Contact and service couldn't have been better. Thanks for a great stay!

A funky property in a fantastic location.  There are bars and restaurants very close and it's a quick walk down to the water.  The only thing to note is that the door to the apartment is immediately off the stairs on the 5th floor.  And the toilet and shower are immediately in the doorway.  Bedroom and lounge are either side of these.

This place was in a great area of Porto. Very easy to explore the city and everything was in walking distance. The place it's self was very nice and clean. We loved it here and would absolutely book it again next time we are in Porto!
The place is great with an amazing view, perfect for couples oven families with kids, ours loved to climb the stairs! We love the central location as well, as you can walk anywhere!

Great location in Porto, walkable to many attractions but in a less busy area. The kitchen is equipped for basic meals and there is a nice balcony. The blinds in the bedroom are great and keep the room very dark which really helped our baby sleep. Cristina was always responsive and communication was great.

The location is very central and close to many restaurants, boutique shops and cafes. Cristina was an amazing host, always responsive and caring. The flat was a peaceful haven from a long day of walking around beautiful Porto. I’d definitely stay here again.

In Porto you can't do better than staying at Yves' apartment. The hosts are young, nice,friendly and helpful. The apartment is specious, modern, clean, airy, sunny, with its own garden. The decor is tasteful, contemporary, fresh. Nothing is missing. We love cooking so we appreciated the great kitchen. The location is quiet, out of the centre but a pleasant walk to everything.
