We never took a cab or public transportation. Supermarkets and shopping are nearby. To anybody visiting Porto,we strongly recommend Yves' apartment.

The apartment is located in a really strategic area of the city, from where you can move by feet to reach the most important monuments and churches. Inside it is confortable: the owner agency is really well organized with a phone service that gives you assistance until 2am. The boy who welcomed us in the apartment had been really kind and ready to give us really useful advices to enjoy the city in the best way

It was a lovely flat, very clean and great location for walking into Porto.  It’s at the top so you need good legs but was nice to be higher up. There is a great park nearby with incredible view of the city. Concierge team we’re very professional and helpful.

A wonderful flat just in the center of Porto. Very spacy, with great view on the Douro! The kitchen is fully equipt. The apartment is  very clean. And it was pleasure to communicate with the host. You should be awared that there is no lift . Dear Joao, thank you for our great staying in Porto!

We had a great time in the apartment. it was very clean and amazingly located, everything is a walking distance and the surroundings of the spyware beautiful. The hosts were very nice and gave us all we need. Highly recommended!!
Very nice apartment for a weekend trip. Simple apartment but everything you need for a short stay. Clean. Close to everything. Very helpful and accommodating. Recommend!

The photos of the view from this apartment are a bit misleading since you can only see down to the river in winter, when the leaves fall from the trees. Any other time of year the view is just of trees and roofs and is not very special. I did not enjoy the service offered by the porto concierge. They say they are a new concept in hotels. As a client I only noticed downsides to this agency compared with standard personal airbnb lettings. They make you collect the key from an office rather than meet you are the apartment. They send generic preprepared messages and you are always communicating with different people. I left my key with a friend by accident and they were going to charge me 20 euros to go to their office and collect a spare, a normal personal airbnb would most likely do this for free if it's an honest mistake. Overall I found the description a bit misleading and the service impersonal and inconvenient.
Very central location . Very near to Clerigos Tower and a multitude of parks, Warm reception , there was a bottle of excellent on the kitchen table.

The flat is noce and fleabag, spacious and comfy :) well located, walking distance to most attractions. Restaurants nearby, and amazon views. Check in was very easy and convinent. We had great time in Porto :)
Our stay in Porto was perfect and it is a lovely place for a city trip! I recommend !

Yves and Ana are wonderful hosts. Very caring and helpful. The flat is only 30 mins on foot from the old quarter - straight ahead all the way - and has everything one could possibly need. It was a real pleasure staying there and I hope to come back in year or two.
We had a great stay in this beautiful apartment. The contact before was informative and helpful and the apartment well-equipped.
Thank you for a great welcome and stay at your place. Although we stayed there for one night, we enjoyed it very much. The place was big enough for our family. All in all, everything was great.
Great apartment, great location and a perfect place to stay with your dog if you're travelling with him

Large clean one bedroom apartment with lots of natural light! On a quiet street with free parking if you are travelling with car. It was a bit far from downtown Porto/waterfront to walk, we arranged other methods of transportation. The hosts communication was timely and he was flexible (2-4 hours) of our arrival time. Cute and moderate sized courtyard to enjoy some wine. Large bathroom. Comfortable bed with large closet. Would recommend.

Yves and Ana are wonderful hosts and location is really good if you want to explore Porto. The apartment is close to the metro (direct line to airport), it is away from noisy streets yet it is still quite close to the main sights and old town, so you don't need to use public transportation in order to get to the central Porto from apartment. We also got some suggestions of what to see and where to eat. I highly recommend this place if you are looking for a nice place to stay close to the old town.

Great experience and location. Spacious and new apartment good for 2 or 3 people. Great cleaning service and communication/ information from the host. As a note I would suggest it mainly for young and active people for the absence of elevator and presence of stairs in the flat.

Such a special stay and location! This was our first Portugal stay on our honeymoon trip and it was so beautiful! Thank you for the delicious bottle of wine, it was the perfect thing to sip as we looked out the window over the Douro River at sunset. Absolutely wonderful! Many thanks!

The apartment is probably one of the best airbnbs we had. Everything clean and well designed. Location is really central, just next to metro station and a big supermarket. Yves and Ana were very friendly and helpful.

This place is a true gem! The location is near a metro stop and great for walking to main sites. This apartment is spacious and tastefully decorated and in a quiet neighborhood. Yves and Ana are great at communicating! I would definitely stay here again.

The apartment is clean, spacious, with all the basic amenities and is located just walking distance away from city's attraction spots. The stay was very comfortable and cleanliness was also taken care of well. Highly recommended for a couple or a family of  3-4 persons.

The apartment indeed is beautiful and modern. It has the very basics but for a couple of days is ok. The views are nice but if you’re expecting to have the view of the river, this is not the place. Overall the attic is very lovely however it could use a renovation or cleaning of furniture as the couch and chair with cloth were sticky and disgusting to sit in. I work from home so it is important for me to be in the house. The towels could use a little care too as they were small and sticky. In regard to the location, it is a beautiful neighborhood and very central. There are a lot of hills that you have to go up and down however the whole city is like this.
Cozy place, in a very central area of Porto. Host is a very nice person and me and my family had a really nice and relaxing times there
Great location near the metro and within walking distance of the centre. The appartment was quiet , clean and plenty of space in a nice old building. The communication as also good.
is one of those flats that gives you best value for your money, a lot of space and quite private and well equipped
Everything was great! They place is near a metro stop and very close to the historic center, convenient to the airport. It’s a nice and comfortable space. The host was communicative.
Great service, very impressed with both Go2Oporto and the apartment. Would definitely use again.
Fantastic location- although a little noisy at night. Great apartment- spacious and well appointed. Checking in was easy and our host was friendly and very helpful.
Great place, but a little bit noisy at night. Host was friendly, gave us a map of the city and gave recommendations with sightseeings

We had an amazing and comfortable stay here! Bruno is so nice and gave us so many useful recommendations.  The apartment is very well located and close to a lot of tourist attractions. Definitely recommended!

We lived our stay at Porto. The property is in the middle of everything, great for someone that wants a central location , walking to supermarket as well as the main attractions. We did need to close our windows at night as the apartment overlooks the bars.

Staying at Yves Apartment was an absolute delight. The space was stylish, clean, and equipped with everything we needed and Communication with Yves was seamless from booking to check-out, and they were always quick to respond. Thank you!
Thank you Yves and Ana for early check in. That was big bonus for us Thank you so much

Vivian's place was better than the add showed,especially the terrace,which is fabulous to have breakfast or diner or just take in the sun. Very clean, well equipped, we stayed for 3 days and cooked all our meals there. Supermarket 5 min away, subway is 2 blocks down and we walk to the old city in less than half hour. Really good value for the money, I would highly recommand it. Vivian was there to greet us as we ask to check in early and she was very helpful and nice.

Perfectly located apartment, a short walk from the metro that takes you into the main tourist attractions and if you walk only about 30min to the river. We loved being in this more local area with a great square and fountain and lovely bakeries. Vivian left lovely touches in the apartment and we appreciated her notes and information places throughout. The bed was comfortable and we loved letting fresh air in from the huge patio. We would stay again in a heartbeat. Thanks Vivian!
Great apartment a little bit outside the city centre with a free parking opportunity in a garage. The metro and bus station is located nearby. Friendly and helpful host!

The place was clean and comfortable and it answered perfectly our need while visiting Porto. There are private parkings in the area that you can use as the streets are narrow.  The check in felt a bit rushed as the internet malfunction can sometimes be an issue with opening the door and the host didn’t mention this in the instructions.  At checkout, the cleaning lady came before the checkout time despite us saying that we would message the host when we would leave.  Despite these miscommunications, the place was great, functional and quiet.

We had a great stay at Vivian’s place! The location is great if you don’t need to be right in the city center. It’s very close to the metro to quickly get around and there are lots of shops and restaurants very close by to walk to. We especially enjoyed the terrace and small balcony in the bedroom! The place was very clean and just as described. Would definitely recommend when visiting Porto 😊

Perfect when arriving by car. Close to metro, which is ideal to get into city Center. The apartment has a nice balcony and is very good especially in terms of what you pay! We loved ALL the small details in the apartment that made is feel at home. Also tailoring some spesific things to our needs.

The place is a really nice decorated and cosy house, we loved it very much. Porto is at walking distance and you can park the car in the street for free. We would certainly recommend this place if you want to visit the city with your kids and love to stay at a quiet place nearby the city center.

A fantastic place to stay in very easy reach of the main sights of Porto. The metro is just at the end of the road. Porto itself was perfect and one of the best cities I have visited.  The house suited our needs perfectly. We were able to make food, sit outside and feel at home.  We even managed to get parking right outside.  A great host who communicated well with us throughout.  Thank you

We had a great time at Christine and Miguel place. Lovely house in a quiet neighborhood, however, not far from town. The house is super close of the subway station and walkable distance from good restaurants and bars. We travelled with our 1 year baby and they provided travel cot to him. Responsible Hosts, provided us clear instructions for self check-in and local tips. I would definitely comeback with my family.

We had a good stay. The apartment was visibly set up very well. Easy to check-in and good communication with the host. Very close to the metro station and good small local cafes around for breakfast. The WiFi had some minor issues now and then but it doesn't affect your stay much. Bathroom is on downstairs and from room upstairs at night was a small inconvenience.
Lovely home and Thiago was very helpful at check in. 5 mins walk from the main square and a great little flat with good facilities. Just what we wanted! Thanks!
Tiago as a host was great. He was very flexible and the house was cosy and very good for a couple. The apartament was very clean and the location is close to the city centre. I recommend it 100%.

Tiago is very responsive with the mail, it's very pleasant, thank you ! The accommodation is cute and matches with the photos. The location with the metro is really very convenient especially to go to the airport. However for the winter it is a little cold, because there is no real heating, so towels are hard to dry, and the sheets are a bit damp... For a romantic weekend, it's lovely and perfect, i recommend !

The flat is clean and pleasant, even if it might be a little noisy sometimes because of the cars. It also well located in the city - you can access to the center in 15-20minutes walking. Tiago was reactive and accomodating.
nice little apartment very well placed close to trindade and sao bento. lots of cool places right next door. the apartment is comfortable and cute tiago has been considerate and reactive to us
The house is fine, communication was quick but we never saw anyone. There is a lot of noise from the street.
Everything what we needed was there. Clean and nice appartment ideal for a couple. Good and save locality near the city centre.

Tiago’s apartment is a good sized place for a solo traveller or couple with basic amenities in the kitchen and bathroom.  Overall, the apartment was very clean. However, we did find live cockroaches in the kitchen/living room area. I contacted Tiago to inform him; he said it’s becoming quite common in Porto.  The apartment is in a good location for walking into central Porto or catching the train from Trindade metro station. However, it is on a main road and therefore can be quite noisy, especially if it’s warm and you have the windows open.  Easily fixed with earplugs though :-)
Small but really nice place to stay. It has everything you need. There is no heating, however, the house counts with a heating device that it's enough. I would recommend this place to my friends.
Such a lovely place! Would stay there again! Great communication and very easy. Everything was very clean.
The listing is great and has everything you might need. great location and all went great. thank you Tiago, you are a great host.

The house is in Vila Nova de Gaia, about 30 mins by bus from the center of Porto (about 10-15 mins by car). It's calm and our hosts were extraordinarily nice, explained everything to us and were always available if needed. Would definitely choose the Airbnb again! :)
The place is a very charming house, it was so convenient to be so close to bus stops and a supermarket. The host is very friendly, good with communication and very helpful!
Great Hosts. Made us feel right at home and very accommodating. Would stay again
Lovely apartment in a very good location. It has a very nice classic look for whoever wants to see a bit of how old buildings in Porto looked like.
Great and very cool apartment in the city center of Oporto. The host was very friendly and gave us a lot of tips and recomendations.

As other reviews mentioned, there’s a funky smell throughout the place…And we found it a little bit cold in the apartment. But honestly I don’t know if that can be avoided in a historical home like this one - The charm outweighs the negatives. There are heaters in each room but they can’t really keep upbeat the high ceilings. We would stay here again, just maybe bring warmer clothes next time.
Amazing location and very reasonably priced! Excellent for two couples as their were two bathrooms and the rooms weren’t right on top of each other.

Mariza was a very friendly and accommodating host, all of the communication and the check-in was swift and professional. Although the immediate surroundings (the busy street next to the apartment) aren't that interesting, you could easily walk to the relevant areas downtown. The aparment was nice, functional and very tidy, all in all a good place from which to explore Porto!

Mariza was very lovely and let us check in early due to an early morning flight from the UK! She was very understanding when we turned up later than expected. The flat was very modern,clean and comfortable as pictured. The location was great - very easy to reach from airport and walking distance to city centre. Thanks for a great stay!
Great location not far from the airport and close to metro station. Mariza is a great host.

The apartment is situated brilliantly near Trindade metro station with great links to the train stations and airport. Comfortable walking distance to the centre and all the sites. Apartment is so clean and modern with a wonderful terrace to enjoy breakfast in the morning! Very comfortable, would definitely stay again.
We had a lovely stay. the apartment is very charming and clean, very central! we even had a welcome bottle of wine! Would definitely recommend :)
We had a really nice stay in this accommodation. The Apartment is really comfortable. Have had some problems with the power, but it was solved at once.  Would stay there again.
Sweet Apartment, central location and Alexandra was very helpful. We would recommend Alexandra and her Apartment!

Would highly recommend this place for a trip to Porto. Location was fantastic, about 10 minutes walk to the centre and 5 minutes to the metro (which goes all the way to the airport). Alexandra was really helpful, quick to respond to messages and ensure we had a good stay. The apartment is very clean, modern and a great space.
Very nice place and well located. The host was very helpful and left us a bottle of wine to enjoy during our stay. Very recomended
Excellent treatment by Alexandra. She was worried about us at all times. Both she and the apartment deserve the 5 stars.
Alexandra is a super host! very enthusiastic about sharing her Cool Home. Our stay began with a personal check-in with Alexandra and a very nice gift. A great place for sure.

The apartment was really clean and tidy and perfect for what we were looking for. The host was really quick at replying and gave us local recommendations for restaurants and things to do. One thing I will say though is that it is on a main road and is very noisy so if you are a light sleeper than it might be ideal for you.

Nice, cozy, well-equipped apartment with stylish decoration, just as the photos showed, and even better than I had thought. Staying in the apartment was comfortable and I really enjoyed cooking in the kitchen. (The welcome bottle wine was wonderful!) Alexandra was an excellent host, proactive and respondsive. When I accidentally needed a new phone and asking for help, she responded immdeiately and provided the information of the store. (Thank you so much, Alexandra!) Highly recommend Alexandra and her place!

Stayed 4 nights. Alexandra is a super host, excellent instructions on how to find and access the apartment and very responsive. The listing and photos are accurate, it was modern, clean, comfortable and a well equipped and located place to stay. What more can you ask for! Highly recommended, I would stay here again should I visit Porto again. Thanks Alexandra :)
Very happy with our stay in Porto, close enough to the centre we were able to walk in but far enough out we felt right at home in the apartment.

We had a very nice stay at this Apartment. The site of the Apartment is exellent. It´s placed in the City Center near to Restaurants and bars. The apartment is equiped with everything you need for a City trip and is very beautiful and clean. The host who welcomed us gave us good tips and informations about Porto. All in all a very good stay at a beautiful City.

Beautiful, modern apartment, located in the heart of Porto. All facilities easily accessible and within walking distance. The apartment was clean, well maintained and equipped wth everything you need for your stay. The team were on hand to answer all enquiries efficiently and quickly. In addition, they provided some very useful tips on sights and places to visit.

The place is really central and the main sights of Porto in walking distance. Communication, response went really well and they gave us local tips. The appartment is very clean and we would book it again.
Loved the location, everything was within walking distance. They provided some local preferences for things to see and do which was really helpful as well. Very clean and comfy space :)
Incredibly central and very clean, perfect for a city break. Bit loud on a Saturday night but great if planning on going out. Had a lovely stay.
Very nice and clean apartment, good location. A little noisy at night but would definitely recommend when coming to Porto.

Very clean and pretty  apartment. Excellent location in the middle of Porto, everything is within walking distance. The welcome was very friendly and they give you a map of the city and point out the hotspots of Porto. Would definitely recommend.

The apartment was very central, and close to a lot of sights and restaurants. It was clean, comfortable, and a good size for solo travellers and couples. It was a great place to stay for a couple of nights, and I enjoyed my stay there. Communication was also great, and they were very accommodating with check-in time.
The location is central, walking distance to many good restaurants, cafes and attractions. The apartment is clean, ORM Team is very responsive. Check-in is smooth and very positive.
The Location of the Apartment is Amazing and the Host gave us so many Insider tips! Worth a stay for sure! 5 Stars
Awesome stay! Clean and in the best part of nightlife! Walking distance to everything. Can be noisy at night, but it’s worth it for great nightlife, would stay again !

Great flat renovation in an amazing historical building in the heart of the bustle and hustle! Very clean and all the amenities as described. The hosts were super friendly and always available and flexible with our timelines and needs. Definitely recommend!
Diogo was super helpful when I checked in and walked me through much of what Porto had to offer. The place was a clean and cozy place to call home for the 3 days I was there.
Great place and location. The adminstrator was very helpful and advised on a lot of things to see and do. Great hospitality- in overall, everything was much mote than we were expecting.
Great value for your money and location. Smooth and helpful check and check out process. Would stay here again!

Wonderful apartment, ideally situated in the city centre. Carlos kindly welcomed us on the first day, stayed extremely reactive to our messages/questions before and during our time here, and made us numerous recommendations concerning the restaurants as well as the other places of interest around Porto, he has been of great help and made our stay even more enjoyable ! As for the apartment itself, it's just like the photos suggest it is : clean, well decorated, practical, etc. I highly recommend Home Alegria to anyone looking to spend a few days in this beautiful city of Porto !

Carlos was a really great host, very thoughtful, the appartement was amazing, clean, nice decoration, comfortable beds. Carlos responded quickly, gave us directions on how to get to his place.  He received us very well when we arrived and gave us tips on where to go. We had a great stay!

Carlos and Helena were very kind and accommodating hosts. The flat was extremely clean, stylish, and comfortable. We stayed with a total of four guests and the flat never felt too crowded. The flat is only 10 minutes away from the center of town, but there are great cafes and restaurants even closer to the flat. Would definitely stay here again if we ever find ourselves back in Porto.
The space has everything a tourist needs and the location is close enough to and far enough away from the madding crowd. I heartily recommend the place!

Thank you so much for your kind hospitality Carlos! My boyfriend and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay in this beautiful apartment. Your recommendations and tips were very helpful - to show us how to get around. We really appreciated the time you took to share this with us.

Carlos was a great host and his Airbnb was in a location. He was flexible when our arrival time was pushed back a few hours and he was kind enough to spend a good 10-15 mins telling us about things to see and eat in Porto. I went on an amazing food tour with Taste Porto and the meeting point for their downtown tour was just a 2 min walk from this Airbnb! The only tip I have for future guests is to bring ear plugs. Because it’s an apartment building you’ll hear the neighbors when they are walking or talking in the staircase as well as usual street noise. Other than that, a really great Airbnb to relax and explore Porto.

The apartment is located on the first floor of a traditional building. It is stylish, comfortable and very clean. Well appointed with all necessary kitchen utensils etc. Fresh, crisp bed linen and fluffy towels provided. Really good, powerful shower which is easy to control for the temperature. Perfect for a couple.  Checked in by Claudia who was friendly, helpful and informative. The location is superb, just a 10 mins walk from the Metro which runs direct from the airport. It suited us perfectly as everything was within walking distance, ie main sights, tours, great shops and eateries. We even walked over to Gaia on the other side of the river.  Bring good walking shoes! Loved our stay here and would recommend.
Great apartment, very stylish and clean space, perfect location close to the metro and within walking distance to centre and bridge. Thanks Carlos and Helena for the nice stay!

Highly recommend! A great place to stay a few nights. Carlos was there to check us in and show us round the apartment. He gave us lots of great tips for Porto. The apartment was very comfortable and had everything we needed! It was in a great location very close to everything but in a quiet location. Would stay here again!

The apartment is very nice, clean and well equipped. It is bright,  with a lot of light. Location is near to many cafes,  shops and a short walk distance to the center. The host was pleasant and very helpful. Could not asked for more! Highly recommendable!

Great little apartment near all the best spots in Porto. Carlos welcomed us with a detailed overview of the best sights to see and was on call to answer any questions we had during our stay. The location in particular is very central and makes getting around the city by foot easy and enjoyable!
perfect location and the apartment have all you need . Carlos is very nice  help us with places and things to do . I love it ! the apartment is in very safe place and it was very important for me
This is just a nice gem in the city!  The apartment is conveniently arranged and has everything for a fine stay!
Lovely place for a stay in Porto. Well located, close enough to the main sites, easy to get around from and perfect for 1-3 people. No A/C though, so keep that in mind!
The apartment on the website was not available but Jorge offered an alternative that was even closer to the seafront. Location was perfect and Jorge nice and very helpful
Jorge is an amazing host ,  and his place is perfectly clean . He gave us a beautiful unexpected surprise and we are greatful for his response to our needs everytime needed .  Thank you so much .

Amazing stay! Carlos was really helpful and communicative before we arrived and then sat with us at check in to give us recommendations and help us get our bearings. The apartment was really clean and stocked with everything we could need. We loved our stay and would definitely stay there again.  Only downside was that the neighbourhood/street outside is quite noisy at night over the weekend but not enough to prevent us from returning.

We had an amazing time at Carlos' place. He met us and gave us a few great recommendations which we would not have known about otherwise. it is very centrally located and we were able to walk to all the best spots in Porto. highly recommend staying at his place if you're lucky enough to find an opening!

Carlos’s place was the ideal base for exploring Porto: everything within walking distance but also very close to the metro. Place was immaculate, stylish and comfortable. Felt right at home - Carlos made sure I had everything I needed. Highly recommended.
The place is exactly as advertised: clean, cozy and very well equipped. It’s about a 20 minute walk to most attractions, but it’s easy to navigate and close to transit. A pleasure to stay there!

Carlos's place is a true gem in the heart of Porto, perfectly located within walking distance of everything. Upon our arrival, Carlos thoroughly explained all the details about his place and highlighted the city's key attractions on a paper map, offering fantastic recommendations for authentic Portuguese cuisine. His communication was exceptional. Don’t wait too long—book this place before someone else does!

Smart apartment, well equipped, comfortable, convenient for Porto and trips out (e.g. Douro Valley, Aveiro). Host Carlos was very helpful with check-in, suggestions and information about the city and area. Really enjoyed our stay!

Apartment was beautiful and exactly as described! Great location and very walkable to the city and metro. Carlos was very responsive and helpful in sharing places to see and things to do. Would love to be back in the future!

We really enjoyed our stay at the apartment.  Carlos met us on arrival and gave us a very comprehensive briefing on local amenities etc.  We later had a couple of queries which he responded to very quickly.

Do not hesitate to book this place, it is clean and modern looking. The place is a little small but for a couple it’s the perfect place. A couple minutes by walk from city center which is very nice. Staff was very nice and helpful. By far the best airbnb experience.

Our stay in Porto was great. The apartment is perfect, there's everything you need and the rooms are modern, clean and beautiful!  The contact with Home Me was also very uncomplicated. We could leave our luggage at the office even before Check-in and Sergio gave us some really good advice on what to do in Porto.  Would totally recommend it!

The appartment was great, it was exactly like in the pictures and very well situated. We've been very well welcomed by the Home Me team, they provided all the informations needed and have been really reliable. Thank again, we had a great stay :)

This was a lovely apartment! We enjoyed our stay here very much. Everything was just as described, and the apartment was well located close to everything. We didn’t hear any noise in the night, very quiet apartment. Would definitely book again!

This was a lovely apartment, very central and very accessible to get to from the airport using the metro. Arrived late at night and the host Nico was there to meet us. Recommend to anyone staying in Porto.

This is the perfect place to enjoy comfortable accommodations while be close to the best parts of Porto. The private garden is a rare and fun detail of the space. We enjoyed drinks out there under the stars. The space itself is very clean and well organized. Everything is updated and modern. Our host also gave us some great tips on food and local sights. Highly recommend!!
We had a great time in Porto. The apartment was beautiful and had everything we needed for a few days. It was just like in the pictures. The contact was very easy. Thank you!

Very well located flat.  Really annoying dog next door which barks all day, but that's not the fault of the host!   Our toilet broke on the first day, and wouldn't flush.  It took a few days to fix - but in fairness, this was because it was the weekend and everywhere was shut.  I can't fault the host for their quick replies and the effort they went to.

We really appreciate the warm welcome and suggestions of visit when We arrived. The appartment is very well situated in a quiet and nice street. Many restaurants around!  The decoration is exactly as the photo descriptions and We enjoy the terrace. The appartment is also very well equiped. We will recommand this address for sure !

This is a very nice place to spend a few days exploring Porto from It’s close to the subway , supermarket , bars, restaurants, 30 stroll gets you to the waterfront  The unit is modern ,clean and well equipped.  The host was easy to contact  met us on arrival and spent a few minutes outlining suggestions for sightseeing. They responded quickly when the electricity went out .
Great place. Really close to everywhere, the apartment looks exactly like the pictures. The heater could be a bit better, but Nathanael kindly gave us another blanket.

Lovely flat and ideal location. The outdoor space was fantastic. The Home Me team quickly responded to us in all inquiries and gave helpful advice on Porto. Would recommend this place to anyone visiting this wonderful city.
very good value for your money. nice apartment, great location. we had a terrif stay in Porto

Exactly what we needed! Super location, near the best restaurants and bars but quite during the night. Cozy and very well equipped. Flat was warm and very clean. Great bakery just on the corner 👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻highly recommended 🥯🥐🥞  Would definitely comeback 🌼☀️🙌🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼

We had a fantastic stay in this lovely apartment. The location is great, really close to the main metro from the airport and lots of amazing restaurants but still super quiet at night. Wouldn’t hesitate to come back!

This apartment was perfect for visiting Porto. Everything in the city was within easy reach. The metro was a few minutes walk. There is an excellent bakery for breakfast and many many bars/restaurants for the evening. We would definitely book again.
Great location, close to the lots of good bars and restaurants. Super cute and clean apartment with all basic utilities. Only pity the terrace isn’t in the sun but still nice space and view to have.
Right in the middle of town, close to some of the historic sights and plenty of places to eat and drink. A great pad for a few days!

Great amenities in a clean and fresh remodeled apartment. Great shower and bathroom, has a dishwasher and clothes washer, and everything you need to cook a full meal. Tv in the living room AND in the bedroom. Absolutely exceptional host -- probably the best if not one of the best hosts I've ever stayed with. Very informative, knowledgeable, helpful, quick to respond, and friendly. He enjoys hosting and it shows. The apartment being spectacular as well is an added bonus to staying with Joao!

It was my best airbnb experience ever. João is fantastic host - very kind, attentive and accurate. The apartment itself was much better than I expected. Location is great - walking distanse to everywhere we wanted to go, but quiet at the same time. There’s also a fantastic panoramic view from the windows. The apartment had all we needed, even the dishwasher and coffee maker. This lovely apartment became our sweet home for few days. Thank you João!
This place is sparkling clean and João is an incredible host. He took the time to show us around the apartment and talk to us about what we should see in Porto. This is such a great place to stay!
The apartment was bright and clean.  The settlement went quickly.  A negative impression was left by large stains of mold behind the bed.
Cleaning was perfect and towels were really clean. Host responded to our requests promptly. I would definitely recommend this airbnb!!
Had a great break in Porto. The apartment was clean, modern and very comfortable. The host we met was very friendly and helpful.  He gave us loads of  great recommendations.

It is not everyday that you find a place when traveling that truly makes you feel at home. João’s beautiful apartment was just that for us. After a very warm welcome, we began exploring the city, enjoying being in a quiet road just a few minutes walk from everywhere. The apartment is spacious, newly renovated, fully equipped with everything you need and generally just great. We will love to come back.
The apartment is lovely; modern, clean and very centrally located. The communication was great and really helpful, will definitely recommend!

Really amazing stay, especially for the price. I was shocked at how Center to all of the attractions and landmarks I was. I saved so much time not walking, Ubering, or taking the bus to look at attractions. The place was clean and quiet despite being around a rowdy party area. Highly recommend!

We enjoyed our stay a lot and can highly recommend this Airbnb. The room is beautiful and the little balcony is perfect for having breakfast in the sun. The location is great and we could explore all parts of Porto by foot. We would come back anytime :)
Antonio was very kind and helpful and gave us good suggestions. Apartment is very good, perfectly located, recommended.
We enjoyed staying in this nicely decorated, clean modern apartment. Antonio was very helpful. It was easy to find our way around Porto.

A lovely and well-located flat in Porto: perfect to reserve if you want to get to the know the city.  Antonio is friendly, professional and attentive, and in my case was very understanding when I got caught up in the half-term / Jubilee weekend flight chaos, (and when I forgot that it takes 4 times as long to get through customs now post-Brexit!) I would definitely recommend.

The apartment is perfectly located, transports are nearby as restaurants and supermarkets.  The appartement is clean and corresponds to the photos and  very well equipped.  Thank you Antonio and highly recommend!
This was in the perfect location and a beautiful, clean flat! The host couldn’t have been more helpful and lovely!  Would recommend it to anyone!
Well located in the center of Porto, ideal for a couple. We were there with 2 small kids announced upfront, they made it work perfectly.

Everything was perfect : location, communication with hosts (thanks Daniela!), the apartment itself (cleanliness, tidiness, size, bed, equipments (kitchen etc), flexibility with the keys. I would definitely recommend it

As others have said the location of the apartment is perfect to explore Porto. You can reach most sights by foot and if you need public transportation there are metro and bus stops nearby as well. We found the flat to be very clean and felt very comfortable. For two people there‘s plenty of space. One thing to maybe consider is that it is an old building with wooden floors which means you can hear the neighbors above you walking around - although this did not bother us at all.   Communication with the hosts before and during our stay was good and the self check in was easy.
This is in a great location with an awesome view! On top of that it is very nice to have two bathrooms unlike most hotels. The host was very quick to respond and very helpful with recommendations.
a very nice large one bedroom two bath flat with an epic view from the patio. The central location was also great, so easy to walk to all sites and restaurants

The photos don’t lie - the view is amazing. The bedroom is in the back with the kitchen and bathroom between you and the living room so it’s a lovely dark quiet chamber to rest in.  Very comfortable, close to anything you’d want. 5 min walk takes you to a dozen different spots in Porto.
Beautiful place in a beautiful city:) Dinner and breakfast on the balcony will make your stay in Porto perfect.  And the communication is awesome which is always a gift when travelling.

We had a lovely stay with Eva and Dani. The place was clean and tidy, with excellent views over the city incl. the famous bridge! Communication was great, and allowed us to slightly overrun out checkout time without much hassle. Shame about the weather! Would heartily recommend.
Beautiful apartment in a fabulous location. Very quiet despite its central location, extremely well furbished, with great views and a cute balcony terrace. Couldn't have been better!

This is a beautifully decorated and spacious apartment with an amazing view. Communication with the host was easy and they were very quick to respond. They even gave us tons of restaurant and activity recommendations in the area when we arrived. We couldn't have been happier with our stay, highly recommend if you're visiting Porto.

The apartment has great location with amazing view. It’s well-equipped and clean. Big plus is a small cafe downstairs. The communication with the owners was very smooth, they were fine with late check-in.

This is a fantastic place that deserves all the positive reviews. It is comfortable and relatively spacious in the cramped inner city, and its location is hard to beat. You have convenient stairway access down winding roads to the Ribeira area and are otherwise right next to the Clerigos tower adjacent to nightlife, shopping, etc. Check-in was convenient and communication was excellent. Really an amazing way for us to start our trip!

We stayed in this apartment for 2 nights with our 2 kids. It was so well located! We loved the view from the balcony!  Check in and check out was easy and communication with owner great.  Highly recommended for your Porto stay :)

Absolutely wonderful stay! Eva and Dani’s place is well appointed, comfortable, and beautiful! Check-in was fast and easy, thanks to the clear communication with Eva and Dani. Everything was as it was stated in the listing and met all of our needs. The location (very central) and view from the apartment are incredible and I would highly recommend to anyone visiting Porto!

The view at Merc’s is sweeping and stunning. The place itself is also quite large versus other places I have stayed in Europe. The kitchen is wonderful and I wish I could have had the time to cook a meal in it. The pull out sofa bed wasn’t the most comfortable to sleep on, but I ended up using one of the large, thick blankets in the closet as a base layer, which helped a lot. They are renovating the building directly in front of the balcony. Other than scaffolds and construction mess, we didn’t have noise issues—but we also stayed on the weekend. The shower has good water pressure, but you’re limited on time when it comes to it staying hot for your shower. Major perk for having a washer and drying rack for clothes! All the amenities were great. Overall, a wonderful place to stay. I would recommend to friends and family.

Great apartment in great location. Loved the little balcony which is a sun trap in the morning. Everything we needed for our stay in Porto. Great restaurant recommendations from the host which we managed to visit a couple.

We absolutely loved this place. The amazing view and balcony, spacious living room, washer and dryer rack, comfortable bed, super clean bathroom and linens- it was all just perfect! Also loved the location. It’s right next to a beautiful viewpoint of the city. 7 min walk to Harry Potter bookstore, 10 min walk to Sao Bento and the heart of Porto. Super convenient yet on a nice quiet street. Hosts were very communicative, helpful, and friendly. Absolute perfection! Dying to come back one day.
Merc's place is smack bang in the center of porto, and it's a lovely wee place. recently renovated and clean with a beaut view over the city. take your sweetie pie here, easy
Thank you for everything, Eva, I had a wonderful stay at your apartment! The view was incredible. Perfect spot to discover Porto ☺️

The apartment was immaculate, modern, quiet and extremely comfortable. It was walking distant to everything we wanted to see and do. I highly recommend the Merc place and will book with them again when I return to Porto.

We loved staying & visiting in Porto. The location was great- right in the old town with all the cobblestone streets. Lots of cafes tucked in the back streets. We walked all over & was very close to the Guggenheim. The apartment was a great mix of old and modern.
Great location and amazing view from the balcony. Open space layout, well designed. Only minus here is that the wooden floor is squeaking. Other than that it was terrific.
It was a very convenient place to stay. Close to things, restaurants and the like. We had a great stay.

We stayed at MERC for three days and had a pleasant stay. The street is in the old part of Porto with interesting buildings and scenery nearby. The flat is convenient with a well equipped kitchen and all neccessary amenities. Can recommend.

Fantastic stay in a centrally located well equipped apartment. The views from the balcony were a bonus!  The communication with Eva and Dani was quick and the self checkin instructions were easy. Highly recommend this place.
This is a wonderful place to stay.  Porto is such a great town to walk and site see.  This place to stay is perfect and just as advertised.

We had a great stay here! The location is really nice. It was easy to walk to everything we wanted to see in Porto. There is a wonderful view from the apartment as well as a fantastic viewpoint right around the corner.

Absolutely beautiful apartment. The view off of the balcony is amazing! I didn't have time to prepare meals, but the cabinets were fully stocked with all the necessary tools and utensils if I'd wanted to. A couple of minor hitches during my stay, but they mostly consisted of me not figuring out how to operate something, and getting a super-speedy explanation back from the host.
Wonderful location very near the Vitória Miradouro. Great communication throughout our stay. Washer was very useful and two bathrooms was a major win! Would stay here again!

A beautiful piece of paradise in Northern Portugal. Ana and Lucia looked after us very well, nothing was too much trouble even getting a log delivery in a thunderstorm. Ana is a proactive host without being intrusive and is always on hand to help. Saberamar is set in a beautiful woodland, not easy to find and an interesting drive but Ana gave clear concise instructions. Those who like us enjoy being in the middle of nowhere will love this property and never want to leave.

Apartment is fantastic. Very well lit and nicely decorated. A/C unit was very strong and was nice to come back to a cold place. Bedroom is in the front of the unit away from the A/C so it was a little warm. On the other hand, pull out couch is very cold as you're right under the A/C. Location was great - half way between top of the hill and the river. Google maps will you tell you to walk up 1000 steps to get to the unit, ignore that and walk around on the street. July 2024 - There is construction going on around the unit that you'll hear during the A.M. but wasn't too loud. Hosts were very accommodating with check-in. I'd stay here again for sure.

Our stay at Ana’s appartment was beyond expectation. The appartment is very complete and so beautifull. The property is huge and located in a beautifull green valley where you only hear the birds and the river that runs through the property. We stayed for 5 nights at Ana’s place. Wished we could have stayed longer. Ana’s is really the sweetest host. Shengavr Sina warm welcome and she gave us a lot of Information about things to do in the area, nice restaurants etc. We can recommend everybody to plan a holiday at Anna’s property. You will not regret to!
Thank you for a wonderful weekend in Porto, the house was beautiful, well located for the beach and comfortable. My friends and I had a wonderful weekend.
It ´s a wonderful tasteful house on a location close to the beach. The communiction with "feels like home" was perfect.

This is a stunning apartment, with a wonderful host. Immaculately clean.with so many thoughtful touches and supplies. Miguel is a champion host, so considerate and friendly, responding speedily to any communication. Cannot praise him and his beautifully decorated and outfitted apartment enough. There is a bus outside the door, a metro six minutes away and the central tourist street five minutes away. Miguel has compiled a great information manual to help you enjoy the city of Porto. Thank you a Miguel!

We had a wonderful time in Porto. The place of Miguel surely was part of the great experience. Great room and perfect location within walking distance of all the sights in the old centre of Porto. A nice warm wlcome by Miguel and his personal tips added to the short stay we had in Porto. The route he suggested was perfect for one full day.

Hallo Porto firehouse was an perfect place to stay. The apartment was very clean, well equiped with everything you need. Away from citynoise but on walking distance of all nice shops and hip places to eat. We would certainly recommend it to anyone else. Porto is a great city for a weekend getaway.

It is a very nice apartment, just as in the pictures, spacious, full equipped and the most important very neat. Very good location, just 10-15 minutes walk from the center. Our host Miguel was very kind and helpful. I would definetely recommend it!
This place is really great, we enjoyed our stay a lot. Miguel is extremely nice and helpful. I‘d come back any time

This was only our 2nd airbnb experience and we were very impressed.  Miguel is an excellent host, very thoughtful and accommodating.  Everything was spotlessly clean and extra touches were much appreciated.  Lovely space and although there were only 2 of us it would very easily accommodate 4.  Right in the bustling city centre and very easy to get to from the airport.  Highly recommend if you enjoy city centre living.

We loved our stay at Miguel’s place!  It was beautifully appointed with 2 bathrooms and an upstairs loft bed ! Miguel greeted us and made us feel completely at home!  We would love to stay there again. Also centrally located  to all sights !!!

This condo is very big and beautiful! 1 1/2 baths and lovely seating area. The location could not be more perfect for walking to everything! Miguel met us and was warm and welcoming! He left us wine, water, juice and biscuits. Coffeeshop on the corner and Pedestrian only shopping and dining a few blocks away. Very happy to have stayed here!

Miguel ‘s furnishings were excellent....all of the finest quality.  His assistance was above and beyond the norm.  Location was easy walk to preferred sites.  This is new construction of an old firehouse.  Very spacious.  You will  be pleased with selection.

We had great moments in Portugal. Beautiful country, great people. Miguel was a perfect host since our first contact.  My family felt like home the whole time. The place is incredible, well localized and very cozy. Definitely it was a right choice! Thank you Miguel!
Great apartment, great location, great host !! Not much else needs saying. A++ stay, can recommend :)
The apartment is great. There are many nice places to visit nearby. I would be happy to stay here again.

Wonderful apartment, tastefully furnished, and there is  a good large bed. We would highly recommend staying here. Miguel is a wonderful host. Very communicative, responsive and accommodating. We felt right at home. Thank you for your hospitality.

Absolutely loved our stay at Miguel’s place. First solo holiday and we were a group of young girls, felt very safe and secure. The place was clean, spacious and comfortable with everything you’d need. The apartment was within walking distance of the port, local shops and metro. The beach was only about 30 mins away by metro and there was a lidl close by too. Miguel was very responsive to our questions and left a lovely planner full of amazing activities to do in Porto. The only downside to the place is that the hot water in the shower ran cold after a few minutes. Apart from this, the apartment was practically perfect. Would definitely recommend and love to come back again soon.

Photos are more beautiful but the place was good. The neighborhood upon first impression doesn't look good but it is prime location for tourism. You are walking distance to EVERYWHERE and well served by metro and bus. It was easy to find parking at night close by. The place itself was well served. Functional kitchen with sufficient gadgets to cook a proper meal. Confortable bed and bathroom.

We stayed in the beginning of March, and temperature outside was from 10 to 16 degrees. Apartment had two air conditioners which kept all the place warm. Also it is rather far away from ocean, which is a huge plus for staying warm in cold periods. The place is huge two story apartment with everything to cook on site. It is in a stone throw from huge grocery store and metro station. As well as two stones away from tourist Mercado do Bolhão and other sightseeing's. Apartment is equipped with lots of really useful tourists guides and even some toys for kids. Not a critique, bit just a useful tips:  No noise after 8pm and on weekends. Keep that in mind if you travel with noisy kids. Also apartment is on the second floor accessible by narrow ladder. Overall our stay was wonderful. Miguel is very responsive and helpful host. Definitely recommended!
Miguel was very communicative and accommodating. In addition the space was well equipped and pleasant. Fantastic stay. I recommend.

Dare I can say this is the most beautiful house in Porto. We could enjoy the beautiful scene from inside and the every furniture in the house was beautiful. We really want to visit this house again ! This was the very very great experience for us!!!

Amazing place with an unforgetable view over the Douro river :) very nice furnished, very clean + the host very friendly and informative. Even if our flights were delayed for several hours and we arrived very late in the night, she accomodated us very friendly and took the time to recommend us good restaurants to eat and nice places to visit. We would definetly come back here. Highly recommended!

This is a very comfortable apartment in a great location for exploring Porto. When we arrived Tiago met us and showed us round the apartment. He also went out of his way to provide many suggestions for places to eat and things to do during our stay. We hope to return soon.

We had a great stay here in Porto, the place was much larger than we were expecting, with a lovely view over the river from the bedroom. It’s a super convenient location, close to everything on both sides of the river. Having a fan was great, as it just made it that bit more comfortable to sleep at night. A full kitchen and living room (even with an HDMI cable!) made it a great place to relax after a day of exploring the city. Highly recommend.

Nice spacious apartment with everything you need . Great location and fantastic view of the river. It can be a little noisy at weekend so we would bring ear plugs next time. We would definitely book again. There is a great bar around the back with an even better view of the river and the bridge.

Amazing view of the river made this stay very special. Perfect location with so many restaurants and tourist attractions in easy walking distance. Also the proximity to San Benton train station makes traveling in and out of the city so easy. The place is simple, very elegant, and clean with all the amenities you need.

We really enjoyed our stay at Lisa's place. Lisa was very kind and easy to communicate with. The apartment was spacious, luminous, and very very clean. Of course, the view on the river was a big bonus! As we were there in January, it did get cold in the apartment, but Lisa provided us with heaters and they kept us very warm in our bedroom. The location was also very convenient - we could walk everywhere and it's close to train station and also metro station. Thank you Lisa!

Excellent location, in the heart of the old city. The size was amazing also. As a couple you have room if someone needs to go to sleep early, and the other does not. We used the full size kitchen every day to make our breakfast. The washer to catch up on cleaning clothes from our long trip. Long term (3 day parking) was available for just about 30 plus Euros and an easy walk with luggage. We were given excellent recommendations for Fado, parking, places to eat. As noted it is a full kitchen. One of our best bookings.

This place is even BETTER, if possible, than it looks!!!  The location was amazing. The place is an huge value and this cannot be said enough! It was a very nice touch to be met upon arrival and pointed in the right direction for spectacular local referrals.

Loved the place so much, great location and more space than the pictures even show. We never had to walk more than 20 minutes to get where we wanted in Porto. Good wifi, good kitchen, washing machine was great to have.

Lisa’s apartment was in an excellent position to enjoy Porto!   It was walking distance to the Ponte Luis 1 and the bustling Ribeira area for all a tourist could want - restaurants, bars, boat hire, bike hire, port tasting and just at the top of the furnicular for when you need to get back home! The only draw back was a very strong mouldy smell so we had all windows open, but with no screens on the windows we had a serious mosquitoes problem!   But position wise it was just perfect.
We had a very good stay in Porto, the place is very conviennent to get around. The recommendations that Lisa gave us were great!

The location of the apartment is really good, close to the centre, the bridges and other points of interest, we barely used metro or taxi throughout our stay as a lot of things are in walking distance. Getting to the apartment from the airport is easy and convenient. Everything in the apartment is fit for purpose, even though the toilet and shower facilities are a bit of a squeeze. It is a basement so a bit humid as other reviewers have said, the fan provided made a huge difference. The host Lisa was amazing, she provided a very useful guide to Porto and communication was clear. Would recommend, good value for money.
Very central and had everything you needed. A bit dark and humid, but we were aware of that from the beginning. Got some good tips from Lisa. I will definitely recommend this place

The apartment is in a great location in Porto - near the train station & Ponte Luis bridge.  Close to most things you will want to do in Porto. The apartment is clean with everything you need for your stay.  Lisa is an excellent host and meets you upon arrival to show you everything you need to know about the apartment. She also provides great recommendations. I highly recommend this place.

Perfect location, the host greeted us upon arrival and gave us a map of the city and made many great recommendations. The apartment is perfectly located and very well equipped, the bedroom area is very spacious as well. Would definitely recommend!

Lisa is a proactive, responsive host who has an Airbnb very close to many landmarks of Porto, and good places to eat like Padeirinha Doce (breakfast) and Restaurante Marroco (veggie couscous lunch special). For these reasons alone, I recommend her place. Lisa’s place is a budget conscious place, which is something I expected from day 1. So I am not sure why people previously complained in here about it.  Read the ad! Anyway, I enjoyed staying at Lisa’s place with its quirks and all that. 5/5.

Overall the place is nice and the communication was easy. The open space was very nice and the AC worked great. Only thing I wish they had was an iron. For people traveling and having wrinkled clothing I feel this is a necessity for Airbnb hosts to provide. Especially with the price paid for this place.

Beautiful apartment overlooking the river. Teresa was great when checking in, giving great advice on local places to eat and things to see and do. The apartment is next to a church, and the bells are fairly noisy, but the apartment itself is well located and very well kept. I would heartily recommend.
Super cozy and beautiful apartment, had a wonderful stay in Porto. Perfect location, nice and helpful owners! Super recommended.

Super apartment! The location is great on the river. We were very comfortable and the place was very clean. They accommodated for a late check in but for a 20 euro charge. Would highly recommended! Was great having the AC to stay cool while we slept

We loved this apartment, spacious, modern, light and close to everything yet quiet and secluded. We were met by George who was very helpful with a map and tips on what to visit, restaurants, coffee etc.  many thanks, we absolutely loved Porto and if back will definately stay here again

We had a wonderful time in Marcia and Teresa's beautiful apartment - it's beautifully renovated, sparkling clean and cozy. It's right where you want to be - but be prepared to walk some hills to get anywhere in Porto (which is btw true for pretty much any location). Also, ideally don't bring a car, as it's hard to find parking. But thanks to wonderful Gaby, who also equipped us with helpful advice, we found a spot :) thanks again, guys!
This place was great! We enjoyed our stay here. Gabriela provided us with some great tips to explore Porto!

Nice flat, 5 mins walk to the restaurants along the riverfront. There is a view of the river, although don't expect one that's picturesque. There is a church opposite and the bells start chiming at 8.00 am. There is a small supermarket underneath, which is very handy.

If you're looking for a beautiful and romantic place for your vacation in Porto. Then you came to the right place. The place is absulutly stunning beautiful, and elegant. And Carla is just amazing. She is so attentive and nice,and even helped us to send something we accidently took from the airbnb in another city, with no extra charge. This is your place for sure.

Thank you very much for the nice stay in this lovely little apartment - Highly recommended. Tastefully decorated, great located and super comfy bed - even using limescale-repellent shower head:) All in all a great place to discover Porto from.

The room is lovely, clean and spacious with a great shower and a kitchen area with everything you need for making breakfast. The bed is very comfy and we got a great nights sleep. Views are nice and the location is perfect for most attractions, although this is Porto so be prepared to walk up some seriously steep hills which ever way you go. You are next to a church with a bell which will wake you up at 8am... but as we didn't visit the city to lie in bed, this was no problem!

everything was perfect, the location is great and Carla was so polite and friendly through messages. We checked in remotely and check out also. Porto was very beautiful and we will sure come again. Thank you Carla.

A perfect location to stay in during your stay in this lovely city. Clean, well equipped, very comfortable. A few minutes walk to to city centre. We will recommend it to family and friends. Our host Carla was effecient in her communications with us.

Had a good stay, nicely located apartment in Porto Old Town near river Douro. Aptmt was clean and cosy. Check-in flexible and very easy, no problems at all. Wifi could be faster. Would come here again.
a very nice place. clean, near the center, friendly, quiet and everything is available. You hear the church from 8 am till 8 pm but you get used to it. we will come back.
Great stay. Parking was secure but too far away to be practical.  We parked and picked the car up at the end of our stay.
Very nice experience in a historical setting. Carla was very helpful and responsible in helping us check in!
The place was really beautiful and located in a great spot with lots around that was walkable. Carla was really responsive, timely and helpful with recommendations. Thanks so much Carla!

We really enjoyed our stay at Carla’s place in Porto. Carla and her family were very nice and helpful, and the room was super comfortable and with great views from the windows. The earplugs were a very nice touch and definitely helped get a good nights sleep, even with the seagulls :-)
Really nice flat, very friendly and helpful owner. One thing to note if you are not an early bird - church across the street rings its bell starting 8AM, might wake up some people.
A great Airbnb that let us feel very cozy and part of the community. It’s close to the river, but a little far from the central shops and cafes. Carla is an amazing host. Would recommend!
Absolutely gorgeous apartment, very close to the centre. Carla and her family were incredibly welcoming and the place was spotless and just like the pictures. Loved it! Will try to come back❤️
Great place to stay with a window view of a church with the authentic azulejos. Host is very responsive and flexible with the check in time. Obrigada Carla!

Had a wonderful stay! Carla was incredibly hospitable, and responsive. She provided great recommendations and the apartment itself was very clean and looked like the pictures. Comfy bed with a working kitchen. Wonderful location too, most places we wanted to go to were walking distance. Highly recommend!
Great place to stay and a short walk to the river front and area of Ribeira and easy to commute to Sao Bento. very peaceful stay and would highly recommend.

Carla’s place was really lovely! It was an excellent location and a short walk to the main areas where we wanted to go. We loved the authentic neighborhood. There is a church right across the street and the bells do ring, which we enjoyed. This is one of our favourite airbnb experiences that we have had in our travels! Highly recommend!
We had a wonderful stay in Carla's beautiful apartment - it was conveniently located near the best bits of Porto and was very comfortable - highly recommended!

Very beautiful and clean. Carla was incredibly nice and even had a guide for us. It was loud when the church bells went off next to us in the morning, but nothing we couldn’t manage and Carla provided ear plugs! Very beautiful place.
We had a lovely time in Porto. The apartment gave easy access and walking distance to most amenities. Had a good information booklet with recommendations in. Good communication, thank you.

I LOVE this apartment! I spent my 60th birthday here - a solo trip to Portugal and Spain. Romantic Ribeira was a perfect place to begin my adventure. Carla even delivered a birthday cake and balloons for a celebration! She arranged airport transportation for me and was accommodating with regards to check in and check out. The apartment is gorgeous and clean and comfortable. The market below has everything you need. The view of the church and river are excellent!

Great place to stay in porto. Exactly what i needed. Perfect location, very near the river and lots of beautiful bits of town. most things easily walkable. Lots of natural light through the Windows, but great shutters, so dark and warm at night  (I visited in december). Really attractively laid out place, high ceiling, open plan, lots of room, yet cosy feel to it. Well equiped kitchen, good shower, aircon machine made it really comfortable througout. Big bed. Lots of effort had gone in here to make it excellent. Even a very pro looking bespoke guide book, for things of note near the building. Very happy I chose the place and would do again. All round excellent :)
The apartment was pretty clean and beautiful. It was so good to wake up with a view in the morning and Carla was very helpful we enjoyed🤗
Carla was a pleasure to deal with. My room was beautiful and very clean. The location was perfect and looking forward to coming back.
Great location near a market. Incredibly clean. Nice hot shower. Beautiful Airbnb just like the pictures.

We have a great time is Porto and Carla's apartment was superb ,  spotlessly clean , amazingly comfortable bed , walking distance to pretty much all the main sites . felt safe and secure. the shop below  was handy for anything you needed.   the church bells next door were nice to hear , although porto has so much to see and do we were hardly home to hear them.  . Great location and value for money..

Lovely place with a lovely host. We enjoyed staying at Carla's and felt like it looked like the listing. I'd recommend the stay to anyone. The only recommendation is to bring earplugs (or use the ones provided), there's a church with some musical bells 3 minutes to the hour during the day (so no naps) and as Porto is built up, some city noise.

The location was around 10 minutes walk from the main center, so very practical. The shop below has all the items that you may need like breakfast, fruit, fresh bread, etc. The seagulls outside are a little noisy first thing in the morning, however earplugs are supplied and you get used to this quickly. The room itself is very spacious and well decorated.
We had really nice and romantic 2 nights there. It is clean and good place. Walking distance to center.

We really recommend this appartment. ORM helps with a lot of tips and services. It is very nice located in the middle of the city centre (this also means it could be loud during the nights). In only 10-15 min you can walk to the River Douro. The area close to the appartment is full with great restaurants and bars. The appartment was very clean!!! :-)  We also recommend the breakfast service. Very good quality.
As accurate as the photos. Nice, clean space in a renovated building. Convenient access to lots of great restaurants and bars and as a base for exploring Porto.
Nice location, good place for a couple. Early check in, ... only small downside was some street noise :).
Great apartment, clean, comfortable, good location but very loud until late at night and earlyish in the morning due to  building works. Otherwise great location but take ear plugs.

Very nice! The location is brilliant, the check in was very smooth and the person greeting us even gave us a lot of cool spots to visit in the city that we otherwise wouldn’t have known about! Highly recommended

This is a nice and comfortable place and the hoste(Teodoro) is someone very nice, always willing to help ;and I recommend this ofcourse.I'm looking forward to be in Porto again and will be in the same place for sure.

Great flat, just right for the four of us. Location is great, the flat very clean, just the right size, nothing too much or too little. Teodoro was a great host and we recommend staying with him. Private Parking Thanks Teodoro Sónia

We really enjoyed our night at Teodoro’s place! It was exactly as described. He was good at communicating the move in and move out instructions and offered some suggestions of things to do for our short time in town!
Easy check in. Apartment fulfilled our expectations. Clean and tidy. Could have a better sound proof, but for us it was no problem at all.

Great house with a wonderful pool, large bedrooms and a bathroom in each one. We went with family members from all across the world for a wedding that was taken place nearby and it was simply perfect because we were all together but had our privacy at the same time. We would definitely recommend Valter’s place!

Very nice house in a quite neighborhood. Everything was very clean and the pool was larger than expected. Even the lawn was being mowed when we where absent. The  only Problem was the check in and check out. Since the Madame assisting Valter only speaked portugese. But nevertheless we figured a way out to communicate.

Vaulter’s villa is lovely and the pictures are exactly what the villa looks like. We needed to be close to Braga and close to the beach and this location worked perfect. Ines was extremely helpful with any queries we’d have and when there were any issues during our stay they were rectified swiftly. The pool was amazing and we hardly used the aircon since the house stayed cool at night quite well. Highly recommend, they were extremely flexible and helpful.
Beautiful villa in a stunning location wasn’t to far to Porto city. The host was very helpful before and while staying at property. Would highly recommend. Definitely worth the money

The host was flexible for check in and check out.  The house had infiltration through the walls, making the house quite cold at night as well as humid and there was a stain on the floor in the hall. Some kitchen utensils were not clean to use. Other than that, the location of the house is good and quiet and peaceful.

Our stay at Miguel's place was just perfect. The apartment itself was beautiful and located so close to everything we wanted to see. It was just about a 10 minute walk down to Luis I Bridge & the Douro River with all the shops and restaurants nearby. The apartment was extremely spacious and very clean. Miguel was very responsive when it came to any questions that we had and was so helpful recommending parking locations for our rental car. The apartment also had an amazing view of the Douro right from the living room window! I would definitely stay at Miguel's place again and recommend it to any friends visiting Porto as well. Thanks Miguel!
The apartement is really nice, clean, with large beds and useful kitchen. Miguel is so nice, he gives you lot of tips to visit the city and enjoy your stay. I highly recommand this place !

Miguel's place is beautiful, comfortable, and well-located just across the bridge for Porto's old town, and Miguel himself is easy to interact with and quick to reply when contacted. Highly recommended.

Miguel was a fantastic host who was extremely responsive and easy to communicate with.  His love of Porto was contagious, and his recommendations of restaurants, bars and cellars were spot-on. The beautiful apartment was in an great location that was near the port cellars and a close walk across the bridge to the city center. It was modern and impeccably clean. We are already planning our next trip to Porto, and will stay in Miguel's apartment again!
Miguel's place was a fabulous base to explore Porto from. It was close to the buzzing restaurants on the river, walkable to the old town and was very stylish.

The apartment was exactly as advertised.  Convenient to walk to Porto or hop on the train practically right outside. Spotless, clean, and fashionably furnished. I found it perfect for my wife, daughter, and me.  Good value for money spent.

We enjoyed our stay at Miguel’s apartment. Comfortable beds. Great kitchen amenities. Proximity to Jardim do Morro is an asset—we enjoyed a Sunday afternoon there watching the sun set with great music and vibrant social scene. We parked our rental car nearby easily. Easy and prompt communication with our host.
This is a perfect place for 4 people. Miguel is responsive and helpful. The location is ideal!
Miguel's place is very clean and stylish. Although we can only take a hot bath for every 1 hour, it is not a problem for me and my friends. Miguel is a helpful host and I recommend this place.

Great experience. Strongly recommend.  The place was super clean. Very conveniently located walking distance from tourist sites. 2 min from metro station. Plenty of parking around. Check-in/out was seamless. A+
Wonderful place, very clean, near the city center (and 30 seconds walk to the tram station), plus Miguel was a wonderful host and answered everything we needed. Super, really!

Good sized 2bdrm apartment, a short walk from wineries and Luis bridge. The kitchen is well stocked with any items you may need. As promised you can see the Douro river from the sitting room window. We had a wonderful stay and wouldn't hesitate to stay here again

Miguel’s place is in a brilliant location,  close to the river and within walking distance to all the main tourist attractions. It was very easy to get to and from the airport using the metro. Miguel was a great host as he responded to all messages very quickly. It was also a very convenient and simple check in as you are given a key code rather than needing a key (an added bonus throughout the stay, as we were in a group and would sometimes go back to the apartment separately). I would bring ear plugs if you are a light sleeper as although it’s a quiet area we could hear some noise in the night. Overall, a fantastic place to stay and we had a brilliant time. Thanks Miguel!
Nice place, nice host, would reccomend to a friend. Lovely view from the living room window.

We really enjoyed Miguel’s. It was comfortable and very clean. While we initially thought the location might be inconvenient, we were actually very happy to be in a quit neighborhood away from the very touristy areas. The park down the street was lovely and the views were beautiful.
Great flat in a great location. We stayed as Corona was just kicking off and the city and its people couldn't have been more accommodating.

It is a great place to stay in Porto. Very convenient self check in was very important for us, as we came late at night. Thanks Miguel for the tip for the cheap parking!!! The apartment was very clean and we loved the stylish details, the bicycle at the wall, different pictures and stone walls give a special touch and made our stay very cosy and unforgettable.
Great place! Very clean and a nice location. Easy to find and to self check in. We were happy with our stay.

We had a wonderful stay at Miguel’s. The apartment was very comfortable, and we had everything we needed. The location was perfect with only a 5 minute walk to the Gaia riverfront and a 15-minute walk into Porto. Miguel’s communication was excellent.

Great location, nice place, good for families. Make sure you pay for parking if you park on the street. Unfortunately, we got a ticket; however, highly recommend this place. It was so convenient using the key punch in for check in and check out.

We enjoyed a clean and comfortable stay.  We were able to walk to many places including down to the river, which is just behind Miguel's neighborhood.  Parking was a bit challenging as expected for a busy city, but with some patience we were able to park right by the entrance.
Miguel place was perfect. Everything we needed within walking distance and a nearby parking garage for our rental car. Place was clean spacious and cozy. I would definitely recommend 5*****
I had the pleasure the stay at Miguel's place with my family. it was a lovely location and had everything we needed. I recommend 😄

I loved Susana’s place، Centralized location, perfct to see the city centre and all it’s attractions. The restaurant is around and the famous street is walkable. However, i loved Susana welcoming, once I arrived she was there and even stayed with me to give me an idea about the most important places to visit and restaurants. Susana was adorable I’d recommend here place for any one. Thanks Susana. See you again.
Susana is a wonderful and welcoming host. Her place is in a central location to all that Porto has to offer as well as public transportation. I would highly recommend staying here.

Miguel’s place was simply amazing. Check-in was very convenient and the metro was just a 2 min walk from the apartment. The view from the living room window was spectacular. He had the basic amenities and his apartment felt homely and peaceful. What I really loved is that he was always quick with his responses with whatever questions we had. Would definitely recommend Miguel’s place. Thank you for a wonderful stay.
MIGUEL’s information for parking and easy entry to the apartment was greatly appreciated. Well situated with all amenities close by. Apartment very cosy and very clean. Thank you for such a nice day.
