We had a wonderful stay in Miguel’s home! Everything was super clean and the house has everything you need for your stay ! The location is fantastic and extremely walkable, nice quiet neighborhood and great restaurants. We loved our time here and will definitely be coming back !
Great place with a view,  short ride to the city center, responsive host. Felt at home.
Miguel's house is in a great location, within walking distance of the Moru Park, the Luis Bridge, and the Porto wine district. We made many good memories of Porto here. Thank you.
Miguel’s place is clean, renovated and easily accessible. Perhaps it is because of the rain in the city, this place smelled & felt damp when we stayed.

Beautiful property which has everything in it . Very well situated and easy to get around . Our host was great to give us many tips on where to visit and things typical to do in Porto .  We had a great holiday in Miguel’s and Claudia’s home 🏠  😊

Private balcony area was a beautiful addition to Miguel’s place and the apartment was in an excellent spot that was easily walkable to many of Porto’s beautiful attractions. The quaint touches added charm to the apartment. We were very happy with our time in Miguel’s place.
We had a great stay at Eduardo's apartment. It was comfortable and central enough to the rest of the city. Thank you!

Eduardo is so lovely and kind! Replies to whatsapp. Place is super clean and quaint and right at the riverfront. Bathroom super updated w a nice shower. Wine & water waiting for us. He helped us get a reservation :) no issues w the place  There are parking garages around apt -- if you're driving make sure to. Heck the location and park there as parking / finding the apt can be difficult if you're driving. But it's in such a cute location I wouldn't want you to joy stay - just come prepared! Love Portugal!!

Eduardo and his niece were very welcoming and nice. They were available at any moment to answer our questions or help us. The appartment is nice and just 2mins walking from the Douro River. It's located in a very beautiful and lively neighbourhood.

Eduardo’s place was 5 star all around and a perfect spot in Porto with our kids.  Check in was easy (and he arranged a taxi from the airport for us) and the apartment is in the heart of the lively and beautiful Ribeira neighborhood.  The apartment layout was perfect for kids.  We love being able to walk around the city and would definitely stay here again.
Great place and great location! Right on the river! Eduardo greeted us and took time to explain local spots. We look forward to coming back to Porto and seeing more of this beautiful place!
The location of this place was amazing! Just a few steps away from all the happenings Porto has to offer with great views of the bridge.

Really nice apartment. Enough space to 4 for people and everything you need is present. Communication with Eduardo was super easy as he quickly responded and adopted to our check in willings. I would definitely stay there again.

Eduardo's Ribeira apartment is in a great location right on the waterfront. There are lots of restaurants and bars on the Cais da Ribeira and there are 2 grocery stores nearby. It was very easy to walk (uphill) and/or take a bus to reach other areas of Porto. The apartment was immaculate and very quiet. It was the perfect spot for our week in Porto.
Beautifully furnished place that is convenient yet quiet. Eduardo is friendly and responsive, and check in/out was very smooth
Eduardo’s place was excellent. Check in was easy and instructions to find the place were excellent.  Great location right near the river and close to many things. Definitely recommend!

Had a little bit trouble to find the places by car. Only the car have a access code to enter. It was easy to get it and out. The place near river and lots to do around . Eduardo is really nice and quick response. He left a port wine on the table with five glasses. The room is clean and we felt like home. We will recommend our friends who come to Porto.

My mobile phone needed charging so I couldn’t retrieve the instructions to self check in. Eduardo thankfully was on hand to help. We were in touch with him a lot as we had a lot of questions and his response was always prompt. He was an excellent host I would highly recommend.

Great, central location. Close to everything you want to see. Very clean and comfortable. Mattresses are thin and very firm so not the most comfortable for our old back and hips. The sofa was very comfortable though. The fans kept us cool and comfortable in the heat. Eduardo and Ani offered restaurant recommendations which were really good. They also arranged for a taxi to pick us up on our last day for airport transport which was super helpful and greatly appreciated. They were very friendly and prompt in all communications. Highly recommend this place!

Brilliant location, right in the heart of the busy area but tucked away so very little noise carries to the apartment. Everything was walkable with ease and we were right on the doorstep of the river front with loads of eating and drinking places.  The apartment was perfect for us as a family of 5 and it had everything we needed. Our host, Eduardo was always in touch checking everything was OK. He was great.

Thank you so much for letting us stay at your place. Everything was great. Great location and super clean. Great host that accommodated my family with a crib when needed. Also super great host that contacted me after I left my purse behind and ensured I got it back ! Thank you so much for everything ! Will be looking to stay again am next year !

Joao and Andreia's place was a wonderful and cozy home away from home. Their beautiful apartment exceeded all of our expectations with beautiful furniture and decor and very comfortable beds. They even left us a delicious bottle of port and yummy fruits. We stayed with our 3 yr old and 4 month old daughter and it was perfect family hideaway for us as it was so nice and quiet but central to all the great sights. We had a wonderful time and would highly recommend staying here. Muito obrigado!

This place was a real gem. The perfect home in Porto. Close to everything and so incredibly cozy and warm. It’s a gorgeous home and really relaxing place to stay. Andreia was super helpful and wonderful to work with.

The nicest Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in - absolutely stunning apartment. Beautifully done up, perfectly clean, and the little extra touches were amazing. I cannot recommend Andreia and João’s place enough. We came from NZ and their hospitality and kindness is unrivalled - they looked after us beautifully. Lovely people with a lovely apartment.

This apartment was amazing. Central, stylish and comfortable. Andreia and João were perfect guests, stocking the fridge with water, providing fruit, teas etc. It felt like being at home. They were also very helpful in terms of giving us city tips and being available if we had any questions. Great experience.
João & Andreia’s apartment was absolutely lovely and exactly as pictured.  Very spacious and in an ideal location.  Would definitely recommend for your next stay in Porto!

My daughter (19) and I had a fantastic stay at João & Andreia’s place and would absolutely definitely book again. Great communication and check-in.  Very warm and hospitable people. Great local advice.  The place is very conveniently located for walking in Porto, restaurants and shopping.  It is a modern, built-out basement space with good outside light.  Two full bedrooms and baths and well equipped kitchen.  Very nicely and comfortably decorated. Excellent in every way.

Joao and Andreia were exceptionally friendly and helpful hosts.  Their Porto apartment is beautiful and in a fantastic location within an easy walk to explore the beautiful city of Porto. When we arrived we were welcomed with fruit, juice, water, coffee, cooking basics and of course some port wine.  This really felt like a home away from home...thank you.

Enjoyed staying at this apartment. It was close to good restaurants and a good base for sight seeing around Porto. We had a baby travelling with us and the hosts organised a cot and high chair to be available.

This property is beautifully appointed and very comfortable. João and Andreia are gracious in their welcome, in providing great advice on Porto and so helpful during the stay. The location is a comfortable walk to lots of Porto’s main attractions. A great find. As an added bonus there is a good cafe a few doors down toward the river. Fantastic coffee and great fresh, simple food. Look out for Bird of Passage. Thank you João & Andreia for all your kindness.
It was nice to be able to stay in a nice and cozy house. The owner was very kind and sweet. The location was also excellent and perfect.

Joao and Andreia are truly super hosts. Their kind and warm welcome into their apartment makes you feel as if you just arrived  in your own home.  They are very generous as well and received us with staples such as crackers, juice, sparkling water, fresh fruit and a bottle of Porto.  The apartment is beautifully decorated and sparkling clean. There are tasteful details all throughout the interior and exterior spaces.  You will find a well stocked kitchen with everything you’ll need to have a very pleasant stay.  Communication was excellent and clear.  I highly recommend them as hosts as well as their apartment.  It was a memorable vacation.  Thank you!
Stunning place, beautifully finished. Like a five star hotel! Probably the nicest AirBnB we've stayed in. Super friendly and helpful hosts. Loved it and would totally recommend.

João and Andreia are the BEST hosts. They welcomed us like we were their friends in their stylish apartment with fresh fruits, porto wine, tea, fruit juice and fresh water bottles!  This appartement is way better than a suite in a luxury hotel:) Great location near all the amenities including shops, restaurants, city bus tour, bakery,... Perfect!

A tastefully furnished, Immaculately clean and quiet apartment in a great location to walk around Porto.  Joao and Andriea were great hosts - excellent communicators, helpful recommendations and maps, lovely welcome gifts of fruit, port and wine ; very responsive to our requests - all in all, an ideal place to stay in Porto; highly recommended!!
Joao and Andreia's place is very stylish and comfortable.  And it's location can't be beat.  They were very welcoming and gave us many useful hints of where to visit and where to dine.

A most lovely place, terrific location, wonderful amenities and hosts however, the kitchen has ants that will find anything left on the counter and the bathrooms had an awful sewer smell with sewer flies. They clearly know they have a sewer problem as the strong smell of deodorizer tried to cover it when we checked in. Until the host  resolve the issues, it could be free but I wouldn't stay there. I'm sure they will as they have a terrific business as they have multiple units.  A beautiful place...that needs urgent issues addressed.
Lovely apartment in a very good location of Porto. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it. The welcome basket and personal introduction by Rita was excellent!

My husband and two of our friends spent 3 nights at João & Andreia's flat and couldn't have asked for a nicer place. The hosts' friend (I think her name was Rita - she was wonderful!) was waiting outside when we arrived and explained in great detail all of the nearby attractions. There was also a bottle of port waiting in the kitchen and well-stocked drawer of coffee, teas, and little snacks. I would definitely stay here again and recommend this place to anyone.
Wonderful stay.  Thank you Andreia for all your help and kindness.  Your place is lovely with an attention to detail that is unmatched.  Great location, beautifully new apartment and lovely host.

Beautiful apartment with in walking distance of all main sights, shops, restaurants and bars. The apartment is spotlessly clean, well equipped and very comfortable. The lovely  welcome gift of  Fruit, water, coffee and Port was a perfect touch. Andreia is really friendly and helpful . Can definitely recommend this apartment.
The flat was perfect in a great location. The host made us feel very welcome and even left snacks and drink for arrival! Lovely convenient and clean flat. Would highly recommend.

I doubt that there is a better located and appointed 2 bedroom unit in Porto. All services are within a few moments walk of the unit. The water front is 5 minutes walk away. Buses two minutes and Sao Bento maybe 10 minutes walk. The apartment is clean, clean and artfully appointed. Joao and Andreia are extremely and professional hosts. One of the best Airbnbs we have stayed in.

Our stay in Porto was great and this is really thanks to that Airbnb appartement. We traveled with a 16 months old baby and god knows it can be sometimes very hard. The place was clean, well decorated, quiet, fully equipped (baby chair and bed). There was also a welcome gift: a bottle of Porto, fresh fruits and bottles of water. It’s close to the historical city center and there are 2 supermarkets at 5mn walking.

This was the perfect Airbnb for a weekend in Porto, I would highly recommend it. The apartment was well located and super comfy, with air con for hot nights! We spent most of our time outside the apartment exploring but it seemed well set up for cooking and staying in. The terraces are amazing for sitting with a drink too, and the welcome bottle of port was extremely welcome. Thanks for a great stay!

Beautiful apartment very central. Everything can be reached by foot. Beds are really comfortable, we were welcomed with a few thoughtful details. Joao and Andreia were super accommodating and always available, would definitely recommend their place when in Porto.

This is a fantastic AirBnB property in a great location with great hosts. Property looks as good in person as it does in the pictures. It is clean and comfortable and has everything one can need. The AC worked well and the hot water was strong and plentiful.  The hosts went out of their way to help us at check-in and check-out and to make our stay comfortable. They offered nice gifts upon arrival and gave great recommendations on things to do, places to eat, and sights to be seen.  A+ experience that I recommend to everyone.
Fantastic stay, in a lovely place. Great touches with the welcome and very easy check-in/out.

On our recent trip to Porto we stayed at Joao and Andrea’s place and it was just perfect for the four of us. The accommodations were clean and the location perfect for getting around town. We took Bolt ride service as well and never had an issue. The only thing I feel it was missing was a basic coffee maker. There was an espresso machine but we don’t drink that.  I would definitely recommend this place for anyone visiting beautiful Porto. Perfect place for two couples or a family of four.

We loved everything about this apartment!  It was modern,clean and spacious - in a great location, walking to everything.  If i had a question they responded immediately with great information.  Loved, loved... Oh and you have outside area which was fantastic to have as well!!!  The porto and fruit was a very nice touch too :)

Very very very nice apartment. Fully equipped. Located in the city center. Very quiet place. One stair down to get access. Grocery store around the corner. We were welcomed with Port and fruits :-). We recommend highly.

We loved the apt, it had all we needed and the welcome basket of fruit and port was a lovely touch. Rosa and her companion, who greeted us were very welcoming and informative.  One very small thing I would suggest is to have non slip mats on shower floors or a grab rail and perhaps another hook for towels.  We did so enjoy our stay in the apt and would happily recommend it or stay here again if we return to the great city of Porto. A big thank you to Andreia and Joao.

This is a great apartment. It is quiet and peaceful as at the back of other apartments with two terraces. Great security as 3 doors to get through from the street. The terraces were either straight out from the bedrooms or one just up front he steps from the basement apartment which is under the hosts house. Everything is on your doorstep. 10 minutes walk to the major shopping strip, 10 to the major food market, 10 to either Balhao ( this line takes you straight to the beach) or san Bento metro. Lots of good restaurants within 5 minutes walk. 3 Supermarket within 5. Buzzy atmosphere nearby. If I return to Porto this is where I would stay. The hosts were incredibly responsive and helpful.

Joao & Andreia’s place is beautifully decorated and very comfortable.  It is in a great location downtown.  We were able to walk to all the sights we were interested in visiting.  There are lots of restaurants nearby.  Joao and Andreia very kindly let us drop off our bags and check in a bit early. I would highly recommend staying at Joao and Andreia’s place when you are visiting Portugal.

We had a wonderful stay in João and Andreia’s place. It is located easy walking to all the sites in old town. Being located in a courtyard like location made it very quiet at night. Would gladly stay again and recommend to family and friends.
We had a lovely stay. Andreia was responsive. It’s was extremely nice for a basement apartment.  Port, fruit and water were provided by the host which was a very nice touch.
The unit was clean and neat. Check-in was easy and the unit was well located. We had everything we needed.
Fabulous holiday destination, great local knowledge on arrival, thank you Grace, quiet, comfortable, well appointed accommodation, superb communication with hosts, thank you

João and Andreia’s apartment was perfect for a short stay. It is located in an area where there is plenty of restaurants and bars to choose from. We were greeted by Graca who was lovely and gave us plenty of recommendations on what to do and where to go in Porto. The apartment was very clean and there were a few extras which were greatly appreciated. Definitely recommend this apartment
Very nice and cosy apartment, located in a center of the city in walkable distance to all amenities. Highly recommended!!!
Very good location, everything is close and you can go by walking to every place of the city. The apartment is clean and perfect for a couple!
Great ace. Close to the centre and nice restaurants. Street noise is there but not at al irritating. Very nice place to stay.
Everything was awesome! Vitor’s friend met us on time - although we were arriving very late in the evening, showed us the apartment and gave a few good suggestions about the city

It was great staying over at this cozy apartment in Porto and the host has been so welcoming and accommodating, even though we arrived very late! Thank you so much and definitely recommend! Great locations, close to everything and great host. 😊

My sister and I had a very pleasant stay. The apartment is cosy and the location is perfect. The place was clean and the bed is nice. Elisio (Vitor’s host) was very friendly and had some nice recommendations.
The Loft is cozy and has everything necessary. Super central within a beautiful neighbourhood. Elisio is a top notch host - by all means. We are keen coming again!
Highly recommended for its location. The communication with Victor’s great, he was very helpful with everything we needed. Next time we go to Porto, we will definitely stay at Victor’s.
Great location and close to everything. Shower was broken, but a part from that we enjoyed our stay and would return.
Great location close to all the sites. Vitor was also very helpful in providing recommendations on sites to see

Photos exactly what it is like inside. Nice room, construction of a morning and can hear people walking past partying but did not bother us as we are deep sleepers or were out most of the time.  Perfect location, communication was amazing and they helped with everything we needed. Would highly recommend 10/10 value for money.

The apartment was clean and had everything we wished for. It is located in the very center of Porto and we were able to walk literally anywhere. We slept well and the bathroom was nice, it was not too warm and at night we could open the windows. The windows are also nice for taking pictures. Elisio was very forthcoming, sending us tips and places where we should go and also a place where we could park the car for a very cheap price. We would definitely come back to this apartment!
Great location, the host was super on top of us constantly which we really appreciated! Thank you!
Perfect little crashpad very near Cleriogos Tower. Great base to explore the area. Check in was very straightforward.

Place is in a great location! Catch the sunset just a few blocks away, great food near by and easy access to transportation. It was location above a bar so it did get a little noisy at night but it mostly got quiet after 1am. I do recommend the location regardless.

This place was right in the middle of the action. Definitely noisy but I was ready for that and very worth it with the location and price! Victor was so responsive and had great recommendations for the area and excellent hospitality. Quick to help when a small issue came up. Would definitely stay again!
We had a lovely stay - the apartment was in a great location with a gorgeous balcony. We would definitely stay again!

Vitor's place was really lovely and cozy, great location for exploring Porto. Kettle with tea provided and having a fridge was handy. Quite loud at night so take earplugs if you're a light sleeper :) would defo stay here again!
The place was exactly as expected; centric, clean, cozy and with charm. I stayed for two days and the location was just perfect!

Perfect location to travel Porto! It's located really close to the city center so it's perfect for tourism :) It looked exactly like the photos and was really clean! Ellios was very responsive as well. Would highly recommend to anyone!

Carmen is a gracious and wonderful host.. The property exceeded our expectations and we had a marvelous time. The vegetables and home made wine from the property were extra special and yummy.  Carmen was most helpful and lovely to speak with. The dogs were super friendly and greeted us happily every morning. What an introduction to Portugal! Love!!!

Excellent host in wonderful country location. Walking distance to a lovely village with slate houses. The pool exceeded our expectations. Easy drives to Porto, Braga and Guimares. Short drive to the train station for a 30 minute journey into central Porto. The garden was full of fresh figs, apples, pears, sharon fruit and tomatoes. Loved by both adorable friendly dogs. Highly recommended.

Daniel´s apartment is very beautiful, comfortable and located in a great location. However, our check-in experience was a bit complicate; the cleaning was not done on our arrival and we had to wait one hour until the cleaning was done and we could enter the apartment. This was a bit frustrating.

This is a great apartment, in a great city, with a great host! A nice clean and stylish flat, within easy walking distance of everything a tourist could want to see in the city. Check-in / Check-out was a smooth and easy process, and Daniel even helped arrange airport transfers and gave advice on Porto like how to get football tickets.
Daniel's place was amazing. The place is centrally located and it's close to the train station and restaurants. Daniel was great as a host and in giving us ideas of things to do and see.

A nice flat in a very small and quiet road, in a very authentic neighbourhood.   Comfortable for 5 people, it is on the second (top) floor of a small building with charm, overlooking gardens at the back.  Very close to a good supermarket, and not too far from the centre.  We had a good stay!
Perfect appartement for a stay in porto! The place was very clean, and walking distance from everything. Great coffee shop for breakfast near the appartement (Combi).

Good location to explore Porto in a calm area of the city. Spatious for 2 couples and a single or for parents with kids. Even though it was very hot in Porto when we visited, the apartment was cool (and fans were foreseen). Check in was smooth, communication went well through text message. Very good value for money, would recommend!
Had a great stay in Porto. Lovely apartment with plenty going on around it and also right next to the metro. Highly recommend

Communications with Gustavo was great and easy. It was a lovely apartment with enough space for the 9 of us, very well located but still quiet. The terrace in the backyard is a real plus! Only toilet paper was calculated very thight, and should have been more, when hosting 9 people.  But besides that, all very well and can be recommended - even great to stay for a week! Thank you!

Very nice place. Spacious and comfortable with a terrace, which serves well for a morning coffee. We were a group of 7 and it was OK, but if you are singles then the max I would recommend is 5 because there are 2 double beds. The location is also central, close to cafes and restaurants (but a 10-minute walk to Rua de Paris where the night bars are). The host is helpful, speaks very good English, and was easy to communicate with.
Stefan's place was ideal for us. It's really spacious and in a great location. Stefan's communication was great and the apartment was very clean.

Overall good place. Good location, very walkable, and responsive host. Bathroom situation leaves a lot to be desired - no basic toiletries and downstairs shower is moldy, shower head doesn’t have a hook so just hangs in the tub.

This Airbnb was beautiful, it was very spacious and the garden terrace was ideal. I couldn’t mark it higher than 4 stars due to the lack of aircon. There were 4 people staying in an attic room with a tiny window and it got unbearably hot, it was difficult to sleep.
Great location and great place to stay. Actually is bigger than it looks in the photos.  Would definitely recommend

Teresa's house has personality to sell. On several levels, with glass walls (but good curtains for the night), well renovated, furnished with taste and pragmatism, very clean. It made our stay in Porto a unique experience (this is the beauty of Airbnb). Location slightly off-center compared to the area of ​​major tourist interest (20-25 minutes on foot from the river) but metro station (Trindade) very close. Teresa was extremely helpful. An experience to highly recommend.

Fabulous apartment and location.  Teresa was a wonderful host and could not have done more to make our stay more informed or welcome.  The accommodation was spotless and had all we needed for a great stay.  Highly recommended.

We had a wonderful time at Teresa's place. The space was beautiful and we had plenty of room as a group of 7. The location is perfect for exploring Porto without being too much in the centre of it all. Teresa herself is an excellent host and clearly wants all of her guests to have a great time. She is easy to contact and very accommodating with any requests. Hoping to make it back to Porto in the future and would definitely stay at Teresa's place again.
Teresa is a great host really nice and welcoming! The place is big with lot of bathroom we were nine and had a great time!

My friends and I stayed at Teresa's apartment while we went to Primavera Festival, and it was perfect. everything was exactly as described and the terrace was lovely. Teresa was very responsive, and the location was great.

Tersa and George were brilliant hosts an went out of their way to help us when we arrived. Teresa is very responsive to messages prior and during the stay and the accommodation was fantastic,  in a great location. As a group of 8 of us this was a great deal and I would definitely return! Thankyou so much for a great stay 😊

Teresa and Jorge were great hosts, very accommodating and sharing so much helpful recommendations and tips about Porto. We are happy to have stayed at her place that Anna their housekeeper cleaned so well for us. Thank you again Teresa and Jorge
I can’t say enough about how helpful Teresa was. Her recommendations were spot on and made our stay very enjoyable.

Teresa was extremely helpful and communicative right from when I booked the apartment, months in advance! Check in was technically 3pm but we arrived at 12 noon and there was no problem with our arrival time — the cleaner had finished and was there to welcome us and show us round the apartment. Prior to arrival, Teresa sent us lots of recommendations for places to see, museums, and restaurants, as well as detailed instructions on how to get to the property from the airport. She was very responsive to all messages at all times. There is a lovely large terrace to sit on at the back of the apartment. The location is great, within easy walking distance of the centre.
We had good time staying in Teresa’s house, everything was great, thank you so much Teresa!
Thank you very much Teresa for a great stay. Teresa is a very responsive host and provide clear guidance and suggestions of great local places!! Thank you again!

This stay was all we hoped for we went with a group of friends, the place is huge. Very comfortable and sparkling clean. Alina was the best made un feel welcome and gave us great tips.  For sure a place for a group of travelers our couples every room had its own bathroom.  Thank you for a wonderful time in Porto

Teresa’s place was wonderful for our group. We were welcomed with a glass of port and ice cream.  The outdoor terrace is a great feature to sit and have coffee or a drink. Teresa was very helpful in recommending a wonderful place to eat just up the street.  Authentic Portuguese meal in a family atmosphere.  We had a wonderful stay.

We came to Porto for the first time with a group of 6. Teresa was very accommodating and responsive. The house was in a good location and walking distance to everything. The house was also very clean, and spacious for a big group like ours. Highly recommend!
We had a great time in Porto with our group of friends! Would definitely recommend this apartment 🤩

Dino & Ines have a really lovely place in the centrum of Porto. You can walk nearly to every attraction in Porto from the apartment.  We had a really pleasant welcome with some cake, wine and cheese. Also, Dino showed me all sights one has to see in Porto on the map, as well as gave me lots of recommendations for restaurants. You have to try the Sandwich! The apartment it self is beautiful and in mint condition, including everything you need to make you feel like home!

Dino and Ines' apartment was perfect for our long weekend in Porto - very stylishly done up, spotless, and they've thought of all the amenities you could need. The kitchen is very well equipped, all the appliances are modern and they've used the space really cleverly. They were incredibly welcoming hosts and were always easy to contact when we had questions, they also offered us loads of tips about where to visit and what to do in the city.

Dino &Ines are very nice people, they prepared a homemade cake(very delicious) and a bottle of wine before we arrive. The apartment is the best I have ever met, beautiful, decorated with very decent furnitures and equipment, very modern and classic. The location of their apartment is very good as well, closed to 2 Metro station, 10 mins to São Bento station and city center, by walking, and also, there is a big supermarket called Froiz near the apartment. If you are Chinese, there is also a Chinese supermarket near the apartment. Most importantly,  Dino & Ines will give you very detailed tips about traveling in Porto, you will like here!
Lovely lovely hosts who provide you all the information you need to know, even before reaching the city. Thank you Dino and Ines for sharing your beautiful home with us.

if it was possible to give 10 stars I'd give them to Ines and Dino ! I can't describe how wonderful they are, so helpful and kind. The appartement is beautiful, a real nest where you feel comfortable, at home. Well furnished, decorated, situated. They gave me lots of tips and informations and I've had wonderful time with them. Definively, they gave to Porto a touch of magic. in a signle word : FANTASTIC ! Minh, and Farah
While I was there, I was really comfortable. dino &lnes is very lovely and kindly!!!!

Dino and Ines place is great. We were welcomed with a welcome basket of local goods. It was all excellent. The accommodations were amazing. The place was very stylish and comfortable. We felt very safe. Dino did a very good job offering suggestions and guiding us through the must see and eat places. I would absolutely recommend and would absolutely visit again.  Thanks Dino and Ines.
Absolutely amazing apartment in a perfect location. All the amenities were up to standard and the space was sparkling clean. Dino and Ines made the stay a 10/10. Thank you and we will be returning!

Great space and very well located. It's a short trip from the main spots in Porto, and you can either walk, take the subway or an Uber (super cheap). The space itself is very stylish and cozy, with self check-in available and some thoughtful touches as well such as cheese and a homemade cake :) I definitely recommend this space to whoever wants to visit Porto, specially solo or couple travellers.

First time experiencing an Airbnb plus. A really warm welcome, Ines even made a cake and gave me a bottle of red wine, port, cheese from the region and have given me a lot of tips via Whatsapp and an personalized map on google. The place itself is also very clean, comfortable, and modern. The apartment is within walking distance of the city centre (~5min) and nearby the metro station (apartment to airport ~30min).

One most exquisite, warm and welcoming flat we have ever been. Dino and Ines were the best ever hosts, made a great effort to make us feel informed and ensured our comfort without been intrusive. As it was my  wife’s surprise birthday- they played into this too, making it the most memorable ever! There was a birthday cake, a bottle of bubbly in addition to the lovely flowers on arrival. We enjoyed our stay so much that we woukd love to return and as much as possible, recommend this accommodation for all else. This place is actually far better than what is on the website.
Best airbnb we had so far. Very welcoming hosts giving excellent recommendations for restaurants and activities. The place was spotless clean and stylish designed.

A great, cosy place to stay for a family of three! Easy to find, stylishly decorated, and comes with the oh-so-Portuguese hospitality of Dino and Ines (we particularly enjoyed the cake and the prunes!) A great stay overall.

It became a perfect home for 3days stay with good location. We can go San-bento station just by 10m walking. Area near B&B was not crowded, so good for rest at night too. House was really clean and morden. Everything we need was perfectly ready.  Host was so kind and did his best for comport staying for every aspects from preparation, finding location, suprising welcome gifts, warm explanation for the city and easy check-out.  Staying here make us feel Porto city itself as more attractive and warm place! I strongly recommend to stay here!

Couldn’t have been better. Apartment was beautiful, spotless and equipped with everything we needed!  Dina and Ines truly go above and beyond to make you feel welcome in their home with lots of lovely, delicious and local touches.  Rita their niece greeted us upon check-in and checkout and she was very kind and helpful making the process easy and very smooth.  The location was walking distance to many great restaurants, attractions and bars!

First time in Portugal and we couldn’t have hoped for better hosts. Wow the kindness and support from Dino & Ines was unmatched! They kept in contact with us well before and after our stay. And the apartment was probably the nicest home we ever did have the pleasure of staying in. The space was just right, clean, cosy and very comfortable. Every amenity you could possibly need and want was available in the apartment. Thank you again for your warm welcome, next time we come to Porto we hope we have the opportunity to stay with you again. David & Phoebe

My stay at Dino’s lovely apartment was by far one of the best Airbnb experiences  I’ve ever had. Not only did Dino wait for us at the property to explain to us how everything in the apartment worked, there was even a home made cake waiting for us on the dining table! Everything in the apartment worked well, especially the bed which was extremely comfortable and helped us to sleep like babies. Rain shower had a strong water pressure, which is something we really appreciated after a long day of walking and exploring. There is also a supermarket just a few minutes away, and the city centre is extremely nearby and easily accessible on foot. Not to mention a pharmacy nearby which helped because I was unwell. Thank you Dino & Ines for a fabulous stay & the incredible hospitality ;) If we’re ever in Porto we will be sure to stay here again!

This was the best Airbnb experience I have had.  Dino and Ines made me and my mom feel at home from the moment we arrived.  The room was very clean and they provided local snacks for us upon arrival.  Dino was helpful and gave us tips on where to go in the city and was very responsive to any questions.  The location was within walking distance to the city center and all the tourist attractions in Porto.  There is also a metro station near by that can connect to the airport or main train station.  I would not hesitate to stay here again!

Stop scrolling!  I found your next host in Porto, Portugal!   The apartment is intimate and perfect for two adults.  It boasts strong WiFi, nicely furnished, sparkling clean, safe, and is walking distance from all of the action.  Our hosts Dino and Ines were absolute gems as hosts. Not only was the apartment just as listed, Dino and Ines went above and beyond to ensure our stay was enjoyable (pre-check in to post check out).  Their personal and thoughtful touches to help us celebrate meant a lot to us.  If you’ve made it to this point of my review… go ahead and book your stay.  Obrigado Dino & Ines

We had a great stay in Porto! Ines & Dino are anazing hosts who received us with a cake, cheese and wine! They are always easy to reach and gave us great recommendations for the city. I would definitely recommend this place!

Perfect place to enjoy a stay in Porto. This is the nicest Airbnb we’ve stayed in. There was a freshly baked cake on arrival as well as bread, cheese and wine. Dino and Ines made our stay very comfortable and it was impeccably organised. They even provided us with lots of suggestions of nice things to do and places to eat. 10/10!

This was the absolute best location that I could have hoped for during my stay in Porto. You can’t beat the location, the space is well designed, artful, and comfortable. I felt like I was really living like a Porto local. Close to many attractions and to parks. Dino & Ines we’re fantastic hosts and went above sod beyond to share local attractions, locations for laundry, and even baked a cake. Very kind.

Our stay at Dino and Ines’ place literally could not have been better. Dino could not have been more helpful and kind, and the space was so thoughtfully decorated with everything we could have needed. As noted in other reviews, they even left us with a delicious homemade cake and local wine and cheese when we arrived. They offered a ton of suggestions for things to do and places to eat and were quick to respond when we had questions. I also preferred the location, being a quick walk to the center of town but far enough to be peaceful and quiet at night. I could not more highly recommend that you book your stay with Dino and Ines if you are looking at Porto!
Highly recommend, incredible stay, all was perfect! Thx again for the little attentions :)

Staying at Dino & Ines’s Airbnb is highly recommended! We felt extremely welcomed and the home was very beautiful and cozy. We were welcomed with fresh bread, wine and baked caked! It was amazing. The area is phenomenal and we will definitely be coming back!!

Dino & Ines listing was top tier, the best Airbnb experience! Dino & Ines were so nice with allowing a flexible check-in, welcome treats, tour of the apartment, daily check-in communication, and local recommendations. The hospitality was above and beyond, amazing people, and highly recommend their listing! The listing was in a perfect location near various tourist attractions! Plan to be back in the future.
Dino was a phenomenal host , who provided a lot of useful information for us. We would definitely stay with them again if we stop by Porto again

Dino and Ines were outstanding hosts! Dino went over and above making us feel relaxed and comfortable. They gave us a lovely surprise when we first arrived making it the best Airbnb experience yet! The studio was clean, fully equipped with amenities and quiet. We could walk everywhere and there were grocery stores and restaurants not far from the apartment. Dino checked in with us and offered us excellent recommendations around things to see and do. We’d highly recommend them to others! Thanks for a wonderful Porto experience.

Dino was such a great host. He met us in person and made sure we were comfortable throughout the stay. The location is amazing, right next to a central metro station and very easy to travel around. The apartment was modern, clean, cozy and well equipped. We would definitely stay here again when we’re back in porto.
Beautiful apartment with a stunning view.  Great amenities, comfortable bed.  We loved our brief stay here.  The location was excellent.
Perfect views over Porto port area. A must stay for first timers. Serviced apartment rather than homey feel.
I really loved the view at Patio25 and the host was responsive and helpful for my last minute booking. It is an easy walk across the bridge to Porto and all of the restaurants/sights to see.

This was the coolest AirBnB we’ve stayed in.   Being right next the Ponte Luis I bridge was magical with beautiful views of the river front.  The place is as shown.  Very comfortable beds.   Really loved it.

Ideal location for watching the river. Like another reviewer said, we were gifted with live music down below the apartment until 8pm. It was lovely to open the balcony doors and watch the sunset with the music playing! Apartment was very clean, but did have a strong bleach smell. Easy to access and great communication. Beds were comfy.
We were very well looked after by the team managing the flat, who were responsive  and extremely helpful.

Amazing property. Everything as advertised. Very spacious with amazing terrace. House spotless, kitchen fully equipped, and a five minute walk to a variety of restaurants and bars as well as to the centre. Will return for sure. Irene was a wonderful host who was helpful Mel in every. Way possible. As for Porto, well what a splendid place, can’t believe I didn’t visit before

Wonderful modern style hometown, well decorated and well equipped.  As advertised, with a large garage suitable for any type of car on the ground floor, 2 confortable bedrooms on the first floor, a large dining/ living room / kitchen for big family like our on the second floor and, cherry on the cake, a nice terrasse on the roof. 15mn walking from city center or 5 mn with Uber (very affordable in Porto) We will come back again!

Our stay in this property was wonderful. The house and the garage are very spacious, and nicely renovated. Communication was very easy, and the location is convenient for exploring Porto as well as exploring other places outside Porto by car. Fully recommended.

For us it was the perfect place to stay but it is a 30 minute walk to the old part of the city and the river. However it is very easy & cheap to get around by bus or an uber. Irene was easy to contact and quick to respond and very helpful with advice about how to get the best out of Porto. We would recommend eating at Agusto restaurant - a 3 minute walk from the apartment. They do a wonderful set menu and a very warm welcome
Very comfortable apartment and it was great to have the lockup garage with our rental car. Supermarket and bakery nearby. No problem to walk down the hill into town.

Excellent location. Beautiful apartment, plenty of space. Having access to a private garage in Porto is awesome. Multiple AC in the apartment makes the premise comfortable. Very responsive host. However, outside balcony floor (on the last floor) is dangerous and needs to be changed. In general, very satisfied. Highly recommend.

Andre’ place is outstanding. My best Airbnb experience so far. Andre and his brother Patricio, we’re super available anytime I needed anything or had questions.  The tips for places to eat and visit were spot on. The apartment is well-equipped, the bed and linens were super cozy, plenty of sheets and towels, everything you would need and more. Everything you would love to have in the kitchen. Oh and the pocket Wi-Fi! I’ll never leave home without one of those things again, I don’t know what I would’ve done without it. Thank you

Great place for a couple. We managed to have 4 people, two adults and children 6 and 9. It is small but cozy and comfortable. Honestly you probably won't be inside much because Porto has so much fun to offer. If you have the time take the Douro Valley wine tour, spectacular landscape and wine! We arrived on a holiday and the next day the city was somewhat slow to wake up. Lovely beaches in the area too. Highly recommend this place in the heart of the city. There are over 50 steep stairs up, dont forget your mobile on your way out :)

Andre (and his brother Patricio) are the greatest of hosts. Everything was perfect and we enjoyed our stay a lot. The apartment is lovely and very centrally located. 100% would recommend it as your go-to place for a stay in Porto.

If you're going to Porto, this is the place to stay! The location was perfect, the apartment very nice and cosy and Andre was quick to reply. I met him in person when I checked in and he showed me everything and obviously is a very lovely person. If I come back, I'll definitely book again.

André's place is located in a prime spot in Porto. I was able to walk everywhere, and had no shortage of restaurants, bars and stores to choose from. The apartment is located in Clergios so you're ready to go up the small hill there or down to the Ribiera. André provided lots of excellent suggestions on what to see and where to go. His flat was airy with a great breeze, and lovely views. I was able to use the mobile hotspot for video calls for the month without issue, usually 20-30mbps up/down. The apartment was clean and safe, and as others commented includes a bit of a workout going up the stairs, but you're in Porto so you've got lots of hills to climb! Obrigado André!

Ahh, we spent a wonderful time in Porto! Great localization for discovering the secrets of the city! Andre and his brother Patricio are both truly kind and helping people. The apartment is unusual! Highly recommended, thanks guys!

We had a very lovely stay at Andre’s. The apartment was well furnished and had everything you needed and more. His brother, Patricio checked us in in person. Andre was also very responsive and went above and beyond to give us recommendations.

We enjoyed our stay at Andre’s apartment. It was in a convenient location, clean and had AC. Andre and his brother were very helpful answering our questions and giving us recommendations. We recommend this place if you plan to visit Porto.

Both Andre and his brother Patricio were very friendly and helpful. They were quick to respond to questions and were very knowledgeable about the area. If we ever return to Porto, we will definitely stay here again!
Everything was great. We loved it. But keep in mind that if FC Porto wins it might get very loud on the streets :)

Super studio apartment. Newly renovated, stylish, spotlessly clean and light.  You cannot beat this location in old town Porto.  The building has a lift, so you don’t need to carry your suitcases up stairs.  Everything you would need for a great city break!
Very nice place in top location! Would definitely recommend! Only thing: could not sleep with open window. Street close by gets noisy during nights.
Terrific host with some quick & easy info for guests! Very helpful 10-15 minute intro to the area

Location Location Location! The Home Me's apartment is in the best location in town, everything is in a waking distance, the best restaurants 1-5  min.  all the communication with Home Me was great, the apartment was clean with everything you need, they welcomed us when arriving giving us great tips for the town. Highly recommended.

I've stayed at Home Me in a business trip and enjoyed it a lot. The photos are super accurate and the apartment couldn't be better located. Also, very enjoyable stay with all the amenities and super friendly host that wouldn't mind waiting after a flight delay. Also, very soundproof house, if you want to sleep well this is your place!   The only thing to point as less positive was that the house was a bit dusty. Either way, I recommend it without a doubt in mind and I'll definitely stay here again if available. Thank you Home Me! :)
We absolutely loved this place! Renovated, extremely clean, beautiful space and decor, spacious, good location. Great tips from Nathan at check in; we definitely recommend it.
Beautiful apartment, excellent location, the only thing that I would add to this place it is a AC unit even in this season it was a hot  inside, they provided a fan but it was not enough
A brilliant studio in Cedofeita, well equipped and full of light.  The host is very supportive. Being in the town centre, a bit of noise was to be expected, however nothing too disruptive

This place is as good as a hotel if not better!. Stylish apartment, just like photos, very clean and has all that you need. Place is cosy, good for 1 or 2 pax but not more. Bed was also super comfy we had such good sleep during this Porto leg. The AC was a great respite in the heat of summer where temperatures were close to 35deg. They also gave an extra set of towels for our stay which was much appreciated.  Location was also fantastic. We didn’t even take any public transport because everything was in walking distance! Many stylish bars and cafes close by. We met with filipa who was really friendly and gave us plenty of tips for food and things to do. We wanted to do the duoro river tour and they arranged it for us wo any hassle. Highly recommended, I wouldn’t hesitate to book if I were you!
Every thing was perfect, clean, good advices and nice touches in the room, I love it, thou it’s central it was pretty quiet :) I recommend it totally:)

We were in Porto just 2 days, but thanks to ORM and their hosts we were able to enjoy the city to the fullest. The apartment was super clean, well located and nicely decorated. The communication with ORM was fast & easy.  We got many nice tips from ORM for sightseeing, restaurants and bars. I would highly recommend Zenith Brunch & Cocktails for the best breakfast/lunch, Tapa Rua for tapas + live music and to eat a francesinha at Cervejaria Brasao Aliados.
I enjoyed everything about the apartment. It is new and clean. It has all the amenities. There is no view, but thanks to that it is very quite. 🙃
Great apartment. They were very helpful with the check in process when we realized we were going to arrive 2 hours late, they made the right arrangements and in order to let us in.

Where to start! What an amazing first experience with Air BnB :D . The apartment was even better than what we were expecting. Such a beautiful space with a lovely outside area. The location is exactly where you want to be as everything so close. The staff were fantastic - Especially Filipa who always went above and beyond ensuring we had a great trip. I would highly recommend booking the boat trip with ORM it was such great value for money and even included a port tasting ! Will definitely be coming back soon :)

We stayed here recently for 2 nights whilst exploring Lisbon. It is ideally situated and means the centre is very accessible. Plenty of bars and restaurants within walking distance. The apartment is sparking clean and although small, it is very stylish. Amenities are good and everything I needed was at hand. Air conditioning too. Only  negative is that bed is built up and only accessible from one side so this may not suit everyone. Otherwise perfect.

This was an awesome place to stay! The apartment is right in the heart of Porto. It's superclean, neat and the hosts are really friendly and their English is fluent. Cheers to the guy that welcomed us (sorry, I forgot your name), we thank you for the warm welcome, your amazing drawing skills and the elevator experience that made our lives complete ;) We could not get enough and will definitely be coming back!

Very friendly and welcoming host  Good communication and availability  Smooth checkin and out  Stylish and pretty apartment with beautiful walls  Located well  We were happy to be able to cook in the kitchen  The dishes and the fan in the bathroom weren't clean though  A bit shame that it was hard to see the TV from the bed  Nevertheless we've had a good stay. Thanks for having us.

Loved my stay! Great communication from local host. Very helpful with tips and recommendations. Great place, newly remodeled, perfect location. Walking distance to everything (cafe, shops, metro, etc). Location is central and was loud on the weekend so plan ahead with ear plugs if you plan on sleeping early.

Great apartment in a super location, everything you need is on your doorstep and it’s a great base to explore Porto. We had a super time. Host was very kind to allow us to drop our bags in early and gave us some lovely local tips. The only issue was that there was street noise at night and bells, but when you stay so centrally this is to be expected :) Thanks so much
Very nice and cosy flat, very well located and  with nice equipment.  Windows are thin so a bit noise comes from the street. fortunately few cars pass through this street.

great appartament on the first floor. Beautiful decoration, confy bed but pillows are not that much. Location is perfect! everything is very near! Only thing is the noise coming from the other appartaments, is not very well isolated. But overral we had a great time!
Risuko's place is a perfect getwaway. Just big enough, clean, comfortable, nicely decorated and a great location.
Beautifully designed place that is centrally located. Close by to great restaurants and literally anything you could need, shopping, sightseeing and very close to Douro river. You cane all anywhere!

This lovely apartment has everything you need for a short trip to Porto and is located in the very center of the town. All important points, nice restaurants and cafes can be reached in a few minutes. In the evening it was a little bit noisy from the street in the front.
This place has a wonderful shower and is very stylish. It can be quite noisy at night, so bring earplugs. Great location, otherwise. Steps to everything you want to see.
Lovely stylish apartment, very central. Would really recommend staying here. We were given plenty of local tips for during our stay. Thoroughly enjoyed our time in Porto
Absolutely excellent room and location however during our stay we struggled to sleep due to street noise from neighbouring bars.

The apartment was cozy, clean and near the Sao Bento station, which was also near most of the tourist attractions.  The room was equipped with everything we might use. The heater was well- functioned which saved us from the cold winter night in Porto.  Lovely stay team was really really helpful. The girl who greeted us (Chloe) gave us lots of information about the local tips. Besides she recommended a wonderful restaurant( Reibeira Square) where I had the most tasteful seafood rice in my whole journey. Undoubtedly it’s one of my best memories here.  The whole team was super kind and willing to reply any question I asked in a very short time.   Porto is a lovely and charming place. If there’s any chance to visit here again, I’ll definitely choose Ritsuko’s apartment as my first choice!
This studio flat is in a great location - really central and a lovely street. The flat had everything we needed and was nice and spacious. We'll definitely be recommending it to friends and family.
The location was just absolutely amazing and close to every where. The flat was really good and the lovely stay team members were so kind and helpful and flexible. Highly recommended 😊
Thank you so much! We've really loved your place to stay. The apartment was so lovely and very clean. And the location is so central and perfect. We will definitely come back!

This accommodation is very pretty, in accordance with the photos. Conveniently located next to streets with lovely restaurants. We loved staying there for a weekend. The organization with LovelyStay is very convenient and pleasant.

Beyond all important informations about the apartment Ritsuko shares to us with clarity, she allows us to bring the check-in earlier in the afternoon (2pm instead of 4pm), taking into account our situation with reactivity, flexibility and kindness.

The stay was amazing! Okay effect location. Excellent room and very clean. The AC is difficult to manage which was not disclosed but we were there at a great time of year so it was no trouble. Highly recommend!
The accommodation, was beautiful, clean, extremely well located and easy to get to. Perfect for our short stay in Porto, thank you!

Very beautiful apartment and in the perfect location. We would definitely stay here again. I would highly recommend this stay. We did have an issue with the A/C and the host was very responsive, but we were unable to fix the issue. Other than that, it was perfect.

This is a great appartment in a great location, the only problem is that the nearby streets are all under construction and it makes it difficult to get to and from the appartment. Other than that the place is nice and comfortable.

Very well located, very clean and had all amenities for a short trip. Just unfortunate there was a lot of noise from construction around, but it seems half of Porto is being renovated. Thanks again for a seamless stay.
Everything is as described, great location, easy and quick access. Only downside was the noise insulation, which wasn‘t very good.

Amazing location. Very easy to walk to all the sights and plenty of great bars and restaurants around. The apartment itself is really nice with much appreciated air conditioning! Ritsuko was always quick to respond whenever there were any queries. There is also the option of storing your luggage in their offices, a short walk away, which is useful if you have time to kill after check out.

Location was great, but if you are a light sleeper this is not the place for you. The roads are cobblestone, so road noise from cars every 30 seconds all night is excessive with the very tight street this apartment is on the sound comes right in. If you wear earplugs, all is good, but if not, this is not a sound proof apartment.
Location can’t be beat. Bit of street noise overnight but that’s to be expected staying in such a central location. Centrally located, many sites, shops, and restaurants nearby.
Very enjoyable stay, great location, perfect room, just a bit loud in the morning due to roadworks, otherwise perfect place

Great location and the host is good at communicating. Unfortunately we had issues with the AC on a very hot weekend and it was not resolved right away. In addition, the hot water did not last for 2 quick showers and slowed down part way through the first.

The apartment is great.  It has a great location.  There was construction going on next door while  we were there so it was noisy between 8 - 6.  If you plan on hanging around during the day best you ask if the construction is finished.

Marcia is the most fabulous host, so friendly and helpful... nothing to was too much. On the apartment, it completely exceeded our expectations! It has everything you need and is in a brilliant location! The terrace is fab! I’ve stayed in a number of air B&Bs (which I’ve been very lucky they’ve been excellent), however this has been the best. Look no further... this is the place for you!
Amazing stay in Porto in this lovely apartment, great location, stylish nd comfortable apartment, highly recommend to everyone, close to lots of restaurants, the river and central square 😁

A modern air conditioned apartment, very comfortable, modern furnishings, quality bed linen, beautiful bathroom. A large terrace with a table and deck chairs, very safe and private. Restaurants nearby, 10 minutes walk to river side, station and main shopping areas. Marcia  and  Andre were waiting at the apartment when we arrived, they both speak excellent English, (we speak no Portuguese.)
Marcia and Andre were lovely hosts and we had an amazing time in this apartment.  Especially loved the terrace and the central location.
Perfect location. Comfortable unit. We used the courtyard and the washer. Next time in Porto we will try to stay again.   An so many restaurants close by. Thank you.

Excellent apartment, fully equipped and very spacious. Close to the centre of everything, near to great places to eat and with easy access to the metro. Bernardo was very helpful at check-in; we are already planning a second visit.

One of my favorite Airbnb’s i’ve ever stayed in. The space is simple and clean with splashes of character and color. It was spotless when we arrived and we were greeted with local tips that helped us make the most of our time in Porto. I’m not exaggerating when I say we could’ve eaten every meal on our trip without leaving the block that this apartment was located on. So many amazing local restaurants and bars right outside the door. Despite being so centrally located, the building still was very safe and quiet. Finally, the outdoor terrace is even better than pictured. Huge space. Don’t hesitate, this is the place to be.

The flat was perfect, well equiped, very nice and clean. We appreciated the travel cot and baby chair for our 7 months baby girl and the coffee ! The neighbourhood is really calm and there is a supermarket really close (2min by foot) Thanks a lot to the hosts !!

Had a wonderful stay at the flat! It’s in a great location, and the bed and pull out bed were very comfortable. The terrace was amazing. I will def. stay here again and recommend to any friend staying. Bernard was great, easy to get in touch with.
Great apartment in a great location. The terrace is amazing and the apartment has everything you will need to make your stay in Porto perfect. I’d definitely stay again and recommend it.

Very nice apartement, great location, well maintained. Nice terrace with Sun-umbrella and canvas chairs to relax.  It is located in a very interesting neigbourhood with many amenities, close to transportation for excursions.

Great place for a city break. Perfectly located in the central area of Porto this flat is so well designedand has everything one can need during their stay. Every detail is fine and convenient for a traveller.  Terrace is a pure treasure! Bed is very comfortable. Kitchen is very well equipped.  Susana is a true SuperHost and deserves that status 100%. Never met more helpful and caring host, although we travel a lot. Thanks a lot for making us feel like at home.
A really nice and comfortable appartement, in the centre of Porto. The hostess was super nice, responded so quickly and friendly. I would  definitely recommend a stay here

This apartment was very cozy, clean, and pleasant. Susana is a tremendous host and she goes above and beyond to ensure a great stay, including communication with the guest from the original booking date all the way through the check-out. The location is convenient to all of Porto and the private terrace is a nice addition to the apartment. Truly a fantastic stay overall.
This is a wonderful apartment with lots of natural light. Great location. Very nice and easy check in with the host. Clean and spacious. The air conditioning worked well.
It was a cozy and very clen appartement. We enjoyed the stay very much. You can reach anything by walk. The Host is very kindful and courteous.

Susana’s place was perfect! The check in and out was simple. As for the comfort and location, we couldn’t have asked for more. It is a super clean flat fully stocked with everything you need. The neighborhood had great night life yet it was very quiet inside. I plan to come back with my wife and would definitely try to stay here again!
Comfortable apartment in a good part of town. Close to the train for the airport and tons of great bars/restaurants. Definitely recommend!

Susana is a host who is always available, very responsive to messages and very friendly (excellent host). It also allows an earlier arrival or a later departure (which is very appreciated). The apartment was clean. Quiet accommodation. Neat decoration. Very large terrace and very well equipped. Very comfortable bed and pillows too (we sleep very well at night). Central apartment in Porto which allows to visit easily on foot there is no need for the car because the apartment has a good position in Porto. Spacious apartment. I recommend this accommodation. Good experience. Good stay in Susana's apartment.
This place is amazing!! So many fun restaurants on the street and Susana is an amazing host.

Perfect place, extremely well located! We had a really nice stay in Porto. The apartment was thoughtfully arranged and my little family of 4 was very comfortable.  The host provided us with a crib and high chair for the baby. The patio was definitely a highlight of the apartment! We loved this apartment and highly recommend that you stay here when visiting Porto!
Susana was a fantastic host and we really enjoyed our stay in Porto! The apartment and terrace are done in extremely well and we’d love to be back!

Susana’s place was so cute and clean. The patio was an extra bright bonus, we wish we stayed longer to enjoy it more. The location is incredible, but somehow still quiet at night. The mattress is on the firmer side. Susana was easy to communicate with and very accommodating.
Susana’s place was the perfect place to stay for exploring Porto. The neighborhood has a lively vibe and the apartment is cozy and comfortable. We had a lovely time there!

Gorgeous house and perfect location to explore porto on foot. The host is extremely helpful and went above and beyond to help me when my kid fell sick. The house is full of light and had ample space for a couple and a toddler to run around. The patio was beautiful and we had our morning coffee there everyday looking at the seagulls flying above. Highly recommend!

Susana went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and she resolved an issue we had very quickly. The apartment was quiet and well equipped. The location was convenient to restaurants and shopping. Would definitely recommend.

Hands down the best Airbnb I have ever stayed in. Susana was the most pleasant and flexible host. She personally met us at the apartment and showed us around. The place was brand new. Had a private patio. A washing machine, every kitchen utensil you can think of, the most amazing central location you could ask for.. and so much more. It exceeded our expectations. We loved our stay and the apartment is a 10/10.

Susana's very clean apartment was a wonderful place to stay.  The location was ideal for walking to everything--sights, restaurants, shops and transportation.   The apartment was decorated very tastefully and designed for easy use.  It was very  quiet for sleeping,  and the terrace was the icing on the cake.  Susana was very easy to communicate with and responsive to all our needs and questions.  Highly recommended.
Great location with incredible restaurants within 3 minutes - walking! Great stay for a few nights exploring Porto!
Susana’s flat was fantastic in every way. Perfect location. Gorgeous unit.  Expansive private deck. Quiet. So many amenities. Looking forward to coming back soon!
Would highly recommend Susanas apartment. Very clean and the location was perfect, plenty of places to eat and drink wine nearby.

Susana is incredible and goes above and beyond to make sure you have an amazing trip! She is also so responsive. I accidentally locked myself out one day and she literally answered me immediately and got me right back in. Everything is so clean and comfortable.
Susana’s place was fantastic! It has all you need and is great walking distance from anything you’d want to visit!
We had the most wonderful stay. We will absolutely be back to Susanas place. The location in particular was incredible and she was such a fantastic host!
Great place and amazing location! Local restaurants within a short walk!! My wife wants to live there. 😁

A perfect stay right in the centre of Porto! Susana's communication was prompt and helpful (incl. detailed instructions for check-in). The apartment is nicely decorated, well maintained and very clean. The high-speed Wi-Fi was ideal for a day of working home office from abroad. The apartment is within walking distance of a lot of sights, restaurants and cafés.(lot of very good options in the street and surrounding streets). We highly recommend this apartment for a lovely stay in Porto!  Thanks, Susana!

Susana was a great host: helpful, flexible, responsive and very attentive to guests’ needs and schedule.   We absolutely enjoyed our stay end-to-end:  cozy stylish apartment, lots of space, fully equipped kitchen, spotless cleanness everywhere and supreme location.  Susana and this nice flat truly overachieved expectations and we would love to come back again!
Susana’s place was perfect and close to everything. Liked having a balcony. Bed was very comfortable and Susana was very helpful and available when we had a question. Would stay here again.

Just the best stay at Susana’s place. It’s in a great part of town - with many restaurants and bars around and all major tourist destinations within walking destination. A less than 5 minute walk to the Trindade station with a direct metro connection to the airport. Despite the central location, the flat is quiet, spacious, bright and felt like a real haven in a bustling city. Porto was such a welcoming, friendly and exciting city!
Although i never had the pleasure of meeting Susana her place was fabulous and exactly as described. The location was perfect and we will miss the apartment and just lived Porto.

Susana was a wonderful host.  She was always quick to respond to any questions I had and offered lots of helpful information to help us navigate Porto.  Her place was spotless and thoroughly outfitted and beautifully designed.  There were plenty of coffee bars and good restaurants within a five minute walk of the apartment.  The apartment had a deck to relax on and a washing machine--both wonderful treats for weary travelers.  We would happily stay with Susana again!  And Porto, for those who have yet to visit, is a charming city.  You can't help but fall in love with it.
Can't say enough about how wonderful this place was!! Its a perfect location and the host Susana was amazing! She went well above to make my stay special!! Thank you for everything!

We enjoyed a really wonderful and special stay in Porto. This apartment is perfect for a big Porto experience. We loved the special touches and the quiet location despite being right in the heart of town. 100% recommend!

We had a fab stay here in Dec 2024. The apartment was spotless, really well equipped and was easy to find. The hosts were very clear and responsive and made the whole process of checking in and out very smooth. One of the many reasons we would choose this apartment again is that although it's very close to the busiest parts of the city, you would never know while inside as its extremely quiet and peaceful due to its position at the back of the building. The large private rear decked patio was an added bonus and I'm sure would be amazing during the warmer months. Overall 10 out of 10!!
Lovely apartment, easily walkable and nice restraunts near by. In a lively area but had no problem with noise.

Susanna was a great host for our two nights in Porto. The apartment is lovely. It had all the kitchen supplies we needed for coffee and breakfast in the morning. We especially appreciated the blackout curtains, which helped our jet lag immensely. The location was perfect, close to restaurants, city center, and the river. Highly recommended, would stay again!!
Adorable place , clean and has everything you need . Sasana was a perfect host , very helpful . Would definitely recommend!

Great place to stay in Porto! Though it is located near the top of a street going uphill + a flight of stairs makes bringing luggage up a little tricky, everything else about this place is wonderful. It's surrounded by many great restaurants, and the area feels lively and safe. You don't hear much of the outside once you're inside, and everything was clean and tidy. Best part was the private patio! After a long day out, it was nice to have a place where you can lounge or have a meal outdoors. Susana was really responsive to all of our questions and needs, and we really appreciated her letting us self check-in earlier than stated. The sofa bed was actually quite comfortable too! We really enjoyed our stay here.

We had a wonderful stay at Susana’s  apartment . Perfect location allowing easy access to all Porto has to offer.  We loved the road the apartment is located on with great places to eat and drink on our doorstep. The apartment is light and spotlessly clean. It is well equipped and comfortable.The terrace is an absolute bonus.  Communication throughout from booking to departure was outstanding. Thoroughly recommend Susana’s place.
We had a great stay at Manuela's place. There was a garage for our car and the check in and out was very easy.
We loved the location and Ana was great at giving us recommendations and helping us! We loved this place and Porto!
Ana Sofia’s place was just what we were looking for, and she was extremely helpful. We’d definitely stay there again.

Ana Sofia was a great host! Amazingly responsive, caring, friendly, and went out of her way to make us feel welcome. We appreciated how flexible she was with the check in/out process. Would highly recommend!

We loved our stay at Ines place. It was sparkly clean and spacious. Her father gave us a detailed explanation of the neighborhood and what to expect. They even left us a big wheel of cheese and local wine, which we devoured with glee. Next time I'm in Porto, I will definitely stay here.

The house is my favorite style, fashion  clean and comfortable!  The location is very good, easy to anywhere in Porto! Inês’s father is very nice. Give us much useful information! As a owner, Inês father is professional!  He suggested us a very good restaurant! It is delicious and not expansive! We think we must come to Porto again, we must choose Ines house next trip!

This is a great place to stay. Manuel (Ines father) was great during the checkin and explained the apartment and local area very well, which was really useful. The apartment is very central and pretty much all the sights and many restaurants are in walking distance. The apartment was really clean, modern and had all the amenities for our stay. Definitely will rebook if we are back in Porto. Thank you Ines and Manuel.

We had an amazing stay at Inês' place! Inês was incredibly welcoming and made us feel at home in her beautiful flat. She provided lots of suggestions of excellent restaurants around the area, as well as places to see. The flat is very well located, with lots of nice restaurants and bars very close by; it is also just a few minutes walk away from a supermarket and Metro station. The flat was very comfortable, bright, clean and decorated with beautiful paintings by Inês' father.  It was easy for us to walk around the city, yet the street was quiet and safe. We had everything we needed and would definitely stay here again when we are back in Porto. Thank you so much for hosting us Inês!

The flat was lovely and clean with huge windows and great natural light.  Everything seemed new and well maintained. The location is perfect, and within walking distance of any major site. It was quite hot during our stay but the flat has a well-functioning aircon which is barely audible. The check-in process was easy as the host greeted us and responded quickly to any queries we had. The only slight draw-back was that there were few cooking utensils.  The little craft beer/wine shop a few doors down is great too and its' possible to leave  luggage there for a day if need be.

Ines was the very best host who I have ever met. The flat was well prepared and very neat. She was very kind and thoughtful. She  was available all the time answering my questions. Mu family really enjoyed staying there.

Manuel was very warm, hospitable and responsive. He gave us all the information we needed and was easily reachable. He responded positively to all our requests.  The apartment has very modern amenities and is very centrally located within 5 minutes walking distance of the main square. Thoughtful touches like coffee pods for the coffee machine, extra clean towels etc made our stay extra comfortable. If I return to Porto, I would love to stay here again.

Manuel welcomed us with hopitality. He informed us a lot of useful information around the place. His list of good restaurants were helpful. The place was modern styled and newly renovated. We had a good time in Porto.

We had a wonderful stay at Ines’s apartment. She was such a gracious host and welcomed us in person with recommendation for our visit. Very easy check in and check out process. The apartment is perfectly located in the center of town - we walked everywhere.  I would definitely stay again!

Excellent location, close to everything in Porto. The apartment is impeccable in every aspect (decoration, cleanliness, furniture, etc...) in an entirely renovated property. Manuel couldn't have been more helpful. Important fact: we traveled with a baby and everything was ready to receive him. We feel that he was also treated as a welcome guest. I highly recommend this apartment.
The room looks exactly like in pictures!! Location is perfect and Mr. Manuel is very friendly and helpful. We had a nice stay here in Porto.

Manuel is an amazing host and the apartment is in a great location. He went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. His recommendations were all amazing and became our hot favorites! He even helped us print out a document we needed before flying, which we really appreciated. Can't recommend it enough!

This is an amazing place in Porto. Extremely convenient of a location, and a beautiful modern place. The apartment if extremely cosy and the high ceilings made the space feel spacious. Lighting was also great.  Look no further! We met Ines’ dad, Manuel, and he was quick to help and excited to welcome us in.

It was a great experience. The place was wonderful. The check-in procedure is perfect! Manuel, Ines's father, met us, and he was so friendly and communicative.
