The apartment is located on the top floor of a renovated house and close to Trindade metro station. Getting to the apartment by metro from the airport and train station Campanha is equally convenient. Close to the apartment, you could find a fairly large grocery store (approx 400-500 meters). To Ribeira, only 15 minutes for the walk and the same for other sightseeing.

We were a group of 3 females visiting the city, the apartment was in such a fantastic location. It’s just outside the hustle and bustle but so accessible to so many great bars and restaurants. There is a supermarket nearby for breakfast items. The air con was much appreciated on the hotter days. We were so happy with our stay.

Lovely modern apartment with air conditioning. Good location as it’s relatively quiet but easy to walk to the main sights. Very responsive and helpful host - would recommend this place. Note however that the apartment is on the 3rd floor and the twin room is up a steep set of stairs within the apartment.

We didn’t meet Ines but her father, Miguel, was amazing! He was able to accommodate our early check-in and was very responsive. He had a lot of great recommendations and was very easy to talk to. The place itself was beautiful and clean, and walkable to a lot of places! I highly recommend staying here!

We had a wonderful stay in Ines's apartment, which is very pleasant and conveniently located. Thanks to her father for providing us with a flexible and warm welcome. I highly recommend this accommodation.

My wife and I stayed here for one week over the new year holiday. Everything was absolutely perfect - excellent location and close to many attractions, quiet, super clean, modern, and comfortable, with beautiful views from the two small balconies. Ines' father, Manuel, was so kind, friendly, helpful and communicative before and during our stay. When we first arrived at the apartment, he met us there to give an orientation of the apartment's features. He also provided informative manuals on Porto's attractions, activities and local restaurants. We would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend! Thank you, Manuel!

Wonderful stay, apartment was very clean and in a great location! Manuel (Inês father) was great. He met us the first day and showed us where everything was, and when we checked out he went above and beyond helping us with all of our luggage.  Would recommend this stay to others.

My mom and I had a positively memorable time in Porto and it’s a huge thanks to our host! They were responsive, helpful, and enthusiastic. We felt right at home despite being miles away from home. Very clean, organized, and welcoming space.

Beautiful apartment, in a good location making it very easy to get everywhere. Plenty of space for 3 of us. The communication and flexibility of check in was very good as we arrived very late. Highly recommended, can’t think of anything to improve. Thank you

Location was perfect, cool shops, cafés and restaurants on the door step. There's a newly opened café on the corner where you can get beautiful lunches, cakes and pancakes for breakfast (also very friendly). The apartment it's self is very nicely presented and has all that you need. We were in Porto with 2 teenage kids. It's a great city for pottering around, taking in the beauty and chilling in cafés /bars. Also found it to be not quite as touristy as other European cities. We weren't so lucky with the restaurants - food patchy so prob worth researching or noting where is popular and being willing to wait for a seat.

We are a family of four with two older teenagers who stayed for three nights in August. This is a wonderful Airbnb with lots of space for a family to spread out. All the beds were comfortable, the air conditioning worked perfectly, well stocked kitchen, and there’s a lovely view from the living room windows. The neighbourhood is great. It’s peaceful, but also walking distance from all the action. The host was always responsive and met us at the place to show us how to get in and gave us great local recommendations. 5 stars all around. I would highly recommend this place for families looking to enjoy Porto!

Myself and 2 friends stayed in the apartment for 2 days and it was perfect! On the top floor of the building so nice and quiet but still walkable to all the amenities of Porto.  Manuel was very helpful, allowing us to check in early and gave us full instructions on the place and Porto. He even arranged a taxi for us back to the airport. The apartment was very clean and airy, air con worked very well and the beds were very comfy. The kitchen and bathroom were very clean and had everything we needed for our stay. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Porto!

Inês and Manuel were fantastic hosts! The apartment was great and had everything we needed. It was far enough out of the center so it was quiet, yet close enough to walk to everything. There are great restaurants close by, markets, shops, a nice cinema, and the metro is short walk. Highly recommend!
We had such a wonderful time in Porto and Ines’ place was perfect!  Comfortable and peaceful after days of adventuring!  So close to everything we needed and wanted to see!

We enjoyed our stay there very much. Everything that was described about was correct. Checking in earlier was granted without extra charges and we’re thankful for that. We had some difficulty with one of the combination locks but Manuel provided keys and the problem solved. Good location, good stay great place. Thank you Inez and Manuel.  Andy
A lovely comfortable modern apartment well situated in Porto near plenty of cafes and restaurants and within easy reach of the river. The hosts were very informative and responsive. Highly recommend.

The location is quite nice and close to many restaurants and most of the spots. The house is also very clean and warmed. Manuel is very kind. He welcomed us and showed us around when we arrive at the apartment.
This is a beautiful, impeccably clean, modern home, in a terrific location.   Thank you for hosting us!
Everything was perfect , especaily the host Nuria who gave quick intro in everything we should see in Porto

The location of the flat is great. Within a couple if minutes you are in the city centre. The communication with the owner was also very good. It was great that we could drop off our luggage on arrival earlier. Everything was really, really nice.
Lovely and modern place in a stately and luxurious building. Management staff are very helpful and location is excellent. Highly recommend.

This is a beautiful flat, 3 very nice bedrooms, 2 beautiful and very modern bathrooms, a very stylish sitting room / dining-room / kitchen area. All the kitchen utensils we could need were all provided. The flat is opposite a shopping centre which has a good supermarket and is also near bus stops and a metro stop. The flat is also very close to Rua De Santa Caterina  which is full of shops and restaurants. Thank you Telmo, my family and I had a fantastic Christmas Break.

We stayed at Telmo’s apartment in Porto and were very happy with all aspects. The apartment is very clean in a well appointed location opposite a shopping centre and the Bolhão market. The apartment is very stylish, with a balcony at the back and laundry facilities which was very useful after our weeks on the road. Telmo’s suggestion for our Douro Valley tour was exceptional and well worth the day trip. Thank you for your hospitality, Telmo!
Love this place, it is clean and stylish with amazing showers👌🏾 The balcony is lovely and location is convenient.

Telmo’s place was well located, clean and we enjoyed the hydro showers. It would have greatly enhanced the experience if there was someone at check-in to explain the facilities and share some tips. There were also no maps or brochures in the apartment. 2 rooms faced a busy main road hence noisy. We were unlucky that one of the A/Cs was very noisy as well.  No proper sitting area and the tv was not working. Handy supermarket across the road and a few minutes walk to the metro and main shopping street.

The best Airbnb I’ve ever been to!! Very clean, equipped with everything you need and more, comfortable bed, designed, very central location, but yet a very quiet place, easy check in and out. Telmo was an amazing host that was available all the time and answered all our tough questions ;) Highly recommended!!!

This place is great for downtown Porto, walking distance from sights and restaurants, the space is super comfortable for up to 6 people and is filled equipped, functioning TV, dish washer, hot water, etc. We had a wonderful stay here and Telmo was welcoming and prompt to comunícate! This is not the place to stay if you want a view of the sea, since it is the heart of the city.
Worth the price paid for. Very friendly host. Well located, you can explore the city by walk everything is close to the apartment.

This is a well located property. It is a good base for exploring the city by foot! I would say it is not so much for hanging out in as the lounge area is not as good as the big bedrooms. If you are a light sleeper, be aware of road noise (or bring earplugs).
Telmo was a nice host, very helpful and fast in communicating. The house was perfect for us and we had a wonderful time there.
The place was just perfect! Clean, in the heart of the city, spacious. Highly recommendable.

We arrived much earlier than our check-in but Telmo let us drop our stuff off and go and explore Porto before checking in properly later. We were also allowed to check out slightly later too.  The place is great! Good location, spacious bedrooms, super comfortable beds. I'd stay here again.
The place was nice and quiet. The entrance with codes was very convenient. Although the kitchen could use more equipment, it was sufficient.

We enjoyed our stay. The location of the apartment was close enough to the centre to allow us to walk in, and far enough out to be quiet. The streets nearby had good cafes and restaurants, which proved very helpful. The apartment was a decent size, with air con in all the rooms, and the instructions for entry were clear and worked well.

We have enjoyed our stay for 2 nights in early November. The appartment is spacious, clean and nicely decorated. As it is very central, almost everything was within walking distance. Parking was also easy. Many thanks.

Big, easy and clean apartment! Nice beds!  Check out was also flexible!!  In the middle of the centre of Porto…  we would go again!!! Just bring some salt , pepper and oil , so basics for cooking , that’s not there…
Very nice location and very kind host. Check-In was easy going and fullfilled all out expectations. Thanks alot Telmo! Best regards Alex

Our host was very cooperative and helped us a lot. He was quick to answer our questions. The apartment is very well located. It is within walking distance of several attractions and restaurants. The apartment is modern and clean.

Telmo was extremely friendly and was flexible with check in. The apartment was very clean and close to city centre. The apartment was on a busy street so there was noise at night, otherwise was a great stay. Thank you Telmo!
Great place to stay, great location. Slight issue with a leak on the last night but nothing that the host could have anticipated or done anything about.

This apartment is in a central square of Porto. It is at the top of the historic center making it easy - albeit hilly - walk into the town to see the sights and the waterfront. There is some renovation of a building shell that made it noisy but only during day hours when mostly we were away from the apartment. There was a small grocery store next door. The apartment was clean and comfortable for my family of two adults and two teenagers.  Alexandra the host was at the door waiting for us when I rang the bell and assisted us in entering the garage with our car. She was very warm and friendly and took the time to show us the apartment and describe the city, the main sights, and places to eat. She was a good host. There is an elevator up to the apartment.

We had a wonderful time staying at diogos place. We were greeted at arrival and given lovely insider tips. The flat is spacious and very comfortable with easy access and lift. The bedrooms are well equipped with amazing blackouts and air conditioning. I think there is a little bit of scope to improve the kitchen amenities but to be honest those are just details and special touches which are really nice to have when renting a holiday home. The location is amazing and the supermarket downstairs is a life saver.  We really loved staying there and would certainly be back!

Diogo's apartment was large and clean for the 4 of us. Its a perfect unit size-wise. Alexandra was wonderful in explaining what the apt offered and where to go. I can't give the unit 5 stars because there was deferred maintenance when we arrived. They addressed the maintenance issues the day after they were brought to their attention.
Ana was an excellent host, her home is a beautiful place filled with vintage furniture in a quiet neighborhood. Next time I visit Porto I would be happy to stay here again.
Amazing place. Very near to Porto. Perfect Portuguese home for anyone who wants to check out Porto.
The Ana's place was great :) We stayed there and the place was very nice, clean, cozy and perfect. Ana was very warm and responsive and generous :)

Very clean and comfortable home. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The hosts were very warm and hospitable. Thank you Ana & Jorge. Your recommendations for visiting Porto were superb. Cafe Cila next to the house provided a wholesome breakfast. Bus 906 takes you directly to Porto - lovely night life. We will definitely recommend to our friends

We loved our stay at Ana's house! You can explore the beaches and visit Porto but also spend some time at "home". Great rooms, good internet and a very welcoming atmosphere. Two grocery stores just around the corner. The hosts are also very nice and helpful. I would totally recommend the house!
This is a great location to stay in. Close of many services, the train to Porto, and many excellent places to eat. Ana was also very helpful and very nice.

Ana’s home is absolutely beautiful and I’m so glad that she has chosen to share it with us! We had a wonderful time ,her place is spotless, spacious and close to Porto center. I would recommend her place to anyone and look forward to staying again in the future!

Thank you, Mané and Pedro for such a lovely stay. The apartment is absolutely beautiful. The decor and design touches made this one of nicest apartments we've strayed in.  The location also, was perfect for both walking around the town and easily being able to drive to the geopark. And the communication from Mané and Pedro was also excellent. Very thoughtful and helpful. Thank you also for the delicious cookies!
Very clean and cosy place right in the center of Arouca which was very useful. We very much enjoyed all the little local treats left by the host.

A really great space that has all you need for a few night stay in Arouca. We needed to cook at lot at the apartment because of dietary issues and the kitchen is incredibly well equipped for anything you need to cook. A very clean space overall! We appreciated the extras the hosts had left us for check-in. Would recommend.

Everything about the apartment was great except the stairs to the bedroom was quite small. The apartment is on the 4th floor so having to climb all the way up was timing. Location of the apartment was great, Bolhao market, shopping streets, and sightseeing within 5mins walk. Jorge was very responsive and even allowed us to keep our luggage past check out time which was a lovely exception. Will recommend if you are okay to climb the stairs every day.

We had an amazing stay at Jorge’s! Check in was seamless and Jorge even went above and beyond and accommodated our need for an early check in. The apartment is in a beautiful building in a super convenient location for enjoying the city. Would definitely recommend!
We had a great stay at Jorge’s place. Spacious apartment in a central location. A little loud at night time but otherwise excellent. Highly recommend!

Beautiful, clean, and perfectly located apartment! Super comfortable bed, great amenities, and thoughtful touches throughout. The host was kind and responsive. Would definitely stay again—highly recommended!

The apartment was beautiful and spacious!  The advantage of being close to the inner city just had one downside, it was a bit noisy as it’s right on a corner with traffic lights and lot of traffic (loud motorcyclists and emergency horns wake us up more than wished).  Beside that, I recommend the lovely and special apartment from Jorge!

Jorge has a tidy apartment and really central. Upon checking our documents Jorge saw it wad my partners birthday on the day we arrived. He messaged me with really clear instructions about how to get to his property as well as telling me there’s a surprise for my partner. When we arrived , the property was very easy to find. As we got in there are some flowers, champagne and a box of chocolate for my partner. Jorge had gone an extra mile to make our stay memorable. 10/10 if you had a chance to stop by Porto, his place is in a really good location and communication with Jorge is very easy. Thank you for a lovely stay!

The apartment is gorgeous and very spacious. We were a group of 4 and had plenty of space. The location also is very convenient, we  almost always walked to the various sights we wanted to see. Chloe from 'Lovely Stay' was super friendly and always responded very quickly. Only the traffic might bother you during the night, if you are sensitive to noise. Other than that we can highly recommend the apartment.
We had a great time in this apartment, close to the city centre and other amenities such as supermarket and metro.  A lovely spacious living space, very stylish and attractive.
The flat is awesome, close to everything and the host amazing. Help us with finding a parking spot and other amenities.
Excellent flat in the center of Porto. Full furniture, very cleaned. Me and my friends were delighted with this amazing flat.

The apartment is centrally located and easily accessible by metro. The apartment was perfect for 6 people and extremely well maintained. Maria, our host was extremely warm and receptive! Would 100% recommend this apartment

The space was super spacious and well equipped and clean. Maria was a great host with lots of recommendation. We appreciate her helping us with our parking situation. She is very responsive! Had a great stay and would highly recommend.

Wonderful stay! We were so appreciative of the host as we were traveling with two families each with 2 kids under 2! They provided us with two high chairs and two cribs with bedding, the bedrooms had blackout blinds that made for great sleep and baby naps, the A/C units were a great surprise, they coordinated in providing us paid parking in a garage about a 10 minute walk away for our 2 rental cars. We cooked a lot at home and had what was needed for that and we took advantage of the washing machine and drying rack. Great that we had two bathrooms which included showers in each.  There is a yellow bus tour stop about a 2 min walk away, we enjoyed the adorable streets nearby with outdoor dining. Highlights of the neighborhood included the tasting menu at Almeja for dinner and the Dubon Chocolate Bar - for chocolates and cocktails - both walking distance.
Maria is very helpful and responsive. She walked us the apartment and gave us useful instructions about the area. Even though there were some incidents, we thought this is a good place to stay.

Maria welcomed my family and I to her beautiful city of Porto. She made us feel welcome as when we first met her, she had a big smile as she could not wait to show us the beautiful apartment and tell us places to see and restaurants to visit.  The balcony was approachable from 2 bedrooms and the living room, and it provided a beautiful view of the city. The living room, dining room and kitchen are very spacious and allowed the 7 of us to have a place to sit down, relax and talk about what we experienced each day in this beautiful culture. The apartment was in the city and close to restaurants, bakeries, stores, etc. The Portuguese people in each restaurant that we went to were extremely warm and welcomed us as we entered their establishment. What a beautiful experience my family and I had.

Maria's place is a well-centered location. All the amenities were in place, spacious apartments, solid spacious rooms, with airco—outstanding living room for families and a good balcony.  The check-in was smooth, and I can't provide more details because despite booking 4 nights we only spent 1 at the apartment due to a variety of reasons. Nonetheless, the apartment matched the description, only remark for the building in general is that the balcony has a low height, which isn't super comfortable when you've toddlers around.
Easy to get to old town, along with good local pubs and cafes. Plenty of space in the pleasant apartment.

Can’t say enough about this beautiful home. Do not be put off by the neighborhood, it is a city. The apartment is spacious, bright and lovely. The location is perfect for exploring by foot all of Porto. If you need or want to use public transportation the metro is literally on your doorstep. We enjoyed our stay and would absolutely stay again if we return to beautiful Porto.
Spacious, clean apartment. Exactly what we needed for our girls trip. About a 10 minute walk from the city centre and just 3 minutes from the metro station. Definitely recommend!

Large and airy city apartment with modern furnishing.  Located 10 mins from Santa Cristina and a 20 minute walk to the river makes it a good base for those wishing to explore Porto. Many thanks to Nuria (a great host) who was very accommodating with our late arrival  and still took the time to offer guidance on local attractions and restaurants.

We, two couples, really enjoyed our stay at Casa Amarela.  The common area was quite spacious and, though the weather didn't cooperate during our stay, the outdoor space was quite inviting as well.  The location was good.  We were able to walk to the center of town each day yet had a quiet place to return to in the evening for a relaxed glass of wine.  Groceries were close by - just across the square.

The home is beautiful with an amazing garden all to yourself. We thoroughly enjoyed the home and Porto. Great location. It is a bit noisy but you soon get used to that. Other than that we adored staying at Casa Amarela.
Excellent accommodation for 2 couples and good quiet location near to supermarket and Trindad station and 502 bus

This apartment could not be more enjoyable! The location is perfect, not far from the center of action and yet the placement of the bedrooms is super quiet. We were there the night FC Porto won the championship and the city went completely wild with fireworks and raucous celebration late into the night,  yet the moment we closed ourselves into the bedrooms, we had total peace! The enormous outdoor space is a true treasure, and each day we loved throwing open the windows and doors and letting in the light and fresh air. The real joy of the apartment is in the thoughtful and beautiful renovation, incorporating the gorgeous bones of the building with the gracious ease of contemporary living — like living in a metaphor for the city itself. The vibrant neighborhood is full of excellent restaurants and is easily walkable to anything you might want to do. We were so glad to have found such an oasis from which to explore the jewel that is Porto!

Cristina is quick at responding and has wonderful suggestions to offer. We had a fantastic time in Porto all thanks to her and her delightful Airbnb! Be sure to check out their lovely shop as well :) thank you for everything, Cristina!
Cristina's place is beautiful and perfectly situated  close to everything , walking and seeing everything is easy.   will stay again

The place was really close to Bolhao station. I was comfortable to stay because everything I needed was provided. Also there has a supermarket, a Starbucks, and a laundry shop just five minutes away. Christina was the fastest reply ever! and she was so calm and kind person. Porto is a lovely city and I want to travel again.

Cristina was a great host! We’ve really enjoyed our stay in her apartment which is located near Bolhão station and therefore super central. The apartment was very clean and the balcony a personal highlight. We can totally recommend Cristina and her sweet little apartment!

Great host!   Christina and her family are really friendly, welcoming, and quick to respond.   They made sure that I got everything needed during my stay.   The apartment is centrally located and the host family runs a store nearby and that makes things so much easiler!    An excellent stay!   Great experience!
This is a super place to stay ! It’s very cozy and so well located.  I would recommend it ! And Cristina is very nice !!

Cristinas flat is a GEM in the beautiful city of Porto. It’s located in a busy shopping street, but totally silent during the night. Shops, cafés and supermarket on your doorstep and a perfectly silent night to sleep well. The metro station (with all major lines passing) is at two minutes. But I actually never used it as the best thing is exploring a city walking it’s streets. And it’s all in walking distance. The flat is tastefully made up / decorated and everything is brand new and stylish. I also loved the balcony for having a coffee and watching the people passing by. I absolutely recommend Cristinas place for your trip to Porto!
Cristinas was a wonderful host and I had a wonderful time at the apartment in Porto. Thank you!

I would really recommend this apartment. The arrangement and design of the space is very nice and complete. Cristina welcomed us and gave nice recommendations for dinner. We loved the balcony, on which we enjoyed live music from the street in the afternoon. At night the apartment is quiet. Great location to explore the city of Porto, with almost everything at walking distance!

The flat was a wonderful home for me during my stay in Porto, everything was clean and cozy. Cristina is very helpful and open minded - a gorgeous person. I enjoyed my time there a lot and can definitely recommend staying there :)

The flat is great - fully equipped, clean and located in the city center with the nice balcony. Cristina was very responsive, accommodation without any problems.  Highly recommended but mind there is a noise at night during the weekend :)

Super friendly host, and a homey airbnb in a fantastic area! Only downside is the noise in the evening, but that is to be expected on such a popular street. Super accessible by metro. Cristina was also super helpful and always there is you needed help!
The apartment is in a really nice area. The check-in was easy. And the apartment was also really clean. Cristina was always available for questions.

This apartment was good value for money. It was just perfect for us. The location was superb, literally 2 mins walk from the subway. It was nice and quiet at night too with a comfy bed and great shower. Cristina was lovely and gave us a warm welcome and left some delicious port and goodies for us. We would definitely stay here again if we return to Porto.

We had a wonderful stay at Cristina’s place! The location is right in the middle of a shopping street with loads to do and you can easily walk to the nearby market, train station, restaurants, and loads of other attractions. The apartment itself is perfect. Cristina was an amazing host, always staying in contact and answering any questions we had.

Cristina’s apartment was a truly lovely and peaceful retreat during our exploration of Porto. The balcony was a wonderful bonus, and the apartment had everything we needed. The location was great – peaceful enough, yet still right in the heart of the city. Cristina is incredibly warm-hearted and ready to help in any situation.

Great little studio in excellent location! Felipe was a perfect host- provided local recommendations and was quick with communcation. Even helped us out when we lost a phone. Check in is easy and smooth. We had everything we needed for our weekend stay!
The apartment was very clean and the location was perfect! Felipe was very helpful and responsive. It was a bit noisy at night and in the morning from construction.
Great place in a great location with access to everything. Daniel was a great host and made the check in process very easy and provided us with some great tips to see the city.

Great flat in the centre of Porto! Daniel is also super helpful. The flat is modern and spacious. It also comes with parking which is a great advantage given  its central location. Would not hesitate to recommend!

I can’t say enough about how welcoming, kind, and helpful Daniel was. Our flight was delayed more than 5 hours, yet he met us at the apartment at 1:00 in the morning with a smile. The next day my daughter became sick and he brought us fresh linens, called a doctor to come examine her in the apartment, and even brought us Gatorade! Once she recovered, his recommendations for places to see in Porto were perfect.  I 100% recommend this place to other travelers. Porto is charming, so warm, and welcoming to visitors - we wish we could stay longer!
The flat is fully equipped and has an excellent location. Daniel was always eager to help and responded quickly. Fully recommended.
You will very much appreciate the location of the apartment in a safe and quiet building in the centre of the city.  The apartment is clean and modern. You will be close to everything.  Enjoy it all.
The apartment was accurately described. The host provided a very useful overview of Porto, with several useful suggestions.
Great location to explore Porto.  The apartment had everything we needed and the parking space was really useful. Daniel was very helpful - we had a great stay
Daniel and Nuno are excellent hosts - very attentive and thoughtful! The apartement is nice, clean and has a great location. I would recommend it 100%!

This was an amazing Air BnB experience.  The process was smooth and attentive.  Local tips were really appreciated and the location of the apartment could not have been better.  Possibly my best Air BnB experience to date.  Thank you for all the thoughtful details to make our stay perfect.
The place was extremely nice! Kitchen had everything you need. Comfortable pillows and bed. The host was amazing and spent some time giving us tips about Porto.

This apartment is fantastic, I couldn’t recommend it highly enough. The location is perfect for exploring Porto and Daniel is an excellent host. Checking in/out was easy and stress free and communication was very good.

Daniel welcomed us in person and he gave us some great recommendations and was also really helpful with quickly organizing baby equipment for us even though it was a really last minute request. His place is really clean, comfortable, well equipped and most importantly really well located. It is in walking distance to some great food points (a must go restaurants is Porto) as well as the city center. I strongly recommend Daniel's place to anyone who wants to have a nice stay in Porto!

The apartment is clean and nice and is located directly next to the centre of porto and you can do everything by foot. We loved it there and had a great time in porto. Daniel is a great host who is always available if needed and gives great tips and advice.
The flat is in a great location - really close to the main sites and lots of great restaurants and bakeries.
Daniel’s place was great - very clean, great communication, and close to everything the city has to offer! Would recommend this place to anyone:)

this apartment is in a great location, you can walk to everything. There are 2 great cafe's for coffee and delicious pastries right down the street. Daniel the host was always quick to respond to our messages, for example, one of the kitchen chairs was a bit wobbly and within hours we had new chairs. Our Porto experience was fantastic.
Was an absolutely lovely stay. The host (Daniel) was so helpful and ensured our stay was absolutely perfect. I would definitely stay here again if I visit this beautiful city again
Daniel was a fantastic host. He provided clear, detailed instructions that made for a smooth checkin. The location is great, with so much close by and walkable. We would love to return.

We had an absolutely great stay in this very spacious house. Although it is not in Porto itself, you have a very good access to public transports. It is 2 min by foot. With well thought out details both surprised us and we definetly will come back. It is a so quiet and peaceful and in particular clean!

This home was amazing! It was very spacious and very close to the Metro. Daniel was always available and looking to help. He made sure our safety was always first. The beds were very comfortable and overall, he did a great job at making us feel at home. I had a perfect time here!
Clean, comfortable apartment in a great location. We definitely recommend and would love to come back soon.

It looks plain on the outside but it is very cozy, clean, contemporary and comfortable inside. Great location - it is within minutes of easy walking to train station, which whisk you to downtown attractions. Parking is easy. This unit is equipped with all the you will need.

Thank you Daniel and Maria for hosting us! Although the stay was short, I was given many useful tips and information about my stay! This apartment is very private and quiet and the bonus is that you have two toilets which comes very handy when you have many Travelers loving together!
Daniel's apartment is fantastic . İt is spacious , clean and very relaxing . I highly recommend the apartment , thank you Daniel !
Overall great experience, good location and price. Loved the backyard. The house also has air conditioning which was a great addition!

This apartment was perfect for the two of us as we each had our own bedroom and bathroom! It was very walkable to a nearby metro stop and restaurants.  The host, Daniel was extremely responsive before and during our stay. It was very quiet, extremely clean and the beds were very comfortable!  I highly recommend this home!
The house and the location was good. The host was very kind and supportive. The showers a little tight for a big  person. But, I think that's very common in Europe.

Great place! Extremely clean and have everything we needed.  Host was great to us.  The washing machine is a washer/dryer combo which was super convenient.  Short walk to everywhere.  Host has great pointers on what to do in the city.

Excellent host, recommended places to visit and the best places to eat. The house was clean, tidy, the sofa and bed were comfortable. The house is well located, minutes away from everything. I fully recommend it to anyone who wants to visit Porto.

The apartment is really wonderful and lovely decorated. But for sure the best thing of our stay was our host Gerardo. He is really friendly and helpful. Gerardo helped us to bring our luggage into the apartment and gave us some really helpful tips about Porto. I would definitely stay in this apartment again and highly recommend it.
The appartment was as good as expected. Clean, modern and in a good locality. Thank you for a great stay at Porto!
Very lovely apartment with good bus connections. We would stay there again.  Spotlessly clean , and many thoughtful touches to make a person feel at home.
A lovely apartment with great hospitality near the centre of Porto. Helpful check in and communication from Gerardo! Would definitely stay again!

Good location, nice, clean, spacious and bright apartment. Communication was easy. The only drawback was that cooking was a little difficult, as basic tools like chopping board, knives and other kitchen utensils were missing.
Would definitely recommend this place. We received lots of wonderful tips and helpful info on getting around. The place was super comfortable and spacious.

Constantino's appartment is very nice and located in a restored old Porto style building. There is everyrhing you would need. You can reach center easily walking down the avenida, no need for cabs or public transportation. Constantino is fantastic host he welcomed me warmly and provided a lot of information about the city amd more, and marked interesting places on the map I've got from him. He also was there to wish me good flight on check out. Alrhough he said i can call any time if would I need something that was not in the appartment there was no need for that, all was perfect. Thank you Constantino!
We had a fantastic stay at Constantino's place. It was nice and clean, comfortable and equipped with everything we needed for our stay. Thanks and we hope to be back again!

Apartment is well located, invaded by a beautiful morning light through its large windows and has good amenities including washing machine. Supermarkets and cafes are at a short walking distance. In 15 to 20 min walking one is in the main St Catarina area.

This is a great place to explore Porto from a local perspective. It’s located 15 minutes from Balhâo, Rua Santa Catarina and some other downtown attractions. Communication with Constantino was great at all times.

The flat is modern, very clean, you have everything you need, small markets right next door. The flat is also well equipped. A 10-15 minute walk to the old town is also super good. The coffee shop across the street is also highly recommended.  However, I found the street really noisy, which I hadn't noticed in the other reviews. But during the day, you are usually out and about all day anyway, so you can get over that.  If you don't have a problem with loud noise, go for it. Because the price-performance ratio is very fair!
We spent great 10 days in Porto The host Was very helpful and nice The communication Was perfect ! the place has a good location ,close to the shops and bus station  I highly recommend :)

We enjoyed our stay in Porto. The apartment is spacious with a living room and separate sleeping area. The location is great to explore the city. Constantino was very helpful. We would stay here again.
Highly recommend! Constantino's place has that special quality that makes a place feel like home. Plus, Constantino was a wonderful host.

The apartment is located in extreme closeness to the public transport, there are a few bakeries nearby. The place itself is absolutely lovely, cosy, clean, light and bright. Constantino is a great host👍 He's polite, attentive, cheerful😊 I will for sure book this flat next time I'm in Porto🧡 Lots of love from Ukraine🇺🇦

Great place and very tidy. just to note the maps link takes you to the bottom of the hill! Flat can be very hot and may benefit from a fan, otherwise it is noisy with the windows open. But Constantino replied very quickly and super helpful!!
The apartment is nice and  has a central location. The view is amazing. It was easy to communicate with Brigite. Highly recommended!

The place was amazing. Just as advertised. Perfect location for anyone wanting to explore Porto. Close to a metro stop, walking distance to the main downtown for sight-seeing, and on a major avenue so it was easy to get an Uber.

We had a fantastic time staying in Brigite’s apartment. The location is ideal with easy links to Porto via the Metro. The views from the large sun terrace are spectacular, giving a expansive vista of the local neighbourhood, the river and a good deal of Porto. We could shop for all our food goods locally with bakery’s, greengrocers and supermarkets all within a 5 minute walk.  Filipe our host was really helpful and accommodating. He responded immediately to any requests or questions. The apartment was spotless, modern yet very homely. It felt very safe and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay.
A fab apartment with a beautiful view. Brilliant hosts, very quick replies to our questions and really flexible with our timings. Location is perfect too!!
Great flat in great localization. Very easy to contact host and sort things out. Charming view from the terrace! Worth visiting!

What a fabulous city apt! We loved this place so very much. It was great to be across the river in Gaia with an easy walk/Uber/tram across the bridge to Porto and also to escape the crazy business of the city. We really enjoyed eating by the river and looking across at Porto by night...it was fab! The apartment is close to amazing restaurants and shops/markets as well as some spectacular historical sites.  If we go back again we would most definitely stay at this place. We much preferred staying in Gaia to Touristy Porto (but we LOVED to explore it throughout the day). Gaia also has amazing fishing villages just a short Uber away with incredible seafood and local vibes. The last thing to mention is that balcony!!!! The photos do not do it justice. Sunset looking over the Douro River and spectacular Porto was incredible.
Incredible flat! The private roof terrace has the best view in all of Porto and the flat is amazing. Great value and location - a true hidden gem!
Apartment’s best spot was definitely the terrace with amazing views of Porto! Host was communicative and straightforward
Filipe’s appartement was perfect place to stay if you schedule more than three days in Porto ! Very clean and have a nice view at the terrasse ! We can go to Moru park by 3 minutes walking :)

Felipe’s place is amazing. The location is prime. 5 minutes walk from Ponte Luiz 1 and from there you can access the touristic area of Porto.  The place was sparkling clean, it has all the amenities needed while on vacation and as mentioned before, the location is perfect. We didn’t use our car once. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for privacy at a prime location.

The apartment was perfect. The views from the terrace were incredible. The apartment is in a great location and is large and comfortable.  Filipe was great to deal with and responded quickly to our questions.
The place was clean, good equipped and located in a great area. The owner of the flat was very helpful with everything. It was a nice stay in Porto!

We are a 7 people group and stayed at Nuno's house for São João,  Porto's biggest party. The house would've been a bit small if we were staying for more time, but as we were only sleeping (not a lot of hours) for two days, it was perfect! It was clean, and had all the needed commodities.  The only thing to be mindful of is that the rooms are both upstairs, and the stairs are a bit tricky if you have mobility issues (or if you're afraid of heights!) but there is nothing wrong with a bit of a challenge ahah :) Nuno was very thoughtful and available, and we're sure to come back when we return to Porto.
Nuno’s place is well located and it has everything you need. He was very nice and responded quickly, and we were able to enjoy our stay because of this great place! Highly recommend!

Nuno was a great host and so accommodating. I had a thousand questions and he answered them promptly. Made great suggestions, facilitated an easy check in. Location is great - walkable to most noteable attractions. Had a great visit and stay :)
Good value for money and nice neighborhood. But we found a lot of hair on the toilet seat and in the bath tub. Could be cleaned better.

The host was very easy to communicate with during the booking and also our stay. The apartment is gorgeous and very well located, few padarias and mercados around. The layout was great for our group with kids as we could still enjoy the living space after the kids went to sleep. The kitchen is well equipped. We would definitely stay there again.
Good place close to downtown and very close to the Metro (once you figure it out). Took some time to get response from Adriano, but once he responded all was good. Great guy, very helpful.
Great location, great apartment. Marta was a great host. Would 100% stay here again!
The reality was better that the description. Fantastic apartment, convenient location, greate smooth service. For a group of people, this is as good as it can get.

Marta’s place was beautiful, very much like a boutique hotel.  Everything extra chic and high tech.  Codes to elevator, nice microwave and fridge built in smartly.  Marta was helpful when I asked questions about the area and any other questions I had.  We had an issue with the Wi-Fi as it was recently changed, however after calling I got someone who quickly explained the matter and provided the newly changed password. Beautiful apartment in quiet part of town.  Would love to stay there again in the future.

Lovely apartment in a great location. Only a two minute walk away from the main metro station and plenty of places to eat and things to do within walking distance. Thoroughly enjoyed a 4 night break here!
The apartment is just as described. We had a couple of things that went wrong. However, Marta was very responsive and made sure the problem was fixed. Would stay here again.

We had a great stay, perfect for our family trip with 3 generations. Babycot and chair was provided at request. Marta was very easy and quick to communicate with, really appreciate that. Location is good close to Trindade station, be sure to walk left out of the station to avoid the stairs that someone had mentioned here earlier. Minimarket just across the street, big supermarket a few hundred metres walk away. Porto is lovely, thanks Marta!

Large flat located near Trindade metro station.  Easy to reach, quiet, plenty of restaurants nearby, very clean, and has a well-equipped kitchen if you fancy making your own meals.  Suitable for a bunch of friends or family.  It can be quite hot in the flat, but plenty of fans are available and make sure you open the windows for ventilation.
We spent almost a week at Marta’s place and it was perfect for our needs.  Plenty of room to spread out.  Kitchen was well equipped.

Marta’s place was great for 3 friends visiting Porto! It’s very spacious and clean, in a quiet and safe area - quiet enough to sleep with the windows open, although you’re in the middle of the city. I would definitely recommend!

The appartment was very nice and located in the center of Porto. Communication was also without problems. It was clean and big enough for 4 people.  The doors in the appart and building make a lot of noise so people with sensitive sleeping should pay attention :) Also each person has to pay 2 euros taxes when checking out which is not written on the description of the appartment (but written in the overall rules of airbnb concerning Porto).
Very friendly welcome and even got a Google maps with a lot of points of interest of Porto. Super nice apartment with nice view.

In one word - SUPER. And it’s because of the fabulous superhost Luís.  Perfectly located apartment (close to everything central by walk), picture perfect interiors (I felt like I walked into Pinterest) and the most thoughtful details and care taken by Luís, my stay here matched perfection standards that one expects from hotels and not Airbnb. Absolutely recommend it to everyone and I wish my stay was a month and not 2 days.  Also don’t forget to get the amazingly organised list of things to do in Porto when you get to the apartment. It’s the best thing ever.

Had a great time staying in Luís’ apartment. He was there to warmly greet us and offered extensive tips and recommendations of where to eat, drink and see. The apartment itself was perfect, clean and stylish. Luís was also available throughout the weekend if we needed him. Really great trip!

Luis was an exceptional Superhost! His directions were precise allowing us to to transfer effortlessly to his apartment.  He gave us a tour of his apartment and highlights of the City of Porto. He asked us about our needs and then supplied us with a list of restaurant nearby.We felt totally cared for and welcome. Largely because of Luis we felt so comfortable in Porto and plan to visit again. Luis is kind, naturally warm, and an ambassador for his City. Can't wait to come back again :)
The most lovely, calming view in the middle of Porto, allowing you to relax and revive after busy days out. The sound of seagulls and a rooster added to that feeling of an oasis in the city.

Luis is an amazing host, friendly, extremely helpful and he gave us loads of great tips! The place is lovely, just the right size for two people, stylish and in a great central location which isn't too touristy. We hope to come back one day soon!

Luis was an incredible host. He brought Porto to life for us by bringing the history and sites together. His suggestions were helpful and knowledgeable. The apartment was spotless, modern, very comfortable and beautifully decorated. It was also very centrally located so that we could walk almost everywhere.

Great host and apartment. Very well located. Luis give us all the information we needed and even a huge list of places to visit and restaurants, shops, etc. He's the best Airbnb host a I have ever met.

We had an amazing stay in Oporto all thanks to Luis! The apartment was my 50s mod dream, updated yet retaining some of the unique architectural features. The furniture was simply beautiful, complimented well by his original artwork! I wish he could decorate my home! The windows and balcony looking out to the trees and other buildings in the back was such a wonderful surprise and our favorite part of the apartment. Luis provides you a very extensive map with suggestions of where to eat and what to see. My only regret is that we didn’t have more time to explore! This place is perfectly located and  we could walk to pretty much everything we wanted to see. I think this neighborhood in particular was just right. Quiet yet lively and in the middle of everything. When returning to Porto I would 100% stay here again!

Wow, found a gem in Porto:)  Lovely apartment walking distance to restaurants, tours, shopping, metro and train station:). Luis was so friendly and made me feel welcome from the moment I arrived.  I couldn’t of asked for anymore.   Obrigada again Luis for a fabulous stay in Porto:)

The home is stylish with Luis’ artwork. Luis was a very nice host and gave us everything we need for Porto visit. And he’s very responsive to our requests. We appreciate that. Only thing that did not work out so well was the shower. The heater at that time had 3 minutes of hot water and then it becomes completely cold. Luis was helpful and also came in to help us look at it. But we finally did not find where it was going wrong. This had a bad impact on our stay. Other than this, everything else worked perfectly and I would highly recommend Luis as a host.

Luíz is an incredibly polite guy who was so kind to welcome us late at night and always helped us out if we had some questions. Just as the others mentioned, he will have lots of recommendations for you, just ask him and try them! The apartment was very clean, classy and just about 5 minutes from the first spots you need to see in Porto. Would go again :)

Luís is a great host, friendly and helpful, he did his best to make our stay as pleasant as possible. He shared some useful tips of places to see, food, wine etc. Luís was also flexible with check out and responsive at all times!  His cozy and stylish apartment in the centre of Porto definitely made us feel at home!
Luis and his place were both fantastic! Luis was very welcoming and helpful on recommendations in the city. His place was very clean and perfect location. We would love to stay there again!
Our stay at Luís’ place was perfect, felt like a second home & Luís was so accommodating and friendly, couldn’t do more for us. Thank you, we will be back 💗

Luís’ place was perfect for my time in Porto. It is thoughtfully designed, artful, spotlessly clean, and comfortable. It is located in a cool neighborhood that is accessible to all the sights and points of interest in Porto. I particularly enjoyed the peaceful patio. Luís greeted me warmly at check in and we chatted about Porto and the history of Portugal. Would recommend to anyone!
The place was beautiful and Luis was a great host that went out of his way to make sure I had everything I needed.

Wonderful apartment in Porto. The apartment has everything you need and is located in the arts District close to downtown. The apartment is comfortable and is bright and sunny which is important. I had a great day and will return.

Luis was the perfect host and his place was an excellent choice. Located in a very walkable area, lots of restaurants  and shops nearby. The apartment itself was clean, well-decorated, and comfortable. Luis was able to give us a flexible check-in which was so helpful because of our early flight arrival time. Stay here, you will not regret it!
I just spent 8 nights. Good location, walking distance to just about everything. Room was clean, well appointed and everything worked out great. Overall, very satisfied. 👍🏻

Luis' place is stylish and a perfect home base for your Porto adventures! I especially loved that his apartment is in the Arts District and a little bit away from the touristy areas. There are many great restaurants, cafes, and places to walk in this safe neighborhood. His apartment is just as stylish as it appears in the photos. The bed is comfortable. This place had everything we needed for our adventures in Porto! I wouldn't hesitate booking this place again!

Luis apartment is beautifully situated to explore Porto. Wonderful restaurants, bakery and grocery stores are handy. The balcony overlooking gardens and pools makes for a perfect place for morning coffee and evening drinks. The apartment is smallish but great for two people. Hot water needs to be well timed for showers and dishes. Luis is a lovely host and the area was a perfect to explore Porto. Highly recommend Capela Incomum wine bar and delicious bread at Masseira bakery around the corner from the apartment.  A little farther but worth the walk is Bilha Nova restaurant.

We had a great stay at Luís's apartment. It was clean, comfortable, and very walkable to fantastic restaurants, shops, galleries, etc. Luís was also very communicative and accommodating with my schedule. He knows a ton about Porto and is happy to share his knowledge. Muito obrigada, Luís!

We just got home from our trip through Europe and by far, Luis’s place in Porto was our favorite. Luis was lovely and super helpful during check-in and communicated   quickly through message. Can’t recommend this place enough!
We really enjoyed our days in the apartment and felt very comfortable. We had breakfast on the balcony every day, which is truly beautiful and the heart of the apartment!

Luis is a fantastic host who is super responsive and communicates clearly and proactively, providing lots of local recommendations. The place is super cute and is in a convenient location (15-30 min walk to key places). Be aware that there is construction in the area (and in many places around Porto).
My second time staying at one of Luis's places. Lovely responsive host and apartment was exactly as described and in excellent condition.

Casa de Gaia is a wonderful little apartment 20 minutes walk away from Porto. Everything was clean and organised, the hosts were wonderful and gave tips on how to get around the area. Everything was fantastic, I highly recommend this place to anybody coming to Porto.
Alvaro was a gracious host, very helpful and knowledgeable; clean place in great location; tram can be noisy in day and streets are quite steep/ cobbled, but worth locating this gem
Alvaro is a very friendly and helpful host. The apartment was very clean and cosy and the kitchen was very well equipped. Everything was great and we absolutely recommend this place to stay in Porto.

Alvaro's place had everything that we needed. Fully equipped kitchen, comfy sofas, balcony with a view and all the towels and pillows we could want. There were lots of nice touches, too. I really liked the location, a short walk from town but in a quiet neighborhood that had a really nice feel of the countryside. We hope to go back!

We got a warm greeting and Alvaro got us great tips for our visit in Porto! The apartement had a nice view and exept some dogs it was a silent location. You can go to the citiy center by feet. We had everything and it was very clean also the decoration was cute.
We had a great stay. The apartement was very clean and has everything you need. It is located in a residential area though that looks a bit deprived.  It takes about 30 minutes to walk to the city.

Best airbnb experience in all of my airbnbs ive been to so far!  Alvaro helped me so much, from getting around in Porto to everything about this house. We felt so welcomed and the house was clean and we were provided with EVEYTHING a person could possibly need. Alvaro also speaks very good English and is willing to help all. The neighbourhood was quiet and clean, I do admit that it isnt located in the city centre but I liked the atmosphere too.

This was my fist experience with Airbnb and I couldn't be happier. Alvaro was an amazing host, made me and my family feel very welcomed and the communication with him, was excellent. The property was really nice, very clean, nice localisation, very friendly neighbourhood and very quiet. Overall, it was a great experience and I am very happy to highly recommend Alvaro to future guests, as I am positive their experience will be similar as mine. Best regards, Antonio & family.

Alvaro’s place is a really charming mid-size summer house/apartment. Perfect for the family trip. All things are well-equipped and maintained. You can view Douro river right from the living room, felt very relaxing! Most importantly, Alvaro is a super host and was extremely helpful while we stayed. We really appreciate his hospitality and great tips! Highly recommended!

We really enjoyed our stay in Alvaro's charming cozy abode.  Located on the quiet side of the Doro river, with wonderful river walks.  Quiet neighborhood with a 15 minute walk to the Ponte Luis bridge.  Alvaro is a fantastic host, he took really good care of us. He went above and beyond to make us feel welcome in our little home away from home.

The apartments are small, but neat, fully equipped and perfectly clean.  There is air conditioning and a balcony, which is important.  Alvaro is a very pleasant person to talk to.  And be sure to take Alvaro's advice and walk from the apartment along the river D'ouro to the Luis 1 bridge and the Cais de Gaia.

We can 100% recommend our stay with Alvaro. Alvaro is super helpful, he welcomed us right away and we were able to drop off our luggage even though we arrived at 7am. We immediately felt comfortable in the flat and small attentions, such as fresh oranges, made the stay perfect.

This place is located in a tranquil residential area. Inside the house was very clean and organised, with all the necessary homeware like washing machine and liquid, extra pillow and linen, a great range of kitchen utensils and equipment etc.  There are 4 of us and the place felt spacious. There is a balcony overlooking the Duoro and we particularly enjoyed the beautiful sunrise there. Alvaro was a great host. He gave us a very detailed tour of the house and gave us great recommendations around the city. We had a great stay at this place!
Great host, amazing apartment, very clean and cozy! The location is not bad either! Totally recommend to stay in Alvaro’s place!!

Alvaro has to be one of the best host we’ve ever had. Very quick to respond to questions. He greeted us when we first arrived and gave us city information and places to see - so very helpful. Uber is cheap to use from accommodations to where we wanted to go. Accommodation was wonderful, the view was amazing! Very clean and felt very secure and safe in the area. Lots of hills and as two of us have knee issues we chose to use Uber rather then walk, but there is transit close enough that you could walk if you wanted to. Rooms were comfortable and Alvaro thought of many little things, like oranges and apples. The place is not huge, but has wonderful windows and lighting and was comfortable for us three adults. I would recommend this place to family and friends. Thank you Alvaro for being the person you are and welcoming us into your accommodation.
Really enjoyed our stay as a family of four with two young children. Lovely arrival, everything was clean and was just what we needed and hoped for during our stay. Thanks again!

Nice roomy apartment away from the bustle of the city center with a great view over the Douro river - perfect for visitors who want to stay away from the commotion of the city center and don’t mind walking about 15 minutes to the nearest metro stop. The apartment fit 4 people very well and was clean and furnished with everything needed for our stay. Álvaro is a very friendly and proactive host who made sure that we felt at home. We had a wonderful stay and take home great memories from our Porto visit.
Great stay, Alvaro was very helpful and gave us local recommendations! Everything was as described and good value for money
Booked this spot same day and Alvaro was quiet to accommodate. Everything was extremely like shown in the pictures. Clean space and comfy beds.

Very good host! We enjoyed our stay at Alvaro’s. The apartment had everything what we needed. The location is a bit outside the city center and it’s quite steep to walk around. He had a car, so it wasn’t a big deal anyways.  Thank you Alvaro, for your hospitality!
Superb host !! We could get an uber and Mr Alvaro was kind enough to help us and pick us from the train station. His home has everything top class . I would definitely give nova de Gaia 5 star .

The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. The communication was perfect and anytime we had a question or needed something - the response was prompt. I can only recommend this place if you're staying in Porto. Very nice apartment and super friendly host!
Thank you for a wonderful stay at your lovely apartment. The apartment was perfect for us. Lovely and clean, and close to the city centre. Would highly recommend!
Everything was great! Henrique was always available to answer questions, and the place was clean and spacious.

We had an excellent time in Porto and a great stay at this beautiful apt that had an underground parking lot.   Had a few questions upon arrival and received timely responses.   Apt was nicely decorated and very comfortable.   Thanks..
This place is super as a home base while exploring Porto! Amazing location, lots of character and lovely hosts.

This is a very clean and spacious apartment in a lovely and charming part of the city. The apartment itself could do with a few personal touches however. Something nice on the bare white walls or some features that reflect the city of Porto.
Great place in the center of historic Porto. Place was perfect. The host is very friendly and really tries to make you as home as possible.
Great location, cozy apartment - could be a little cleaner.  Very easy communication with the hosts. Thanks for hosting us ;)
maja is a very nice host, the place was very nice clean quite and close to the amenities .

It was really nice stay in this appartment. Calm neighbourhood however, right in the city center. Fully equipped - and now even improoved with shelfs, drawers and hangers for clothes. I would definitely recommend it!

We were surprised because the place was a lot larger than what we saw in the pictures! It has a perfect location and we had all the amenities we needed. I am happy that we chose this place for our stay in Porto!
Very nice and clean studio flat with all necessary items provided. Great location in the old part of Porto, where you can reach everything very fast and easy.

Our stay at Mord's flat was amazing! The flat itself is in a lovely central location and a minute walk away you get a lovely view of Porto which most tourists treck up a bunch of stairs to reach. The Flat was perfectly clean and comfortable with a great view of the uniquely tiled buildings opposite the balcony and the beautiful church up the road. Communication was without fault and response times were quick. Couldn't recommend enough! And will defiantly be staying here if we're in the area again :)

The place is great - great location very close to the centre, but still quiet! Simona, the girl who helped us check in was really helpful and nice! She helped us a lot and even gave us advice for good beaches!

Simple studio in a quiet street in the city center. Felt a bit anonymous, could have been a bit more cosy. Bed was rather hard. All in all we had a nice and smooth stay. Tip 1: have a simple breakfast in the lovely tiny cafe at the end of the street next to the church (O Lanchinho Da Vitoria). Tip 2: bring a sleeping mask because the light from the hallway shines through the glass window of the door.
We stayed there for a week and the place was just perfect for us! Very clean, right in the city center but calm area. Would definitely come back! 🙌🏼

This beautiful space is located in the very center of Porto, in a safe and quiet historical road from where you can reach everything by foot. The house is more beautiful and magic than the photos. The bed is comfortable and everything is very clean. I loved the buliding, too, the staircase and the small balcony.

Porto’s place is in a great location for exploring the historical  City with plenty of restaurants, cafes bars nearby. The accommodation is secure and comfortable with a rooftop pool which is great at the end of a busy day
Great place to stay in the centre of Porto easy to get to from porto airport too via metro enjoyed every moment staying here great for a couple or a single person holiday

I had a pleasant stay at Mord’s. The room is very nice and there is a lot of space. Chairs are small but artistic. Living room table is made from the cross section of a tree which is very cool.  Check-in and out were pleasant.

Had a great stay at this beautiful apartment. The host was very responsive and helpful even with a very late check in. Location is very central, I only had half a day before I caught a train and because of the great location I was able to walk everywhere I wanted to with ease. Great place to book if you are wanting to explore the city and make the most of your time.

Overall a very pleasant stay - unfortunately there was ongoing construction on the street and very thin walls/floors in the building so you could here everything. But other than that a great experience!
Best Location in town !!! - Very clean and Cozy. I would definitely come back next stay in Porto !!!

I stayed for a month and overall it was great. Lucas was absolutely incredible in getting back to me within minutes of any issues, which included heating (common issue here) and brought an extra heater by next day. The unit is small, definitely a little “worn,” but it’s incredibly cozy and provides every amenity needed. There’s also a grocery store just across the bridge (you can see it from the main window in the unit) and it’s only about a 25min walk to the main “downtown” area. I would 100% stay again.
Great studio apartment. Close to a supermarket and metro station. Very easy to get around. Nice area with park nearby. The inside of the apartment was well kept and has everything you need

The apartment is  very well equipped, we found everything we needed. The location for us was perennial as we were looking for sth near Casa da música and metro station. The problem that we had was the lock; quite difficult to handle.

The place is ok.  We had issues with finding the place as the proper address was not provided to us.  We were lucky to find local people to help us .  After about one hour of wondering we finally found the place.  The place itself is close to public transportation and good for the value.

The best place I have stayed in thus far. The apartment was beautiful and I felt so comfortable and right at home. The host was extremely helpful, provided recommendations in the area, and made sure I was happy with the apartment when providing the keys. Grocery store and train/bus stations are only 5 minute walk away. I felt so lucky to stay here. Thank you for the wonderful stay.
Nice place. check-in was good, but a little late, which wasn’t really a problem for us
Very well presented apartment that was very clean! Good location, with a 10 minute walk down to the river. Very helpful staff. The pool was also a great bonus!

Perfect stay: the room was clean, comfortable and well equiped, the pool and jacuzzi were both perfect and we were warmly greeted by Susana who gave us really handy information about the city and what to visit nearby.  Absolutely recommend.

The place itself was generally fine. It looked as advertised. But the check-in guy was an hour late. The beds were also pretty hard. They left us only one roll of toilet paper and there were ants in the apartment. Wouldn’t stay here again.

This place was amazing and everything was perfect. Super modern, clean, cozy, great location and everything you might need inside. The host was great too, always attentive to anything we need and even gave us great tips about places to visit or to eat around the city. I will definitely stay here again when I comeback and will recommend it to all my friends.

Stylish and cosy apartment that we felt at home immediately. Very centrally located to the main shopping area, with lots of bars and restaurants nearby. Friendly and helpful hosts who respond to any queries you have very quickly and happy to assist. Highly recommended.
We had a great stay at BMyGuest’s place. They keep the apartment super clean and neat. If I come to Porto next time, then this will be my first choice.
we had a great stay in porto! perfect and convenient location and the apt itself was very clean and nice.

This apartment is very cool and in a great location, but definitely has a “well-used” feeling. The shower head was broken off the wall which made it difficult to use; aside from that and the need for a good cleaning this was a great place for 6 people.
Great space and location. Only limited with 1 bathroom and low ceilings for the other two rooms but I would book again

The location is amazing, the apartment was beautiful. The host gave us a bunch of recommendations that were really helpful. The only downside is that the beds were pretty hard however all the pros outweigh iy.

This place is in a great location!  Everything we wanted to see was within a 20 min walk. It was also very clean and a beautiful space. We were allowed to check in early to drop off our luggage.  Only one bathroom for 6 people was a little bit hard. The rooms upstairs were warm while downstairs was cold. Also not well stocked.  No paper towel and only one kitchen towel.  When we asked for dish soap we were told they weren’t allowed to stock that. Host did not always respond very quickly.
Really nice apartment. Very clean, elevator made arrival and departure easy. We were five adults, and everyone enjoyed their stay

The apartment is beautiful and practical. We loved people watching from the balcony. Very cool apartment with art and cool interior design. Walking distance to great shopping and city views. Definitely recommend this apartment. I didn’t like the check in system, where I had to fill in a form outside of air bnb and that they used a messaging system outside of the air bnb app. But the host Pedro was amazing and the apartment was so lovely. So that made up for it.

We had a good time in Porto and enjoyed mostly the great and central location of the accommodation.  The communication went very well and easy.  We were 3 people, so it was fine, but 6 people would probably be more an issue with only 1 small bathroom and the open bedrooms on top.  As other guests already said, it is very noisy, mostly from the neighbours upstairs. During normal hours it wouldn't be a problem, but it's noisy until after midnight.

A lovely apartment which is well located. The market is just around the corner where you will find fresh fish, meat and fruit and vegetables. The boulevard and beach are at walking distance. The apartment was well equipped and has everything you need. We enjoyed our stay here!

Pedro is a great host!  The apartment is brand new, lovely and very comfortable.  It is in a perfect location, you can walk to all the sights and also walk a few streets over to be out of the tourist area which is also a very nice experience.  Highly recommended.
Highly recommend staying here! This is a lovely, stylish and clean apartment. Pedro is also an excellent host and he made us feel very welcome in Porto. Thank you.
We had a fantastic stay in Pedro's apartment - it was beautifully decorated and sparkling clean. The location was great - about a 10-15 minute walk to the main sights in Porto and the river.

Pedro’s place is amazing!! Even better than in the photos. Comfy bed, spacious and stylish apartment, lots of amenities, and a great location!! Everything you want to see and do is walkable from the apartment. Pedro was a fantastic host to us and gave great recommendations for places to eat, things to see, and activities during our stay. He even had some port wine ready for us to try in the apartment when we arrived. One of the best BnBs we have stayed in hands down. Thank you so much Pedro for sharing this space with everyone!

We had a very nice time in Porto thanks to Pedro and his apartment! It's very spacious and clean. There was a lot of different kitchen equipment available. The place looks exactly like the pictures. The apartment is very close to the city center. When meeting Pedro, he gave us a little sightseeiing and gave us helpfull information about the neighbourhood, tourist attractions and restaurants. The communication with Pedro went really well!

Perfect Perfect Perfect. Pedro and his house made our travel more wonderful.  5 starts are not enough! I would like to give 10 stars haha ^^  This room was clean and offered everything we need.  Interior, decoration, and kitchen utility were amazing.  I already miss the morning coffee time in dining room.  Near to hot spot - Lello library, Sao Bento and nice cafe / restaurant that I looked for.  Pedro was frienly and helped for anything we need.  “Thank you so much, Pedro! ” Best, Jimin Lee

Lovely, stylish apartment in a great area! We loved our stay for 3 nights in Porto. Pedro was very helpful and responsive  for check-in and left us a sampling of pastel de nata (yum!) and a bottle of port from his family’s vineyard. Apartment was very clean, plenty of towels, complimentary toiletries and kitchen amenities, and having two bathrooms was nice! Would stay here again during our next visit to Porto.

Pedro is the best AirBNB host we have ever had! Very friendly and took time to show us around and give us plenty of local tips (the sandwiches are a must). The apartment is spacious, clean and has a great location within close walking distance to everything but a little out of the touristy areas. Highly recommend visiting Porto and staying at this apartment!

Pedro was super helpful. Took us around when we arrived and showed us some great places to eat and areas to go to which made things much easier. It is a great location, and not far from all the sites to visit and the places to hang out and mingle.

Pedro’s apartment is a beautiful, clean and comfortable place to stay.  The top floor location provides good views of the surrounding streetscape and lots of light to the apartment. Pedro’s hospitality is exceptional and we would love to stay again!

The apartment was very well located a bit off the beaten path but only a 10 minute walk to all major points of attraction and 15 minute walk to the Ribiera (River Walk).  On of the best things about the location of this apartment are the near by restaurant which were delightful and made our day activities easier to plan.  The apartment itself is located in the third floor and it was spotless.  It had all the necessary things such as clean linens and towels etc.  However, the best thing about staying in this apartment was the host, Pedro.  He went above and beyond to make feel at home. He took time to give us a brief walk around the neighborhood and to point us to attractions, restaurants, etc.  I honestly felt like I was visiting family staying with Pedro. When I return to Porto, I will certainly stay here.
Pedro will do his best to make your stay wonderful. Even the smallest details are taken care of
Very comfortable stay in a convenient location in Porto. Pedro was very friendly and easy to communicate with.
Pedro is really helpful and friendly and made us feel at home. The flat was clean and well equipped . Alsi it had a perfect location, close to the tube, restaurants and city center.

Absolutely everything about our stay at Pedro’s was truly exceptional. Right from the beginning our check in experience was incredibly special, a welcome port, pastries and even a tour of Pedro’s local recommendations! The place itself is immaculate yet has a homely and welcoming feel to it. Pedro’s hosting skills and communication are the best I’ve ever experienced with Airbnb. Don’t hesitate to book!!

Hospitality gets a new definition with Pedro. The house was very clean and detail-oriented, we didn't miss anything. It can be quite cool in November if you are not familiar with traditional old houses, but there are enough cozy warm blankets. Thank you, Pedro!

The only place we'll be staying when we're in Porto from now. The space was modern, clean and spacious for the 2 of us. We felt safe both in the unit and the surrounding neighborhood. No outside noise to disrupt the sleep. Thank you Pedro for meeting us in the early morning to store our luggage before check-in and giving us an intimate tour of the local joints. Location surpassed our expectations. We'll be back.
Pedro was an amazing host, amongst the top hosts I've ever stayed with. His apartment is so beautiful and centrally located. We loved the amount of space spread out across two floors too!

This was the best air bnb we have ever stayed at! Pedro was the perfect host and incredibly helpful every step of the way. Every room was designed and upkept so well it made us feel very safe and at home. Everything was truely wonderful and was a complete highlight of our trip :) THANK YOU for making our stay so special Pedro!!

We stayed 3 weeks at Pedro's place. Great location - very central to walk everywhere. We loved the living room balcony and the second floor bedroom with balcony.  The two bathrooms was a extra plus and very important - a comfortable bed.Pedro greeted us and gave us a nice tour of the neighborhood.  Pingo Doce full grocery two blocks away. We walked everywhere from our apartment. Nice restaurants, bakeries, (favorite Molete Bakery) cafes,  blocks away. Perfect stay for our first time in porto.

Pedro was an exceptional host. So warm and friendly - meeting us at the apartment to welcome us in person. Very close to everything Porto has to offer. And such a lovely clean and spacious place to stay - we wanted for nothing! Good places to eat all within 2 mins walking distance.
