We thoroughly enjoyed our week-long stay at Pedro's place. The location was ideal, within walking distance to restaurants and bars, the place was clean and stylish, and Pedro was a warm and welcoming host. He even greeted us with pastries and port from his family's winery. Truly a delightful stay!

What a wonderful apartment and a very wonderful welcome from Pedro who truly is a super host!  He showed us around his beautiful duplex apartment and then showed us around the local area. He gave some great tips for lunch and dinner options in the local area. The apartment has everything you need and is well located for exploring Porto and the surrounding area. Pedro is by far the best host we’ve encountered and he made our trip very special!!  Highly recommended!!

We truly enjoyed our stay and cannot recommend the apartment and Pedro as a host enough. The apartment was beautifully renovated, stylishly appointed, fully equipped with quality items (kitchen, linens and consumables, etc.), and was by far the cleanest Airbnb we've ever stayed in. The location is perfect with nearby restaurants, grocery, laundry, and easy walking distance to all of the major attractions. Pedro redefines the meaning of superhost with his timely and clear communication, easy and welcoming check-in, quick tour and information about the area, and sincere willingness to help in any situation. If you are looking for a place to stay in Porto, look no further than Pedro's place!

Pedro was a great host, he is kind and friendly and quick to respond (both before and during our stay), and was happy to help with recommendations for restaurants/places to visit and even let us store our bags before/after our stay. The apartment itself was perfect for us: easy to find, lots of space, comfortable large double bed, clean, and in a great location for exploring the city. We would highly recommend staying here ❤️ thanks for a great stay!

We are grateful Pedro greeted us with a warm welcome and made us feel right at home, even graciously accommodating our late arrival time. His place was spotless and clean! The kitchen was well equipped to prepare meals and stocked with delicious welcome treats. The place is in a great location, walkable with lots to see in the neighborhood. Great coffee shops, bakeries, restaurants and near the grocery store too. Thank you so much for a lovely memorable stay!

Pedro was the best Airbnb host we’ve ever stayed with.  Super friendly and attentive with great communication! He welcomed us in person which we really appreciated.  He gave us a lot of recommendations for the area too. The port and pasteis Pedro left as a welcome, were delicious.  We were close to lots of restaurants, grocery stores and walkable to every spot we wanted to see.  The kitchen was also set up nicely for cooking meals.   We really enjoyed our time there.  Thanks Pedro

Pedro’s duplex is an amazing property and Pedro is an absolutely exceptional host. From the moment my husband and I booked our stay until the minute we left, Pedro went above and beyond to help us and make sure our stay was as enjoyable as possible. The duplex is spotless & located in a wonderful neighborhood with plenty of great restaurants & a small market nearby.  We loved returning to our apartment each night & really appreciated Pedro’s thoughtful extras and attention to details. We highly recommend a stay at Pedro’s historic downtown apartment!
Pedro was above and beyond… helpful, friendly, responsive, kind And the apartment was pristine

If you want a slice of inner city action, this is the place! Easily walkable to everywhere, right near fab local bars and restaurants and just far enough from the tourist hoardes...  Apartment is gorgeous, everything you need (and properly everything, loads of loo roll, kitchen paper, tea towels, oil, condiments, nescafe pods for the machine etc - makes such a difference!)  Two balconies to watch the world go by below and enjoy the delicious port, provided by Pedro.  Pedro really is the host with the most! Feels like the old days of Airbnb when you actually got to meet real local people who can give you the inside track of the area... Charming and responsive, took us on a handy walking tour, pointing out all the local places to go, (and trust us, his recommendations are worth it!)  Thanks Pedro, hope to see you soon!

My Mom and I stayed at Pedro’s place before heading to 3 other destinations. The only downside of this being our first stop was that nothing else compared after this! Not only was the apartment spacious and immaculate, but Pedro is the sweetest, most helpful host. He really wanted to make sure we had everything we needed and that we enjoyed our stay. Not only did he provide amazing recommendations for Porto, he also sent recommendations for the other cities we were visiting. The apartment is located within walking distance of everything we wanted/ needed. Great restaurants and cafes nearby but not right in the middle of all the hustle and bustle. I would recommend this place to anyone and everyone. Thanks, Pedro, for being one of the highlights of our vacation in Portugal!

Pedro was an attentive friendly host.  He met us at check in and walked us through everything. Left and gave us great recommendations for places to go and things to do. Even provided us a small bottle of Port from his family’s farm. The place was modern, sleek and contemporary. It’s a duplex that is beautifully finished. The location is GREAT and lots of shops and restaurants around the apartment.
Great location, clean and lovely apartment, right next to all restaurants and main attractions.  Pedro had great ideas about where to go as well. Loved it

Pedro's place is a rare gem! He was a gracious and helpful host, even providing some family Port and explaining where it came from! His place is beautiful, private and in a great location. Easy to walk to all sites and good local restaurants. HIGHLY Recommend!!

The apartment is amazing! We received the apartment very cozy and clean. Pedro is the best host I have ever had on airbnb, he welcomed us on the first day and was always available for any questions and requests. Definitely recommended when visiting Porto!!!

Pedro's property is located in a terrific spot for walking to so many sights.  People watching was fantastic as there are parks, restaurants and coffee shops nearby - perfect for when we needed time to give our feet a rest!  There is also a yoga center and massage therapy just a 2 min walk from the apartment which were convenient. The apartment is lovely, comfortable,  relaxing space in the bustling city. The port wine Pedro shared was such an excellent extra touch. Yum!
Pedro was an excellent host, we only had 3 days and he provided great activities for using the time available.
Pedro and his wife have created a masterpiece in Porto.  From the stunning home to the historic location, one could not ask for more. Thank you both so much for hosting Kevin and I.

This apartment in Porto was perfect! Super beautiful and elegant—exactly what we were hoping for. Pedro met us outside when we arrived and took the time to show us everything we needed to know. He’s such a nice guy, and you can tell he’s really proud of the place (as he should be, it’s stunning). One of our favorite spots was the little balcony with the table—perfect for a quiet morning coffee while watching the city wake up. We felt right at home and honestly didn’t want to leave. Would 100% stay here again!

Pedro’s apartment was the perfect place for us to base ourselves for our holiday to Porto. It was a great sized traditional apartment with real character (but also with air conditioning which we needed in August) and exactly as described. It was an easily walkable distance to all the places we wanted to visit, including Bolhau market which we visited for lunch before checking in. There are lots of bars, restaurants and shops close by with a supermarket a few minutes walk away. Pedro was really flexible, storing our luggage for us when we arrived very early, and gave lots of great recommendations for places to visit. He left us port and Pastel de nata which were a lovely welcome. His breakfast tip-Combi Coffee, around the corner was our daily haunt as it was perfect with great coffee and breakfasts. Thanks for a great stay Pedro!
Really nice space. The communication was really clear and we got some nice tips and help for trips. The place is quite small, but very nice. We cooked our own meals and I just love the kitchen.
The apartment was great, exactly how it is described. Close to supermarket and restaurants. About 20-30 drive to the 516 Arouca bridge.  We really enjoyed our stay. Thank you again
I stayed for 5days and it was a very good place. It’s convenient to go to downtown(by walking 15min) and taking a subway. I had a great trip, thanks!
Really clean, nice apartment. Easy check in and always fast answers. Definitely would recommend it. Also quite big and with huge windows.

I can recommend this place a thousand times over! Cleanliness - perfect Hospitality - Perfect comfort - Perfect Space - Perfect we stayed there 3 nights. The apartment is located in a quiet place and just 15 min walk from the city center. The bed was comfortable and I loved the antique closet in the room. We cooked some meals in a very well equipped, spacious and lit kitchen. The hosts are super friendly and answered all our questions. They even waited there until midnight for our arrival.  Airbnb experience can't get better. I would love to go there again!!!

The location was perfect- close to metro and on a quiet street. The building was also very quiet. There are lovely pateserias and a coffee shop shop nearby where we would stop each morning for fresh pastries. The apartment was equipped with utensils and dishes when we decided to prepare our own meals. There were numerous grocery stores nearby to pick up vegetables, fruit and other groceries. This was very handy. The apartment also very walkable to the Porto historic area where we spent a lot of time seeing the sights. Highly recommend Joao’s Airbnb! Joao was also very quick to respond and had a book on Porto ready in the apartment with things to see and do. All of these details made our stay very enjoyable and welcoming!

We enjoyed our stay. The apartment was safe and in a perfect location, accessible by foot or metro but out of the busy city centre. The kitchen, bathroom and appliances were in perfect working order and spotlessly clean. The twin beds were comfortable. Thank you for your instructions for taking the metro from airport to apartment and making our week in Porto so comfortable and memorable.

We loved the place of João! The apartment is located in a nice area next to shops and restaurants. 15-20 minutes walk to the touristic hotspot but also nice restaurants (non tourist). Subway is 3 min walk & shoppingstreet too.  Apartment was spacious enough for 2couples with everything you need. We woud def come here again.
Very attentive host, the apartment was great, sparkling clean,  excellent location!!  If you are ever in Porto I really recommend you stay at Joao’s place!!

Fantastic apartment, within walking distance to the top attractions in Porto.  The apartment was really comfortable for 4 people and absolutely clean. The automatic check-in and check-out was quite fun as well, honestly!
Super well located apartment, easy to walk everywhere from this place. Our host have us great tips and was very helpful extending or check out! Super recommended location!!!
A wonderful flat that is close to a lot in Porto. Super easy and quick communication and the place was great. Definitely recommend it !
Lovely place, in a great location! Hosts were very helpful with any questions! Hopefully we will be back :)

We had a very nice stay in Porto. We briefly had problems checking in, but help came quickly. It was very helpful for us that the check-in was possible very late. very good location and good communication with the hostess! Thank you!

The location of the apartment is perfect, everything close by, and a bit away from the crowds in Ribeira. Communication was very easy. The apartment has everything you might need. We really enjoyed our stay.
We enjoyed our stay here. We never met the host, I believe it’s a small family business with a few places they rent out. Their communication was good through the app. Air conditioning was brilliant.

We loved the location with so many shops and restaurants all around and such easy access to the metro. The apartment was quiet at night. Having ac was great on the hottest day, but we also got nice breezes from the windows and the balcony. The elevator made things easy for luggage and for my elderly mother, who has limited mobility. She managed the few stairs to get to the elevator just fine and the three stairs to access the bathroom in the apartment. The kitchen had all the basics we needed, beds were comfortable, and space was good for three of us.
An ideally located place to see the city sights.  Sofia's place was very clean and the beds super comfortable.

Overall, an affordable and good property given how close it is to the airport and the overall size, general amenities and private terrace space. We enjoyed it. Washing machine wasn’t working when we stayed and the apartment would benefit from some small repairs.
Great place. Amazing location. You can literally go everywhere by walking. Shops, pubs and supermarkets are nearby.
Great apartment for a long weekend in Porto. Plenty of space for two couples, loads of bars and restaurants on the door step and really clean. Bottle of wine was a nice touch.

Good location next to restaurants and not far from center. No air conditioning wouldn’t have been a problem since you can open the windows, but since the garden is so close a bunch of mosquitos get into the apartment.
Great location! Jose was very responsive & we got the extras we asked for. Highly recommend this place.

Very clean and well equipped room. It was a pleasure to spend two days in the town center. Loved the porto wine and the fruits that were waiting for us at our arrival. I totally recommend it and I’ll book here again if I come to Porto. :) The street was a little bit noisy but the shutters helped a lot - it was ok.

Paulo’s place was exactly as pictured and then even better! Very clean, really easy to get there via the airport and very close to everything! His mother checked us in and they were very accommodating! Couldn’t recommend this place enough :)
It was a great experience meeting Paulo in person.  He is an amazing personality,  who helped us with many tips.
Paulo and his mother are very hospitality. The apartment is clean, comfortable and cozy, all was good. And it is very good location. I recommend this apartment.

It was very great to stay at Paulo's. The location is great for a short stay, close to the center but not in the busy and small streets of Porto. Apartment is clean, Paulo is here to help you of you need anything and he wecolmed us nicely with some Porto wine! I recommend to stay at Paulo's if you visit Porto. The street is a bit noisy sometimes but only for light sleepers and after a day of exploration it doesn't really bother!!!

Paulo’s place was great, check in was smooth as his daughter met me outside the home to show me inside and hand off the keys. Very nice area, walking distance to all the nice restaurants and stores that you would need. Would recommend to anyone.
Really nice place. I stayed there for a week with my family and we didn’t have any kind of problem. The place is very clean and very well located.

It’s a great experience. The apartment is as beautiful as the photo. Close to the MRT, but the MRT exit is uphill. There is a supermarket nearby apartment. It is very convenient to take the airport bus (3M bus) .The bus stop very close.

Great place to stay. If you don’t want to walk into the centre of Porto then the metro is just 3 minutes away. There is a lovely pastry shop below for breakfast and the owners speak English. Pedro de Fragoes is a wonderful restaurant for dinner and is only a 5 minute walk away. This place is perfect for a weekend in Porto.
Everything was perfect! Very good flat with all necessary things. I would recommand it. Well placed, very cute and good for 4 people.

It’s at the back of the building so very quiet. Elevator is very small but works fine. AC/heating didn’t work and wasn’t fixed during our 5 nights. Wasn’t an issue for us as it was fall and we had a standing fan.  In a perfect place in the city. Easy to walk to everything.  Recommend it for a couple. It gets small if someone is sleeping on the sofa bed.

Filipe's place is amazing! It is fully updated and the design/decor is beautiful. The location is also perfect for exploring the city. I highly recommend Filipe's place during your time in Porto. I will def be back!
Clean, centrally located location across from the beautiful train station.  Felipe was a great host, and provided local knowledge and quick responses answering all questions.
We very much enjoyed staying with Felipe. The place was very stylish and well located. We will be back next time we stay in Porto.

Stylish, comfortable, spotless, and extremely well-located. Seamless check-in and check-out and lots of great local recommendations. We were very pleased with our stay and would definitely stay here again.

The place is really beautiful. It's located next to São Bento station which is a really in the heart and center of Porto. If you are sensitive to noise take some earplugs with you as it can get quite loud especially on the weekends. You get kissed by the morning sun if you want to. It's a really beautiful minimalistic apartment where you find everything you need. I highly recommend this place!
Great location within walking distance of all we wanted to see. Can be a little noisy outside when the window is open but not a problem.

My wife and I had a great and romantic holiday at this place. The apartment is really pretty, clean and right in the center of town but not where all the tourists are (which is great because it’s not too crowded outside). Also, whenever I needed something and reached out, they responded in less than an hour. Highly recommend this place.
We had a short stay, but was a great place in a super convenient location. Given the prime location, there is a bit of noise outside, but that’s to be expected.

Great location! Right in the city center. Lots of restaurants walking distance. Gets noisy with the windows open of course but I personally enjoyed having the city in my living room. The appartement itself has a lot of space and is super clean.
The place was great! It has a really nice sunny terrace. All communication with the host was great!

The apartement is very nice and clean. 5 Minutes walk to the metro station. Supermarket and restaurants near by. Belina was very kind and answered immediately to all of our requests.  I recommend it to everyone!

Very nice and clean place, close to Metro station. Belina was very welcoming, she gave us some local sweets (Pastel de Nata) and allowed to stay after checkout time which was very nice of her since we had a late flight. I highly recommend this place.
Very nice and confortable apartment. Belina is very nice and helpful, she goes the extra mile to help her guests. Thank you very much.
A tidy apartment at a great location, very close to the bus stop and metro station. Good supply of hot water.

Very cozy, pretty and comfortable apartment near metro station Marquez. Walking distance to old town. Lots of shops near by, also walking distance to bus station. We really enjoyed our stay there. Definitely I recommend it. ;)
Good place to stay, close to bus and Metro routes. Very comfy bed. Enjoyable stay.

I had some issues with my flight from Manchester and was not able to come to Porto. Unfortunately, I have lost quite some money on a plane ticket, and now accommodation. I canceled the reservation before the time it was supposed to arrive and got a refund of 15$ lol. Would absolutely not recommend if you are not 100000% sure about your trip.
We enjoyed our stay very much. The place was clean, nicely decorated and close to the city centre. Belina responded quickly and was informative. Would recommend!

Great location with lots of things to do and beautiful scenery. The apartment is very close to the Metro but also close enough to walk into the main town. The shower was amazing and the apartment is exactly what you see in the photos.

Great place to stay, about 7-10 minute walk to metro,. Apartment is great, good wifi, comfy bed, would stay here again, host was awesome with recommendations and suggestions. very responsive to questions

Overall very little love for details and low quality furniture. Quick and responsive host - for instance we had issues with the coffee machine which were fixed immediately so that was great! However you can feel little genuine hospitality, you get the feeling the host wants to disappear as quickly as possible and the restaurants recommended were tourist traps. Also, the parking outside the apt. was not for free as indicated on the apartment profile. Wifi was quick enough to work. So overall an OK stay if you're just looking for a place to crash, especially at the competitive price.
This place is just a block away from the "Marques" station. So getting around is pretty convenient. The studio is clean, modern and have everything you need to sleep well.
Wery good location.  Street parking and very close by a Metro station (4 stops into the center of Porto).

Really cosy apartment, we had a great time. It has a lot of sunlinght and a nice space outside to chill. Its not super close to center (30 min walk) but we enjoyed the neighborhood and the calm of it. Better that the crowded center streets!
Lovely apartment with a great host! We spent five nights with our 16 months old boy in Marílias house and enjoyed every day! Thank you very much!
Apartment is wonderful! Station of mento is very close. Quiet place and area. Apartment is very clean and cozy.

The host is accomondation is highly recommended if you want it to be a little quieter and still want to be in the city quickly. Metro nearby and very good bakeries and supermarkets. Only to be recommended!!!
This was a fantastic, good value and very spacious apartment, easy to get to everything in Porto. We would definitely stay again for our next visit to the city!

Absolutely wonderful area and apartment. We arrived to find everything clean and organized. We had everything we needed and it was a joy to stay here, such a spacious apartment .    I was so happy to see the sea every morning while I had my morning coffee. It just made my heart sing.  Please try the bakery on the next block that is fab, bus stop was down the road as was the supermarket. Easy to go into town and the buses run on time! Everyone we met in the area were friendly, kind and helpful.  Gaia shopping literally a 5 min Uber ride and the Andante card is a must, easy to buy and use. Thank you to the host for allowing us to have a very special family holiday.
Great stay for a family trip! Apartment was spacious, fully stocked with the amazing ocean view :) highly recommend!

Comfortable place for those in need of space. Even though the apartment isn't located near touristic attractions, it's close enough and easy to get from/to historical sites by taxi/Uber/bolt. We (4 adults) had a great time there! Thanks
Very nice play to book if you are travelling with more than 6 people. 15 min to the city center by car. Nice and calm neighborhood. We will book again !!
we had a nice time in the apartment.  we did face some problems,  but Grau responded and helped to fix them.
Absolutely spotless place and really well priced. Joana was friendly, helpful and responsive. Exactly what we need the night before flying home.

Joana's place was perfect! It was spotless, comfortable and ideal for exploring the area. Close to Porto and within easy reach of everything. We enjoyed our stay and would certainly recommend it. Thankyou😊😊
Amazing place to stay in.  Judite is a great host. the house was extra clean and it has a  lovely garden. We did enjoy our staying very much
The apartment is nice but because the water pressure is very low at the apartment it makes it hard to shower.

The apartment was even better than described! It is very nicely furnished (as you can see on the pictures), there is even an air conditioner and we got a bottle of wine as a welcome gift, which was very kind (and very good). The location is close to the city center with nice cafés just around the corner. The only small complaint is the clairaudience in the house. Still, I can fully recommend this apartment for a stay in Porto!

Lovely stay and immaculately clean in this contemporary apartment. There was also port wine waiting for us on arrival and a balcony we enjoyed every night around sunset. Ruan was welcoming and helped us with anything we needed. Would highly recommend!

Great place to stay. Very clean and neat and was exactly what was advertised. Our host was great. He let us check in a little early and even helped us carry our bags upstairs which was so nice. The upstairs gets a little warm even with the AC on but there is a window that you can open and hopefully catch a breeze. We also loved how the closet was downstairs. It was convenient to not have to go up and down the stairs when we wanted to change. We would stay here again and recommend this place.
Our stay was great! The apartment is in a great location and the apartment is beautiful and very clean.
It’s soooo beautiful apartment,  very nearly in center and nearly so many restaurants.i love this apartment
Fantastic space! Had everything we needed in a great location. Thanks for having us and hope to return!
Fantastic apartment, great location and incredibly comfortable. Hard to imagine a better place to stay in Porto!

Very nice and neat apartment, all amenities included, great location, spacious apartment. The bedroom window can’t be shut and allows a great deal of sunlight in the morning. A bit noisy due to wind. Great AC. It could had been a bit cleaner! Very nice experience and definitely recommend!
Great location, very central. Good alue for money, however, very very noisy. You can hear everyone in the other apartments walking and talking.
The room was clean and comfortable. The perfect location for our start on Camino Way. We recommend it to everyone who wants a private room for their Camino adventure.

Air bnb was very cute with great amenities. Bed wasn’t very comfy or relaxing. The parking was really nice and check in and out was easy. The location wasn’t at all what we wanted when visiting porto for our first time. That’s on us for not doing research. Otherwise clean and cute air bnb!
The room was very nice. We really felt liked we were in a expensive hotel :)  The bed was very comfortable and the linen was very nice.

We loved the stay and Judite and her team was so proactively reaching out that helped so much for finding and getting into the place. The place is exactly as shown in the pictures. We loved the location as we had our car to go around and they provide really good parking space that connects to the house. Will definitely look for their properties next time.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Such a very lovely place in the heart of Porto! Carlos is super friendly! Everything was so clean, new and cozy. 100% recommendation

Amazing apartment! Bright, spacious, nicely decorated and new. It was very quiet. The location is great! In the city centre close to everything you have to see in Oporto, you can find in the area good restaurants and supermarkets, which is very convenient. We had free parking in the building, something that made the stay even better. Eduardo, the person who received us was very helpful and pleasant. I totally recommend the stay there!
Such a great place, right in the centre of the city. Welcoming hosts. Would love to stay there again!
Pros - location is great - flat is super unique - free parking so so key - felt safe  Cons - mattress wasn't the best if that's important to you - some dirty dishes in cupboards
Our stay in this Airbnb was AMAZING! The apartment is beautiful and exactly like the pictures, host was very kind and accessible.
Good communication and very helpful and understanding staff.I would definitely recommend anyone who wants to visit Porto’s attractions to stay at this place. It’s clean and good for a short stay.

Beautiful building and apartment; I don't have any issues with the place itself, it was quite nice, but the checkin procedure was difficult.  It seemed like there was no communication between the person letting us in and the host, which was pretty stressful.  The person letting us in didn't seem to know when we were planning to arrive, and our messages to the host didn't seem to be relayed.
Everything was almost perfect. Just the curtain on the upstairs bedroom needs to be fixed. except for that, the check in was very smooth and the appartement is great
was great! we needed to meet the person to get to the parking and he came right when we arrived.

Couldn’t recommend this property more. The location was central and quiet. We came with a 1 year old and it was the perfect home from home. The property was very clean and we were surprised with the small added extras, a small outdoor balcony, wine and coffee, some toiletries and super helpful staff
The appartement is even more pretty (brighter!) than on the pictures. And the area is nice.
The apartment was great, clean and in a very Good position. Reccomended! 😁
great place to stay. well located in downtown. very clean, spacious. great responsive hosts. would recommend others to stay. Will stay here next time we are in porto

Great apartment very close to public transit and the Bolhão market. Parking was a little tough, we had to back in from a busy road, but thanks to the location we only had to do that once since we were able to walk everywhere!

Great place. Host is so kind and helpful. Goes out of there way to make sure everything is perfect for your stay. Big apartment. We stayed on the third floor in the loft. Just a couple streets from the heart of the city. So easy to get to from the train station 7-10 minute walk or 10 minute walk from metro. Metro from airport £ 3.00
Wonderful stay, too short unfortunately so hope to return soon. The apartment was lovely and well decorated. Location is perfect!!!

Nice clean place in a great location at a reasonable price. My only disappointment was the wifi which was very intermittent and the garage which was very difficult to get your car into as it meant reversing into from a busy road through narrow gates into a very confined space. Fortunately there was ample on street parking beneath the big concrete bridge.

This was a great place to stay. The apartment was peaceful, very close to everything. I really appreciated the local recommendations, the garage option to park our car inside and not have to fight for street parking.  The host was extremely nice and personable. Highly recommend!
We absolutely loved our stay! The place was perfectly located, very comfortable and we were able to walk to beautiful parts of the city. Highly recommend it!

This place was perfect for us. It is a lovely, modern, and spacious apartment. It had everything we needed for our stay. Duque was a wonderful host and made us feel right at home. The garage was right underneath, so parking was not an issue. There was a little sitting balcony to get some fresh air. The location was perfect for us. Easily walkable to the river, and most of the city honestly. Porto is so nice to explore on foot. Would highly recommend.
Ed was a fantastic host, glong put of his way to help us with parking and local knowledge. we would recommend this amazing host to everyone x
Great spot for a long weekend or a long stay, just wonderful!!! Clean, spacious and PERFECTLY decorated! PS. Ruan was so much helpful! Totally recomendable!

Ruan was a fantastic host with an amazing space. His place was very clean and stocked with everything that we needed (sheets, towels, toilet paper, etc). The place itself was beautiful and right in the middle of the city where everything is within walkable distance. Ruan was great with communication and was very nice and thorough when introducing us to the apartment. Would recommend to everyone!

The place was amazingly clean, 10 min walk to the main bridge and good restaurants on flores. Host responded very quickly, a little noise from building works if you like the windows open but also AC so shouldn't be an issue. A great place..would definately stay again!

Best stay In Porto! Very easy communication, absolutely central location, with many cafes and supermarkets around. Very close to main sightseeings of Porto. Perfect for discovering the city if you have couple of days.  The apartment itself is modern, very well equipped and and clean. Wish we could stay longer.

Really nice apartment, perfectly situated in the centre. We were friendly welcomed and the private parking in a garage is very convenient. A small disadvantage is that the second bedroom is situated right beneath the attic, so it was quite warm up there, because the air-condition from the living room couldn't cool that area down that we'll. besides that, we really enjoyed the stay.
Perfect place for a short stay in Porto! Communication was very smooth. The place was clean. We’ll be back next time we’re in Porto!

Eduardo and his colleagues were extremely helpful and accommodating to our small group. I would highly recommend this beautiful apartment. It’s well located, has a very unique interior design and had all the necessary amenities. We had a lovely stay at this place.

Take note of the many, steep stairs if you have a large suitcase - quite the struggle. The parking garage is in the building and is a tight squeeze but much appreciated in this bustling city. The apartment is cute, if spartan. Location is good - lots of rigorous walking up and down hills. No extras so be prepared to go out for coffee, etc (which you'll want to do anyway!)
We had an amazing stay at Duque de Loule. Nice and quiet appartment very well located. Thank you to the entire team for everything, including Sergio and Ruan Carlos !
The interior design of the apartment is astonishing. I think it was the most stylish place I've ever stayed in. Congratulations! Above this, it's in a great location and quite cheap!

Great location, nice apartment and communicative host.  My single comment is that the upper bedroom is a bit challenging, need to ascend a narrow staircase and it’s not sealed. A part from that it’s highly recommended.
We really enjoyed and felt comfortable in this place, highly recommended if you want to stay in the heart of the city

We were really happy staying here. Location was excellent. Kyle was really welcoming and helpful. The 'attic' bedroom was comfortable but a tight squeeze getting cases up there and a steep descent to the bathroom at night, if needed. Better for younger couples. Good value.

It was a great stay, parking was of course tight as you’re right in the city of Porto, but the host greeted us with the garage door open.  He was super helpful and gave great tips too.  The building is beautiful and nice high ceilings.  They worked hard to make it very nice and we were very impressed. Beds are big enough which is important! Obrigado!
We had a great time in this apartment! Great location in central Porto, spacious, very clean... we could not ask for me! Thank you!

Such a cozy place and lovely host! The apartment has been clean and pretty good located with everything you‘ll need right around the corner! If i‘ll return to Porto, i‘ll definitly return to Helenas Apartment!

Helena‘s place is quiet, clean, peaceful, and in a perfect location. It’s really nice to be in a area of Porto that is not overrun by tourists, but still has so many fun and interesting places to go to eat and to see nearby. I highly recommend it!!!!!
Bruno’s place cannot be beat.  It was so clean and much bigger than the pictures show.  The view is spectacular and the value is outstanding.  Would definitely stay here again next time I’m in Porto!

The apartment is very well appointed with everything you could need. At the check in we were welcomed with tea, coffee, a bottle of local wine and snacks.  The location is superb: easy to access by metro from the airport (approx 30 minutes) extremely close (walking) proximity to the best bits of Porto but not busy. The road is historic and beautiful, and the daily view is simply stunning.

Bruno’s place was excellent. Great location and amazing views right from the balcony. Walking distance to the water. Bruno and his cousin were quick with responses and very helpful with places to go and things to see. They sent me a list of restaurants and site seeing places prior to my stay. I would definitely recommend staying here.
Fabulous apartment with the best views in the city.  Sunset and vino verde from the balcony is best. I would return.
Bruno’s place was near the cathedral. So its location was pretty good and view in the house was awesome.

This apartment and Porto were amazing. When we come back, we will be looking for this home to stay in. AMAZING views, sweet and thoughtful touches, everything was perfect. Book this place, you’ll be glad you did. Super close to everything by foot and next door to a gorgeous cathedral and museum.
Great place near all the major attractions.. walking distance to so many places!  The view is the amazing!!! We surely be back!  Thanks Bruno!
This was a fantastic spot!  View from the balcony was awesome. It was clean and had everything we needed!

A really great apartment! Not for those with mobility challenges but really really wonderful. Great location, cute decor, and Bruno and his cousin were quite wonderful. My brother thought he had forgotten something in the apartment after we left, and Bruno and Paolo looked for the item for us. The view is spectacular!

This apartment had the most beautiful view anytime of day. We enjoyed having both the old town and the river view. Everything inside the apartment felt new. Bruno was so easy to reach and very accommodating. He sent a great list of restaurants and left us a bottle of wine, which we enjoyed with amazing views on the balcony. Don't hesitate to book this great spot.

Bruno's apartment gives you the best of Porto living. From the cobblestone street the entrance is set upon to the breath taking view from the balcony, it is truly a great experience. Highly recommend!

Perfect location, good tips, Nice and helpful team. Perfect for traveling with and without a car. Very clean rooms and attention for detail. I recommend it and if I would go to Porto again I know where to book.

With exquisite decoration and fascinating furniture, the feeling is like living in an old but modernized castle. The location is in the busy street, with easy access to public transport, shopping stores (e.g. Lidl), among others. However, the stair access to the room is via a little bit narrow route, seemingly without an elevator. But overall it is a nice place to stay.
Everything was perfect. The location, the accommodation, all of it. I can’t thank Judite enough, we will surely comeback!

Great place to stay during our visit to Porto. We especially liked the enclosed terrace room that was bright and comfortable for work which we took advantage of while we waited for a storm to pass. We found a great restaurant right next to the parking area and across from the cemetery. We would definitely stay here again  on our next visit to Porto.

Bruno’s place was perfect for us. It was clean and comfortable not to mention the incredible view! He even had his cousin meet us to get us settled in as it would have been a little difficult for us to find initially. I would absolutely recommend this beautiful place to anyone looking
Perfect location, most of the atractions are on walking distance, superb view, quite and cosy. Good raport for money.
Comfortable, clean with an amazing view.    You can't ask for more!  Communication with our host was above and beyond.   We'll definitely stay here again.

This was our second visit to Bruno’s apartment. Excellent and prompt responses  to questions. Small but adequate apartment  with windows and an adjacent balcony to take photos of an absolutely stunning view of Porto, the Douro River, and Gaia! Steep stairs to the apartment are we’ll-lit with a sturdy handrail. So glad we came again!!

This place was amazing! It has  the most magnificent views of Porto and was a great place for our family of 6.  We loved the city and such a convenient location. The host was very accommodating and helpful and extremely kind. Highly recommend!!!
Unbelievably fantastic place with a view that is incredible. We were so happy staying at Oporto top view. It had everything we needed it was so clean and comfortable. I want to return for sure
Fabulous  location, amazing balcony views, great communication and check in meeting.  Cannot fault the apartment or the host, would love to return!

This place is absolutely amazing. The location couldn’t be better - right in the historic district within walking distance of everything. Of course, the true star of the show is the balcony - the view alone is worth the stay. When we come back to Porto, we will 100% stay at this place again!

As a family with 2 kids, we had an excellent time in Porto and in Bruno´s apartment. The central location is perfect for wherever you are heading. If the weather allows, it is real quality time to sit on the balcony for a coffee or a glass of wine enjoying the fresh air and the stunning view.  The apartment itself has everything you need and is very well equipped from dishwasher, different types of toasters, hand vacuum cleaner, microwave, TV with Netflix etc. The apartment was very clean and all of the interior was in an excellent shape, all pretty new. The host was very helpful, the handover worked perfectly and we were welcome by a nice hostess and some gratuities.  Overall, I can highly recommend Bruno´s apartment. We had a great time there and really enjoyed it. The location, the equipment, the host...everything get the best grade from us.

Bruno's place was perfect for our stay in Porto. Centrally located with a beautiful balcony overlooking one of the most beautiful cities I've ever seen. Luisa met us at the apartment and went over a few things and showed us how to use everything inside. The kitchen and bathroom were both well stocked, space heaters were available for each room, and the welcome bottle of wine was a very nice touch! I'd definitely stay here again on a return visit to Porto!
Great location! The views from the balcony is amazing! Very responsive hosts and great recommendations about local restaurants and business. Loved the stay!

The apartment was very comfortable! Of course, as the photos show, the view is amazing! Bruno’s niece met us there, and was so sweet! They definitely made us feel comfortable and were very responsive. We wouldn’t hesitate to book again if we visited Porto as it was in a very convenient location for walking around the city.
Great location! Stayed 4 nights and asked for more towels(had 1 bath and 1 hand each) and Bruno was very responsive and had more dropped off. Comfortable and safe. Would recommend.

Wonderful location! The metro is right down the road and the view was spectacular over the river. Clean, great space for 3 of us. Bruno and his family were helpful and so kind. Would very much recommend anyone to stay here!

If this apartment is available, then book it! One of the best airbnbs that I’ve ever stayed at. The view alone is worth it, but the apartment itself is also thoughtfully renovated and modern. The owner is flexible and goes above and beyond to make sure that you feel comfortable.

Cannot say enough positive things about Bruno’s unit.  Communication with Bruno and Paulo was great, instructions to get into the apartment were easy to follow and the pictures where to park were helpful. Louisa came to meet us for check in and she was absolutely lovely. It was a nice touch.  The apartment itself was pristine, clean and stacked with everything we needed (hair dryer, shampoo, conditioner, coffee, tea..etc). The location was great as well, a 3 min walk to Starbucks and 5 min to the River front. We highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Porto. Thanks for having us and when we return to Porto we will book with you again!

Words cannot describe the treatment we received from Bruno and his staff.  They were very proactive in communicating and anticipating our needs .  The apartment is in a great, safe location with a fantastic view.
Amazing views, great location! In-person check-in was very helpful and the host was really responsive whenever we had any questions. We really enjoyed our short stay here.
THE VIEW IS UNREAL. You look at the photos and think okay this will be nice but once you are there it is absolutely STUNNING. The street is also beautiful. I couldn't recommend enough.

Bruno and Paulo are great hosts of this airbnb, the communication was responsive and helpful. The view is incredible and the location is very central to lots of sights. We, a family of 4, enjoyed our stay and will definitely stay again when in Porto.

Me and my husband came to visit Porto with another couple and Bruno's location is perfect! We pretty much walked to everywhere in Porto with lots of things we can do. Sao Bento metro/train station is within a short walkable distance. Porto is a hilly place so definitely be prepared to go up and down the hill everyday. Just make sure to bring a pair of comfortable shoes! The view by the balcony at this Airbnb is gorgeous!!!! worth every penny we spent!

Bruno’s place had even better views than the pictures! The host was very responsive in communication throughout our entire stay. They left a sweet welcome gift when we arrived and we felt very comfortable!

The location was initially difficult to find as the GPS won’t pick it up, but Luisa met us and was very helpful and welcoming! The apartment was fantastic, clean, well stocked, comfortable and very convenient for walking to everything we wanted to do! It is on a beautiful old winding street that felt magical. The balcony view was extraordinary! We were very happy with our experience and would highly recommend it!

We had a great stay! Bruno and Paulo were super helpful, very responsive and were extremely accommodating of our changing schedule. We would highly recommend this apartment for its location, cleanliness, amenities and most of all the super hosts!

We loved our stay at Bruno’s place, the view is amazing and the balcony is a perfect place to sit after a day sightseeing.  The street is very quaint and quiet at night and the apartment is in the perfect location as we were able to walk to all the sights of Porto.  We would definitely stay here again and recommend Bruno’s place without hesitation.  Thank you

We enjoyed our stay. We saw the reviews saying the view was worth it alone… they were so right. We stayed with our two year old and the layout was great. Kitchen has everything we needed. Very accommodating for traveling with a child. The location is also great for exploring.

WOW. Bruno’s place is a gem in Porto - tucked away in the old cobblestone streets. The view from the balcony is absolutely spectacular - the photos don’t do it justice! We wished we were staying here longer.  Bruno and Paolo were both very responsive and kind. Paolo met us at check in which made the process very easy. I also left something on accident and they were very accommodating and went out of their way to help return it to me. Would highly recommend staying here!

We had so much fun!  The location was close to many places, and within minutes we were drinking coffee and lots of restaurants to choose from.  There were many ways to get to the apartment from many points in the city.  We were on an adventure each day.  Very cozy place we had a nice time.

The views from this place are absolutely stunning! The accommodation was spotless and had everything I needed. The location was fantastic - so close to many attractions and restaurants within walking distance. Being on an upper floor meant a bit of a climb with luggage, but the provided water, snacks, coffee, and wine were a lovely touch. Loved my stay here!
We enjoyed our stay. This is a good location to see Porto. We would recommend this site  to other travellers.

Lovely apartment in excellent location. Short walk from train and beautiful views from balcony- very central yet peaceful. Roomy apartment comfortable for our 3 person family; tidy layout and beds very comfortable. Welcome included a bottle of wine! I can’t imagine a better place to stay in Porto- highly recommend!

We were a group of 4. Bruno’s apartment is in a great location in old town area with easy walk to restaurants, local attractions, laundromat.  Apartment was clean and spacious with a fantastic balcony overlooking the town and water. Cars cannot go down the street, but it is easy access and departure with taxis next to the cathedral area.

Beautiful and stylish place in the heart of famous Ribeira - can’t ask for more central location. Margarida’s place is very thoughtfully set out and we felt very welcome and at ease in her beautiful apartment. Very recommended!
Lovely studio, with just what’s needed for a great visit to the center of historic Porto.  We had a wonderful time. Thanks Margarida
It was amazing place to stay! Especially we like many kind of very thoughtful things here - towel heater, wine, bread, fruits. Thanks a lot!!!!

We had a lovely stay. The apartment was perfectly located for us. It is great having a fridge and the possibility to cook little things. The communication was always quick and easy. The only thing was that the sound proofing is pretty bad. Not made for light sleepers.

Margarida is the perfect host and the apartment is also also perfect. Everything exactly as in the description, all super clean, and really big enough for 2 people, as the space at hand is perfectly used.  Top location,  all sights to be reached easily walking and bus stop just around the corner. We were very happy to stay in this beautiful apartment in a wonderfully renovated building and can only recommend it. Next real supermarket is a bit away but Margarida even provided us with what we we might need to eat - and even some port with delicious cookies!! Thank you again - this was highly appreciated!

after a bad experience that we had in Como, Margarida's flat was a suprise for us, super clean with lots of details.  she is really quick in reply. even she has prepared a booklet which it was helpful. 100% recommend this place.
Great place to stay in Porto :-). The place is in a really pretty and convenient spot in the city and the apartment itself is very nice! The host is also very nice and accommodating
Wonderful place to stay great location, lovely loft. A little noisy from the street and quite dark but neither bothered me. I liked having the doors open :)
The place was in a good neighborhood, but the furniture was pretty uncomfortable and not exactly what was pictured in the listing.
The place was lovely, the attentions from the host too. We did not want to leave!

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb, it’s in an amazing location right on the river, a beautiful flat, and surrounded by many great bars and restaurants. Although it could sometimes get a bit noisy, everything else was absolutely fantastic and the host herself was great. Would highly recommend!
We really enjoyed staying in this apartment. Very beautiful and close location to the city center. Margarida is a very kind and friendly host. Highly recommended.
Highly recommend Margarida’s place! It was centrally located, beautiful, and she was very communicative and helpful during my stay :)

We were delighted that we had found such a centrally located studio in the heart of the old town! It was perfect for our needs in every way. We thank Margarida for being friendly & helpful before and during our stay.

Great little spot in the heart of Porto, easily walkable to everything we wanted to do. Lots of restaurants right at your doorstep. There was even pasteis de nata and a glass of port waiting for us when we arrived.  Thanks Margarida!

Margaridas apartment was beautifully decorated and in the perfect location. Right beside the river and allots of restaurants. Margarida had great communication and responded quickly. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed during our stay. I couldn’t recommend it enough!

This apartment is stunning, clean, and perfectly located. It’s on a quieter, cute street that connects right to the main roads near the river, where there is so much to see and do. I was here during the power outage in Portugal, and the host left us a flashlight without us even having to ask :)
Great central location with loads of restaurants in the area.  Host very helpful and responded fast with any queries we had.
Great place,  very clean and with everything needed. Also in an ideal location in the city.
Right in the heart of old town, stylish space, very clean and comfortable.  Highly recommend.

Porto is a Fabulous City and this is a great apartment to stay in when visiting. The best thing is the location, seconds from the river front. At the same time the apartment is spacious, modern, very clean and safe. It has everything we needed and more. Also the communication from Brunna was first class, and we enjoyed flexibility on checking in which was great. A five star experience in a five star city.

Brunno E Nuno has an exceptional place.  Starting with location, it's literally minutes from the Dom Luis Bridge, City of Gaia, and lovely cafes.  The apartment is perfect for the solo traveler or couple - it's clean, the bed is big/comfortable and the bathroom hast to be my favorite about the place!  It's big, sleek and modern.  They also have a dual purpose washing machine (you may need your own detergent) and we all need to wash our belonging while exploring these amazing countries.   Lastly, the communication was top notch and even allowed me to stay an additional day due to some arrangements in my flight itinerary.  Thanks for a wonderful stay!  I will surely be back!

Very convenient, well located and well equipped apartment. Very close to the Douro, in the centre and many restaurants nearby. Everything was easy: communication with Brunna and Nunno, check-in and check-out, getting around Porto. Perfect for a few days to discover the city. Highly recommended!

This was an AMAZING place. The location could not have been better and we were so so glad we stayed here. The host was amazing and always responded very quickly and was extremely helpful and accommodating. Would recommend this place to anyone.

Amazing location and steps for the river cruise. Definitely dine at the restaurants next door A Grade (octopus starter, seafood rice, pork cheeks and lime pie) and Taberna dos Mercadores. Washer/dryer was so helpful after being on the road for a few weeks. Highly recc for first timers.
Fantastic spot in a perfect location. Brunna was even nice enough to give a list of recommended restaurants and activities that were all amazing!

This location was unbeatable. You’re a block up from the ribeira, next to a great architecture tour, and a 5-10 minute walk from the train station. The apartment was small, but had everything my husband and I needed and was very clean. Brunna was wonderful and checkin was timely and brief. We would stay again.

Very good location and close to everything with a fado restaurant right below. The apartment is beautiful and clean. The host also accommodated our early check in request which is very kind of her. There are few things could be better to improve guest experience. Showering with a soap bar was super difficult and drying, a wash is provided but no detergent and I had  to get a big box  which is rather inconvenient for a tourist, there are nespresso pods available but guest have to pay for each one you use. it’s still cheaper than getting coffee outside though. Overall it was not bad and we really enjoyed our stay!
This was a great place! Incredible locations, good amenities and the hosts were extremely kind and responsive. Really enjoyed my stay!

What a beautiful place! So much space, great location, everything you need to feel comfortable in Porto!  They have everything you need in the kitchen.   The location is excellent for anything you want to do in Ribeira and in Porto.  Everything is within walking distance.  Sao Bento train station is a 10-15 minute walk, the buses are near by, the Douro River and all it has to offer is RIGHT there!  I cannot recommend this place enough!
We a very nice home and the perfect location! Very tight space but was clean and a good stay.

My stay at this Airbnb in Porto was absolutely perfect! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and beautifully set up, offering everything we needed for a cozy and enjoyable visit. Its central location made it incredibly easy to explore the city’s iconic spots and hidden gems. What made this stay truly special was the host. They went above and beyond to ensure we had an amazing experience—super communicative, accommodating, and always ready with helpful suggestions to make the most of our time in Porto. Their attention to detail and genuine care made us feel right at home. This was hands-down one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve had. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable stay in Porto!
Great location and host! If you like to see live music, Hard Club is a minute to two minute walk away, and the Douro river is right around the corner. Would stay here again!
Pedro and Paula are wonderful hosts. Pedro is extremly helpful and accomodating. They have a great place and made our business trip so much better. Thank you, Ira

Pedro and Paula are very warm and kind hosts. The place itself is located in the city centre, just a minute away from town hall and the metro station. It is clean, well equipped and quiet if you take the fact into account that you live directly in the city centre. They provide a small pamphlet with good tips for supermarkets, bars and restaurants. If I re-visit Porto (which I will) I will definitely take Pedro and Paulas place into consideration again. Total recommendation!

The location is great for exploring the historical city of Porto, and the accommodation is well suited for a short stay with restaurant dining (plenty within walking distance). Breakfast and small meals can easily be made in the kitchenette, which also is a small living area. The apartment was clean and fresh and worked perfectly for our five-person weekend visit. Communication with Paula was fast and accurate and the check-in and -out were smooth.

The appartement is exactly as shown on the picture. The only downside would be that there is a big construction right next to it and that there is no possibility to completely darken the room. Only curtains. For the rest, very nice. Even gave us the opportunity to leave later so that we could let our luggages before our flight.

power went out. place was clean. beds were nice. noise form outside was very loud. communication was amazing. we were able to stay in apartment past check out time. amazing place other than minor issues

The apartment is located in a central area with plenty of restaurants and cafes nearby, which made it very convenient for exploring the city. The hosts were very welcoming and accommodating, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. Overall, I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay in Porto.
Really nice Appartement for this price.  We walked to every destination in the city.  Clean apartment.  Thank you Pedro for the nice stay.

Great place for families. Clean, comfortable, has elevator and close to everything : metro, restaurants, & historic landmarks. We walked everywhere but still quiet at night. Has good info and instructions and very responsive through WAp. Thank You!
Comfortable, well located in a busy area. Easy to stroll to the main sights, river front and other side. Pedro and Paula make it easy for you and with a couple of creature comforts too.
It was really nice apartment in the city centre, close to main attraction. Only thing you should keep in mind is that they don't have stove.
We were very satisfied. The apartment is within walking distance to everything, restaurants, groceries, coffee shops, shopping, churches. Host was very responsive and friendly.

Great location. Paula is very kind.  The apartment is perfect for a group of six even if they have different interests.  we were family,young party people and a couple with a baby, the distribution of the rooms allows one go in and put without bother who wants stay in and rest.

This is a really great place to stay in Porto! In the Center of everything! So many bars, restaurants and shopping close by.  The place was very modern and the beds and pillows were comfortable.  You can hear a lot of street noise in the bedrooms so would recommend ear plugs if you are a light sleeper.

Mariana's place is a perfect appartment to discover Porto. It has everything you need: comfortabele bed, nice shower, a kitchenette with fridge etc. You can walk to the city centre or take the metro. Extra plus: the busterminal is very close by if you want to take a trip to another city (we went to Coimbra one day!) Mariana is very welcoming and helped us to find a place to eat the first night and said we could always message her if we got lost. So, if I go to Porto again I would definitely choose Mariana's place again :)

The accommodation was very clean and nicely established. Marianna is a super host and she will sort every problem that occurs. I am thankfull for her hospitality and loved her place. It really is literally walking distance to town center.
Mariana was very responsive and the place was very nice and well located! I'll be happy to stay again in the loft if I come back to Porto! :)

Sofia was an exceptional host! Extremely responsive and even accommodated an earlier check-in for us, provided us excellent tips for local must-sees and provided a great in-person overview of her place.  Her place is in a fantastic, centrally located spot and even a 5 minute walk from the bus terminal and 15 minute walk from the train.  The place was fully stocked and even a nice bottle of port greeted us.  Obrigada!! 👋🔆 The h

We had a truly lovely stay at M's place!The apartment is located on a peaceful street close to Porto's main sights and you can also reach the southern part of the town and port wineries easily by walking. Everything worked well with the self check-in and the place was clean and cozy with beautiful artworks on the walls. We were also beyond happy to discover that there's an aircon to ensure good night's sleep after warm summer days. Thanks again M for a great accommodation!
We loved our stay here! Check-in was really easy and hosts were communicative and helpful. Cozy bed, plenty of space, close to everything. Would definitely recommend and return!
Great location and an easy walk to lots of activities. Lovely apartment, air conditioner was a plus. Highly recommend

Lovely top floor studio in a great location in Porto, with proximity to local metro station and supermarkets. Mariana was a wonderful host who provided everything we needed during our stay and clear instructions on how to check in. The studio came with everything we needed to enjoy our trip including toiletries and and bathroom items (hairdryer, brush etc). A great base for exploring the city. Thank you!!
We had a great time in Porto, the Check-In and the communication with the host were really good and uncomplicated. The room was like it's described and very clean.
This airbnb is in such a good location in a neighborhood that feels safe. Mariana was a wonderful host. It enhanced my already wonderful experience in Porto.

Mariana's place is fantastic, tucked away from main streets but right in the middle of everything. The flat has everything one would need (and more), is bright and cozy. Communication was excellent and instructions super-helpful. Couldn't be happier and would certainly return when back in Porto.
The apartment was perfect and our hosts were very helpful with questions. They also suggested many things to do and see which was very helpful! We had an amazing stay. Thank you again!
The apartment was perfect and any issues or questions were quickly sorted. It’s a little noisy at night due to the street so bring earplugs! Everything else was great!
Lovely flat, only 30 minutes walk from centre of Porto making it ideal for week long stays. Could do with a tea towel for drying up and fixing the extractor fan
We had a nice trip to Porto, where we enjoyed this airbnb very much. Everything was as expected, and we had a good communication with the host.

The apartment is very well localized with good space. There are plenitud restaurants around. Very close of metro station.  The apartment odor was pretty bad, I guess due a toilet drainage issue. Ana; the person that checked us in was very polite and gave us few tips about Porto
Easy access to downtown, yet quiet neighborhood. Great location near metro. Great space and had everything we needed.

The stay was very good. The location of the house is perfect. You can get to the city centre very quickly on foot or with the Uber. The free parking is really good. But the highlight was the very tasty breakfast and the nice contact to the host.
Liana is definitely a perfect host. We had an excellent time and highly recommend. The free parking conveniently beside apartment is such a bonus as is enclusive breakfast.

I highly advise you to book this house when you can. It's two minutes down the road to the best city vista in Europe. The terrace is lovely and you can feel the vibes and mood of Porto in the right way. =)

We loved our stay in this lovely apartment. Easy check in. The host was super helpful, gave us lots of recommendations and answered all our questions! The area is lovely, just a short walk to the river and from there you can cross the bridge into Porto. Great breakfast! Highly recommend…
An awesome experience. A very nice place to stay near to the wine caves and good restaurants. A few miles from Porto, but on the best side of the river.

Liana’s reply is made so quickly. Car park is also free, that is located from 3min. walk from the house.  In general, Porto and Gaia close to Douro River have many slopes and narrow steps, so that handling suitcases would be much harder if you would have more than one suitcases by person.  This house will be good for young backpackers. Breakfast can be enjoyed in local shop/cafe nearby.

Really convenient location to the riverfront and World of Wine while still being far enough to be quiet at night. The space was clean and stylish and the included parking, breakfast, and laundry facilities made this a great value.
Great apartment with an even better location. Highly recommend for anyone wanting to explore Gaia and Porto.

Perfect location to discover Porto. The only point is, you need to be comfortable with stairs (in the alley outside). I really appreciated Paula, her hospitality and her availability. Super appreciated the car park because moving in Porto with a car is a real mess.

Very helpful communication before we arrived with precise instructions we could follow. Location was wonderful, easy walk to Porto and to breakfast location. House was very well equipped and extremely clean. A couple of days we needed takeout breakfasts and it was delivered the night before - really helpful and flexible. Overall a very comfortable stay. We would return!
Great location and the breakfast was excellent. The stairs are a bit tricky, but we were just very careful. I would stay here again.

Our family had a great time staying at Liana's place.   Lovely apartment, very convenient location, an option to park the car nearby, and breakfast at a local market - all this made our trip very special.  Thank you for your hospitality, Liana!

Here’s a review you can use for your stay in Porto: Our stay in Porto was fantastic! The location was perfect, and the place was well-maintained. The host was extremely hospitable, with quick and helpful responses. The breakfast, which was included, was amazing and really set the day off right. Having a dedicated parking spot was a huge plus, especially since parking in the area can be hard to find and would easily add €20. Overall, a wonderful experience!
Great place and location for exploring Porto. The Breakfast and coffee was an added bonus and delicious. Beds were comfortable.  Highly recommended this place.

Wonderful house set away from the road. 5 minute walk to the river downhill, cafes restaurants etc. or 5 minute walk uphill to the Jardim do Morro and the best sunset views. The famous Port Wine houses are on the doorstep.The house is just perfectly sited. After a day walking up and down the alleyways, the house is a peaceful haven at night to return to.  Spotlessly clean, comfortable beds, well equipped kitchen, powerful shower. Nice balcony to enjoy the views and sunsets. Breakfast is included at the local Mercrearia do Bernardino, where Paula and her staff just can't do enough for you. Croissants, bread, cakes, yoghurt, cheese, ham, coffee, tea and more, sets you up for the many hills and steps of Besutiful Gaia and Porto. We will be back soon.
We had a wonderful stay at Carolina's apt. The apt is lovely and extremely well located. Would definitely come back!

The location is perfect - couldn't ask for better!! The apartment was  extremely clean with all possible facilities. Caroline was a thoughtful and very communicative host, making sure we had a perfect check in and check out. Everything you'd like to see in Porto is less than a ten minute walk away. Every aspect was better than imagined, honestly. Absolutely no room for improvement - look no further you won't regret your stay in this home within a world unesco site - ribiera!
The apartment is clean and spacious, and very well located. Carolina is super helpful too. Really enjoyed my stay.

The apartment is absolutely perfect. Centrally located but on a quiet street. host is nice, accessible and helpful. very easy check-in and check-out. The apartment is newly refurbished, really nice ,cozy and with all the facilities you need. I would love to come back myself and highly recommend to everyone else. Thanks a lot to Carolina for a really enjoyable stay

We absolutely loved this gorgeous apartment! Stylish, clean and cozy equipped with everything you need for a perfect stay. Check in details couldn't have been more straight forward and the apartment itself greatly exceeded our expectations. Fantastic base to explore Porto. Great location with lots of restaurants, bars, local shops. We walked everywhere, but transport is also convenient should you need it. Carolina is a fantastic host and so helpful! Communication with her was really easy and quick. Can't wait to come back!

This location is amazing - it’s a short walk to all major attractions and bus lines, yet very quiet inside. The check in was very easy with the self-check lock box. Carolina made herself available for any questions we had. We loved it!!

This apartment is fantastic. The location is superb—all the nightlife, restaurants, shops, everything is right outside the door. Easy to walk down to the river.  Very easy to access from everywhere.   Your options for experiencing Porto are unlimited.   Pretty decor, I might add.

Super central location! Easy check in and quick responses! Lovely to come back to after a day of exploring! Bring earplugs as the buskers in the street/ restaurants can get fairly repetitive and noisy!

The apartment is well located, right in the midst of the Porto tourist scene and within walking distance to all the major sites. The spaces are bright and airy and the bed is very comfortable. We loved evening wine out on the narrow balcony, watching the pedestrian walkway scene below. The trade off for such a central location is urban noise of trucks, street musicians, recycling but ear plugs work.
Great location very central. Very clean and spacious! Big bathroom and comfy bedroom - great value for money
It‘s a nice apartment. Really close to the Duoro and Sao Bento station. It‘s perfect for a couple. The bed and cushions are very comfy and everything was very clean.

Really enjoyed my stay at the apartment. The host was very communicative and made the checkin process very easy. Lovely apartment with balcony and view. Excellent location to use as a base to explore Porto. A++++

The spot of the apartment was really beautiful, though the bedroom was located right above the glass container on the streets. Between 11 and 12 all the restaurants dumped their glass there, and between 3 and 4 am (really crazy) the truck picked it up on each night. This caused us to wake up multiple times during the night. Too bad, because the apartment is really tidy and well-located.

The apartment was really good located for doing all important activities in Porto. Bus for going to Matosinhos beach was at 5 minutes of the appartement. The appartement was clean and well agenced. Not really noisy. Carolina was present and fast to answer to all of our requests. I totally recommend this apartment!

We had an amazing time at Carolina’s, she was very helpful and responsive and the appartement had everything we needed! It didn’t take much walking around for us to realize how great the location is, nearby all the different attractions of Porto and with a beautiful view from the balcony! Was worth every penny!
Carolina is a great host. She is very efficient and fast to respond. The place was in a great location and it has everything you need.
Great location in downtown Lisbon. Could walk everywhere. Room on the small side however very clean. Host was amazing!

Lovely, spacious apartment in the heart of Porto. Well stocked kitchen and completely comfortable living room. Construction in area is challenge, but once we figured out our routes it worked out fine. Recommend highly!

We had a lovely stay! Carolina is very responsive and she pays attention to every detail to make your stay perfect. Due to some constructions outside  there was some noise but they provided us ear plugs. All perfect!! :)
I had an amazing stay at this lovely apartment. It’s very clean and cut! It’s walkable to almost everywhere! Wonderful location and a lot of good restaurants around! Absolutely loved the stay!

The apartments are located right in the city center, close to the famous promenade. Easy to get to any attractions. But keep in mind that this is quite a noisy street even in the evening, as there are many restaurants and tourists around. Even with a small child, the noise from the street did not bother us much. Karolina was always in touch, quickly answered and helped when something was needed. The place is clean and good-equipped. Overall we are satisfied with our short stay :)

Spacious and very clean and comfortable apartment in a great location. Carolina was a great host, very helpful and quick to respond. As per other reviewers, the only drawback to this spot is the rubbish collection point beneath which means a lot of loud noise at odd hours of the night. Apart from this we were extremely happy with our stay and would highly recommend.
Great stay in a beautiful apartment. Fantastic value, too. This is a full apartment on a main street in the city center. I'd book again next time I'm in Porto.

A nice apartment in the middle of touristic part of the city with all upsides and downsides it brings. A lot of things to see around and I was able to return to it without any map multiple times because of how prominent the location is. A good place to stay for a few days while visiting the city.
Everything was great! The flat was very nice and central and the hosts were nice as well. I can definitely recommend staying here :)
Spacious apartment with a great location. Can be a little noisy early in the morning as others have mentioned.
Brilliant location. Fairly basic amenities but has everything you need for a short city break.

The location was great, short walk to the river front and many restaurants.  Carolina is an outstanding host, she was in constant communication with us and resolved some minor issues as they occurred.
Beautiful space, right in the heart of the popular restaurants and bars. Host was very responsive and very accommodating. Check in and check out was smooth.

Great flat in the perfect location as long you’re ok to walk up 4 flights of stairs. Really enjoyed our stay and the view is gorgeous! Love the fact that they’ve included a portable WiFi dongle with the flat so you can walk around Town without eating into your data.

Amazingly central location and newly renovated apartment with stunning views! Coming by car is not advisable (navigating small streets, additional parking fee of €15/night, parking location a short walk away around the block). Washer not in apartment but communal and 4 floors down. Mattress not the best quality (too soft and seemed overused)..but definitely not a dealbreaker. The apartment is really wonderful and the location and views make up for the little drawbacks. Thank you for a great stay!

This apartment was absolutely fantastic. We were sad to leave. The views were spectacular, beautiful and the church bell chimes where beautifully sounding. Couldn’t get tired of it. Location was perfect and in walking distance to everything, including the train stations. Would recommend this place to any visitor and we would return as well. Thank you Porto city hosts for everything. Our stay was perfect.

It's simply lovely.. The view from the balcony is breathing, especially if you catch the sunset.. it's very pleasant and clean.. i loved the location and felt lucky that it was available on my visit period.

This apartment has fantastic views over the city and is in a great location. Communication with the hosts was clear and easy. The amenities were good. I’d recommend this place to others — who are able to climb the hill and the stairs to the fourth floor.

It's really stylish apartment with a great location in the city center. The apartment has an amazing view. We enjoyed our small vacation there.  The only thing which can bother you that seagulls can be loud at night sometimes :)
Great view to both sides! Super clean and comfortable! Awesome customer service! We‘d come back for sure!

Amazing apartment right in the thick of Porto’s buzzing heart. The view from the apartment is absolutely incredible and you can enjoy all day sunshine with the doors open. Worked remotely here for 2 weeks and was the perfect place with a decent internet connection.

Beautiful best area located apartment, the view is beyond imagination to the old Town just like a fairytale like you went back to medieval times.. Bed is super comfortable and worth the price for sure!
Excellent stay! The apartment features unique views, is very cozy and comfortable. It's located in the city center and everything is in walkable distance.
Great area with beautiful view from the living room. The church bells were a charming touch.
