The location of this place is absolutely amazing! So much better than I had expected. And I expected a lot. The place is super clean and modern, AC worked great, views are spectacular.
Nice place in the center. As others have mentioned the stairs can be a lot, but overall a good stay.
The appartement is very close to everything one could need. The view from the living room is great.

Great place, great location. Very clean, modern and convenient. Check in was very easy.  The only problem is for those who have a suitcases… The apartment is on the 4th floor with no elevator and a very narrow stairs. Other than that it was perfect
Excellent views, enough space for two, very close to restaurants and coffees. Will definitely come back.

Absolutely lovely views! Ideal location to major attractions & train station.  Yes, stairs not for everyone, but neither are Porto’s hills. It wasn’t a problem for us. Laundry is on entry floor, not in unit, to clarify. It was a joy to come and go from this super convenient and comfortable apartment. Grab and go market just 3-4 minutes walk. Consider that cars can’t get to the actual door of the apartment in case you are using the car service or Uber. Starbucks is a great drop/ pick up location at the end of block. Grateful for terrific communication and car transfers made things super easy.
Perfect location in old town, great views, quiet house and street! Only problem to us was, that for 2 persons there are one shared bed with one shared blanket.

A very clean and nicely decorated space. This apartment was in a great location and had great views from both ends of the apartment. Our only complaint is that it was tough carrying all of our luggage up the tight spiral staircase to the 4th floor. Otherwise, an awesome space in Porto!
The apartment is located on a hill. There are road works around the place during our stay that made navigation tricky. But a lovely place with great views.
This apartment was perfect for my week stay in Porto. It has wonderful views from the 4th floor and is very quiet. I plan to come back!
Great location and views from the apartment. Overall would recommend. The only downside was a bit of an “old house” smell and lots of small black spots (mold?) in the shower.
It’s a great space with beautiful views in every direction. The space is comfortable and clean and the windows keep out the street sounds. We’d definitely stay again given its perfect location!

Walking up four, narrow flights of stairs with luggage for a family of three was inconvenient, especially so since you cant drive up to the apartment and it’s located half way up a steep cobblestone street.  More inconvenient was booking this place with a hide a bed with the expectation it would be ready to use. Instead we had to pay 30 euros for bedding so our kid could have a place to sleep.  All that said, it was in a great location for São João and in a very central location to other sites. We watched the fireworks from the living room which was incredible.

We loved staying in this attractive bright apartment right in the heart of Porto. It was handy for the sights and transport and had fabulous views. The seagulls were really noisy at night but this was not a problem as the double-glazing & shutters block out the sound completely, plus their is air conditioning. It is top floor so a bit of a climb but well worth it for the view, light & privacy. We would definitely recommend.

I enjoyed my stay here. Very close to the action in Porto. I walked everywhere once I arrived from the train station. Be prepared for steps, but that’s typical in Porto. Besides, the view is well worth it. Highly recommend!

I stayed at this apartment for a week and I was amazed by the great views of the city and the river. The apartment is clean, and well-equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The host was very friendly and helpful. The location is perfect, as it is close to many attractions, restaurants, and public transportation. I enjoyed walking around the neighborhood and exploring the charming streets and buildings. I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to experience the beauty and culture of Porto Lisbon. It was one of the best Airbnb experiences I ever had!

The place is really walkable and in a great location. As others mentioned going up the 4 flights of stairs every evening was a bit tiring, especially after all the delicious meals we enjoyed in Porto. Overall the place was very nice, felt like a standardized Airbnb so was not very personalized/unique, but very comfortable. I only experienced a shortage of hot water one evening. Kitchen had plenty of pots/pans/etc, but they only provided coffee pods for one day so hopefully that is something the hosts can improve. Their directions also ask guests to empty their own trash daily which seemed a bit unusual. Check in was very easy. Would still recommend as it was a great location and good value.
I had trouble with my original Airbnb, so I was able to book and check in to this one within an hour. Very helpful.

Such a lovely apartment, central to everything, with a terrace right next to this beautiful church. EVERYTHING is walkable. Apartment was very clean. Hosts were so helpful, gave me great recommendations, and even let me keep my luggage in their office while I walked around before the apartment was ready. The only not-so-great part was the four floor, super narrow walk-up. Other than that, the apartments was amazing for a college girls trip!
Great team with prompt communication. Even on New Year’s Day, there was someone to text for a minor issue we were having.
Great stay, the views from both balconies were incredible. Its a wonderfully central location. The steps are no joke, 4th floor. Would recommend to anyone looking to enjoy Porto.
There is only one comforter in the house, if you request an extra comforter sheet you will need to pay extra

Enjoyed my stay here! Very clean and perfect for the solo traveler or couple. Host was very communicative with clear check-in instructions and left a physical key in case the code wouldn’t work. The location is very convenient and easily walkable to points of interest - and the balcony view of the church is beautiful. Just be aware that for the view, it’s a 4th floor walk-up with no elevator.
Very comfortable flat in the centre of Porto with some amazing views. The apartment is spacious and big enough for 2 even 3 people. Would stay here again!
This room was very clean and the view was amazing. The staff was very friendly and responded promptly to questions.

Very stylish, clean with high end finishes.  Bottle of Port and some Nata pastries on arrival were a welcome touch.  15 minute walk to the riverfront.  Just be aware there are 4 flights of stairs and no elevator.
Great apartment, clean, new and well equipped. Beds very comfortable. Location is great, just off  Rua Caterina. The only negative is 4 flights of stairs to get to it.

We were very happy with the location and the apartment.  Everything was as describe, Carolina was super responsive and proactive.  We were aware that it was in the 4th floor, and we though it was easy but It does take an effort.  My kids did not mind it!  I would probably stay again if I go back.  Thanks Carolina!

Very clean apartment, and high end. Embroidered linens, nice scents and soaps, truly boutique experience!  To top it all off, extremely accommodating with check in and check out, able to help with luggage storage! Beautiful outdoor terrace, lots of sunlight!  Location is excellent, close to Via Catarina shopping street! Highly recommend, and would stay here again in the future!

Had a great time at Filipe’s apartment, the city centre is within walking distance and the apartment is very easy to get to from the airport. Everything was clean and well presented - would recommend it.
Great location, needed a late check in so this place was perfect. Very clean and host always there if needed. Would definitely stay again.
Very clean and confortable for a short stay. Walkable distance from everything Porto has to offer.

I loved this little spot. Really cute view and very walkable. Only a 10 minute walk from the city center but far enough to get away from all the tourists and craziness after a long day of exploring. The apartment was extremely clean and had everything it needed. Felipe is very responsive and gives very clear instructions on how to enter the building. I'd definitely book this again :)
Great little apartment in Porto. We went to Primavera sounds and the apartment was perfect for 3 for that purpose. Thank you!
The apartment is very nice and comfortable! Location is perfect, near shops, bars, restaurants and tourist attractions. The host was very helpful and friendly, gave us very useful tips!

This is a well appointed flat in the heart of downtown. The hosts are some of the best I've encountered and will give you great information. Nothing is too much trouble. I had no issue with noise either from the rest of the building or the street and the little extras: wine, nespresso machine and smart TV with Netflix etc made it a more homely experience than you're likely to get in a hotel. Recommended.
Easy and simple Communication - the location of the apartment was great - a lot of good recommendations from Da’Home Team. Thanks!

Our stay at this apartment was brilliant. It was a super stylish, relaxing and really clean space that made us feel at home straight away. We got a great presentation of tips and other helpful information from the hosts and even when there was an issue with a bath plug, it was kindly sorted straight away. Great location and communication too - couldn’t recommend enough! Thanks guys

The apartment which is fancy and the design is beautiful; it’s near all the sightseeing point and  you can go by foot. There were so many yummy restaurants around. The host is in quick response and i got a super warm welcome by Caterina. All the facilities which is ready for you to stay there like you home. I’d enjoy to stay with DA’Home’s and is a good recommendation to you all.
Perfect location - close to all the main places, but still quiet. Spent two pleasant weeks in this apartment.

Superb spot for your stay in Porto. Communication is handled by way of a whatsapp group with several people monitoring it, ready to answer your questions. A great touch.  The apartment itself is gorgeous and in a very central location. The local area is packed with places to eat and drink. All you could ask for basically!
Such a nice stay, they were super helpful and welcoming and the apartment is in such a good area. Would Definetly stay again :)
Fantastic location, next to the main sights of Porto. Extremely clean, well equipped and nicely decorated apartment. We felt at home. Recommended!

We had an amazing time in Porto! Catarina was a great host being very flexible with check-in and check-out times! She also gave us great tips on what to see around the city. The best feature of the apartment is by far the location. The apartment is in a quite area, but all tourist attractions are still reachable by foot. Thank you very much for hosting us!

Cute apartment with an amazing location! Loved all the little local restaurants and small boutiques/galleries within walking distance. The apartment is from another era so there are some heat and humidity issues. You have to run a loud de-humidifier all day or the kitchen floors can get quite damp. There are also 2 space heaters keeping the chilly apartment warm, but it’s probably very pleasant to stay in the summer. Overall I think the price accurately reflects the value, so no real complaints here :) The hosts are also very welcoming and responsive.
Really nice space and in a great location for restaurants, bars and sightseeing. Communication was brilliant for check in, during the stay, and for check out.

Staying at this location was absolutely great! The apartment is next to a very cool art district where you can find a lot of nice coffee places and street art. The location was super - we could easily walk everywhere! The apartment was clean and well decorated. Communication with the host was easy and fast. Definitely recommended!
The apartment is perfectly located, very cozy and beautiful and has everything to make you feel comfortable. The tips from hosts about local places are very useful.
overall a very good stay - a few issues with cleanliness of the property unfortunately but great location and very quiet.
The room was nice and in the middle of Porto. Pretty cool :) But it’s a hostel!

If you want to be in the heart of the city this is the place! It did make it a little noisy at night but was very convenient getting around. You have to climb a couple flights of stairs to get into the hostel/your room. But clean facilities!

I had an amazing stay at this place. The apartment was so clean and so nicely decorated. The location was very good in the heart of the commercial area but so quiet. Cesar was an amazing host to reply to every my question very shortly. I wanted to stay more... Thanks for everything!

The apartment is clean, stylish, comfortable, and very convenient to everything Porto has to offer. Cesar gave us wonderful tips, and the added touches were so appreciated. Definitely a great place to stay while you visit Porto!

Great location located on the third floor of a central building in the middle of a historical area. The style of the apartment is quite welcoming and inviting despite the small space all amenities are immaculate and sparkling clean. Upon checkin,  the host was quite responsive and met us in person. We were provided with a manual of local tips. The wine and sweets upon arrival were excellent touch especially after a long flight. The host is really responsive. I cannot find the place I highly recommend it we will definitely be back. The fan was sufficient for air circulation in  addition to the windows being left open at night, and it was quiet not noisy. The coffee pods were really good quality and the tea. I would give this stay 100/100
This Airbnb is well located, super clean and the host where there to meet us and give us information on our first day in Porto. I really recommend this place.
A very elegant and clean studio! César was really kind with us and we had a great communication. Central location!  5 *!

This place was FANTASTIC! I was greeted by Cesar, who was super informative, responsive, and very kind. The apartment is small and cozy, and has everything you need - and was super clean and super peaceful and tranquil. It is on the 4th floor (no elevator!) of a historic building with beautiful wood floors and tastefully restored.  Great neighborhood that didn’t feel touristy. It is conveniently located just a couple of blocks away from a metro station and a major shopping district (with 2 huge, multi-level shopping centers, with grocery store and international food courts - but somehow magically hidden from street view  behind traditional shops and such), but the apartment itself is on a very quiet side street. Extra special touches included some lovely port wine to try and yummy treats. Wonderful apartment and excellent hosts. A+!
Cesar was very nice and he took a lot of his time to recommand us the best places in Porto. He even brought porto wine and pasteis de nata ! It was perfect, thank you again :)

Carmen’s place is fantastic for a getaway to Porto - not only is the location pretty much perfect, walking distance to the main sights and dozens of amazing restaurants, the apartment was sparkling clean and the host offered many amazing local tips. Totally recommend this place!!

This is a perfect place to stay in Porto.  Really central, near supermarkets, shops, but in a quiet street.  The place is very beautiful, clean, easy to reach.  It has everything we needed.  If this place is free for your dates, book it right away!  You won't regret it!

We really enjoyed staying in the apartment. It was clean and very well put together. César and his family put a lot of attention to details and you can see that. Everything was very well accommodated, I literally can’t think of anything that was missing!  Overall: very clean, put together and nicely designed apartment with a good location!

Cesar's place is clean, comfortable, well-decorated. César is really helpful and will make sure you have everything you need to discover Porto. The appartment is in a quiet street, but very close to Porto's historical center.  Totally recommended !
The best location in Porto, close to the shopping center, public transportation and city attractions. Very clean and cozy place, I would definitely recommend this apartment.

The apartment is well located, the announcement is accurate and it is very good value. Cesar is an attentive host, that makes sure that you are settled. There is even a brochure with recommendations of what to do and see around.

Cesar's airbnb was a wonderful experience. From the very start, Cesar was an attentive host; reaching out to us a couple of days before our stay to confirm our arrival. When we arrived, Cesar welcomed us and showed us around the airbnb as well as given us a few tips to explore Portom The stay itself was top tier - very clean, comfortable and well thought out. There were even fire extinguishers and first aid kit available (Which really demonstrated host's attentiveness). I would definitely come back as well as recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto.

The apartment was really clean,  nicely decorated and well equiped. It is in walking distance from the city Center and all the sights. Communication with the host was easy, nice and welcoming. We really enjoyed our time in Porto!

The apartment is very nice, tastefully decorated and close to one of the nicest streets in Porto.  Easy to reach by Metro from The Campanha train station and to move around town by foot or Metro.  Cesar was very responsive, met us at the door at the agreed time and answer our our questions promptly.  Highly recommend.
César was a great host, very kind and responsive. The studio has everything you need for a short stay in the city and it was sparkling clean we arrived. Highly recommend!

Cesar was a great host. Always responsive with questions ahead of my arrival. I was delayed due to airline difficulties, but he was still available to meet me and explain everything about his place.  He also  had the  most thoughtful and thorough notebook on instructions, vital information, and helpful suggestions!  The place had all the basics I needed and was immaculately clean and charmingly decorated. Just one warning. There is no lift. There are 65 steps to climb with luggage!  I counted!

Cesar’s place is very nice, cosy, comfortable and quiet. Well-located in Porto, we really enjoyed our stay. Cesar and his co-hosts were very responsive and available to help. We will definitely come back!

It was a real treat to stay at such a nice place and with such a warm welcome from the host, Cesar.  The place was very clean and comfortable with lots of little extras that made it very special.  One thing to note is that it is not suitable if you are mobility challenged as it is up several flights of stairs.  I happen to not mind it at all as I enjoy the exercise.

The apartment was very centrally located and just about everything you could possibly want to do is within a 15-20 minute walk at the furthest. Many great sites, restaurants and shopping areas within a few blocks of the apartment. The host is very kind and provided many good recommendations!

Had a wonderful stay at this studio apartment for our first visit to Porto. The space is very well equipped with kitchen supplies, plenty of towels, and a binder FULL of information and recommendations about the city. Rui was so, so, so kind and helpful. He is very responsive and kept in touch about check in time. The location is just a 5 min walk to the shopping center and Balhao Market (and metro stop). Very easy to walk to other locations around the city while being out of the hustle and bustle! The street is actually very calm and quiet, even with being so close to attractions. I would recommend this stay!

Rui was a complete delight and the room was pretty, clean, well appointed with very lovely touches. Big white towels, treats, personal checkin and informative guest book. It was advertised as a king bed, but it’s a queen (not the end of the world) but the pillows were very uncomfortable which was surprising because you can clearly see the pride of ownership.  This is also on the top floor with many steps. It’s really lovely but I would not have booked had I known about all the steps but I would still recommend if you don’t have mobility issues as I do. Beautiful building and very convenient neighbourhood. Very nice host!

Excellent apartment! Looking forward to returning. Everything was great, many thoughtful touches and amenities, and it was very comfortable. Beware of the stairs to the 3rd / 4th floor if that poses an issue for you and your luggage. Host was very friendly, responsive and communicative.
Great stay, easy access to main pedestrian areas. Flexible check-in was very helpful to facilitate our trip. Helpful recommendations to prioritize our time while visiting Porto.

Overall the stay was fine, Isabel was really friendly and nice. The only caveat to any newcomers is to be aware of the humidity. Though there’s a humidifier it is extremely humid and the host let’s you know about it.

Miguel’s condo was excellent. The location is perfect to walk anywhere among great restaurants and cafes, super close to the river. Kitchen is well equipped  to cook if needed, and the bed was very comfortable. We had a great stay.
5* Porto experience! Great new apartment with every amenity and perfect location. This apartment is a must when visiting Porto.

We were very pleased with everything. The location was perfect, it was in a rather quiet part of the city and everything was nearby. The apartment was bright, high standard and the host was super nice. She was available and helpful. There was not much of a view from the window and there was some noise from other guests.
Beautiful apartment in a very central location with all amenities close by. The decoration is simple, the apartment is practical and comfortable. Check in worked perfectly as we arrived so late.
Good stay and very nice host and cleaning lady! Worth the stay for 1 month! 😄

Good apartment. Clean and comfortable. Some traffic noise from street (tolerable) and no blinds. Check in process required getting the key in an hostel, far from the apartment (15min). But the experience was positive!

Very nice flat, modern and clean. Great location, everything is nearby and in walking distance: popular city attractions, restaurants, a shopping mall, laundry. Staff is very friendly and helpful with any requests. We stayed for a month and there was a weekly cleaning service that made our stay easier!
Great location very close to metro, train station and sites plus a good supermarket. Clean bright apartment ideal for a short break. However front apartments face onto quite a busy road.
A lot of thanks for a great holiday.We really recommend this place. Host were very lovely and helpful, thanks again !!!
Very good location, near by train station, exactly a few steps from the beach, quite surroundings with sound of the sea. The room was under our expectations. We were satisfied.
Nice classic room with private toilet on the floor . Seaview is modest but an extra . Mario and Dulce are very kind people , I can recommend the stay
Mario was the perfect host, they were so kind and accommodating to our needs. A great location with easy access to the shops, beach and city. Thank you for hosting us in your lovely home.

This Airbnb is a good location. It’s close to the bus station and metro so it’s easy to get around the city and to other cities in Portugal. It’s about a 15-20 min walk to the city center which is great. The place is also close to many shops, grocery stores and pharmacies. The hosts were nice and one greeted me at the door, explained the facilities and was helpful in assisting me in finding the place. It was great for my two friends and me and it’s a good value. Would definitely recommend this place.

We had a lovely time in Porto. The appartement was clean and located perfectly. Within 5 minutes you will find a lot of great restaurants and bakery's! Great place to stay. We would recommend this appartement :)
This is a nice place to stay and spacious. The balcony is great in the afternoon because you can enjoy the sun! Supermarkets are near and a nice walk to the center.
Great apartment for a short stay in Porto, place was nice and clean and short walk to city centre.
Abel's home is clean, spacious and centrally located. We had an easy time getting into the building and communicating with the hosts.

Communication with the host was great, we received clear instructions for the self-check-in (very handy). The location of the place is very convenient to walk around Porto. The apartment needs a bit of TLC, it should probably be aired a bit before guests arrival and a bit of general cleaning wouldn’t be a bad idea.

The apartment was exactly as we expected looking at the photos and description. The location is so central, walking distance to the city, transport and local amenities. The hosts were extremely friendly and responsive, communicating with us before, throughout and after our stay
Great value. Location is close to the center so easy to get around.  The place was as described. Super clean And Rose was very responsive at all times:)
Ana Paula’s house is in a great location close to the beach and local food shops. The apartment was better then expected from the photos. We really enjoyed our stay.
It is a nice apartment 20 to 25 minutes drive from Porto. Very clean and convenient. Host is responsive and provide many useful informations of where to go on new year eve.

Gustavo welcomed us late at night, took the time to show us around the flat and gave us some tips on places to go/eat! The flat is really clean and located about 20 mins walk from the centre. The bed is super comfy and we slept really well but if you are not used to city noise, you might find the traffic a little distracting.

The apartment was beautiful, spacious, clean, modern, and in a prime location close (within walking distance) to all the main tourist attractions. Another plus was the parking garage which was very convenient since we had a rent-a-car. Also, it was very nice being greeted with a complementary bottle of wine and the Krups coffee maker was especially fabulous. I also must acknowledge how Nuno went out of his way to greet us when the four of us first arrived very late in the evening. Thanks again, Jazmin

This is It...this is the executive premiere level of airbnb experiences.  This place was so amazing that I did not want to even leave in the evenings.  The atmosphere, the hospitality, the amenities, the location, the elevator, the black out shades, the kitchen, the washer/dryer.  It just has It all.  You are around the corner from everything, yet on a quiet street.  On my many trips to Porto, I wish this place was always available!

nuno and anita are wonderful hosts! there place is beautiful (better than the pictures!), very clean, and the location is excellent. the space has everything you will need and is the perfect place to come home to after a day of exploring. the decks are an added bonus.  they provided wonderful ideas and suggestions. I highly recommend their home.

This place is a gem. The description and comments are all true. It’s clean, big, beautiful, has parking and is in a great location of the city. Not only that, the hosts are outstanding. In advance of our visit we got a sample walking tour and list of restaurants which really helped us maximize our short time in Porto. While it was only two of us, this place is perfect for a family or friends traveling together. If we return, we will be sure to stay here again!

Everything you need is here.  The perfect location, the elevator, the outdoor space, the ideal hosts.  This place has It all.  I don't have one but of feedback that is not 100% positive.  If It is available I would stay here every time I am in Porto!  Bravo to these wonderful hosts.  This is the ideal top notch Airbnb!!!!
Cool apartment in fantastic central location. Wonderful and responsive hosts. Our only issue is that we only stayed 3 nights!!!
A lovely loft in the heart of Porto. The flat is nice, modern, very stylish, have everything that you need. Nuno was a great host. I recommend it!

An absolutely fabulous place to stay. The condo is beyond beautiful, very conveniently located, loaded with amenities, and Anita and Nuno were amazing hosts.  They really went all out to make sure we felt welcomed and comfortable. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a place to stay in Porto. I wish we could’ve stayed longer!
Really nice place! Amazing host! Well deserved nice vacation! The most well designed air-bnb apartment that I have every seen and ever experienced! Need to go!!!

We had a great stay at this wonderful penthouse in Porto. Nuno and Anita were great hosts, always there when needed but also respecting privacy big time. The weather was quite rainy during our stay, but this apartment made it quite comfortable to stay in and spread over the two floors... the terrace is great when its sunny. Recommended!

One of my favorite Airbnb experiences. Anita and Nuno’s place is the perfect place to enjoy Porto. Beautifully designed, full of sun, strong wifi, equipped kitchen, every detail thought of. Definitely plan on enjoying the sunset from the lovely deck. And Anita and Nuno are wonderful hosts!

Wonderful place for a visit to beautiful Porto; we were a family of 4 with 2 adults and 2 kids and were extremely comfortable, Nuno and Anita were great hosts that shared with us recommendations and great communication. The apartment has anything you need and more, we loved our stay and hope to come back soon. Thanks!

Perfection. A great 2 Bedroom flat. Amazing outdoor space! A parking space!! Great hosts that helped us get parked, get settled. Find the very convenient grocery just on the street. Umbrellas for the rain. We even worked out an extra night that helped the rain clear!

Nuno and Anita are awesome. They are kind, caring and quite helpful. The apartment was super clean and well cared for. Their location was perfect.. close to everything but so quiet at night. We will be back.
Incredible apartment, very clean, wonderful decks, and great hosts! Comfortably fits 4 people. Highly recommend this Airbnb.

This place is one of the best airbnbs I've stayed in.  The location is central in Porto, the hosts are lovely, beds were comfortable and appreciate all the little touches they've put on the place like a home gym, welcome bottle of port, etc.

The best Airbnb we’ve stayed in. Nuno and Anita were super friendly and had loads of great recommendations for us. They were very accommodating of our arrival and departure times. The flat is beautiful, furniture looks great and it has three wonderful terraces. We particularly loved the honesty bar with some of their favourite wines and beers. They even had Netflix and Prime! They really did think of everything. We will be back!

I've booked over 40 airbnbs in 10 countries and this is one of the best. Not only because of the amazing hosts, but the apartment is comfortable (great beds and couch, equipped kitchen, a convenient neighborhood with markets and restaurants, near the main sites, AND parking in the building with an elevator. Sunset and sunrise views, and quiet neighbors despite being in the city.

The apartment is perfect!It has everything we needed and was close to the center !The hosts were very friendly and hospitable, they explained everything to us !Even if Porto was rainy we enjoyed it from the coziness of this apartment ❤️Obrigado!
The flat was well equipped and quite lovely.  Wish we could’ve stayed longer!  Anita and Nuno were great hosts.  If you’re in Porto I would highly recommend staying here!

We loved our stay at Nuno & Anita's. The apartment is in a quiet part of the city but with excellent access to places to explore. They provided excellent recommendations for activities and restaurants which was really helpful!

Porto is amazing and this apartment is the prefect place to stay there. Close enough to walk everywhere, but on a safe and quiet street. The apartment gets a beautiful breeze, which makes sitting on the deck even better. Nuno was incredibly welcoming, and we wish we could have stayed longer.

We had the pleasure of staying at Nuno and Anita’s apartment, it was by far the best location we stayed at during our month long stay in Portugal.  Nuno and Anita were so thoughtful and made sure we had everything we needed when we arrived.  There even was a crib, high chair, and baby accessories available as we were travelling with an infant.  Communication was excellent, the apartment was extremely clean and well thought out.  We only stayed for 2 nights which was the biggest regret during the stay.  We will definitely stay here again when we visit Porto again.   Highly recommended!!!
Perfect apartment. Great space, excellent location and great hosts. Just as the pictures and would happily return.

Absolutely loved this place!! Such wonderful hosts - from the list of recs to the impeccable home and welcoming, it was nothing short of perfection. Great location and awesome balcony. Every detail was thought of. Highly recommend!!!

Nuno and Anita's apartment is an excellent base to explore Porto with outstanding facilities. They had thought of absolutely everything you could need and we wished we could've stayed for longer! Nuno met us on arrival and gave us detailed personal recommendations aligned to our interests (and the weather) - we really couldn't have asked for anything more and would highly recommend the apartment. A quiet spot right by all the all key sites. Loved it!

Nuno and Anita could not be better hosts. The apartment is lovely, clean, and beautifully fitted with lovely furniture and fittings. Everything you could need and more was in the apartment. The apartment block was situated near everything but far enough away to be quiet and restful, which is important after a busy day sightseeing.

Excellent place! Everything is thought through in this Airbnb. Nuno was very friendly and helpful with our questions. We were allowed to keep our car in the garage after checking out. Our family of 4 lived staying here!

We had an amazing stay at Nuno's apartment. Though we arrived close to 10pm he was happy to meet us and spent quite a bit of time going over the apartment and recommending places/areas to see. We received a VERY helpful printout of local restaurants, areas to "get lost" and attractions that might be of interest. It was the most complete info we've ever had from a rental. You could tell Nuno loved his city and wanted to share it with his guests. There's also a new washer and dryer that was easy to understand - that's not always the case in Europe. There were huge sliding glass doors on both sides of the apartment and the breeze blowing through was amazing!  It was convenient to everything we wanted to get to and would definitely stay again if we return to Porto.

We had a lovely time at Nuno and Anita’s place. I’ve never had  such a wonderful host who greeted us and gave us a lot of good information about what to do, restaurants, and getting around.  It was truly a comfortable place with so much beauty and great balconies to hang out on.  We really enjoyed hanging out in the kitchen with our coffee in the morning as really neat courtyard and view of the neighborhood.  The AC in each room was awesome and worked very well.   It was fully equipped with amenities of coffee that is super important to me. He had a nice selection of waters and other drinks for a small price.  He had also curated some bottles of wine for purchase that I would have loved to get into, but didn’t have the time!  It was an easy walk to most attractions from the apartment. The walk home is a lot of uphill so sometimes we took an Uber back.  Super hosts for sure!

Nuno and Anita's apartment was perfection. It's in an ideal location to walk everywhere, but is one street off the busy rush so you feel like you have some respite.  The space is clean, spacious, tastefully decorated, and well stocked. There's tons of light and lots of outdoor space. Beyond, the amazing apartment, Nuno has gone out of his way to make his Airbnb a 10... He's thought of everything, from an honor bar with wines from the region that he's personally selected and wrote detailed background descriptions of, to ear plugs and eye masks, and an incredibly helpful guide of Porto and the best walking route and restaurants. This is easily the best host I have ever dealt with and the apartment is in the top 3. Book this! You'll be ecstatic with what you find.

Incredible stay!  Nuno was a terrific host and his place was wonderful! He even helped us plan a beach trip! His place in Porto was quiet but walkable to everything. He had wine and beer to purchase, maps of the city, restaurant suggestions and his AC was good. We have traveled all over Europe and Nuno was by far the best host I have ever had.  FIVE STARS!!!!!
We had an amazing time in Porto thanks to Nuno!  The apartment was spacious and the beds comfortable.  It was nice having an outdoor terrace.  A great find in a fabulous city.

Wonderful apartment hosted by a lovely couple. Really made you welcome and assisted in lots of ways. Had a mini gym on site and great views to practice some yoga in front of. Loved the selection of terraces and views across the streets of Porto. Loved the honesty bar and enjoyed the Port!  Went to one of the areas recommended by Nuno and had a lovely alfresco evening.  Thoroughly recommend this one.

Well appointed apartment with a wonderful host! Comfortable beds (special attention to pillows -they were wonderful). Good showers and hot water supplies. Close to shopping but a few blocks away allowed for quiet evenings. I highly recommend this listing- thanks again for a great stay!

We absolutely loved Nuno’s place and would stay there again in a heartbeat. It was so comfortable and cute but also spacious and well stocked. Nuno made us feel so comfortable and well cared for. He gave us the best recommendations and was available at any time. Cannot say enough good things about him and our experience.

I would highly recommend starting at Nuno’s apartment when visiting Porto. Upon arrival he gave our group a through tour of the apartment, and gave us recommendations on what to do and where to eat in Porto. The apartment itself was extremely tidy and clean, and was beautifully orchestrated with furniture, decor, and linens. The flat gets flooded with natural light. Would love to stay again:
Our time in Porto was amazing and the time spent at Nuno’s condo was just as amazing ! Nuno provided us with great restaurant, places to see and where to get lost in Porto to explore !

Can’t recommend Nuno’s place enough! Amazing apartment with all essentials covered, and in a great location. We arrived very late and Nuno met us and spent time to make sure we had all of the info we needed to enjoy our stay. I hope we can return again!

I have stayed at many ab&b's and this was by far my favorite! The apartment is absolutely beautiful, every detail is well thought out, great space utilization, and very well equipped! All the details like a full wine rack and accompanying detailed description of each bottle, espresso maker with pods, and cold drinks in the refrigerator were a bonus. The host Nuno took 20 minutes with us to go through all the great details of the apartment and his multi page list of restaurants, sights, and the city maps so that we were able to make the absolute best use of our time in Porto. And the recommendations were all amazing! The location is perfect, on a nice quiet street, but just a couple blocks walk to all the beautiful things Porto has to offer! If you are visiting Porto this is the apartment where you want to stay, trust me, you will love it!
Nuno’s apartment was fabulous! Spacious and clean in a very convenient location. So many thoughtful touches - including a local wine selection. We look forward to staying here again.

This place exceeded our expectations! The host went above and beyond making us feel comfortable. The house had everything we needed and more. I loved all the books on Portugal. The views from the house were great. This is by far the best Airbnb we’ve stayed in. Next time we are in Porto, we hope to stay here again.

Great place, Nuno was very helpful gave  great recommendations. Apartment is very nice and clean had all the amenities and more neighborhood is perfect walking distance to all the sites that you want to see would definitely recommend to stay here.

Couldn't ask for more. Nuno gave us a comprehensive introduction to the apartment and Porto. Beautiful new building. Thoroughly enjoyed our 4 day visit and I can assure anyone considering the apartment that they will not be disappointed. Thanks Nuno

Wonderful place. Beautifully decorated, very clean and comfortable. Ines was was very helpful; she greeted us and showed us how everything worked in the house. She was helpful with parking instructions ( which can be a bit challenging in big cities) excellent experience.

We had everything we needed and they accommodated our luggage as we arrived earlier than expected.  Excellent recommendations for sightseeing and restaurants and provided a map. Beautiful patios and even supplied converter electrical plugs and had wine and beer available.  Coffee and port as a welcome and umbrellas for when it rained!  Literally couldn’t ask for more! Private porches off every living space too!

This was one of the best Airbnb that we have had the opportunity to stay. The apartment was immaculate, centrally located, quiet, and beautifully decorated and maintained. The apartment has such an attention to detail for travelers. The laundry facilities, extra converters, local recommendations, ac in bedrooms etc.  Do not hesitate to book this apartment, and to top it off Nuno is fabulous host. We would definitely return.

Nuno and Nia were absolutely amazing. Very kind and helpful. They had great recommendations of things to do while in Porto. The home itself was even better than I anticipated. Multiple terraces throughout to enjoy a nice drink after a long day exploring. Very convenient location close to many tourist attractions. I would love to come back to Porto again and I would definitely come back to Nuno’s property.
What a great host Took the time to describe the area attractions, restaurants and shopping. Great experience

Thank you Nuno, for your accommodations while we were in Porto. Your place is perfectly located in walking distance to all of the city and just around the corner to the mini mart. The bedroom and loft were very spacious and all the amenities were perfect, the washer, drier, iron, refrigerator/freezer, and garage. Nia was extremely helpful showing us the highlights and recommendations of Porto as well.  We highly recommend staying at your place.

I had an awesome time in Porto and a great stay in Anabela’s place. The place was very clean and tidy. The room was pretty good size with its own bathroom. The common area is stylish and the kitchen is well-equipped with cooking utensils. Although I haven’t met him, Antonio is very quick to respond and very very helpful. He took the time to follow up if I was okay during my stay. The location was awesome, very accessible by the Metro after a short walk. I love that I was able to do my laundry after being on the road for many days. The only thing  is just to be prepared for climbing upstairs (I was on the top floor). Other than that, I would definitely highly recommend this place.
Very very nice place to stay for its price. The location is great! I didn’t mean Vitor but I met his girlfriend and she was very very nice. Felt right at home!
I stayed for 3 nights at Anabela’s place. It was very clean and the room had a general high standard. It provides all you need for a couples city trip.  I can absolutely recommend the accommodation!
Perfect for staying a few night's in Porto. The apartment house was really great. Only a few minutes to the next metro station. The room was perfect. Thanks a lot.

This is a great guest house. Everything was perfect. Antonio and Anabela are truly super hosts. I would give even 10 out of 10 on AirBnB :). They have a very friendly housekeeper called Paula who takes care of the place with love. I would definitely come back again.

A very well equipped room with shared spaces as kitchen and living room. The best was the cleaning lady, Paula, extremely kind and friendly. The place is quite far from the city center but we’ll connected. The neighbourhood where it is located has nothing special and it’s a bit sad at nights, where no shops or restaurant are opened.

All was good, except the internet. Staff were friendly, helpful and available. The place was clean, and on good location. Fixing the internet on my floor took 4 days. There were available internet on the ground floor, but it was often noisy.
Cristiano’s place is very cute and comfortable. I enjoyed the stay so much! Definitely will recommend!

Very nice place in Porto. The living room is very big, clean and has many facilities. The room was pleasant and tidy. The airbnb is easiliy accessible. Furthermore, António was helpfull and responded to my questions quickly.
Would definitely recommend. Location was great. A room was small but cozy, everything was clean including shared spaces. Spacious kitchen and cozy terrace.

We had an excellent stay at this Airbnb, the room is very tidy and well-equipped, and  the whole Airbnb has a high standard and a tasteful interior. The hosts were very friendly and flexible concerning check-out time. The location of the Airbnb is well-connected with public transport and you’ll find typical Portuguese bakery and pastry shops nearby.
Antonio's place was exactly as it was described. Paula , the housekeeper is a very nice and helpful. We recommend the place.

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! we had an amazing stay for 5 days at as Antonio's place. it was exactly what we wanted. room was spotless clean and had everything we wanted. common areas are very spacious so you have enough space for everyone including the garden. it's very close to trindade Station and you can literally walk to main city within 25 to 30 mins. Antonio was very responsive. Housekeeping lady was very sweet and she's always around in the morning! 🙏❤️

I stayed in barbara and Vitor's house one night before walking to Esposende, and everything was perfect. Clean house, nice hosts, perfect location near the beach and the Camino da Costa. Ideal place !
Nice room in perfect location within town, near beach. Lovely surrounding. Hosts are very helpful and friendly at all times, responding quickly. Thanks for a nice time!
The host is very friendly and kind, the location is good behind the sea.. really raccomended!!
Vert nice! Matched the pictures, everything was clean and Antonio was very helpful and responsive. While not inside the city center everything was within walking distance.

Very nice place to stay in Povoa. Everything is provided for in the cute apartment. The hosts Victor and Barbara are so easy to communicate, check in and check out was hassle-free. Location is good and love my experience. I also love the little balcony both in front and in the back where I can see outside as I am very claustrophobic.

Susana's and Pedro's place is a charming small place in perfect location to start sightseeing in Porto. It's quiet, clean, very good looking and close to some of the most appealing places. To add to that, Susana and Pedro are wonderful. Very helpful, open and communicative.  When we come back to Porto, we'll certainly check if theirs place is available again.
Amazing appartment with a great location!  Also very kind hosts. We definitely enjoyed our visit and would recommend it.
A very pleasant appartment. An excellent location and the communication was fine. The street was quite busy/loud and the mattress could use an update, but other than that really worth it!
I really can recommend this apartment. The owners are very friendly and the apartment is in the center of Porto.

Susana and Pedro’s apartment is well located (about 8 minutes from Sao Bento train station), with good restaurants nearby including the wonderful Cafe Almada which offers traditional Portuguese food at amazing prices. The apartment was clean and modern and check in and out was smooth and efficient.

I had such a pleasant stay in Susanas and Pedros apartment. The location is super convenient, just a few steps away from many restaurants. And despite of being well located in the city centre, it is not noisy at night. I could sleep peacefully all the 4 nights Ive been there. For the ones working remotely: the internet speed is really good; I was surprised by it. I would recommend it and come back anytime I go back to Porto. Muito obrigado!

the place is very small but cozy at the same time, it’s in the heart of the city and highly comfortable for everything: if you need something cheap but easy to reach, this is your place! pedro welcomed us and was very kind :)
Susana and Pedro are super hosts, one of the best experiences I have had in a while. I recommend to everyone!
Great appartement. We got there later than the supposed hour and the owner didn’t make us pay a dime ! Always appreciated, + the owner is really nice and helpful. +++

Wonderful stay in Porto and the apartment on the first floor was perfect for our needs. Susanna and Pedro were available for a very late check in and we had no problems whatsoever with the accommodation … also a nice spot of port left for our arrival …

We booked the apartment for a week and it was a pleasure to be there. The Check-in was easy and the communication with Susana (the Host) was very good and welcoming.  The kitchen has everything you need to cook, the bed is very comfortable and the view and location is stunning. And on top of that this was by far the most clean AirBnB I‘ve ever visited. You have everything you need there and you can explore Porto very easily on foot. Everything is close by. We will definitely come back and of course we recommend the apartment to everyone who wants to visit Porto
Great location and good value. If you stay here I'd recommend closing the shutters at night time to keep the street noise out.
Cosy and clean apartment, very near the centre and the host very friendly and responsive, thank you
an attentive and most kind host, a lovely furnished, brand new and all-equipped and ideally located appartement. an asset for an enjoyable stay on Porto
My boyfriend and I had the most magical time in Porto. Couldn't recommend the city or this apartment more. Prime location with nearby parking!
Sofia, thank you for all your help and advice during our stay. Your apartment is beautiful and is a great location to view the city!
Sofia’s apartment is the perfect spot! Great location, comfortable and very quiet! Sophia thought of every detail. We loved our stay and will definitely return!

Sofia is a great host, very kind person, communicates perfectly. The appartment is in the middle of the downtown but not noisy. Perfect for 2 people, clean, tidy with a comfortable bed. Highly recommended.

Sofia’s place is great! It was perfect for a short stay in Porto. We loved the balcony overlooking the pedestrian street and the welcome port wines waiting for us upon arrival. Everything was spotless and the interior was cozy.
Absolutely wonderful studio right in the centre of Porto easy access to all sights. Very very comfortable bed and room spotless!!  I’d defo stay again. Highly recommend!
We really enjoyed our stay at Sofia’s apartment. It is the perfect size for a solo traveler or couple and the location is ideal for exploring Porto.

Sofia's place was so well decorated and had everything you need for one or two people! It was amazingly located and within walking distance to the main Porto train station, shops, and restaurants! 10/10 would recommend for anyone visiting Porto!

Perfect place to stay in Porto, beautifully styled with all the necessities you need for a comfortable stay right in the middle of the city. Sofia was a very responsive and friendly host. Couldn’t ask for me...
Everything perfect. Really nice apartment in the city center. Sofia gave us some great restaurant recommendations. We hope to come back some day.
Beautiful apartment in a great location. Really clean and great amenities. Sofia was a really kind and thoughtful host :)

We love the place Sofia was given us. The location is amazingly close to everything and the area serves all your needs from restaurant to bars to pharmacy to normal grocery shops.  The apartment was clean and very cosy. We enjoyed our time being there and the communication with Sofia went fluent and uncomplicated.

Sofia's studio is a perfect home base for exploring Porto! The location is fantastic - we could walk to everything. We especially enjoyed sitting on the balcony, taking in the sights and sounds of Rua das Flores!  The studio is decorated beautifully and is very comfortable. You can't go wrong staying here!
Sophias place is charming, clean and in a great location. Sophia was an excellent communicator and her mother was so gracious and helped us in when we arrived.
Great apartment and amenities.  A bit loud at night and even into early morning. Super helpful hosts.
We had a lovey stay! The location was perfect and the apartment was in great shape. Comfortable and safe. I would absolutely stay here again.

Sofia and Fatima’s Airbnb is beautiful and in the perfect location. The pedestrian street it’s on is lively and full of great cafes and shops, but does not interfere with a great night’s sleep. We loved the overlooking balcony and the thoughtful decor. Hosts responded very quickly and made us feel welcome. Would absolutely stay here again!
Lovely apartment with a great location. Highly recommend to anyone staying in Porto for a few days. Sofia is a very wonderful and responsive host.

Sofia’s apartment is beautiful, amazing amenities, such as a/c that works great, excellent location, safe entry and easy check in/out. The apartment is very clean and it is on the Main Street, great restaurants and  stores.  I would definitely stay there again. Best location in Porto.

This is an amazing place in an amazing location! Very clean and well organized, has everything on par with a hotel like stay and the host was very responsive. The street is the best street to have an AirBnB and will save you a lot of time and money in the long run. The balcony is also perfect to just enjoy the action on Rua Das Flores. Get it, don't think twice.

Sofia’s place was perfect for our stay in Porto - great location, small but comfortable. She included a glass of Port wine for us upon arrival. She was understanding and accommodating when we were delayed a day due to a canceled flight. I recommend Sofia’s place!

Sofia’s studio is the perfect place for a visit to Porto. Great location, close to  everything. The apartment is incredibly clean and nicely decorated, it is located on a busy street with shops and restaurants, but the apartment stays very quiet at night. Highly recommend.

I had a wonderful stay at Sofia's apartment. The space was very clean and perfectly located in the city. There is also a very nice private balcony that we enjoyed to relax after a long day. We really appreciated the welcome gift that Sofia left for us - 2 cute bottles of Port wine.  The apartment is walking distance to many cafes and touristy activities. It is only 5 mins walking distance to the Luis I Bridge and only a few minutes walking to the train station. I would definitely stay here again! Also Sofia was very accommodating with our check in and checkout. Although we arrived to Porto early morning and check in wasnt until 3pm, she provided luggage storage for us at no charge. Also, on the day of check out, Sofia allowed us to keep our luggage in the room for an extra hour until we were ready to leave. Sofia is an amazing host.

One of the best features of my stay at Sofia's place was that she offered to arrange my transportation to/from the train station for my husband and myself. This made our arrival into Porto very smooth. Our driver also walked our bags to the front door of the apartment and carried my bags to the car on our return to the train station days later. I was very pleased with this service and the location of the Air BNB is perfect!

We had a beautiful stay. Very well kept along with being clean, great location and extremely relaxing. The hosts where amazing even helping with dinner reservations and dropping us extra coffee pods. It’s a must stay for Porto. Beautiful city and what amazing hosts. Thank you so much Sofia

Sofia's place is exactly as described. I really enjoyed my stay at her apartment. There was everything one needed for a short stay. Also, the location is pretty cool --- although it could be quite loud for someone. I would definitely stay there again if I visit Porto.
Wow! What an incredible location and could not have asked for anything more. Cannot wait to come back to Porto and stay here again.

I had a fantastic stay in the apartment on Flores Street in Porto. The location was perfect, right in the center of the city and within walking distance to all the main attractions. The apartment itself was clean, very quiet (if you close the windows) and well equipped with everything I needed for my stay. One thing that stood out to me was the proximity to all the sights. I was able to walk to the Porto Cathedral, the Ribeira district and the Luis I Bridge in just a few minutes. There were also many restaurants and cafes nearby, which made it easy for me to try some of the local cuisine. Overall, I had a wonderful experience at this apartment and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient stay in Porto. The location, pleasant host and proximity to all the sights make it the perfect choice for your next trip to this beautiful city.

Sofia was the absolute best! The home is perfectly situated on a bustling street but when the curtains are drawn it’s quiet and peaceful. You have everything you could need (fridge, coffee, iron, hairdryer) and a lovely apartment with cozy bed and chairs.  Sofia went above and beyond with local recommendations and accommodating every request. Stay here!! You won't regret it.

Super cute place in a great location.  Everywhere is walkable if you fancy it.  Super quick response time with any questions you may have. Would recommend to anyone who would be making a trip to Porto   5/5

I loved Sofia’s place so much that I kept recommending it to anyone I see in front of me for the rest of my trip!!! Beautiful, clean, cozy but most importantly safe studio and location. Sofia and Fatima were VERY responsive and very sweet and helpful and it came to any questions I had. I will definitely be back again!!

Sofia’s place was absolutely beautiful & so comfortable! The location was perfect - close to everything yet not loud at all. She provided all the necessities to make our stay fantastic! Would definitely return! ❤️

Sofia’s place was a hidden gem in center of Porto! The place was cute and as described, it had everything we needed for our stay. Sofia was very responsive and friendly. We were able to store our luggage before our check-in which was very helpful. Very close to all local attractions. Would highly recommend this place to everyone but especially couples.

There were so many reasons we loved this place! Here are a few: Fantastic location with a beauitful balcony overlooking the street.  Extremely clean.  Complimentary port.  In-unit washer.  Very quiet considering it was on a public street (we did stay in the off season, however, this may vary).  Tons of restaurants right outside the front door or within walking distance.
The place is located in the heart of the city! Our host was very responsive and provided us with great recommendations! We loved the experience.
We had a great stay. The location is in the heart of the city . Plenty to do and see and easy to get to all the best the city has to offer! Highly recommend the apartment!

Our stay in Porto at Sofia’s place was perfect! The location was very central for walking to everything and the people watching from the balcony was perfect. I loved the restaurants and cafes in the neighborhood. The apartment was clean and very comfortable.

We absolutely loved staying in this Airbnb! The apartment is exactly as pictured and is located on a very lively street that has many stores, shops, and restaurants. I enjoyed watching the street from the balcony at night and in the morning. Sofia is a great host that has everything you would need, including a very detailed set of instructions and recommendations. The place was perfectly cleaned and the stocked kitchen is a plus if you plan on cooking at all during your stay. We arrived at Sao Bento Station and made our way over to the Airbnb that was less than a 5 minute walk. The area is a great central location to use as a home base for your stay in Porto.

Staying in Sofia’s apartment was a pleasure. Not only was the apartment as advertised and in perfect condition, all of her suggestions were spot on including restaurants, things to do, and local transportation (Carlos transport to and from airport was very enjoyable and full of helpful tips and tricks). Sofia, Carlos and Fatima are very genuine people…such a pleasure. Would we go back? A resounding YES, YES and YES! Obrigado x 10 Pam and Marc (Canada)

We had a great time in Porto! Sofia’s suite was centrally located near the river and many local attractions. We spent quite a bit of time on the balcony people-watching. Sofia even arranged her driver to take us to the airport when we were leaving. Would highly recommend!

This place is well worth what I paid for and more.  I chose it because of its balcony but I got more than that.  It has a central location (all the activities that I booked, the meeting point was always a little over 5 minutes away).  It is spacious and felt like a luxurious hotel stay.  The space is well thought out, super clean, and very safe.  I love that place is on Rua das Flores.  I highly recommend it!

Loved our stay in Porto thanks to Sofia’s place. Bang in the center, easy walking to all the sites in Porto. In spite of being on the pedestrian street, it was quiet at night. The apartment is well furnished, with great mattress and amenities. Sofia was super helpful with recommendations that helped us enjoy Porto to the max. Very responsive host for any questions we had. Obrigado!

Sofia’s flat was perfect for us. Centrally situated in the city close to everything. The instructions were clear and easy to follow, so we had no problems at all. Everything went smoothly, which is exactly what you need on a shorter city break. All the recommendations were great, the restaurants and taxis were just spot on. I would highly recommend Sofia’s apartment and would definitely stay again. A very well deserved 5 stars.

In one word: perfect! Everything about this Air bnb was perfect. The location is ideal - right in the city center, close to tons of shops and restaurants. Comfortable bed, extremely clean, we felt safe at all times of day and night. Highly recommend this unit! Even though it’s on a busy street, it’s very quiet (and we were there on the loudest night of the year - Sao Jao!). Sophia was a wonderful host and provided recommendations for things to do. She also connected us with a car service from the airport and back to airport when we left; the driver was friendly, kind, and very helpful. We loved our time in Porto and loved having this lovely Air bnb to rest in after a busy day!

The apartment is perfectly located and I was able to walk everywhere! Only needed a drive to the airport and I highly recommend the private transfer with Carlos (Sofia recommended it and is arranging it for you!)  The apartment has everything to make you feel at home! It was great to have a washing machine. There was a clothes rack, an iron and even an iron board! Sofia is very responsive when you ask a question.
great location! hosts are super organised and check in with the keypad was very easy. only thing is no doors on the bedrooms. other than that, highly recommend - really clean, swanky place!

This was a terrific location to explore Porto.  Comfortable beds, great communication from hosts (who conveyed some minor issues from the previous guests), and surprisingly somewhat quiet considering despite being in the middle of historic Porto.

Location was absolutely perfect. Very comfortable beds, and great communication from the hosts. There are no doors on the bedrooms but that worked out fine for us. I really don’t think you can find a better place for this price! We would definitely stay again!

Outstanding location! An easy walk to everything. The place is clean, organized, and stocked, and I loved the decor. Cool House was easy to communicate with and friendly. It was smaller than expected with very little floor space around the beds and no doors on bedrooms but overall a good value. We enjoyed our two night stay.

Our family of 4 (2 kids) stayed in the ‘cool house’ for 2 nights while exploring Porto.  The apartment is very well located, trendy, modern and comfortable.  It is small and cozy without doors for the bedrooms, but that was fine for a family to share.  The check-in and check-out was easy (all keypads) and communication was great. Thanks!

Great place to stay. Excellent location-  walking distance to Ribeiro and beyond yet quiet over night… if not for screaming seagulls. Nothing you can do about it except shut the windows. :) Good communication and timely responses from the host. AC worked as needed. Thanks.
Everything was perfect. The apartment is in the city center so very easy to get to any point of the city. It was clean and comfy.
This was the best spot in Porto. Close to everything, clean and host was so helpful!!! I highly recommend!
We were only there for a night but the apartment was cute and as described. Spaces are not completely private but are separate. Location is great!

We had a great time in Porto staying at Cool house! The apartment is nice and clean and was spacious for a group of six friends. The location is great, quiet and nice and close to everything. Thank you for some lovely days in Porto. Would absolutely recommend!
The house was clean and in a great location, but the stairs were a bit hard to go up with luggage and The rooms had no doors but still, overall it was a good stay
Great stay in an apartment right in the city centre. Everything fit the description. Host was very quick to respond to messages.
Stylish place! Only problem is it lacks windows but the owner supplied it with fans so it was fine :))
The house is located in a nice area but has little lighting due to no outside facing windows. The room was clean.
A great stay! The place was as described and was cozy and comfortable! A good location, and Nuno was right on top of communications!  Top marks! Highly recommended!👍

Location was soooo good. I didn't pay any transportation fee and you can communicate well but Wifi worked slowly 😭 usually I used my data. when I turned on air conditioner, Water leaked out. so I turned off.

Nice place inside and out, very clean, 1 block from the intercity train station, only stayed one night before my trip.  Nice 20 min walk along the river to the main tourist areas. Air filter helped remove bathroom's humidity. Great host.
A large, light and airy space that is close to the centre.  Prompt responses from the host. Would stay again.

very nice apartment on 2 floors and very clean. friendly &  easy checkin. Checkout was flexible. Taxi was organised from and to airport (on our request). Perfect organised. Always quick answers and good recommendations! Perfect for 4 people. View to the DOURO. Everything was in walking distance. Apartment is on top floor -> no elevator! But no problem for us:-) the only thing we missed : towels in the kitchen. But it was ok. Dishwasher is there.
Nice spacious modern apartment however slight disappointment that construction work to properties at the front and rear of the apartment during our stay meant early wake up calls.

Very stylish spot with a great view of the river. It is true this spot is a bit of a walk from any central “bustling” tourist location, which some may prefer, and there’s also quite a bit of construction going on outside the apartment (but you still have a great view!). The hosts were very communicative and accommodating.
This was a lovely airbnb. The actual apartment was clean, well put together with gorgeous views of the river and bridges. The hosts were extraordinarily responsive and helpful at all times.

If you would like to explore Porto and the douro this is your place to be! Absolutely top location next to the centre. A wonderful view over the douro is also included. For a short break you can use the small but lovely garden in the backside of your house. Next to the location you‘ve got one of the best cafes in porto! Try it!
Everything was great! Very nice flat with an amazing view, close to the airport and the city center.

This spot was so stunning it was hard to leave. It was bright, airy, comfortable and had a great and expansive view of the river. Hosts were great when self check in was glitchy and solved the issue within minutes.

Excellence at the turn of the key!  Quiet, clean, large space, easy to walk to town/downtown areas, near train station, high ceilings, breathtaking views, hot water works perfectly, great water pressure, felt like home, modern, perfect in everyday, look no further!

This place was stunning and so peaceful!  The windows opened up to a gorgeous view of the Duoro River, and I sat on the cushions relaxing, watching cats meander the rooftops and locals sip beer on the streets.  The place was super clean and comfortable.  It was truly a treat to stay here.

Beautiful view, lovely apartment, central location and communicative hosts. Local bars with bifana and snacks on either side, which is helpful if you arrive late! It is a 3 floor walk up with no elevator, no issue for us, with just carry-ons! Also, bring coffee/ tea as there is no ‘starter kit’. Would not hesitate to stay there again!

Great apartment. Very comfortable to hang out after a busy day.  The view of the river is amazing.   Great restaurants up the hill and Sao Bento is a 15 minute walk.   I would highly recommend this place.   Its not in the tourist zone but close which we liked.

We enjoyed the apartment very much! It is great for a group of four people to hang out. We especially enjoyed the view towards the river Douro from the big windows in living room. The city is easy to reach with a 5 - 10 minutes food walk. In the morning we used the two little café shops right and left just one building away to start our day with a galao coffee and a pasteis de nata.

The place was awesome! Probably the best AirBNB we've ever stayed in :) It was absolutely beautiful, we especially like the view of the Duoro river in the morning after making a coffee with the provided Nespresso machine :) Thierry, Nastia and Pila were wonderful hosts, they send clear instructions and an awesome list of cool places to explore in a loooong message before arriving :)

An airy and light place perfectly situated looking down at the Douro River and across at the monumental bridges and the monastery. Low key neighbourhood with the charm of local gatherings and the curious visitor.
The whole team of hosts were great and accomodating. Smooth check-in. Everything was easy. Great view. Excellent workspace, as we had to do some work calls. We would stay here again.

Ines could not have been more helpful and responded very quickly to all our queries. The flat is very comfortable with amazing views and  lots of space. Two of us stayed and had a double bedroom and bathroom each which was a real treat. It is situated slightly away from the busy tourist spots so lovely to come back to some peace and quiet and a tucked away garden where we could could sit under the orange tree. Everything was clean and air conditioning a real necessity!

Lovely house right by the river! Beautiful and stylish! The place was super clean. All the amenities you might need.  There was a few weird local characters hanging around in the street, but they didn’t seem dangerous.  We can recommend this stay!

We stayed for four nights. The hostess is very helpful in accommodating our early arrival by letting us check in before noon instead of the normal 3PM check-in time. The apartment is very nice and roomy, overlooking the Douro river from the living/dining area.  Our apartment is on the third floor. There is no elevator.  Carrying large and heavy luggage can be a challenge. The kitchen is fully functional with adequate utensils, plates, glasses, cooking spices, etc... Outside noises from the street below can be noticeable with the windows opened. The area is safe for walking. The location is within walking distance to many places. Porto is a city on the hill. Walking uphill and downhill is expected... We enjoyed the apartment and the city very much. The hostess is very responsive and very nice. Thank you.
We had a beautiful stay! The hosts were so kind and responsive . The home is very spacious and has a beautiful view and Decor. And very close to all the best Porto has to offer. I highly recommend!

The hosts were fantastic! Quick to respond and gave us really good instructions on how to check in.  Their place is super cute and so well decorated and spacious!  We were all so thrilled with our stay and would definitely stay there again!  Highly recommend staying here.

Lovely apartment with fabulous views over the River Douro. The apartment was beautifully fitted out. Very handy location for getting around Porto.  The local contacts Ines and Joao were super helpful when one of the party was unfortunately taken ill.

We had a great stay. The apartment is exactly as described with a beautiful view of the river.  It is very close to the sights of Porto including the Ribeiro district. Tatiana was.a great host on behalf of Thierry and Nastia. She was very responsive and helpful with local tips. Thanks for a super stay.
Bright and clean apartment. Beds were really comfortable. The kitchen had everything we needed. Everything was very clean. Hosts were quick to respond. Great walkable location.
Excellent communication from hosts! Tatiana was very quick to respond and help when needed. Very cute and spacious interior. Would recommend to anyone visiting Porto.
Appartament was clean and we had nice river view.  Center was 10-15 to walk and it was ok. Hosts were helpful and friendly.
Wonderful space. Very spacious.  Great views. Easy walking distance to Porto's city center. The hosts were great communicators.
Fantastic stay! Perfect location, spotless apartment, and a warm, helpful host with great local tips.

We loved everything about our stay the apartment was exactly as described. Great location close to everything with a great view of the river. Thierry & Nastia were always easy to contact and gave a lots of great ideas for places to visit  Thank you we will stay again

Luís and his colleagues were super welcoming and made our stay at their place feel really special—they even left us some Port wine in the apartment! Everything was super clean and the space is really cozy inside.
We had a good time in a friendly apartment close to the center. The check-in, the apartment and the check out was perfect.
A cute and stylish space with nice touches. The pool is a great way to cool off and the host had a ton of local tips for us. I would highly recommend staying here!

Casa da Praça is in a very interesting area. The swimming pool is perfect for a relaxing moment in the city. Be aware that the room is small and it has a small bathroom and kitchen. The living room is shared with other guests.
I had a lovely stay at Casa Da Praça. It’s definitely a great place to discover Porto, clean, with an aesthetic touch and a pool is an additional extra. Highly recommended!

We loved this place, the location & the very friendly hosts. Everything was absolutely smooth and we loved that we had the option of self-check in and we didn’t need a key. You can tell everything is done with love in this apartment and the Internet is very good so you can easily work from here. Any questions were answered within seconds. We will definitely come back!
The room was so nice and well decorated ! The swimming pool is such a plus and we loved it. It’s located in a quiet part of the city which is nice  We did the self check-in, that was easy and fast
Nice brand new hostel, very pretty old renovated house, only problem is the bathroom with no doors so you can not go to the toilet in privacy

My experience at Porto Je T'Aime's was outstanding. The place is very well located, just and 1min walking distance to the train station, in front of a big supermarket where you can by a lot of traditional Portuguese food (unfortunately I didn't have time to try everything), beautifully decorated by the owners who are always around to help and have an enjoyable conversation. During your breakfast, if you have a chance, talk to Sandra, the cleaner of the place, she is a very inspiring lady with loads of good stories. For sure I will come back

Another stay, another great experience! I love Porto, I love Je T´Aime and I love this sweet guest house. The location is perfect, the hosts are even better and it's all I could wish for! My stays with you keep surprising me and the people I travel with are also very surprised and satisfied. Big thank you to your team to make me feel at home. Obrigado!
Amazing stay, very clean and accommodating. The room and the house is very pretty and cool. Would recommend 100%. Also, Joao is very responsive and helpful :) will come back again!
Everything was great! Communication was spot on. My room was super clean! There’s a great gym nearby if you like to workout! And a great mall!

We really enjoyed staying at Porto Je T’Aime, I even would love to stay there longer :) A very nice place, tidy and it’s in a very good location, it’s comfortable to reach best Porto places. I’m also very grateful for the host for a very warm meeting. It was nice that two people speaking in two different language can understand each other.

João was incredibly responsive and made sure everything was taken care of. The building is in a great location, very close to the grocery store and a short walk into the heart of Porto. Wifi was reliable and fast.
Florinda’s flat was perfect - spacious with a beautiful view and in an ideal location. Florinda was very attentive and helped us plan our time there. Thank you for everything!

The apartment is five stars!!! It’s big enough for 6 people (two big beds and two bank beds). There are also two bathrooms! Florinda is a super host and always takes care of you!  The location is super convenient, however it is better without a car as there’s no free parking in the streets around the apartment.
