Anyway the car is not needed because public transport is more convenient.  We fully recommend this place!
This is a fabulous apartment. Modern, clean and beautiful. It has a fantastic terrace and wonderful views. The location is ideal.  Very highly recommended on all counts!

Florinda and the property were absolutely fantastic.  We were able to store our luggage after arriving in the morning at Florinda’s shop, which is located a few doors away from the flat.  The home itself is very clean, bright and airy, and has the most incredible patio in the back looking across the river to Gaia.  It was perfect for wine in the evening and coffee in the morning.  The flat is also within walking distance to everything you’d want to see in Porto.  We all loved it and would definitely stay here again.  Thanks for everything, Florinda.

Great stay. We are family of 4 and was more than comfortable. We walked to a lot of the main areas. Also has pretty sunset down the block. Owner was very sweet as well and helped us get free parking on the street.

Florinda’s apartment was amazing. The check in process was very smooth as we were able to store our bags at her store and they moved our luggage for us when the apartment was ready. The place was huge and the deck was beautiful. The location is very convenient to restaurants and the sights. Florinda even coordinated a ride for us to the train station for our return home. I would highly recommend!

Perfect spot to explore central Porto. Exceptionally clean. Florinda was available for recommendations. Beautiful terrace. Beds are firm, but that's a matter of preference.  Would definitely stay again.

Florinda has a lovely place in Porto. Amazing views of the city and we had a very pleasant stay. Florinda was an awesome host and gave us superb recommendations about where to eat in the local area. Highly recommend staying here when in Porto!

Florinda was a warm, kind, organized, and extremely accommodating host. Her place was spotless and was exactly central to all of our Porto destinations. The city view from the balcony is miraculous. Checkin was simple with the option for luggage storage, and the space was large and comfortable. I’d highly recommend staying here. The only thing to note is that soap and shampoo were not included so be sure to bring your own!
We were so lucky to have stayed at this lovely apartment! The view was absolutely stunning and the location could not have been better. Definitely try the tapas place that Florinda recommends!
The apartment was very comfortable with a gorgeous patio and plenty of space for our group. Location was great too! Thank you for making check in very easy and providing great recommendations!

We had a lovely stay at Florinda's adorable apartment with our two small children. There was plenty of space for everyone to be comfortable and the back patio was truly dreamy. The attentiveness, friendliness and hospitality of Florinda and Sergio was what really made our stay memorable!

The Airbnb was amazing (location is as good as it could be), however Florinda really was the best of hosts and made the whole trip that much more enjoyable. Her recommendations were spot on. We are staying in Portugal for a while and we even changed our plans so we could come back and stay here again before leaving for the US. Could not recommend more!

The place was amazing. The apartment is just as described and everything was super clean. We were close walking to everything we need. Florinda was the best host I’ve ever had. She was so kind and helpful. She gave us an overview of the city and restaurant recommendations. She was very kind to make reservations for us when we were hesitant to call somewhere when not knowing Portuguese. This place is great and Florinda makes it even better!! I would 100% stay here again on my next stop in Porto.
Excellent location, super central with incredible views of the city. Lovely, spacious and modern. Exactly what we were looking for.
Florinda was very welcoming with a lot of great recommendations. Perfect host that knows Porto better than anyone!

We enjoyed staying at Florinda's place, a unique spacious apartment with a great garden space that over looks Porto, The Douro River and Villa Nova Da Gaia.  Very rare to have a garden/patio in Porto.  Florinda is a great warm human being she made us feel very welcome.  The location is surrounded by a great variety of restaurants for breakfast, lunch and Evening Meals and local convenience stores are 20 metres away for the front door.  Plenty of space for up to 6 people so great for a family or 2 couples with 2 full bathrooms, with  all you need for a comfortable stay.  We would 100% recommend and would stay again.

Florinda’s place was in an ideal location — tons of restaurants and grocery stores nearby. We were close to the river, but the apartment was very quiet and lovely. The view was incredible! We would definitely stay again.

We loved the stay here, the location and view was beautiful!  Except checking in was a pain! The cleaning lady had left the key at a cafe because of an emergency but it took us about an hour of running around to different places to find where the key was to let us into the house.

Florinda was a great host. Upon arrival she showed us around the apartment and gave us great local recommendations.  The location was perfect for exploring downtown Porto with most things within 10 mins walking distance. Highly recommend!

We had a lovely time staying at Florindas place. She was extremely welcoming, helpful and friendly. we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.  The location is perfect. Lots of fantastic places on your doorstep.

Vitor welcomed us with his great hospitality and with a ‘sweet’ surprise. Staying at Musas was really nice. Quiet area, close to the city center, a 15 min walk. The apartment was bigger than expected and very clean, also an excellent shower. You won’t regret booking this apartment!
We enjoyed our stay in Porto! The apartment was very quiet and away from the bustle of the city, though easy to walk to (or take the subway) to any point in our itinerary.
Had a great time here, Vítor is a great host very social and accommodating. The location is great, everything is very walkable and there is a subway station close by just in case.

myself and my best fried Julita had a late flight into Porto so we paid for a taxi to accommodation,  the host was there to meet us and show us around the flat and explained how things worked, even provided us with some milk, bread and ham, cheese which he obtained from his sister Tina who lived upstairs, lovely friendly host.
Victor was very kind and helpful host. the place was very nice, clean, very large rooms and space, all the facilities in the kitchen, wash machine, clothes dryer

Great spot on a side road, so quiet but still very close to the city center with many things in walking distance. The apartment can be a bit damp but Vítor provided us with two dehumidifiers - just keep them running whenever you can and clear the water out every day 😉

Gustavo is a friendly host and the communication was very good.  His apartment is located near a main subway station, what makes the travel through beautiful Porto very easy.  Very nice shower! :-)  Thank you.
Cute apartment with a spacious bedroom and well equipped kitchen. Gustavo was friendly and very responsive. Recommend.

Me and my sistser had a nice time in Susanas appartment. It is nicely furbished, cosy and perfectly situated close to the city center. Dogs are welcome too. Would stay there again if i return to Porto.

Susana was really sweet. We were really comfortable at her apartment, in the very center of Porto. The communication was fast and she even let us the apartment for the day until we left at night. I totally recommend this place: clean, comfy, in the center,... It is just as they show you in the pictures
Great space and great host! Susanna was prompt to respond when we asked questions. We loved the location. No complaints!
The place is super central to the main shopping street of Porto and the place was clean and as described! Had a wonderful time.
Great,great,great location.Appartment was very clean .  it is situated in the hearth of the city.Higly recommended
Susana's place was very clean and conveniently located. It was a great place to stay for our trip to Porto!
Everything was fine but there was not much kitchen equipment. If you plan to cook a bit in the apartment, choose another accomodation.

Overall it’s a great experience. Check-in was easy and the host super helpful. The house was exactly has advertised and very clean. The place is very central  and is near a lot of the best restaurants and places in town. Our fear was noise but the house is to the back of block so it’s very quiet as well. Highly recommended.
Lovely stay in Porto in the quieter neighbourhood of Bonfim. Short walk to the centre and the host was very helpful/quick to respond to any queries.

I stayed with my parents for 2 nights in the Esmerald apartment of the Charm Palace Porto. I liked the apartment and the location: it was within walking distance of the city centre and Campanhã train station. The kitchen was well equipped and the apartment has two bathrooms. One bathroom is connected to one of the bedrooms and the other is separate in the common area. The garden is lovely and we were always offered tea and water near the reception.
Susana's place is incredibly well placed in the heart of the city right next to a metro station and lots of things to do in the city, recommended 100%
Wonderful stay in a bright sparkling clean apartment. Location great ( steps from metro, 15 min walk to the old city) . We enjoyed very much !

The apartment fits the description, it's well accurated, everything as described. We had everything we needed. The only thing that can be improved is the kitchen equipment. The bar on the ground floor is the worst part because sometimes it is a bit noisy.

Nice location and great restaurants nearby, Monteen is a definite recommendation. A nice fruit shop and bakery with friendly owners on the square. A short walk to transport and to city centre. The apartment is as described although the shower did leak each time it was used, and as others have noted there is a damp smell common to these older buildings. Otherwise a nice stay to enjoy a lovely city.

Nicely located to main areas. The position of the apartment let’s you walk downhill most of the way to tourist spots then you can either walk up or take another mode of transport. The parking lot was a bit expensive but conveniently located. Apartment is as described. I enjoyed my stay!

Nuno is an excellent host, he kindly waited for us for our late check in; we came at 1am; and provided us with a lot of useful information and local tips ! Nuno was also kind to let us check out late as we wanted to surf on our last day! The apartment is beautiful, stylish, clean and very spacious with a lovely balcony, and around 20 min walk to the centre of Porto. I highly recommend it !!
Excellent place to stay for our visit to Porto. Great location near a Metro station made it very easy to get around. Our host Nuno made checking in extremely easy. Highly recommended!
Nuno was super helpful and very friendly and welcoming! Had an awesome time in Porto and would definitely recommend his place to anyone who wants to stay in Porto! :)

It was a wonderful time in Nuno's cozy apartment. It has everything you could possibly need and is beautifully furnished. A highlight is the sunny balcony which is perfect for relaxing. Supermarkets, restaurants and stores are all within walking distance. Worth mentioning is also that Nuno is an excellent host. He took enough time to show us around the apartment, to give us directions to nearby supermarkets, and to share tips on where to park. It was easy to communicate with him and he was very helpful. All in all, we can highly recommend this apartment.
The apartment was very nice and we had a lovely stay. Even though the water didn’t work in the beginning but it was fixed very fast. The communication with Nuno went smoothly.
Fantastic! The place was clean and well organised, the host very responsive, and the location was great! Highly recommend!

I recommend these apartments. everything was clean, there was everything you need. We really enjoyed. And the owner is very accommodating and will always answer all questions. Thanks Nuno it was wonderful time.

We were very satisfied with our stay at Nuno's apartment and can highly recommend it. Great value for the price and the location is good too. Nuno was very responsive and offered us to drop off our luggage way before check in.

Nuno was very helpful and made checking in / out very easy. The place was very clean and tidy with a lovely terrace outside, perfect for a little porto getaway. It’s only a 30/40 minute walk to the port with a beautiful garden you can pass through on the way which we fully recommend. There is also a food market next to the apartment which isn’t all traditional Portuguese food but is worth checking out. Overall a great stay :)

Nuno was a very nice host, responsive and super flexible - and the apartment was super clean! We were a bit unlucky with the weather and couldn’t enjoy the beautiful terrace. The location is not very central and not much to do around, but everything is very walkable. Overall we liked our stay !

Mr. Nuno is very friendly. He was professional from check-in to check-out. I really enjoyed my stay; we stayed for nine days and everything was clean and tidy. The rooftop terrace is spacious, and the location is convenient. I highly recommend this place, it's a great choice for many people. Thank you

Great place and a great host. Nuno was very helpful with check-in/out as well as helpful with questions. The apartment has a great balcony perfect to relax. The apartment is close to a very nice food court, that we enjoyed when we didn't have the energy to go downtown. Good spot for communications, both metro and taxi, or take a bit of a walk to reach downtown. All in all, we had 9 wonderful days in Porto and at the apartment!

We had lovely stay, the place was perfect for a few days exploring the city. It is located right by a metro stop, so really accessible to get round the city.  Nuno was a great host and really helpful when we had some delays with our flight. Thanks again!
What a lovely place to stay, light, peaceful, with a beautiful plant filled balcony, extremely comfortable bed and Nuno, our host couldn’t have been more welcoming and helpful with all our requests

Nuno's place is highly recommended. It is in an easily reachable location with great public transport, shopping and dining options. Being on the 5th floor of the building it is far away from street noises, has a nice sunny terrace and view. Nuno is a wonderful host, very friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay here again.

This place is excellent! We loved our stay. We had 5 of us sharing the place which was cosy but perfect for us. It’s a short walk into the main part of town which was the opposite side of the river, and very close to a supermarket and other shops. It was spotless when we arrived and the facilities were great, especially a washing machine! Only fault would be one of the aircon’s wasn’t working during our stay but a repair was being organised.

Our Trip to Porto was very nice, thanks to this Appartment. The Rooms are very clean and modern, everything we needed was included, inclusive the Parking Space. The View from the Balcony was excellent. The Hosts were very friendly and informative. We would stay again here, if we return to Porto or Villa da Nova Gaia.

Everything was just PERFECT. Super nice with amenities, comfy bed, kind host and literally ASTONISHING view.  I highly recommend this apartment who visit Porto, and I booked here again for my next travel to Porto, right after I checked out for this staying.
Certainly the best view of Porto! Everything was great, just didn’t give 5 stars because the a/c on the bedroom wasn’t working. Otherwise, I recommend it! Great location

Really enjoyed my stay here, perfect location for seeing the City of Porto. The apartment had everything we needed, and the view from the balcony was spectacular. Would recommend this apartment to anyone!

I cannot recommend this place more highly! The hosts were very accommodating with early check in and were flexible when our arriving flight was delayed. The view is spectacular, the house clean and the beds comfy. What more could you ask for? Just be aware that it is up a hill so be prepared for some physical activity or to grab a cheap uber when heading back.
Amazing stay here. The views are spectacular and the location was perfect good walking distance from everywhere we needed to be. Any problems were sorted out immediately and communication was good!
Nice flat in a great location, excellent communication from the hosts. Only needs some minor repairs around the flat to make it perfect.

This place was amazing! I was hesitant to stay in Gaia since we wanted to se Porto. Well, I’m so happy we did because we got the best view of Porto and so many great restaurants and wineries nearby. Porto is only a 10 minute walk away.  The place is very comfortable and has all the amenities you need. It is on the second floor, but there’s an elevator so it was very convenient after so much walking in the uphill streets of Porto.  Renato was very nice checking us in and gave us a lot of tips for the area. Oh and a bottle of delicious Port wine was waiting for us.  I would definitely stay again if we ever go back to Portugal.

Amazing place and outstanding service from superanfitroes. We were kindly received and checkin by a very attentive guy which patiently explained all we needed to know about the home and surroundings. They were always attentive to respond our wapps when needed. At the end of the stay we decided to spend some days in algarve and needed to short our original planned stay and they kindly changed the check out days so I could not be charged for those days. All in all, an amazing place to stay in villa nova de Gaia which is just 15 mins walking distance from main spots to visit in Porto.

The view is amazing! The space has some small quirks but is overall comfortable and functional. The location is also fantastic, especially if you’re interested in exploring the port wine cellars in Gaia.

Great Airbnb in a quiet neighbourhood of Porto! We used bolt to get around which was very convenient. Great restaurants a 10 minute walk away down to the river and the space was beautiful and clean! Hosts were super responsive and attentive and surprised us with a welcoming gift! Best part was the view
This is the perfect spot for an amazing view and also walkable to all great places in Porto. The apartment is cozy, and well equipped. The view is amazing. I recommend this stay.
Great stay. I would recommend this place to anyone. The view was amazing and the host was very helpful

This apartment was lovely and clean, it has the most beautiful view of Porto and was located in a great location in Villa Da Gaia. Everything was walkable and it was very comfortable. Would definitely recommend this beautiful apartment.

Beautiful apartment with an amazing view. It’s located in the beautiful district of Gaia, super walkable and close to many places. Communication with the hosts was pretty smooth. Really helpful and responsive. Would totally recommend.

We had a wonderful stay. Great views. The included parking was a bonus and so close.  The apartment was extremely clean. Perhaps due for a little makeover/maintenance soon. Bathroom door did not close and a couple of dining chairs needed replacing.

perfect place to stay for a weekend away in Porto. The apartment is perfectly located within waling distance of all the main bits of the city, the apartment was spotlessly clean, with a big comfy bed, and if you wanted to cook- a well stocked kitchen. The host was very communicative and helpful which made our stay even better. would recommend

A wonderful apartment, fully equipped, quiet and breath taking view. I just love it. Susana was very helpful up the day we left, she arranged taxi for us. She is supercool. Location is perfect for me, restaurant and mini market. A nice walk down to do visits in surrounding area.  Unit is super clean, with AC....I like that. Highly recommended.
Your house was really clean and comfortable. There is 5th floor and no elevator so a little tired to go up. But everything but that was perfect!
A true gem in the heart of Porto and close to all the important monuments. The house was very beautiful and spotless clean. For best value for money, look no further!
Great place to stay. Super new cozy flat, close to shops and other things. Highly advise this place.  Thank you 😊
Great stay! A little noisy because of the construction site nearby but still a very nice and clean place :) The host was very helpful and available.
Very pleasant accommodation in a quiet location near the historic center of Porto, I highly recommend. Zuzana

Great apartment close to the heart of Porto. The hosts were super nice, promptly answering our calls and solving our lack of hot water within a couple of hours. Beds are ok, showers are great. Nespresso, tea and traditional biscuits were a pleasant surprise.
Accommodation is in good and quiet location near the center. The apartment was beautiful, clean and spacious. Lucia was wonderful host and we were very satisfied.

We had a wonderful stay in this apartment, Lucia is a great host, the communication was very easy and fast, she also gave us a lot of tips what to do in Porto. The apartment was super clean and comfortable, it had everything what’s needed :) I will recommend this apartment to others :)

The apartment is nice and clean. Lucia is an amazing host and very friendly. The apartment has everything you need for a couple days in Porto. It is very close to the port wine cellars and the waterfront and about 20‘ walk to the city center. But everything is easily accessible. Overall a highly recommend accommodation
We had a great stay in this apartment. The host was very helpful and welcoming, the location was great, and the apartment was comfortable, spacious and clean.
The apartment was very comfortable and in a great location.  Fernando very kindly gave us lots of local information which was really helpful. We enjoyed our stay very much.
I really like hosts. Fernando welcomed us, gave us instructions what to do, how metro works and we had lovely chat. I can recommend this place for everyone. Hosts and the place are great!

We stayed at the airbnb of Ac in Porto and it was great! Pretty appartement with an amazing view, easily accesible and definitly worth the price. Ac responded quickly with clear and good instructions and responded very fast when you asked questions! Great host :)

Great host who met us personally at the property & communicated & visited us to make sure we were settled & happy. Fab location with a short walk to the sea front & a further 10 min walk over the river to the other side of Porto. The apartment was clean, spacious & the beds were very comfortable. We would definitely recommend this property & host

Our stay in Porto was great from every aspect. From the moment we booked the reservation and received great and timely information about our upcoming stay; to having a very courteous driver meet us at the airport and remove any concerns about finding the location; to the warm welcome and introduction we received from Pedro - who provided us further local guidance about where to eat, and what to do. The location was superb; close enough to the action (walking distance), but far enough from the busier tourist section of Porto. The accommodations, were modern, bright, cozy, well appointed, and very clean. The outside deck was a great place to spend a quiet evening, with a nice bottle of wine. Ruis recommended a Port house, and of the 5 we visited the one Ruis recommended was the best - Real Compania (great find). Pedro organized our transportation back to the airport - with a pickup at 3:30AM - We appreciated the early morning pickup!!
Everything went well! Location is very good and the house reflected the pictures. We had a great time
Amazing stay in Porto! The space and terrace were excellent, lovely host and welcome. Clean, spacious and nice location. Thank You so much! 5 stars from Estonian girls :)

We had such a great time in Porto. The location of the Airbnb was perfect and it was easy to walk to many great restaurants and sights. It was a great size for two couples and we spent a lot of time on the porch. Check-in was seamless and we were given the option to add in airport transfers which made our arrival and departure stress free. Will definitely stay here again if we get the chance to come back to Porto.
Very nice, spacious apartment with a lovely terrace. It has a good location with lots of nice restaurants nearby. The host was very welcoming and helpful. We would definitely go there again!

Firstly, this is an excellent location from which to explore beautiful Porto. Secondly, the apartment is very smart and clean, with all the amenities you could hope for. And lastly, the communication was helpful and our welcome immaculate. I simply recommend this apartment to anybody wanting to spend time in this wonderful city .
This is the best Apt out of all the ones we stayed at during our stay in Portugal. Very clean, comfortable, and great location. Highly recommend it.
Very nice appartment, located from walking distance from city centre. Rooms are very spacious and there is a nice terrace to enjoy the evening 👍

Check in was very easy - we were met on arrival and everything went very smoothly. The apartment was spotless with crisp white bed linen and a great balcony to catch the last of the sun.  Everything was walkable and there are some fab restaurants within 5 minutes walk.  I would highly recommend this apartment.

The apartment is lovely.  Living room smaller than appear in photos, however very comfortable and worked well.  Check in was seamless and we were allowed an early check in at 1:30 p.m. which was appreciated.  We were met by a delightful young woman who ran through everything with us. The location is great, easy to get everywhere.  The weather did not cooperate for us to be able to use the wonderful deck which would be  a real plus in good weather.  I would recommend this apartment and if back in Porto would stay again.  We really enjoyed our time in Porto and the apartment was a part of a great experience.  Thank you for a lovely visit.
We had a great stay in Ruis apartment.  It is located very central, so everything is in walking distance. Great rooftop terrace :-)
Loved this apartment. Perfect for two couples traveling. Very spacious with lots of natural light. Simon welcomed us and was available if we had any questions.
Beautiful place, very homy and comfortable. Quality of the assets are excellent and the feeling of the host is very honest and transparent.

What a wonderful stay! The host from the very beginning  was beyond accommodating. So responsive from the beginning and incredibly helpful. Even though our flight was delayed, they met us and let us check in early- even greeted us with a glass of port! Comfy beds, modern showers, and gorgeous terrace. Couldn’t be happier with our stay and would definitely recommend!

This was an absolutely beautiful, comfortable, tidy, modern, and wonderful home for our trip in Porto. It mirrored the charm of the city and added so much enjoyment to our stay. The two bedrooms are spacious and modern, and our favorite part was the beautiful deck/balcony that we enjoyed every night after exploring the city. I definitely recommend this stay to anyone visiting Porto. You’ll surely enjoy it as much as we did!
Absolutely beautiful property!  Patio furniture needs attention, and shower doors were extremely difficult to open. We didn’t realize there were so many stairs and no lift, and no dishwasher.

Great place for a stay in Porto, away from the super-heavy tourist area (which is only a 5 minute walk). Super location, modern suite, very clean. The patio gets full sun during the day, and it gets quite hot during summer-type weather (the unit itself has excellent air conditioning as well as motorized blinds in each room) but if you expect to spend a lot of time on the patio, you probably won't, unless it's early morning or evening. Super-convenient grocery shopping, excellent restaurants. Would definitely stay again.

Accommodation is perfect in a great location, all places of interest and port are within a 20 minute stroll away. We were met by Pedro, who was lovely to talk to and very informative. I would highly recommend this accommodation.
The property was very well-managed and Pedro was punctual, friendly and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay!

Pedro met us at the apartment and gave us a walk through. He also took the time to answer our questions and gave us recommendations for good places to eat. The apartment is updated, clean and spacious. The balcony is a perfect place to enjoy some wine at night.  Great location. Lots to do within walking distance.

Wonderful top floor apartment a short walk from the centre of Porto.  The apartment was well fitted out with everything working perfectly and the outside patio was a godsend to relax on at the end of the day after busy exploring Porto.  The lady who checked us in was extremely knowledgeable, friendly and full of advice, despite our late arrival it was still lovely to be welcomed promptly and with a glass of port!  I can’t say enough about this apartment except ideal for 4 adults in a great location.

Amazing apartment, great communication with Ruis and Simon. Loved the bedrooms and the bathrooms, enjoyed on the balcony with the tanning beds and definitely an apartment that I will recommend. Loved our stay, thank you 😊

Loved the apartment. We could walk everywhere. Close to a metro station going directly to the airport. A lovely cafe for breakfast right around the corner.  The apartment itself was spotless. Ruis kindly let us drop our bags there early so we could start our mini break straight away without lugging our bags around. Lovely to have big spacious rooms both with en suites and another half bathroom. Terrace was an extra luxury.  We would definitely stay again if we go back to Porto.
Amazing apartment, great size for 4 people. Clean with big bedrooms and a nice terrace. Would definitely recommend
Lovely apartment with great sized rooms. location was great for restaurants and some bars. Host was great with communication and very flexible with us checking in.

We really enjoyed our stay.  Well situated.  Traffic is quite something - very busy.  Parking lot was about a 4/5 minute walk away.  Top floor so make sure you can do stairs.  Quiet.  Lots of great restaurants and coffee shops close by.  Communication was awesome with the host.

We were two couples traveling together that rented this place and we loved it! Great location with a close distance to a lot of great restaurants, the supermarket and the subway. We really enjoyed hanging out on the terrace after a long day of exploring the city.

Lovely apartment with two double bedrooms both en suite. Large sunny balcony with plenty seating options. Supermarket and bakery nearby. Apartment is up two flights of steps and it is a 15 minute walk to the old town. Overall we really liked the apartment and would stay here again.
This house is very nice and comfortable for family trip. I want to recommend this place to my friend.
The space was very clean and a great location for getting around Porto. The host gave great tips and was quick to respond to any questions. Highly recommend.

The hosts were very kind and provided all tge necessary info for a pleasant stay.  Perfect flat for vacations with family with plenty space and all necessary commodities. The location is outstanding as it's nearby public transportation and 10 minutes walking from Porto. Definitely we will return!

Great location very close from General Tores metro station, Ponte Luis and board walk. Beautiful terasse, appartment is great with two bathrooms. A/C is 5/10 but great wind when windows are wide open. The building next door is under construction starting at 8am finishing at 6pm everyday… a bit noisy not for staying in bed ahaha. Great spot with a lot of local shops.

This is a beautiful apartment!!! The location is unparalleled in Porto. It is in the middle of the most happening place in Porto, with superb restaurants and shopping. Make sure you make reservations for the best restaurants cause they fill up fast.  Derek was the perfect host! very responsive, the check in process was super efficient and convenient, and the description is pretty on point. It’s a historical palace newly renovated. So it has a lot of charm with all the modern features, designed very tastefully, and very comfortable for our group. This is a beautiful city and we feel like we got the best experience possible staying here. Thank you! We will always remember these memorable few days :)

You will be staying right in the middle of all the action in Porto.  The train station Bento and Clerigos tower are both walking distance.  Walking down to the river is real easy (although walking up may not be for everyone).  Apartment is well furnished with comfortable beds.  I would not mind returning to the same apartment but for a longer stay.  Thank you Derek.
It's perfect. Comfortable house , cozy bedroom It was nice because the house was warm. Everything was perfect If we come back to Porto, we will stay here again.

The place is absolutely wonderful and feels warm and welcoming. It is very clean and has everything you need. Check-in went very smooth and we got some nice tips for restaurants and cafés. The apartment is located in the heart of Oporto and that is a big plus. Grocery store and nice restaurants, bars, shops and the train station and bus stops are around the corner.
A very nice 2 bedroom apartment in perfect location. Very much recommended. The only negative point that we faced is that the pillows were not comfortable, apart from that the place is great!
This place is even better than it looks in the photos. The sun is on the balcony all day and the views are amazing.

Absolutely beautiful apartment -it was spotlessly clean and location is ideal for exploring Porto. Would definitely stay here again!! Also got lots of great recommendations from our host for restaurants and things to see in Porto.
Great central location.  Private. Nice balcony with a sunset view for a drink. But be aware there is major construction in the immediate area during the day.
Beautiful apartment in the perfect central location. Plenty of space for the five of us. Great communication and accommodated an early check in. Highly recommend!

Thank you for having us. The appartement is very well furnished and decoration was made with very good taste. The place is quiet even if located in the city center. Would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone.

Lovely spacious apartment right in the heart of the city and so close to everything. Gorgeous wood features.  The double glazing is amazing as it cuts out any street noise when closed.  There is air conditioning in the main bedroom and fans are provided elsewhere.   We enjoyed staying here and would definitely come back again . Really appreciated being able to leave our bags for a bit longer after check out.  Great communication too.

Couldn’t have asked for a better location!The bathroom was slightly dated and had a bit of a moldy smell but not unexpected considering the older building. Host were so accommodating and even set out a crib for our toddler. Great stay!
Derek's place was amazing. The location was perfect, and the place was bigger than I imagined. Couldn't recommend this place enough.
The bedrooms are really noisy. The living room and the kitchen is OK. The beds are not comfortable.

The apartment was very clean. The location was excellent. Very friendly service. Laundry facilities were a plus. The bathroom door was tricky, difficult to open and loud. Couldn't go to the toilet quietly at night. The light from the toilet was also disturbingly bright in the other bedroom.  Would recomend!

lovely flat, clean and well equipped. walking distance to key sightseeing. It was very good for us (family with two children aged 5 and 3). Ruis and collaborators were helpful and communicated well. Recommended stay.

We had a great stay here. Esmael was quick to respond and very friendly and flexible about meeting us when we were late arriving. The apartment is in a lovely street and easily walkable to the old town. The apartment had everything we needed for a 4 night stay and was very comfortable.

Really nice compact apartment in a great location, that we’d highly recommend. The communication from both Maria and Carlos was fantastic, really quick, clear, friendly and helpful with lots of tips - everyone we met in Porto was so friendly. Carlos met us at the airport, making our arrival super easy.  The location is brilliant - near all the main sights and the river (though everywhere is hilly!). Some great cafes/restaurants nearby (DaTerra was great for breakfast, Cana Verde for lunch/dinner). Easy to get the bus to the beach. Very family friendly - a cot and high chair were arranged for us. Perfectly clean, exactly as described. Just great all round.

Comfortable and stylish apartment in a great location. Very airy, spacious and great light.  Had everything I needed for a very comfortable stay.  Ana was very helpful and responsive. Thank you for the lovely hospitality!

This was my first time in Porto and this place was amazing. The location is central to everything you could ask for- restaurants, bars, riverfront. The place itself is relaxing, modern and well-equipped. The check-in process was so easy and Maria was so helpful. I would recommend this beautiful apartment to anyone wanting to experience real Porto living!
Great apartment, quiet, well-lit and comfortably furnished, centrally located and hosts that are attentive and accessible (even if we didn’t meet them). This was perfect for us. We highly recommend!

This place was in convenient location for shopping and dining. Maria arranged transfer from the airport and was so helpful for us with big luggage. There were some noises from next room or upper room but acceptable. I do recommend!
Everything was perfect and we had a delicious Portuguese champagne on top of it. Could not als for more. We felt so at home. Also, the best area to be in. We loved it.

We loved staying here. The apartment was perfect for us and our 18month old child. It’s right in the centre of town so exploring Porto was so easy. Maria and Carlos were super welcoming and the airport pickup was definitely worth it. They were really great when we locked ourselves out too! Can’t recommend this place enough.

The location is exellent, very close to Sao Bento station if you arrive by train. You can walk to basically anywhere in central Porto and also very close to some amazing restaurants. The apartment is very clean. The bed is comfortable to sleep in. The communication with Maria/Carlos is great, they respond in a very timely manner if you have any questions or inquiries. The check-in process was very easy. Overall very happy with my stay in this apartment and if I ever come back to Porto I'd definitely stay here again.

A stylish, comfortable apartment in the perfect loation for exploring Porto. The check in / check out process was made really easy and the host went above and beyond to help get us and our 9 month old baby to and from the airport. Would highly recommend this place!
Great spot centrally located to sights, restaurants, and all the wonderful things Porto has to offer. Maria was very communicative.

The location of the apartment was excellent, right in the historic centre near the train station. Carlos was very kind and picked us up from the airport for a reasonable fee. Maria and Carlos were both very responsive on Airbnb and text. The apartment was very clean, had amenities such as towels, shampoo and shower gel etc
Very clean and airy apartment - inside the unit and the building as a whole. Maria was very responsive and kind to our needs. Would love to stay here again!
Worth the money. Ideal location. Perfect distance from anything worth seeing in porto. Looked like pictures advertised.

This spot is in an excellent location and is very walkable from most major attractions in Porto. During check-in, figuring out the doorknob was a bit of a challenge, but once we understood how to work the door key, there was no issue (thanks for the host's responsiveness). The place was relatively clean - some dust and stains that we tidied up, but nothing absolutely glaring. I would recommend this place during the cooler months as there is no central AC as stated in the listing and the bedroom can get quite warm. Also as someone with back pain, I would say the mattress was not the best for my lower back. My friend would also wake up with stiffness in the mornings. Overall, the size, location, and amenities are just what we needed for our first time visiting Porto.

Wonderful place to stay right above the Starbucks. Keys were tricky at times, but checking in and out was easy. This is very convenient to old city and we really enjoyed our stay. Who would have thought, we wished for air conditioning in October!  We would come again.
Great location, easily walkable to everything. Not too loud at night, and being able to do laundry for a long stay was great. Would happily stay here again!

previous review mentioned the place is not well lit. we didn't find it and issue. the windows face an alley but it was plenty of space for the sun. the bathroom was fine too. the tub is a bigger step in and out, move the screen door and you can find better footing, reverse your body out of it using your quad and there's no issue of falls. the bed is on the firmer side
Nice stay, not super-fancy but very functional, ideal for a stay during a touristy weekend!
Very nice location, the flat was perfect for a baby.  The furniture was complete and the flat is very quiet, you would be surprised when you open a window.  I recommend

The pictures don’t do justice to what is really like. The flat is BEAUTIFUL, it is fully equipped with all you need and even more. It has a first aid kit, something I couldn’t even think about that. The instructions about everything (check-in, check-out, trash, etc.) are very clear and easy to understand. I’m really happy and glad to have chosen a place like this. It’s very silent at night, you can’t hear the outside or the streets. Everything is amazing. If I ever have the opportunity to visit Porto again I’ll definitely be choosing Maria’s place again.
Beautiful apartment , all there at use, Maria very nice and proactive.We had a problem with the shower head and the day after she has replaced it ;)

Amazing place to stay at in Porto. Very spacious and clean. We were able to walk everywhere from here. Strongly recommend staying here.  I would stay here again. Sweet anime ramen location near by and Starbucks next door.  Maria is very kind and helped us have a very enjoyable stay. Nothing wrong with this spot.
Lovely, quiet apartment. Great location, with lots to do and see. We travelled with a 2 year old and really enjoyed our stay!
This was our second trip to Maria’s place and we felt right at home again. Can only recommend!
The location of the house was very good. However, it faces the back street, and since it is very close to the building across, we didn’t feel completely comfortable. Overall, it met our needs.

The apartment was brilliant and located in a fantastic part of Porto! There was ample space for two and the lady who showed us to the flat gave us both some really good suggestions of places to see and eat at!  I would definitely reccomend!! 😁
The Home Me experience was as expected very good. Genuinely felt at home and a recommendation you to make thuis your home away from home.

Very stylish and cosy appartment, great location and very friendly and punctual host. I loved every detail, shampoo bottles, design and small complements with cookies and coffee. Definitely recommend!
My stay was extremely nice and comfortable. The apartment is very cozy and equipped with everything you may need. It has a good vibe! My communication with the host went also smoothly. Recommended!
Ana's place is in an amazing location with really good wifi! (Something we struggled to find in Portugal)  Very comfortable and homey feeling. Would recommend
Amazing accommodation. I had a wonderfully comfortable stay, in a great location. If I’m ever to return to Porto, I’ll undoubtably stay here.

Ana’s apartment is exactly as described: clean, placed in a central location and with a lot of natural light. Ana was very responsive to our requests while all communication was very effective and straightforward. We travelled by car and we could conveniently and safely park our car in front of the apartment, at no cost. We highly recommend Ana’s apartment.

Would highly recommend this apartment for a stay in Porto. The location is very central, and you can enjoy wonderful access to amazing pastel de nata, and the beautiful sights of the city. It’s even a short walk from the fernicula so you can get home quickly from the river. The space was just like the photos and super comfortable. Would also mention the shower was one of the best I’ve ever had while traveling!
Everything was perfect, the house was beautiful, clean and very confortable. The best thing though was the location, close by the river and just 2 minutes away from the city center.
The apartment is really nice and really well located. You can reach the main attractions of Porto by feet. The airport ist connectd with the metro station near the house (ca 40-50mins).

Wonderful location, just a stone’s throw away from a lot of the scenic spots in Porto. The place was also very clean and well designed. A bit of noise from the upstairs floor but if you’re not a light sleeper, it’s fine. Bed is also super comfortable!
Highly recommended. The flat is really clean, pretty, has all the amenities needed and in great location.
Great place. The location is very good and the appartement is lovely ! It is a shame that we came to visit the town and go out because it is a great house to stay at home and chill

Excellent location to explore Porto, the main attractions are within walking distance. The apartement was very clean. The kitchen is very well equipped with all kitchen tools you need to cook. The host also organised an airport shuttle, which we really appreciated. We would definitely stay here again!
The apartment was at a good area - it was close to attractions and restaurants. The apartment was very well equipped and impeccable.

This is a lovely apartment near the train station/main area. Very clean, nicely decorated, appreciated the amenities—wish there was laundry, but otherwise well stocked and appreciated timely communication and local recommendations like the massage place!!

Easy and hassle free checkin as they have a key lockbox … high quality finishes with double glazed windows and solid shutters to keep the noise of the busy road outside São Bento railway station out … sparkling and spotless with air conditioning for those hot summer days and a very comfortable bed all within a 3 minute walk to Rua das Flores with all its restaurants and a 10 minute walk to the famous Dom Luis bridge.
perfect stay. location is perfect city of porto is very nice and small you can walk it all. definitely would come back

Ana’s place was perfect for our two night stay in Porto. We were surprised at just how close it was to the train station, making it so easy to access once we arrived. Despite the proximity to the station and eateries nearby, the space was pretty quiet. The unit itself was very spacious, clean, and stocked with everything we needed during our stay. The location couldn’t be better, as everything was walkable within 15 minutes. We wouldn’t hesitate to book again next time we visit!
Location was great! Close to the metro and in the middle of everything. At night the street itself could be a little suspect but aside from that it was great!

A great apartment.  Minutes from Sao Bento station and close to all the main attractions o Porto.  Very modern apartment and very clean. Had everything we needed for a couple staying four nights. communications with host excellent.
The location is great and made walking to all the sites very easy. And even though it was very central, it wasn’t noisy at all.

Really enjoyed our stay at your beautiful apartment. We liked that we were in the tourist area and could walk everywhere we planned on visiting. Porto is quite hilly so lots of exercise was gained just going and coming to and from the various sites we visited.

We had a great stay here. The airbnb was in a central location so we found it very easy to get to everything. The place was clean and easy to check in. The host was lovely and accommodated us checking in an hour earlier. Even though it was close to the center of everything, it was still really quiet and easy to sleep.
Great stay and location, but there was some loud construction that woke us up in the mornings. Still a great place in a beautiful building!

The location of the airBNB was very good and very central to all the tourist parts of town. We found it very easy to explore and walk to everywhere that we wanted to go. The apartment itself was exactly as pictured and felt very clean and nice. The surrounding area sometimes felt unsafe at night, with some people sleeping on the street nearby and we did see police inspecting a nearby situation on one occurrence. However, the building itself, and apartment, felt very secure and safe. Overall, we had a very good experience staying here and loved our time in Porto.

Ana Cristina’s was a nice place to stay with easy walking distance within Porto & Gaia Apartment was great, had everything we needed & suited the two of us Would recommend it to anyone wanting to stay in Porto
Had a lovely time in Porto for the weekend! The apartment is perfect as it is very central - we could walk everywhere! It is clean and comfy.

Thank you for a wonderful week in Porto! The apartment was very clean and cozy. The location is excellent—within walking distance of many sights, and the neighborhood itself is full of interesting things to do. Everything worked well, and the apartment had everything I needed. The only challenge was opening the front door, which took a bit of practice, as the locks here are quite different from those in my home country, Finland. I felt at home here and would be happy to stay again. 🌺
Excellent  location, had all I needed, too bad I couldn’t extend my stay at this place

Exactly as described/pictured, perfect location, good noise insulation when everything is closed - great place Shower basin near the plug hole feels a bit fragile and water leaks on the floor slightly

This apartment was great for our group of four! It was clean, spacious, had modern amenities, and a great AC. It was located close to several restaurants and monuments. The check in instructions were clear and finding the apartment was simple. I would highly recommend staying here!

Very nice and perfectly located apartment in the heart of Porto. Eugenia and Luis even provide you with recommendations of restaurant and things to do and check-in/check-out is very easy. The apartment completely corresponds to the description and pictures.

Great location in Porto. Can easily walk to all the Downtown Porto must see spots! The unit is great. Lots of space. Stylish unit with all the amenities required for an enjoyable stay. The morning delivery to the unit of the bread and croissants was really nice.

Spacious apartment in a perfect location, just a few minutes from the river and from key sights, plus plenty of cafes and restaurants. Bottle of port was left for us on arrival - we had everything we needed, including a great view! Would highly recommend for a trip to Porto.
Apartment was amazing, fabulous location and very beautiful. Hosts were quick to resopd to respond and lovely. Could not ask for anything more. I would highly recommend.

The place felt like home - from the beautiful french doors leaning out to the street. The location couldn't be more perfect. It's quiet and has super fast wifi. It's a fully fledged apartment with all you need. The only thing I wish it had was AC, which they were transparent about in the listing.
This was the PERFECT stay!! We felt right at home and felt the owners went above and beyond. Very responsive

The only negative comments that I have are that the number of stairs needed to climb to the unit were substantial and the fact that it is owned by a company made it feel less personal and less flexible in making special requests.

Lovely apartment in a great location. Hosts were very responsive and left lots of recommendations for the surrounding area.  Beware that all apartments are up stairs which didn’t worry us.but may others.

Great apartment, looks exactly like in photos. Very clean and functional. There are 2 bathrooms and 2 separate rooms, each on different floor.  The location is perfect - 2 minutes walk from the beach and 3 minutes to the Porto Metro station, which goes directly to the Porto city center.
The apartment was lovely and very well located! Although some parts of it are in need of refurbishment. The host was welcoming. Good value for the price. P.S. no kettle if someone wants a cup of tea.
We had a great stay. The apartment is very nice and clean and we really enjoyed our stay. It’s about 2km from tourist area, but a quiet area. Not many restaurants nearby.
Marvellous loft! Super comfortable with two nice balconies and close to the city center. Plus private parking and perfect communication. We were super happy :)

The apartment immediately makes you feel home with the large, bright windows and balconies as well as the comfortable and elegant furnishing. Ani is a great host, she welcomed us with a lot of warmth and supported us with many information during our stay.
fantastic place, very clean and well managed. check-in also excellent, no complaints. great for long stays as well

Beautiful, clean, stylish and comfortable… we enjoyed our stay here very much. The immediate area is very residential, so generally safe & quiet. The unit is on the 4th floor with a few nice balconies, and building has an elevator.  We spent a few nights dining in, and a few others walking to nearby restaurants & bars.  If I’m being picky the only thing that could be better would be the 10 minute walk to the metro or the 6 minute walk to the nearest market, but neither was that big a deal. And, you’re a few blocks from one of the best Francesinha places (O Afonso) and one of the best shopping & dining streets (Cedofeita). Overall, location was a net positive.

We had a fantastic stay in Porto at Ani's! The flat was as listed and was a comfortable and clean retreat after a day touring the city including sunset view from the upper balcony. Amenities included were helpful. Ani was very responsive for any queries we had. Would recommend and looking forward to hopefully returning one day!

Ani and Joana are magnificent hosts. They responded quickly, were very helpful and took care of a special request I had because of an allergy. I appreciate self check in and out. Both were possible. The free car parking is great and very easy to access. The location is great if you want to explore the city and live close to locals. It is also quiet at night. Perfect for a good night sleep :) Even a cleaning during our longer stay was offered. We loved the decorations and had a great time. Many thanks!
A top notch place.  Really great for 2 people.  Loved the balconies and it was easy and super comfortable.
Had a wonderful few days at Anisalbel’s, the apartment is super nice and had everything we needed and more, also walkable distance to a lot of places. I’d Totally recommend staying here
Great location.  The flat was very comfortable, charming and welcoming.  Great for a solo traveller or a couple.

This is a really beautiful apartment in the perfect location for a visit to Porto. Everything is easy walking distance. The apartment itself is very new and spotlessly clean and has everything you need.

One of the best apartments we’ve stayed. The neighborhood is close to everything in Porto center but surprisingly very quiet and tucked away in a nice windy road. Smells and looks great, highly recommend it.
Super cute apartment in a great location! Walkable to shops, restaurants and Porto sites, quiet, and had all the amenities needed. Host was responsive and helpful. Would definitely stay here again.
The apartment was beautiful and bigger than I thought. The location is perfect and the check-in is easy. I also forgot my keys inside and the owner of the apartment helped me really fast. Thanks!

Truly amazing apartment with a more than helpful and very friendly host Maria. Beautifully furnished, very luxurious - and the location is a blast! You'll find yourself in the middle of the beautiful old part of Porto, just 2 minutes from the Douro river and 5 minutes from the famous bridge. Lots of excellent restaurants around, this apartment does not only feel like home, but rather is the perfect base to start your day to discover Porto! We will for sure come again. :-)

Maria‘s place is perfectly located to discover the beautiful city of Porto (everything can be reached by foot easily). Also, the apartment is very stylish, spacious and safe. Maria was very helpful with the self check-in and available at all times. Would definitely recommend.
Stylish AirBNB situated in the city center. Nearby you can find everything you want, the apartment was modern and looked like on the pictures. I will definitly return!

We cannot say enough great things about our stay, we absolutely loved it and would definitely return! this apartment is so beautiful and in the most amazing location, you can easily walk everywhere but don’t have to go far to enjoy amazing resturants, bars and shops close to your doorstep. Maria was a great host, checking on us to ensure we had everything we needed and made check in and out very easy and smooth. Definitely recommend and thank you Maria!
It was amazing !! Definetly would stay there again , location is great , everything worked in the apartment , great WiFi , it’s perfect

A great apartment in a perfect location. Everything was flawless, from the airport pick up to the airport drop off and everything in between. Centrally located, everything within walking distance. Great restaurants nearby and it’s a short walk down to the river. We loved Porto and would love to return one day!

Our stay in Porto in this apartment was wonderful! The comfort level was top notch as well as the location. It was so nice to open the doors to the balcony and experience the life going on below, but when closed the noise was gone! A very comfortable and beautiful place to stay!
This apartment is in a great location in Porto a close walk to The Douro river.  It’s close to restaurants, bars, shops just below the apartment.  The bed and air conditioning were excellent.
Great to experience authentic Porto architecture in such a beautiful space! And the location was perfect! Easy to walk pretty much anywhere but lots of great places nearby.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. The apartment is well decorated and tidy, and has everything you could need for a comfortable stay. The location couldn’t have been better for exploring the city of Porto and all the best views are nearby. We’d happily recommend staying here!
The apartment was lovely, clean, and comfortable. Super easy to find and get inside, great location with a great local bakery right around the corner.  Would gladly stay here again.

We had such an amazing time. The location is perfect for walking and exploring. Maria was very quick to respond and handled an issue (that was not an issue of the Air BnB) with the electricity and the city and stayed in contacts with updates the whole time. It happened to be a HUGE championship Football gave between FC Porto and Italy so it was very active! Even with the festivities it was still quite with the shutters closed. Be aware, the space heater does not work but we were fine with the apartment heating unit. This is a fantastic find and I would stay here again.
The apartment is in a great location, very close to the river and other main attractions. The amenities were as described and we had everything we needed.

Overall good stay at Maria’s place!  The location was the highlight as it was very centrally located to everything. The water at the bottom of the street and great restaurants/bars and shops every which way. Albeit, it was at the bottom of the hilly street so every day started with quite the jaunt up! Hills are to be expected in Porto but just a consideration for some.  The space was as described/photographed and spacious. Had what you needed, nothing extravagant.

Incredibly easy to access the apartment. Clean, tidy and all the amenities needed for a comfortable stay. We cooked a few times and there was the necessary pots, pans etc to do so  Perfect, would recommend and would stay again. The location was great, the apartment is near numerous bars, resturants and transport links   Perfect.

It was nice place to stay, very near to most touristic spots. Although we closed the shutters there was still noise which was not ideal for light sleepers. On the other hand everything was fine for two persons’ accommodation.
Perfect appartement in the historic center of Porto. Really nice interior, everything you might need (even an umbrella 🤞🏻). We felt right at home! Maria was a really friendly and courteous host!
Great apartment, very clean, had everything we needed. It is in a good location, just a bit noisy at night but to be expected for being in the heart of the city.
Maria was a great host. Her place was centrally located near everything. We loved our stay!!! Thank you!!
Great host. Organised a private transfer from the airport (Carlos) who was fantastic. Apartment was better than the photos. Lots of helpful tips inside!
Lovely apartment.  Central location to the port  .  Would definitely return and loved our time there.   Thank you Maria

Maria is a fantastic host ! Super communicative and very flexible.  Great location so close to everything yet not on a busy street.  We loved it. Would definitely stay again and will recommend for sure

This is a very well located and gorgeous apartment in Porto. The place was spotless and looked even more beautiful than photos. Communication was clear and courteous. I would highly recommend this place and would stay here again. There is a lot of construction at the moment in the area, but we still had  a fantastic time.

this spot is an absolute gem! it's easy to find, so central to restaurants, the waterfront, the rain station and gelato! it's so clean, beautifully decorated and has everything you could need. it's absolutely gorgeous! even with the road out our Terrace under construction, it in no way impacted our stay or quality of sleep. we also felt so safe. definitely stay here!

We loved staying at Maria’s place. The checkin process was efficient and instructions clear. The location is located by many good restaurants and close to the Duro.  Maria was very responsive and accommodate an early checkin. When we come will stay here again.

We had a wonderful remote working and holiday stay at Maria’s place. It is in a fantastic location but there is a lot of construction and some noise also from other apartments and the street below. Not surprising probably when you’re so central. The space itself is beautiful - really cool and comfortable.  It does feel like there’s a little wear and tear - like some things being slightly broken or stiff and it’s more expensive than some others we saw, but still recommend for a beautiful space in central Porto.
It's a bit noisy during the day but surprisingly quiet at night. The house has a good view of the river and a nice vibe to it and there are a lot of things to do within a 15-20 minute walk range.
We loved Maria's place from start to finish!  It is a beautiful place, a wonderful location, and felt right at home.  Highly recommend Maria's place when visiting Porto.
Maria’s apartment was beautiful, clean and in a perfect location. We had a great stay and would recommend.
Excellent accommodations. Comfortable, well decorated and ideal location near Douro river. Very secure entry and exit. Enjoyed the balcony!
It's a very nice comfortable place and a great location to enjoy Porto. It'll even be better once the subway opens so you may explore further. But everything is walking distance.
Best value in Porto. The spot was so cool - you felt like a local.  Maria was very responsive.  Highly recommended!

Maria’s place was the perfect location for our time in Porto! Extremely walkable in a quiet street. The place was comfortable and had everything we needed. We had a fabulous time! Definitely recommend.

We had an excellent stay, the place was very spacious and clean. The location was also super convenient, everything was easily walkable. Maria was a friendly and responsive host. I would definitely recommend and would stay again!

We absolutely loved the apartment. It looks just like in the pictures and is perfectly located, right in the heart of everything and easily accessible from everywhere. For those who prefer a quieter place, staying outside the city might be a better choice.

The flat is lovely and Marina is a great host. The piano was a nice touch and well appreciated. It was a lovely and quiet area, 5 minutes walk from the nearest beach. Espinho is the nearest town with some really cheap places to eat out.

A great place to enjoy a quiet stay and get away from things. Shops in easy reach but a bit of a walk if you want to go to town or the nearest train station as there are no buses and taxis are hard to come by. The house itself was lovely and had everything we needed. Marina and Pedro are great hosts and nothing is too much trouble.

Marina is an excellent host. She took the time to meet us and explain everything about the apartment even when we arrived much later than expected. The apartment was really cozy with everything we needed. The area is nice, well serviced by supermarkets and really close to Espinho if you want a bit move movement.

Marina is a very friendly Host, her flat is big and clean.  I highly recomment the flat to everyone who wants to enjoy the coast of portugal close to Porto and Espinho, which is a nice walk on a very idillic passway on the coast. You find in Marinas flat everything for a confortable stay, Lidl and farmacy very close. Thanks Marina✨
Nice cozy place by the ocean. Ocean breeze, close to small restaurants and a fish market, by the beach with a good promenade. Parking in abundance. Great host!

I felt more than welcome at Mario's place. The room is sufficient for one person. Room and bathroom are very clean. The beach is just around the corner. You will find all necessary places like a small convenience store, restaurants and cafeterias close by. I will definitely come back.

Mario and Dulce are amazing hosts and people, lovely couple with a lovely apartment. You can really feel like you’re at home. Apartment is right in front of the beach, you just need to cross the street, station is around 4-5 minutes away (by foot), walkable everywhere and for me personally, their place is the most peaceful place I’ve ever stayed before ❤️❤️❤️❤️

Really nice apartment in the heart of Porto, next to Casa da Musica. The flat is big enough for two, quiet, clean and very well equiped. Nearby there is everything: metro station, bus stops, super markets  etc. Next to Avenida da Boavista which leads to the ocean.  Will keep in mind next time we 'll be in Porto
We really liked the services offered by the Porto Concierge. The room was spacious and pretty, near a subway station. Only minor downside is the size of the shower! We recommend!

We want to say biggest thanks for the host! The place of apartament are located more than good, because it takes just 2-3 mins of walking to reach station from-to airport, city center, sightseeing bus. The apartament is clean 100 %, thry even meet us with Porto wine :) They helped us with tourist things etc. Likewise, you can feel 100% safe even in the middle of the night in this neighbourhood. The apartament is also ready for cooking at home or woth the kids :)Thank you once again!
I needed a place to stay near Av. da Boavista for work and the Music Hall - Yellow Submarine was a great option. Will try to book it again in the future.
Everything was clean and nice, location was good as well. The hitting didn’t work well, but they fixed the problem immediately
Good appartment, close to the metro and the host are really reactive, any question or problem, they are here for you!

Really pleasant stay. The flat is situated well, easy to walk to the river (30-mins walk) or to grab a bus/metro. The surrounding area can be quite busy so I recommend bringing the earplugs with you, especially for light sleepers. It’s nicely furnished place, despite furniture not totally new anymore. Kitchen is well equipped for some minor cooking. I loved the welcoming gift in form of wine :)
Nice location, really close to the city center, ceveral shops around. The kitchen was well equipped. Communication with the host was always helpful and friendly.
It is a great apartment, near everything I needed (metro, hospital, and cozy cafes to be able to work remotely). It was clean and had every equipment necessary for my stay. Definitely recommend!
Great place to stay for a very reasonable price. Was very clean and they were very helpful. Let us leave our baggage with them once we checked out. Couldn’t ask for more

The apartment is clean and functional. Metro station at less than 10 minutes. One bottle of wine offered at arrival. We suggested the owner to mention the size of the shower cabin as it is only 0,70 x 0,70.

Place is great. Bathroom is a bit small but this wasn’t a problem for us. Street parking around the area is hard to come by but there is a parking garage ($) around the corner.  The sofa bed wasn’t very comfortable but we managed. Host/cohost were very helpful! Overall great place. A bit of a walk from center but Uber is super affordable to and from center. The city is beautiful! Would definitely recommend.

Friendly and helpful host, and everything very well prepared despite I booked the apartment on the very day I check in. Everything functional and all places are at walking distance. Good place in a beautiful city
Luis's place was comfy, near the metro, just outside the tourist bustle, so in my books--perfect!
The apartment is well situated with many amenities around and bus around the corner. It's very good for solo or couple travelers

Great location, nice, quiet and clean apt. Plenty of options for restaurants, groceries and cafés nearby. The only thing to point out is there is no "central heating" but rather a space heater in the room, not necessarily a bad thing, just not what I was expecting.  Overall great experience, would recommend!
This is a comfortable apartment, and I really enjoyed the location. If you want it they’ll deliver breakfast to your door, and you have a kitchen!

What an amazing stay we had in Porto in Maria’s apartment! She and her family are incredibly professional and thoughtful hosts. The apartment is silent, brand new, fully equipped and perfectly clean, of course. Location is 20 minutes from city center with nice walk but well served by subway. Maria took care of everything we need and helped us with parking and every kind of tips. She suggested a great restaurant and was lovely with us and our kids. A great example of hospitality, Maria set for us a new standard of hosting that will be hard to match. Greatly recommended.

Maria is an amazing host. Since we came, I felt like I am at home.. The house was super clean and tidy, there were snacks and even Portuguese wine she bought for us!  House is in a good location and has parking space in front of the apartment. Highly recommend this place!
Maria is a great host. She is very warm, charming and cheerful person. The apartment is great located, clean and cosy.  It was a true pleasure to meet Maria and stay in her beautiful apartment!

Overall good. Spacious apartment but very small shower. Apartment looks identical to the pictures. Location OK for full day trips to the city centre, but bit far to go back and forth. Unfortunately currently next to a construction site.
everything is OK. Couch is not new with some small holes or smth like this. apartment is comfortable for 2 persons.

Had a great stay here and would definitely recommend! The place itself was really clean and easy to find, it's spacious for 2 people (seems like it would be spacious enough for 4 even). And bed was really comfortable and large, it all felt really homely. The WiFi was good for me to work remotely and the kitchen had all the essentials to cook a proper meal. It's close to restaurants and supermarkets, and a short distance to the centre too. It's really peaceful outside and was always quiet waking up in the morning which was nice. Would recommend for your stay in Porto!
All good. Top floor therefore not many issues with noises except for loud guests and metro construction site outside. But nice 😊

We had a wonderful stay at Maria's! The apartment is well equipped and clean. she is very sympathetic and she spent a lot of time helping us to get to know the city. All in all we can totally recommend staying at her place
Maria's place was wonderful. very close to the city center and yet in a quiet street. the apartment is well equipped, very clean Maria hospitality is generous and warm. don't miss it!

Walking distance from shops and good restaurants. Adriano was very responsive and provided great recommendations for local restaurants/things to do. Apartment was a good size for 3 people, ideal would be 2 for ample room. Street was a bit noisy at night but we had a sound machine so were able to sleep comfortably.  Would definitely stay here again. Thanks!

Lovely host lovely place. Location not too far from the centre. But still, walkable. For those with walking difficulty, you might want to consider taking an uber/bolt as there is a very steep slope (typical of Porto) from the station to airbnb.  Nonetheless, we made it. Adriano was a five star host. He was really helpful and responsive. Even helped lugged our 20kg luggages to the room. Room would be perfect for 2 people. We were 3, a little crammed, but its defo compensated by the comfortable beds and convenient location.
Great place, very well located  Quick response by Adriano.  Very friendly and helpful.  We even got  fresh fruits at our arrival. It’s a historical building, very charming but not well isolated.

The space created by João and Diana is amazing. The rooms are sparkling clean, the kitchen is equipped better than my own, the common space inspires meeting and getting to know travellers from across the world. The location is also very convenient: there are bus and tram stops 2 minutes away, and a supermarket across the street.
Excellent location, close to public transport, supermarket and shops. Great hospitality and rooms. Here you feel at home!

We had a perfect stay in this apartment. Everything was clean, the interior is very stylish. The district is calm and not far from the major tourist spots. I would definitely recommend this place if you want to spend some time in Porto.

Great hosts and facilities, responded quickly with any questions and requests and very helpful, lots of cafes and the beach close by, tramline right outside which is convenient for travel if a little noisy at times.
Great trip. Host very welcoming. Place clean and nice. Perfect trip. Would recommend 100%

A really nice place with spotless private rooms. Right next to the metro thing to get to Porto easily. Charming strolls all around the neighbourhood , lots of restaurants and seaside is 3minutes walk ! The hosts are great characters aswell :)

It was a very nice stay in a stylish loft. Even though we did not meet the host personally, we were in constant contact and were able to contact Belina with all the questions. The location was also good - quiet but not far away from all the sights.

Great Location. Perfect place to roam around the city. Very hospitable host and very prompt  in replying our queries. Got excellent tips from Diogo. Check in and check out are so smooth. A big thumbs up

The space is small and cozy - perfect for someone who used it to work and sleep, but otherwise spent most of the time outside. The location is nice and the apartment is pretty quiet (though I am a heavy sleeper). The team is very communicative, and was able to accommodate an early check-in last minute despite scheduling dictating otherwise. Shampoo and conditioner were missing upon check-in, but I brought my own so didn't reach out to them about this. They also left me enough Nespresso pods for a daily coffee and a selection of tea. I had a great time at this apartment.
The room was exactly as described, the area is far from the center in a weird neighborhood (Present of prostitution). The most annoying part was the presence of cockroaches

Stylish room well centered to a main road and public transportation.  Lots of space and nice facilities in the building (especially the kitchen and dining area) Super friendly host which knows a lot about the city and General portugal.  Definitely a recommendation
Stylish place, would’ve stayed way longer if I hadn’t booked the rest of my trips. Very clean and in a great spot, everything is easily accessible by walking or metro.
Had an amazing stay! It was last minute, very last minute and they accommodated us immediately and did everything to make us feel comfortable and welcome! Amazing stay! Clean and an oasis!

Beautiful apartment that looks just like the pictures, lots of space and was very clean. they also provided a bottle of wine to welcome us. The bed is comfortable and the room bright and spacious good location - not too far from the tourist area but close enough to walk. Really good value for money!
Very clean, very good condition, very kind host, very good facility. It's the best bnb I've ever stayed. It was even better than my room.

A wonderful unit! Very clean, spacious and nice and bright. We really enjoyed staying here and would highly recommend it. It's about 15-20 minutes walking distance from downtown and its a great walk with restaurants.

The apartment was clean and very practical. The bed is huge. All equipment was operational. The location is very nice, to all major attractions were easily accessible on foot. The only ocean was a bit far, but with good public transport. I recommended.
Great apartment with everything we needed during our stay. Centrally located, but quiet place. The host was always helpful and the communication smooth. I surely recommend!
