It is close to a lot of tourist attractions and neighborhoods.  We loved staying here. Can't wait to come to Porto soon. It is definitely more expensive during the tourist season so please book ahead.
Place was nice and clean and felt luxury at times. Only thing lacking was the hot water in the shower.

Lovely, clean unit with everything we needed. Comfy bed, electric kettle, Nespresso maker, hand soap, dish soap, and plenty of tp. Centrally located to walk to all the major attractions, two metro stations, and a Pingo Doce grocery. I saw a review that said it seemed like a shady neighborhood. I didn’t think so. I felt safe. Only challenge was hot water. My best guess is the water is shared by the building. Plan to shower at off times or to be very cold. Bring ear plugs to block the rooster.

Great place to stay! Peaceful and quite area, not in the center but in a walkable distance from it. Nice and cozy. The host was responsive and gave clear instructions how to find the place and  self check-in. Thank you!

Great service, but the kitchen were missing a lot of things, cloths and such. The oven was extremely slow. The floor was dusty which makes you wonder if everything has been cleaned properly. It was very noisy from neighbors at times and there was a rooster, waking us before 07:00. The water in the shower was not hot enough. The pillows were bad in my opinion.

We had a great time in Porto. The apartment was exactly like in the photos, everything was neat and tidy. Situated within a walking distance to the centre and the metro station, the apartment felt close to everything while beating peaceful and quiet at the same time. The hosts are very friendly and always reply to questions in a timely manner. We would definitely choose to stay again at one of their properties in the future.

Porto stole our hearts! The place made it even better. Great hospitality and care. All went super smooth, the apartment is new, clean and communication was super. It will be our stay when we come back :) Thanks again!
Very nice and cozy place. Close to the subway and well connected to the city center. Everything went great!
Communication was good.  Apartment was clean and the kitchen had all equipment I needed. Apartment is located by a busy road, so noise is coming from there.

I liked living at Rodrigo’s apartments. Very clean at home and in the house, I found there all I needed, even radiator! Close to the Metro station, close to the centre. I was happy to stay there. Thank you!
Very good stay in Porto. Comfortable and walkable location to the center. The apartment is comfortable for 2-3 people with enough amenities provided.

The apartment is new, very clean and comfortable, you have everything that you need. It is also close to the sea, with surf schools and rentals, the metro and nice fish restaurants. Jose has been really helpful. We have a wonderful stay.

Very nice appartment,  very well equipped, comfortable beds, location couldn't be better, café's, restaurants, (super) markets, yoga studio, everything around the corner. José really very sympathetic, responds immediately to anything you might need, the place to be in Matosinhos

This house is the absolute best! I would recommend it to everyone. Prior to our arrival we had contact. Our host Hugo responded very quickly wich makes life easy.  Arriving at the house was easy and Hugo was there to welcome us. He gave a good tour of the house and was very precise in explaining everything.  The jaccuzi was great, the outdoor kitchen worked perfect, the rooms are spaceous and luxurious. Bathrooms are equiped wich rainshowers. Our stay at this house was absolutely perfect. The weather in februari was real good, unfortubatly a little too cold for the pool. But we'll try that next time! Thanks again for having us and being a great host!

We stayed in the villa for a week and everything was absolutely perfect! The house is more beautiful then on the pictures, the pool and garden are an amazingly serene oasis and overall it’s a wonderful place to relax, disconnect and enjoy the Portuguese weather. The house is located in a small town with everything you need close by (small supermarket, bakery) and Porto is also easily reachable by car. A huge thank you to our host! Super helpful with everything we needed during the week! We had a wonderful time and are looking forward to being back again soon

This villa was amazing! It was huge, and was very clean. The hot tub was great! Host was really helpful and quick to respond to any questions. It was really nice to stay a bit out of the centre or porto and it was easy enough to get an Uber in to Porto when we needed to. Would definitely stay again!

Hugo and Manuel were great hosts, proactive and good communicators. Home was gorgeous and exactly as described. Would 1000% recommend for anyone looking for privacy, space and all the creature comforts!

The villa is perfect for a relaxing break away with friends with a bbq, pool, and jacuzzi. It was very convenient to have a nearby bakery, butchers, and a small supermarket (about 5mins walk away). Hugo, our host, was friendly, pleasant, and helpful and was just a call away if we needed anything/had questions. I would highly recommend going to the following restaurant and vineyard for amazing food and wine - Winebar Casa da Viuva and Quinta da Avelada (book in advance). The villa is in a rural area so car transport is necessary. We relied on Andre, a local taxi driver recommended by the host who was excellent.
Absolutely amazing weekend at the place! Hugo was super professional and responsive. The house looks better in real life than at pictures. Definitely worth its money.

Accommodation more than lived up to expectations. Very good welcome from Hugo, very responsive and pleasant. The accommodation was very large and very clean, we didn't lack anything. We'll be back with pleasure.

Our family holiday with 9 people was so enjoyable. The villa lived up to our expectations and beyond It was well equiped, spotlessly clean, and Hugo was very helpful and friendly  The garden with numerous fruit trees was beautiful.  Towels were changed mid week and the pool and jacuzzi cleaned I would thoroughly recommend this villa The local mini supermarket  and cafe were wonderful   The fresh pastries every morning were delicious  We had a wonderful, peaceful holiday and hope we will return one day

We had an amazing time in the wonderful family home. There was enough space for everybody but it was also cosy! Everything was super clean and the communication with the Host went very easy.  Thankyou for the hospitality

Beautiful Villa, so spacious, well kept and great facilities! Hugo was very responsive and nothing was too much trouble. Had an amazing stay here as a group of 10. Ubers are easy to get into Porto city centre. You will need a hire car in order to get to a big supermarket.
Such an Amazing place! Swimming Pool and Hot tub absolutely Perfect.  We had a perfect Holiday and enjoyed everyday we stayed.  Hugo was so Help full with anything we needed, Cant wait to go back.
This place is fantastic! We’ve been traveling around Europe for weeks and this has easily been the best place we’ve stayed!

The appartment is really great, it looks amazing and has the perfect location to visit Porto!  Do mind that the appartment is next to a very busy road. There is good isolation  but sound will get through. Despite this we still would recommend it! Advice; It is hard to open the front door of the complex, don’t put the key completely in when you open it!
Such a lovely flat and amazing hosts. The flat was fantastic and very clean, and a brilliant location. 10/10
Loved the place and the hosts.. Was  a little disappointed because of the lack of air conditioning which was very warm inside however they did provide fans in lieu of the air conditioning

We had a nice stay at Marta & JP’s. Great communication, ideal location, and it had everything we need. Aside from some stained towels/sheets and the space being a bit damp (could use an extra air purifier) we had a good stay. Thank you!
The place was small but there was everything you need. It was sparkling clean and very pleasant. Carla is very hospitable person.

Silvia and Edu communicated, answering our queries. Edu checked us in. The apartment was lovely. There was a bit of a walk to get to the riverside but it was pleasant strolling through the neighbourhood .

Had a great time staying at this apartment. Very good value for a two bedroom. Apartment was very clean and the beds were so comfortable.  The part of town is decent, just a walk down a straight road into the heart of the city. This probably takes about 20 minutes, up a bit of a hill on the way back so bear this in mind. But wouldn’t be an issue for most.  Close to bars, metro and essentials. Would wholeheartedly recommend and even stay again if we were visiting. Edu was a helpful host on arrival.

The flat has a perfect location to discover Porto by feet or Metro. It is big enough for 10 adults. To our sorrow we found several defects, which we told the agent on the first day of our stay: one shower-rod and one toiletseat wasn't fixed. After 4(!) visits of the agent those two problems were fixed. One trashbin and one nightlamp was broken. Most difficult was that the sink-protection was missing which made it a challange to clean our dish. And there are no portwine-glasses and is no corkscrewer in the flat (remember: u r in Porto!) . All these missing parts werent delivered until we left after one week.

Wonderful place with an incredibly helpful host. Susan’s small hotel was superb, clean, stylish and comfortable. We had the entire place except for the rear villa and it worked great for our group of 12. The rooms were spotless, the beds comfortable and the shower the best we’ve encountered while traveling. The staff was friendly and helpful and made us a wonderful breakfast each morning. Easy location to explore Porto. Almada 331 is a small restaurant just down the street with a warm and engaging host. This property is obviously very well run and it was a delight to stay there. Our group agreed we would enthusiastically recommend it to others.

I would definitely recommend this beautiful, well decorated, cozy house in an amazing  surrounded environment. Olga is a super host that cares about your comfort and needs. It’s a friend that we love to have when we leave our own house to travel and find ourselves “at home” Thanks for hosting my family  We had a unforgettable journey
Fantastic location near the Arouca516 bridge and river beach, full of character. Attentive host.

Wasnt too sure about booking this apartment, looked a bit small on the pictures but finally did due to the good reviews. The apartament was way better than expected and better that how It looked on the pictures, we both loved It. Good location, confortable, very clean...super nice! the only reason i dont give It 5 starts is because the last morning the guy cleaning the rooms was very noisy and woke us up about 8 am in the morning.

We spent two nights at the stay and we love it. The stay proximate  to the river therefore you can see night view in your private space freely. Staff are friendly and helpful throughout the stay. We will stay here again if we visit the beautiful city again.

AMAZING stay in Porto! Riverfront. Wonderful view of water and trees. Loved the personal breakfast basket each morning. And the interior design/renovation of this property is elegant, simply modern, warm & inviting, and complete gorgeous. Bed and pillows were extremely comfortable. Robes and slippers were provided too! I could easily have spent the whole of my stay in this suite. But Porto is also a fabulous, vibrant city that is so fun to explore! This stay is a win-win-win on price, location, and design! Not to mention the hosts were so very helpful, friendly, and made access incredible easy. A Wonderful Experience all around!

I loved my stay here- right on the river. Easy check in and check out. It was a nice peaceful location to go across the river or up into downtown. The apartment was immaculate and the kitchen was well equipped. The breakfast was an amazing bonus- loved the fresh pastries and coffee! I would definitely stay here again!
Cute little flat located by the road. Can be a bit noisy at night as it is just by the road but it’s not a major problem. Was a comfortable stay.
beautiful apartment but the walls are very thin, so you could hear the train station outside and noisy neighbours.
Excellent hosts, location is right on the middle of historic town. Easy to access restaurants, coffee shops, churches, museums snd much more. Highly recommend

Not bad for a short stay in Porto. The location is very central, but it’s a bit seedy as it’s close to the main train station. That is really an upside too. The apartment is located in a courtyard with small dwellings that are made for short rentals. I didn’t get that impression from the pics so it’s with stating. It lacks a bit of personal love. There are signs of a leak from the shower that hasn’t been made good.
Great and central place to stay in Porto, elevator in the building and very clean and tidy. Comfortable beds and a nice bathroom. I can definitely recommend this place!
the appartment is really well located. very good handbook to get to the place and around. clean place. thank you Claudia & the team

Amazing location, on the doorstep of everything you’d want to do. Short 10 minute walk across the bridge to get to the port caves. Mattresses are very firm so keep this in mind if that’s not your thing. They offer a free bag drop service but it’s very far away, I highly recommend a bag drop service just next door to the apartment. I used an app called Bounce to book and it was super cheap and much easier.
everyone was welcoming. the room was really pretty, and the windows really let all the light in. the view is stunning. the breakfast basket was perfect.
Nice and walkable place to stay near Ribeira. Extra points for the great bed & breakfast :)
Super good location and cool looking room just like the photos. There was a breakfast basket every morning as well which was a nice touch :)

Christina's place is confortable, secure, peaceful, beautiful and relaxing. We had a very nice nice stay in the place, and Cristina gave us much more than we we expecting. The communication was great with our host. I highly recommend Cristina's place. You'll have a unique and exciting time there. Thank you very much Cristina for offering us a unique and adorable experience in your home.
Owners live right next to the place you are staying in. Smaller than pictures make out but tidy place.

What a great location ❤️ First of all Cristina and Lina were so kind and wonderful, perfect hosts. The place is beautiful, clean and cozy. The bed is very comfortable. And the highlight is definitly the pool and the view ❤️ We could swim in it in May. You have to watch the sunrise - so wonderful 😍 We only spent 2 days, vould have stayed longer. Communication and check-in was super easy. We can definitly recommend it👍

A very nice place away from the crowds but still a close drive to Porto and other coastal places such as Vila do Conde. Great to stay by the pool or take a trip around the area. Bakery and small supermarket in walking distance. Cristina is a great host, recommended!

This apartment is perfectly located in Porto. We were able to walk everywhere. The flat was immaculately clean and equipped with all comforts needed. Vitor, our host, was responsive, attentive and very helpful. We highly recommend this Airbnb.
Location was perfect! The place itself had everything we needed, super tidy and felt like at home! Would definitely stay again!
Perfect place to stay in Porto, you will not regret to book this place. Perfect for 4 persons.  Walkable to almost every place you want to visit in Porto.

Well located apartment, just a short walk to Livraria Lello. Lots of cafes and bars nearby. The apartment is fully spacious and fully equipped. Downside, no service elevator and located at the 2nd floor, but very minor compares to accessibility of the location.

Excellent location, several minutes walk from metro station. Close to many attractions of the city center. Clean appartment with a very clean bathroom and kitchen. Excellent communication with the owner. One of the best places I've ever stayed.
A well equipped apartment in an excellent location! Elisio was a great host, with very clear instructions and local recommendations for our trip. Would stay again!

We loved our stay here! Very close to public transit and popular Porto attractions like Livraria Lello. The place was clean, spacious, and exactly as described, and the hosts were incredibly helpful in letting us check in early. We would definitely stay here again!

Joao and Gustavo were very friendly, the apartment is very comfortable, well equipped, and very clean! Besides,they answered my questions very fast and I was delayed for my check out and they could support me with no issues! Totally recommend!
Enjoyed our stay. Nice place and Joao was very helpful in answering our questions when needed.

Small apartment with tiny beds. Great location near Bilbao Market and half mile from river front. A very noticeable smell (a mix of mildew and cleaning products), we had the windows open all day to help air it out. Nice to have access to laundry which we used daily.

The place is very clean and looks exactly like the pics. It’s very walkable to all the attractions. We only took Uber once. Other than that, we walked to all the places. There’s a supermarket a few min away from the apt. The apt is spacious for 4 people. The owner is very responsive to questions. The self Check in was very smooth. The only  cons: the beds are ok but not very comfortable and there’s only one set of towel for each guest. It would be great if we could get extra set. Anyway, we had a great stay!

We are a family of five, and this is definitely our favorite place in Portugal. Affordable price, clean, close to everything, great kitchen, comfortable beds, warm enough heater during the winter, and elevator! We are impressed! Everything is almost perfect, so we highly recommend any family of four or five consider here when they visit Porto!

João is such a great host and all the team at the hostel are super welcoming and helpful. The house is perfect to use as a remote working base whilst exploring Porto.  There is a lovely private garden that gets lots of sun, great aircon and the house is very well equipped and comfortable. The location is ideal with only a couple of minutes walk to a main train/metro/bus station with fast links to the airport. Lots of nice cafes and local restaurants in the neighbourhood too. Just an amazing experience!

My husband and I stayed an entire month at João's house. We took our 2 cats with us, and they simply loved the backyard!  The house is charming and super well located, we had everything we needed within just some minutes walking. The place is well-equipped, and the internet is good and stable, which was perfect for us since we worked from home.  Joao and his team are nice and very helpful, they were always ready to help. I would recommend the place for anyone staying longer, like us.
A very convenient place to stay in Porto. The Wifi speed was brilliant, and I appreciated the smart TV🤩.
The apartment was good 👍 the location is perfect and Marta was very helpful and answered at the time 😊
Super beautiful Airbnb, loved the character and the check in was easy and the place was spotless. She leaves plenty of recommendations and I would 100% stay here again.

We enjoyed our stay here.  The flat is in a great location, being just a five minute walk to the train station and really close to lots of great tourist attractions.  Whilst there is no air conditioning, the shutters on the windows help to keep the bedroom cool in the evening.  We struggled a lot with noise of the other flats - the building as a whole is old, which means you can hear creaky floorboards and footsteps of the flat above.  There is also a coffee machine, but no coffee pods.  There was also barely any toilet roll provided - so make sure you pack some.  On the whole we would recommend staying here, it’s worth the money!

Marta was very responsive and the place was clean. Place was located near the center (walkable). There is no AC (as described in the listing), however we recommend  more than 1 fan in the apartment- especially during the summer months.

Everything was perfect. Very spacious, enough rooms and bathrooms to house 16 people.  The bathrooms in the rooms were great but also the extra private bathrooms were perfect.  The apartment was also very clean and the beds were very comfortable. The location was key as it was only 20 to 30 minutes walking distance from any main attraction. I will definitely stay here again the next time I visit Porto.  Thank you very much we had a great time.

The Airbnb is a really nice place especially for larger groups. The area is central and perfect for the stay. Communication is very friendly and easy! Kitchen and living room space was very nice Thanks a lot

We really enjoyed being in the apartment, it is well located, the space is pleasant, large and well equipped, including the kitchen. It has an interior patio which on hot nights should be very pleasant. We had a stay of one month, for which only 2 cleanings were done, ideally they would have cleaning every week, for those with a child. Communication was always easy and they always responded to our requests promptly. We caught the first cold days after summer, but the air conditioning helped keep the house warm and pleasant. One of the rooms has a small infiltration in the corner, but nothing that bothers too much. There is the option of renting a garage, but we didn't think it was necessary, as you could find a place in the surroundings with some ease. Overall it was a good stay. Thank you!
Highly recommend! Clean, spacious, great light, great beds, all around perfect. Great communication with host,  everything was amazing.
It was so nice to stay with kids.   My family spends a pleasant vacation in a spacious and comfortable environment.  thank you💛
Great and stylish apartment  Interior is amazing  Next to the metro station  There is a nice cafe in front of the apartment  We enjoyed staying there would recommend for everyone

I really enjoyed my stay at the flat. The flat is bright and nicely decorated. The beds were comfy. Bomfim is a great neighborhood as you get the feeling that actual Tripeiros (people from Porto) still live there and not just tourists. There's a bakery across the street and a supermarket nearby. Metro station Heroísmo is visible from the flat and the bus 207, that leaves right next to the metro station, takes you to Foz do Douro (the mouth of the river Douro).  I arrived early, but Miguel and Ilze let me leave my luggage at the flat and so I could go for lunch without having to drag my suitcase around.  Highly recommended!

The location was ideal - - - We appreciated the short walk from the train station (no taxi required).  We were able to walk to the busy area where most attractions were; the river was a bit of a walk but we still managed it.  We spent three nights and could have easily stayed for a few more with so much to do in Porto - - - maybe next time.  Our hosts responded quickly to our questions and we would certainly stay there again.

We had a really pleasant stay at the apartment of Miguel&Ilze. The communication and the access/leaving was super easy, we could park our car for free. The apartment is brandnew, greatly equipped and super clean. Strongly recommended!
Nice and clean Airbnb. Good location to walk around. Friendly and very helpful with local recommendations and restaurants.  Would come back and stay at the next visit.
Perfect place to stay, we highly recommend. A lot of place to spend time together. Adriana was very helpful :)  The only thing is a nervous neighbor but it’s enough to don’t care about her :)
we had a wonderful stay at Adriana's place. Everyday there is something new and peculiar to find in the house. I would always recommend it.

A group of 7 of us stayed at Adriana’s for 5 days. The house was absolutely wonderful, and we loved exploring! Adriana was an extremely kind host, meeting us at the property and providing us with local recommendations of places to eat. It was an easy walk to the beach, and the Ubers to go to Porto city were very quick to come by. Overall a fantastic stay in an incredible house!!

This is such a lovely place in the hear of Porto. We had the pleasure of staying for an entire month. The photos do not do this place justice. It’s simply magical and beautiful. The views from the balcony alone are everything. The place is in a quiet neighborhood and close enough walking distance to everything in Porto. The bed is comfortable, and the place is equipped for both long and short term stays. Maria is an excellent host who was always available if we needed anything and provided great recommendations. We made friends with the elderly backyard neighbour and her dog who kindly gave us fresh vegetables and herbs from her garden. This place is situated between the tourist region and local places which is perfect for any getaway. Thanks again for a wonderful time.
The location, apartment and communication with Mariana was perfect. We would definitely recommend this beautiful apartment for everyone especially for people who love interior.
We had a wonderful stay at Mariana‘s apartment. It‘s well located and equipped and tastefully furnished. Mariana is a kind and helpful host. One of the best airbnbs we‘ve been so far.
Everything was perfect! The location is great and the appartement is clean and really nice!

Had the best stay at Mariana’s apartment! The apartment is beautiful and spacious. We loved sitting on the balcony. Mariana was a great host and accommodating to our early check in which we really appreciated. I’d recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Porto.
Beautiful apartment very close to the center of Porto. Comfortable and with great amenities. Host was helpful and responsive.

Unfortunately, the automatic ventilation which switches on from time to time is a little bit annoying. Besides that it‘s a beautiful and sunny apartment, nicely decorated and well equipped, with lovely details and a nice balcony. Really close to the historical city center.
Marianas place was great! Perfect for walking around Porto. Close to many cafes and restaurants. Very clean space and loved having the balcony!
This place was amazing! Loved the design of the apartment and it was so walkable to all the spots we wanted to see.

Beautiful apartment, well located for walking into the centre and to all the amenities. Loved the style of the space and was well equipped with lots of extras such as dishwasher and washing machine tabs. Would definitely recommend to friends and family visiting this fabulous city.

Such a lovely place to stay. Really well thought out, beautiful tall ceiling and original features. Clean and comfortable. Good communication. Location is good because it’s not too far from the main bridge (10 mins) to get to Gaia and also close to main restaurant area. Would definitely there stay again.
Beautiful apartment! Mariana was very responsive and understanding as we went past check out time a bit. Great experience
The apartment looked just like the pictures, location was very good and Mariana was always quick to respond.  The only thing we didn’t like was how hot it got inside.. but it’s august in Porto ;)
Beautiful apartment. Stunning space, excellent bathroom/shower and comfortable bed. Loved our stay at this place, would recommend!
Best airbnb ever Mariana is the loveliest woman and was very helpful with us  Will recommend my friends and family

This is a beautiful flat, with amazing views. Great place to hang out during our rainy stay in Porto. Mariana was very helpful and the washing machine was an added bonus.  Two small caveats: two floor up means four sets of stairs so be prepared. And the kitchen was not easy, mainly because we couldn’t figure out how to turn on the stove!  I would highly recommend a stay here.

Had a great stay, clean, tidy and spacious for a one bedroom place. Mariana was proactive on late checkin instructions and was very responsive. The place itself was a great location in walking distance from the city and other landmarks. The only issues were the wifi wasn’t connecting to our phones and only had one toilet roll for our four days stay. Overall would stay again if those issues were resolved.
Amazing place, great location, super clean and Mariana alway answered quick. I would recommend without a doubt !
So happy. This rental as so amazing. Close to everything. And I felt so safe. I will rent again. Thank you.
Such a wonderful experience, great location, high ceilings, very spacious. It’s even better than the photos. Marianna was very helpful, thank you! We’d love to come again

we had an absolutelu wonderful time during our stay. the apartment is so nice and right in the city. Easy to get to all the tourist spots but private and very comfortable. spotless and really modern apartment with a great view from the balcony

We had a wonderful stay at this property! Check in was very easy and communication was great. The property itself was decorated very well and was very clean! It was in a great location and would definitely recommend it to anyone thinking of visiting Porto!
Mariana’s place was a great base for our trip to Porto. The apartment is comfortable and really spacious. Check in/out was easy. The location is great for seeing all the sights. Would recommend!

The apartment is well located near downtown, has tons of options when it comes to restaurants, bars, and local attractions. Also has a great view of the city and the apartment in itself is beautiful, the distribution is perfect! I would totally recommend the stay for couples.
Absolutely a gold mine of a location, I love the terrace. It was clean and comfortable. Easy location to go out an explore locally. I would definitely come back.

a beautiful apartment located in the very center of the old town. the apartment has everything you need for living, and the view from the window is incredibly beautiful. the host is very communicative and answered all questions. thank you and we will definitely be back

yes yes yes. Really good accomodation on a short walking distance from the centre of Porto.  Communication: the hostess was really Swift to reply to all inquiried we had. Ussually within 15 minutes Arrival: we received detailed information how to get in the appartment  Cleaness: Appartment was sanitized and clean upon arrival.  Furthermore, the appartment contains all amineties you need for a short stay.
Great location, beautiful view and the most peaceful night. best sleep ever.  really enjoyed the view from the balcony.
Great place on the other side of the river, which is more touristy. Quiet, but still lots to do down the street.
We spent a few nice days at Diana's place. The apartment was comfortable and clean, the location was just great.  The balcony was especially charming. We had really great time in Porto

Great Place to stay, in the peaceful neighbourhood of Vila Nova de Gaia. Walking distance to the river and World of Wine. Diana was an excellent host, always available to address any issues/ answer our questions. Would definitely recommend!
This was such a great place to stay while visiting Porto! It is in a great location, with everything in walking distance. The balcony also provides great views of the city!!

Location is perfect! I’d stay again when I visit Porto. The only issue was the WiFi not working well as I do work remotely, and check in was pretty late in the day, But overall, the place was a great stay and very comfortable!

Great place, location and communication. Pedro was quick to reply to messages before and during the stay and very accommodating when it came to letting us leave our bags in the place for a few hours pist check out. Would stay again.

Very generously sized apartment in the center of the city, the location is brilliant! Lots of restaurants, bars, and things to see right at the doorstep. The apartment is furnished very nicely, and extremely comfortable. I would be very happy to stay again!

The apartment was very spacious and communication with the host easy. We could store our luggage before official check-in, so we did not have to carry it throughout the city. The appartment is located quite central, so you can reach anything in short time. We would recommend!
Nice and large apartment in a great spot in Porto. Easy to find and access. Clean. We had a pleasant time with our kids! Thank you!
Paula was great. She made sure we were comfortable and even helped us with all the covid situation.

It's a nice small studio for a couple of days, and the location is good for exploring Porto. I wouldn't necessary recommend this place for more than 2 persons, because there is very little space for eating and only 1 or 2 stools. I was hoping I could have watched local tv channels for some time (and eurovision) from tv, but you can literally watch only netflix there, and the wifi connection is quite choppy.
The appartment looks like on the pictures. It is very central and had all that we needed. Check-in and communication was very good!
Great location. Easy to walk from the city center. The place was quiet and had clear instructions for check-in. Warm place for the winter. Will be back if given the chance. Recommended.
My 3 friends and I stayed at this airbnb and loved it! Location is very central to anywhere you’d want to go in Porto!

Paula was responsive to any of our requests or questions.  Her place was clean and  well prepared for us. He beds are comfortable and the kitchen well equipped. The place is tiny but everything important is there. The plus is that is close to all tourist attractions. I recommend this accomodation and would stay here again.
Great position, and super close to the city centre, the apartment is small but perfect for a brief stay to explore the city
The location was perfect and close to everything ! I felt comfortable during my stay and the facilities were perfect for what I needed. I would recommend it to anyone !

The place is amazing for a short trip, cosy and so close to the city center that you will feel amazing after getting to know the city. There was even a complementary olive oil for us to cook, just truly amazing.

Great location and on the bottom floor with a window! Just one room with a fold out bed and bunk beds. Host was very responsive the only small fix would be the mold in the bathroom but otherwise very clean.
Cozy studio at a really good spot, close to everything you need, Paula responded quickly and was very helpfull, would go again!
Paula’s place was perfect for our weekend getaway to Porto! It was clean and very walkable to everything in Porto!
Great location, good value. We didn’t use the kitchen. Bed linens were nice and I loved the shower. Space is a little bit tight for 3 people.
A truly wonderful, modern and stylish place, right at the coastline of one of the most enjoyable beach towns in the Porto area! A perfect spot for a couple of relaxing days at the Atlantic.

The apartment is lovely and has everything you might need. Paula was very responsive and very flexible for check in and out. Train service is very good and there is a lovely pizza restaurant right beside it. There is lovely walks along the beach and dunes. Can also rent scooters & bikes through Bird app. Only suggestion we would make is to have more local information and maybe a map of where the local restaurants, cafes and bakeries are. We only found some of them in the last day by chance.

We had a lovely stay at Paula's place.  The accommodation was very good, right on the beach.  There were deck chairs and a place to eat outside.    Paula was very responsive and flexible for check in and out.   We would highly recommend.

We had a lovely stay at Paula’s. It was clean and looked just like the photos. Paula was excellent at responding to our enquiries.  The house is located right on the beach and is within walking distance to some lovely local restaurants and beach bars.  We even found a great Indian restaurant on the last night. We will definitely be back.
Raffael was a very friendly and helpful host. The service was great. We had a very lovely time in Porto.
We stayed for two nights. The Airbnb was in a great, central / walkable location. It did the trick for a short stay! Fairly basic apartment without many amenities.

Renata is a very kindly person and gave us clear instructions and recommendations about the city. The apartment was clean and cosy and also very good location to walk around the city. We recommend this place and will go back there for our next trip to Porto. Thank you, Renata!
Nice apartment with very nice location. The communication with the host was very great as well. Thank you!
Very clean and comfortable room.  Walking distance to many nice cafe and restaurant. Abit of uphill walking.

This apartment is everything we wanted. The location is 10 mins walking from every amazing spot in Porto. Maria is great and has been checking if everything was okay at all times. Everything was very clean and great communication. Totally recommend it for anyone wanting to come to Porto!!!

Very well placed and fully equiped apartment. Metro, shop and many tasty restaurants in the neighbourhood. 15 minutes walk from tourist attractions. Be carefull with the washing machine. Our clothes, after washing and drying programme (the lowest temperature available), shrinked and faded out a bit.
nice and clean appartamento. friendly host. I just could not sleep at all because of the noisy street

Great location! Perfect place for one or two,  just what you need if you want something cosy with everything close by (lots of restaurants for example). We had helpful advice from the lovely host, on what to do during or trip accompanied with a map. Would definitely recommend. :)

Great place to stay with our 1 year old.  Lift was convenient, kitchen well equipped and baby could crawl in circles to get his energy out.  Sousa was really helpful and the location made it easy to get to the river.  We could even get around relatively easily with the small pram which was a pleasant surprise.  Small supermarkets and lots of eating options close by.  Ended up using Bolt (local Uber), though no baby car seat options with any car transport services.  Really lovely little spot with a great use of space and tidy design.  Feels like a tiny house as opposed to an apartment.
+: nice apartment and very good location. -: bed is small. Overall: very good place for a short stay in Porto.

I cannot recommend this apartment enough! My partner and I stayed here for 3 nights and it suited us perfectly. The location is superb. The apartment is in walking distance to everything. There are lots of  great brunch places and restaurants within a 5 minute walk of the apartment. Literally everything you’d need/want is so close by. You are also provided with lockers to store your luggage after you check out which was so useful on our final day in Porto. Sousa is a very friendly, responsive and accommodating host. Sousa’s son gave us the warmest welcome on our first day. He provided us with a fantastic manual for navigating the city with all the best food and tourist recommendations. The perfect apartment for your stay in Porto!
Very nice apartment. Well located and everything was clean. Check-in was easy and very flexible. We just stayed for a couple of nights, but enjoyed the space.

great location! walking distance to bars and restaurants. also close to the metro, but i didn't need to use the metro as i was able to walk to all the touristy sights. apartment was clean and outside noise was very minimal. felt right at home here. host was very friendly and informative. would stay again if i came back to porto. 100% recommended!
Really good stay. Flat was clean and as advertised, and the location was fantastic. The in-person check in was appreciated as well, a nice touch.

We loved our stay. Perfect location, very clean and wonderful space that perfectly matched photos/description. Host was very responsive, accommodating, and helpful throughout. When visiting Porto again, will definitely book here again!
The place was perfect :)  Location very good to go anywhere.  Clean and cozy atmosphere was also nice. I will definitely choose the same airbnb if I come again to portugal!!
Good location, very nice host. Loud but understandably so, since it’s in a major city where they’re doing a lot of construction
nice apartment with great location, almost everything within main attractions is in walking distance, owners are nice and helpful
Our stay in Porto was perfect! The host was friendly, the apartment was clean, it suited our needs as a couple and was perfectly situated. We would definitely stay here again.

The place was exactly how we had seen on the photos. It was super clean and tidy. There were plates, cups, wine glasses and etc to cook and enjoy during the stay.  The apartment itself was quite and the location is 5-6 min walking to city center. There is a beautiful small balcony that you can watch the street from your bed.  Host and the team were helpful and kind! I believe I will rent the same place my next trip to Porto again!
Very nice place to stay in Porto! We loved the fact there was a washing machine for our clothes since we were traveling long term.

We stayed in this apartment for four days and it has everything we needed for the stay. Sousa wanted to welcome us himself so he was waiting for us at the apartment, was very nice and told us everything we needed to know about Porto. He was also really flexible with prior mail  communication. The apartment was super clean when we arrived. Another advantage I see is definitely the price and also the location. It’s very close to the historical centre and the restaurants and everything, so you don’t need to use public transport. We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment and hundred procent  recommend it!
The apartment had everything we needed, it was very close to the city centre and Sousa provided a very pleasant stay with lots of recommendations. Would definitely stay here again.

An amazing apartment in a great location with everything we needed. The apartment is really well laid out with everything you need and felt spacious despite its compact size. The windows and doors leading to the balcony (there is space for standing) let in huge amounts of light and are great to watch out on to the street below, especially during sunset. The location is ideal - it's close to the metro station so easy access to and from the airport, and once settled all the main sights and attractions of Porto are within walking distance. We enjoyed walking to the Bolhão Market in the mornings to get coffee and pastries for breakfast and then onto wherever we fancied in Porto. The lockers in the reception area were also really useful for storing luggage if you arrive early or need to store it in the afternoon. The host was amazing, giving great local recommendations. Would definitely stay here again if in Porto and would recommend it to anyone.

We had a great stay, Sousa was very helpful and responsive. The apartment is in a great location, can walk to most of the main attractions <15 mins. The building has an elevator and the apartment has air conditioning that works well. We had a very pleasant stay and would recommend!
The apartment was well located, close to buses and the subway, clean and as described. We also appreciated that there was a good water pressure in the shower. Thanks again Sousa!
The host was very proactive, very clear in his communication and had some very helpful tips. The house was clean and cosy. The location is pretty good as it is very central. Felt right at home.

I stayed Sousa’s place over a week and enjoyed it very much. The place is clean and neat with all amenities needed. The location is good within walking distance to main attractions. Sousa is always friendly and very responsive. Highly recommended Sousa’s place!!
Souza was an amazing host, always ready to help and super flexible. The venue is super cozy and is in an amazing location. Definitely recommend! 🙌
The room was super clean and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Its location was perfect, close to all the main sightseeing spots. Highly recommend for anyone visiting the area!

We had a really good time here! The flat is really nice and clean and the kitchen is fully equipped with everything. It is very close to the public transport, but you can find a lot of good restaurants in the very close neighborhood too.

Sousa and his son were amazing hosts! The  check-in was smooth with his son coming down to facilitate the entire process. I loved that they created a personalised guidebook for Porto and the neighbour the airbnb was located in. Overall, an wonderful and pleasant stay - would definitely recommend it!

This Airbnb was the best I’ve stayed at. Sousa was so responsive and helpful. The place was clean and filled with the amenities needed. It was in the perfect location for walking and seeing everything. There were amazing restaurants around and Sousa gave us so many recommendations! It was amazing. If I come back to Porto I would love to stay here again!!

Our stay was absolutely perfect! ☺️The location couldn’t be better , everything is close by and there’s so much to do in the area. The apartment is exactly like the photos, beautifully clean and fully equipped with everything you could possibly need. The host was extremely kind, very responsive, and explained everything clearly and in great detail. I would 100% recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto!

The apartment was newly and thoughtfully renovated. Huge windows, lots of natural light. Not too noisy despite being central. Location is great,  in the heart of the city - everything is walkable. Sousa, the host, was very responsive and a pleasure to communicate with. I would definitely stay here again! :)

We had a lovely time staying in this beautiful getaway in the city. We felt like we could have been nestled somewhere in the countryside. The hut was well designed and felt really cozy. All in all, we had a super time and would recommend faux sho. Thanks João + Achilleas
The cottage was clean and comfy and yet very stylish. The mattress was very soft and the bed big enough to sleep two people. We enjoyed our stay and would have loved to stay a bit longer.
It was exactly like the pictures. Perfect for a relaxing vacation in Porto. We would go again.

We had a lovely stay here in Porto - I would highly recommend! This a lovely, secluded area, just minutes away from the city and it proved to be a great escape from the business of the city. The hut had everything we wanted and more and I hope to stay here again soon.

Amazing place, everything was clean and maintained well. The place was beautiful and matched the photos which is a plus. We noticed that the remote didn't have any batteries therefore we could not use the tv. I texted the host and he provided the batteries very fast and it was late at night. Totally worth the investment, strongly recommend. Thank you for the lovely reception!
Great stay! It was a very cozy and nice place. It was well located and we could walk everywhere! We would definitely recommend and come back.
Good location, the tapas restaurant nearby is the best, it’s quiet even located on busy street.
Very clean and good located apartment. Communication very fast and easy. Checking very friendly and uncomplicated. Thank you so much!
A perfect location for touring Porto.  Very comfortable and clean apartment that is a great value as well!

This apartment was amazing, we stayed at a sister location 3 years ago and loved it as well. This apartment is not only located centrally to almost everything but it is very spacious and perfect for a family with kids. It's kept very clean, maintained extremely well and has all the amenities needed to make a trip to porto just perfect.

Great neighborhood and the windows really kept out the street noise. The bed was comfortable and large. No ac that we could find but we really didn’t need it. The decor was exactly as shown in the photos.
Very clean, comfortable and perfect location only two blocks from the river. Communication and check in were smooth. Loved it!

We recommend Old Stone. They are very responsive and great hosts. The location was perfect and the apartment provided everything we needed. The only reason this review is a 4 instead of 5 is due to a water issue in the bathroom. There was water coming up from the tile floor. We thought it might have been leaked from the shower door by the previous tenant or the cleaner, but it became clear they have a maintenance issue. We stayed there for 5 days, being very careful to not let water out of the door area, and yet the water still came up from the tile floor when you step on it.

Really enjoyed our stay, it was super relaxing. Once you close all the windows shutters and the bedroom glass door, it was very quiet. The apartment was really clean. Super location, in the heart of everything.

Fabulous location, great spacious apartment. Would definitely recommend! Only drawback is no A/C and street below can be noisy with cars and late at night with people walking out of bars and restaurants. But that’s a big city for you!
Great and tastefully furnished apartment in the centre of Porto‘s old town. Kind and very responsive host. Recommended!
Great apartment; larger than what the photos show; and perfect location, and I mean, perfect for Porto!

We had an amazing stay!  The apartment is spacious and has everything you could need for a short stay.  It was super clean and well-designed and the instructions made it easy to find and a breeze to check-in!  The location is superb and we would definitely stay here again!
Great place and very close to the metro. I was met by Vitor, a very friendly guy and gave me loads of tips of how to enjoy my holiday
Very helpful hosts, convenient location and nice to have a refreshing dip in the small pool in the garden, especially for the children .

So beautiful home, easy self check in and check out. Full equipped kitchen. Amazing fireplace is a cherry on the top! We enjoyed this place, many thanks ☺️ I wanna add just one note that it might be not easy to take a taxi from there)
Locals were great from nearby futbol match, to small and large grocery markets, numerous coffee gathering or grab and go, restaurants either typical foods and courtesy.

We had the 2nd and 3rd floors of this building, which was perfect for our 2 families.  It is spacious, tastefully decorated, and has plenty of beds for everyone.  It is conveniently located next to a little shop for staples and close to a bakery.  It's 5-minute walk to the train station (and a good pizza/beer/wine restaurant) for a direct ride into Porto and a 5-minute walk to the beach for beautiful, long walks in either direction on the boardwalk.  Rui gave us many ideas for activities and restaurants before we arrived to help with our planning, he met us at the house upon our arrival, and kept in contact throughout our stay.  This is a great house for a big group of friends and family!

Fantastic huge place. Great location. Rui is very very helpful and communicative. He met us there and introduced us to the house. Short train to Porto.  Very breezy and cool near water. Highly recommend.

The house is quite big and perfect to hang out and chill with friends. The terrace with ice machine is perfect! The location is OK, the trains are slow to Porto but Ubers are well available and not too expensive.

Me and my 15 friends had a great time in the beachhouse. Especially the host we would like to thank for his hospitality and help, he really wanted the best for us. The house is very beautiful and spacious and well located: close to the cute trainstation Granja. We would for sure recommend this place!

We had a brilliant stay at this beautiful apartment. We were a large hen do and the apartment for us perfectly. The terrace was a perfect place for us all to be together and have a few drinks before going out.  It is in a great location, very close to the beach. The centre of Porto is easily accessible using an Uber.  Rui was a great host, easily available and responded quickly to any questions. Would definitely recommend.

We (group of 11) visited from the UK and stayed at the Migranja Beach House for 3 nights. The beach house was immaculately presented; had all the mod cons you could need (including a fab top floor bar area with an honesty box); and is within easy reach of local beaches and Porto. Rui was the perfect host, who gave us helpful information before and during our stay, including recommendations on cocktail places and restaurants. 10/10 and we would highly recommend this place to others. Thank you for an excellent stay!
Great hosts. Vera and Rui were very responsive and flexible with us. They made sure we had everything we needed for an enjoyable stay. Thank you.

We had a brilliant time, the air b&b was perfect for purpose of our visit ( group of 11 girls ). Lots of space & lovely bedrooms, the party room upstairs was perfect for our evenings. Very close to the beach and also easy and not too far from Porto city centre. We loved it. Rui & Val were very helpful & friendly, responsive & easy to communicate with :)
We had a wonderful stay here! Everything was super clean, Goncalo and Gabriela were ver responsive and super helpful. A lovely place, easy to get around by the nearby metro!
A great place to stay, simple with everything that you need! It is close to the Metro which makes getting into the city super easy. The hosts were very responsive and communication was great 😊

Jonathan greeted us upon check-in. He was very nice and helpful. Explained the security key pads, pool and apartment rules and showed us items within the condo. The condo was small but was just what we needed. Beds were comfy and pool was great. They even gifted us a nice bottle of wine as a welcome gift! It was a short walk to the metro station and easy to manage into the city center. For the price, it was perfect. Off season, it may be easier to stay closer into town so you don’t have to take the metro back and forth, but we were on a budget. Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Incredible! The views were amazing and the house was so cozy. Will definitely be going back again.

I was there for a month and this was one of the best apartments I've stayed in with Airbnb. All the appliances were top quality and seemed brand new. The AC works well and the TV is particularly huge and set up perfectly to watch from the bed. There were a few small issues during my stay, but these were all resolved quickly and professionally. My only gripe would be the sound of footsteps coming from the apartment above. I was particularly aware every time my upstairs neighbour started moving around.
This comfortable studio is well located just up the hill from the Trinidade metro and is easily walkable.

This flat really helped make our trip great!  The flat itself was clean, stylish, and convenient. It perfectly matched our needs.  The area was fantastic, as soon as you step out you’re surrounded by great little businesses and you’re only a short walk to centre. Perfect little base for our time in Porto. I would definitely recommend!
It’s a great place to stay very near to Trindade Station and São Bento as well.  The place is amazing safe and secure.

Ana Cristina's place was perfect for our visit to Porto! The apartment is in an amazing location right on one of the main pedestrian streets, and is close to all of the sights we were hoping to see. The apartment itself was also very spacious and had everything we needed for our stay. The highlight was the balcony overlooking the lively street below where there was often live music being played (a double set of doors made the apartment absolutely silent at night though, which gave us the best of both worlds). The hosts were super helpful during check-in, provided a number of recommendations, and were quick to reply when we had questions. Would absolutely recommend staying here if you're planning to visit the city, and hopefully may be back ourselves!

In the heart of it all!  Prime location, and a spacious place with a balcony designed for people watching and listening to sounds of the street.  Special note - the blackout curtains were so dark, I felt like I was in a cave...PERFECT.  The soundproofing is also excellent with the double doors system.  Internet worked great for work meetings.  Friendly and kind hosts.  Thank you!

The apartment is really well situated and spacious. I traveled with a friend and we were both delighted with our rooms. We found everything we need and the place was quiet. I strongly recommend this apartment.
Great hosts, very thoughtful, communication was seamless. The apartment is charming, exactly as described, and the location is perfect, very central. I definitely recommend.
The apartment is very convenient, well located, super clean and spacious. Ana and João made our arrival easy and comfortable. The apartment is a bit darker than it looks but still very pretty
Ana and Joao were so accommodating. It was a fantastic location with everything you need for an amazing trip!
We had a great stay in Ana‘s & Joao‘s flat. The flat is very clean and has very central location where you can easily walk to all the main sights in Porto. Thank you very much, Ana & Joao!
Joâo was great from the beginning. He was reactive, patient and friendly.  The place is lovely, perfectly located and easy to find.

Ana & Joao’s space was wonderful. The space was very modern & very clean. It was easy to walk everywhere. There are some nice restaurants & coffee shops right in the neighborhood. Also, they left us some port wine & cookies- a great special touch.  They were also very responsive.  I would definitely stay here again & recommend it to others.

Great place, walking distance to many restaurants, markets, and places to visit during your stay. Place was well kept, and clean. Check in was easy and an elevator is available if you have luggage that you need to take up to 2nd floor.
My family and I loved staying here. Ana and Joao’s attention to detail and lovely decoration made us feel at home. I am looking forward to staying here again.
This is a great little apartment right in the centre of Porto. Everything was walkable and the apartment was lovely and quiet.

The apartment is on a great location, on walking distance to some of the main attractions and the train station. Clean and spacious apartment, and the communication with the hosts was very easy and fast

The apartment is very well located and close to most places. It was as described and the stay was very comfortable. The hosts were responsive and accommodating. Recommend Ana and Joao’s place to anyone looking to stay in the heart of Porto.

Nice place close to everything. We have used our feet every day and had no need for taxi to see shoppingstreets, sight or restaurant. The appartment is just a few meters walking from a grocery store and it’s a laundry next to the enterance if you would like that. The pictures are not lying of the look of the appartment
It was a great stay and we enjoyed the apartment and Porto a lot. A perfect spot for weekend trip! Thanks.

We really enjoyed our stay at the apartment. We were 2 friends travelling and the 2 bedrooms were both a good size. There was plenty of space in the living room kitchen area. The hosts were great. So quick to respond to any questions we had. Overall a great stay- I would happily stay here again.
Nice appartement on the 2nd floor with elevator. Next to most attractions and activities in Porto. Communication with the owner was very nice and the check-in very welcoming :)
Ana & João’s place was wonderful. We had a great time in Porto, the location was lovely super easy to walk everywhere.
The apartment is well placed ! Near the dock, monuments and restaurants, we did everything by foot ! The flat is fully equipped with TV, Wifi and modern design. I felt home !

Excellent location right in the center of the city, all attractions in walking distance. Even though a pedestrian street with street musicians and cafés and bars, noise was not a problem. The apartment is exactly like on the pictures, very charming, clean, and with a comfortable bed and sofa. We can recommend the apartment without hesitation, it was a pleasure to visit!
The location is AMAZING. Truly the best spot in town. And the apartment is so cute and well laid out.
Great central location, accessible on foot (you can park nearby if you have a car). Enjoyed the musicians on the street from our window.
Well equipped and so centrally located!  Easy walking to all the sites. Apartment is just as described, we enjoyed our stay.
Phenomenal location, you get to experience live music from your window all day. Walkable to everything !
We had a pleasant stay at Marcia's apartment.  It is centrally located, small but quaint, clean, and communication with check in and check out was a breeze.  Thank you.

Very nice and renovated apartment in the heart of Porto. Márcia was helpful and responsive and the stay was perfect. The apartment is in Rua das Flores, a busy and lively street. There's usually someone playing music in the street in front of the apartment but by 11PM they stop and the street is quiet.

We had a lovely stay in Porto thanks to Márcia - very quick responses throughout, kept in touch to make sure we had everything we needed and gave a list of recommendations on places to see and eat. The apartment was exactly what we wanted - its a busy street and there are plenty of buskers but all were finished by or before 11pm, and all very talented! The window seat is a perfect spot for a coffee with a view. Perfectly located - would highly recommend!

Overall the stay was nice and comfortable. Easy to check in and out. The entry hallway is very clean. The bench at the window is a nice place to drink and look outside. Like in the description it can get a little bit loud at night, would recommend using sleeping earplugs if you’re a light sleeper.
Marcia’s apartment was really lovely. The apartment is in a great location for exploring beautiful Porto but as it is facing on to the street you wont get a good nights sleep unfortunately.
Márcia’s apartment is a nice studio on a great street in the heart of Porto. It was very convenient and we had a great stay!
Perfectly located in the prettiest street of Porto! This apartment is very nice and comfortable. Autonomous entry was super simple.
Great location in Porto! On a main street right by restaurants and the train station. The place looked exactly like the pictures and was clean and comfortable for our short stay in Porto.

This location was so ideal for exploring Porto! It was very central and convenient while also being clean and charming on the inside! I loved the window overlooking the beautiful Rua das Flores and hearing the music from the street!!

Lovely stay, great location and great communication…it would have been better to have a/c due to the heat. There were fans provided but unfortunately did little to cool down the apartment even with the windows open…It was a lovely apartment and I should’ve have been more attentive on weather or not it had a/c…my fault. Other than missing a/c it’s a perfect place to stay…thank you.

This host was super friendly, flexible, and easy to communicate with. The location is great, right next to a main train/metro station. The rooms were spotless and we felt right at home. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a great place to stay!
Perfect apartament with great windows and natural light all day, very cozy, silent by the night and a walk in location to every corner of the city ❤️

We stayed at Marta's place for 4 nights and it was very nice: the apartment is perfectly located in the very center of Porto, but in rather quiet part of it. It has everything needed to make one's stay as comfortable as possible. We enjoyed it a lot, so thank you!

The flat is very well furnished and has nearly everything in the kitchen like home , in case you wanna cook some days- I was able to do every morning pancakes for my daughter , cause there is also a hand mixer :). I also appreciated  , that we had 2 rooms to sleep as mother and daughter traveling .  It was calm by night and within a 20 minutes walk by foot we reached a lot of tourist spots in the town. We didn‘t get to know Marta personally, but she sended us instructions for log in and answered questions fast and friendly. I would recommend a stay in her flat - it is a beautiful , well thought and structured flat , where you feel easily  cosy and like home.

Very nice place to stay in Porto. It's clean, tidy and fresh. Easy to park as well if you're travelling by car. The host is very kind and quick to answer. Instructions to check in were very clear too. Highly recommended
Great spot to stay for the price. The metro is nearby which is easily accessible to everything downtown but have the peace of being in a quite neighborhood.
Francisco’s place was perfect for my partner and I. It was very clean and modern. It was a close walk to the subway to get into Porto. Would recommend.
Modern flat, very clean and organised. double glazed windows . Price and quality was fair . Host always communicative and attentive. I strongly recommend this property.
Space very clean, organized and comfortable. Location is pretty good, and we can get anywhere at ease. Will for sure be back again!!
Even though we booked last minute, it was very easy to find, they were always quick to reply and we had a lovely stay. We deeply recommend this place and the host.

Silver Duque was a great place to stay during my week long trip in Porto. It’s in a very convenient area, close to multiple bus lines, metro stations, cafes and restaurants. But without being in the middle of a super crowded area which I appreciate. The view from the balcony is beautiful, and the apartment itself felt comfortable and spacious. The building was also pretty quiet during my stay. The laundromat next door is also very convenient, and the cat cafe a block away is a hands down the best I’ve been too.

Great stay. The perfect house with the perfect service. We did a last minute booking and everything went smooth. Everything was very clean and the communication was perfect. Great check in experience. Highly recommended
Very cut flat, well located (10 minutes walk from the city center and next to a metro station), very luminous et well decorated. We had a very nice moment there ! I recommend it !
Very nice place, just the right size for a couple and a nice location. Very clean and a nice touch with a welcome bottle of wine. We would recommend this place.
Great Location, very modern and very close to the City Center. We could do everything by walking. Very friendly and fast Communication and Easy Check-in and Check-out. We would come back!
Flat was clean and in good condition. The location is ok but a bit north so you have to walk a few minutes to get to the city centre. Overall we had a nice stay

We loved to stay at this apartment. The location is great as it’s not far away from the city center. The interior is nice and the bed comfortable. The only thing you have to keep in mind is that you might to get to the welcome center first to get your keys or someone will bring it to you for a fee of 10€ I think. We really love Porto and we would definitely book this apartment again. We would recommend the local restaurant downstairs where you get a good meal for a cheap price!!
Cute, well located a 5-minute walk from Trindade station. Perfect for a week of working remotely, wifi was good, and the apartment was quiet during the work day.

This place is ideal for a 1 max 2 person. The place itself is quite spacious and has all the amenities you need, you’ll fell right at home. I would recommend this place for anyone who wants to visit Porto. The location is spectacular just a 10 min walk to all the attractive locations. The host was super responsive

This was my first airbnb with no contact, but everything went very smoothly. The apartment was just as described in the pictures and easy to access. The location is very good with many things to explore/visit within a short walk. Very responsive to the few questions we had. I would definitely stay there again next time I am in Porto.
This was a great apartment! Right next to the Trindade station and an easy 10min walk to all the tourist zones. It was clean, very cool, and easy to check in to.
The studio looks exactly like in the picture. Located more o less 15 min walking to the historic center of Porto but closer to other main streets.

Overall it was a great location and good stay but the shower had an extremely small amount of hot water. If one person took a 10 min shower there was no hot water left for anyone else. This unit needs a bigger hot water tank as three people would not be able to all shower. The bed sheets had some staining. Overall it could have been cleaned a bit more but generally speaking I would still recommend for a quick stay in Porto.

We loved our stay! The location cannot be beat - close to all the action and the Balhao Market and the rooftop balcony view was insanely beautiful. We really enjoyed having our breakfasts out there. There was AC which was great too. Recommend for an affordable stay in the heart of Porto!

A beautiful apartment at an amazing location! I would definitely recommend it to anyone. The apartment was super clean and cosy. Joana was really helpful and there was always fast communication. All the nice restaurants/shops/spots were at walking distance.

Joana's apartment is truly great, and right at the heart of the city. From the bathrobes and slippers, to communication, to personal recommendations from the hosts, everything was perfect. Definitely will be the first place to check once we're back in Porto :)

What can I say, great little apartment in the best location with knowledgeable sweet host. Everything was perfect and all their recommendations were spot on. thanks guys ( oops am I still allowed to say that? 😂 Don’t forget to do Douro Valley with Timur

Exceptionally quiet, great bed linens and terrific location with responsive hosts. Most of what you’d need. Quite small, and lacking enough table space for spreading out your bags/suitcase or for putting out your bathroom items when there are two of you. Arrival was stressful with a rental car since streets  surrounding the apartment are extremely narrow, steep and choked with people, and there is really no street parking. Expect to pay for the parking garage at about 30 euros  per day. Our hosts were fairly responsive regarding things we needed like more toilet paper or a bath mat.

loved our stay. We felt immediately at home here. All the amenities were exactly as described. The street this is on is very busy in foot traffic - make sure you're aware of coming in by Taxi/Bolt. Very hard to get taxi/Bolt ON the street, had to walk a few streets away which was fine once we realized why the Bolts could never find us. Very centrally located. Would totally stay here again.

This location is perfect. Your own personal oasis. Located on a central and busy street but with large windows/doors to an inner courtyard which had a small balcony and great natural light. A small grocery store is just a short walk away if you want to cook a meal, but if you want to go out, there are many options for restaurants.

Joanna’s place was amazing! It looked exactly like the pictures! It was very clean and in a perfect location! It was very quiet and comfortable. I would definitely stay here again.  When we needed extra supplies she was very accommodating. We also needed to extend our stay by one day and Joanna made it easy to do this. Tara
Great location in Porto - very close to all the tourist action. Quiet inside the apartment building and very secure.
Perfect apartment in the perfect location and some great restaurant recommendations from Filipe. Thank you so much!
A bit noisy at night but orherwise perfect, the location is excelent, easy checkin, private parking right across the street. I would stay there again.

The apartment was clean and well equipped- only a 10 minute walk from the centre. The only downside was noise from upstairs (you can hear other guests walking around) which was a bit disruptive at night. Otherwise a great stay.

Great location for price and only about 5-10mins walk from most things. Check in was easy, stress-free and well communicated. The room was comfortable and a perfect size for 2 people. Everything was clean and looked after well. We were really pleased with this place!! We would give this place 5 stars however we had an unfortunate guest above us who was very loud and the ceiling/floors are quite thin which meant we were kept up most of the night. Don't believe this is the fault of the place however and just bad luck for us.
Spacious apartment right next to the river, easy access to the main water front area. Filipe was very communicative and helpful too!

The apartment is fantastic. The location is perfect for exploring the city, with great views out across the river. Enjoy watching the trams pass by while enjoying a coffee from the café just below. One of the best places we’ve ever stayed. Thank you Filipe for making our week in Porto unforgettable!

This place is very close to the city centre, has safe parking available just around the corner and also a decent view from the balcony. In terms of the home, it’s really spacious and very clean. I really enjoyed my stay here
Everything went well. The location is very good. The host was very responsive and helpful.
It was a fairly decent spot. A little outside of the city center but a great place for accommodation.

Thoughtfully planned and charming place with an incredible view over the city. Caring and charming owners with a passion for hospitality. This is easily the highest ranked recommendation I can give up to this date.

Lovely new hotel, really attentive hosting- great breakfast! Fun design and architecture. Late at night the neighbourhood can feel a little unsafe if you're a woman alone, but I don't think there's any real risk- I was fine.
This was such a great location! Super central to everything. Five of us stayed and the apartment was plenty big! Air conditioning in every room. Hosts we very quick to respond and very helpful!

Wonderful apartment for our group, well located and spacious.  Alex who managed our check-in was incredibly helpful and friendly. While we didn't need any recommendations for this trip he had so many to share if needed.  We would definitely visit again

The unit was very clean and comfortable and our group of five loved our stay here! Great location as it was only about a 15-30 minute walk to all the places we wanted to go to and easy to Uber to and from for further destinations like the beach. Management was very friendly and responsive - we had some confusion in communication with getting a van to the airport but that was the only mixup. Would definitely stay here again next time we’re in Porto!

Nice apartment in the center of Porto. The spaces may not be as wide as you expect from the photos if you are in more than 5 people, but still enough to enjoy the stay and all the comfort you need for an holiday in Porto.
Perfect location for anyone looking to stay in the centre of Porto.  Beautiful apartment that looks exactly like the pictures.  Check in was seamless and would definitely stay again!

I can definitely recommend staying at this apartment to anyone. The location was great, it was pretty close to all of the city's main points. The apartment was clean, well-equiped and had a nice common space where we could all spend time together on comfortable couch. Our hosts communicated with us on a timely basis, they agreed for us to leave our baggage earlier which was really helpful. Moreover the person who welcomed us gave us a lot of useful tips on what to see in the city, where to eat and so on. Nothing to complain about :)

This space was excellent for our group of 5. Close to everything we needed allowing us to walk places. Maria was so helpful at check in, giving us fantastic suggestions and even booking a manicure for me! So wonderful 😄 I would definitely book with ORM the next time we come to Porto.

The place is in a great location, very close, and walkable to everything. This is a commercial area. The place is excellent, with a lot space. The host was easy to communicate with and very response when we had some issues (hot water) and found a solution right away. One day we ordered the breakfast option from a local vendor, which was terrific. Just note that this place is a third-floor walk-up (it feels like five floors), and it may be hard to go if you have heavy pieces of luggage.
Great spot with nice little bakeries nearby for a coffee and pastry. very friendly and helpful host with great local recommendations.
The place is comfortable and big enough for 5-7 people easily, great location near every big landmark. Friendly hosts. Overall really good stay!!
The AirBNB was lovely. The only complaint we had was that both the bathrooms had an awful smell, particularly the down stairs one. Other than that, superb place to stay!
Amazing apartment, highly recommend for a group trip. Perfect location and the host were super helpful with any questions. They also helped us with airport transfers!

The major downside of this rental is the horrible smell coming from the downstairs bathroom. The smell made 1 of 2 of the bathrooms completely unusable and for a group of 6 people, this made our stay less comfortable & not ideal. The host was responsive and they did come by to do an extra clean of the bathroom & hang air-freshens. Ultimately, it did not help and we ended up keeping that bathroom door closed all week. Additionally, the host does not offer free extra towels which was inconvenient for a week-long stay. Otherwise, the rooms were comfortable and the location was ideal.

Absolutely perfect location - very close to the water and many restaurants.  Excellent views from the living room and all modern interior!  It was perfect for the 3 of us!  One word of warning - there are a lot of stairs so if you have bad knees you might have a hard time (but we loved it)!
The location is super good, close to the port , we were able to walk everywhere. The apartment is clean and tidy. Host were kind and informative! Had a pleasant stay in Porto
Prime location, very close to the metro and the park with gorgeous view :) very fast communication with the host, overall I’d recommend
Not recommended at all.. the room was so tiny and not up to the mark as showing in the pictures and they charged you for unacceptable things 0 out of 10

The apartment was everything I wanted. So beautifuly designed and well-equiped, with perfect location, literally 10 minutes to everywhere. Wish I could move there :) Elena was a wonderful host, she made me feel welcome.  Looking forward to my next visit.
