A cozy apartment with everything you need to visit Oporto. The location is perfect and the communication with Elena and Alexander so worm. 100% recomended!

The appartment is in the center of Porto close to Ponte Luis I. It is pretty small, but has everything you need. The kitchen is well equipped if you want to cook for two people. Unfortunately the seagulls are very loud, because they are sitting on the roof directly on top, so we have been woken up by them everyday at sunrise.

Lovely studio,perfect for couples or solo travellers wanting to experience a few days in Porto. Comfortable bed and great shower. Excellent location but you need to be fit for all the walking and the steep hills! Had a great time here and would recommend.
Great location on a quiet street, perfect place to stay in Porto with everything you need. Checkin and out was also super easy.
Apartment was small but so cozy! Just a short walk from a lot of the city’s main attractions including the Luís I bridge.

this was overall a great stay! super close to city center and very modern with all appliances you would need for your stay! there were some minor things that needed to be cleaned before we got there, but it was nothing major that ruined our trip! highly recommend this airbnb for couples or single travelers! :)
I was a great time in Porto! This flat is perfect for 2 people and Elena was very helpful

Our stay with Elena went excellently, I highly recommend to anyone. As fellow Airbnb Superhosts, we understand the work that needs to be done, to make a guest feel right at home. Her attention to detail, to the needs of her guests, is nothing short of amazing. Everything we needed was already there, amenities extra linens, towels, you name it. Amazing location as well, beautiful natural lighting… Elena, our stay with you has inspired many ideas in us for own apartments. I thank you for your hospitality. Ali from Casas do Olival.

Delightful well thought out Full Bedroomed 3rd  floor studio in fully renovated building on Rua Sol in between Majestic Cafe and Sao Bento Train Station(take Historical District exit from underground). Elena was always there for questions. Superb Shower with cosy bed. Seagulls add a certain charm to life in this beautiful city.
Great location, clean flat and helpful host! Very clear instructions for checkin and checkout and very helpful
Lovely loft apartment in a central location - a great spot from which to explore the City on foot
We had a very lovely stay in the apartment, very good for getting uptown or downtown.  Easy to find and everything you could need for a short stay.
The accommodation was clean and very cozy. Excellent for short trips. The accommodation was in the city center. Communication with Elena was excellent. I recommend this accommodation
Amazing stay, everything was as described. Location was extremely accessible to the center and other attractions. Will recommend this place to others :)

This apartment is in the perfect location. We walked all the way around Porto from here- including an hour walk to the beach! There are so many great restaurants nearby and we were able to sight see the whole city super locally.  It’s on the top floor so you can hear the seagulls pretty loudly, but that’s just a Porto experience! We were so bummed to leave. I loved this stay.

Centric located beautiful apartment. It was a bit smaller than it looked on the photos, but it was absolutely perfect. I loved the super high ceiling a the attic windows. Also the host was very nice and helpful.

Our stay was perfect, the apartment looks exactly like the photos, it’s really clean and functional.  It’s really close to beautiful touristic areas! Overall we really recommend coming to Oporto and staying in this flat!

By far the best place I’ve ever stayed via AirB&B. The welcome was very personal and kind. The room and all others above expectation. Big, clean, with all another identity. The garden a quiet spot in a vibrant city. The staff without exception friendly, accurate and helpful. The breakfast lovely and complete. So I will definitely be back, when in Porto. Thanks to an excellent team… Rob
The hotel is a beautiful, characterful place, close to the centre of Porto, with very kind and courteous staff.

Hey - I just don't know what to say - the Casa Antiga is amazing. Everybody was so kind, so lovely to us. I've never seen such a beautiful designed room and atmosphere. Thank you very much for your time. We definitely come back to Porto and we will never stay at another place again. All the best and see you soon - Felix
The location of Antica is fantastic- an area of Porto I hadn’t explored before and I found some new favourite spots. The Airbnb itself was a calm oasis and the staff very friendly and welcoming.

Had an amazing stay at Joao’s apartment in Porto. Joao was very clear in communication and gave us tips on what to do and made sure that everything was in order! The apartment was near the river so walking distance of everything. Would definitely recommend!

The location is perfect and the house too. Perhaps the wifi is a little slow, so keep it in mind if you’re working. But apart from that everything is good and there are tons of appliances if you need/want to cook

Joao’s place was exactly as you see it in pics! The shower was the best! Great pressure and hot water! The location was perfect to visit Porto. The bedroom was quite comfortable with lots of closets. Wifi worked perfectly.
We enjoyed the time at Joao's apartment. The apartment is cosy, clean and includes everything you need.
Great location, good space, good host. communicates well. Some of the neighbors might be a little intolerant to tourists. Overall though, not a bad experience.

This place has an awesome location! Overall we really enjoyed our stay. The place is clean, updated, and had nice amenities. The wifi was a little spotty and slow, and there was loud construction going on nearby, but overall we liked the place and had a great stay.

A great, clean, central, and comfortable stay! João was a responsive and proactive host. Made our Porto trip better than what we could have asked for.  Also appreciated the Nespresso, (we brought some pods), toaster,  and electric kettle which made mornings easier before setting out for the day.

We had a great time in Joao's apartment, which is in a perfect point to visit the city! The bed was very comfortable and the host was really kind and helpful: when I asked for one more towel, he immediately answered and provided one the day after! Just one little thing, be careful about taking long showers because hot water doesn't last too long. I would recommend this place to anyone and I already miss the beautiful Porto! Thank you Joao once again :)
Clean, easy to locate with great check in instructions. Host was over communicative but provided good recommendations for local restaurants. We enjoyed our stay in Porto and would stay here again.
Great location, Joao was very accommodating with his help & understanding. The places was clean. Excellent location!
Incredible stay at Claudia’s place in Porto. Centrally located with great amenities! Would highly recommend!!
Gorgeous and super clean apartment in the center of Porto. The building is newly renovated, next to really good shops and restaurants. I would definitely go back! Great choice for a couple!!!
The apartment was just adorable!  Very clean and nicely done.  Access to the building and the apartment was also very easy.  We would certainly stay again.
the cinema luxury house was perfect, exactly as described and Claudia was really great with communication. ideal location, can't recommend enough!
We were very impressed with the apartment and the service we got from Claudia. Will definitely be back.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Claudia’s apartment. It has an excellent location and most of all, comfortable beds and air conditioning, which was a big plus for the hot summer days in Porto. Also, despite its busy location, it was very peaceful and quiet in the apartment. Communication was superb!

Well located, nicely designed, super clean, great communication and check in, parking solution within 3 minutes walk. All lovely…The only cons: not much space for suitcase… still we will come back without a doubt!
A great little gem - perfect location, the view of the church from the apartment was a lovely surprise, and the host has excellent communication and attention to detail. Would definitely stay again.
Claudia is a very friendly host. She gave us some nice recommendations . The appartment is well located. We would recomend this air b&b.

Claudia’s apartment was very clean. The use of the space is very clever.  Yes you have to climb a ladder to get to the loft bed and yes you have to crouch down, and can’t stand up straight but the bed was very comfortable and we were glad to have two separate spaces. Since I didn’t spend much time up there except to sleep and change, it was fine. Mariana was very helpful. Great location, quiet street, checking in and out was a breeze. I would stay here again
This was a great place to stay! Great location and clean and well maintained .  The loft bedroom is fun (but watch your head!)!

Such a clean and cute Airbnb! Amazing location, walking distance to so many restaurants, shops, cafe’s. We really enjoyed our stay here! Claudia is very responsive and provided us with some great recommendations!

I have been staying at Airbnbs around the world for the past 1,5 years and hands down this apartment was one of the most outstanding of all I have ever stayed at. Not only it was clean, well furnished, new, and beautifully located, it had everything you could possibly need on your trip and more. The huge windows and the balcony make you fall in love with the place the second you walk in and allows you to enjoy Porto to its fullest. The location was amazing, just a walk away from stores, restaurants, cafes, and touristy areas. I could not recommend this place more! Thank you so much for hosting me!

Claudia's appartement was perfect for our stay. We were in Porto for 5 days and were very happy with its location in the center. We did everything by foot and the apartment was exactly as in the pictures.
great appartement, very well situated and super clean. Communication with Claudia was very smooth. highly recommended.

A great location for exploring beautiful Porto. Locating the apartment was made easy with information provided and excellent communication. The apartment was clean, comfortable and well appointed with amenities provided. Really enjoyed our stay here and would definitely visit again!
Great location, and Claudia is very responsive/easy to communicate with! Very walkable area, would recommend this apartment for a stay in Porto.
Very nice apartment with modern furnishing. Great host who was responsive and had everything prepared. Had a wonderful stay. Thank you!

Beautiful space efficient apartment in the center of Porto. Neighborhood is full of life without being noisy. We enjoyed Mass at  historic Catholic Church across the street , were able to easily walk to everything and found many nice restaurants and coffee places close by.

Such a beautiful spot to stay while visiting Porto! So close to walk to downtown areas and beautiful views from the balcony of St. Idelfonso church. Bottle of champagne was a nice touch to welcome us!

Great place to stay, as long as you are prepared to climb the ladder to the 2nd room. Top tip from previous guest - pull the ladder out, it makes all the difference! Great situation, good cafes & restaurants locally. Easy check in & out. Would definitely recommend
Excellent stay. Good location. Value for money and super clean. Very much enjoyed. Excellent beds.

What a wonderful apartment! Modern with everything you could need and a sweet little balcony too for the early morning coffee and evening glass of wine. Bruna could not have been more helpful, picked us up, sorted a restaurant booking and even a taxi when we were leaving - she is just lovely. If you get chance walk a few minutes up the road towards town and visit the Vintage Market, it's amazing (and has a bar too).

What a neat place! The Airbnb was comfortable, clean, and really cool. It’s close enough to everything to be convenient, but far enough that’s it’s quiet and relaxed. I feel like I could live here. Would recommend to anyone!

Our stay was great. The apartment was very clean, tastefully decorated and in a prime location. I highly recommend for anyone visiting Porto. Easy check in and out. Parking down the block. Great place.

This was a phenomenal Airbnb! It is very beautifully designed and well-equipped. The location is awesome and the value was great! The hosts were very friendly and easy to communicate with, and they allowed us to check in early. A+ experience!
The property was well worth the money just for the location. It was very clean and tidy and quiet. Great for a short stay.

Me and a friend stayed in the apartment over New Years and it was just perfect! It’s easily walkable to the city centre and really close to restaurants and bars along the river. The apartment is as advertised and has everything we needed.  Elio and Bruna were incredibly helpful and provided us with some excellent recommendations for New Years Eve and some general recommendations for things to do too. They were the perfect hosts!

Amazing Airbnb, really beautiful and a great host for communication. Had a lovely stay there for one night and would recommend to travellers.  Only downside was the safe box where the key was kept in was open at the time of arrival and not locked!

We had a fantastic stay, the space was amazing. It was beautiful, very clean and what a view from the balcony. We drove a car, there was convenient public parking near by. Claudia was great to work with and made us feel very welcome. We would absolutely recommend.

Amazing location and apartment! This was our first time in Porto, and the spot was super central to a lot of things :) We also loved the gorgeous balcony, we spent a lot of time watching the city below and listening to the music from the streets. This place came with so many great amenities and was very comfortable/peaceful after a long day of traveling.  We will definitely be back (thank you Claudia)!
Amazing apartment situated in a perfect location for exploring beautiful Porto. We had a great time staying here. Would definitely recommend.
We LOVED this apartment.  The big windows and style are so great and the location can not be better.  We walked everywhere we wanted to go so easily from this location.  Highly recommend it!
Wonderful, lovely space, great location, super clean and super easy check-in process. Super easy to communicate with the host, they even had a bottle of wine and snacks. 10/10 stay!
This was an excellent stay. When returning to Porto, I don’t need to look farther than this stay!
Super cool and cozy apt! Right in the center of Porto, close to everything.  Me and my friend had a really great time staying there! Highly recommended!  Thanks Claudia !

Stayed for a short while but thought that this place was fantastic! Instructions from the host were very clear and location was very convenient! I would definitely recommend if you have a small group (1-3 people) and you want to be close to public transportation :)
Very nice apartment in a nice neighbourhood. You can explore Porto by foot and there are many good restaurants nearby.

Our first visit to Portugal traveling to Porto, Lisbon and Lagos not knowing what expect . This airbnb was in the perfect location in the historic district. Everything in walking distance, cafes, patios, restaurants, bars and bakeries. Custard tarts everyday. We loved it. Tours are great, the Duro Valley Wine tour is a must do. the unit exceeded our expectations and was a perfect fit for us. We highly recommend it.  Claudia was amazing and an attentive host. Quick to respond and answered our question. Our plane was a day late and we kept in contact.

I stayed in this apartment for a week and it was great! It had all of the amenities that you need for a comfortable stay - coffee maker, fridge, air conditioning, and good wifi. The location was great and felt very safe, with plenty of restaurants and places to go right in the vicinity, nearby public transportation, and a short walk to the Sao Bento train station and historic attractions. I would definitely stay here again.

Claudia was a great host, very helpful. Enjoyed every day u stayed. Really great price. Very close to supermarkets & vendors, really nice cafe’s,bars & restaurants. I would recommend take the walk up the hill if possible it’s great to see lots of the architecture and the city. Be prepared to walk a lot of stairs & hills. If you’re carrying luggage take the shuttle up to the main district and from there it’s a 3 minute walk from the bridge.

It was really nice stay - flat was clean and cozy! Really nice window view, small balcony, windows can be closed and protect our sleep from daylight. At night it was absolutely quiet, and bed is very comfortable, so we slept very well!  Thank you so much!

This place is perfect! Bruna was so lovely and great to communicate with. The apartment is really well equipped, including everything you need to cook, and also beautifully designed. Great location close to food and the sites. Would definitely stay again.

Excellent location on the old tram line. walkable ten minutes to Ribeira. Appartment very clean with comfortable beds. Small touches like shower gel and teabags along with cooking oil available. The decor is lovely. The host communicated very well and always replied. Easy to find and self check in went well. Water drinkable.Great list of recommendations of what to do from the host.

Booked this property after I had had a nightmare at a nearby hotel. For a similar price to what I paid for the hotel, this accomodation was lightyears ahead in terms of quality, space, amenities, cleanliness, and finish. The property is central, bright, relatively quiet, and is a great space for solo travellers or couples. Cannot recommend this property enough for those thinking of travelling to Porto.
This apartment was perfect! It has everything within a short walks distance. The apartment was secure and very nice. Will definitely stay here again!

A lovely and comfortable apartment,  very centrally located. Loved being so close to all the wonderful sights that Porto has to offer! Claudia was a great and helpful host and we would definitely stay again!

Elio’s place was wonderful. It was just like the pictures. They gave us great instructions on how to get in and restaurant recommendations. We loved the apartment. We walked to the wine tasting across the river and to the Cathedral and Palace. There are a lot of great restaurants and pubs within walking distance.

We had a fabulous stay at Elio’s place! Communication before and during our stay was excellent, the apartment was immaculate, very well equipped, in a quiet area but easy walking distance to everything.  Would highly recommend to anyone looking to stay in beautiful Porto
Elio was wonderful to deal with and the apartment was fabulous.  Great location. East walk into town and a tram top outside.  Would highly recommend

Loved the apartment!  The location was superb, it was tidy, had a well equipped kitchen, a perfect fit for 2 adult couples traveling together.  Bedrooms were comfortable and allowed for privacy at night. Having the little deck off the living area was a bonus, we enjoyed sipping our wine and/or coffee just enjoying neighborhood.  Elio was super helpful in coordinating a place for us to be able to watch our local football game while we were in Porto and also managed to drop off umbrella’s due to some wet weather during our stay.  As a side note I recommend utilizing the sight seeing on/off bus and boat combo tour, It was great . I give Porto in general and this apartment 5 stars all the way across the board. 🤩  stars across the board from me !

Elio's place was perfect. You can just tell he's an experienced host that understands and makes his guests' experience in Porto exceptional.  Cozy apartment with everything you need and is so close to nearby attractions. We loved staying in the place and would recommend it to anybody travelling into Porto.
Great apartment! Very nicely organized and clean. Great location. The owners are really helpful and communicative.

A very lovely, comfortable apartment which had everything we needed. Convenient for going out and exploring the city with a scenic walk alongside the river. A great host who was very helpful and attentive.

A small but perfectly formed apartment - ideal for our family of 3. Great location to explore on foot or by public transport.   Beautiful city - so much to see (and eat!). Always felt welcome and safe. Thank you Bruna/Elio for your help, advice and assistance. We loved being in Porto. X
enjoyed our stay. The flat was well designed and well proportioned. Situated for easy access to town. Nice to have a  small balcony.
Great place to stay. Our first visit to Porto and this was the perfect base and location! Would recommend this accommodation to others.

Patricia is a great host: She let us check-in early because the flat was empty the day before, gave us tips for where to go in Porto and responded immediately. The flat is a dreamhouse where we wanted to stay living. We also appreciated many useful amenities the flat has to offer.

Great modern appartement in a quiet neighbourhood. The appartement had a lot of space for clothes etc. The bed was very comfortable and the shower was great. Patricia was a very nice host and explained a lot about porto and gave me a lot of helpful tips during the check-in.

We loved our stay at Patricia's apartment! It's very centrally located, so you can easily walk everywhere and you have lots of restaurants, shops and sights within walking distance. At the same time, it's located in a quiet street.  The apartment itself is great, it was super clean and very modern and stylish! Also well equipped with everything you need. We also worked from there and the internet was good for this too. Patricia was very friendly, always replied quickly to messages and gave us great recommendations for things to do around! 100% recommend :)
Great place to stay! Very handy location and clean. Good design and airy. I would come back. Perfect location as there's a subway station around the corner.
Great apartment with all the amenities you need. Excellent location, close to the metro, the perfect location to explore Porto. Patricia's communication and instructions were excellent.

A super apartment well located for the metro and the Port where we spent a lot of time.  Paula & Rafael kept us well informed throughout the trip. Will definitely be back. Top Top apartment and location.

Fantastic location convenient to a lot of great restaurants and sites. We were there in December, and it was COLD, but the tiny space heaters worked well. Parking was nonexistent, but we knew that in advance. Highly recommend this place regardless.

Such a beautiful apartment with a gorgeous view.   Perfect self check in process!  Very easy.   Area is very safe and charming.  Close to everything.  Loved the heaters in each room.  Hosts were always easy to reach.
Really lovely space in a great part of town. Clean, spacious, and easy to find. Fantastic value for money.

Location was awesome!! Very modern looking place. The entrance to the condo was wide and very clean. The place had everything that is needed. Washing machine was a plus :) So many choices for cafes, dinners and lunches walking distance. Loved it!!

A 5 star stay! I don’t think the location could be any better. The hosts were really nice and they have great recommendations. We really enjoyed our stay and if we ever have a chance, we would stay there again
This place is clean, perfectly located with amazing hosts that make you feel welcome and address any concerns. Highly recommend as your home when you stay in Porto! 5 stars all the way!
Fantastic apartment in an excellent location. Beautiful views, quiet after hours, and steps away from the top sites. We had a wonderful time!
Really lovely apartment, very spacious and clean. Great location, just a short walk to lots of bars and restaurants, and only 5min walk to the river!
Had a great stay.  Walkable location with restaurants and shopping nearby.  It’s on a very steep hill and no elevator which with our family was the only downside!

Very nice apartment - and very well located in the middle of the city. Only draw back was that the key was not in place when we arrived - and the cleaning was not done. However both things were solved quickly, so all in all we can recommend the apartment.

It is what you see, beautiful and private. It’s really in the center so if you visit uptown you’re halfway up, and if you want to visit downtown you’re halfway down! Really close to all public transport to airport and others.  The supplies were limited, and  communication with hosts was quite impersonal. You don’t see or interact with hosts at check in nor check out.  We were there with 4 people for 5days… and we had 3toilet paper rolls. When we asked for more, they said even those 3 were courtesy…  There was no household paper, and there is a dishwasher but no soap for it… So if you’re traveling, expect to do a full household grocery run. Airbnb used to be more personal, about vacationing in someone’s home… this was an impersonal experience but all in all still a good location, facility and experience :)
Overall the stay was pretty pleasant. The listing was very clean, had all the necessary amenities. The host was responsive and all times.  I would definitely recommend :)
Great location handy for the river and up the hill to the sights. Clean, simple flat. Easy to find and check in. Would happily stay again.

Well located in historic area, very close to Sao Bento station.  Lovely views, great restaurants in close proximity & a cute wine bar downstairs.  Perfect size for myself & 2 friends.  When leaving the apartment, make sure you have the key on you, as the downstairs door is deadlocked & requires a key to exit.   The laneway does feel a little dodgy if you enter from the top end.

This is a really good spot to stay and exactly like the photos. It is on the third floor and I'd say with 4 people if we were staying any longer than 2 nights we'd definitely need to grab more toilet paper. Super easy to get into once you have the key, lots of great restaurants around and just an all round good landing spot.
i really enjoyed staying in this airbnb! the owner was really nice and flexible!! thankyou so much

We had a great stay here. Only issue is that you can hear a lot of the street noise. It’s on a side street not a major road but there’s still a good amount of noise during the day. Otherwise no issues, would recommend.
Great apartment and location. Oporto is a great place to visit, if you can cope with the hills! The old town is fantastic and the riverside well worth a visit

The location is great for seeing the city. Plan on walking a bit if you get dropped off or drive as cars do not have access to the narrow street that the apartment is in. Besides that, location is great for exploring. As listed, no AC and I did find it a bit warm when sleeping. But overall fine a fine place to rest while exploring Porto.
The property was just as expected, and exactly like the photos. Location was perfect for walking to all main sights, restaurants and shops. No issues with check-in and check-out.

Leisej is very helpful. The apartment is lacated in a residential area and can be reached by Metro (only 4 min walk). The room was nice during my stay. There are some cafe where you can find foods and drinks. Recommended!!!

The perfect AirBnB, very clean and tidy. You can tell it’s the culture of the home. I was in the house with the host and I think his family but the place is setup such that it feels like they are in a different apartment, it’s like having the best of both worlds; a home and a hotel all in one. I also liked the furnishings in my room, nice wood polished furniture and nice flooring. Fine bathroom, fine kitchen. As for the location it’s a good location as long as you can get to the city attractions without a fuss. I booked the AirBnB partly because of its proximity to the metro but I ended up not using the metro because of how cheap ride-sharing services are (when you pay between €1-€5 for a 3km ride to the city attractions, and pay just over €7 for a 16km ride to the airport, you really don’t care about the metro haha)
Great stay! Room and bathroom were very clean. The bed and pillows were very comfortable as well. Subway located 3 min walk from the apartment. Would stay here again!
I really like the apartment. It was fantastic and very well located. The street is a bit noisy at night, but the apartment has good noise isolation.

very stylish, beautiful and extremely central place, everything was perfect… i knew before that it would be loud in the nights since it’s so central but I thought it wouldn’t be that bad since we were there during the week but there are many bars around so it’s noisy every night, just be aware if that and bring some ear plugs
This was such a special spot. Clean, beautiful views, and had everything we needed. Communication was clear and quick. Can’t wait to return.
The place is amazing! the host is the best one we ever had. he helped us in everything.
Amazing location and fantastic place! The communication was super smooth and check in was easy. We would definitely stay here again in the future.
Very nice stay and personality. We were there at new years eve so we got wine as present，it’s so nice！☺️
Great apartment with stunning view! Brilliant location for exploring Porto. Hildebrando is a very attentive host with great communication and hospitality :-)
Had a fabulous stay in this lovely apartment right next to the river with stunning views and location close to the Porthouses and the old town.

We had quite an impressive time in Porto after a week in Lisbon, the weather was great and we could see the best sunset directly from the living-room and have the most marvellous view of the city. The 3 bathrooms were great for us as friends, and we had everything close by. Some minor things to be fixed were already announced by Hildebrando right away, and is hands down an excellent host and a great guy we love to see back in 2023. Next year we could definetly be back. Tip: search for house no10, not14, and be aware that right now cars cannot cross the bridge down-side, only up-side, so only people can walk the lower bridge by foot. Obrigado, Hildebrando!
We love this place! Awesome location. Warm host . They are super responsive . This place is just wonderful . I would recommend to my friends and family for sure!

Amazing location, just a few steps away from the bridge that takes you to Porto. So much to do and see on both sides of the river. It was fun watching the crew teams from our balcony on Sunday morning.
Awesome location, beautiful views. Could not have asked for better location. Accommodations were fine. The bed mattresses were uncomfortable - could feel the springs. But otherwise all ok.

We loved this place!!! Although it was on the smaller side, it was perfectly outfitted, and the location could not have been better. The apartment was right on the water, walkable to everything and cleaner than clean. It's a beautiful place.
Better than the pictures this place was absolutely incredible and one of the best airbnbs we have ever stayed in.
Great location and amazing views of Porto!! The host was so kind and flexible with us and gave us great recommendations. Highly recommend this apartment if you’re visiting Porto!

Hildebrando's apartment was an amazing place to experience Porto. With doors and a balcony that opened out onto the river, the sunshine and lively atmosphere of Porto could be experienced whilst lying on crisp white sheets. With temperatures soaring into the 30s when we were there Hildebrando's apartment was cool the whole time (with fantastic air conditioning, but even with the doors open it remained cool). Fantastic, central location. Hildebrando was very communicative. Would highly recommend.

The apartment was really great! It was small but had just what we needed. The view over the Douro River was great and just minutes from the area with shops and restaurants. The location is noisy due to the activity by the River but it’s the trade off for the fantastic location.

We had two couples in our party for our stay from May 4 - 7, 2024 at Hildebrando’s home.  This home was absolutely charming and seemed larger than the photos from the listing. The views of the Duoro River, Porto and Vila Nova de Gaia were phenomenal.  We could just open the windows in the living room or bedroom to watch all of the activity on both sides of the river or easily join in the fun by using the stairway adjacent to the house to go down to the riverfront. The home itself was comfortable, clean and well stocked.  My husband and I stayed in the bedroom on the street side and had no issues with street noise.  The beds were very comfortable. The management team was very responsive during all communication with our booking. They even helped us arrange transportation to the airport for our party at 5:00 am for an early morning flight. We highly recommend this Air BnB.

We loved this Airbnb! Amazing location with an amazing view. Easy to get to everything in Porto. Hildebrando was an extremely helpful and responsive host. We were even greeted with a free bottle of wine and water! 10/10 would highly recommend!

Perfect, let me repeat, Perfect location. Wonderful view of Porto. Right at the end  of Gaia. The bridge is one step away. The apartment is small and minimal but well done. A great Porto vibe. Glad we stayed there

We had a fantastic stay in this apartment. The location is amazing - great views of the old town - everything was walkable - great restaurants right on the doorstep! Would highly recommend and definitely stay again!
We really enjoyed this stay in Porto. The location was fantastic and the host was great. Would highly recommend this home for any visitors to the beautiful city of Porto.
Amazing view. Location is perfect. Attentive host. They went beyond to make us confortable. I will stay again.
Amazing view of Porto and in a great location. Spacious apartment with  three bathrooms however we faced issues with the plumbing but host was responsive. Would recommend!
Clean, quiet, comfortable and well located.  Hosts were great and communicated well.  Excellent value.  Secure building with taxis lined up outside.  All good.
The Appartement is very beautiful, it is near the center and well served by metro. We had a fantastic days in Porto. Thank you

This beautifully designed apartment is as beautiful as the pictures. Use it with care!  If the kitchen had been stocked with some more essential ingredients, it would have been more stellar and welcoming.
Loved our stay in this beautiful flat ☀️☀️☀️Would highly recommend! Thanks a lot ❤️

This apartment was perfect for our stay. It is just out of the center/near a central train station, which means it is easy to reach but also quiet at night. I would recommend it for a couple's or girls' trip.

The apartment is light throughout the day, functional and has a cozy and nice vibe. I liked the layout - bedroom faces the inner yard and is very quiet during the night (also keeps slightly cooler than the living room). I had no need to use AC so can't comment on that - the temperature inside was perfect during my stay (23-24 degrees...yes, I travel with a tiny thermometer/hygrometer) :D The only downsides are the squeaky floors (depends on the routine of the people upstairs) and the fact that the house next door is under full renovation (deadline Oct ´26) so there can be pounding and drilling going on during the usual working hours (except Sunday)...occasionally it can be quite loud. Also be mindful if you're airing the bedroom that the other guests are not smoking in the inner yard (another Airbnb with a little inner yard/balcony).
This is an awesome apartment. You great a vary spacious living room with amazing light. Lisa is a great host. Her apartment is perfectly furnished. All was perfect.

A beautiful, well equipped apartment with a view at a great location. The apartment was well prepared and very clean. Communication with Lisa was easy and Tiago gave us a very warm welcome even though we arrived only around midnight. We had a great time at the location and will certainly return!

The apartment is very nice. Very well appointed kitchen, comfortable beds, delightful views of the Duoro River, and once you get used to walking up and down the hill, very close to restaurants , shopping and the historic downtown area.
We had a great visit! The check-in was easy and apartment was exactly what we needed. Location is great as well, with quick access to the river.
prompt response for anything, full of good tips for restaurants and visits, very kind and helpful, even though we didn't need any support since everything was perfect.
A very nice flat in a very strategic position to visit the city. clean and with everithing you need. Lisa is a very nice host. It has been a great stay in Porto.

Lisa’s place is a gem. Modern and clean. Comfortable beds and living room space, good kitchen. But the star of this show is the outdoor areas. Yes, two. A terrific terrace facing the river and an even more terrific back yard with sitting table and spectacular views (also facing the river). Great location (you have to be ok with some hilly streets to get to it - but c’mon, it’s Porto!!). We really came to love the location. Quiet with great views all around. Very homey. This is a place to measure all others by. And Lisa was terrific. Very responsive and helpful.

We had a great time at the apartment.  There was a lot of attention to detail. Great amenities - everything you could want and more and spotlessly clean. Lisa was really responsive and flexible.  As others have said, it is Porto so there are lots of hills,  but the apartment was well placed for heading down to the river or up into the old town.  Great views from the outdoor spaces down to the river. Would thoroughly recommend.
Lisa was a fantastic host. The view from the terrace is breathtaking! Overall we really enjoyed our stay

Such a lovely Airbnb. Hosts had amazing advice and guides to Porto and made the stay really enjoyable. Flat is beautiful and looks exactly like the pictures, thank you so much for such a great trip to Portugal! Couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay

The view, overlooking Porto and Gaia, was breathtaking.  An added plus was the little backyard, which was lovely and well maintained.  I would highly recommend this place for anyone, except those with limited mobility.  The unit is built into the side of a hill, and it takes more than an average amount of effort to get luggage in.  But even then, Sandra our kind host offered to haul our baggage.  That tiny bit of inconvenience was worth it when we checked in and enjoyed the view.  Porto has been the highlight of our trip.  Well done.

All the attraction, restaurant and walking tour recommendations were great. We tried quite a few of them and found them all to be excellent choices. The apartment was well equipped & comfortable. The beds were comfortable. We came into town early and were able to drop off our bags which we appreciated.

We had a great stay,  apartment was as described. The beds were of good quality,  kitchen was clean and well equipped. The two balconies on both sides of the house offer nice opportunities to be outside.

Lovely, clean and modern home with great water views. The location is great, with a short walk to the busy part of town but is also quiet where it is located. Lisa was a communicative hosts and provided many great recommendations too!

A wonderful stay in a lovely apartment.  Very close to the restaurants and bars on the river but also just far enough away to have peace and quiet after a day of hustle and bustle.  Fantastic views, great facilities and even an outdoor escalator to save you from the stairs!
Beautiful apartment, great host !!! Lisa was very amenable and flexible and friendly . She stayed in touch when needed.  Would highly recommend!

The perfect apartment for a vacation. Spacious and comfortable with a spectacular view across the rooftops of the historical city and down to the Douro river. The sunny balcony at the front, and the garden at the back, provided ample private outdoor space and Tiago was immediately responsive to our questions about the area and requests for transport. We loved exploring Porto and found the apartment to be a relaxing place to recoup and relax in the evening or during the day (high ceilings, comfortable beds, and well-equipped kitchen, eating and sitting areas). This was one of the nicest Airbnb places we've stayed in. Perfect for a family with teenagers or for two couples visiting together.

Pros: huge space - 5 bedrooms, 4 full baths; location - close to everything Cons: spartan Highly recommend this place. We are two families each with small children. It allowed for easy access to sightseeing, stores, and restaurants. Communication is good and professional.  There are utensils and cookware, but no oil, salt, etc making it harder to do so.  Would stay again!

Fantastic location.  Steps from the foot bridge over the river to Gaia, with beautiful sunsets.  The rooms are crisp and clean with 2 twin beds in 3 of them, which can be a king, or separated, and 2 queens or double, not sure, in the other 2 rooms.  4 nice bathrooms with good water pressure.  There is an elevator to the 3rd floor which is so nice.  It is also nice to have a balcony for fresh air.  Each room has an air spliter with AC and Heat.  The living/dinning area is spacious with a well equipped kitchen.  There is also a washer and dryer in the apartment .  I felt very safe here.  We had 8 ladies traveling together.  It was perfect for us!
Amazing apartment in the centre of town. The place had everything we needed. Had a great time and it was nice to have so much space. Communication was great both ahead of time and during the stay.

We stayed here as a group of 7 and it was amazing! So spacious, beautiful set up and location, the easiest check in and out process! Honestly couldn’t recommend more, it was the perfect spot to see Porto and our hosts were so quick at responding and so helpful with local recommendations!
Everything perfect! Close to the main train station, there is a metro stop close by and the area is quiet. I would recommend it, enough space for larger groups.
I honestly have nothing bad to say. An excellent place with excellent location ideal for family or big groups.

What an amazing location! the spacious apartment with 4 bathrooms made it easy to travel with 2 families.  The beds were very comfortable and he heat also worked well, perfect for chilly, rainy days. Having a washer and dryer was a bonus! It is 4 flights up so be prepared but the space is worth it

This location was fantastic and we had easy access to a lot of sites in the historic district. We were disappointed that we didn’t know the elevator wasn’t working. Although it didn’t impact our group, it would be a problem for others as the apartment is on the 3rd floor.

My friends and I (8 people total) had the pleasure of staying at N Apartments - Luís. It was perfect to accommodate us and was located central to everything in the city. Definitely walking distance to most if not all notable sites of interest. Very quiet apartment building. Will note that the elevator was not working during our stay; this wasn’t a problem for us but may be to some since it is 3-4 floors to climb. The apartment had tons of space for us to spread out, lots of light and a big kitchen. It was really nice getting to come home at the end of the day and all be able to sit at the dinning room table and couch. Overall, great stay. As described and pictured. Would stay here again.
Perfect for a large group, very big apartment. lots of bedrooms and bathrooms. Easy to co live together.

The communication with this company was amazing.  When we checked in, we were able to leave our bags for a while and Marianna gave us a map and a lot of helpful information.  The location was close to a lot of sites and restaurants.  The only down side was the elevator didn’t work.  But everything else was terrific!  I highly recommend this company and this apartment!
Fantastic apartment for a group. Very rare to find a 5 double bedroom 4 bathroom place, very comfortable for a group. We all had a bit of privacy and plenty of space.

Great, spacious location right in the heart of downtown. We also received some great recommendations and felt that N Apartments was extremely responsive and easy to communicate with. Would 100% recommend
Our stay was awesome. We loved the balcony so much! Apt is pretty spacious, with all the needed amenities. Recommended!

A brilliant accommodation, very cosy and great access to the Swimming pool and Gym. Close to local amenities. Will be back when the football season recommences  as Estádio do Dragão is seen from the swimming pool.
The place was really nice with the pool and everything, looks exactly like the pictures. But we had a lot of problems during check in eich made everything very stressful😕

Great nicely equipped apartments in the heart of downtown and lively Ribeira neighborhood  with plenty of restaurants within walking distance . A short walk to the bridge going to Vila Nova de Gaia with more restaurants and Port wine tasting rooms. Super clean. Easy Instructions to follow for check in . We were 2 families ( 3 and 4) and enjoyed the convenience of being on the same floor (next to each other) but still with the privacy of own place.  Driving in Porto is quite difficult with the lot of constructions going on therefore I will suggest not to arrive by car. Parking is very limited, restricted . Riberia Saba Parking is a block away however super expensive@ 50 euros overnight.
Great location. Apartments could have been cleaner (showers had a bit of mold) but location was the best

This was an amazing place to stay and a great host. Location is perfect, and place was very suitable for kids. We had 2 kids with us and there was a baby chair , crib and stroller. Absolutely wonderful stay. Would stay again.

The location is really ideal for a visit to Porto.  Just steps away from the picturesque riverfront and all the restaurants, the Luis I bridge, which you can walk across to Gaia to visit all of the port wine tasting places.  All the historical buildings are lit up at night which gives the entire area a magical feel. Communication from Tiago before check-in was clear with entry codes & even videos that made getting into the unit stress-free and trouble -free. The beds were comfortable and the unit was clean.  We had everything we needed to prepare breakfasts and simple meals in the kitchen. There is absolutely no need for a car when staying here.  Everything is within walking distance.  If you want to travel farther afield, Uber is available and very economical.  Thanks for a great stay!

Absolutely wonderful! Would stay again in a heartbeat! Great location… comfortable beds and furniture… fully stocked kitchen… coffee… and the lift helped so much with the luggage! Great Host! Very friendly and proactive with check-in photos and videos!

Great stay at Tiago’s. Very communicative host, great location, and easy access with all needed items in unit. Elevator was appreciated! The location was central and close to restaurants and the water- overall great stay.

Our group of 8 had a wonderful stay in Tiago's apartments in Porto. Location was perfect - quick and easy access to stores, markets, restaurants, attractions, riverfront, and Ponte Luis I to walk over to Vila Nova de Gaia. Together, we had both top-floor neighboring units (4 people each). There are no other units on the floor so it was very private. The elevator was a huge bonus. Both units were as advertised, clean, and bright. One unit had a combined washer/dryer and small balcony, and both units had their own separate lockboxes and sets of keys. Access to the apartments was very straightforward - Tiago's directions were clear and he provided videos to facilitate the check in. Everything went smoothly with our stay and we would absolutely stay here again!
Amazing location and host!  They provided helpful information to help navigate our first visit to Porto. We hope to stay with them again!

Brilliant location for exploring all the tourist attractions. The apartments had everything we needed. The lift was great for our luggage. A little noisy at night but you can't be in the middle of everything and expect peace and quiet. The location definitely outweighed the noise. Walking distance to everything. Felt very safe and secure. Tiago's communication was brilliant. Highly recommend his apartments.
Great location. Close to river, restaurants, bars, and stores.  One apartment has a/c, the other has fans.
Amazing 2 story flat. Clean and tidy. Self check in system very efficient. Questions are replied within few hours.
Recommanded. The flat was clean, calm and nearby Porto city center. We had a very nice trip.
Our stay there was lovely! The flat was beautiful. Nothing negative to say about it! We loved it!

The apartment is well located, we did not use the transport and just walked around the whole city. It was clean and the beds were very comfortable. The view and privacy to be able to rest in the pleasant atmosphere. The mini terrace was very nice. All the necessary facilities were provided, including toiletries.

The appartement is well located and comfy You can hear the church bells every morning around 10AM, but it's pretty calm appart from this The cleanliness could be improved Overall we had a great time Thanks !
This place was beautiful and the location was great. Very responsive and super helpful hosts. Recommend 100%

The apartment was as described and photos are exact the same in reality. The location is just incredible, Ponte Luís 1 is just 1min walk from the apartment. All that I needed in the kitchen was there so you can cook what ever you want and the WiFi quality and speed are remarquable

Amazing location, easily checked in / checked out, very clean. Its just hard to carry a big luggage to the top floor if you are an alone traveller. I was just thinking it would be great if a small bottle of water could be left somewhere to show hospitality after check in.

Lovely little apartment, just make sure you are good with stairs and luggage ( very clear that there is NO LIFT). Extremely clean, and one of the quietest places I’ve stayed in Portugal cities ( there is still noise but it’s muted).  Very communicative hosts. Easy to walk to so many great places and tourist attractions.

I would highly recommend. i stayed here for just under 2 months - the apartment is newly renovated and had everything i could possibly need. Catarina is a very attentive host - she'll drop you a message to check up and see if you need anything at all. The location is great too - far enough from downtown for some peace and quiet but also close enough that you could be there at the drop of a hat. There's a good selection of cafes, bakeries and supermarkets nearby. I'd definitely stay here again next time I'm back in Porto.
Really good apartments, communication was great and host was lovely and friendly and very accommodating. great central location in beautiful Porto.
This place is in a great location. Decorated nicely. Newly remodeled. Great communication. Would stay here again.

Everything about this accommodation is excellent! The location is perfect, the place is spacious and it has very cute terrace, as well as everything else you need during your stay - from towels to coffee machine. Communication with hosts is easy. Highly recomennded!

The flat was perfect at all! It was very clean, in a great central location and just as beautiful as the pictures show.  The check in was personal and very nice, you get great recommendations for activities and food, which we gratefully tried and loved. They are always available for help.  When we checked out, they kindly gave us the opportunity to leave our suitcases until the flight.  So we can only warmly recommend this apartment!
Very helpful and friendly, staff, very good communication. The location is amazing but still quiet in the evenings. We hope to come back!
We had a fantastic stay! Exactly what we needed :) The air conditioner was broken so it was dripping water a lot but it didn't bother us. Great location and feels so safe!

The location is perfect. Right in-between the two city centres. The place is a little bit dark, it doesn’t get a lot of natural light but if you are not planning on staying in shouldn’t be a problem.  We got a free cleaning service in the middle of our stay which was highly appreciated. For some reason a little bit cold sometimes but could be managed with the AC.

We are really happy with our choice of airbnb. The location was a 10/10, we were really in the center therefore almost everything was accessible by foot. The communication with Dahome was also very efficient. It was also very clean. Honestly no regret !! I recommend 100% and I will surely be coming back :)

Our hosts were very kind and communicative. Check in is very easy. The terrace was beautiful, lovely to enjoy in the morning and sunset. The location is great. We walked out the door and could explore the city easily! Great place to stay!

This was an excellent place to stay -- the apartment matches the photos perfectly. The terrace is great, and the views from the apartment are beautiful. Lots of natural light. Easy access via elevator. Excellent location for exploring Porto!

This apartment is quite small (the bathroom sink is hilariously tiny), but it has everything you need and works fine for two people. That said, the outdoor terrace was amazing (the absolute highlight of the Airbnb) and the location was perfect. The apartment was very clean and we had no issues whatsoever with checking in.

This apartment is in a perfect location. It’s a short walk down to the waterfront or up to the city center, where you can find some great bars and restaurants. The unit itself was very tidy and featured great views, especially from the large patio. Definitely recommend buying a bottle of wine and catching the sunset from there.  Would 100% stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay here! The first thing we did when we arrived was walk out onto the patio and marvel in the view. Is it the best view it Porto??!! It certainly felt like it. The location was ideal— within 5-10 min walking distance to the riverfront, bridge, and Jardim do Moro where you can catch the sunset. Sometimes after long travels the little things matter— being able to checkin a couple of hours early without hassle, good working AC during one of Porto’s hottest weeks, blackout shades, and good water pressure. This apartment offered it all. We would definitely stay here again!

This was a great apartment with a fantastic view of the city. We enjoyed sitting out on the balcony at night at sunset and throughout enjoyed the apartment. The only complaint I have is the shower design is very poor, and so when you shower, the water sprays out onto the bathroom floor and you have to mop it up each shower. Couple that with there not being a good place to dry the towels and showering wasn’t always the easiest thing to do. Otherwise, a great apartment!

The views from the balcony were absolutely stunning day and night. The apartment is a bit bijou but practical. A kettle would have been useful for the tea drinkers but we managed. The bathroom sink was small for my husband to shave. That said the views from this apartment and the great location  far outweigh the smaller details inside.
We had the best time in this beautiful flat, such a great view and comfortable place! Great position also!
the terrace offered a really nice view and felt very private. the apartment was very clean and comfortable.
Looks exactly like the photos! Extremely clean space and the bath towels smelled amazing. Great location, too. I had a wonderful stay.
Great place to stay in central Porto, near everything and yet far from the nightlife center where it gets very noisy.  The bedroom is spacious and it has a guest bathroom which comes very handy.
Eduardo and Helena were lovely hosts that responded quickly to messages and gave some amazing tips. The apartment was exactly like the pictures.
The flat is very nice and clean. It is centrally located. Eduardo is a very pleasant host.

Helena’s flat is great! It’s super spacious and in a great location (10min walk away from the Lello bookstore). The flat was super clean, and the check-in and check-out were extremely easy and flexible. Helena’s communication is great, always responding soon after I messaged. All in all a great experience and I’d definitely stay there again!

We loved our stay at Helena and Eduardo's apartment. The location was really great for us - There were lots of attractions in walking distance as well as restaurants and bars. It was also nice and quiet. The apartment was spotless and really well looked after; very stylish, comfortable and modern. Eduardo welcomed us and also did check out with us too which was a nice touch. We would highly recommend staying here and if we return to Porto we might go back ourselves too!

Really good experience from start to finish Edwardo met us and went over everything and was there if we needed anything also at checkout offered to store our luggage for a couple of hours would highly recommend
The apartment looked exactly like on the photos, especially the bedroom is beautiful. It was very clean.

Helena and Eduardo were fantastic hosts. Eduardo was friendly, welcoming and assisted us every step of the way. The flat was wonderful. The location is perfect, walking distance to the centre. Porto, we fell in love! We will come back. Thanks for everything!

We loved our stay in Porto, Eduardo and Helena were very friendly and welcoming and the apartment was spacious, comfortable, immaculate and had everything we needed for our stay. The location was amazing, 10mins walk to the city centre, quiet and with a few great restaurants nearby. Would definitely recommend to anyone staying in Porto!

We had a great stay in Helena and Eduardo's apartment. The location is ideal for exploring Porto, with lots of nice breakfast and dinner places within walking distance. The apartment was as described, very spacious, comfortable and clean. Our hosts were always responsive and available to us if needed. We would highly recommend!

The apartment was perfect for staying in Porto few days. The location is the best to explore the city. Communication with the host was perfect and Paulo provided us all information to have the best experience in Porto. The room had anything necessary for a comfortable stay.
It was a really nice stay at Paulo's apartment. The view and the location are just great!
large and newly refurbished apartment,  well placed. despite being on a busy street, it is no loud

The mattress and pillows were so stiff that my neck and back hurt for 8 out of 10 days that I stayed there. When I asked for softer pillows, I received pillows with almost no stuffing and they were entirely flat. Some nights I even had difficulty sleeping. I asked for a third roll toilet paper and ran out by the 8th day. I was told to buy my own toilet paper.  The water pressure of the shower wasn't very strong, and I had to take longer showers as a result of this. My recommendation: give your guests what they need (such as an extra roll of toilet paper), check the plumbing and faucets for the water pressure, and please get more comfortable pillows and a mattress. I have a difficult time recommending this room if you have specific comforts. But it is near the bridge and the city centre.

Overall i had a pleasant stay for a few days. The place was as advertised,  a room at first floor after a narrow staircase; with small kitchenette, fridge, private bathroom and a nice view.  The room was quiet, clean and spacious and self check-in and out went flawlessly. It is placed a few minutes from metro and Jardim do Morro and subsequent Luís Bridge, and there's a few minimarket nearby and a large Pingo Doce a 10 minutes walk away. I didn't meet the host, but comunication and instructions were clear and extensive. As other have mentioned, the mattress and pillows are quite stiff and someting to consider (it didn't bother me much).
Very communicative and gave plenty of instruction on how to feel immediately at home in the apartment and the area.
Really beautiful location and clean apartment. The hosts were lovely and very communicative ! Really made our stay in Porto lovely
Arrival was easy and we were given a warm welcome. The accommodation was as described and very clean. It has all the necessary facilities. The only default is the lack of soundproofing between rooms.
Great location, very close to the metro station, restaurants, stores. Lovely place, very clean, comfortable, you feel like home. Perfect for 2 people. Good communication.
This place was really beautiful, the bed was confortable and the apartment was very clean! My friend and I had a very nice stay at this place :)
Great location—easy access to many attractions, shopping streets, and restaurants.  Apartment is stylish, perfect for shorter stays. Would stay again!

Great location to walk to everywhere, delicious bakeries and the food market around the corner or outside the apartment. Place looks like the photos, is spacious and clean. Had a lovely bottle of wine to welcome us, thank you! Communication was quick and easy and check in was seamless. Only regret getting to stay just one night! Would have loved to stayed longer! Next time...
Great location with good coffee and a deli across the street. Photos are accurate, clean and simple. Lovely high ceilings, would recommend for a couple or lone traveler

Great location! Room looks just like the pictures. Host was able to arrange transportation to the airport the next morning. There was a little miscommunication with our early check-in at 2pm, but the host was able to to let us in early to leave our luggage and we were still able to make our 3pm appointment.

The apartment is great for a weekend break in Porto. Check in and communication was smooth, it has everything you need and is in a perfect location. Make sure to try the pasteis de nata from across the road too!

Eduardo's team was flexible with accommodating our early dropped baggage.  The apartment was extremely clean and pleasant to stay in with an incredible location central to everything in Porto- we greatly enjoyed it! Beautiful set up, furniture and high ceilings. Super beautiful

The apartment is in a prime location for sightseeing and shopping. A beautifully decorated space with great light and a lovely terrace. Our host was very responsive and gracious. Will definitely stay again.
host was friendly, the apartment was really great. also I was pleased with such things as a coffee machine and a bottle of water ☺️
Lovely base to explore Porto, well located, and everything you need for a city break. Thanks very much!
100% recommended, perfect location, fast and efficient communication with the host and beautiful place to stay. I would undoubtedly stay again here when coming back to Porto!
Loved the location next to the Bolhão Market. Was a very simple but clean and comfortable accommodation.
Truly an oasis in the heart of Porto. I highly recommend this stay for anyone looking to recharge in comfort.
Beautiful little nook on a gorgeous street filled with lovely shops and markets. Really cosy, clean and well-designed space
Clean, tidy and in a central location. The balcony was very noisy because of a generator and did not have great views.
We had an absolutely lovely stay. There is so much to do with an adorable balcony, they let us check our luggage early so we didn’t have to carry it around. Perfect 5 stars

Great little apartment to stay in. Location is amazing and 15-20 minute maximum walk to anything in Porto. Loved going to the market each morning. A little noisy at times during the night but nothing sustained at all.

The Formosa apartment was a stress-free stay. The apartment is central, which makes it a perfect base to dip in and out of the many local attractions. Despite being central, the area was quiet at night, making for a good nights sleep. Definitely value for money.

Excellent location adjacent to the Mercado do Bolhão! Walkable to everything you would want to see in this wonderful and welcoming city! The apartment was super bright, very clean, and provided a place to prepare meals and enjoy a highly restful night of sleep. The hosts were very responsive and offered to give us new towels without prompting. We also asked for a sheet change halfway through our stay and they provided it without question. Highly recommend this place for a couple looking for a tranquil and homey space in the heart of the city!

Great stay. Host was really responsive and flexible around check in which was helpful with a delayed flight! Great location and perfect sized apartment for a couple of nights. Right next to Mercado de Bolhão which is worth a visit. Everything is up and down hills in Porto so it is an uphill walk back from Gaia / Ribeira but there are tram options if needed.

A lovely stay in the little loft in Porto- location was perfect within walking distance for lots of bars, restaurants, cafes and sights ☺️ We stayed for four nights and felt that a few more bits of cutlery (e.g. bread knife) would of been handy! Some more storage space/drawers for clothes would be really helpful- there was sadly no drawers or cabinet and only a small rail with four hangers on it for our clothes.  A great place for a short stay in Porto!

The appartment was really beautiful with the old wooden floors and the high ceillings. We we're right in the center of Porto, everything was close by, the stores to do some shopping, a variety of restaurants and the market 2 minutes away by walk. I gladly recommend  this place!
Formosa was very kind & attentive. Her accommodation was very clean & located in a convenient location. I would definitely stay again!

Very nice and clean apartment located in the center of Lisbon. We really liked our stay there, the owners was very helpful and the apartment had everything you needed for a short stay. I recommend this accommodation for anyone going to Lisbon!
Great value for money. Clean, all basic amenities are there, central, and extremely helpful staff.

thank you for your hospitality.  Our stay in the apartment was good and comfortable.  I will recommend to friends the accommodation is clean and comfortable, the view from the window is very beautiful :)

We loved our stay and could not ask for a better location. We stayed in studio 6 which had a nice view and private small balcony. Hosts were responsive and responded promptly to our one request. The suite itself had working a/c, cookware basics, and clean linens. Only cons were the mattress was quite hard and about 5/10 on the comfort rating, walls are thin and we woke up a few times from people going up and down stairs. Would stay again.

Had a great stay in my room. Sat outside on the balcony every morning and took in the view. The check in was very easy and the host was responsive. It is at the top of a very steep hill so be prepared to walk up the hill and up all the stairs to the room if you have a lot of luggage. I felt safe as a solo traveler and the other guests were respectful of the quiet times as the walls are thin. Would stay again. Great location.
I would say it’s the best value for this money Really good location and a very friendly host to give us all the good places to visit Thank you so much

It was a great time in the apartment!! The location was great,the room was bigger than I expected,and very comfortable. Although,we were on the highest floor of the building, so is was a bit hard with the suitcases
Great stay, only thing I could say about the flat is that the walls are really thin and I could hear a lot the flats around.  But Im use to sleep with sleepBuds so not that disturbing to me
Apart from the noisy guests downstairs the place was valued for money. We understood this can happen and not in control of all hosts

My girlfriend and I stayed at the Coppersmith Apartment for one month. We really had an amazing time. The location is perfect and you can reach most places within a 10 min walk. The place is clean and well-equipped. Restaurants, shops and grocery stores are right around the corner, so is a laundromat. The apartment is located on top of a hill, which can be quite exhausting to reach at the end of the day, but it is definitely worth the  amazing location and views around! Maria and Pedro were great hosts, replied fast and were always helpful. They even allowed us to stay longer since we accidentally mixed up the dates of our flight. We would definitely recommend staying here if you are looking for a private place in the heart of Porto.

Pedro and his mother were one of the best hosts I’ve ever had, I felt very welcomed. The place is great, it’s close to one of the greatest bars areas but it’s location prevents noise to come in. I stayed for two months and would stay again if available.

Great location in the middle of downtown. Walking distance to all the main Porto sites. The bed it's comfortable and the kitchen is well equipped. Pedro is very friendly and responsive to communications.
Cozy and nice accommodation. It's placed nearby landmarks so almost of place are walkable. Especially recommend here to 1-2 person or long-term travelers. I'm satisfied with here.
Great location close to many major attractions and great restaurants. Maria and Pedro were very helpful and friendly and always responded immediately.

Pedro and Maria are exceptional hosts and their apartment is lovely, a perfect place to enjoy Porto, and one that felt very much like being at home. I’m highly grateful for their hospitality and would prefer to stay here in future whenever I visit Porto. Highly recommend!
We had a very good stay. The apartment was in the middle of the city center which was very nice. We’d definitely book again.
Lovely space in a very central location! Nice view of the Torre des Clérigos. Clean and just as described. Would recommend.
Should of been made aware of the difficulties with the hill to get to the property Flat 7 was very high up in the property after the hill climb to the property Poor supply of toiletries

Great spacious modernist apartment! Has the most amazing wooden staircase in the building. Very well located, lots of fun galleries and local design shops, a pizza place right next door. Kitchen and bathroom have everything you might need and the terace and garden are very nice to use on a sunny day. Great experience overall, I would definetly recommend it.

We were extremely happy with our stay here. The hosts were amazing, they responded to every email within minutes and were super helpful with everything. They even let my wife use their downstairs office for a few hours after we checked out. The apartment is large and the kitchen was fully stocked with everything we needed. I highly recommend.

This is a great neighbourhood! The area is walkable with tons of restaurants, bars, and parks. The apartment is spacious and the shared backyard is a bonus if you have a pet. The team is extremely attentive. Thank you!

My friend and I had a great stay at Luis' place — the location of the apartment is fantastic, within walking distance to many attractions but also removed enough to be peaceful. The surrounding area itself had many nice stores and restaurants as well. The apartment itself was pretty much exactly as described and pictured in the listing, and we enjoyed the perks of having laundry in the building and a small balcony/garden in the back. Thank you to Carolina for your responsiveness during our stay, and for allowing us to store our luggage before and after check-in/check-out!

Very good location, restaurants and grocery stores around the corner. Takes some time to walk to the old town (15-20mins), but it’s worthy it staying in a more quiet neighbourhood. Spacious apartment, well equipped with everything you could need.

perfect location. easy access to everything. a little noisy in ront bedrooms overnight but it is not an apartment problem this is screaming people in the middle of  night.we were confused how to use cooktop.

We chose the place based on location and size and we’re not disappointed - it’s a large apartment convenient to the Porto sights.  The difference between a perfectly acceptable experience and a great one is usually in the details, however.  We would have appreciated enough supplies like bin bags and toilet paper to get us through the length of our stay, and some extra towels would have been nice.
Flat fully furnished in recently renovated building. Just one remark, there is a restaurant right below, and customers sitting outside might make it a bit noisy.

The studio was very nice. Communication was a little confusing, first morning I received an email saying checkout was at 11am without the date so I thought  booked wrong. On the day of checking in, when I sent a message, there was no reply. It was easy to get inside and the place had nice light, was clean and easy to walk to places. At night it is very noisy on the streets. There were no printed instructions and I am very sorry, I forgot to take the garbage out.

This was my favorite Airbnb that I've ever stayed at. Instructions to check-in were very easy, Airbnb was spotless, and it was very close to nearby attractions. I could walk to every place in Porto that was on my list. I would stay here again.

Flat is clean and tje position is very central, that means a bit noisy in the night, but also means you're are at short walking distance to all the major attractions in the city, which is ideal for a short stay.
The apartment was in very good conditions, it is well located, with many good restaurants within walking distance. The communication with the host was very clear and straightforward.

Best hospitality. Definitely best Airbnb experience. Every detail was planned in this apartment. It is clean and very cozy. Just 2 corners to the D.Luis Bridge. Owner is very nice person and will support when needed. I definitely recommend this apartment. :))

Pedro is a very nice homeowner, he helped us a lot, the room was clean, bright, quiet, warm, and the location was great, only need a 5mins walk to the metro. I would like to recommend this room to my friends who want to travl to Porto.
One of the best Airbnb’s we have ever stayed at, super clean and well-designed and well located.  Pedro is an excellent host and goes out of his way to help you whatever you need.
Pedro’s place was amazing! Super clean and spacious, looked better than the pictures!! I would definitely recommend this Airbnb! Loved it 😍
Do not hesitate to book Pedro's place. The location is super convenient and walkable to all the good to see places , and he keeps the place impeccably well.

Great appartment to stay in Porto for a few days. Very close to most of the main attractions in the city, everything is walkable. Communication with Pedro was really easy, quick replies, very friendly and good tips on what to do. Recommended!

We travel a lot and this has to be one of the most charming places we have ever stayed. Pedro is charming and very friendly. The pictures mated the advertisement and the amenities exceed the advertisement and our expectations. On top of that the location is unbeatable and Porto is a very charming city. We definitely plan to come back.

Pedro's place is exquisite, and Pedro was very accommodating. Our flight to Porto was delayed, and Pedro was so responsive and understanding of our late arrival. He met us and explained everything in the apartment. This was the best check-in experience we've had using Airbnb for over a decade. The apartment itself is absolutely lovely, and it's location very walkable to the Ribeiro and historic sites of Centro Porto. It is also steps away from the funicular that travels to and from the waterfront. Pedro also provided great local recommendations for food,  drinks, and sites. We highly recommend Pedro's place and would stay again in a heartbeat.
It’s was perfect! Very beautiful and well located apartment! I really appreciated all locals adresses provided by the host!

Our stay was perfect!  Pedro met us when we checked in and ensured we had everything we needed. The location was incredible!   The apartment was spotlessly clean, and the kitchen was well set up, Pedro had left us a lovely bottle of wine to enjoy.  Thank you so much for making our stay so wonderful!

Muito obrigado, Pedro! Check in was a great experience, we were able to store our luggage while we took a day trip to the Douro Valley. Pedro was so warm and accommodating. The space was spotless, updated, lots of storage available and the kitchen had everything you could need. Our only regret was that our itinerary did not allow us to stay here for more than one night. Bed was super comfy and it was a quiet area. Walking distance from Sao Bento station. Highly recommend this host and space. 100 Culpa - amazing breakfast/brunch place (100% gluten-free, enjoyed by both gluten-free and gluten friendly patrons).

Pedro was a fantastic host! Excellent communication; the apartment is spotless and close to where you want to be for a few days in Porto. Also very safe and secure. I very highly recommend this listing to everyone.

Awesome appartement in Porto with a very friendly host.  It was our second stay at Pedro's appartment and we can fully recommend it. Beside Pedro being very friendly, always available for any kind of question and even handing us some welcome drinks, the location of his appartment is perfect for a city trip. You can't get really closer to the famous bridge of Porto without being disturbed by other tourists or party. This is the perfect stay for everyone who wants to have a good sleep and a 3 min walk to the city center. Super clean and modern appartment. And Pedro did an upgrade towards 2022 and installed an air condition which is great! Also great service out of of the usual experience: Luggage service before official check in, a lot of restaurant and event recommendations and of course and always available in case you need help. Pretty sure we will book it again for our next trip to Porto. Thanks again, Pedro!

The location of this apartment is perfect. You are near to central Porto and key sights. Pedro is a welcoming and friendly host. He shared with us his tips of things to do and places to eat which came in very handy. The apartment itself is bright and clean with a comfortable bed. It is well designed and Pedro has nailed every detail for a quality AirBnB experience. This is a fantastic place to stay when visiting Porto.

Great position in town for everything. Very modern decor and "hi tec". Very light and airy with a little balcony to look out onto the  little used side road that the flat is situated on. Hard to fault.
