Incredible studio apartment that felt a lot larger than a studio. Great location, central to everything you need and want to see. Communicative host. Very helpful. The place itself was so clean and well put together. Absolutely would come back and stay here.

I would highly recommend spending your time in Porto with Pedro. The unit was absolutely amazing and frankly the photos don’t even do it justice: super clean, very spacious and everything that you need. Pedro is a thoughtful host and provided a little welcome gift, great tips and a helpful tour of the unit. There is also optional parking which is really handy to have at such a superb location in the middle of the city where parking is had to come by. Again, it was a wonderful stay !

We already miss our stay in Porto! Beautiful place in wonderful city. Loved being close to everything but just off the busy area to find a peaceful rest. The sun in the morning was the perfect wake up while relaxing on vacation. Thank you so much!

Loved this place.  Solo traveling and it made me feel super at home and safe.  Loved the bottle of wine and coffee in room.  The windows and porch were perfect.  Great AC.  Had a laundry service that I truly appreciated.  Pedro was also very friendly and helpful.  Would stay here every time if I could!  Thank you Pedro🙏
An excellent place located on a quiet street within walking distance of everything! We had an excellent stay and would rebook if given the chance! Thanks to Pedro!

We had a great stay at Pedro’s Airbnb. It was very comfortable and in a great location. Pedro was very helpful in showing us around the apartment and was on time to welcome us as soon as we arrived. We had a great stay and it makes sense why Pedro’s apartment is so highly reviewed. Hope we will be back!
Absolutely great location, close to most things! Pedro was very kind and made my stay very easy! Would stay here again

Great location - super close to the river and the bridge (lots of stairs though 😅) and walkable to most of the attractions and restaurants.  Pedro was a great host. He insisted to carry our luggages to the second floor. Sent us all helpful information before we even asked.  The place is very clean and well kept. Thank you Pedro and we enjoyed Porto from your place the fullest!

We had a nice stay at Pedro’s. The place itself looks just like the pictures. Perfect for 2 people. Clean, nicely decorated and comfortable. Walkable to all the sights around the city. He was very helpful and gave a lot of recommendations for Porto. Would recommend!

Perfect! Close to city centre, train/metro station, bakery, shops etc. No loud noises from the city, only some footsteps from the apartments upstairs. The place was 100% clean, modern, everything you need is there. Pedro was very welcoming and he was kind enough to let us store our bags when we arrived early!  We highly recommend 'Neta 3' for breakfast. 5 minutes from the apartment.

Irene’s place was phenomenal. It was close to just about everything and arriving from the Sao Bento train station, the flat is just 2 min away walking which was easy for me given I had heavy luggage 😅. Irene was such a great host, even met me on arrival and checked throughout my stay to ensure I was comfortable. Would highly recommend and would stay here again!

Irene was the perfect host, and the flat was even better than it looks on the pictures. She was extremely helpful with tips etc during our stay, would definitely come back. Only downside was construction nearby which was a bit loud at some points. But everything else was perfect and will definitely recommend this.

This is a gorgeous apartment in a super convenient location. As with most places that are located in the center of a city, there is a bit of street noise, but it wasn't extreme. Irene is a fantastic host and helped us with anything we needed. We would absolutely stay here again.

Gorgeous listing in the HEART of Porto. Irene’s listing is just as described and she was fantastic with communication and expectations. If you have a car, you can park at Praça Dom João parking garage right by the listing for a fee. However, staying at Irene’s - you won’t need a car to explore the gorgeous city!

Irene’s place is beautiful and centrally located to all of Porto’s historic sites and great restaurants. I especially loved the comfortable linens. There is a lovely cafe downstairs from the apartment for morning coffee and pastries. I recommend this place and would stay here again if returning to Porto.
Great host and beautiful apartment in the perfect location. Irene was very helpful getting us settled in and working with our schedule after our flight was delayed. Highly recommend!
Wonderful stay! The apartment was beautiful and Irene was a great host.  Thank you for having us!
We greatly enjoyed Irene’s place! It was convenient to everything, had great amenities and Irene was incredibly hospitable and responsive! Highly recommend.

We had an incredible stay at Irene’s! It was the perfect location to explore Porto - walkable from major sights and restaurants. The apartment itself was exactly as the pictures depicted - very clean, tasteful and accommodating. Others have mentioned noise at night and from construction- we were not bothered at all by either (ear plugs were offered). We would definitely stay here again!

This is a wonderful place to stay in Porto - it is clean, exactly like the photos, and it is a well kept apartment! Irene is an excellent host and she went above and beyond in her communication and preparation for the place. I would highly recommend you book this place for your stay.
Fabulous stay at the heart of everything. The bed was so comfortable, shower was powerful and apartment very peaceful. Thank you Irene.
As described in the description, my only concern was the back door did not have a lock and was continuously open.
Kinga and Antonio are super nice, for the house, u will get whatever you want, love this place!

Lovely apartment about 20mins outside Porto centre. Comfortable beds and great outdoor space. Pool was a godsend.  Communications by the owner were great and very helpful.  Used Ubers to get in and out of Porto easily and wasn’t expensive.
It’s on a quiet street which has good places to eat and a laundromat nearby. The location is walkable to all popular sights.  The unit was very clean and newly painted. Hosts were very communicative.
We booked it very late because our other accommodation was cancelled on the same day. The team helped us very quickly and got us this perfect room in no time!
Had a good stay. The AC heater didn’t help much, but overall ok. Someone got into the apartment during my stay, that made me feel uncomfortable and unsafe. Good price though.

Great location, reasonable size for the price, and very attentive host. My only issue was the musty smell which has probaby been caused by the visible damp in a couple of the rooms. Other than that would highly recommend.

Responded to my messages almost immediately! Very helpful. Flexible check-in, and when I needed to extend my stay for a few days helped me get into another unit right away (the first one had already been booked or I would have stayed there). They gave helpful information for the area and it is really the perfect location. Felt very safe, and easy to get around town. Had to pay attention to make sure building front door locked when coming/going.
would recommend if you're wanting to party, can be loud in the early hours if you're wanting to get up early!
The place and hosts were great! Very nice location,  and the noise from the party street below is very managable.  We had a fantastic time and will be back!

We stayed in this apartment for two nights. The apartment is fully equipped to meet basic needs. The location is excellent, and you can reach the classic attractions in just over ten minutes on foot.  The noise problem is worth paying attention to. The bar downstairs will continue until more than two in the morning and until dawn on Friday night.
Because I am undisturbed by noise while I sleep, I thought the location was excellent. So close to absolutely everything I wanted to do!
Amazing central location in a quiet street, couldn't have asked for more. The accommodation was great, just like in the pictures. Me and my friends enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back.
The apartment was really clean, quiet and in a wonderful location next to the Sao Bento station and all shops and restaurants. The host was really responsive and I enjoyed my stay.

This is a lovely comfortable apartment. Like most of Porto, an old building outside but refurbished to a lovely modern standard inside including the shared entrance. Great wifi and comfortable bed and great shower. Located in a small alley behind one of the main streets in the Historic area just a short walk from Sao Bento metro from the airport and the great vibe of Ribeira waterfront. The safe and quiet locked alleyway also leads the other way towards the Cathedral so a great location for exploring Porto and still a short walk to go back for a rest! Just make sure you confirm before hand with the hosts where the location of the keybox is as there are 10 of them! Accessed via R. da Ponte Nova next to Starbucks. Happily stay here again.

Susana and Pedro were very accurate and well organized hosts. Through their clean and very well-located property, we had an amazing experience and were able to thoroughly enjoy Porto. Highly recommend!
Very good location and charming apartment. The street was just a little noisy so we had trouble sleeping the window open.
We had a good stay, but it does get noisy outside at night, so it was hard to get some sleep during the weekend.
Cute little apartment, very clever with the kitchen. For us was quiet at night, no problem with the noise outside.
Excellent!!! Perfect location with lots of bars and restaurants near by. Also not far from anywhere.    Highly recommend if staying in Porto!!

Lovely compact studio appartment - ideal for 2. Easy walkable access to town centre and local bars & restaurants.  No air conditioning though and it was very warm at night. We could not open windows as the street is noisy. However our request for a second fan was acted upon immediately. Overall a nice stay and would recommend
We enjoyed our stay for 5 days, would consider selecting the place if we come back. Clean and good surroundings.
lovely place, hosts were responsive and helpful. I had a great time. A lot is walkable and the neighborhood was quiet.

An apartment with character in a top location. It's an old building so the noise isolation is a bit on the weaker side. After the first night I had no issues sleeping though and the street outside is not too busy.
Great communication, very nice apartment, close to my favorite part of Porto. Host was very willing to help make my stay as comfortable as possible. Would recommend!
The apartment was very nice and comfortable. The host was very friendly and responsive. Would definitely come back to this host and to this apartment.

Loved our time here in Porto. The room was super comfy and had everything we needed. The location was perfect! Right next to great bars and a short walk down to the water. We were also grateful that Susana had a fan turned on for us when we arrived! We would definitely return.

Susana’s apartment is in the perfect spot for a city break in Porto. All of the sights are in short walking distance from the apartment, and there are plenty of great bars, cafes and restaurants nearby. The apartment had absolutely everything we needed - the kitchenette area in particular was really handy. Thank you Susana for a wonderful stay in a beautiful city! 🌉

I had such a wonderful stay at Susana’s place. The accommodation was perfect for a short stay and felt very comfortable. It is in a great location and you can walk easily to all the main attractions. Plus there are plenty of cafés, restaurants and shops around. Susana herself is a great host and always very responsive and helpful. I wish I could have stayed longer.

Great location for all the sights of Porto. Need to be physically fit as it’s on a steep hill but so is most of Porto! Easy check in and accommodation was as described, very comfy and quiet at night.  Susana arranged our return taxi which turned up on time as requested.  Would recommend this accommodation.

Clean apartment, good communication with the host. The location of the apartment was great, lots of Cafés and close to all the sights. Nevertheless it was very noisy, especially at night. We couldn’t sleep well, because we heard music from a club all night.

The apartment itself was great, however, the communication was absolutely terrific. We didn't know how to check in until an hour before we arrived despite many attempts. When we were to check out, the office was closed.

A very nice, little, quiet and cosy place with all you need for some days.  Very close to everything.  You don't need public transport, except if you want to go to the sea.  The balcony is the jackpot!
This place is perfect! Has everything you need, without having anything you don’t need. Plus, the location is perfect for walking around to explore Porto.
We loved staying here! Great location, very clean, perfect for two people for a few days. The design of the space was great, and the balcony was a nice addition.
This was a great location.  Communication was clear and timely.  The place was as listed and we enjoyed the little balcony.  Very nice place to stay in Porto.

This was a lovely apartment.  Everything was very nicely decorated and very well appointed.   The washing machine was an excellent addition.  We loved sitting out on the balcony in the morning and the evening.    Comfortable and classy!!

Amazing location, a short walk to restaurants and sightseeing spots as well as travel links throughout the city and to the seaside. The balcony was lovely with a lot of afternoon sun and the room was pleasantly decorated with everything you could need. The hosts were great with a lot of information about the city which really helped us enjoy our time in the city. Would love to visit again, thank you!

Small cozy place, we did not spend a lot of time in the apartment, so it was fine. We did enjoy the small balcony. The location was perfect. Everything was within waking distance. The apartment is on the third floor so be ready to get your luggage upstairs. Good experience. I would rent there again.

Everything was good the place and the rooms were clean and nice designed!  The problem was the noise from the upstairs it was literally too much some times and at some point the bathroom’s ceiling was dropping water The check in check out was super easy and the team really good to communicate with

The apartment is located very well if you want to see the center of Porto.  The apartment is super clean and well maintained. We especially enjoyed the cozy terrace. The only thing you should be aware of, is the loudness. We could here out upstairs neighbors all the time.

This Airbnb is ideally located near Sao Bento station, and a quick 10-15 minute walk from top locations like Clerigos Tower, Porto Cathedral, Livraria Lello, etc. It's also a quick 5-minute walk from a Minipreco where you can stock up on breakfast and snack items. The home itself is spacious, bright, and comfortable--with all the amenities you need. Most importantly, it has a dishwasher and clothes rack to do that load of dirty laundry you've been carrying around (!), and a sweet, cozy patio to enjoy the sunny outdoors. The only negative (as mentioned by others) is the relentless trampling and thudding from the upstairs unit. The insulation is so poor that you can hear every thud and creak, and if you have active neighbors, unfortunately the noise can be very disruptive.

Perfect location and the accomodation looks exactly as on the pictures. True is that the bathroom door would deserve to be fixed as it is almost imposible to close it and you can indeed hear the neighbours. Overall this didn' impact my stay and I would stay again at the same place.

lovely accommodation, very central next to Sao Bento station. Air-conditioning and balcony a definite bonus. very small apartment but fine for a single person or couple for a short time. please note there is an elevator which mat be beneficial to guests with mobility issues aa the apartment us on the 3rd floor (almost 60 steps!!!) Things which could have improved our stay: a handle in inside of bathroom door (it's difficult to slide open and shut)  another comfortable chair in the living room area a tea towel to dry dishes more plug points in the kitchen more pillows however, these are only suggestions. we enjoyed our stay,  recommend and would stay again. thank you

A really great stay here. Very central to all of the key sites. It was also useful that the company office is 2 doors away who were more than helpful, especially with leaving bags before check-in/out.  A really memorable stay!!
Despite being situated next to the train station, the apartment was so quiet and peaceful! Absolutely zero complaints, probably the best airbnb i’ve ever stayed in :)
Great location! Easy to get to many of the attractions. Really easy to communicate to the host. Thank you very much!

We loved our stay at Diogo’s apartment. The apartment is very central and in a fabulous location. Felt safe and private. Check in was easy. Decent sized apartment, great for two people. The stay would have been even better if there was things like shampoo/conditoner/washing powder/ enough coffee pods to cover the entire stay (i.e 6 for our 3 night stay instead of 2). Otherwise, amazing airbnb. Would recommend if visiting Porto! 😊

We loved this apartment. It was relight beside the time out food market and in such a good location. The balcony was enjoyable to sit outside in the mornings. The bed was really comfy and we liked the air conditioning.
Very nice apartment, small but everything is there. Perfect location, in the middle of the city center

We had a lovely 2 night stay at Marta's airbnb. Well located apartment with parking always available just outside. Kitchen is a bit small but has everything you need for a short stay. Marta was very nice and always responsive. Would recommend!
Good apartment. Nicely renovated and functional.   Its a bit small but good windows that give you space feeling.  Near the sea and about 35 min drive to Porto.  I liked it.

We booked this apartment to stay in a quiet area close to the coast and, ideally, to the metro as well. Marta's place matched our expectations, totally. It's a nice modern apartment, located within a walkable distance from the beach. It's clean, cozy and reasonably equipped. The hosts were kind enough to ask beforehand if we preferred two separate beds. Overall, a good option if you are looking for a peaceful hide in this part of the greater Porto. Recommended.

Comfortable apartment, well equipped. Feeling like you are at home. Great location - everything is within walking distance - close to shops, beach, restaurants, metro, etc. The host is very friendly, always available with advice.

Bright, clean and spacious appartement steps away from the beach and a few restaurants. We are a family of 3 and stayed for 2 nights . It was a comfortable and smooth experience from the booking all the way to the checkout. Shops closeby and free parking across the street.

The property is full of bed bugs - myself and my husband suffered from painful bed bugs bigs. We had long sleepless nights. We made contact with the property management but nothing was done to solve the issue. I would strongly advise against staying here. We had to throw most of our holiday clothes as we were worried to transfer the bed bugs to our home. In addition to all of that, the flat is at terrible condition and it feels like things will fell off. The kitchen sink stinks really bad like something rotten. The toilet seat is broken and at terrible condition.  This flat is a health hazard and does not deserve the renting value. I would strongly suggest to avoid it. Its not cheap and you can get a better deal with that money.
As described, maybe a bit on the pricier side for what it is but close to the beach and nice bars and restaurants nearby. The host was friendly and helpful. Free parking right outside the Airbnb.

I found the apartment to be fine, great location and you would communicate with me... you know the iron damaged my clothes, I even tried it on a lower heat with a video to an old shirt, it still damaged it.... I’ll be taking this further, trust me
Would recommend. Very central to Porto in teh thick of it. Premium price but well equiped and very nicely decorated
Great location. Very clean. The construction noise was not a problem. They worked during normal daytime hours when we were not in the apartment anyway. The restaurant across the street was excellent.

My husband and I had a wonderful stay here!! It was spotless and cozy and in the perfect location close to everything that Porto has to offer! The hosts were also super attentive and responsive! Thank you for a great stay!!! ❤️
The place was very welcoming, close to the city center. Had everything we needed, both Marisa and Mario were very helpful. Would visit again without a doubt!

Thank you so much for hosting us at your wonderful Airbnb in Porto. Everything during our stay was excellent! We made sure to leave everything as we found it. We really appreciate your hospitality and hope to visit again in the future!
One of the best airbnb experiences I’ve had. Check-in was seamless. Clean and comfortable apartment. Location is unbeatable. 10/10

The apartment was very well located in Porto and was clean and tidy.  A comment: I used to let a property (in the Algarve), and always left tea bags, coffee capsules, milk etc in the apartment for guests to use. There was nothing like that in this apartment, not even a bottle of water. I think this could/should be made more explicit on the information relating to bookings. Apart from that, the apartment felt secure and was in a good neighbourhood.  Dr Mark D
Nice apartment in the center of Porto. Has everything you need, clean and comfortable. Silvia helped us with everything, thanks to her for a pleasant accommodation

Great location within walking distance of many key sites and bars/restos etc. Very clean and well-equipped with amenities. Host is very welcoming and responsive. The only negative comment is that it can get a bit noisy at night when bars finish.

Great location, the place was clean and everything promised was provided. Since we were travelling with a baby there was a crib set up with blankets, towels and even a teddy bear. Kitchen was equipped, so we could make dinner or breakfast ourselves. Also plenty of closet space.
Central to everything. However, the place is on top of a commercial. Fantastic for two people, with kids or more than two it feels small.  Looks like in the pictures.
Really nice place - clean, great location close to the center, the only problem we had was the small window in the toilet which we had do cover somehow because everyone could see through.

we had a lovely stay at the apartment! we had to prolong our stay, and the host was super responsive we even managed to stay there for extra days.  the apartment is clean and welcoming, with a comfy bed. Thank you very much !

The apartment is in the center of the center. Good part is convenience, bad one is the disturbances on the street. We stayed during the Holy week, for some reasons people chanted and bang on something at 5am two days in a roll. Plus the area is going through construction. Get the earplugs ready!
maria is a very kind landlady, had a late evening arrival and checkin was no problem. overall well equipped, clean apartment with top location
Amazing location and lovely room! The hosts had fantastic recommendations and the area was central to many great restaurants/sites.
We have been very nicely welcomed. The place is clean and very functional. The location is perfect!
Great location. Really nice apartment. A little bit noisy outside as you can expect in the city center

Maria was a wonderful host! Her and her team were helpful and provided local recommendations on places to eat and things to do. The location was perfect, so close to everything we did and made everything walkable!

This is a stellar place to stay when visiting Porto or the surrounding areas. It has fantastic views and wonderful location to the waterfront. The host was very communicative and accomplished. Would highly recommend for 2 people to stay.
What a beautiful place in a perfect location. Host was very accommodating with great communication. Will definitely stay here again on my next trip to this beautiful city
We really enjoyed the stay, great appartement, clean, well located. Check-in and communication were smooth. We recommand it !

This is a fantastic apartment, perfectly located in the centre of Porto. It is very well equipped and was really clean when we arrived. The host was really good with communication both before and during the stay and offered us great advice on getting the most out of the city. We will come again!
This is a stylish apartment with a great view in an excellent location for exploring Porto. Note the sunken bed is not the easiest to get in and out of if this could be an issue for you.

We couldn’t have asked for a more ideal location for our long weekend in Porto. The apt. was clean and modern with great views. Checkin went smooth and we were offered some great tips on places to visit and eat.

Beautiful stay In Porto- the host was incredibly responsive and checked in often. The area is centrally located and the view from the room is amazing. I would stay here again in future travels to Porto
The location and the views from the unit was incredible. Able to enjoy the port as well as the city of Porto  Patricia was a great host, very accommodating

Gorgeous flat in a fantastic location. It had everything I needed as someone traveling alone.  That view! The low mattress ( a full-thickness mattress fitted into a depression in the floor and topped with a comfort topper) was great for me but would not work for everyone. Would not hesitate to book here again!
Such a great spot, beautiful view and amazingly well appointed apartment. The bed was super comfy, the place spotless. Basically, highly recommended!

The location is perfect. A short walk to the river and access bridges to the adjoining neighbourhood. The view is stunning,  both during the day and at night with the illuminated places if interest.  Excellent restaurants are close by. Book early as they fill up fast. The best places to eat are generally not along the river edge.

We loved our place in Porto. It was in a great location with an awesome river view. It was clean, bright, and modern. The bed was comfortable, but be aware that it’s recessed into the floor in sort of a Japanese style, and might not be easy for some older or physically challenged people to get in/out of. Overall, we loved it and would recommend it highly.

The pictures does not do this place justice. How can I capture in words how wonderful this place is?! The views were out of this world. It was easy access and walking distance to local attractions, restaurants and transportation. The place was cozy, clean and kid friendly. The host was super friendly, kind and full of life. It was such a pleasure to stay here. Snatch it up if you’re traveling into Porto. This place is a gem!

View was amazing and location was very central. Space was beautiful. The built in mattress in the bedroom was a bit of a challenge to get in and out of.  Host was very helpful and responsive.  Overall we had a great stay.
The location was perfect and the keyless entry is a nice addition. However the sunken bed is not ideal. I think it I good place for an individual traveller but too small for a couple.

The apartment is as lovely as it looks in the photos. As other reviews say, the view is fabulous, and the location is great. The downsides for us were: the bed - we are okay with a bed on the floor but this one is actually sunken and the mattress is a bit soft - it is very awkward getting out;  also, although there is a small closet with hangers and shelves, there is no place for suitcases except the floor of the dining area and no place to unpack small items except the dining table. A tip:  we had a rental car and parked in the closest garage mentioned in the listing. It cost 166 euros to park for 3 nights.
This apartment was just WOW!! Exactly as seen on pictures and very very close to everything you can think of. We were truly happy with our stay!

I had the most amazing stay in Porto thanks to this Airbnb! The location was absolutely perfect, so central to everything I wanted to do in the city and close to some great restaurants as well, and the apartment itself was gorgeous, stylish, and so clean. I especially loved the meticulous details throughout, such as the washing machine, dryer, and dishwasher tucked away in the kitchen (which was also well-stocked with dishes as well as some oil and seasonings for cooking) as well as the wall panels that unfolded to create window coverings. The views were also fantastic! Could not say enough great things about this place.
Beautiful space, great view and most importantly, the host was very helpful and immediately responded when questions were asked. Highly recommended!

This was a very unique and enjoyable space. The bed was very comfortable, the space was very clean, and the view from the living room was breathtaking. The spot is also in the perfect location for exploring and close to some great food spots. We would book again without question!
Stunning views of the river. Stylish decor. The sunken bed is unusual but perfectly fine. We had no street noise during our February stay.

We had a lovely stay in Porto! The view and location are absolutely unbeatable - waking up to that view every day was such a treat. The building has an elevator, which was a really appreciated perk. The kitchen was well equipped, with a spacious fridge and freezer, which made it easy to prepare meals. The host was very communicative and checked in frequently to make sure our needs were met, which we truly appreciated. There are a few aspects of the space that might benefit from some minor adjustments to improve comfort, but overall, this is a stylish and well-located apartment that's ideal for travelers who prioritize aesthetics and location.

What a gem of a stay in Porto! ✨ The apartment was spotless and stylish, clearly put together by someone with a great eye for detail. Each morning we woke up to the most stunning Douro River views, and every evening we got front-row seats to the sunset—pure magic. 🌅 The location couldn’t have been better: right in the heart of the city, so exploring was a breeze. And our host? Absolutely amazing—when we accidentally left things behind, they even helped ship them all the way back to the U.S. Talk about next-level hospitality! 5/5 stars without a doubt.

Douro was a really great host. We had a bit of trouble with the lock and he seemed to be somewhere around the corner ready to assist. The space was a bit smaller than I anticipated but the pictures do show it well. Do be careful of the steps as they are steep. Douro also allowed us to keep our luggage in the space after check out since we did not have any other accommodations — I highly recommend this to everyone!

The apartment was very nice and clean but it was very hard to sleep since the apartment didn’t have any air conditioning or fans and we went in the summer. The host was not as helpful as I’d have liked, we had some communication problems.
It is a very small apartment with very basic amenities. Bathroom is not very well designed and water was clogging. For family of four it is very small with only 2 blankets and no spare pillows.

Little and nice apartment, it was very clean but the fact that it has no heating is an inconvinient. We went in January and it was very cold. If you want to visit the center of Porto maybe it's not the best option, as it's 1h walking, however, if you book a taxi is 16min aprox. Douro was very nice and fast comunication.

Douro’s place was nicely located. It was sorely deserved by little cafes and restaurants. It is a taxi drive away from the center of the city, so there isn’t any metro transportation close by but it isn’t an extreme distance. The area is very peaceful and quiet. The upstairs area is a bit different from the pictures, so that was the only con. Apart from that it was a great area and Douro was very responsive.
Lovely place with even lovelier surroundings. So peaceful and tranquil. It feels like a Portuguese small town right next to Porto.
lovely place to stay, everything was spotless clean. everything was working as it should, lovely shower. few restaurants and shops around, but mostly cash only.  definitely will stay again.

We booked this stay for 1 night , it was a bit smaller than expected but did what it needed to do in terms of giving us a space to lay our heads. In a peaceful neighbourhood with a lot of seafood restaurants near by. 15 min drive from Porto. Good location if you want a change from the busy Porto
It was great stay, very clean flat, small but has everything needed for long or short stay  Would highly recommend!

The location of the house was perfect and everythings' was in order apart from the fact that there was really less ventilation and heath, I cannot imagine stay in this house during summer without a proper air conditioning system.
Lovely apartment, the host was proactive and always available. The position is perfect, very close to many activities.
Great location, perfect for a short stay but noisy and difficult to sleep due to staff at old folks home next door shouting to each other in the very early hours of the morning. Otherwise very good!

Excellent location for transport.  very close to luis bridge and all the Port Cellars.  River cruise. cable car and finicular.  Mini preco supermarket very close. larger supermarket Pingo a 15 minute walk.   fantastic bakery on the corner of street. General Torres tram line and train station end of road.  5 minute walk.   Very safe and secure. Super large balcony.   There is no view from apartment.  You are facing the back of other apartments.  This did not put us off at all.  I would stay again  Fillipa kept in contact all the time.

I can’t say enough how much we enjoyed our stay with Elisabete. She is so genuine and heartwarming. Her guest house is so warm, inviting and clean. Rooms very private .  Breakfast spectacular.  2 minute walk off the Camino for pilgrims.  Her Camino knowledge was invaluable. We travel a lot and this was by far our best stay ever.  Don’t think twice about it, just book it!!
Beautiful apartment within walking distance of everywhere you would want to go in Porto and great value. The huge balcony and window views of the city is an added bonus!
We enjoyed our stay. It‘s a very nice and comfortable place in the middle of Porto with a great view from the balcony. Well located, you can reach a lot of touristic places by walking from there.

The apartment was gorgeous - exactly as described, all very new and has everything you need. The location is great for exploring Porto and there is a metro station 5 minutes away with a direct line to the airport. The check in and check out process was very straightforward, and there was a great list of local suggestions. We had a wonderful stay and wouldn’t hesitate to stay again.

Very bright and clean apartment. Location is great 5-7 min to metro station. Tones of restaurants and cafes with in couples of blocks. You don’t have to meet anyone to check it which is a big plus in my opinion.

A lovely and cozy apartment with a wonderful balcony and everything you need to have a great stay in Porto. It is very central and near almost everything, monuments, supermarkets, coffee shops and some great restaurants. Would recommend without a doubt!
This Airbnb is located in a perfect location for tourist. I stayed here with 1 other person & there was plenty of space for the both of us. It was a plus having access to a balcony.

Very clean new apartment. Walkable to everywhere. Located on a busy intersection , so great people-watching from the wraparound balcony. Once the balcony doors are closed, very quiet inside. Several interesting bars and restaurants within a couple blocks. I recommend a dinner at Olume a few doors down, great cuisine and service.

Location was great. Apartment is on the corner with a nice balcony so you get a great sunny view.   My stay was good with the exception of coming home one night to a remote controlled light that had turned on by itself and was going off on strobe mode (felt like a dance club). I couldn’t figure out how to turn it off and  didn’t receive any help on the matter until the following morning so had to try and sleep through it, which was not easy.  More of a random mishap, and I would still recommend this place for being in the heart of Porto.

Great location and very clean and tidy. Host was very responsive and friendly. Check in was also simple and easy. Area was a little noisy but just like any city centre and location was definitely worth it. Windows and light were amazing, highly recommend this Airbnb.

The good: Great location, nice apartment, very clean and modern.  The reason it got 4 stars and not 5 was because the kitchen supplies were very lacking.  When I book Airbnbs, I do it because I expect to be able to fully utilize the kitchen, otherwise I would just stay in a hotel.  The only pan was the most scratched Teflon pan I have ever seen. It was missing some other basic things like spatulas, oven mitts etc.   Some other things to note: getting to the apartment is a bit confusing if you follow g**gle maps, but just read their instructions and you will see what street it is on.  However, lots of people have had this complaint and they have not taken the effort to adjust their check-in instructions to be more clear. The place has a lot of potential, but its clear its a property management company that doesn't seem to be worried about the finer details.

A very nice apartment. It has a lot of daylight and a great sun balcony. The location is perfect for getting anywhere and there is a lot of activity around. It can sometimes get a bit noisy, but nothing that disturbed us too much.

Certainly! Here’s a more professional and polished review: "We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and within walking distance of everything in Porto. The host was very responsive and ensured a smooth experience. The only improvements we would suggest are adding a TV in the bedroom and providing small blankets in the living area for added comfort. Overall, a highly recommended stay."

The apartment was beautiful and exactly as described - airy, light and very clean with a great outdoor terrace with plenty of room to sit. Joaquim and Joana were great hosts as well, very responsive and proactive in their comms and provided a mid-week refresh clean during our stay. Would recommend for anyone visiting Porto and would gladly stay again
We had a lovely stay. The apartment is in a great location, easy to walk to the train station, restaurants and shops. I’d highly recommend staying here!

Great location! Everything you need is walking distance. Communication was also great, we received everything we needed to know ahead and also videos of how to use the bed on the wall and other Stuff, which was really helpful. Thank you!  The Apartment is equipped with the basics, but was missing some small things you don‘t want to buy while travelling like salt & pepper, oil, a scissor etc. Talked to the owner and they said they would provide it for the next guests though :) Check-in is 4 pm and check-out is 10 am, which I find a little early, when you are on vacation. The Place is really small so I don‘t think it takes that long to clean and prepare for the next guests. Upon request we were allowed to check-out half an hour later though. All in all we really enjoyed our stay in Porto, which is a lovely city and we would Book the Apartment again :)
Great place. Excellent location.  Cozy and clean. Close to everything.  Wonderful host. I would recommend to anyone.
Great and comfortable stay here with friends! Highly recommended. The area is very nice, close to the river and near many restaurants and shops. Would definitely come back.

Well located…Porto is at you doorstep. Finding the flat was very easy if you are arriving at Sao Bento. The flat was extremely easy to check in to and the team supporting the flat were very communicative. There is ample room in this stylish flat. We were travelling with two teenagers and everyone was able to find space.  When we find ourselves in Porto next time, we would certainly stay here again.

YourOPO is an extremely professional host in both service and the appartement standard! Only reason for not granting 5 stars is the outside noice. There is a new underground metro line being build in front if the building and it will probably take a few more months (summer 2023) to finish. Nonetheless I recommend the place.

This place is beautiful and serene, well located, and easy to find.  We felt very comfortable and right at home. The staff was extremely responsive, helpful and always welcoming and friendly. They gave us a helpful map and many local recommendations, which were very helpful.  We appreciated having lockers on site to leave our things when we arrived early, and we very much appreciated having a lift/elevator because we were on the top floor. A couple of things that needed to be attention were attended to right away. The kitchen is beautiful but quite small, which is fine if you’re not really planning to do more than make coffee.  The main issue with the kitchen is it could use better lighting.  This is a wonderful place to stay and we enjoyed it very much.

The location was absolutely perfect—close to everything we wanted to see and do! It made getting around super convenient. The host was incredibly proactive and responsive, checking in before and during our stay to make sure everything was going smoothly.

Good location, close to some nice neighborhood restaurants and a park as well as the metro station. Maria was very helpful with parking our van and suggestions for restaurants, both of which were very good.

Amazing stay at this Air Bnb. Extremely clean and they provide robes which is a nice touch. Check in was extremely easy, we arrived a bit earlier than we had said and they were able to accommodate for us. The bathroom felts like hotel bathrooms and the area is very quiet and nice. It was a 20 minute walk from most of the places we ate at but an easy walk!
The apartment is a good location - about 20 min walk to the downtown Porto area. Convenient to have the garage on site. Hosts were great and incredibly responsive.
Really nice place, spacious and high quality! Location is very good, but the downside is the noise from the bars outside.
Beautiful appartement, the location couldn't be more perfect and the communication went quick and nice. I would definitely recommend the appartement of Paula & Rafael!

I stayed here for 2 weeks with my wife and dog, and we had a great time. Check-in was smooth, the host was helpful, and we found everything we needed in the apartment to work and relax and there is plenty to do in the area.  I would definitely stay again.
Highly recommend for your stay in Porto. Greta location for sights and restaurants. 15 min walk to the river

Paula and Rafael’s apartment is clean, spacious, well equipped and very conveniently located. You can walk to all the sights that Porto has to offer. The neighbourhood also has some fantastic restaurants, some of which are mentioned in Paula and Rafael’s guide to Porto.  My wife and I couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay in Porto.

My friend and I booked Paula & Rafael’s place for two nights in Porto. We wished we could stay longer! It was exactly as pictured, a beautiful oasis that allowed us to rest and relax. The self check in was super smooth with the instructions! And such a plus to have a washer/dryer.
Had such an amazing stay here, the location was more than perfect and we could walk to places very easily. The space was beautiful and I’d love to come back and visit.

The place is very cool! Everything is very walkable. Tons of restaurants and historic sites right out the door. The apartment itself is surprisingly quiet even though it’s in the midst of of so much constant activity.

The loft was fantastic, really pretty and very clean.  The location is really great and central, yet the loft is very quiet so you're not affected by noise.  Paula and Rafael always respond in a timely manner and had local recommendations.  Overall stay was fab! Can't wait to be back!
Very nice apartment in a very good location.  A lot of good restaurants nearby. Besides a bit of fixer uppers in the apartment (e.g kitchen door) everything was perfect.
One of the best apartments where we have stayed so far. There are everything that you need, even air conditioner. And location is perfect.
Great location- close to restaurants and bars. Walkable. The only issue if you are a light sleeper the noise from the bars and restaurants might bother you.
Lovely stay in this host. Very modern and new, looks so beautiful. Only the neighborhood  is a bit loud. I would reccommend it!

The apartment is so lovely, clean, and in a great location for exploring Porto. We did have an issue a few nights into our stay with smoke coming into the apartment, which we think came from a chimney close to the bedroom window. It carried on for a few nights and was very unpleasant. The host said they have never experienced this issue before, so it may have been a one-off, but we checked out early due to the smell and having difficulty sleeping.
It really was a beautiful apartment, and we felt right at home. It's very spacious and really couldn't complain about any of the facilities.

The place is as described. Very clean and enough space. It's really in the centre of Porto, which means you can fully enjoy how life is in Porto ;-). Perfect place to stay for a couple of days to visit the city.

It was our first time in Porto. The location of the apartment is really good, easy to get there with metro, bus or simply walk 10 minutes to the train station. There are a lot of possibilities for shopping, nice restaurants and all the tourist spots are close. The apartment is great, and has everything one needs for a tourist staying, we could cook, sleep well, and even use Nerflix... I would recommend the place!

The place was just perfect. Really good area with lots of nice restaurants and easy to get around the city. The apartment is just like the pictures. The bed was good and everything was clean and new. Would recommend everyone to visit this apartment when in Porto.
The apartment is very lovely yet it would be better if it was better soundproofed, the constant noise is a little anoying.

Construction STRAIGHT next to the window even though we were on the top (3rd) floor — we even had to keep the blinds closed in the bedroom the entire day because otherwise they could look inside. They started at 7am and continued until 8pm. When consulting the owner, we were told they are bound by law to stop working at 5pm. When we first texted that they were continuing until 8pm, the only reply we got was "I cannot believe it." Furthermore, the stopper in the bathroom sink wasn't working, so after the first day the sink was full of water and unusable. After texting the owner, we only received an unhelpful tip and then no further replies. The flat itself was cute, but we paid way too much for the experience we got — very unfortunate!

Great location in Bonfim, close to the Metro and walking distance to many good restaurants and attractions.  The apartment is impeccable—nicely appointed, clean and quiet.  Oh and the balcony was perfectly tranquil. We worked remotely a few hours and internet speed was good.  Highly recommend this place.
Wonderful.  Beautiful apartment very central to the heart of a beautiful city.  Would definitely recommend.

We actually dealt with Pedro who was a superb host. Apartment was very well appointed and we needed for nothing. Monday can be a quieter place for restaurants we discovered and Pedro recommended a restaurant which was a highlight. He was also able to recommend a supermarket within a 5 minute walk on a Sunday evening. On our last day our flight wasn’t until 7pm and I asked if there was any chance of a later checkout. Pedro made this possible.  If you like the look of the apartment and the sound of what is on offer then this was another great Airbnb experience
Very nice Airbnb. Excellent position in the city. Everything we needed was there and easily found  great attention to detail
The apartment was great, really liked it. Great location, clean and very responsive.  When we go to Porto again, I would definitely stay again.

The place was such a perfect location to access so much in Porto. We walked to everything- the river, many historical sites, restaurants, arts, and cultural attractions. We loved the modern design and layout of the place. Our host was very responsive. Highly recommend!

Great place to stay. Stay in a local area in a beautiful Marina, getting to escape from the cities busyness. You can easily access anywhere in Porto by using an electric scooter for extremely cheap. I would highly recommend especially if you are traveling with a car given the free parking not easy to get in most airbnbs across Porto. A very pleasant experience.
It is truly a unique night in a boat. The marina is a cool place to hang out, and not that far from Porto, it was gorgeous on Sunsets !
It was a beautiful place. It is about a 20-25 minute walk to the city’s center.

The apartment is recently renovated and very comfy! The furniture is bright and friendly.  We had some problems with the electricity, but Paulo was very easy to reach so he fixed the problem very fast. It was a great stay. Thank you!

We had the most amazing stay at Paulo’s place during our stay in Porto - it was the a wonderfully decorated, very practical apartment with everything we needed! Extremely clean and modern with a few lovely touches. Will definitely be back!
Pauli’s place is super clean and spacious. It has a great location, close to everything. Highly recommend!

The apartment is lovely--clean, bright, comfortable--and the location is terrific, just 150 feet up a cobbled street off the Duoro river and a lively part of the Ribeira.  Uber/cab drivers find it a little hard to get to, and the slow creaky elevator to the fourth floor is somewhat intimidating.  But it's a nice place and a good value.

Paulos appartment is very beautiful, in a great area of the city. It's comfortable, very quiet at night and day and easy to reach from the airport. It is very near to the beautiful river and has everything you need for a good stay.
Paulo was super responsive! We loved staying at his place. It was walkable to all of Porto! He was an excellent host.

Staying at Paulo’s apartment in Porto was a fantastic experience. Its central location allowed me to effortlessly explore the city on foot. The apartment was exceptionally clean, offering all the comforts needed for a pleasant stay. Paulo was quick to respond to any queries, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable visit. I appreciated his attention to detail and readiness to assist. I highly recommend Paulo’s place for anyone visiting Porto. It’s perfect for a comfortable and convenient stay. Looking forward to returning!

Overall this place was great, we did have an issue where the wardrobe wouldn't open (would be an issue for longer stays) and we weren't sure about walking straight into the bedroom but generally this is a great place to stay.  The location is great and it has everything you need.
Great location! Pretty accurate description. Only thing is elevator never works and it was a lot of stairs with luggage.
Lovely apartment in the middle of everything! We loved the location and the apartment had everything we needed. The shower was large and had great water pressure. Great experience!

Great stay! Not complaints. Paulo was super responsive but we didn’t need a lot of assistance either. He allowed us to check in early because we had an early flight and he gave recommendation for laundry services. The place is near everything you need!

Thanks so much. The location is perfect. In the middle of Ribiera, the ancient and iconic cultural hub of Porto. The appointment is cosy and spotlessly clean with a really nice atmosphere and the most comfortable bed. Also a powerful and hot shower and good cooking facilities. What’s not to love….Bill and Áine.

Paulo’s apartment is cozy and located in a great, walkable area. He is responsive and easy to communicate with. However, we had to wait about an hour to check in when we arrived because the key was unavailable. Once we got into the apartment, we found it had not been cleaned and prepared for our arrival.  I forgot to leave the money for the sofa bed linens, but I sent it later using an App. Paulo was helpful throughout this process.  Life is imperfect, but we had a great stay despite these inconveniences and would book again.

A great place to stay! A bright, sunny, well-decorated apartment - spotlessly clean, very quiet. (The owners even left us a small complimentary bottle of port, which we thought was nice touch.) Location was perfect - steps to the riverfront area, restaurants, shopping. We arrived by car - we were able to pull up to the door to load/unload bags, and then park in an inexpensive parking lot a short walk away. Definitely recommend.
The apartment was in a fantastic location - very walkable and close to the river.  It was clean and we were very comfortable staying there.

We are very honored to be the first guest. It’s very beautiful flat in very good location for tourist.  Closed to historic center, really closed to supermarkets and restaurants,cafe…etc. No AC, it is not really a problem. We didn’t feel hot at all.   Host, Rui and his wife are very friendly and kind. It is not a planed trip for us. Luckily Rui helped us to get around in Porto.  Also they really put their heart to run this guest house, very detail things, they do care.

The appartment is freshly renovated and super clean. Also the bathroom was clean and the shower was really good. The Location is close to the city center, as Porto is not such a big city. Everthing can be reached by foot.  Rui is very responsive and kind - all in all, a perfect stay ☺️

Very nice and cute flat in Porto. Interior was very sophisticated, clean and tidy. Location is great, only a short walk from narrow city centre.Our host was very friendly and gave us suggestions what to visit and eat, and we took those advices and it turned out as good information.
The apartment was very clean, modern and new. Great location but a little noisy so we kept the windows closed for most the time.  Thank you!

The appartement was very modern, clean and cosy. This place is everything you need during a citytrip! Within 15 min you’re in the historical centrum or at the iconic bridge that’s crossing the Douro. Rui was very sympatic and helpful. We would definitly visit again!
Once I figured out the neighbourhood it turned out to be a great little space. This isn't really an apartment, but like a private hotel room.

Rui was a fab host! Really responsive and an easy self check-in/out. He was very kind and let us check in early so we could drop off our bags and get exploring. The Airbnb is perfect, we stayed for a long weekend and it had everything you could need. It was close to everything too, we didn’t use any public transport whatsoever because everything was 15-20 mins walk away. Loved the Airbnb, loved Porto, and I’m very close to booking my next trip back! Thanks Rui!
The host rui is a niceguy who is willing to share info around the area. It is recommended to stay when visiting porto.
The apartment is lovely and in a good location - easy to walk everywhere and near a metro if you need. Rui was a great host and was really helpful with recommendations etc :)
This location was extremely clean and very nicely decorated! I LOVED this place  10/10 recommend!
we loved our stay, great location, comfortable, Rui gave lots of ideas for sightseeing and food, always quick to respond, laundromat across the street. would highly recommend
Great apartment in a very central yet quiet location, easy to walk everywhere! The apartment was super clean and has everything one might need. We would recommend staying here!

We had a great time staying at the apartment. Rui was a very nice host and always helpful! Communication was super easy and always there when needed! The apartment had everything it needs and was super cozy warm in this time of the year due to the heater. The location was great cause you could reach several shops, restaurants or metro stations within 10-15 minutes. Thank you so much!  Anytime again!
Rui was a great host. Always helpful and very responsive. We enjoyed our stay, very central to everything if you’re touring Porto. Highly recommend!
Great apartment. Close to the city centre and Rui was extremely helpful with restaurants and directions. I would stay there again. Loved Porto!

Our stay in Porto was fantastic thanks to Rui’s hospitality. The apartment was in a great location, had everything we needed, and Rui sent plenty of great recommendations to ensure our short trip was well spent. We would happily stay again!
A nice apartment with central location and close to metro station. Be wary, there is no AC, just a fan. The owner is very supportive and welcoming
Very nice and friendly host  Rui was extremely helpful and care  It made our stay even better 😉

Absolutely fantastic! Beautiful and detail orientated renovated historic Building with high ceilings and great interior Design. Everything complete new. Elegant Bathroom with real stoneware. Everything was super clean. Great Hotel Bedlinen. Professional organised with Key Code Access. Location - totally in the Center with a Historic Building on the other side. It was our last day in Porto and we could not have better memories to the City.
There was a slight hiccup in my reservation but Mariana was quick to fix it.   Mariana and Faith are also very helpful in every way.   The house was very clean as well.

Mariana's apartment is well-furnished with a kitchen that has everything that is needed to cook great dinners. We stayed for six weeks. The wifi was great for remote work. The furniture is comfortable, the washing machine works well, and the shower is excellent. We appreciated the air conditioning since it was Summer. The view of Porto is stunning. Be advised that construction is occurring across the street, but the noise is muted and is only during work hours. Mariana is a wonderful host. We would love to stay there again.

Wonderful and spacious villa with bright and large rooms. Nice tiny terrace, with all the needed furniture. Elita and her mum have been very friendly and lovely host, fast and clear communication and with useful information about restaurants and amenities. Highly suggested.

Great apartment, with some lovely home furnishings to make it a comfortable stay. Diogo was very easy to communicate with after my family and I had to quickly find some accommodation at last minute, and the change was just right! I would recommend this place to couples or groups of friends for a pleasant stay in Porto.

The apartment had a verry intens mould smell. At first we thought that the problem will go away if we open the windows but dis not go away and we then foud lots of mould at the entry.  We announced the property manager but did not get a answer for 2 days and before leaving they offered to bring us air fresheners.  In 2 days, at 5 am there where some shouting and fights between the neighbours that made it impossible to sleep.

Fantastic apartment in a great location. Easy access to the beach and Porto, and if you have a car, easy access to the surrounding area. Joana and Valentim are excellent hosts who gave us a whole list of places to visit and restaurant recommendations.  Highly recommend the apartment and the hosts.

A modern apartment with seaside view in beautiful and cozy Foz area of Porto! The ocean was just a few steps away, while the bus number 500 took us conveniently either to downtown Porto for sightseeing or to Matasinhos for tasty seafood. Joana was a flexible host and communicated well. We appreciated the option to arrange reliable airport transfer through her.

We had a great time, it was perfectly clean and modern, also the surroundings are great. The apartment is really beautiful and has everything you need. You can cook and it even has heating.. we were very happy there and would definitely stay there again!

We had a great stay in Joana’s apartment. Even though we arrived late due to lost luggage she stayed up late and gave us a great welcome and introduction and recommendations of the city. The apartment was also very nice and tidy, and just a short walk from the beach. Couldn’t have asked for more!

We (four girls) had a great time at Joanas place. The apartment is well located and close to the beach, shopping opportunities (food and clothes) as well as restaurants and cafés. Joana has given us many tips for things to do in Porto, which was really helpful.

Super friendly and welcoming! The apartment is spacious for a 2-person stay, the kitchen equipped really well, the view is absolutely amazing. All relevant public transportation is right outside to take you into Porto or elsewhere.

Everything went very well. Very friendly and quick communication with the host. The apartment was exactly as described. We can highly recommend the location of the apartment, with a sea view and close to the beach and the charming neighborhood streets in Foz, as everything is easily accessible from there.
Nice apartment with great views. Kitchen was fully equipped for cooking. Some nights the street was noisy if you are a light sleeper or sensitive to noise.
This place is as advertised. Perfect location, super clean and modern, and easy check in. Would recommend 10/10.
It is an excellent apartment for a 4 day visit. Location was perfect. Quiet and clean. Thanks Alina
Alina’s place was clean, as described, easy to checkin to, and right in the mix of everything!

Thank you for hosting. I appreciate you for good and cozy flat. Flat is light, there is not noisy.  Fully furnished. Comfortable bed. Convenient transportation, subway is near. Good infrastructure, there are several small stores, also lidl - 10 minutes walking. Owner is communicative and kind person

What an amazing apartament, close to everything highly recommended. The hosts are amazing and they reply to you very quick. From the check-in to the check-out everything was perfect. I can't wait to go back and stay there again. Thanks once again for everything
Amazing stay in Porto, only few stops to get to the centre. Clean and beautiful rooms, and good instructions from host. Highly recommend.

The check-in was very easy to do, with clear isntructions. The location was very good. Although it was very close to the station, the noise did not reach the apartment. There were many good public transport connections, and it was close to the city centre. The bathroom and the shower were good. The kitchen was well equipped. The communication with the hosts was very good, very responsive. Some technical things weren't working at first, but when we informed, they very quickly took care of it. The ACs were working well, which was good. The apartment building - although made from concrete - was covered with metallic cover, which was surprising to us. But it seems this was quite common in Porto.

This lovely 2 bedroom garden apartment is located near the Praça Republica in Porto about 10-15 minutes walk to bars and restaurants of the downtown area The apartment is large well equipped and both bedrooms are a good size with excellent bathrooms  Parking is provided for one car, although we had some issues with a car wrongly parked still managed to squeeze in next to it! Would definitely recommend this apartment

If you have a chance to stay at Alice's place take it. You will not regret it. It is elegant, charming, cozy, excellent separation between with 2 fully comfortable suites (I traveled with a colleague or if you have children. safe. private, in the gate parking space. Just amazing!!
Our group loved our stay! Beautiful home inside and a picturesque, high walled garden that made for a peaceful backyard in the middle of town!
Thanks for havingus, we loved your place. We were a short uber drive away from the beach and downtown. Porto was a great place a d indeed we wish to come back.

The best Air BnB we have ever stayed at! Stunning interior with everything perfectly thought through in terms of design and luxury. We felt we were in an expensive boutique hotel.  The gardens were lovely and peaceful to relax in after a day of sightseeing. Close to a metro and very good supermarket. Alice was a great host with clear instructions and helpful when we had questions. No complicated rules or instructions which made us feel at home. Highly recommend this apartment , it’s the best apartment we’ve ever stayed in and we have stayed in many over the years. Thank you!

Absolutely stunning apartment, with such attention to detail! Felt like we were staying in a luxury getaway. Alice was a great host and extremely communicative and responsive. Would 100% recommend to anyone staying in Porto. Our favorite accommodation of the trip.

Beautiful apartment with a great location. The unit is very spacious and nicely decorated. The courtyard garden is a delightful bonus. Alice was incredibly responsive and wonderful to communicate with.  We are so happy we chose this for our Porto stay.
Fantastic place, especially when you’re coming from Lisbon. Really good for vacation and around 15 minutes’ walk away from most tourist attractions.

The flat is beautiful and very accessible with close metro and walkable distance to attractions. Even though it’s beautifully decorated the cleanliness was lacking. The bathrooms were dusty, with mould and rusty/dirty bathroom accessories. Dinning table was greasy.  Alice is very responsive and very easy to communicate. Instructions for everything were also provided and easy to follow.

The apartment is very comfortable and in a great location. The bathrooms are gorgeous and there is everything you need for a self-catered holiday in Porto. Alice was brilliant and replied really quickly to questions. It’s so important to have a helpful host and Alice was more than helpful.
A lovely, luxurious escape from the hustle and bustle of Porto. Very close to the Metro  which is very quick and easy to use to get around Porto

Fabulous two bedroom - two bath suite with a southern exposure. There is a patio off the main entrance - the perfect place to enjoy a drink after touring Porto.  Alice is a terrific host who went above and beyond to make our week-long stay in Porto memorable. Recommended.

The accommodation was clean, thoughtfully furnished with comfortable beds. The location was great, right next to the metro and walkable for shops, restaurants, etc. Parking was convenient and the garden was lovely.

Beautiful Place just like the pictures. Close to metro although we walked everywhere. Very safe residential area with grocery store close by as well as a lot of restaurants a few blocks away. Very comfy bed, beautiful garden area, very quiet and peaceful.
Aesthetically lovely and very comfortable. The garden was the cherry on the cake! Alice was available for information and instruction and we appreciated her kindness. Highly recommend

Finding this place was a real find! Once settled inside, it was a quiet, comfortable, luxurious oasis.  Alice was a great host. Quick to answer any queries.  Wish we could have stayed for longer.  Many thanks, hope one day we can visit again.

Alice’s place is a great space for a visit to Porto. While it’s a little far from the main squares and the Ribiero district, it is well worth the walk! When I return to Porto I would surely book this place again.

The place is good in terms of location with a metro station 200 meters away and lidl about 800 meters away. The place looks exactly like in the pictures.  The responses can be slow, and in the start of our stay there were hair all over the bathroom but they cleaned it the next day. The toilet trash wasn’t taken out after notifying too. And when we messaged them about insufficient toilet paper, we didn’t get any response.  All in all, it was how it seemed in the pictures online besides the slow responses.
Nice flat, not that easy to find the door, clean and comfortable when inside. We'd repeat!
The location is fabulous! The balcony is a wonderful spot to relax with a glass of wine after a long day of sightseeing. I highly recommend!

The perfect location! A beautiful apartment! We loved our stay. And after a day of walking the hills of Porto, we really appreciated the lift that opens right into the apartment. The penthouse is lovely and well appointed. Great view from the balcony.  We felt warmly welcomed and the a very nice bottle of wine that greeted us was the perfect touch to start our visit to this stunning city. Just FYI, we left something sweet in the recycle bin and did have some ants. Rinse out your bottles first! And be mindful of the step down to one of the bedrooms. We  highly recommend Derek's place and cannot wait to return.
A really great location! Easy to walk to everything we wanted to do. The balcony was amazing to relax on after a long day!
Fantastic and peaceful just a short walk away from the buzz! A lovely quiet and sunny house at the heart of the city.

I felt very at home in the cosy room and house, and Teresa, her partner and cat were absolutely wonderful to stay with! Such interesting and friendly people! The location was perfect, close to cafés and supermarkets, only a short walk from the metro and about 20 minutes walk from the centre. Communication and check-in was flawless, and I could not have chosen a better place for my first time in Porto!

A pleasant stay. The location is within walking distance to many attractions. Nice and private nook of the place with all the amenities free to use. A cute courtyard also. And the sounds of cats walking on the roof for free.
Really nice and comfy! Surrounded by green, woke up by sunshine, bird, rooster, and adorable cat in the morning <3
Teresa’s home is very comfortable and nice, we enjoyed the little patio and all the amenities! Multo obrigado!

I think everything was as described and just right for me.  I would have liked somewhere to hang my clothes even though I was only staying for a couple of days and a mirror in the room.  But I managed.  I travel quite a lot and usually find my way to the metro/buses fairly quickly, but I guess as it was a holiday when I arrived 15 August, everything seemed dead..  But nowhere is very far with an uber.  Teresa was super helpful about everything and I would highly recommend it.  Peaceful and quiet at night, good night's sleep.  Good bathroom and kitchen facilities, basically a home.  Thank you Teresa, Im sure I'll be back!

Great location for a fabulous week in Porto - supermarket and lovely coffee shops nearby. A pleasant 25 minute walk to the old town and very easy access to metro. Spacious, modern apartment was perfect for the 6 of us. Hosts were extremely helpful, responsive and easy to communicate with. The pillows on the beds were not very comfortable and some of the kitchen facilities (toaster/cutlery/crockery) weren’t great.

Great location, very central and therefore quite noisy. The apartment itself is very clean and has everything you may need, location link on the listing is wrong however the hosts and greeter are very responsive

Really clean and nice place. Communication via Phone and App was fast and helpfull. Locations is nice, 15min. walk to the City. Buses in everything direction. Perfect for 2, a bit small for 4 though. We can recommend this apartment.
Perfect for a city trip to Porto! Very Nice and modern apartment in central location. Everything was clean and we really enjoyed our stay.
Good place to stay! Communication also worked very well everytime when was needed. Would recommend this place 100%.
Pda is an above average friendly host. What really matters is that he is truthful and helpful.

Very nice stay in a great location. Lots of things nearby. The street were a little noisy during night and the bedroom downstairs quiet cold during night and also during the day. Otherwise everything as listed and definitely a good recommendation to stay for a couple of days in Porto.

This is THE place to stay when visiting Porto. Ana greeted us at the apartment and we were blown away with this beautiful space in the best location. The home is decorated fabulously with so much style. There is AC in the living area but we were able to just open the big windows to let the light in and take in being in the center of it all. Despite the location, we also found that it was incredibly quiet when we shut the windows which is helpful with a 7-month old baby. Ana provided a high chair, baby bed, and baby bath too, which we really appreciated. You will be so happy you chose to stay at Ana and Joao's place on your visit to Porto.

This accommodation  is very very perfect!! The accommodation is in the main downtown area, so you can walk everywhere. The view is very nice and clean.  What's unfortunate is that it is difficult to use very warm water if you wash in both bathrooms at the same time. Wash it separately and it will be solved! I want to stay here longer.

The place is beautiful, clean, and in the best location possible. The host was extremely responsive whenever I had a question or needed anything. We had a blast and I would definitely stay here again.

Great location to visit Porto in the heart of the historical district.  Everything accessible by foot  Well equiped for a family with young kids.  The only dowside its a little bit noisy until 10pm with musicians playing in the streets above.

This is a FANTASTIC place to stay. Location is super central, right in the midst of the action. The apartment is beautiful, peaceful, and remarkably quiet, with all the amenities you could need. The balconies are wonderful. We really loved staying here.

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would stay again. Unit is spotless and I am picky!  I wanted a location where I could walk to anything and this was perfect. Train station around the corner, river area very close. So much to see and do.  They always responded quickly and had suggestions for tours.  First time to Porto and it was an amazing experience. Thank you very much!
Very spacious, beds were very comfortable, felt right at home. Great location to walk to everything.

Ana & Joao’s apartment was the perfect place to stay in Porto. Just minutes from Sao Bento Station and easily walkable to everything you could want to see in Porto. The apartment is exactly as described, in the middle of everything but very quiet. Ana & Joao are very friendly and quick to respond to any questions. We would stay here again without hesitation.
A good accommodation for a family of four.  My parents have some mobility issues so be mindful that the apartment is on multiple levels but they managed.

The apartment 100% corresponds to the photos, sunny and cozy, not so far from the city center (40 minutes by walk). The owner helped me with all the questions I had and responded very quickly. I would highly recommend this place to stay.

Pedros place was amazing. I love the style and look of the two-story place. The bedroom kind of hangs about the living room like a stilt bungalow. Classy modern decor and a it gets lots of sun in the daytime. Just two blocks to action, and three blocks to the big beautiful bridge. Wonderful location. Pedro himself is super attentive and very responsive to needs. Has paid parking in a garage downstairs, which is important in an old town like Porto if you're driving. Couldn't have asked for a better stay.  Very clean.
Lovely place in a great location. Pedro was a friendly and helpful host too. We would definitely stay again.

The apartment is very modern and super clean.  It has everything you need for a comfortable stay.  We really appreciated the bottle of wine left for us by Pedro and the nespresso machine with a great selection of espresso.  The location is fantastic, just a few steps away from the center city.  I guess the apartment is not ideal for people with disabilities due to a lot of stairs but we didn't mind it at all.  We really enjoyed our stay.
We had a wonderful stay in Porto! It was a very safe, clean, and well decorated apartment. Pedro was quick to respond to questions and offered his help for anything we needed.

This place was perfect. Easy to check in, walking distance to all the prime destinations and the apartment itself was clean with a beautiful touch.  I’ll definitely come back to stay at Pedro’s place.

We had a great time in Porto and Pedro's place was perfect for us. It was centric and clean, and Pedro is a great host, always responsive and flexible with the check-in time. I recommend Pedro's place to those looking to explore Porto and its surroundings.

This was one of the best airbnbs I have every stayed at. Pedro is a wonderful host and was very attentive and proactive. The apartment was so clean and spacious. There were also nice touches that showed that Pedro went above and beyond. We really appreciated having a Brita filter for water and the slippers, wine, and water bottle. The location is great, we were a 10 minute walk from almost everything we wanted to see. I would not hesitate to stay here again.

The location is perpect! I walked to the Luís I Bridge only 5 minutes, so I enjoyed the sunset everynight. Pedro is so kind and flexible host. I got a lot of help with him and he gave fast response. His apartment is super clean and having everything you need.
The best Airbnb in every way from location to host to amenities. 10/10! Only thing missing is a washing machine which would make it 11/10
Both the apartment and Pedro were perfect.  We should have stayed longer than two days.  John

Fabulous apartment. Almost new and extremely clean. Excellent beds, bathrooms, kitchen etc. Pedro was excellent. Two little points, don't leave a glass of water beside your bed because it will probably fall off! Heating is a little difficult to control. I would definitely return.

Pedro was a great host, super friendly and helpful.  We were able to do luggage drop off and park the car early, in order to explore while apartment was cleaned. We were able to check in early also. Pedro even carried our luggages to the unit. Beautiful quiet area but walkable to everything.  Apartment kept in shape and clean. Would stay here again
The apartment is spacious and spotlessly clean, it's in a quiet street but close to restaurants, shops and sights. And Pedro is an excellent host.

One of my favorite airbnbs of all time! Apartment exceeded my expectations. Clean, spacious, fitted with all necessities plus more.
