The location was perfect and walkable to all monuments and historical buildings. Pedro was very friendly and provided us a list of his personal recommendations for restaurants and bars.
great location, nice stylish modern studio apartment, beds comfortable, very responsive host, would be nice to have AC as it was hot in summer and too noisy to open the window
The apartment was nice and clean. Location was good - easy walking distance to the river and sightseeings. Communication with host was quick and friendly. Everything was perfect.
This place has it all great location, well decorated, and a great host. Would absolutely stay here again the next time k visit Porto.

Pedro’s place was immaculate! It was a gorgeous place and Pedro met us at the door and walked us through everything inside the Airbnb. Also left a bottle of wine for us to enjoy! He sent us links with suggestions of where to find groceries, restaurants etc. We used quite a few of those suggestions. I would definitely recommend his place, it was a rare find.

Awesome stay. Felt like a little beach house in the middle of Porto. Extremely close to popular sights and the metro/trains yet peaceful at night. Very comfortable with everything we needed for our stay. Highly recommend
Brilliant spot in Porto, close to the river and vibey restaurants. The place was beautifully done, with everything you could ever need. Highly recommend!

Pedro is an amazing host! He is very helpful, and his flat is clean, organized, very well constructed, also centrally located. Staying at his place makes our whole Porto travel experience so much better! We will definitely come back again if we travel back to porto and it’s definitely recommended to my friends as well, it’s probably the best air bnb experience so far 🤩
Amazing place to stay, great apartment, location, would definitely come back. Might not be adequate for young kids due to the stairs.

This apartment was fantastic- everything was clean and comfortable, and the cool layout of the place makes it seem very roomy. And Pedro was an absolutely wonderful host- he was easy to reach, incredibly thoughtful, and lovely to meet! We would definitely stay there again and recommend it highly to friends.

I stayed for 8 nights, this apartment is perfect for exploring Porto, very easy to walk to everything. Our host met us and helped carry our bags to our 2nd floor apartment. Everything was explained. Apartment was immaculate and was cleaned 3 times during our stay, with fresh towels and bedding. There are stairs to the apartment but we managed these, even my 75 year old mother. Would highly recommend for a stay in Porto.
Close to many many restaurants, the Douro River and a great tourist information centre.  The home had everything we needed.
Beautiful apartment with super great location! Monica ( host) was always responsive and helpful. I would certainly recommend.

We enjoyed our stay immensely and the location was amazing. When we asked Monica for local recommendations, we were provided a wonderful guide full of suggestions.  The stylish apartment was clean, comfortable and had everything we needed. Thank you!
Very nice and clean apartment close to all the main attractions in Porto.  Close located to the metro and train station which will allow you to visit also Braga and Guimares.
Had a wonderful stay in the center of Porto. Great location. The apartment looks the same as described. Has everything for comfortable stay. Monica was very helpful and responded immediately.

We had a lovely stay with Casaporto. The hosts were extremely responsive and hospitable and were also flexible with check-in. The building and apartment is well-renovated and we felt safe with the lock system. The apartment itself was very spacious and clean, well-decorated and we had a comfortable stay for our 2 nights in Porto. The building was along a main street that made the surroundings feel safer too. I highly recommend staying at Casaporto for a warm welcome back after a day of exploring Porto!

My friend and I loved staying here and having o our own bathroom! The apartment is very cute and spacious. Beds were comfortable. Great location. Definitely would stay here again, and Pedro was super nice!

We had an awesome stay at Pedro’s! The apartment was beautiful. He met us upon arrival, showed us around, and shared some great local recommendations. We loved our time in Porto and would stay here again!

Pedro's welcome defined our visit. I've never had a better host. Incredible welcome, guidance and recommendations. All details of the apartment were fantastic. Compact two bed, two bathroom with all required kitchen products and accessories. Aircon included. Optional parking which is valuable in the city. Loved the stay!
Loved my stay here. Centrally located, and a clean, air conditioned apartment. Would definitely stay again.

Great stay for the three of us- clean, spacious, and centrally located. We thought the space was really well designed and did not feel overcrowded. There was no noise from the street or neighbours, and so many great restaurants and bars nearby. The host, Monica, was extremely responsive and flexible, making our stay really relaxed. We would definitely recommend and will likely return ourselves!

Completely renovated house using the old materials with quite some taste.  Fantastic and flexible host in a very small village in the surroundings of Arouca.  Even a (non heated) pool and a magnificent view.  For us the mattresses were far too hard and we have informed the host.  We were unlucky that dogs in the close neighbourhood did not stop to bark…really long time.  So if you like calm, quite and forest this is the place to be.

The house lives up to the pictures and description in the listing. Great venue for a group trip to Porto. Getting into the city centre is quick and cheap by cab/train. The house itself is lovely and clean. Two nice lounges and kitchens, a pool and terrace. Comfortable beds. The team at Casas were great at communicating and facilitating our stay.  Would recommend.

+ : The place was spotless, and the host very friendly, flexible and responsive and resolved issues really quickly. Quiet neighborhood, plenty of space and comfortable.  - : The rental was not quite ready when we arrived (no toilet paper, cable TV box now working, central heat and hot water were off). This was in February, so our first evening was pretty chilly. However once we informed them the hosts showed up within a few hours and got things going. Several rooms had visible traces water damage/water intrusion. The listing shows “riverview” and “waterfront”,  but while some of the rooms on the upper floors do have views of the river, the rental is way north of the train tracks and nowhere near the river (nothing wrong with the location, just don’t expect to be a stone throw away from the river). Overall the positive outweigh the negative, it is nice large place, great for big family gatherings, very quiet neighborhood.
Great space for traveling with a group. It was spacious and clean. And it was a short walk to many of Porto’s must-see destinations.

We had a great stay with our team. The house is close to the train station and the city center. The kitchen was well equipment, the house is very nice and all in all we had everything we needed for a great stay. The communication upfront and during our stay was always friendly, helpful and fast.
Great place for a reasonable price, the hosts were very helpful and we were able to check in early! Decent accessible location.

Very spacious and clean accommodation over 3 floors. Good value for money.  Unfortunately not all windows/bedroom balcony doors had curtains/shutters so can’t keep light out in mornings. Also showers + baths don’t have any shower curtains.

Stayed as a group of 10 for a long weekend exploring Porto and would highly recommend this accommodation to big groups ! The host was super helpful explaining the best parts of Porto and responsive when required.  The accommodation itself was very easy to find from nearest Metro station, less than 5 minutes walk with a little supermarket on route for the basics. Bed were comfortable, lots of toilets and lovely living room spaces to relax within as a group.

A large communal house is ideal for bigger groups. The unheated pool was still enjoyable, and the terrace view and BBQ were lovely extras. It's about a 30-minute walk or a 10-minute taxi ride to the city centre. Would recommend.  .

Great property. Spacious with all the necessary amenities. Lovely pool to relax around which was great in the hot weather. Lots of places to eat and drink in the local area within 10 mins walk.  Also very easy and quick to get into more central locations.

We loved our stay at this apartment. The location was great and had many places to explore and dine within walking distance. The apartment was exactly as pictured and was very clean. Check in was very easy and having a provided parking spot was extremely helpful. We would stay again!
Nice apartment, completely new and situated in a good position.  The home have all you need , washing machines included too. I strongly suggest this apartment !
we had a great time during our stay. Everything was as described here. would recommend to everyone.

Lovely stay, clean and bright! Any communication had a fast response, and basic kitchen utensils etc were provided. Toilet roll and soap were provided which is so handy when first arriving somewhere!  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and if we return to Porto will look at staying here again! Location is a fair walk from the main porto town and river restaurants, we also didn't realise how hilly porto is (our fault), however it is close to the Crystal Palace gardens and is in a peaceful neighbourhood, as well as some lovely restaurants! Parking was brilliant too!!!
It’s a very good place to stay, a bit far from metro but the house itself is clean, tidy, with a/c

Great stay! Brilliant location, apartment has everything you need. The company was very responsive to our questions and sent out a plumber to resolve the shower issue promptly!  Has an underground car park that was secure to park our van.  Great place, would come and stay again!
Great, modern apartment less than 30 min to the old town by foot. Comfortable also for 3 people.

The apartment is very clean and well furnished, the bed is comfy and the location is very quiet. The parking space is a big plus. Internet works but is very slow. The city center with all its points of interest is within walking distance but supermarkets are few and far between in this part of town. We would have appreciated some sugar and a couple of extra towels, otherwise everything was great.

This airbnb made the holiday in Porto even better. The hosts are very welcoming and ready to help at any request. The location is very central and the flat has everything you need and it’s just like you see it in the pictures: beautiful, modern and clean. If you’re staying in Porto, I would definitely recommend you book this airbnb.
We had a wonderful time in this beautiful flat. Perfect location close to cool bars and restaurants. Communications with Drew was easy and we totally recommend to stay here.
Perfect location.  Modern and very clean apartment.  Very responsive and helpful host.  I highly recommend it!

We had a great time here. The apartment was spacious and modern design with beautiful furniture. The neighbourhood is lively and cool. There're so many nice restaurants and bars around there. We wish we could stay longer here.

Don’t look further!  Best airBnB we’ve ever stayed in, by a mile!  Beautiful place, tastefully furnished, clean, and everything we needed and more. Location is perfect as well, we easily walked every where, and there are lots of lovely restaurants and terraces very near by.  The 5* is well-deserved.  We absolutely loved the food, drinks and people at Coupage 51, just around the corner.

Wonderful apartment. It have all you need for a great stay in Porto. Super clean, great space and the location is just perfect. Communication with the host was fast and she was super helpful. Will stay here again if I am ever so lucky to come back to Porto again.

We had the absolute best stay at Hailey’s place! It has everything you could need in a fabulous location in Porto. They were very responsive with a few minor issues that came up. Very clean, great building, charming and quiet. We stayed for a month and felt right at home. Highly recommend!
location was great, apartment was very good, a little on the small side but that'sto be expected in the city.  access to the building via your phone can be a challenge for the non techs.

Impeccable heat insulation, you will appreciate it on cold windy days. It is a renovated building just a few minutes walk from the Metro, a couple of streets away from the busy Rua de Santa Catarina, thus convenient stores, restaurants and historical sights are near by. The flat has everything you might need to stay with a family of four. Very recommended.
The Airbnb was clean and cute, very comfortable, short walk to coffee shops/restaurants.  I would definitely stay here again!

This place was our favorite Airbnb we have ever stayed in. The place was impeccable and host was super helpful and responsive. Place was so comfortable and well situated. We have only positive things to say about this apt and Hailey.

The flat and surroundings were perfect to visit the city! Very clean and quiet flat. More than enough space to stay with 3 (2 adults and a 15-yr old teenager). The little terrace is nice to have a relaxed coffee or aperitif. Coffee bar at the corner serves very good pastries as breakfast and the Japanese restaurant Kintsugi (Kintsugiporto) blending Japanese with Portoguese food was amazing, next to the various other nice restaurants close by. Do not hesitate to book the flat, you will not regret and will enjoy a wonderful stay in Porto!  Thanks, Hailey!

We stayed in Marco’s apartment for a few days during our stay in Porto. The apartment is exactly as described, and was very clean, spacious, and the location incredibly convenient. We enjoyed the neighborhood and sitting outside on the patio in the afternoon. The kitchen is well equipped. Marco was readily available for any communication and very helpful. Overall we had a lovely stay!

We loved this apartment and didn't want to leave! We could walk to everything and were right in the middle of everything but it was so quiet and peaceful.  We can't wait to return.  Note: If you have children, the apartment is on the 2nd floor and the steps are quite steep.

The place was very clean, modern, had everything we needed to feel at home, and was an easy walk to all the sites we wanted to see Also steps to dozens of restaurants and cafes. Communication was great too. Felt right at home. We would highly recommend this wonderful apartment.
The balcony was amazing ! The bed was a little bit small for two.  Great location. The hosts were helpful and responsive!
Great apartment with a nice terrace (that we could not use, unfortunately, but that wat because of the bad weather), centrally located. We would always return! Thank you!
We really liked our staying at Marco's place. Perfect locating to explore the city.  Beautiful flat as described and very quiet.  Thank you.
Great place, near places of attraction at a walking distance. Marco communicated well and provided needed support on a timely manner. Definitely recommend his place !
Great accommodations, great communication and flexibility by host. Clean, nice location, wonderful view of garden area in the back. Would definitely stay again.

We had a wonderful wonderful wonderful quick stay -- this spot is such a dream for a couple or two travelers! Filipe is very easy to get in touch with, the building is easy to access, and we had everything we needed. Easily one of the best Airbnb experiences I've had ever!

Filipe’s place was amazing! It was very modern with a great view of the city. Everything you would need was included and he was very responsive. Would highly recommend him and this place for anyone looking to experience Porto!

This is a really nice flat in a fantastic location. I would absolutely recommend it to other travelers to Porto. The flat was very well equipped, well designed and with a wonderful shower! All the main tourist attractions are within walking distance and there were plenty of good restaurants and bars nearby. The area is well served with public transport and had a nice old town atmosphere. Communication was brilliant, an early check in helped and the  Easter eggs was lovely treat. Thank you!
Great location and enjoyed the rooftop view! Easy to walk down to the promenade. Easy to check in and Filipe was a very kind and responsive host. Highly recommend.

The location is very central, walking distance to the ribiera, cathedral , restaurants and other local attractions. The building is clean and very well maintained (or newly renovated ?). The appartment is as shown on pictures, very clean and has everything inside (Shampoo, shower gel..  Convenient for backpack travellers 😊). Filipe is very available to respond to any questions. Thanks !! We had a very great stay !!
Comfortable stay, good location and appreciated Filipe’s extra efforts to make our stay with comfortable, especially for the baby - crib, milk in the fridge, baby wipes, etc.!
It was the best accommodation I’ve ever had! Nice location for touring, such a beautiful penthouse for only us.  If you go to Porto, you have to stay here!
The appartment is absolutely beautiful!! We loved the rooftopview and the location is just perfect in the middle of the old town but without the noise. Highly recommended!
This placewas exactly what we were looking for in Portom it's a great location and great apartment.  despite being on the top floor, it stays very cool

Beautiful apartment and easy walking to everything, uphill of course. Clean and spacious and exactly as described. Filipe was very proactive with communication from original booking to start of our stay. Would highly recommend.

Excellent stay, Filipe was was very helpful and helped with some local recommendations. The apartment is lovely, very quiet and perfect for a couple of nights in the city. The location is perfect, a short walk from Gaia or Porto City centre.

The place was in a perfect location for our stay in Porto. Communication was excellent and there were no problems with check in or anything else. The apartment itself had everything we needed and was in great condition. I would highly recommend it.
The place is like a five star hotel in the middle of all actions. 100% would come back again.
We enjoyed our stay in Porto- this place has an excellent location and is very clean and comfortable.
On top of being a cozy and clean apartment, it comes with an amazing view. There are plenty of things nearby and the river is only a short walk away!
Perfect place and perfect host!! Filipe had awesome restaurant recommendations and always responded right away. Bed was super comfortable too!
exactly like the pictures!! super modern and clean. Filipe was very helpful answering my questions. The beds were comfortable. perfect location. easily walk everywhere

Highly recommend this stay if you are in Porto! Pictures matched the stay perfectly and location was amazing (Central to everything). Apartment was cozy and view from the window was outstanding. Also owner was very responsive and accommodating. If I ever come back to Porto I will definitely rebook and highly recommend to anyone going to the area!

Great locations and apartment true to pictures. The sleeping area is a step above the living room area which is two steps above the balance of the apartment. This can be tricky to remember and navigate at night so just a caution to mobility challenged and perhaps older guests....I had to keep the bathroom light on to remind myself! Otherwise throughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend.
Wow! Amazing, clean and well decorated flat (just like the pics)! Loved the washing machine tablets and dishwasher tablet addition!  Amazing for the price. Right in the heart of Porto 🩷
Wonderful place to stay in Porto.  Close to good food, shopping and dinks.  It was  a great time.  Lots of hills in Porto, so bring comfortable walking shoes.

Loved our stay at Filipe’s loft in the Ribeira district! The apartment is cozy and stylish, with everything we needed. The location is excellent—steps from the Douro River, Gaia, and all the main sights, yet in a quiet building. Filipe was an excellent host, very responsive and helpful. We can’t wait to come back to the beautiful city of Porto.

This apartment is absolutely beautiful, just as pictured and in a GREAT location. We were able to walk everywhere we needed. Impeccably clean and convenient, the communication was also quick and thorough. The one thing to mention is that you have to download an app to check-in and have to use that app every time you entered the building as well as your room. Not a huge deal, but if you don’t have a good data plan on your phone to download apps, or if your phone happens to die while you are out exploring, you aren’t in great shape.  That didn’t stop us from having a wonderful time in this place, but I wanted to share the info in case it is something that might be an issue for others.
Beautiful appartment in a great location, check in was quick ans easy and hosts available for help during your stay

We had a great stay! The apartment was exactly as in the pictures/as described. Newly renovated and of great standard. Very clean. The key free access to the apartment using an app on the phone was also very convenient. Good location, everything within walking distance. Highly recommend a stay at Almada 180 apartments when in Porto!
Very clean and bright, great central location with access to everything Porto has to offer. Good air con!

The property is in the right location, very clean and comfortable. There are plenty of restaurants downstairs and not far from the attractions. The only bad thing was that there was no lift to the ground floor, which was not very friendly for us travellers with big luggage.
Joana’s place is superbly located, it is luminous, nicely decorated, super clean, a great place to stay in Porto!  Ram
Thank you Claudia  We enjoyed our stay we love to come back we will definitely recommend our friends and families  Thank you again

The space was perfect, clean and perfectly located near everything. Host was very nice and responsive. Noisy upstairs neighbors, not sure if they were just temporary or permanent residents but that doesn’t take away from the 5-star review.
Location, location, location! The apartment was beautiful. Close to restaurants and the tourist District. I would definitely stay here again!

The house is very beautiful and had everything we needed.  We felt like home and there are plenty of things to do and see in the nearby area. Nazare was very nice with us, recommended places to have breakfast. It was very easy to contact her and she answered immediately.  Thank you for everything. We'll stay in your place again when we visit the area.
Location was perfect; right at the centre of everything! We walked everywhere.  Pictures of the place are accurate so expect the same! Clean and cozy space!
Daniel was such a wonderful host. Very flexible and responsive!!! Would definitely recommend his place to anyone visiting Porto. It’s so close to the city center!!

Daniel was very nice, responsive. And helpful with suggestions for restaurants and parking. We loved our stay in Porto! Location was superb! We could not have asked for a better location. Felt very fortunate to find this place!

Daniel’s place in Porto is in such a great position - so close to the Douro River, restaurants, cafes, and the many beautiful sites of Porto. The apartment is clean, well laid out for its size, and is better than the photos - it’s highly recommended
Family of 4 had a perfect stay.  Couple of issues were sorted by Daniel straight away.  Perfect location

Clean apt. Location was also good as everything was walkable. Only negative was lack of hot water- we could only shower for couple of minutes before water got cold. And also there are no doors for the two bedrooms- only curtains.

Really enjoyed staying at Pedro’s place - amazing location, very easy to get to with the metro close by and a short walk to bars/restaurants. We loved having the balcony and it felt very private. I would absolutely stay again if visiting Porto in the future!

The apartment is cozy and bright.  Having breakfast on the terrace with such a beautiful view was a pleasure. Nearby are many restaurants to visit and places to walk.  Noise insulation is poor and we constantly heard our neighbors and felt them walking around in their apartments. In general, it was only disturbing at night. We were saved by earplugs, so our experience was not much ruined

Thank you so much for the most amazing and comfortable stay.  The apartment was very well located, spacious with everything we needed, could not have asked for  more. We had a wonderful warm welcome and found the apartment spotlessly clean, and the bedding extremely comfortable. I would definately recomend to anyone looking for an Air bnb in Porto Thank you

The apartment was perfect for a large group. The location is a quick uber to almost anywhere in Porto. We didn't spend much time in the apartment or the area but that apartment fulfilled all of our needs.

This place was fantastic. It is beautifully remodeled. Beds are comfortable, bathrooms are clean, AC works well, and kitchen is beautiful. It is also located next to a lot of hip restaurants and hang out spots. Loved it here and would definitely stay here again. Claudia was also very responsive and available for any needs that came up.
Very nice place to share between friends and famille ! Check-in and check-out very easyjet and the host reply very rapidly. I recommand !
Lovely apartment and well equipped.  The bedrooms were spacious and bright. Good location for transport and shops. We really enjoyed our stay! Thank you Claudia and Pedro.

Miguel is very kind and communicative.   We enjoyed our stay! A special, warm, and authentic place: we even got a chance to know our amazing neighbors. The place is surrounded by wild nature, but also close to the river and Gaia's center.  We highly recommend this Air BNB!!

From the moment we arrived, we felt completely at home. Our hosts Helena and Miguel are not only generous and thoughtful, but truly great human beings. The neighbors were also incredibly welcoming and kind, adding to the warm, community authentic feel of the whole stay. The house is a gem, confortable for our family of four — uniquely renovated with so much character and history, just steps from Porto. Every detail reflects care and creativity. We’re so grateful for this experience and hope to return someday!
nice apartment, nice park and beach in walking distance, public transport to city center was not nearby, but Uber to come back is very affordable. nice people, take time to give ideas on where to go.

André is awesome. He is really a great host. He was very welcoming and also available for questions and suggestions. We had our private room and bathroom there. I don't know about the public transport except that the bus stop is nearby and the bus that stops there takes you to the centre (30min). I really recommend the place if you love dogs as I do 💖

What a fabulous apartment! The location is great, right in the heart of the city centre, the main sites and close to the metro if you need to go further. The studio is perfect for a solo traveller or couple and there are lots of great restaurants, rooftop bars, cafés and supermarkets within minutes.  I'd also like to say Thank You to Paulo who was incredibly helpful from booking to check out. I will definitely be back! 😊

Good location just 5 minutes to Santa Catarina nd Bilboa metro station, walkable to many attractions in center of Porto, many many restaurants near by, super markets. Very well decorated, comfortable bed and squeaky clean bedding.

Being close to the ocean and having a pool made the apartment a fun place to stay. We enjoyed being within walking distance to groceries and the ocean. Parking was always easy. Everything in the place worked. The bed was HUGE and the Wi-Fi was blazing fast. Good couch and dining table. Enjoyed the brand new washing machine.  Andriano was always available and checked in on us to see how things were going. We'll definitely stay here again.

The apartment was so great and the pools were perfect for my kids. Adriano was incredibly helpful and responsive. Really close to the beach and local shops and supermarkets. Walking distance to restaurants. Really clean apartment with everything we needed. We can’t wait to visit again!

This place is a Gem.  Absolutely beautiful, sparkling clean and has everything one could possibly want or need.  Joanna is a pleasure to work with and responds immediately.  This was a last minute booking as we had just arrived in Porto and the original place was  terrible.  We found Joanna’s place and were amazed.   Lovely place and great location to fabulous restaurants and the sea.   Will definitely come back!

My wife and I travel quite a bit (maybe more than we should admit) and this was definitely the best hosting experiences we've had! Joana is incredibly helpful and the home was amazing. We highly recommend it! The location is perfect and Joana went above and beyond to ensure an enjoyable stay. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this home to anyone :-)
Perfeito! The apartment is very well located and very thoughtfully outfitted. Joana is a perfect host. It is apparent that much thought and care has gone into creating this wonderful space.

Joana‘s house was super clean and very well designed. The whole vibe of the house was welcoming and the love for details was amazing. We felt totally at home! Joana helped us out with great food suggestions and also let us check in early. The house is not far away from the water and is situated in a quiet neighbourhood. We can really recommend staying at her place and are looking forward to coming back some day as Porto is such a beautiful city. Muito obrigado Joana!
Very confortable and extremely well equipped apartment in a calm district of Porto. Close to good restaurants and the Atlantic sea. We could very well come back.

My family and I stayed at Joana's place for a little over a week to visit family and have our first family trip in a while. The space was amazing, clean, spacious, walking distance to the beach and restaurants as well as various markets. Joana had Port wine and natas waiting for us which was delightful, she also met us when we arrived to give us instructions on things and was flexible when our flight was delayed. Our next trip to visit our second home we will definitely be staying at Joana's again. Thank you so much Joana for the most amazing time and recommendations!
Joana's home is nothing less than amazing!!! She was the best host I have ever had on Airbnb, so kind and very understanding! We would love to come back again!.

We really enjoyed our stay at Miquel E Rita’s apartment. It was so easy to hop on a bus or walk to surrounding sights to see. Miquel met us on arrival and gave us some great advice on sights to see and places to eat and on how to get there. Whenever we needed any advice we just needed to send a message and always got an immediate reply.
we had a great time! They had a lot of amenities and a lot of brochures for things to do everything was clean and they even provided a midweek cleanup!
The place is very clean, the bed is comfy and the location is great. Rita and Miguel are extremely nice and gave us clear instructions. 100% would stay again
Beautiful palce to stay! Miguel was a very friendly host and shared some great recommendations for Porto. Thanks for hosting us!

Wow Miguel’s place was incredible the location is great, the room had all the services we could need including beach towels and coffee pods, and the room felt so spacious thanks to the tall ceiling. This is the best place you could get in Porto for this price without a doubt.
The Airbnb was perfect, very clean and complete. We really loved the location, very close to the shops and restaurant. We definitely recommend this to everyone!
The apartment was really well located and super clean and stylish. Would definitely stay here again. Only thing is there was no view from the balcony

Great place to stay for exploring Porto. The team is very friendly and helpful, loved the communication with them. The apartment is clean and home-like. No noise. I’d stay again if I come to Porto another time!
Beautiful clean Airbnb. Felt so at home, smart tv so can watch Netflix etc whilst getting ready to go out. Very modern and stylish!
The place was very clean and modern. Great location, only thing to say was it was very small and cramped, nowhere to put suitcases. Apart from that it was great

The location was very convenient as it’s just at a short walk from the main railway station, with easy access to most of Porto’s sights and attractions. The apartment was clean and pleasant with many amenities you’d expect. We enjoyed our stay for the most part, the only downside was the resident upstairs had very heavy footsteps and movements that could be heard through the ceiling at many different hours. On one night we were awakened before 5am from the sound of movement upstairs while on another, we were kept awake till well after 2am.
We enjoyed our stay. The apartment felt like home. Very well organized and maintained. Close to everything :)  Very well recommended.

Just back from 5 days in Porto staying in this lovely accommodation. Right beside Sao Bento train station, very walkable to all major sights and had lots of restaurants/bars/cafes only 5 minutes away. Very much recommend for a city break. Hosts were lovely, responsive and easy to communicate with. Thanks for everything.
Nice, little, clean and cosy appartment with a well equipped kitchen. No noise from the street or from the other appartments in the building.

We stayed at Vasco's flat for 3 days and it was an excellent base for touring PORTO. The flat was immaculately clean,  nice touches on arrival and a very good responsive host. Communication was excellent,  great WiFi connection also.

Wonderful and bright apartment with a lot of natural sunligh and amazing views of Porto. Vasco has been a terrific host who welcomed us with a warm heart. We enjoyed our stay very, very much. Thanks Vasco!
A very nice flat, with beautiful natural light, located in a very quiet area but close to the city centre. And Vasco, a very good host.
Great stay lovely host, gorgeous apartment and would def stay here again. Top location. Obrigada!

Vasco’s apartment was just great, great value for money.  Stayed for 1 week, it’s in a local neighbourhood with local restaurants close by.  Everything you wanted was available in the very clean and welcoming apartment to make your stay very enjoyable, from condiments, teas, coffee, sugar, salt etc to washing materials.  Plenty of towels and clean linen available if required.  Bed very comfortable also.   Vasco was very friendly and helpful.   A welcome bottle of wine and fresh bread and butter was a lovely treat also.  A great weeks stay.  A*
Great stay! Booked at the last minute after our previous lodging fell through and was grateful this place was available. Exactly what we needed.

**Fantastic Stay!**   I had a wonderful stay at DA’HOME Premium! The home was clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything I needed, and the location was perfect. I’d definitely stay here again—highly recommend!

Mold smell!! It’s extremely pungent in the hallway but less bad in the property itself, but you can definitely still smell it in the walls.  That being said, we really enjoyed staying here. The apartment is GORGEOUS and has every amenity you would want. The hosts were very kind and responsive as well, the location is great.

First time in Porto and it was the best experienced. Location was great for all things to walk too,  did have trouble going to the BnB airport via Bolt and then arriving to the place on locating. But overall stay was great!
Great little place in OPorto, ideally located for walkable sightseeing to Riberia, the river Douro, and lots more. Lovely apartment that felt private and quiet enough whilst also being very central
Had a lovely stay at Vascos flat. Had everything we needed for a few days stay. Felt right at home. Left some wine for us too!

This is my second time coming back to this beautiful place and it felt like coming back home.  This place provides such a relaxing atmosphere including a beautiful backyard where you can do outdoor yoga or just chill amongst fruit trees surrounded by ivy and camellia-covered fences. Despite its location on a busy street, you can’t hear any cars in the garden or indoors. I could not wait to come back to the apartment after a long day of walking in the city.  And the communication with the host was prompt. They are very friendly and quick to respond to any questions I had during the stay.  ( Thank you Mellisa and Joanna!) Highly recommended!

this place is special. centrally located, but the moment you walk in feel completely removed from the noise of the city. impeccably decorated in good taste, the backyard/garden feels like a slice of paradise, and the bedroom (with central AC that actually works!) is both beautiful and perfect for sleep.  highly recommended.
Very beautiful apartment, tastefully decorated and with character. Very well equipped for a long stay. Communication and assistance during the stay was impeccable. Totally recommended. Thank you

We really enjoyed our stay! Very clean and modern apartment. You just need to walk a few minutes to reach the city center. Renato gave us all the information that we needed. We would recommend the apartment! 😊
Great, cozy apartment with a nice vibe. A bit loud outside, but beside that everything was good
Small but cosy apartment! A bit noisy during the night but perfect if you're alone or travelling as a couple.
Clean, new and good location with a lot or restaurants nearby. If you have the chance to book this studio, then do it! Would definitely recommend.

We really like the place. It was perfect in every aspect. Very clean, bright and friendly interior (exactly how it is on the pictures), good location, Check-In and Check-Out worked perfectly and Claudia was very caring and answered quickly. Highly recommend the place! :-)
Very nice and cosy appartment. It is perfect for a short stay!  The apartment is not far from the center and is easy to reach from the airport. We really enjoyed Porto and the apartment!
The apartment was fantastic! It looked even better than the photos. In easy walking distance to all of Porto’s attractions and centre.

Amazing stay and host. The apartment is centric and you can walk anywhere from there. The apartment was cozy, clean and beautiful and the host was very responsive. If we come back, we would definitely chose this airbnb again.
This was my favorite place that I stayed in Portugual. Very spacious and the location was excellently. Everything was super clean. Would definitely return
We had a lovely time in the comfortable, cozy apartment in a good location, close to everything and with good food option. Absolutely recommended place and host!
Lovely clean apartment with all amenities you could need. Great location with easy access to main tourist spots, yet nice and quiet at night.  Very easy check in and check out process.

Spotlessly clean modern studio very close to everything in central Porto. Not much floor space tbh. It's pretty compact. Perfect for just a few nights stay. Great bathroom & shower and comfy bed. We enjoyed our stay

Very comfortable room. It feels like coming home. The location is convenient. The neighborhood is quiet. The landlord is very nice. Communication is timely. If I come again next time, I will choose this place!
Claudia’s place was in a very walkable location. It was the perfect place for a couple or solo traveler looking to explore Porto. I’d stay here again!
Great place. Location worked out wonderfully.  Place was pristine.  I would highly recommend!!  Near a lot of restaurants.  Three minute walk to a big plaza with a bunch of great places to eat.

Beautiful apartment in the heart of Porto. Everything was perfect, the apartment is full furnished, very clean and super comfortable. Claudia is very reactive Superhost and can help you to enjoy the city.

Wonderful accommodation! It was extremely clean, and everything felt new and fresh. The hosts even left a bottle of welcome wine, which was such a lovely touch. We were also able to check in early, which made our stay even more convenient. The location was perfect, just a few minutes’ walk to the city center. Highly recommend!

Had a great stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. The location was excellent, close to everything we needed and easy to get around. Our host was fantastic—always responsive and helpful whenever we had questions. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others!

This is a lovely apartment & was perfect for our one night in Porto. Claudia was very quick to respond to any messages, the apartment was spotless & the bed comfy.  The flat itself is situated within easy walking distance of the sights. The ‘treats’ on arrival were also much appreciated!
Stylish and cozy apartment in one of the best area of Porto. Claudia and her crew are amazing hosts.  We'll definitely go back!

Great location in Bonfim neighbourhood. Some really good restaurants and cafes/bakery nearby. 10-15 min walk to historical centre. Perfectly clean and looks just like the photos. Claudia’s place is in an apartment complex of airbnb apartments (which is quite common in Lisbon it seems) and professionally managed. Co-host Ana was proactive with instructions etc and always very responsive to any queries. Thank you Claudia and Ana for a great stay.
Lovely Airbnb, close to the main shopping area and restaurants. Apartment was clean, comfortable and a great choice. Highly recommend the combi coffee roasters for breakfast.

I liked the studio especially for its quietness and secluded terrace. It was clean, comfortable and well equipped. It’s just a 2 min walk to the nice Bolhau district where there are plenty of attractions and restaurants. The communication was fast and friendly.
Claudia is super helpful and willing to help us. The heater is a bit noisy though (even set as quite mode) but overall is a great place to stay and enjoy Porto.
Great location. Private terrace was excellent. Very quiet neighbourhood but within a few minutes walk of great cafes, bars and restaurants.
I had a lovely day at Claudia’s. The decor was comfortable yet classy it wasn’t up a hill which was a nice surprise and it’s very close to the train station.
Great flat in Porto close to any nice place to visit. Clean and homey ! I could only recommend 👌
Check in was a breeze! Really nice place I was in awe. My best experience on Airbnb so far
Such an amazing stay and check in was so easy! Claudia was great and the apartment was in a great location!

Great space in a great location. We really enjoyed our stay, everything was very clean and as described and we found it really easy to walk to anywhere we needed to go. Claudia was a great host and responded quickly to any queries we had. We would recommend to anyone staying in Porto.
Claudia's place was excellent! I would recommend it to anyone looking to stay in Porto.

Everything was perfect, the apartment is very comfortable and has everything you need.  Great towels and linens, comfortable bed.  Anna is a very hospitable owner, we were able to check in ahead of time and after the trip it was very helpful.  Thanks for the treats also, it was very nice. Would definitely like to come back.

Ana was incredible. We were welcomed into the flat with some port wine and one of the best chocolate cakes that I have ever eaten.  Ana and her husband provided us with great information about what to do in Porto with our 4 year old. The apartment had a great location and was in great condition.

A lovely apartment with all the amenities in a terrific location one block off the Douro River, and a ten minute walk to the Ribeira. There is also a tram which runs along the river and will take you to most of the tourist areas. The big plus is that the neighborhood is close to everything but it is quiet for sleeping. It’s beyond clean and comfortable with a great shower, a washer/dryer and a well stocked kitchen. Ana is a remarkable host, there to answer any of your questions or concerns. She offered us some great suggestions for restaurants and sightseeing which made our stay in Porto even better. When we visit Porto again, we will definitely stay with Ana!

Ana was very accommodating during our stay by giving us a list of restaurants to visit in the area as well as things to do! She even baked us a chocolate cake which was very delicious :) The place was also very well located with an easy walk down to the historic centre as well as many public transport stops around the area. Can’t wait to come back!!

Such a lovely apartment, beautifully decorated and equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. It is also really quiet despite being close to the river and nice bars and restaurants. The best of both worlds! Ana is a wonderful host who goes out of her way to make sure everything is just right ,from the lovely cake and other treats on arrival, to helpful suggestions on where to visit and eat. She is a great ambassador for her city and country! We would love to return. Thank you Ana.

We really enjoyed this nicely decorated apt and it’s facilities! Very clean, well equipped, quiet and secure, the bed is very comfortable too!  Two minutes walk from the beautiful Douro, about 20 min walk from the famous Dom Luis bridge and Centro Historico and near bus stations that can be practical at times, we highly recommend this apt!  Ana is a wonderful host, available, very kind and helpful in every way! We were welcomed with Porto and a homemade cake and many other practical amenities. She recommended restaurants that we’ve tried and we’ve never regretted it!  Porto is a very beautiful city!!!
This place is absolutely clean and comfortable, it got almost everything you need. Hosts are very responsive when I had question, would definitely recommend !
A great apartment that is far enough outside the city center to be away from the mobs of tourists, but close enough to be walkable.
Appartment was clean and nice. Self check in and check out was easy. Host was reactive and easy to talk to.

Great apartment for a short stay on walking distance of Porto city center. Close to Lapa metro, supermarket and bakery nearby. There is a lovely small garden that you can enjoy when the weather is good. Accessible by stairs. Would recommend this place!

Apt was in a great spot, easy check in. Only issue is we specifically booked this apt for our final days in Portugal for the dryer, and we were unable to get the dryer to work. Seems like a recurring issue as seen in other reviews so I would imagine the hosts would have done some sort of troubleshooting as of now to ensure they can help guests. We did contact our hosts but they did not provide us with any info. In the end we had to take our wet clothes to a nearby laundromat to dry them for about .40€ /5 mins. If you’ll be using a dryer, I would be prepared to pay to dry your clothes.
Great spot. Calm thanks to the fact, that it faces away from the noisy street, great location, spacious apartment. We were very happy there.:)
Very nice stay with beautiful garden! Quiet and cozy, but for max 3 persons - I can’t imagine being there with more.

Patricia’s listing is the ideal place to stay for those wishing to explore Porto. All attractions are within walking distance since you are in the heart of the action (or public transport is only a few steps away). The accommodation was spotless and very cozy. Plus, it includes a balcony from which you can look out upon the action below, and a wine bar on the ground floor. Also, Patricia was very communicative, and checking in/out was a breeze. If I return to vacation to Porto again, this will absolutely be the place I will want to stay.
A lovely place right in the buzz of Porto! Patricia was kind and very easy to reach. Only thing is there’s no Wi-Fi so you might want to plan ahead for that.

Patricia was nice to us but the place we got needs some work done. The apartment is nice with beautiful original details but the furniture and bathroom are very rundown. Walls and windows also need cleaning. The floors were dusty. All in all, it wasn’t the best experience or deal, I’m afraid. The location is excellent, dead center, with lots of options around.
Modern,  renovated and clean flat in the middle of Porto. Great location walking distance from restaurants, shopping and attractions. Hospitality and service was top notch
apartment was very clean and spacious, host kept in communication and continued to check in to assure everything was running smoothly, we had a great experience

My stay was perfect here. The place met my expectations. The kids had great time playing at the sandy beach. Highly recommended. Very peaceful, calm, and safe. Ps. The neighbors were little bit “nosy”

Fantastic stay in a beautiful house. Its a huge house with lots of spaces for relaxing and privacy. The house is exceptionally clean and had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. The bikes were a extra bonus.

The home was a dream home with the open access of the courtyards and the proximity to the beach. Everything we needed was available in the home and several grocery stores were within walking or biking distance. Neighbors were friendly and there was a local restaurant where walked to most every night for a single drink and to watch the sunset and the owner was so welcoming that by the middle of our stay we were waving to one another like old friends. The few times I reached out to the owners, they responded quickly and were very helpful. it was just a beautiful place to stay and explore Porto. thank you.

We had a wonderful stay. The villa is as good as described, beautiful view to the Atlantic and beach. The area is very safe and quiet. A bit on the quiet side for the two teenagers in our family, but the rest of us enjoyed the possibility to go for long walks on the beach and have some occasional dinners at the restaurants in the village.

Beautiful home in amazing location! Antonio’s place was incredible. More than enough space for family of 5 with really picturesque courtyards for enjoying the mild temperatures plus it was just across the street from the beach. The home was well-appointed, clean and had all we needed to make meals at home. It is a truly special place and Antonio was a wonderful, responsive host. We loved the restaurant he recommended. Can’t wait to come back again!

Honestly the best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at. The place is so cool, it has beautiful views and the location is phenomenal. It feels like an artists hideaway outside of the city, and everything is a quick and easy bus ride to Porto. Will remember this property if I ever come back!
One of my favorite stays in Europe! A nice place in a cool part of the city close to the beach and 1 block from a delicious restaurant.

One of the most magnificent places I’ve slept at with Airbnb with so many beautiful details, combining both old and new. Everything was very comfortable and easy and helpful communication all along. Thank you!

Flat is as advertised. Great location in Foz near the beach. Lovely renovated old house, ideal for two couples. Paula and her team are professional, easy to reach (even on the weekend), and flexible regarding check in and check out times. The flat is well-equipped for cooking (a few more basics like oil and spices would have been helpful) and sleeping. We had a great stay. I can definitely recommend.

This place is a gem. It was spacious, light and airy. The location was perfect in the sense of peace and quiet and yet just a short walk to the river and sea front. Parking was in fact easier than anticipated and we were able to leave our car in the same spot each day and this was just 20 yards from the front door. Porto and its surroundings are beautiful and there is a lot to do and see.  Paula and Daniela were great hosts and very responsive and helpful. We would definitely recommend.

The stay was wonderful, and relaxing as always we have used this apartment many times.  Home me are fantastic any problems they are on it immediately.  The only issue is the dishwasher never has salt or rinse aid, this is the only negative.

Really nice and clean Airbnb! It’s a little bit of a walk away from city center (15-30min depending on where you are trying to get to) but it’s nice in that it’s away from the crowd.  The place is exactly as pictures and has nice amenities like washer, a/c and a fully stacked kitchen. Would recommend if you are okay with a slightly farther walk!
One of the best air bnb we have stayed in. Modern apartment with all the necessities we needed for our stay. Highly recommend

it was second time we stayed here. and everything was good as usual. Just some minor things that would improve experience: there was no salt, pepper, or sponge for washing dishes, although this was indicated in the description of the apartment. Also second time there was no kettle but it was pointed out at check-in and Diogo fixed the issue momentarily. One more thing to note though: the apartment comes without central heating (as it correctly stated in the description) so it might be a bit chilly without AC (apt has it) running on (привет ребятам из стран с центральным отоплением).

We appreciate very good communication with our host. Regarding a premises, we were fully satisfied. Location close to public transportation, nearby many shopping and dining possibilities, still quiet for good sleeping, we highly recommend...

We had an amazing stay in spite of the rainy weather. Porto has so much to offer and everything is within walking distance. We rented a car and drove from Lisbon but we later realized that a car is not needed. There is great transportation to get you around. We definitely recommend this place as it is very centrally located.

We had a really enjoyable and fabulous stay in Porto. It’s a very nice, private and quiet place, we love it very much. Pedro is a super nice and helpful host, he made us feel like home with warm welcome :)
Easy to find, central location. The space is beautiful! We really appreciated all the extra amenities in the kitchen- made cooking our own meals super easy. Would definitely recommend this place!
Great location and very clean, well-kept space. There were some minor issues with the amenities, but the host was responsive and helpful throughout. Would definitely recommend this place to stay.
Very nice apartment, luxury & modern. Location is very central but no noise in side apartment. Overall great stay.

The apartment was clean and location was great with metro and supermarkets. The apartment was quiet and cozy. The appliances were appeared all new and host offered apartment cleaning and new towels and linen within our 10 days stay. It was walkable to many places and very convenience with metro. Ms. Anna whom helped us check-in was very friendly. We would visit again.
The apartment was very clean, spacious & had everything needed for my stay. Quiet location and an excellent night’s sleep throughout. Hosts are extremely responsive & helpful.

We had a last minute change of travel plans and arrived in Porto one day before our other accommodation started... I'm so thankful we found this beautiful gem of a place (and I wish we had gotten to stay longer!).  Beatrix was extremely friendly, responsive, and accommodating. She let us check-in early, which was incredibly kind, so we didn't have to wander around for hours with our luggage. The apartment felt like a luxury hotel!  Located on a quiet street in a newly renovated building, it had everything you could need for a wonderful stay. The large private terrace was an added surprise (with a washing machine!), the bed was really comfortable, and the bathroom was spacious with a great rainfall shower.  I would definitely stay here again in a heartbeat... and you should too!
Very luxurious apartment (feels like a hotel suite) in a gorgeous modern building with a great balcony and spacious private garage. Couldn’t have asked for a better base to explore Porto. Fantastic!
It was quiet place, clean and secure. Not noisy, l liked the parking in the basement, the AC was good.

such a great stay! the view is breathtaking, the location is perfect!  apartment is clean and well decorated, a little bit on the smaller size but for a few nights its okay! will definitely be back again. great communication with the host, replies fast.
Comfortable bed, great views. Had some trouble with the electricity (not their fault), they were very prompt in fixing it.
Lovely, secure place to relax after a day of exploring. Easy access to great restaurants and bars.

This place is amazing!! So cute, so neatly and a perfect location! Cristina helped us more then we could ask for. With lots of information and even tried to help us book a massage and pedicure. Many thanks we will definitely come back!
Cristina is amazing and her apt is the best entry-point for the city of Porto. Highly advised 🤍

Very lovely stay at Cristina’s place, our 6 year old daughter slept very well on the sofa bed despite the pouring rain! Kitchen easy to use and fully equipped. Very private & quiet. A few minutes walk to bus & tram so quickly in the city center or at the beach side.

Christina’s place is beautifully designed, welcoming and comfortable. It’s well equipped, guest friendly and made us feel right at home. The house is so unique and close to cafes, shops, and the big park along the river. Christina was very responsive and helpful host. Thank you! We look forward to coming back!

Absolutely comfortable, stylish, and thoughtfully designed apartment — every detail has been considered. I stayed here during a workation and spent a lot of time at home, so I truly appreciated how well-equipped and cozy the space was. Cristina is incredibly kind, responsive, and always quick to answer any questions. The apartment is just a 3-minute walk from the Douro River and 5 minutes from the ocean. You’ll find parks, stylish cafés, and restaurants of all kinds nearby. The city center is about 15 minutes away by taxi.

Cristina's  home was one of the best places we've ever stayed in. It was spotlessly clean, comfortable and very spacious.  It was a few minutes walk to the beach, bus stop and tram to Porto. It was close to all amenities e.g. shops restaraunts, pharmacy and cafes. Cristina was an excellent host and responded quickly to all our queries.  She organised an Uber to and from the airport and as we were flying out very late, she allowed us to use the accommodation on the day of our flight. She was extremely helpful and kind and we are very grateful to  her. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would love to go back to Cozy Home. Thank you Cristina.
The apartment was impeccably clean, specious and comfortable. It's perfect for a family or a group, in a quiet street but still close to the center. 5 stars hospitality!

I definitely recommend this Airbnb! I stayed here while visiting Porto with 3 other friends and we had the best time!!! We had to find last minute accommodations, and Pedro was a lifesaver and was able to take us in. He is such a gracious and kind host, and we appreciated his professionalism and hospitality. The place is absolutely gorgeous, so beautifully decorated and there are such new amenities. The water pressure in the shower is fantastic, and the beds were so comfortable. The location is central and walking distance to many of Porto’s attractions.
Great service!! Pedro was very welcoming, the apartment was amazing, great view, so so so clean and at a super nice location.

Pedro’s apartment was perfect for a few days stay in Porto - location was ideal,  walking distance to main areas, apartment was very clean, very comfortable, well equipped and Pedro couldn’t have been more helpful. We very much enjoyed our stay - thank you Pedro!

This was one of the best airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in. Pedro was a fantastic host by greeting us when we arrived, offering to park our car for us, and giving us a long list of recommendations for things to do and restaurants. The rooms were spacious and bathrooms very nice. The balcony was so nice as well. Highly recommend incredible stay.

Pedro and Ricardo’s welcome on the first day of our stay was wonderful.  The apartment itself was clean and well appointed and as advertised. Expectations met. We would highly recommend to anyone staying in Porto.
Very spacious and nice appartment, on a +/- 15min walk of the city of Porto. Very nice designed, very clean. Communication was really OK!

Ricardo is a great host. Top tips. Very quick to reply to messages. Made our stay really convenient by providing some stuff for our baby. The apartment is better than the images. Sonia was also great with the later check-in, explaining everything clearly and giving us a detailed map. We will return.

Would not hesitate to recommend this air bnb. Was one of the best we have stayed in. From the host who met us after our flight was late (it was nearly midnight) and gave us super clear instructions and even a fantastic itinerary to follow with great food recommendations to the beautifully styled apartment, everything was amazing. Super comfy beds and great shower, honestly if you’re thinking about this just book it. Porto is a fabulous city! You will love it.

If we can give Pedro 100 out of 100, we definitely will do so.  He always answer my queries quickly.  Pedro is very professional as a host.  He is very helpful and friendly.  We have to say million thanks to Pedro, he went to purchase medicine for my son when in an emergency situation. The property is tidy and beautiful as described on the list.  My family enjoyed so much and even comfortable than at our own home. 😃We highly recommend for Pedro’s place. A high quality choice.  We definitely will refer to our friends.

This was a fantastic airbnb that looked just like the photos and matched the description. It felt like home and was very spacious. The location was perfect too! The host, Pedro, was very friendly, helpful and easy/quick to communicate with. He kept our luggage secure before the check in time and brought it all up for us! He even welcomed us with two bottles of wine and gave us a list of recommendations for food, bars and sights.  Obrigado Pedro. We had the best time and can’t wait to come back!

We where 7 friends visiting Porto and had a great time staying at Pedro's apartment which was spacious, clean and centrally located. It had everything we needed to make our stay perfect. Pedro was a super host always responsive when communicating and providing a lot of tips for what to see in Porto. I highly recommend this place.
Pedro was lovely and so welcoming. Nothing was too much trouble. The accommodation is in a fabulous area - central yet quiet.
This was one of the best Airbnbs I have ever stayed at. Ricardo couldn’t do more for us, from early check in to mid stay cleaning. Lots of room for our group. Highly recommend.

Our stay at Ricardo’s apartment in Porto was wonderful! This is a prime location, beautiful apartment, and walking distance to everything. Perfect for large families or groups looking to take in the best of what Porto has to offer!
Great location and easy walking to all the sites.  Ricardo was great host and apartment was great.
Great place. Fantastic location  Would highly recommend . Ricardo was a great host.

This was the perfect spot for our trip!! Ricardo was incredibly kind and easy to communicate with. He regularly checked to make sure we were having a good stay, which I appreciated. When I asked for a few extra towels, he immediately brought them. The view is great, and the location is also perfect walking distance to many of the attractions in Porto. Highly recommend staying here!
Ricardo was very responsive and helpful. The apartment is in an excellent location and Ricardo gave lots of helpful recommendations. The apartment was incredibly clean!  Thanks for a great stay!
Ricardo’s place was in a prime location. His communication was great throughout our stay. Highly recommend.
Highly recommend staying here! Such as beautiful place in a beautiful city. Ricardo and Luisa provided great recommendations for things to do and restaurants as well.

Beautiful apartment located in a peaceful area (great sleeps!) with amenities, wonderful restaurants and places to explore just minutes away. Check-in was simple and instructions were clear. The host was super friendly and gave us lots of great recommendations to make our stay easy.  The kitchen was perfect, lovely big bed and GREAT shower! The view from the bedroom is also spectacular to sit in bed and catch the sunrise from. Everywhere was spotless and exactly as described. I would 100% recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Porto. Thank you!
Really nice place in a neighborhood with plenty of services but not touristy. Walkable to the tourist highlights w/out all the noise and chaos

This apartment is nice hotel style and has everything we needed. Neighborhood is quiet and very safe and it takes 15 min to get to metro station 24 Augusta if needed. Since most of our interests were in Historic part of Porto we  walk every day and sometimes used Uber to get back when we were returning to apartment late. Grocery stores in the neighborhood close earlier.  We loved it and would come back again.

This is a lovely quieter corner of Porto to stay in, a bit more lowkey but easy to get into town (we love to walk everywhere), or catch the metro which is ~10 mins walk. The building/accommodation seems quite new, and the courtyard was not accessible yet, which was a shame because we had seen some photos and were really excited! Check in relies on someone meeting you there, and given you cannot always be sure of your arrival time this can be a bit tricky/stressful, but the team were really responsive and it worked out.  All in all it was a little less homely / artisinal than we maybe expected but comfortable, clean, modern and we had a great stay.
Very nice stay. Quiet apartment in a calm area. Very good and quick communication with the host company. Would definitely return here another time.
This was great for me. I like to walk. So I could walk to tourist places and come back to the peaceful space. There were nice restaurants walkable as well. All great.

Well equipped apartment. It is well located in a nice neighborhood with restaurant and close to city center.  All communications done with a renting agency and not directly with the owner of the apartment, be prepared to receive several messages per day for all types of communication related to the appartement (arrival, stay, visits, departure).

Absolutely one of the best Air BnB’s I’ve rented. Ricardo was a super responsive host.  He met us at check-in, provided recommendations for the area and was very responsive. The apartment was clean, central to all the major sites AND on a very quiet street.
Great place to explore Porto with a fantastic host and a well set up house! We were 3 couples and the place did not disappoint! Highly recommended !

We had a fantastic stay at Isabel and Igor’s apartment in Porto. The place is beautiful, better than the pictures. Location is great, you can walk to all the important landmarks. And Isabel was available at all time which made our stay so much easier. We look back to being in Porto again and would definitely stay here again

A huge and beautiful place right in the middle of where we wanted to be in Porto. It feels somehow right in the middle of everything, but also peaceful and quiet. The beds are super comfortable, and there were many well thought out touches. The hosts gave us incredibly clear instructions ahead of time, so it was easy to find. We really appreciate having coffee, water, candy, and port when we arrived!! Would definitely stay here again if we returned to Porto
This place was in a great location. We enjoyed the terrace and the furniture and amenities were really lovely. Gorgeous lighting. Loved the keypad entry system. Nice not to have to deal with a key.
We had a great stay, the apartment was gorgeous, location couldn’t be better, and the hosts were awesome too! Would repeat without a doubt.

Perfect stay close to everything in the historic area! The Airbnb was so spacious and had s nice view of the cathedral from the balcony! Hosts were extremely responsive and beds were comfortable! Was wonderful to have the outdoor space to hang and our toddler loved the bunk bed! Would definitely recommend for your Porto stay!!!

As described there are stairs without a lift.  Once you walk up two flight of stairs to the unit once in the unit you need to walk up another set of stairs.   There was a heat wave when we were there and the air conditioners worked great!  So welcoming after long days.   The unit was large an spacious.

fantastic stay at this Airbnb. It exceeded our expectations as I dont think the photos do it justice. We were blown away by the gorgeous architecture of the building and design of the apartment. Very spacious for our weekend getaway. The balcony overlooked a quiet market and location was spot on to visit the river, old town and walk all around to explore wonderful Porto. Highly recommend.

We really enjoyed our stay! Apartment was spacious and comfortable. The location is convenient to shopping, restaurants and grocery store. We only had to walk a few hundred meters to have a great meal. There is metro construction nearby but it is not a distraction as they stop around 5. Igor and Isabel were very responsive and great hosts… highly recommend!

Excellent property in a prime location.  Easy access to all major sites within walking distance, and a very convenient parking lot right next door.  We have stayed in several different apartments in Porto, but this one felt like a much more authentic experience and not a cookie cutter remodel like many other listings.   Highly recommend this stay for anyone visiting Porto.

It’s ok. It’s central and convenient. The apartment is big, and holds a family quite comfortably. The living room decoration is nice. 2 rooms are on the smaller side, but it makes sense as this option enable the house to have one more bedroom. The general feeling of the apartment refurbishment is that it could have more quality, especially taking into consideration the asking price for a night. There are definitely some sub par material and building quality options (I’m not referring to the old/historic nature of the apartment, but specifically to the new fittings. If you can live with that for a few nights, it’s an ok place.

Near perfect stay! Only complaint was that the shades in the living room were broken so if my friends wanted to go out on the balcony they had to go through the bedroom. Other than that, the location was great and place was very nice!

We absolutely loved the apartment and terrace with the view! The flat was clean, warm and easy to find! The location is amazing, easy to get to main attractions on foot! We would definitely book once again when going to Porto❤️
Perfect location, very comfortable for 2 or even 3 people. Air con on living room and bed room. Everything worked and we really recommend this place.

If you are looking for the best location in Porto, this is it. Very good spot right in the heart of Porto, and near the river and central tourist area. The place is cozy and tidy, the only drawback is the 5 floor excursion up and down each time you leave and come back. For people in good shape it isn’t a dealbreaker, maybe even consider it exercise! For less fit people keep it in mind. Otherwise this place has a lot of history and a lot going for it.

Urban is a great host. Our place was wonderful. This is the second time I’ve stayed here nice and quiet clean nicely appointed Urban got back to us quickly about anything we asked I would highly recommend.

We moved to Portugal and lived in this lovely place for 3 weeks while we looked for a long term rent in Porto. Claudia and her mum Laura are very helpful and polite hosts, always willing to help in all matters! The house itself is endlessly lovely - it's fresh, clean, everything you need is available and the terrace is gorgeous! It was comfortable for 2 of us to work and rest here. We were with our 2 gentle pets, special thanks for being pet friendly♥️ When looking for a long term flat, we unintentionally raised our bar of choice because we wanted the same level of comfort as Claudia's home. Thank you for reducing our stress of moving to a new country through the cosiness and beauty of this house🙌

I really enjoyed staying in Claudias Home. It is so beautiful, clean, bright, modern and comfortable. I was feeling at home since the first day and I am so thankful for the opportunity to wash clothes and to use the spices in the kitchen. Also the communication with Claudia and her family was really easy. The only thing that I didn't expect was the noisy cars outside by night. But all in all we are really thankful for the great time im Loft Seixo.

This is a beautiful and convenient place to stay -- away from the hustle and bustle (and touristy nature) of central Porto.  Foz is a great neighborhood right by the sea and by the mouth of the Douro and a great place to be.  If you want to spend every moment of the day at one of the tourist attractions in central Porto with other tourists, then you probably want to find a different place that is more centrally located.  But if you want something more Portuguese in flavor and more relaxed, this is the place to come.  The apartment is beautiful and well laid out.  A well-appointed kitchen, great bathroom, very nice living room/dining area, and a private and cozy bedroom with a very good bed and lots of closet space.  Worked very well for us as a couple and would be fine for a couple with a child. Highly recommended.
like a hotel room but you have 4 burners and large refrigerator with closet space.Good location.

The place was nice and clean. There was a construction going on right next to the room, making it a bit worrisome whenever I opened the windows for ventilation. There is no conditioner or body wash provided, just shampoo. No slippers as well. I could get to pretty much any place I wanted to go to within 10 or so minutes of walk. So it is good for anyone who gets tired easily or is already tired from the trips prior. The bed was comfy. The kitchen is small. The staff were all really professional and quick to respond.
Great cozy place in the center of the city, while being super quite. It is close to everything, definitely worth the price. Would highly recommend it.

Fabulous stay in this place! Only slight inconvenience was the power cut as we arrived and so it wasn’t as easy to get in as we hoped - but the host got it sorted straight away and was very responsive and polite. We were worried initially as we didn’t realised there was no AC, however - the fan provided was fab and honestly better than AC somehow
It was good but the entrance was bad, location perfect. Good room with an outdoor space which is nice
Great place. Easy check in great communication with Upper ground  Location is great, you can walk to the main touristic attractions
Beautiful place,  overall very satisfied with our stay. Also very similar to the pictures, only problem was with the bathroom door it couldn't close and open easily.
Very good location, near to city center, very responsive host, easy check in, I will stay again!
Great apartment, helpful host.  There were no problems and we enjoyed our stay. Thank you!
Perfect accommodations for our family Saturday in Portugal !! Clean apartment , everything we needed. Close to all public transport and perfect walking distance to the Douro and surroundings.
Everything worked really great. The host team was very kind & helpful. Place looks great! Would. Totally recommend it to anyone else!
This was a great stay! Would highly recommend! My family and I had a great time staying at this place!

It was decorated nicely, clean on arrival and there was great communication. It was a bit noisy in the front 2 bedrooms and the beds were quite hard. Only one remote control for all the aircon units as well.

The host was amazing : we had an issue with our hotel and had to reserve this Airbnb last minute at 9pm. They answered really fast and agreed to prepare the Airbnb quickly for us on the same night! We are so grateful.  The Airbnb was perfectly located, we were able to walk to every landmark. The apartment also looks beautiful. AC in every room. Perfect for 6 adults!

Breakfast is very delicious. For us, we had a separate toilet so there was no issue to use toilet and take a shower. All the furniture, tableware and interior design is lovely! We’d like to visit Porto again because of this accommodation! Jose and his wife are kind and considerate. I hope many people will know this place. Thank you for hosting us. We really loved this place. We will definitely come again. See you soon😊

This was the best place we’ve ever stayed in. The apartment is located in a peaceful area with beautiful surroundings. It’s super close to the metro station and there is a plenty of shops around.  The apartment itself is gorgeous, the design is great and the garden is beautiful. It’s a lovely place to wind down and enjoy the day.  The hosts are wonderful! They are incredibly friendly and helpful. It makes your stay so much better with such amazing people around you. Also, the breakfasts are SO good! You can also get vegetarian option. We loved our stay so much and we will definitely get back when we visit Porto again. ❤️

I can confidently say that my stay at this place was truly above and beyond. We were greeted by a friendly host who gave us a tour of the amenities and was always willing to answer questions and offer help. The breakfast was really great, more than we could ask for given the price. The place was kept very clean throughout the day. To top it off, the metro station is just across the street. No complaints whatsoever!

Fantastic place to get a good nights rest on a budget since it’s super quiet and windows not near any roads. Easily walkable to get to everywhere!! Rita was lovely in telling me all the good spots for food, tourist spots, clubs/bars, and she even gave us a map. Thank you for everything!
The appartement was very well located, beautiful and confortable. The communication was easy and efficient.
Alexandre is a great host! The apartment is nice and the location is perfect, right in the city center. Absolutely suggested!

Everything about the place is great, clean, easy to use and exactly as described. It’s a fantastic location with close walking distance to the old town and surrounding restaurants and sights. Thanks Alexandre for a great stay!
