Great location, super clean apartment, and host was super accommodating of our late check out request. Overall, incredible Airbnb.
A spotless, spacious apartment in the heart of old Porto.  I would definitely stay here again.

I really liked the apartment, location and condition of the apartment. Clean, cozy, has everything you need, luxurious location. What else do you need for a good vacation?)) Nice attentive owner of the apartment, quick answers to questions. The overall impression is wonderful, I want to come back more than once to this wonderful city! Thank you, Alex!

What an amazing way to start our journey! This place has everything you need! Walking distance to city sights, perfect location, parking available, well decorated, sparkling clean, well equipped, beautiful balcony, great view and Neil has been the best host, always responsive, friendly, accessible and he also wait for is to show the parking lot since we had a rented car. One of our bast stays so far! Definitely recommended!!!

Had an amazing time! The apartment is so nice and clean. Perfect location, walkable to all the main attractions but very quite in the room. Excellent black out blinds makes it easy to sleep. The host is super friendly, very responsive and helpful. Also great balcony to sit out with a glass of wine.

We really enjoyed our stay in Porto. The communication before arrival was very helpful and clear. A bonus was meeting Neo at the building and being guided to the parking and the apartment. The parking garage is tight as are all in Europe, but easy to access and full in and out privileges The apartment is as it looks on the site and has many fun decorative touches. It’s a very comfortable and warm place with very good amenities and a nice outdoor deck.  The location is great. Almost anything you might want to go to is within walking distance and we did that a lot. Remember though that Porto is literally built on the side of a hill and any walk means many changes in elevation including some very steep ones.  We would without a doubt stay here again if we returned to Porto and unhesitatingly recommend it to any couple that wants a comfortable, clean and well located place to stay.
We had a great stay in Porto and it was in a great location. It was good having a car park. We would recommend staying in this apartment.
I loved the location and proximity to all the attractions. Daniel's place is very clean and well stocked with so many items.
this place was very cute and greatly located. we were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. the garage was convenient and we went able to park and not worry about anything

This Porto studio was a gem! The view was absolutely incredible. The location was perfect, allowing easy access to all the main attractions and great restaurants. Our host was very nice, always responsive and helpful with local recommendations. The studio itself was comfortable and had everything we needed for our stay. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Porto!
Well located, beautifully appointed apartment, full of amenities, right near the old town. We loved our stay here.

The flat was in a decent spot to many attractions. Exactly like the photos, and very well equipped for all culinary needs if required. Daniel was super helpful and always quick to respond. Thanks for a great stay.

We enjoyed our stay in Porto:) very clean and comfortable apt on 6 th floor ..elevator right by entrance. Bathroom with nice rain head shower. Easy pick up for Ubers. Nice pastry shop just few doors down. City sight seeing hop on bus pick up area conveniently  located right down street. Thank you Daniel for the bottle of Vino Verde and cookies:)

Wow. Daniel's AirBNB is nothing short of amazing. It's situated in a very convenient area (walking distance to Bolhão station, Chapel of Souls and a variety of shops and restaurants). The unit itself is very clean, has a beautiful view of the Porto skyline and has everything you would need for your stay. 10/10 I would highly recommend for anyone vactioning in Porto.

The apartment was very nice! Clean, easy to get to, and centrally located! Daniel’s instructions for locating and getting in were very clear, and he was very responsive throughout. We would definitely recommend staying here!

We loved staying at Daniel's place in Porto.  It is not far from the iconic Luis bridge and within walking distance to most of Porto's main attractions.  It has a wonderful, peaceful balcony which one can see the Torre dos Clérigos.  A lovely place indeed.

We loved our stay in Porto! The apartment was beautiful, clean and comfortable, and their instructions were very easy to follow. Having a spot to park our car was also a great perk, especially since you can walk to everywhere from this spot easily. We highly recommend this spot if you’re in Porto!
Great place in an excellent location. We really enjoyed the cleanliness of the apartment and included amenities. The balcony was the perfect spot to enjoy morning coffee and evening wine.
I had a very pleasant stay there,  would highly recommend it to other guests as well :) from all perspectives: the location, the apartment itself and communication with the host :)

Michael's place was great. Close to everything, there are great restaurants around. I walked everywhere and it was an incredible stay. Michael was a great host, always responsive and gave tons of suggestions! The beds were comfortable, and the room was bright. I would definitely recommend it!

Great value for money. The accommodation was simple but it had everything we needed. Good location with breakfast places etc. nearby. Our room in the attic got quite hot during the day, but at night it was fine when sleeping with the window open (there was also a fan).
Excellent home in a great area of Porto.  Clean, modern and very comfortable.  Alexandra was a great host.

What a fabulous stay!  Alexandra helped arrange transportation from the airport from a super nice driver and Mario helped us get oriented, gave us lots of great recommendations and was super helpful.  The apartment is modern but still warm because of the great decorating and the location is great too.  Great stay. Hope some day we’ll be back.
Hands down one of the nicest AirBnBs I’ve ever stayed it. I have nothing but positive things to say. The view, decor and location are all fabulous.

This place was perfect for our family if 4 for the four nights we stayed there. It was super clean and looked exactly like the pictures, plus the tiny balconies had wonderful views to take in the city sites! The location was total perfection. Amazing restaurants within an easy walk yet far enough away to get a little quiet. Loved this place!
Great, clean apartment in a perfect location.  The apartment was roomy and easily housed 6 adults and kids. Beautiful views included. Highly recommend.

This place met and exceeded our family of four's expectations.  Very spacious and modern with all the amenities you'd want.  Washer/dryer unit was key as it allowed us to pack lighter.  The view....wow.  You can see the southern side of the Douro with Gaia in the background, and in the foreground an inspiring view of Igreja de Sao Joao Novo cathedral.  It's an easy walk to many attractions or just for getting lost in an enchanting city.  Alexandra was very responsive and straightforward.  Highly recommended.

This apartment is BEAUTIFUL! It's very modern and luxurious. The view out the windows are incredible. It's even better than the pictures. There's a washer and dryer in the closet outside that works great. We had nespresso pods ready for us. Uber pickup and drop off was super easy to find and fast to the front door. We were able to walk to some amazing restaurants right across the street and also only a few minute walk across the river. It's really a beautiful place that I will recommend to any friends and family on their visit to Porto.

Alexandra’s place was pristinely clean and matched the photos. A perfect spot for 6 guests to live comfortably. Enjoyed the views from the kitchen and the furniture was comfortable. Alexandra was also a very attentive and responsive host. Would recommend to anyone visiting Porto!

The apartment was perfect for 5 adults - location, amenities and living space were all fabulous. The bedrooms were plenty large enough, and the views from most every room were spectacular. We were able to easily walk to every place on our agenda - the Tower, Cathedral, Lello bookstore, Crystal Palace gardens, the riverfront etc. - with local restaurants right around the corner.  Alexandra and Oedro were wonderful hosts, offering guidance and suggestions at every turn. All together, it was an experience and accommodation my friends and I enthusiastically recommend!
Great spot. V close to viewing spot for sunsets. All the sights were within walking distance. Set us up for a fantastic trip.
We had a fabulous stay in Porto. The apartment was clean, comfortable and well stocked, and exactly what we expected. Beautiful views in all directions.. We would definitely stay here again.
Great place to stay in Porto’s historic core. Looked just like the pictures. Would recommend.

Great place in Porto. Views are amazing and the host could not have been more helpful. They booked transportation for us and had someone meet us to carry the luggage up the stairs. Apartment is completely renovated and convenient to everything in Porto.
We enjoyed our short stay in Porto! This place was very comfortable and we loved the views. We liked being close to restaurants, shops and historic sites. Thank you for sharing your home with us!
Great location. Walkable to all that the old part of town has to offer. Clean and modern. Would stay again.

We spent a great time in Porto and this Upperground Airbnb place is definitely recommendable. Touristic attractions are and Metro stations are a bit far but still easy to reach by alternative means. Rooms properties met the descriptions in Airbnb and Angela provided quick support.

Wow what a place. Beautiful, clean, had everything we needed and more! Perfect location, easy access and the cutest tea house right in front.  Would absolutely recommend this place and we will return 🥰

I think this is the nicest airbnb for the price I’ve ever stayed in. My cousin and I felt right at home the moment we entered. Extremely clean and beautifully decorated. Hope to stay here again in the future!
Such a cute place! Very close to everything and easy to get around. Felt very safe as well.

It is very central and located in the nice area. Easy to reach everywhere.  Room description fits to actual room condition. Very satisfied, except for the towels / Dishwasher. We stayed here for 5 days but they gave us only one towel. I asked to get more, but they didn’t reply :/

We had a nice stay in the apartment :) everything was very clean.  We had the opportunity for an early check in, which was really nice.  The apartment is in an street which has a lot of nice design stores and 5- 10 min walk there are nice breakfast places.

One of my favourite airbnbs. Great location that’s just far enough out of the loud city centre, but close enough to walk. The room is great, shower and bathroom are clean, and the kitchen is big enough to actually make food. It’s a great deal- Highly recommended
A wonderful stay in Lisbon. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to visit the city. The Airbnb is in a great location and the host is very responsive to any needs.
Great place to stay in Porto. Near the city, walkable, and great spots all around. The stay is private enough too. We'll be back!
It was an amazing stay! We loved Porto, and you are part of it! I would definitely come back there. Thank you again and thanks for the flexibility at the end.  Have a lovely summer.

We had a great time at the apartment, it was clean and looked like the pictures. The neighbourhood is cool, very artsy with a lot of ateliers around and street art. Even though it was so central we could sleep at night.  The check in was easy thanks to a keybox. I can totally recommend it for a nice Port getaway ☺️

a nice place. what was not apparent is that it's one studio in a house with several other studios and a common area. we still had privacy in the unit, but it did not feel like a separate place but rather a set of larger remodelled rooms that were all Airbnb rentals.

super comfortable stay! very clean and had everything you need for feeling like your home away from home for a few days. few minutes out of the core busy downtown area, off on a quieter street which is nice

Exactly as described, easy check in. The place inside is bigger than what the pictures look, lots of space… We was quite surprised how spacious it was compared to the pictures… great location. Would stay here again. Thankyou for hosting us ❤️
Nice apartment and well decorated, but the host is not very responsive to the request or clarification. More like copy n paste response….
Marta’s place is exactly like the pictures. Beautiful apartment in a great location. Flexible and easy check in. Would definitely recommend and would come back again!

Beautiful place, it made me feel right at home especially after traveling for a couple weeks. I didn’t want to leave! It was super clean, centrally located, private, and safe. Marta was also very responsive. I enjoyed my stay and would stay here again!
My mom and I were in Porto for a few days and had a super comfortable stay at this Airbnb! It looks just like the pictures and is really well located, we walked around the area a lot and loved it.

The apartment is beautiful and  located perfectly in walking distance to shops and restaurants. The streets in front of the apartment can get very noisy even in the middle of the night but the bed is hidden away behind thick glass doors which help a lot and make it possible to sleep.
We stayed here for 5 days with our toddler. We had a great stay. Communication with the host was very easy. Location was excellent. Would recommend

Very nice location, walkable to all tourist attractions.  Clean and spacious apartment, classic and elegant high ceilings design.  Bedroom is not a real separate room, but more like an area separated by glass door.  It worked well for us, only 2 guests. There seem to be multiple Airbnb units in the building, ours was facing street, not with the best quietness at night.  But it did not bother us anyways. Marta is very responsive to all our questions. A pleasant staying.
The space was clean and cozy. The location was perfect, with easy access to local attractions. I felt right at home and can’t wait to return! Highly recommend!

I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking to be in the center of Porto. Literally in the center! You can walk to all main attractions. Marta and her crew were super attentive during our whole stay

Beautiful, elegant and well equipped apartment loft. Fantastic location, easy to find, very easy check in, walkable from metro (8 min). It is next door to Casa Guedes which has out of this world Bocadillos de Pernil, make sure you try it! Lots of great restaurants and cafes nearby. The apartment is quiet, it has lovely soft pillows and very comfortable mattress. We had a perfect night sleep!

This studio is everything you could wish for. Everything you would need for a short stay here, with excellent air con, wifi, great kitchen and decent comfortable furnishing. The location is just great. A short interesting walk from Trindade station with bars, restaurants and little shops in abundance. Lots of dining options and bars on the doorstop. Despite this, the place never felt noisy. Managed to get an Uber to the airport within a minute of ordering too!

We stayed for two nights and we loved the area!  A wonderful cafe across the street and a fantastic Mexican restaurant just around the corner!!  Besides the long stair climb, it was a wonderful place to stay in Porto!
Everything was perfect! Better than the pictures, location was perfect, everything walking distance! Hope we can visit again!

We had a great stay at Paula & Rafael’s. The apartment is in a perfect location with many great brunch restaurants nearby. We were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. The kitchen was well equipped for cooking and the bed was quite comfortable. We’d recommend the apartment!
Great location, maybe the best in Porto. Flat is really cute, new and perfect for a couple. However the entire house and the flat has a smell from the sewage pipes coming and going.
This was a lovely place to stay. The hosts were so responsive and kind. We enjoyed how easy it was to walk to all the main sites in Porto. Would absolutely stay again!
Great location, apartment was clean and had all the essentials. Will mention that the bathroom is a little tight, wasn’t an issue for us but it could be a hassle for some.
Everything was top notch .... really lovely place only fault it was hard to get into the shower as shower head obstructed the door Otherwise we are very very happy with our stay in Porto

Cute little apartment that is exactly as described and shown in the photos.  Great location and near to lots of eating and drinking spots.  Nice to be able to relax in a comfortable space after a hard day walking up and down the Porto hills. Really comfortable bed, pillows and bed linen. Will definitely be back.
This apartment was a gem in Porto! It was very clean and the host was super helpful and kind.
A wonderful accommodation - very close to all the key sights/transport links and kept in pristine condition. Easy check in and out and a perfect stay, thanks!
We had a great stay at Paula & Rafael’s! It was a perfect location, and the place was beautiful.
This Airbnb is amazing and easy to check into with a code so you don’t lose your keys! Both bathrooms were so clean and there are enough amenities to cook. We enjoyed it a lot!!

The place itself is nice, looks great. Amenities are OK, however some things could use a little eye for detail. The smell is noticable, in case of breathing conditions one should reconsider booking. Overall nice, but the humid air was bothering.
Host was very responsive and location was great! Main tourist attractions were walkable distance from the location and area overall felt very safe.

When it's hot, it's so awful to sleep on plastic mattress protector provided by the host of this “hotel”. Many complains have been seen before but nothing has been changed regarding it.  Plus the size of bed sheet is smaller than the bed, so in the morning you woke up separately from it and again, on an awful plastic protector. There is “air conditioning” which is not working at all. So the room is quite small and hot. The homeless person is sleeping in the entrance. Better to find something else
5/5 experience! It wasn’t the first time with guestready and it won’t certainly be the last, this one was very well located too
Overall great experience and great value. The towels great but the mattress was a bit rough for those with delicate backs and shoulders.

The perfect week! Beautiful surroundings, lots of good places to eat nearby, very nice people all around. It was the perfect place for us, since we were taking surfing lessons and also wanted to go to Porto for the turistic activities. The hosts were amazing as well, super responsive, and they let us have an early check-in and a late checkout. 10/10 recommend.

We had a great stay at Ricardo's beachfront apartment! The view was amazing, and the location couldn't have been better with dinner and drinks on the balcony overlooking the ocean. Ricardo's mother-in-law was incredibly helpful and kind, making our trip with a four-year-old and a newborn much smoother. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Highly recommend this place for a relaxing getaway!

We loved the location and sea view of Richardo’s apartment. The location has plenty of restaurants, shopping, and activities. The apartment was as described and offered a nice space for me and my family with ample closet space and comfortable couch. I would stay there again. That said, we could hear the people the floor above us and the rooms did not have a fan. So if you want to close the windows for a quieter sleep the room became a little warm. Overall, I found the apartment offered us a great stay by the beach.
Cristina was great in helping us check in and out. Great views of the beach, spotless condition and well appointed. Thank you Ricardo and Cristina

Exceeded our expectations. We were very warmly and graciously received by Cristina. Both Cristina and Ricardo responded promptly when we had any questions.  The apartment was extremely well furnished . Everything impeccable. Abundant supply of great towels and bed linens. Kitchen was very well stocked. The pictures do not do it justice. Incredible ocean views from every room.  We had a great month and are looking forward to returning

Great value for money, very clean and convenient. Neighbourhood is just outside the old city, 10-15 min walk to everything. 2 bedrooms and a free parking is a major plus! The host is very responsive and attentive. Thank you!

Everything went well, Andre was very polite , communication was easy, checkin was very easy, apartment was very clean .  Location was a little far from luis bridge (30 minutes) but i was walking by foot so it is not big deal . I recommended

Andre is kind and always responsive. He kindly allowed me to check-in earlier (Of course it depends on availability though). The room was clean and had enough space for two. Kitchen facilities was new and easy to use. The stove was induction. Just be aware that there is no shampoo or body soap provided in the bathroom.

Good place for the price you pay, organised, clean and easy to self check in.  Walkable distance to the centrum of Porto with many bakeries, shops and supermarkets in the surroundings. The communication with the host was also smooth. Very much recommended.
I liked my stay at Andre’s place very much and can only recommend it to everyone. Andre himself is a very nice host. I just arrived in Porto and he was very helpful with any problems etc I had.
It was a 5 star house, close to the city center, I would like to stay in the same house again when I come again.
Really nice host and the location is near by the centrum of the city so you can easily get to the main attractions by foot.  Nice Air-bnb with a cute balcony.  Thanks for having me!
I would recommend coming to this cozy apartment, it’s very well located if you plan to explore Porto

The Airbnb is amazing, even better than the pictures ! The small garden is really cute and nice to enjoy the sun. The location is great but a little far from the center (which is not bad because de neighboor is very calm). Everything was convenient and clean. I totally recommend !

The place is very cozy, well equipped and nicely decorated with a nice outside balcony/garden. Host was very helpful, communication and check-in (out) were very easy. Location, is also great very central and well communicated. Good value for money.
The house is amazing and super big! Garden outside to have breakfast or take some sun.   I really liked and enjoyed my stay.

We had a wonderful time! Sofia is really kind and helpful and responds very fast to messages. The apartment was clean and nice and well located. Supermarkets are nearby as well as nice restaurants and bars. Big recommendation!

Beautiful and spacious apartment great for 2 people. Loved having the outdoor space accessible as well and being located in a neighborhood that felt more local but still very easy to access all the main city spots in about 20 min walk. Anna was super responsive and was available to help whenever we had questions
Amazing place to stay in Porto. Well located, you can find whatever you need close. Rafael was friendly and helped us with all we needed.

Rafael and his husband were extremely kind and made us feel very welcome into their beautiful home. However, we had expected that we would be able to enjoy the view a bit more by sitting on the balcony, making ourselves a coffee in the kitchen etc., but since our hosts were using the common area every night and morning/midday, we didn’t feel like spending time anywhere else than in our small (but lovely) room.  So, this place is lovely and unique if you’re looking for kind and personal hosts and a bed to sleep in after a day in Porto.

Our stay at Rafael’s was amazing! He was so friendly and made us feel very comfortable in his home. He also gave us recommendations of things to do and places to see. Flexible check in since we landed late at night and he was kind enough to let us check out later since our departing flight was late, too. 10/10 experience, would totally recommend!
Rafael and his partner are lovely people and went above and beyond to accommodate me and make me feel at home.

Very comfortable, quiet, and clean space. It's small, but very cozy, modern, and the view from the balcony is great. There's tons of great restaurants and grocery stores nearby within a short walk. If you like coffee, visit Fabrica coffee which is an easy walk away. The surroundings are much quieter than further towards the river, but it's still very easy to walk down and cheap to Uber back up. Overall, highly recommend this place.
I loved my stay in Porto! This apartment is super cute and it’s in an awesome location. Sebastien was an excellent host! I’d definitely stay here again.

Beautiful apartment in a great location! We even received a wine and cookies from Porto! There was even a blow dryer with a diffuser which our curly hair needed! Would stay here again in a heartbeat! Thank you!

Overall, a great stay and value for money!! Hard to imagine a better location, everything was super close;) There were a couple of small hiccups, but the hosts were really responsive and it was all resolved pretty quickly. Can definitely recommend!
Great location close to many attractions, restaurants, bars and supermarket.  Apartment was very cozy, clean. We enjoyed the balcony with city view.

Great apartment in my favorite street of Porto. One thing to note is that the ventilation system turns on very early (at least 7 AM) and is relatively loud in this place. So if you are sensitive to noise and a night owl this might be an issue for you.
We stayed there just a weekend, but everything was good - accommodation, place, instruction, communication with host

Our stay in Porto was very nice. The flat is small, but has everything you need. The location is perfect; supermarket, metro, cafés and restaurants nearby. Only downside was the late check-in time because we arrived early and the dust cleaning could have been better - but all in all a nice apartment to a fair price.
Great little self contained apartment in a fantastic location. Has everything you need for a short stay. Would happily recommend.

A lovely studio in a fantastic spot. We were comfortable and very happy with everything provided (including thoughtful wine and biscuits left by the host). Communication was excellent and overall the experience was ideal.
Really nice flat in the old city centre of  Porto. The location is perfect to visit the city, although really noisy. Sebastian and the Lovely Stay team were nice and available.

We had a really nice stay in Porto, the airbnb was very cosy and clean. The location couldnt be better, we walked everything. In the night a bit noisy when you like to have to window open, when you close them then its fine. We would really recommend this airbnb for a great citytrip in Porto!

We had a wonderful stay at Alexandra’s apartment!  She was the perfect host and her place was just what we were hoping for.  Great location in a quiet neighborhood and close to all major attractions in Porto.  The apartment is thoroughly updated and super clean.  We loved our stay and hope to come back soon!

Three friends/colleagues stayed here together to attend an academic conference near the super bock arena. The location is easily walkable and close to a supermarket (Froiz) and Porto’s great transit system. Alexandra was incredibly kind and helpful with great suggestions for restaurants and places to see in the city. The place had many of thoughtful amenities for guests, such as sunscreen and coffee pods for the nespresso machine and more. Most mornings and evenings we enjoyed a coffee or drink on the private terrace. We very much enjoyed our stay and recommend this place to anyone without hesitation!
Incredibly beautiful and comfortable stay.  Host was lovely and very accommodating.  Great neighbourhood!

Diogo’s place is beautiful, clean and tidy. Has all the amenities that is required. The pool spot is also a sun trap during the day!  Benedita’s communication was great, she was so helpful as our flight was delayed and she still helped us check in after 10pm.  She was only a message  away and gave us lots of recommendations on things to do!  Will definitely stay here again if there was a group of us

Fantastic place to stay just outside of the busy city centre. Great for having private outdoor space as well as a pool and very simple to get into the centre. Very responsive host and would thoroughly recommend
Firstly I loved Porto, Portuguese, Matosinhos :) it was a lovely trip. The host and his/ her team was very helpful. So thank you for everything :)
Had a great stay & would definitely stay here again! The apartment was clean, close to the area I needed to be & they gave me lots of useful information before I arrived. Thank.
Hi, it was great experience and we would like to come back in future. Thank you for made my trip easy and homely❣️ Regards Roop
Great experience with great, communicative hosts. Check in was in person and professional. Host was availible all the time via phone :) Great metro connection. Wheelchair was not a problem at all :)
Great host, with a great place. You can walk to all the tourist spots and food within 30 min. The location made the stay very comfortable.

Orit and Meni’s apartment is a clean, spacious and light filled space with everything you’d need for a few days away in Porto. They were great hosts and extremely responsive.  The location is good, a little bit of a walk out of the central city area but easy enough to get to. You do only get one key which is something to consider if there’s a few of you staying.  We did have some trouble, whereby a technician came to fix a chair in the apartment whilst we were out for a number of hours and ended up leaving the door to the apartment open. Fortunately nothing was taken and we raised this with Orit and Meni who looked into it very quickly, however there was no real outcome.  Other than this, we really enjoyed our stay in Porto and would happily recommend the apartment.

The place is great and in a fantastic location.  The house is perfect for 4-5 people and is very clean, has most of the things you need. I’d only call out the fact the checkin was tough, the full instructions weren’t shared in advance and I had to message their helpline number about the entry to the building. The keys are inside and you are dependent on them opening remotely. Once sorted, the place was perfect.  I’d also suggest to have more toilet papers, things to clean etc. the place is in great location,  clean and very cool.

Spacious rooms with easy check in and well furnished. We enjoyed the shared kitchen since it was well equipped to make meals. Quiet street except for the rumbling of passing buses. Still a very comfortable stay.

Lovely little spot for a short stay in Porto. Host was very communicative and helpful. Place was clean and tidy. In a great location being close to centre but just within residential zone so nice and quiet. Overall a good stay.

A nice cosy space in a great area - away from the tourist hot spots, but these are mostly within walking distance. If you need to travel further afield, the metro is 10-15 minutes away. Perfect for a solo traveler or a couple on a budget. All the basics are provided and communication with the management company was excellent. I couldn't figure out how to operate the TV, but that wasn't a deal breaker. It would have been handy to have had some guides or manuals for some of the appliances like the TV, heater and dehumidifier for example. Also, a lot of natural light gets into the building even when all the blinds have been shut. This could be easily fixed and these are just minor observations rather than complaints. The place was spotlessly clean and well maintained. Great value for money. I would happily stay there again.
Great stay in Porto. 15 min walk to the city center. Would stay there again. Host is super friendly and responsive. :)

Amazing place! Loved the big bedroom and very comfortable bed! Nice modern bathroom and kitchen. Shutters close off the windows allowing you to sleep in darkness! Wifi is also great for taking calls and watching tv.  Overall amazing place - will definitely stay again when I come back to Porto!
Just far enough from night life to enjoy a great rest but close enough walking distance to all of the fun.  Super host with great recommendations and above and beyond service.

The apartment is beautifully decorated and set in a very charming building. The balcony overlooking the garden offers a lovely view and a peaceful spot to relax. The neighbourhood is quiet and perfect for a restful stay and plenty of great restaurants nearby and easy access to central Porto. We especially appreciated the shutters, which could be closed at night to make the room completely dark—ideal for a good night's sleep. Overall, our experience was excellent. Joao was incredibly helpful and always quick to respond.
Joaquim's accomodation was excellently located and very affordable. he was proactive with my questions and we had a lovely time. thank you so much!

Joaquim’s  apartment is one of the best place we spent our vacation. The apartment is perfect location, extremely comfortable, beautiful design. You have whatever you need in his place. You feel unique atmosphere in the apartment. He is responsibly, friendly. You can find the place easily and close to attractive and famous place in Porto. I recommend at you spent your holiday in Joaquim’s apartment when you come to Porto.
We had a great stay at Joaquim's place. I would highly recommend it. Very clean accomodation, great location, and excellent communication with the host.
We had a perfect stay at Joaquims place. Would 100% recommend however be prepared that the street is quite noisy during the night so bring ear plugs or something ☺️

Joaquim was a very communicative host, and the apartment was very well located in Gaia. Everything in the apartment worked and it was very clean and well maintained. The only note would be that if you are three or four people you may run out of hot water as the shower did go cold a few times for us. There were also quite minimal provisions provided in terms of cleaning supplies such as dish soap, toilet roll, laundry liquid, dishwasher tablets, tea towel etc and so if staying more than a few days you will have to buy most of these things. Nevertheless, we really enjoyed our stay at Joaquim’s place in Vila Nova de Gaia and would highly recommend!

A great place, though noisy throughout the night as its on a busy road from down town. it would have been good to have a couple of absorbent cloths and some cleaning spray in the kitchen, but otherwise a great place.

Very nice apartment close to the beach and restaurants. Toilet and AC on all rooms is a big plus. The hosts answered really fast and was helpful! Only minus is that there was neighbours that where very sensitive to noise that complained about us only talking after 22, but this is not the hosts fault but still annoying. Would still recommend.

It felt like we were in a new home.  Very clean and spacious.  Unfortunately, the weather kept us from enjoying the nearby beach, but we were able to take a quick taxi to enjoy the many beautiful attractions along the Porto riverfront.  Great way to conveniently experience all the city has to offer while enjoying the benefits of staying in a quiet neighborhood.
Great place with very cozy apartment. We went to beach several times which only few minutes walk. Very quiet neighborhood and we love to come back again.

We really enjoyed our stay at Cláudio’s apartment - it is comfortable, spacious and very classy - and hosted by very helpful and responsive hosts! We had been looking at staying in Porto for a couple of days but are so pleased we stayed by the beach instead. The apartment is a lovely calm haven - walking distance to wonderful beaches with some great local restaurants. We day tripped into Porto via Uber to explore, but we’re so happy to get away from the busy summer crowds at the end of the day  and get back to beautiful sunsets over the Atlantic.  Travelling with our teenagers, we were delighted to have three bedrooms all with en-suites and comfortable, large living areas to relax after exploring the sites/beaches/nature reserve and marina. Thank you so much Cláudio - we’d love to stay again next time we’re in Porto!
Claudio's place was exactly as described! He was very communicative and helped make the stay very enjoyable. We would definitely recommend!

In the listing it says there is street parking, but there are only a few spaces available. Beware two of the spaces are unclearly marked as privately owned spots! Our car was towed from one of these spots and impounded, costing us 200 euros plus the hassle of a 1/2 day to recover. Many of the cars park on the sidewalk area but the police told us that was illegal also.

A spacious bright apartment. Close to the beach and a short Uber ride into Porto centre. Great local restaurants - Claudios recommendations are definitely worth looking at.  Claudio was really helpful - appreciated being able to leave our bags inside for an extra couple of hours on check out - thank you Would highly recommend

Claudio’s place was nice and clean.  Comfortable bed.  Very responsive to are need.  Really appreciated of all the food like snacks, water, milk, coffee and tea we had once we arrived.  That was very much appreciated.  Diane
The apartment was clean and tidy, and had everything we needed.  The hosts were friendly, helpful and very timely with all communication.

Jorge and Olga was very responsive. Apartment was clean and like pictures. If you walk to the Beach and turn right you head to Espinho. The beach is absolutely beautiful and there are lots of great restaurants, bars and things to do. Surfing is great. Thank you Jorge and Olga x

We had a great experience with the hosts who checked in to see if we needed anything and to offer recommendations. The unit was very comfortable, neat and tidy and had everything we needed! Thankyou for having us!
We had a great stay in Porto. It was a clean space with everything we needed for our trip. It was really close to everywhere and the host provided us with lots of recommendations. A great find
The apartment is in a great location. There is so much to see and do around the property. Easy check in and check out.

Perfect location right next to sao bento station and the shopping street, walking distance to most attractions.  Clean and spacious just as the photos.  Felt really safe in the apartment with gate and the security system. Check in and out was flexible host is also instructive. Only thing to note is just the building is so so close together to 3 another buildings (one to the right, 3 in the opposite) we can see people clearly from there and actually people on the street too. Had to close the windows for privacy.
We loved it! Perfect location and place for 2. Very clean, very comfortable beds,  including the large sofa bed.

This place is beautiful and exactly as pictured. It’s located right in the heart of the city with many exciting places to explore right nearby. It’s very clean and a perfect place to stay for a trip to porto. We really enjoyed our stay and would certainly stay there again in the future.
Really convenient location. Host is so responsive. Very easy check in and out. Apartment was perfect and so clean.
The only problem was noisy people outside, homeless drunk people have spot under the window but i think its not depend on you
It was a great stay at the residence. The residence was really cool, nice, peaceful and it met my expectation. Luis is really kind, supportive, proactive and highly responsive.

I went to visit Portugal and couldn't of asked for a better place. Ana's airbnb was beautiful and it made me feel right at home. Ana was very responsive and helpful when it came to things to do in the area.

Host (Neo) could not have been friendlier or more helpful.  Best Airbnb we had on our two-week, 4-city tour of Spain and Portugal.  Exactly as described. Everything is brand new.  Having washer/dryer in unit is a tremendous bonus when you are on an extended holiday.   Great location.  Porto is fantastic.

Amazing central location, easy walk to to the Luis I bridge. The parking was easy to access and a big help as we had been driving around Portugal in a rental car. They were so friendly to work with and provided great amenities.
Beautiful and spotless apartment within a walking distance to many attractions. Daniel was a great host providing a lot of information and very responsive.

We loved staying at the apartment! It was super clean/pleasant and very close to lots of cool stuff! As a wheelchair user, I especially appreciated the elevator access, however the ramp in the front was quite steep, so if you’re a wheelchair user, make sure to stay there with a buddy who can help push you up! Overall, awesome place, awesome location. Would definitely recommend staying there!

Spacious apartment in a very good location, includes parking inside the building as well which was amazing. Daniel was very proactive with making sure you have a smooth check in and comfortable stay. Just note the apartment does not have very good sound insulation, so it's a bit noisy at night/early in the morning.
Attractive appartment and very clean.  Location was excellent allowing easy access to restaurants and main attractions but yet peaceful. Would rent again.
Great location, very well equipped and renovated apartment. It is a commercial building that some local are converted in short term rentals. Daniel was great.
Very clean, comfortable and well equipped unit. Great location and host. Daniel took the time to check up with us. Would definitely stay here again.

What an amazing stay!  Close to everything and what a clean property :-)  Daniel was amazingly responsive and gave very clear directions and great recommendations…I recommend this location to anyone who would like to experience Porto and to live in the heart of the city 💕
nice apartment in the center of town. clean and well appointed. the garage is much appreciated if you are driving because parking downtown is difficult.

Daniel’s place was exactly as described and perfect for our time in Porto! It’s in a great location that’s walkable to everything. The apartment was easy to find and Daniel’s helpful instructions made getting in a breeze for both the apartment and garage. We’d recommend it to anyone visiting Porto!

The apartment was convenient to cafes and the tour bus drop offs, which is great if you're a first time visitor to Porto. The apartment is perfect, just as described. We really appreciated access to a washer/dryer.  Parking in Porto is not easy, and this space has a dedicated parking space in a secure garage.  The most impressive thing about this place is Daniel's meticulous directions. There are photos for everything-how to access the building, apartment, garage... everything.  100% would stay here again!

Very well-located apartment that is close to many good eateries and shopping. The famous Santa Catarina shopping street and the central market are within easy walking distance. The hop-on hop-off bus stop is right outside the apartment block. The host Daniel is very responsive, kind and communicative. Apartment is beautifully decorated. A separate queen bedroom with another comfortable double Murphy bed in the living room. Highly recommended.

Great place to stay, bonfirm is a quiet area but close to public transport and not far from the city centre. Francisco was super responsive a great host who even brought a fan to cool the place down because of the heat!

My family of 4 LOVED our stay in Porto at this wonderful apartment.  The location was absolutely perfect and walkable to all that we wanted to do in Porto.  It was lovely that there was coffee and wine left for us to enjoy and having the available amenities (shampoo/conditioner) in the bathroom was a very nice touch as well.  I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Porto!

Daniel’s place is in a great location, easy to walk to most attractions. The building is quiet at night, and is also conveniently close to a Pingo Doce (favorite grocery store). It was nice to retreat there at the end of a day of sightseeing. Thanks Daniel for a great stay!

The location of the accommodation was perfect, and everything was very clean. Daniel provided detailed check-in instructions and helpful information, which made our stay even more comfortable. The place was incredibly cozy, and we truly enjoyed our time here. Highly recommended!  we’d love to stay here again if we return to Porto!

I had a lovely stay at Francisco's place! It had everything I needed for my one night in Porto. And, Francisco & his co-host were super responsive and helpful. I would highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a nice, comfortable stay in Porto!!!

The apartment was great for one for a few days, it’s as described. It’s in a quiet area, but the walls are quite thin so you can hear people in the other apartments. Luckily my neighbours were not too loud. Francisco was helpful and prompt with messages.

Overall nice place. The owner is very responsive and helpful. I only have two comments. First, the apartment is not sound proof and you can hear the neighbors. Sometimes at night they made noise and I couldn't sleep very well. Second thing, there is a balcony but the view is the back ally and of other buildings. There is also lots of rubble and dirt left from construction I assume that you can see from the balcony.

Everything could of been fine, but finding bed bugs all over the place in the middle of the night after some of it jumped on us and bite was traumatic.  They seemed to have been there for while since the amount and the sizes were massive.  It needs to be checked more often.  Apart that, it’s a nice small apartment

I had a wonderful stay! The room was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made me feel very welcome. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!
We had a nice stay in this cute little accomodation :) It is possible to walk in the center or to the train station. Claudio was very nice and replied directly!

What an amazing place right on the Douro River. A nice walk to the Luis I bridge with it’s restaurants and things to do.  Loved that it had a garage where we could safely park our rental car.  The hosts are super responsive and we felt right at home.
Very nice place. With garage. Really convenient if you have a car. Beautiful apartment. Calm area, with really great view.

A lovely converted distillery, with a good description. Very clean and check in was easy. Only downside is there is little in the way of amenity / attraction nearby and be prepared to walk. That said the walk to the main attractions (45 mins) is along the river and well laid out and easy. The view of the river from the apartment is superb. I would definitely recommend this apartment

Wonderful location with views of the Douro River! The apartment is clean and well maintained. The heated bathroom floors were a nice amenity in the winter! The hosts are very helpful and respond quickly. Highly recommend this location for travelers with a car.
We had a great time in the appartement. It was private and the perfect location in the city center to get where you want.

Stylish apartment in the vibrant heart of Porto! This apartment is beautifully designed — I couldn’t resist taking photos of the furniture and décor to look them up later! It’s a chic, modern space that feels both spacious and thoughtfully laid out. The location is ideal for exploring Porto’s young and lively scene. One thing to keep in mind: it’s situated on a busy street, so it can get noisy. Bring earplugs if you’re a light sleeper. That said, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would definitely book it again!
This was the best Airbnb we stayed at in Europe for the price—very clean, cozy, and with a beautiful view.

The apartment is stunning, exactly as in the pictures! Beautiful views, very quiet and comfortable! Parking space was an added bonus as driving through Porto right now was chaotic. It is about 30-40min walk to get to the action/restaurants, etc so after 4 days of walking back and forth- we felt it!  The host was very responsive and helpful; would stay there again!
Beautiful place! Excellent view and amazing space. Bonus if bringing a car as there is onsite parking. Will definitely return!

I can definitely recommend the accommodation. Everything exactly matched the description and photos. The apartment was perfectly clean. The Vacationy team gave us all the information we needed in good time before arrival and the self check-in was quick and easy. We had a wonderful 5 days in Porto and we owe this great time also to this accommodation provider.

Great stay- the apartment was really nice and clean when we arrived. The area itself is kind of quiet but it’s not too far away from the city centre. You can hop on the train or get a cab and you can get to the beach or the river in no time!

The place was amazing. The apartment was very easy to find, it was clean and there were many restaurants nearby. They also gave us a wine as a gift which made our stay even more perfect.  Overall, definitely worth staying at! :)
Thanks lovely stay! It would have been nice if they communicated some lock related issues on beforehand, but all in all great stay!

Wow. This was our favorite stay in Portugal. Everything was perfect - the location is so charming, I felt like I was in a romantic movie just sitting on the terrace! Within distance to wonderful local seafood restaurants and the riverfront, a short drive to the ocean coast, a short drive to Porto. Absolute perfection!!!! Stay here!
We really enjoyed our time in Porto. Caterina was great! It was nice meeting her at checkout. We will definitely consider staying here again if we return to Porto.
Everything was good, easy to check in, the host let us check in earlier which was appreciated . Easy check out.

Very spacious place to stay, super convenient with all utensils for kitchen, kids and even beach. Closeby supermarket, beach and also some restaurants. We enjoyed our stay with two families and two kids and a toddler.
Really nice to have a large property with 6 double beds. Close to bars and restaurants and places of interest. The host was so helpful

The Apartment stands apart from many other places. The recreation of a wonderful 40’s stylish place has  been painstakingly carried out. All the bathrooms felt period while having all the modern amenities and the quality of furniture, Linen etc was 1st class. We were all genuinely amazed by what our hosts had done and will definitely be coming back with other members of our family.
This was the best airbnb I’ve ever stayed in. Beautiful, clean, well located. The host was very helpful and kind, would definitely go back!
Really enjoyed our stay , wonderful property, great location , would definitely stay again ! Kevin Wise  Aaren Powell

Tons of room in the flat in the middle of Porto. The city market is literally across the street and you are one block from the metro station. Porto is an amazing city as well and it's all at your doorstep.

Great place, very central.  luis accommodated our family and kids really well and was flexible on a number of items that helped us out a whole lot, esp on check in and check out.  I highly recommend the staying here! Thx

Perfect location in Porto. Great for a family or group of friends. Fantastic if you have a car as there is a parking garage and Luis was very helpful to be sure we got access and in person instructions. Nice to feel at home after a long day with the option to climb stairs or take the elevator.
Very nice place in the heart of Upper Porto. Quick walk to many sights, metro station, market and many restaurants. Luis was responsive and we enjoyed our stay.

Large and spacious, well equipped art deco apartment in the heart of Porto. Diagonally opposite the Balhao Market and Metro. Just a block away from the main shopping street, 10 minute walk to the “restaurant district” and a 15 minute walk to the Douro River. Everything as per the listing  and just as expected. Highly recommended, especially for large families.

Luis’s place was gorgeous, comfortable and in a great location. It was walking distance to everything we wanted to see in Porto, but away from the highly populated tourist areas. We enjoyed the quiet environment and the many restaurants and shops just steps from the building. Luis was very responsive and accommodating during check in and we would definitely rent from him again if we return to Porto.

Great location with areas of interest in close proximity. Host was very responsive and offered immediate assistance when we reached out to them about drainage issues in one of the bathrooms. Overall, enjoyed our stay!
Overall it was a great stay. We were 8people total and this place accommodated perfectly.
Best airbnb ever. it was WOW. Delicious decour, HUGE apartment, banging location, we all LOVED it.  Thank you, Orla x
The place was great, easy to get in and out, has an elevator, AC works well. Overall good experience

We had a very nice staying there. Everything worked and the place is really clean and like in pictures. Location at the beach also amazing. The host replied fast and she was really flexible with the check in and out times. Thank you so much!
It is a wonderful indoor and outdoor space.  Walkable distance to the beach, restaurant and transportation.  I highly recommend it.
Absolutely enjoyed our stay at João and Rita’s place! Perfect location for a beach and city getaway! Would definitely come back.

This place was very good. It provided anything you could need, in a good neighborhood, walkable from the center of the city. There was a problem with the windows, theere was a lot of noise coming from the street and cold. Also the bathroom door didn't close very wall, so there was a privacy issue there.

The check-in and checkout were very easy! The space is super clean and feels like a hotel. We also enjoyed the lockers at the entrance of the building to store our luggages until our flight in the evening.  We just think that it would need a little bit more kitchen equipment if travelers want to cook (cooking pot, cutting board, drying rack, kitchen cloth).
Perfect location for our first time in Porto! Close walk to everything we wanted. Carlos was helpful and the house was welcoming! The two bathrooms and comfortable beds were appreciated!
Thank you for a nice stay.  Sadly we had in Porto one night stay only , but we will be back….
Very nice host as it was possible to have flexible check in and out. Home located in a quiet area next to parks and city center easily acessible.

Nuno and his wife are SO friendly! It's a great location, next to the beautiful Parque Serralves. It's  walkable with easy access to restaurants and bus stops. I felt quite at home during my whole stay!
Lovely accommodation, ideal if you have a car with you and want to park it safely. Nuno is very nice and helpful!

Nuno’s place was in a lovely residential part of Porto. It was about a 20 minute walk from a beautiful beach and a convenient bus ride away from the center of the city. Nuno was an attentive host and always easy to contact. Would highly recommend the studio!

This location was great for our stay in Porto! Is was a bit out of the tourist area which we loved (only a 20 minute walk to the city center). Great restaurants options around. The Wi-Fi is not that strong, so I would not recommend working from here.

The place is small, good for 3 persons. Not much in the area but not too far from Porto center. We used Bolt to get to/back from city and beaches.  The plac is under development, in few months time will be even better.  Thanks Joa and Recardo.  Nabard

What a nice place metro is 1 min walking so in 7 min you are downtown Porto . The place is super clean in a neighborhood with plenty of restaurants. Maria answers quickly to your questions. Porto is a marvel .

Maria's place is realy superb and a rare finding. First of all, it is spotless clean. It is very comfortably located, just next to the metro on the corner. The house is fully equipped, and the most important there is a free parking. Absolutely worth it. Muito obrigado Maria :)

What a beautiful apartment close to everything in old town Porto! We parked our car in the parking garage and never moved it until we were ready to leave again! The apartment was large and super clean. We would definitely stay here again when we come back to Porto.

This apartment is very clean, fully funished with anything a guest might want, tastefully decorated, and quiet. Very conveniently located to the Metro and only a few stops to the historic quarter. Maria Angela could not have communicated better. All information, with helpful images was provided at the right time. She provided a parking pass for underground parking nearby, which was very very helpful.
Liked this apartment very much - it's spacious, there is everything you need, it's quiet, despite being located near road. Great communication with the host as well.  Easy 5 stars, would recommend.

Beautiful apartment Maria was helpful when I wanted to know about the area. If  two people are travelling together and want separate bed's the settee does not pull out into a bed. That's the only problem we had everything else was excellent
Maria is excellent host. fast response.  location is excellent.  peaceful and close to metro station and a lot bakeries and restaurants nearby. also supermarket is closely.

I had a great stay at Maira Angela's Apartment. The place was private, clean and well maintained. The host was friendly very responsive and helpful. Hassle-free check-in & check-out. What makes the place special is its location. With Metro & Bus stops just meters away from the apartment it makes the place perfect to explore the city. The place is surrounded by cafes, Restaurants, bakerys, laundromats and shops etc.  overall it was a great experience & a great place to stay in Porto!

We had a great stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb. The only thing that bothered us was the limited kitchen equipment. For example, there was only one cutting knife (which was a bit dull), and we couldn’t find a cutting board.  Nevertheless, we had a good night in the Airbnb and really enjoyed our time in Porto.

"Maria Angela was such a wonderful host! She always responded quickly to our questions and made us feel very welcome. The place itself is super accessible, spotless, and very safe. We truly enjoyed our stay and would happily come back!"

Apartment was in great location! Walkable distance to all main attractions and old town. Lot of restaurants near by. Apartment was quiet and windows facing to town with nice sunset view. I would stay here again for next stay.

we stayed here 8 nights and loved the location in the heart of Portos city. The air conditioner was really helpful and the apartment beautiful. The kitchen had what is necessary, but nothing more. Totally sufficient though. If you are looking for a quiet apartment that is in the heart of the city, this is for you!
Pros: location, true to picture, clean, air-con, bright room with good view. Cons: house is shaking every days, sound block is really bad, room door seems not very safe.
All ok, only the neighbors had a loud party next to us and the apartment is quite noisy.
great place and walking distance to a lot of resteraunts. only complaint is, you can hear everything inside and outside. walls are very thin and neighbors are very loud.

The area is the real selling point here. Half a block from a metro stop and a twenty minute walk to the center of Porto. The apartment was small, but functional. It was quite cold the first night, but the host offered to bring a second space heater, which helped tremendously. My only feedback was it would have been nice to have a drying rack or extra towels for the dishes. Otherwise, would recommend!

Great studio apartment in very central location in Porto. Right off the metro stop and within walking distance of lots of shops, parks, bars and restaurants. Would've definitely stayed longer if the place wasn't already booked! And Marta was a very responsive host.
Great deal for a simple place. The location was quiet but central, communicating with the host was easy, and there was helpful information about Porto included in the check in messages.

One of the best airbnb experiences - we cannot recommend this place enough!! We stayed at this property with a baby and a 3 year old and it was perfect for our family. The farm and all the activities felt like paradise for a toddler and Carla and Antonio went above and beyond to make sure we had everything from making sure we had baby gear, to giving local recommendations, and more!  The nature was beautiful and the accommodations were clean, modern, and comfortable. It was easy to go into Porto and drive to the Douro Valley. We would love to come back again one day!

Our family had a wonderful stay at Carla’s place.  We loved the surroundings of nature and the rural setting so close to Porto.   We were able to take the train into Porto to enjoy an afternoon.  We walked across the road to take in a hike and enjoy a scenic waterfall.  Carla was very easy to communicate with and we were fortunate to meet her and her husband.  The house was lovely and we felt right at home.  It’s on our list of places to return to!!!!

We were on the Camino and have asked for the room just 15 min before check in.  Communication was very easy, friendly and immediately possible.  We were allowed to take everything we needed from the kitchen and the was a very hot shower. The room was perfect and looked like the photos, very nice.  We recommend this very much!

A great host, a very authentic old Portuguese house, awesome location. Unfortunately, it was freezing inside, basically the same temperature that was outside. I had to work with my head under blankets. Better book only in warm months.
The owner was very helpful, reacted very fast, and the accomodation has a really good price-value ratio, the balcony is amazing.
Super nice room and host.  The apartment was a historic gem from another time. Very special and lovely.

Excellent host(s)! Very kind and extremely accommodating (I changed my check in several times, thanks again!). The apartment is comfortable, cosy in a convenient yet quiet neighborhood. On that note, Gonçalo recomrecommended a local authentic Portuguese restaurant, "Aliença", it was perfect!

Great experience both checking in and our stay with Goncalo. only regret is not staying longer. wonderful location. well situated to many great restaurants and the beach but also quiet and serene enough to get a good night's rest. This host clearly knows what he's doing. I have nothing to offer in terms of criticism.

We really liked our stay ! Cute garden and very friendly host . I would recommend this place to anyone who is visiting Portugal but wants to have more of an authentic not so touristy experience . They are many great cofee places and shops near by.

Gonçalo's place is a cozy one indeed. You come in and you can smell the history of the house, written on the wood. We received plenty of local recommendations for food, shopping and drinks. Highly recommended!
Sergio went above and beyond for accommodating my family and I. He was super responsive and helpful. I would recommend this beautiful, spacious house.

An absolute gem of a place and location. Although we were visiting family/friends in the area the Sergios house made us never want to leave. The addition of the pool was also a great touch. We hope to be able to stay here again very soon.
Cozy and clean flat, plus you get one time free complimentary cleaning service, which was really nice. The place felt also safe and communication was great.
We had an amazing experience staying in these apartments. Renovated building, new elevator, fresh and minimalist decor, spacious apartments and great location. Highly recommend!
The apartment is neat and clean and has a lovely terrace. We could walk everywhere since it is so central.  The check in was also very flexible.  All very smooth, we would stay there again.
Pedro communicated with us explaining the locality.  The flat was fabulous and very modern. It added to our great stay in Pontevedra.
Great stay, LOVELY terrace! Close to most things, nice street with restaurants and bar in walking distance!
Claudia was very quick to respond and accommodating! The listing was also very beautiful and well worth the money.
Apartment was absolutely gorgeous!! The decor and furnishings were beautiful.  Easy to find.  30 minute walk to the main part.

We really enjoyed our stay at Claudia's bright and charming apartment. Happy hour on the patio was especially nice. The original art work throughout the apartment is interesting and colourful, particularly in the master bedroom. As avid cooks, our only disappointment was that the kitchen was not very well equipped. Claudia responded quickly when we expressed concern and provided some additional utensils, but still this is not an ideal place for foodies.

Beautiful apartment that I’d happily recommend to anyone visiting Porto, easy to access the historical district with the metro. Only small issue was the communication- all comms were through the company website which was a bit of a hassle, but definitely manageable.

Such an amazing stay and beautiful flat!! The decor is stunning and Claudia was extremely helpful at every turn. Very walkable and a great stay for anyone looking to be slightly outside of the downtown area while still staying VERY close to all the action. Couldn’t have asked for a better experience!
Absolutely BEAUTIFUL home! Could not fault this Airbnb at all. Has everything we needed and more. Highly recommended.

Fantastic location very near many of Porto’s attractions, restaurants and shopping. The apartment is actually more spacious than the photos appear. Spotlessly clean. Nice linens and comfortable beds. The street is a busy one, but quieted down after midnight. Lovely place, would stay again for sure.
Very good apartment and location, the host was super helpful. Important to know that the adjacent street might be a bit noisy. Would recommend
Lovely spacious apartment in a very central location. The place was very clean. Everything was very easy. Car park is pretty tight but we managed with an Audi A3.

This place is very nice, very large, and very well located.  As advertised, parking would work for a smaller car but our rental was too large -- there is a paid lot across the street that worked for us.  Really can't recommend this place highly enough!

If I could give this place and this host more than 5 stars I would. The apartment was not only beautiful, but in a great location which was very walkable and easy to get to via taxi/uber. The host even took time to welcome us and provide a map of the city and his favorite locations which were perfect for our stay. We absolutely loved it!

I cannot imagine a better introduction to Porto. This studio was very easy to get to and only a short walk from the train station. The studio was quiet, comfortable and clean. Not only that, but it is centrally located which made it very easy to walk around the town and never be far from this "home away from home". We chose to do check in with one of the cohosts and I am so glad we did. Daniel was an absolute rock star and I cannot say enough good things about him. He gave us a breakdown of the city and put together an itinerary for our day right on the spot. It was amazing! Porto is an amazing place and when we come back, this studio is where we want to be.

This was one of the best AirBnB experiences I’ve had. It is beautiful — nice touches and style. Feels sexy! Love the blue. Notably — at check the host spent time to cover local sights and restaurants. LOTS of recommendations! Helped me get oriented, which was key as a first time visitor to Porto.  Most of all, I had transportation problems (which you never want to- stressful!). The host was very kind and went beyond expectations to help me sort that out. Not expected, but so appreciated. Cannot recommend enough. Thank you! 💖

Fernando’s place is in a great location. We were able to walk most places. We only got an Uber or Bolt if we were going somewhere that had a lot of hills on the way. Fernando was helpful and proactive during communication. I would highly recommend staying at this place when in Porto.

Fantastic Villa, very spacious (we were a group of 6) and modern, with very good outside space and pool. Good location, close to restaurants and beach and transport links to other places. Host was excellent, friendly, helpful and accommodating. We would recommend and stay here again.

It was a wonderful stay at Michael’s appartement, where he gave me lots of clear instructions on how to get in the apartment, but also where to get dinner the night of my arrival. His response time for me was under 10 minutes, which was amazing to have a spontaneous conversation. Would highly recommend it.

Michael is a communicative and helpful host.  The rooms are small but well-fitted and the location in Cedofeita is a really good base. On two very hot nights I had difficulty in controlling the temperature - too cold with direct fan, too hot otherwise.

The house is very newly refurbished, very clean, every room has has double bed and an en-suite bathroom. There is a common living area with a big sofa, and TV with streaming services (Netflix). The neighborhood is very quite, 20 minutes walk to the city center.  I definitely recommend if you are a big group.

Every member of our group of 9 and a toddler really liked this apartment, especially that each bedroom had a bathroom. The apartment had a sort of industrial feel in its decor. It was very clean with a nice size common area where we could hang out together. It was well located, not far from a subway and about 20 minutes walking distance to historic sites. It also comes with off-street parking. The property is handled by a management company. While communication was not particularly personal, it was overall very good and responsive. Our group would definitely stay here again.

Great apartment for 6 colleague who where in Porto for a conference. We each had our own room with bathroom and a lot of space. We liked our neighbourhood which was residential but had a few great bars and a supermarket within walking distance. Communication was quick and easy. We would definitely recommend!
The apartment is great, exactly like the pictures. Got everything I needed. Great location also. The host was super, 5-star
Great place to stay! Very clean and easy to get to. Everything in the place as advertised. Close to many attractions and restaurants. All around a great place!

The place is pretty, spacious and well-located. We had some hiccups with airport pickup and some slow responses while others were quite timely. Unfortunately the slow ones were when we needed help more imminently for the airport pickup issue. One team member from GuestReady was always fast and helpful, but her colleagues were more delayed in responding. Overall, recommend the apartment highly as it has great space, and beautiful view, an elevator and convenient location. Also had amenities we didn’t know about so a pleasant surprise. Wanted for nothing.
Great apartment at a great price. Right in the centre yet still on a quiet street. Very easy self check in and spacious apartment.
Great value for Money. Super friendly Host that rund the Show Shop downstairs. Lovely Sunny courtyard with a big cat Family.
Gonçalo was very friendly and the neighbourhood is nice and quiet. Very close to the beach and te metro and nice restaurants nearby,
Uncomplicated Check in and room like on the photos. Smelled weird sometimes but all in all good

This is a very nice place to stay, close to the harbour, lots of nice fish restaurants, the huge surfer’s beach and easy to go to the old city center of Porto, and also easy by bus from the airport. Price/quality is 200%.  Thank you Gonçalo
Had a really great time here. The accommodation has all the amenities one might need, and the weekly cleaning service was a pleasant surprise. I'd love to stay here again someday!

Very good area to stay in Porto. Very central to everything but still very quiet inside the apartment. Couldn’t hear any traffic noise. It was very clean and tidy and comfortable to stay in. Would recommend and will stay here again

Staying at this apartment was just fantastic! The location in the heart of downtown was perfect, making it convenient to explore the city's attractions. The added bonus of free parking was a huge plus, especially in such a bustling area. And not to forget the charming terrace. Highly recommend!
Very responsive and great location in the city. Having the parking was a huge bonus. Would recommend.
We had a good stay Ricardo's place. It was convenient to everything we wanted to do.  The communication was excellent and timely.
really beautiful apartment. I enjoyed staying there and it is very comfortable. Only thing would be to include an iron!
The bathroom gets a little bit of water on the floor regardless of how careful you are in the shower. Other than that, a very good place to stay.
all can say is that this apartment exceeded all expectations. Absolutely wonderful and would highly recommend. Location is perfect with everything a stones throw away. hosts were fantastic

My husband and I loved the place. For me, it's my fourth stay in Porto and I would say, the favorite one. The location is perfect - just five minutes walk to the São Bento train and metro stations,  less than 10 min walk to the Luis I bridge, very good restaurants and cafes all around.  The apartment itself is very clean, modern, but homely, tastefully decorated. Very charming place in a central, but quiet location  - you can sleep through the night without being disturbed by the happy tourists. What else that was different from my previous experiences - you and your family members can take nice hot showers without timing yourselves to two minutes each if you don't want to run our of hot water. Thank you Ana for the great experience.
Lovely apartment in the perfect location! Walking distance to all the main attractions but on a short, quiet side road. Would certainly recommend staying here.
We loved our stay at Ilan’s place. It was in the perfect location, it matched the photos, was very clean and the furnishings were beautiful! We would definitely recommend!

Thank you Ilan, Ana and Joao, Your lovely home was the perfect respite after walking the Camino. We love the location to places of interest, shopping, dining and of course, an easy walk to the river. We will definitely recommend your home to others that are planning a trip to Port! Cheers, Mary Petrie
Everything was amazing the airbnb was a perfect location! Very easy to walk around. The apartment was very clean and felt super nice. Would definitely recommend this airbnb!! Thank you!

Amazing location. Very walkable from Ribiera, Dom Luis bridge and close to the Sao Bento station. The unit was comfortable and very nicely furnished. Prior to our arrival, there was a problem with the AC. Joao let us know before check-in and provided portable heaters instead which did a decent job of keeping the place warm. It was a nice & comfortable stay !!!

Quiet location but still very close to many good restaurants on a main street and a pedestrian street. Very close to bus stops too.  Don’t miss Time Out Market on São Bento train station and the World of Discoveries museum (for families) and World of Wine (for grown-ups)

We thoroughly enjoyed stay in Porto at Ilan's place. The flat's location is ideal for a short city trip, with the waterfront and city center within walking distance. Everything was spotless clean and tastefully decorated.

The apartment is very new and very modern. It was nice to stay there! The only negative thing would be that the pull out bed wasn’t very comfortable. Everything else was great and Ilan was very easy to communicate with, especially for instructions on how to get to the apartment.
The apartment was beautiful and in an amazing location in the city! The host was very friendly and easy to communicate with. I would be happy to stay again!

Ilans place is a real gem. Its beautifully designed, tucked into a quiet street in the heart of Porto. The communication was clear and fast. I really loved this air bnb and when I come back to Porto will absolutely stay here again, I can't imagine getting better value for money.

The place is really great, 100% matched the photos. Check in and check out were easy thanks to clear instructions of the host. The apartment has everything you need for short and medium term stay, tastefully furnished, has a big balcony and all the amenities listed. The host was friendly giving immediate response whenever needed. We will definitely come back! Thank you for arranging an unforgettable stay!

* Nice location on a quiet residential area with Mercadona and some coffee houses 10 min walking * Nice placed on the building communitary garage * Interesting flat door that locks up automatically * Nice areas with all the appliances e.g. equipped kitchen glued with living room with big smart TV * Comfy room also with a big smart TV * Fast Wifi (used on a laptop for a 2h video meeting) * Big bathroom with heated towel holder, good water pressure and temperature * 10/15 min walking to the nearest subway station (so we let the car at the garage and used public transportation to get around)

One of the best places we´ve stayed so far! The location is top, few minutes on foot from Carolina Michaelis metro station and not so far from the city center. The apartment is brand new and the kitchen is fully equipped for those who want to make some meals at home. Excellent for 3 persons, big and confortable 2 beds and 1 sofa-bed. Everything was clean and organised. The apartment is warm and modern. Try the healthy meals in the LM cafe, in the downstairs, amazing dishes! Luis and Maria are top hosts, they are always there for you and guide you in the places to visit!  You will feel home, we absolutely recommend!

The apartment was in a very good location--near the train station and on the perimeter of the Old City.  The interior is very new, with nice bathrooms, showers, and kitchen.  The common space is very tight, with just enough room for 4 of us to sit comfortably.  All in all, a very good base from which to explore Porto.
