We really enjoyed our stay with Porto City Hosts. Friendly and very responsive to our questions. The apartment has everything you need and in a very central walkable location. We are so grateful to Joao for his EXECELLENT local food recommendations. Easily the best places we’ve eaten on the entire trip. We hope to stay here again in the future!! Obrigado!!

Very accurately listed, we loved how central the apartment was as it made all the main attractions in Porto so walkable. Great sound proofing from street noise so we all slept well with fantastic fans to keep at a perfect temperature. Happy overall.

The accommodation was exactly as described and a great location.  There was a fire on our street and the road was closed off one evening. Even during the late hour, they were actively checking for updates and in contact with us to assure us that they are available for support. thank you very much
Beautiful, very clean minimalist apartment with all the required amenities , great location, responsive and friendly host. I would stay here again when next I visit Porto.

We loved our stay in Porto.  Luis was very attentive and friendly upon check in, even when our flight was later then expected. Luis also gave a great list of recommendations and a map of local sites which was fantastic as we went to a few restaurants recommended which were all very nice. The location is good and private - about 25 minutes walk from centre and there is even a nice bakery below the apartment and a cute independent pottery shop nearby.  The apartment was very clean and decorated nicely - in fact, the apartment is a lot bigger than it appears from photos and has a separate landing for kitchen/living areas and bedrooms which was great for a group of 4. We really enjoyed our stay - thank you for your hospitality Luis ☺️
Really nice person that want you to feel like you are at home. He will also provide everything you need to go around porto if it is your first time in the city
Jorge was an great host and the place was very clean and looked as expected. I would definitely recommend for the price and location.
we had a problem getting into the apartment because the lockbox was stuck. the place was nice and like the pictures except some plates in the kitchen were dirty.

Catarina's place near Espinho is a vacation dream come true! Waking up to an ocean view from the window was amazing. The room was cozy, and the spacious balcony was a highlight. The shared spaces were always clean and well-equipped. The real gem was the sea-view balcony - perfect for relaxation and her friendly cats. Highly recommended!
great place to stay,. friendly and attentive hosts. easy access, quiet for those who like to walk and great views of the beach.

Beautiful apartment and very accommodating host! Views are fantastic, location is ideal and peaceful.. Catarina was as helpful as can be! We were very grateful to have stayed over in Espinho :) Would highly recommend!
10/10 from the host helpfulness to the beautiful and cosy atmosphere in the apartment. I wish I could have stayed there longer 😊

The Apartment was absolutely fantastic! You can walk to the beach in just 10 minutes, and it’s a long way along. Since Uber is so reliable in Portugal, the distance to Porto (which is about 15-20 km away) was no issue. I love to go to the beach in the evenings, so it was the perfect place for me. Catarina was an incredible host. I had an amazing time staying here and I’d love to go back again this summer.

We had an amazing time at catarinas. The home is very close to the beach and also has a balcony with sea view. The train stations espinho or granja are about 1,5 km away. Espinho Center is a 20-25 minute walk. Catarina was very nice and her cats absolutely adorable. Thanks so much for having us 😊!

Was a great location! Pretty clean apart from some stains on the bed sheets.. the kitchen was very clean and all utensils were pretty much brand new.  The only thing was that the balcony was full of bird poop. Other than that the airbnb was amazing

Although there was a small incident when we arrived, the owners were incredibly kind and handled it perfectly. The apartment was very clean, very comfortable, and truly perfect for our stay. We had a great time and would definitely come back!
Very well located. Space itself is comfortable. Florinda (host) is very kind and responsive. Although we've had some problem with hot water due to the storm it has been fixed very fast
Amazing location, walkable to many Porto attractions. The apartment was beautiful and comfortable. Sound proofing was also excellent.
This place was great! Very clean and just as described - awesome location and beautiful view from the patio!
Tom’s place was fantastic! A jewel in the heart of Porto, with a good amount of space and a fabulous balcony. The check-in/check-out process couldn’t have been easier and Tom was very responsive.
A fantastic stay here. Great location, plenty of room for 4 people, stylish apartment which was well equipped, brilliant value for money thank you ☺️

Perfect spot for exploring Porto! Comfortable beds. We had trouble figuring out how the washing machine worked….instructions would have helped. The apartment is nicely decorated! The four of us had a great stay!!!
Ideal location to get to all the main sites in Porto.  Also, a large selection of restaurants was very close by.

We loved staying at this apartment! Perfect location to all the attractions and good restaurants. The apartment itself was clean, well stocked, and had the most comfortable beds. Would recommend and return in the future. Thanks Tom!
It was an excellent stay! Very comfortable, perfect location and great amenities! I strongly recommend
lovely place, just as described which was in a great location as everything we did was walkable
An excellent apartment in a very convenient location. The manual for operating things in the flat was very useful. Providing some coffee and tea bags etc was a very nice touch.

This Airbnb in Matosinhos exceeded my expectations. It's surprisingly spacious - bigger than it appears in the photos. While it's a shame there's no washing machine, there's a good laundry service nearby. The apartment is tranquil and comfortable, making it a pleasant stay. Its location is excellent, close to the beach, restaurants, cafes, and supermarkets. I'd happily stay here again or recommend it to others looking for a great spot in Matosinhos.

This is the second time we’ve stayed in this apartment and once again we found it really comfortable and convenient. It’s ideal for longer stays and though it lacks a washing machine there are lots of laundrettes nearby. Cleaning is available, usually on a weekly basis, and the bed linen and towels are changed over. There is no air conditioning in the apartment but to be fair it was never a problem because the rooms don’t get much direct sunlight so the temperature didn’t vary much.

Great place to stay if you like being close to the beach! City center is approximately 30 minutes by bus, with a bus stop nearby (5min walking). There are lots of small coffee places and grocery stores nearby, and the beach is very close as well! Would definitely recommend.

I’ve travel a lot in Europe and it’s definitely the best Airbnb I’ve ever experienced. The host was so nice and heartwarming. Even gave us the fruits that she planted when we arrived. The appartement is huge, bright, private, clean, comfortable, heartwarming. With a very cute balcony and garden for getting some sun during breakfast. The host even let us put our luggages after we check out, because we left Porto at midnight. If I ever be back to proto, I’ll definitely want to be reserve this Airbnb again ! Absolutely worth more than what we paid for it ❤️‍🔥Highly recommend for everyone 🩵🩵
Lucia and Daniel’s place is beautiful in a lovely quiet neighbourhood of Porto. Just what I was looking for. Thank you!
Very confortable staying. Lucia was extremely kind in any moment! I had a wonderfull time in oporto

This place exceeds expectations for how well the property is maintained!!  Lucia does a great job of maintaining the house. It is extremely tidy and well suited for a couple of days' stay. The apartment comes with all amenities needed and the hosts are flexible and very accomodative.  As a solo traveler, I found the apartment to be in a quiet yet safe neighbourhood. All major tourist sites are walkable or accessible through buses and trains. I had no trouble navigating from the airbnb to anywhere within Porto. I would definitely visit this beautiful home again next time I visit Porto!

The accomodation is near the city centre and direct metro line to the airport. Comfortable bed with very sparkling white bed linens. Both the room and ensuite bathroom were very clean. I didn't use the kitchen, but it was available. I did arrive late at night, but self check-in was very easy. It takes 5 mins to get to the city centre using Uber which is not expensive in Porto. Next to the house there is a little cafe to get morning coffee. Overall I do recommend.

Lovely stay!  Gorgeous flat, in a gorgeous tiled building, across the street from a gorgeous park. Felt brand new with everything you need: comfy beds, work desks, full kitchen, linens, etc. It has great natural light -  better than the photos. Plus, walking up from the waterfront on this street there are the coolest bars, eateries, & pop-up shops. I dig it. we’ll be back!  ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Thank u Teresa!

Warm welcome and very responsive host (before and during the stay)! Newly refurbished flat and furniture, comfortable and clean. Comfortable, firm mattresses in bedroom with blackout shutters for a restful sleep. Easy access to Porto's attractions and amenities while still enjoying quiet surroundings. Would definitely try to stay there again when we next visit Porto!

We loved our stay in Porto! Teresa was so sweet and a wonderful host.  She had everything we needed and more.  She gave us a nice warm welcome with a charcuterie board and yummy chocolate cake. She was very responsive and available for questions.  The place was amazing, clean and very comfortable.  The location was perfect for the city.  Everything was walking distance and great restaurants everywhere, plus a nice little market across the park. It felt very safe and was quiet at night. The boys loved the park right across from our place to play fútbol. We will definitely come back here.

The stay at Teresa's place was perfect in every way. The host met us on arrival and walked us through everything about the apartment and surrounding neighborhood. The apartment is a quick walk to the city center but not too close to the tourist mobs. All the shops are close by and a little jazz collective is just up the block. We hope to stay again someday soon.
Great flat quick walk from main sites In Porto Teresa was an excellent host w great communication and provided some great snacks and chocolate cake upon check in.

Teresa is a lovely host. She made me a birthday cake and it was it there when we arrived. It is well located to restaurants and stores. Easy to walk around.  The linens and beds were all very comfortable. She made fabulous restaurant recommendations and made my birthday celebration special. She communicates proactively and is very responsive.

Teresa is a fantastic host - friendly . responsive, and helpful. The apartment matches photos and description. Only setbacks were building was full of mosquitos on arrival, which Teresa dealt with quickly after complaint. Also, sofa in sitting room and bedcovers are full of dust and need cleaning.
We had a nice cozy stay there.  We had no problem staying there except for the weather.^^ Thanks for everything.

The warmest, most attentive host - talking to her felt like talking to a friend. The flat has everything that a small family might need, also the location was very good. Although it’s on a quite busy street, the traffic doesn’t disturb that much and there is plenty of privacy. For some reason this place made us feel truly cared for.

Absolutely beautiful apartment, and Teresa is a wonderful host! The apartment was clean and comfortable, and just as stunning as it looks in the pictures, and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Easy walk to downtown, and lots of great bars and restaurants within walking distance.
We had a great stay at Hosty’s place. Very clean and tidy apartment with everything provided. Would definitely recommend!

This place is amazing! I liked everything and it looks just like in the pictures. There is absolutely everything you can need - washing machine,  hair dryer,  oven, pots...I even can't name everything.   The location is perfect- right in the center of beautiful Porto and near to everything  - shops, food, sightseeing points, the bridge. The apartment is very quiet despite its central location.  The beds were very comfortable and we slept very well! Thank You for the great experience! I recommend this apartment!

An absolute stand out.  Teresa was a phenomenal host - from helping us easily locate her space to local recommendations to the delightful surprise of a cake and a cheeseboard upon our arrival.  (The latter of which especially thrilled our daughters!). The unit itself is well appointed and comfortable. You can tell Teresa considers all of her guests needs.  The beds were cozy and the showers great too. This was our first time in Porto and could not have been happier with our stay. If you happen to stumble upon this Airbnb - don’t hesitate to book it!  We certainly will on our next trip to Porto. ❤️

Teresa was a great host. Right when I booked, she messaged me and asked me for anything we needed. Anytime I had a question regarding the stay, she was responsive within the same day. It helped me to be able to pack accurately and the recommendations on the booklet she provided were helpful as well!
great stay, easy to find. the place looked just like the pictures. The check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow. great area, restaurants and cafes within walking distance. great stay!
The place was perfect. Very private, very safe. Nice big clean and comfy bed. No complaints

We enjoyed our stay for a week at Romain’s place. The apartment is spacious and has everything you need to cook your own meals. The interior is nice and updated and there is a laundry machine if need it. The location is beautiful and we recommend the cafe next door called Potts!  The apartment was overall clean - there were some stains on the couch that definitely take away from the clean feeling. We also had some difficulty getting into the apartment building at times using the code provided. Sometimes it would work, sometimes it would not. The host was responsive whenever we needed something.

Romain is a great host, the communication was clear and on time. The place was very beautiful, cozy and super clean, the location was very central with many restaurants around. We felt really comfortable during our stay :) I would definitely go back!

Had a good stay at Romain’s place!  The location is perfect. Very walkable to all spots in Porto - It’s about 5 minutes walk to Santa Catarina shopping street and 5 minutes to the bridge that overlooks the iconic Luis Bridge. Even though it is around the hubbub, you will get quiet sleeps. The place is big and bed is comfy. Keep in mind that there is no AC, just a fan. You can do laundry and dry it by the window. Overall, I would recommend this place for a solo traveler or couple!

What a great stay we had here. Super easy for our taxi to find and very clear check in instructions. The apartment was finished beautifully and the host even left some port samples and some biscuits for us to enjoy on arrival. The location is extremely central, with many landmarks, shops, bars and restaurants within 5 minutes walking distance. The apartment has a fantastic view of the city and we couldn't recommend more.  Great shower, very comfy bed and all finished very nicely
Great place to stay, overlooking the city form you bedroom. Great place, well designed - everything you need for a citytrip
Beautiful apartment, very confy and quite while being very central. Perfect location for a stay in Porto !

We had wonderful stay at Casa Maya. The accommodation was everything we hoped for and more—beautifully maintained, comfortable, and in such a perfect location. Zac's warm hospitality made us feel right at home and we truly appreciate all the thoughtful touches (recommendations, help, etc.) that made our stay even more special. Casa Maya was the ideal retreat for us. Everything about it was so enjoyable. We hope to return someday and will can definitely recommend Casa Maya to everyone!🙂

Wonderful accomodation with very welcoming hosts. My Rooms was exactly like in the pictures and there were water and some little Snacks provided. It's also very near to the next Metro Station, so all in all it was just perfect, I would also recommend it for solo travelers :)

It was a great place to stay, convenient location. The room was very clean, nice scent and the most comfortable bed ever. I slept very well.  Thank you for the host and everything. The host even helped me to get my suitcase to the top floor. Amazing time here and absolutely great value to stay.
Really good guesthouse with comfortable and clean rooms the host was super nice and friendly would definitely recommend it

Had a wonderful stay at Zac Maya! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and accommodating, making sure we had everything we needed. Highly recommend for a relaxing and enjoyable experience!

Nice place - clean & comfortable bed with A/C. Easy to find and do self check in. Host was responsive on messages. Good value for money. They even left a little chocolate on pillows and some bottles of water. 5 stars.

We had a really nice stay at Casa Maya, everything was clean and tidy and the owners were very friendly. The apartment had everything we needed, we got a really good recommendation for a breakfast spot close by.  We would happily recommend to stay here for anyone. :)

A stunning apartment with high end finishes and all the amenities you could require during your stay.  I thoroughly enjoyed my time here.  Main sites are in walkable distance and there is a quiet garden on the first level that is very pretty.  The balcony also features a lovely view of the university. Staff were very responsive and it was nice to have recommendations on the website of what is local to the area.  If I had any feedback is that the hot water tends to run out if you have a longer shower so just keep that in mind if there's two people staying or you have long hair like me!  I would definitely stay here again ☺️
It was a great stay. Really nice place. Enough space. Amazing view. Indoor and outdoor pool   Very nice guys that rented the flat. Anytime again

The apartment was just as beautiful as the pictures suggested. The location could not be any better. We did not use any form of transport except our feet for the entire duration of our stay. The neighbourhood is lively and there are exceptional restaurants and cool stores just around the corner. The entire experience was very smooth. Would return anytime.

A cozy and species apartment with everything you need. Well equipped kitchen, amazing shower and all is clean and new. Super nice hosts!!  They made sure we’re comfortable and satisfied. Zero complains and strongly recommended :)

Pedro and Joanna are amazing hosts. They’re attentive, responsive and you can see them working to keep the building clean. The apartment was clean, prepared for all the guests with towels and beds ready, and they even set a few coffee capsules and teas for when you wake up. Lovely stay, 100% would come back if I visit Porto again.
Paolo was an amazing host! Not only was he extremely kind, but went above and beyond making sure our needs were met:) Thank you again!

Clean airbnb and safe area. Very small, but perfect for one night with 3 people. Walkable from Porto sao bento train station *kinda*. The person messaging was slightly aggressive in asking for our passport information, but otherwise a nice stay.
Great host. Self check in was easy. The apartment's location is great. It's possible to walk to main attractions. The neighborhood felt safe and not noisy.
Everything is great, just like it in the photo, it’s clean, bright and quiet. It makes us feel even more relaxed than at home.
Our stay in Porto was very comfortable and quiet, even with its of noise in the area.  Good insulation.  I felt like the place was a little light on supplies.
Beautiful apartment with an incredible view. Carolina was kind, quick to respond, and very helpful. Would definitely stay here again!

Wonderful experience and stay. The condo looked exactly like the photos (maybe even better!). Breathtaking views and great location. Walkable to many attractions and great restaurants. A fully stocked kitchen - we were able to cook a home cooked meal seamlessly. Clean bathroom with a great shower and cleansing products. The bedrooms were also comfortable. Quick and reliable communication. Really friendly too. If I’m back in Porto, I would love to stay here again.
Great place to stay with a beautiful view of the river. The hosts were great and very accommodating! 10/10 stay

We had the best stay here. The home is a magical space with the most romantic beautiful panoramic views! We loved the pool, balcony and terrace. The house had everything we needed and was extremely comfortable. The surrounding area was exactly what we wanted to explore the old town, parks etc. It was a peaceful, quiet and relaxing stay. The host was super helpful responding quickly and giving local recommendations. I hope I can stay here again, it was super special!

This place is absolutely breath taking. We arrived at sunset and the views were unparalleled. Inside, the apartment was immaculately clean with nice linens and had everything we needed for a weekend stay. Somehow it’s even better than the photos and the architecture makes it one of a kind. You’re a 10-15 minute walk from loads of attractions and top restaurants. Highly recommend breakfast at Noshi’s nearby. Luis and Carolina were always fast to respond and took care to make sure check in and out went smoothly. One of my top experiences on Airbnb!

We loved our stay at this apartment. Everything was clean, looked just like in the pictures. We had all the equipments that were described.  With metro the old town is 20 minutes, the beach is about 40 minutes away, and easily accessible.  Sandia was very nice and friendly. She was helpful and responsive to all our questions.  In consumption we were absolutely satisfied, would book again.

Absolutely loved the place: the room is clean and has everything you might need. Complimentary bottle of water and cookies are a nice touch. 😊It’s easy to get to the sights by public transportation as the metro is about 5 -minute walk and the bus stop is very close. The neighborhood is quiet. Will stay again when in Porto. Highly recommend. 👍🏻
The place was peaceful. My room was immaculate, resembling a four-star hotel. The bathroom was spotless.

Very cute place! The hosts were very kind and kept in touch for any worries of ours. The bed was comfortable and we were given some snacks and water upon arrival! The room was a little smaller than anticipated but matched the description and was lovely nonetheless. Great stay overall!!

We had a very pleasant stay at the apartment. Enough space for two. Fully equipped kitchen and clean bathroom. The neighborhood was safe and there were restaurants and supermarket nearby. It takes almost 10-15 minutes walk to the city center. The host was always very responsive. We enjoyed our stay and we surely recommend it.

The apartment was great, exactly what we we needed. The full kitchen was definitely great to have. And the location was close enough to be able to walk to most of the attractions that we wanted to visit.  Grocery store and pharmacy well within walking distance. Overall great experience here and would definitely recommend to others and we would come back.

My room was very nice and comfortable. The house is a lovely large home, this was fun. The bus 204 is directly across the street, 600 bus is two blocks, several other bus lines are a long block away, and the metro is about 4 blocks away, making it easy to get around the city. This was a good central location.
A very nice hotel in a familyhouse behind a gate, just in a sidestreet of a bigger street, away from the noise, in a luxurious neighborhood.

The communication with the host was good and they left some snacks and several towels for us in the room which was nice. The house was really beautiful and clean and there are a balcony and a terrace where you can sit down and eat. But the beds were not really comfortable and our room was darker and smaller than we expected. Our room was right next to the common bathroom so we woke up several times in the morning because people were shutting the door really loudly. The area is a bit remote but quiet during the night. All in all, it was a good accomodation for our short trip.
Very nice room and beautiful house, quiet, including everything needed. Maria very nice host providing a nice-to-do list for Porto
Maria was really helpful with her suggestions,  quick reply and always said yes for our requests. the house is very nice and spotless clean :) definitely will stay again.  thank you so much
Nice big house, everything looked fine. Maria was very responsive while we were checking in and that made our experience a lot easier.
lovely place, convenient location in a quieter part but still walkable to the centre! didn't miss anything

Our stay was great, accommodation was clean and all amenities were good. The kitchens are well equipped and kept tidy. It’s about a 30 minute walk into the centre of the city, and the area is nice and quiet.

Overall Nuno is an incredible host who was very helpful, proactive, honest, and kind. His hospitality really helped out during our stay in Porto. The place itself is well furnished with beautiful art and all the amenities you would need for the stay. The studio was very clean and organized. We were perhaps not expecting to have a shared (locked) door with the rest of the owner’s house. Additionally, the location while being between the ocean and the city center might not be for all guests. However, besides some minor icks, we recommend this property. We are very grateful for Nuno’s hospitality and to be able to stay in a beautiful home!

Nuno is a really wonderful host, he does everything to make his guests feel comfortable! And if you need any information about the city, he is immediately at hand with his helpful knowledge. Very comfortable bed, super clean apartment with stylish interior - plus a bottle of wine as a gesture of welcome. The famous museum for modern art is just round the corner.

Nuno is a great host, and has a wonderful spot in a quiet area between the sea and the old town in Porto. Nuno was always helpful and friendly, and he was super flexible with our timing and stay. Happy to recommend them!
Great value, clean, good location! I’m glad I was able to stay here during my trip. Thank you!!
The place was in a great location, clean, welcoming and had everything we needed.  Hosts were very responsive and kind.
the place is beautiful on the inside though there was a persistent unpleasant smell from the bathroom. if you stay for a few days it would be worth asking for extra towels.
Lovely apartment, well equipped and clean. Staff very responsive and helpful. Everything was on the spot except an unpleasant smell in the toilet, presumably from the drill.

Two lovely apartments for our group of 5. In a quiet part of the town but easy to walk to the town centre or Ubers are very cheap here. There is  Carla’s restaurant and bar underneath and a shop next  door. Carla and the staff were very friendly offering us coffee on the last day and letting us leave our bags after check out as we had an evening flight.
We loved Carla’s two units which we rented as one for a mixed family group. The location was especially great for exploring the old town.  We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to friends.
Francisco Conde and the Conde Surf Camp were wonderful! He’s an excellent host and was very helpful!

The place was on a quiet street yet central, only a stone’s throw to the Clerigos Tower. Lots of shops and restaurants nearby. They provided local recommendations and were very responsive to our queries. Space was clean. Would appreciate if they provided shower gel/ shampoo. Overall, very pleasant stay.

We loved our stay in Porto, the apartment location was perfect for all of the restaurants and walking to the river. We really enjoyed the balcony and the view over the city. Host was very responsive with any of our queries.
Good location Leakage on the bathroom floor whenever it rained, and beds on lower level are not as advertised. Otherwise decent place

Very central and easy walks to old tram line and old town.   Several good resturants close by and Xau Laura was exceptional.    Hosts were very friendly and made helpful recommendations.    Very tasteful modern apartment that’s very well located.    Pool was small and often busy but clean and so nice after a day walking.     Wi-Fi was good after 1st day (had a fault).  …     Finding it was easy but wasn’t sure which door plus keypad  number didn’t. Work a couple of times.   All very minor and family quick to respond

We highly recommend this immaculate apartment which is in very easy walking distance to all the great restaurants and beautiful old town of Porto. our only word of advice is that if you're driving be mindful that the streets of this part of Porto are very narrow and steep.
Great apartment for a longer stay - you have everything you’ll need in it, plus a lot of restaurants nearby, plus a lot of places reachable by foot.

I felt like I was in the middle of the action, yet the neigborhood itself was so peaceful! I could get to anywhere in the Ribeira area within a 10 minute walk, and just a bit more to go downtown and to Bolhão. The accommodations were as advertised, super clean and tidy. Would recommend!
We had a fantastic time - the location was perfect and the apartment was modern and clean. Couldn't have asked for a better space.

We had wonderful stay at Jessica’s place. Very neat and superbly clean. The washer/dryer was truly a treat. She’s on top of her emails. Really appreciate her as well as Damila with our questions and needs. Will come back and stay here again next time we visit Porto. Thank you!

We very much enjoyed staying at Jessica’s place. It was very easy to get to interesting things to see in the nearby neighborhood, and we got lots of exercise; there are lots of hills. Our unit felt safe, and it was very clean and neat. Jessica was also very responsive to questions I asked during our stay.

Excellent place for our family get together for a birthday celebration. Benita our host went above and beyond with recommendations for restaurants, sites to see etc. Including a surprise birthday & wine !! The house was perfect, well supplied kitchen and super clean. Overall would highly recommend.
Douro Garden was a great house in a good location next to a tram. Communication with the host was smooth and they were flexible throughout the stay. Highly recommend the place for a trip to Porto.

The place was spacious, very clean, and had everything you could want. Benita was fantastic. Truly an exceptional host that went above and beyond. She not only assisted us with recommendations of places to see; she was a great resource in helping us find restaurants and booking reservations for our group.  The host can certainly make a difference and Benita certainly did that and more. If you're staying in Porto this is the place to stay.

Such a great cute space!  And RIGHT downtown.  Near everything - convenience store across the street - umbrella store for the rain - cafe and restaurants steps away. I slept downstairs and my daughter slept in the low ceiling loft - incredible value. I would highly recommend and I’d certainly stay again.
Fresh, secure, impeccably clean, new furnishings and appliances, central to everything, and very quiet at night. Quant setup inside with clever space saving stairs to cosy loft bedroom.
The apartment is exactly like the pictures and has everything you need. The place is close to all attractions within walking distance. Thanks again Elson.

The place is tiny and very well decorated. We had everything we needed and there is a coffee place just around the corner with nice people. That was very convenient for having our breakfast  I will just add that the stair to go upstairs is quite heavy, so be careful if you are having knee problems (but same can be said about the city 😂)

The location was fantastic! Close to everything! I would definitely recommend staying here and I’d love to come back and stay again. Very communicative host and a great value for the price! Two thumbs up.
It was great. One of the reviewers lied saying there was a washing machine but it was still great. Everything is in walking distance and wifi was good.
Elson was a great & responsive host. The apartment is very centrally located making it easy to walk everywhere.

This is a wonderful spot! Highly recommend! Great location, easy to walk to so many great places and felt safe. Elson really made the whole experience better - he is an excellent host. Super responsive, helpful and gave some great recommendations!
The apartment is very well located for exploring the city on foot. Everything was clean and check-in was easy. We had a nice stay.
The apartment was clean and modern with comprehensive amenities. The host was very helpful and responsive. We had a great stay.
Amazing place, amenities were great and everything was perfecty clean and as shown in pictures. Would definitly come back amd recommend strongly.
Great location, beautiful nice and clean unit close to shops and restaurants. However the home did not have the essentials like dishwashing soap, shampoo,etc.
Great stay, perfect apartment, clean and well equipped. True to the description. The host is responsive and professional. Have a good stay!
I can only recommend! Place was super clean very good equipped and communication was very nice with very useful info about location but also Porto in general.
Beautiful beautiful beautiful apartment that would definitely wanna visit one more time! Great location with walking distance to everything you might need!
The place was just what we needed and central enough to be out and about all day and make it back to sleep easy. Odete was very responsive and helpful.
We had a lovely stay in Porto! Place was exactly as described. No sharp knife to cut meat/ veggies/ bread. So keep that in mind but not perfect location :)
Smell was bad, window to allow smell out was too small to vent effectively or cool the room. Host was rather mean in her responses
Perfect location, very clean, easy check-in, great furnishing. A bit expensive but worth it!

The place is in a good location and walking distance to the main attractions.  The place was very clean and confortable, also no noisi during sleep hours which is great! Very responsive host, friendly and helpful. We had a great stay here!

Pros - place looked just like the pictures. Very clean  and modern space  - had all the basics and essentials needed for our stay  - great location  - host was very responsive and helpful Cons - I wouldn't even consider this a con as the issue was dealt with very quickly. The power went out in the morning and the host got someone in the house immediately dealing with the issue.  loved our stay here and would highly recommend!

Don’t turn down this place! It’s perfect! Cozy, comfortable, convenient, quiet!!! Scenic street close to everything. Very thoughtful in including all the amenities! Everything was high end which made the stay so fabulous!! Snatch this place when you can!
We enjoyed our stay at the house, which was clean and well equipped. The host responded quickly to any questions. Towels and bedsheets was changed in the middle of the week, which was very nice.

Great location, 15 minute walk to beach which was enjoyable. Close to cafes and restaurants. (Be mindful on weekends not as much availability as some closed) Easy to reach from the metro which was 6 minutes walk away. We were able to enjoy the jazz festival close by in July. Would recommend the area for families. The beach was great and we were able to do some surfing. Beach towels aren't provided by property.

The house was in good shape but the outdoors space and the rugs were quite dirty which was a bummer with two toddlers. This is in a very residential area so not much to do in the immediate vicinity. The hosts were helpful and also arranged for a midweek towel and sheet change which was great!

Manuel was very kind, hospitable and accommodating. Keep in mind Maia is not close to city centre, but I managed to get out by taking a bus and train. I enjoyed my stay and got everything I needed. Space I stayed  had lots of room and a modern TV so that was a huge plus. Thankyou again Manuel! Would definitely come back!

Stayed here for a weekend & it was great! Unit was clean & the host was very responsive. The location is also great right in the middle of the city - which was a little loud due to construction at this moment but definitely not too bad because there was nothing overnight. The unit is also beautiful inside and includes three balcony windows to see the view of the classic Portuguese tiles.

The location of the apartment was excellent — right in the middle of all the main attractions. They had kindly provided a travel crib, high chair, and baby bathtub for our little one, which was a big help. Overall, we were very satisfied with our stay. Thank you, Home Me — hope to see you again!

Location was amazing. Room was spacious with lots of natural light.  Family of four no issues.  Many great locations to eat. Parking was 1min away under ground at 80euro for two nights. Tuktuks right around the corner. A must do to explore city and get to know the locations and hot spots. 1.5hr 80euro but well worth it.  Walking distance to The water was 15min walk. I would stay at this place with my family again.
Perfect place for a peaceful stay. Also in a great location where a lot of places to visit nearby. Definitely want to stay again :)

Excellent apartment and location. Wish I could have stayed longer! Walking distance to everything with grocery store and things nearby. Quiet with no noise from neighbors or street. Host management company very responsive and helpful when there were issues.

I was very impressed with the location and the overall accomodation. the price is comparable to 4 star hotels in the area while the comfort is 5 stars.  the only issue was the laundry detergent is not provided even though they said it will. however you can buy across the street for 5 Euro. I left the rest for the next guest and I hope they enjoy it more than we did!
Our family is very grateful for the rest and the impressions! The facilities are comfortable, pleasant, and very conveniently located! The view is stunning!

We really enjoyed our stay here. The appartment was very clean when we arrived and complete with all items (towels, kitchen utensiles, etc.). The apperment is rather big, and we loved the terrace with a view of the city and the river. It was very quiet during our stay. The road to get there is quite steep, so be mindful if you have mobility issues. Overall, we highly recommend it.
This was such a beautiful apartment! The balcony was incredible, and even a complimentary wine bottle was left for me when I arrived! 10/10 stay
A nice place for the price. Clean and plenty of room. The street is quite loud at night.
We really loved our stay in this house! The location is perfect, as well as the view. You have a lot of privacy and the staff is really nice. Would definetely recommend!!!
Nice little house, very comfortable and very clean. Equipped with everything you need. Great location.

The place was really cute, the area is fantastic, the river is really next by (scenery was beautiful) it’s so easy to go anywhere from there ! The hosts were nice, gave us some recommandations and were quick to reply ! Amazing stay

This stay and continuing on is the longest vacation I’ve ever taken completely on my own and in a foreign country. Eduardo and Elizabete were wonderful helping me with some initial things but after that and finding my way I was just giddy with excitement about the walkability from there and the comfortable sleep at night. I’m across the bridge now which has an even more historic feel (and older accommodation) Come visit, stay with EEE(-; you won’t regret it.
Rita was very helpful for my stay. Nice place to stay, was grateful there was a kettle for tea

We really enjoyed this neat and well equipped house. The patio was great to relax after a busy day and we really appreciated the aircon! Very quiet and walking distance from all the places we wanted to go as tourists.

Just lovely. Place was clean and welcoming. Very much a local neighbourhood. Close to everything and walkable to most everywhere in Porto. Metro and train stations close by. Host very friendly and helpful provided us with so much helpful information. Would love to return and stay again. Thank you.

co-host Rita was amazing.  She gave us a recommendation for a restaurant that was delicious and on the river.  She also arranged taxi service for us.  If we ever come back to Porto just the two of us we would definitely stay again.  If other people come with us we can't because it only sleeps 2. 😍🌞
The place is very well located in the city centre and close to the tube station and great restaurants and bakeries. The apartment was super clean and the host was super friendly.
Nice stay and responsive host! Just keep in mind it is right by a road so can be a tad noisy :)

The apartment was in a great location, walking distance to lots of restaurants and attractions. The apartment was a great size and well equipped with everything we would need. The host was very responsive and also gave us lots of local recommendations. We would stay again!

I had a fantastic stay in Porto! The apartment was spotless, comfortable, and perfectly located—just steps away from everything you’d want to see in the city. What truly made the experience stand out was the host. Incredibly friendly, responsive, and always willing to help with recommendations or any questions we had. It felt like we had a local guide just a message away. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto!

Filipa and Bryan were very friendly and the apartment had everything we could have needed and was in a good location near to the river. They provided a range of great recommendations of places to eat and visit. Would definitely stay here again the next time we visit Porto.

The apartment was in a great location and had everything we needed for our stay. The hosts were responsive and helpful, and we appreciated the easy check-in process. A higher attention to detail with the cleaning would have been appreciated. However, it was a good value for the price and a great location - overall a pleasant stay.

Please note, picking up keys from lockbox is NOT on property as incorrectly indicated in communication with Guest Ready, which was a very unwelcome surprise after a long travel day. Otherwise the place was clean and comfortable. The towels could use replacing as they’re very thin and worn and we were only provided one bath & hand towel each for a 5 night stay. The washer is also a dryer, which was a delightful surprise as we needed to do laundry. There is also a bonus office room in addition to the two bedrooms. The location could have been better but it was close to metro & Mercado (great vegetarian restaurant on 2nd floor ‘Casa Vegetariana’). Note that the walk to the apartment from the metro is up a steep hill but manageable for us with small carry on luggage. We enjoyed our stay in Porto.
We had a very comfortable stay at the apartment. We found that it had everything we needed. I would recommend the location.

Lovely, cosey little studio/flat near Trinidad. Really good location! Comfy bed and stay.  Great little cafe on the corner of the street. Nice and quiet! Had a lovey week in this flat and would love to visit again!

This flat is lovely and ideally situated for exploring Porto. It's conveniently located near coffee shops, supermarkets, and restaurants. Communication with GuestReady was a pleasure; they were quick to respond and resolve any issues. We highly recommend this flat!✨️✨️

Overall, the location is great, but there were stains on the couch and the place wasn’t thoroughly cleaned. We stayed for 5 nights and were only provided with 2 towels. Extra towels came at an additional charge of 30 euros, which isn’t ideal for a longer stay. That said, the host was responsive, and the location is very central, you're close to everything

We had a great time in Porto! The apartment was very clean and cosy. It had everything we needed for a short stay (three nights). The location is great, a little outside of the city centre, but still at walking distance, and close to the beautiful gardens of Palácio de Cristal. Hugo and Dyhia were very responsive and helpful. Agradecemos-vos por tudo!

Our stay was great! The accommodation was perfect, very clean and comfortable. The location was really good, everything was easily accessible. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay!

Hugo and his team are very polite and ready to help. They explained in perfect detail how to get to the flat, and answered all our questions as soon as they could. The flat was very comfy and nice for our honeymoon trip. Porto is great in September. I would recommend anyone to stay here

Miguel's place is a great find—affordable, well-located, and perfect for exploring Porto. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay. I’d be happy to stay here again if I return to the city.
great place to stay for a couple nights as a single traveler on a budget! Miguel was very responsive and let me store my bags there prior to check in.

I really enjoyed staying in this apartment. It’s located in a nice building with beautiful wooden floors. It has heater, and everything needed for a comfortable stay. The mattress is very comfortable, which is a very important aspect for me when choosing accommodation. The apartment is also conveniently located, with the old town and central spots just about a 20-minute walk away. I would definitely stay here again.
Comfortable stay, a bit out of the centre of Porto but close to transport and shops. Definitely worth it.

Hugo was a great host, very attentive and responsive. In terms of the apartment, everything was clean and and comfortable for our group. Only downside to note is that even though there was a fan in the apt (there’s no ac), it gets really warm in there. Aside from that we enjoyed our stay and appreciated all of the hosts’ attention.
Great, the only sad part about this place is the location which was hard to access by car. You have to park in a street close to the apartment if there is space left.
Nice apartment, clean, in good location. Hosts are very friendly and helpful, provided all necessary information. Highly recommend!
Good place to stay. Can walk to the caves. Parking is a minimum of 250m away, not 50m, and is sometimes hard to find a spot

Fantastic apartment, one of the best we’ve stayed in. The apartment was very well furnished and equipped, practically brand new. A comfortable walk to the Gaia side of the river or a very short all to the bus stop. Highly recommend and would definitely stay here again.
Our stay was lovely, a very modern apartment in a walkable location. Quiet and clean with a great shower.

We had an amazing stay in Porto! The apartment was in a fantastic location — right in the heart of everything, which made it easy to explore the city on foot. The check-in process was seamless, and the gentleman who greeted us was incredibly friendly, full of local knowledge, and gave us great recommendations for food and things to do. The accommodation was comfortable, clean, and had everything we needed for a great stay. Would highly recommend GuestReady and would definitely book again!
Really nice place to stay in Porto. Some issues with the WiFi which was not the fault of the owner. Fast communication.

We stayed 4 days, and the place was cleaned and restock with toiletries on the 3rd day which was great.  We paid $10.00/night for private parking right next to the unit.  Everywhere we went was walkable so no need to buy tram tickets.  Porto has a lot of up and down cobblestone, so it was a good exercise.  We used the recommendations for restaurants through Pedro and Guruwalk guide.  We ate where the locals eat which is better food and less expensive for sure.  We spent 4 days in Lisbon and we used tram tickets there but not too expensive.  Overall, we will stay here again.  Thank you Pedro.

Pedro’s place was fantastic! It was located in a quiet neighborhood. The apartment was clean and well stocked. Pedro even provided different guides with Porto suggestions. I would recommend this place.

The stay was absolutely great! The apartment is compact, cozy, and fully equipped with everything you might need. The location is perfect — right in the heart of Porto. Pedro provided detailed instructions for check-in and was very attentive to every detail. Everything went smoothly, and I really enjoyed the experience. Highly recommend!

The flat was beautiful, spotless and thoughtfully provisioned with everything we needed for our break, including slippers and cotton pads in the bathroom. Pedro was so helpful and welcoming too. A great host, lovely location near all the sights and gorgeous place to stay.
The air bnb was exactly how the pictures looked - the living area was actually bigger than expected. Location was great and Laura was super responsive - thank you so much!

Great location, a short walk to many of the main attractions in Porto. The neighbourhood itself felt very safe. We really appreciated the towels and toiletries as well. The apartment is spacious and we were very comfortable because of the amazing AC in each room. One of the washrooms was a little tiny so just be aware of that. The other washroom was large and even had a bidet! It was very convenient to have Ali's Supermarket right downstairs for fruits, snacks, and travelsize toiletries! We'd also recommend the empanada shop closeby as well as the House of Coffee Porto for breakfast and amazing lattes! Thanks for a great stay!

Pedro was such a lovely host and very responsive. The airbnb felt like a mini hotel room in the heart of Porto. The bed was comfortable and the pillows felt luxurious. The bathroom was clean and well lit. There were lots of plugs available. The location was perfect, quiet and walkable to restaurants, clubs and attractions. Pedro also was very accommodating as we had an evening flight and needed to leave our bags with him. Would come back here and highly recommend.
We had a great stay with Pedro. The communication was quick and super easy. We loved our stay. The place was clean and very well located.

The apartment and Pedro were both fantastic. The apartment was great, everything you need and in a convenient location. Pedro was one of the best hosts we’ve experienced, always responsive and happy to help. We recommend the e-bikes for a cycle down the coast!
Very good place for a short break in Porto. Good localization , near some delicious restaurants and historic center. Very spaceous. With airco if you need. I recommend
Host was very attentive and the place was big, cozy and very well equipped for everything we needed. We had a great time in Porto and this place contributed to that.

The location of this stay is perfect! In an area that feels more local than touristy and is away from the density of the city, while also having easy access to the attractions and city. The place itself is perfect for a family or friends, lots of space to move around and good areas to lounge. I recommend this place for any large group!
Good recommendation for this appartment 👍🏻👍🏻. Nice location, near to the famous bridge, good restaurants, riverside. everything was perfect 👍🏻👍🏻

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Lovely place and wonderful host! Claudia’s home was absolutely lovely—clean, cozy, and in a lively location.  She was incredibly friendly and helpful throughout our stay, always available if we had any questions.  Highly recommend staying here if you’re looking for a warm and welcoming experience!

We stayed for three nights on this apartment in Porto and I wish we had stayed many more!  Excellent location, near the port, well communicated with public transport, as well as in walking distance to pretty much everywhere. The apartment is small and doesn’t have great views, however it has lots of natural light, it’s clean and modern. It worked great for the four of us.

Apartment was exactly as described in pictures and details. Paulo was always responsive through out - pre booking, post booking, checking, during our stay and after. Great recommendations. Apartment is very close to attractions and very convenient to go anywhere.  It is on the heart of busy area. Good, small and cozy accommodation for 2 couples or small family. We were family of 4 with 2 Teenage kids and it was very comfortable for 4 of us.  It was the right accommodation for the price we paid during the peak travel season.  We will definitely be back and highly recommend.
Every amenity was found in this beautiful apartment.   Very clean. Welcome basket with treats we didn’t even get through. Best location.  Enjoyed every minute

Spacious 2 bedroom apartment in a quiet neighborhood. It has all the amenities that you would need for a short or long stay. Antonio was very responsive and accommodating. I would definitely recommend this place.

Wonderful few days in Porto.  Really great location close to everything but quiet enough to get some sleep.  The apartment is brand new and super clean. And we benefited from an early check in which was very much appreciated 👏.

Euclides’ apartment was exactly what we needed to explore the city and be walkable to most things we wanted to see.  Very clean, well furnished, and if this is as important to you as it is to my wife (the shower has crazy water pressure!).
Brand new apartment, beautifully decorated, convenient location to sights, shops, and restaurants.  Very clean and comfortable! We would stay here again!
Very clean place. Clear instructions to get in. Our kids really enjoyed the porch. 10 minutes walk to the dom luis bridge with 2 kids.
Exceptional location, and very nice flat. A good size for Porto, plenty of space and the terrace was a real pleasure to have.
had a lovely stay here! the location was very ideal with stunning views and the apartment was just what we needed!! would definitely recommend

Such a good experience. It was my first time in Portugal/Porto and Isabel&Felipe couldn't have been better hosts.  I was welcomed with warmth, given recommendations about the city, what to do and how to get around. They also gave me a free ride to the airport🥰 The place is worth all of the money. It's exactly as in the pictures and has everything you need. It's peaceful and gives you the feel of a little getaway in the Portuguese heaven.  Location is also close to the bus station and LIDL. I will definitely stay again when I'm back. Thank you for your hospitality Isabel&Felipe and congratulations for giving visitors such a great experience😊

Great location. Private and secure but welcoming. Super close to shopping and restaurants. Great hosts. Very helpful and organised. We were late arriving and it was no trouble and they were on hand to sort us out. Great place. Would stay again. And dog friendly which is always great.
We really enjoyed staying here. It's private and cute. It's in a great location- 15 minute walk to Avenida dos Aliados. The breakfast was well served. Iron was provided on request. Pleasant stay.
It was just perfect. We got all the help we needed and the host was very kind and reactive. The surroundings are perfect if you’re looking for a place in the vibrant part of the city centre!

Great place in the heart of Porto. A couple streets away (3mins) from the main party streets but also far enough away that it is quiet. AC was great in the heat of Summer and room was clean and functional.
Good accommodation for its price and location.  Highly recommend SO Coffee Roasters next door, STORY and Do Norte Cafe for breakfasts.

The location of the house is amazing, you just cross the road and you’re on the beach and there’s plenty of space. The water is cold and the waves are strong, but you can always move along the beach and look for better spot to swim. The city is close by car but we also walked along the beach and it took us less than 1 hour with 3 kids. Farol restaurant was ace! The host, Maria, is very responsive and always helpful. The one thing that the description of the house didn’t mention is that your accommodation has certain communal features, like washing machine, BBQ and ironing. You also have to pass through the owner’s garage to access the apartments. Some might find it not fully private and might need to know it before booking. However, we had a great time as a family and we would recommend the property and the host to other visitors.
Lovely apartment and hosts. It looks just like in the pictures, is very well located and it was very easy to check in and check out. Overall it was a great experience.

We had such a great time staying at this apartment in Porto! The location is perfect, just a short walk to the ocean which made morning walks and sunsets super special. There are also some great little cafes and restaurants nearby, and it was really easy to get into the city when we wanted to explore more.  The apartment itself was super clean, comfy, and had everything we needed and the ocean view from the window is magnificent. The two bedrooms were a good size and having 1.5 bathrooms was a big plus especially when getting ready in the mornings. The kitchen was well stocked, and we even had some local snacks and coffee waiting for us, which was a nice touch. Wi-Fi worked great, check-in was easy, and the host was super friendly and helpful. Overall, it felt like a home away from home. Would definitely stay here again next time we’re in Porto!

Probably the loveliest hotel we’ve ever stayed in! Daniela was a warm and welcoming host. The room was designed beautifully and was huge and spotless! Rituals products in the bathroom were a nice touch. The lobby and breakfast area was lovely and breakfast was a real spread, tasty and in a perfect environment. Location was great too - everything was walkable. Would recommend it to everyone.

Extremely nice, cozy and surprisingly spacious apartment in a clean, quiet building just a few minutes away from the city center. The hosts are responsive and helpful. The   check-in was very fast and comfortable, would recommend to anyone looking to visit Porto

I had a wonderful stay! The location was very walkable, which made exploring super easy. Raquel was such a lovely host, always friendly and helpful. The apartment itself was ideal — clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed. The balcony was definitely a plus, perfect for relaxing after a day out. Highly recommend!

Amazing location, close to everything!  Comfortable bed and sheets that smelled so good that made me smile  Very flexible and friendly host. Easy check-in. Not too many steps to go up to the apartment. I felt safe walking at night. Price is fair. Highly recommend it!
This apartment is gorgeous and so cute. It’s central and near lots of food, the bridge for sunset. And it’s pretty easy to check in and out! Wish I could’ve stayed longer!
